And this little porcelain doll-like infant is Lu Chuan’s new hope and precious treasure.
Suddenly Lu Chuan realized he hasn’t even named this little one since he picked her up.
Since she’s human, she should have her own name.
Lu Chuan felt a bit clueless, having never considered naming a child before.
As for the surname, it’s simple. Being his daughter, she’ll take his surname.
Lu... Lu what?
Lu Chuan ran through all sorts of poems and words he had memorized from his past life in his mind.
Yet, in his rush, he couldn’t come up with a good name.
Until he glanced out the window and suddenly made up his mind.
Since we’re living on the seventh floor, and this is our first home in this world, I’ll call you Lu Qiqi.
Your nickname will be Qiqi.
No matter what happens in the future, as long as we think of your name, we’ll remember the good times living together in this little seventh-floor home.
From a down-and-out youth to a father, Lu Chuan’s mindset has changed. He no longer lives aimlessly just for himself.
Qiqi, don’t worry, Daddy will ensure you grow up carefree.
In this apocalypse, Daddy will create a sanctuary for you!

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Zombie Showdown!
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13: Zombie Showdown!
Lu Chuan looked at the results of his efforts from the night and nodded with satisfaction.
The various storage spaces and open areas in the room were now filled with all sorts of supplies he had brought over.
Even with Qiqi’s considerable appetite, it was definitely enough to last him a long time.
After all, no matter how much the little guy could eat, at the end of the day, he was just a baby, and could only drink formula every day.
With plenty of supplies prepared, Lu Chuan decided to stay at home for a while.
In the apocalypse, survival is key. Moreover, given that he has awakened an ability to control zombies, it means this world is far from as simple as he had imagined.
Lu Chuan could understand that the individual zombies’ physical abilities could strengthen over time or with constant devouring.
But being able to control zombie actions completely defied the laws of biological nature.
The blood moon hanging high last night made Lu Chuan feel deeply uneasy.
He had changed, and it was hard to guarantee that other zombies wouldn’t as well.
No one knew what strange powers zombies might have after evolving, so Lu Chuan decided to lie low for a while.
After all, having just reincarnated in this world and then being attacked by zombies, Lu Chuan didn’t feel that his luck was particularly good...
After feeding Qiqi, Lu Chuan decided to observe the building for a while before considering going out after confirming the outside world was safe.
Anyway, he had already gathered a lot of supplies and didn’t mind staying a few more days.
"This world is really unfamiliar, changing in peculiar ways every moment..."
"If it were just myself, I’d accept this neither human nor ghostly life, but now that there’s Qiqi, I must become stronger!"Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn
Lu Chuan went to the living room and picked up a steel machete about half a meter long.
He had found it in a room on the sixth floor while sweeping through the building earlier.
According to Lu Chuan’s memory of this city, it also prohibited controlled knives.
Who knows what the previous owner of that place did for a living to have such a long machete, and a very sharp one at that.
The straight back and heavy blade made it very suitable for long periods of hacking, typical of a chopping knife.
However, clearly, the previous set of rules didn’t apply in this apocalypse.
After a night of the Blood Moon Mutation, besides his ability to control other zombies, Lu Chuan’s physical fitness had also improved significantly.
His body’s agility was no different from an ordinary human, whereas before, his limbs were stiff, only capable of simple actions.
But now, he could swing the machete fluidly, with the blade flashing silver arcs in the air.
Though Lu Chuan had never practiced any specific knife skills, as a zombie, his physical strength surpassed ordinary humans.
At this moment, he wielded the machete with powerful and swift movements.
Lu Chuan began to practice knife techniques in the living room following moves he remembered from martial arts novels and movies.
The machete cut through the air with a whooshing sound as it sliced, producing a sound of slicing through the air.
Looking at the machete, Lu Chuan was very pleased; its sharp edge made it an excellent close combat weapon.
The machete’s lethality far exceeded that of a crowbar.
Lu Chuan felt confident that he could cleave a zombie’s head in half with a single stroke of the machete.
The difference between humans and other animals is that humans can learn to use tools. All those zombies on the street don’t know how to use weapons and only know to tear with teeth and claws.
But Lu Chuan was different; with human consciousness, he naturally had to master this more scientific and advanced way of fighting.
Lu Chuan was confident that with a knife in hand, he could at least fight several zombies at once.
While Lu Chuan was practicing his knife skills, Ji Ruxue, after resting for a while, regained her Telekinesis and began to ponder her Talent Abilities.
In this life, Ji Ruxue had two very powerful powers: Time Control.
It was something she had from her previous life, already very familiar with, requiring no practice to release as long as she had enough telekinetic power.
The other was the Telekinesis Control she had newly awakened, which required practice over time to master.
Ji Ruxue concentrated intensely, focusing on a silver needle on the nightstand.
Under Ji Ruxue’s telekinetic control, the silver needle slowly floated into the air.
Following Ji Ruxue’s gestures, the needle drew a path in the air.
The silver needle hovered above Ji Ruxue’s head, looking utterly incredible.
It was like a scene from a sci-fi movie, incomprehensible and unthinkable.
Although Ji Ruxue’s current telekinetic control was slow, she was confident that with enough practice, it would become an invisible killer technique over time.
As her telekinetic power increased, the weight of the objects she could control would also increase over time.
It was a needle now, but perhaps one day she could control flying knives.
And like that, time flew by, and two days passed. In those two days, Lu Chuan practiced knife skills in the living room.
Ji Ruxue practiced her Sky-controlling Power in the bedroom, both living very fully, striving for a better life for each other.
One day, after feeding Ji Ruxue, Lu Chuan noticed something stirring outside.
Lu Chuan looked out the balcony window and saw on the street two zombies tearing into each other.
The commotion of their fight was loud enough for Lu Chuan on the seventh floor to hear.
Lu Chuan was puzzled, as he didn’t see any humans around those two zombies.
Having spent a month among them, Lu Chuan knew these creatures fairly well.
Zombies are ruthless, like emotionless killing machines.
But they only act when humans are around.
Typically, zombies don’t attack each other except for competing over food.
But there was clearly no food being contested below...
This was why Lu Chuan was so shocked to see the zombies fighting; it went beyond all he understood until now.

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Crystal Core!
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Chapter 14: Crystal Core!
"Huh? These two zombies seem a bit off."
Lu Chuan, observing the battle from the rooftop, suddenly noticed that these two zombies seemed different from those he usually saw.
However, the seventh floor was too high to see clearly; he could only vaguely see that one had a somewhat larger physique, seemingly more robust than a typical zombie.
The other was smaller in stature but much faster than an ordinary zombie.
This peculiar phenomenon made Lu Chuan feel a surge of caution for no apparent reason, and he quickly descended to about the fourth-floor height.
At this position, he was finally able to see clearly what was happening below.
Only then did Lu Chuan notice that these two zombies were completely different from those he encountered on ordinary days.
One of the zombies had a physique nearly two meters tall, with an extremely robust body.
It was akin to a burly strongman type, and when it swung its muscular fists, even car doors on the roadside were dented by it!
Such formidable strength made Lu Chuan click his tongue in amazement.
Lu Chuan had no doubt that if he faced this zombie, he would be thoroughly done for if it landed a punch on him.
On the opposite side of this robust zombie, the other zombie’s torso was relatively slender.
However, it was clear that its claws were quite sharp.
Ordinary zombies, even when using claws and teeth in combat, weren’t much different from humans.
Due to the zombie virus, even human bodies could experience decay issues.
Yet this somewhat slim zombie had claws akin to five daggers, leaving five scratches on a car’s body with a gentle swipe!
Watching these two powerful zombies fight from inside the building, Lu Chuan felt a wave of fear.
In recent days, he had been worried that the Blood Moon might have some effect on other zombies, so he hadn’t gone out.
In retrospect, his decision was exceedingly wise.
The combat capability of these two zombies far exceeded his own.
Lu Chuan noticed that the more robust zombie, though lacking the terrifying claws of the other, had exceptionally resilient arms.
Those arms seemed to be made of steel, producing a sound like metal clashing when facing off against the other zombie.
Lu Chuan found it hard to imagine what kind of physiological structure these two zombies had, entirely on a different level from him.
Having practiced his sword skills these past days, Lu Chuan was confident that he could easily kill an ordinary zombie.
However, the two zombies downstairs now were a real eye-opener for Lu Chuan.
If Ji Ruxue were present, she would have identified the types of these two zombies.
One was a Tank Zombie, with a robust build, and the other was an Agile Type; these were relatively common types among Evolved Zombies.
They were also the zombies that survivors found particularly troublesome during the early stages of the apocalypse.
Although Lu Chuan didn’t know the evolution types of these zombies, he could judge that they, like him, had undergone some evolution during the Blood Moon night.
However, it was clear that their evolutionary paths were different.
For instance, he could control the zombies’ actions, which was a mental evolution, whereas in personal combat, he had only slightly enhanced himself compared to before, far from reaching this terrifying level of evolution.
These two zombies evidently followed a personal combat route, with different evolutionary paths.
One had a stronger and tougher physique, while the other was agile with a strong attack.
Either one of these zombies was a disaster for ordinary zombies, capable of easily slaughtering large numbers.
Lu Chuan was immensely grateful for his caution; if he hadn’t stayed indoors this long,
he might have foolishly been killed by these two zombies or others like them.
After all, Lu Chuan’s ability was telekinesis, not comparable in close combat.
As it stands, the world is far more terrifying than he had imagined!
Lu Chuan’s mind grew increasingly heavy; his recent pride from evolution needed to be tempered with an understanding of the cruel reality of the world.
But Lu Chuan was curious about why these two zombies suddenly started fighting, as same-species generally wouldn’t cannibalize each other.
At least until now, Lu Chuan hadn’t encountered zombies that would eat each other; this was his first time seeing such a phenomenon.
"Could all the zombies outside have gone mad with hunger now? That can’t be, zombie meat is so unappetizing..."
As a zombie himself, Lu Chuan didn’t find his own meat to have any appealing taste.
His blood had long dried up; eating zombies was no better than chewing on jerky...Thɪs updatᴇd by NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The commotion from the two zombies fighting downstairs grew louder, crushing several nearby cars.
A trace of gravity flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes as he saw that a conclusion was near.
The robust Tank Zombie needed only to swing its arms to cause enormous destruction.
The agile zombie, though powerful, couldn’t break through the opponent’s defense.
Moreover, its weakened body couldn’t withstand even a single punch, while its own attacks merely managed to pierce the opponent’s arm, unable to go all out in battle.
Finally, after a chaotic skirmish, the Tank Zombie swung its fists fiercely, sending the agile zombie flying.
Then, the robust Tank Zombie, moving like a charging off-road vehicle, instantly appeared before the agile zombie.
That massive fist was incomparable to the agile zombie’s slender torso, unable to withstand the Tank Zombie’s attack.
In just a few blows, the Tank Zombie broke the agile zombie’s spine.
Bam!
Another fierce punch shattered the agile zombie’s head, ending its life completely.
The tremendous force of the blow flattened both the agile zombie and the car beneath, causing Lu Chuan to shiver involuntarily.
At this point, Lu Chuan noticed that, after the victory, the Tank Zombie pulled out a white Crystal Core from the other zombie’s head with its massive hand.
"What is this?!"
Seeing the white Crystal Core, an inexplicable desire surged in Lu Chuan’s heart, an intense longing for this item.
Although Lu Chuan didn’t know what it was, he felt that his body instinctively craved it.
It seemed that consuming the Crystal Core would greatly benefit his own body.
"Could it be that the battle between these two zombies was to seize the Crystal Core inside each other’s heads?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Ji Ruxue’s Cultivation Technique, the Glazed Breathing Technique!
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15: Ji Ruxue’s Cultivation Technique, the Glazed Breathing Technique!
Lu Chuan noticed the hulking zombie pounding its chest and letting out deep roars after consuming the white Crystal Core.The most update n0vels are published on
Lu Chuan could hear the extreme excitement in those roars.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
It seemed this white Crystal Core contained considerable power, making this brawny zombie incredibly excited, and he wildly smashed the surrounding parked cars.
The zombie stood in place roaring a few times, its voice exceptionally loud.
Some ordinary zombies nearby stopped in their tracks upon hearing the noise, then all chose to back away, instinctively feeling fear toward this brawny zombie.
After a brief outburst of emotion, the brawny zombie walked into a store opposite.
Lu Chuan waited a long time but never saw it come out, though he could faintly hear the zombie’s roars from inside the store.
Lu Chuan guessed that this zombie had probably hidden away to digest the power of that white Crystal Core.
Though Lu Chuan didn’t know what this white Crystal Core was, seeing this situation, he was entirely sure that the Crystal Core was beneficial to zombies.
Recalling the primal desire within him earlier, Lu Chuan felt somewhat agitated now.
After becoming a zombie, Lu Chuan had felt that craving for flesh and blood.
Upon seeing humans, he instinctively wanted to bite, but for some reason, Lu Chuan retained human consciousness.
Faced with human willpower, this desire for flesh was nothing to fear.
Over time, Lu Chuan had nearly lost all sense of desire for flesh.
Yet just now, Lu Chuan found that upon seeing the white Crystal Core, that primal desire far surpassed his dependency on flesh!
Lu Chuan guessed that eating other zombies’ Crystal Cores would surely bring tremendous benefits.
Perhaps these Crystal Cores could enhance abilities gained from zombie evolution!
If so, it would explain why such terrifying battles erupted between these two vastly different-sized zombies with unique powers.
That is, they both wanted to enhance their strength by devouring each other!
Reflecting on the desire that white Crystal Core stirred within him, Lu Chuan narrowed his eyes.
"If I could eat this big guy’s Crystal Core, maybe I could control more zombie followers!"
Currently, Lu Chuan’s telekinesis wasn’t powerful, with the limit being controlling only these two zombies.
Having now witnessed the changes in the post-apocalyptic world, Lu Chuan earnestly wanted to increase his own strength.
Even if not for himself, he had to strive to become strong for Qiqi.
But the problem was, the special ability gained from his evolution was controlling zombies.
Though his physique had changed somewhat, it couldn’t compare to the two downstairs at all.
The hulking zombie had an incredibly strong build, containing tremendous power, its arms as tough as steel.
And the zombie whose spine and head it crushed had a rather skinny frame, yet was extremely quick, especially those claws that made Lu Chuan shudder.
Compared to these two zombies clearly enhanced for physical and combat capabilities, Lu Chuan was obviously no match.
Lu Chuan had no doubt that if he took a punch from that zombie, he’d be done for...
Brute force confrontation was certainly unwinnable, and the current approach could only rely on wit to win.
Lu Chuan fell into contemplation, but when his gaze shifted to the kitchen’s gas tank, his eyes lit up, a plan taking form.
Yet Lu Chuan didn’t act rashly; plotting for the Crystal Core had to be done slowly.
After all, his desire to become strong was to ensure Qiqi could continue to grow healthily in this world.
If he messed up and died at the hands of the big guy, Little Qiqi would have no one to care for her, and he couldn’t put the cart before the horse.
...
Lying on the bed, Ji Ruxue naturally heard the tremendous commotion outside.
Although constrained by her current body, inhibiting sight of what was happening downstairs, she could guess the general situation after her rebirth.
After the Blood Moon night, the world ushered in an evolutionary climax.
Not only did humans awaken their innate talents, but some powerful beings were also born among the zombies.
The other animals that survived the Corpse Tide began transforming into Fierce Beasts following the Blood Moon.
To continuously evolve, zombies and Fierce Beasts started to slaughter and devour each other.
And human survivors no longer just fled in panic; post-Blood Moon, they had developed the ability to confront zombies.
At the same time, humans began to acquire Crystal Cores from zombies and Fierce Beasts for studying and developing genetic potions to enhance themselves.
However, these genetic potions for enhancing Extraordinary Genes were merely the early products of the global Blood Moon Mutation.
Before Ji Ruxue’s past life’s rebirth, humanity had developed far more powerful cultivation techniques.
With these cultivation techniques, humanity could more perfectly and efficiently enhance their own strength.
And Ji Ruxue, as the Unparalleled Empress among humans, practiced the topmost cultivation technique in her past life—the Glazed Breathing Technique!
In her past life, after going through an extremely difficult and prolonged struggle in the initial stages, she relied on her formidable innate talent to repeatedly carve a bloody path.
And then, through this powerful cultivation technique, step by step, she achieved the status of Empress.
Now that the wave of evolution had begun, Ji Ruxue knew well that relying on her zombie father’s ordinary low-tier zombie power,
it was nearly impossible to survive in an increasingly cruel environment.
Ji Ruxue understood that she had to quickly enhance her strength.
She needed to both protect her zombie father and have enough strength to safeguard herself.
Fortunately, the memories and cultivation techniques from her past life weren’t forgotten due to rebirth.
While she was currently a baby, she could still practice the Glazed Breathing Technique.
After the Blood Moon night, the world went through mutations, and the air was filled with a large amount of Energy Factors.
These Energy Factors floated in the air, subtly transforming many creatures.
For instance, the various evolutions after the Blood Moon were related to these Energy Factors.
However, human survivors in the early apocalypse were still stuck in pre-apocalypse thinking, focusing on genetic potions research without learning to harness this power.
Later, appropriate breathing techniques were developed to absorb the Energy Factors in the air.
As Ji Ruxue engaged in the Glazed Breathing Technique, her small body began a subtle tremor.
Her breathing became rhythmic, steady, and long, with the Energy Factors in the air slowly entering her body with her unique breathing technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Burning the Tank Type Zombie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16: Burning the Tank Type Zombie!
Whether it was zombies or fierce beasts, they all relied on devouring each other to strengthen themselves.
In the later stages of the apocalypse, humans mastered this more efficient cultivation method.
Ji Ruxue was very grateful to be reborn in the later stages; otherwise, with this infant body, surviving in this apocalyptic world would’ve been a problem.
With each breath, a large amount of energy factors surged in, making Ji Ruxue’s bones increasingly resilient, and her flesh more condensed.
Especially since Ji Ruxue was an infant, her telekinesis was currently very weak, but now it was continuously strengthening thanks to these energy factors.
By the time Lu Chuan returned to the bedroom from downstairs, Ji Ruxue was still immersed in her cultivation.
Lu Chuan was unaware that Ji Ruxue was cultivating.
Seeing Little Qiqi lying on the bed and trembling all over, Lu Chuan was extremely worried.
Could it be that she caught a cold at night?!ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
A baby’s illness is a big problem!
Lu Chuan hurriedly grabbed a quilt from the side and gently covered Little Qiqi.
If a baby got sick before the apocalypse, they could still go to the hospital for treatment.
But now in this apocalyptic world, where would there still be a children’s hospital, only bloodthirsty zombies...
Feeling the movement on her body, Ji Ruxue was startled awake from her cultivation.
Opening her eyes, she saw the quilt covering her and the worried-eyed zombie father standing beside her, which made Ji Ruxue find it a bit funny.
She had just begun cultivating the Glazed Breathing Technique, and her body would slightly tremble with the influx of energy factors with each breath in the early stages, which was a perfectly normal phenomenon.
But clearly, in the eyes of the zombie father, he probably thought she had caught a cold and covered her with a quilt out of worry.
A smile appeared on Ji Ruxue’s face, and her eyes became very gentle.
Looking at the zombie with a somewhat pale complexion and blood-red pupils in front of her, Ji Ruxue wasn’t afraid at all but felt a warm current flowing through her heart.
In her previous life, Ji Ruxue grew up in an orphanage and had learned self-reliance and independence early, only completing her college education through scholarships and subsidies.
The warmth and coldness of human relationships, the sour, sweet, bitter, and salty, only Ji Ruxue knew.
Now, having a second chance at life wasn’t easy, but the parents she was reborn to perished at the onset of the apocalypse...
Ji Ruxue felt the warmth of paternal love for the first time, even though the other party was a zombie.
Seeing Little Qi was fine and smiling happily at him, Lu Chuan finally felt at ease.
Unknowingly, Lu Chuan realized his emotions were already deeply influenced by this little one.
Looking at the little one’s eyes full of gentleness, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but reveal a slight smile.
In this decaying apocalyptic world, such a hopeful baby is undoubtedly the greatest encouragement to people.
Seeing Little Qiqi was alright, Lu Chuan then started pondering on how to deal with that zombie outside.
This massive zombie was opposite him; Lu Chuan had to figure out a way to eliminate it.
Otherwise, having such a dangerous presence living nearby always made him feel uneasy.
This robust zombie could even smash a car, and Lu Chuan didn’t think the old iron door downstairs could stop it.
Moreover, having devoured the white Crystal Core, its strength might keep increasing.
God knows to what extent this creature will grow in the future.
Lu Chuan decided he must strike first.
Whether to devour the Crystal Core and become stronger or to eliminate this potential threat, he had to give it a shot!
...
Evening fell, and night descended.
But from the dim shop across the street, a zombie roar echoed from time to time.
This roar was different from ordinary zombies; it was deep and full of oppression.
The wandering zombies, upon hearing this, instinctively distanced themselves, as if they feared encountering something terrifying.
In the shop, the robust zombie Lu Chuan had seen earlier was even stronger than during the day!
Originally close to two meters tall, its height had risen to about two meters three, and its arms had thickened again.
Boom!
Just as this zombie was digesting the Crystal Core’s power, a loud noise came from the shop’s entrance.
Interrupted by the noise, the gigantic zombie was instantly furious, pounding its chest and stepping outside.
Its bloodthirsty eyes were filled with violence and slaughter, eager to unleash the magnificent power and rage within its body.
Roar! Roar!
On the empty street was a low-level zombie standing still, constantly roaring at the tank zombie.
If you look closely at this low-level zombie, you’d find its blood-red pupils were hollow.
Roar!
The tank zombie pounded its chest, letting out an extremely loud roar, its voice several times louder than that of the low-level zombie.
Even Lu Chuan, hiding in the shadows, couldn’t help but feel a chill.
"Wow, this big guy’s aura is unusually strong, good thing I was prepared ahead and used a Corpse Puppet..."
Lu Chuan was eager to gain more power, so he decided to finish off this zombie first.
But for safety’s sake, Lu Chuan sent out a Corpse Puppet to provoke it.
Lu Chuan controlled the low-level zombie with his mind, picking up a flower pot by the roadside and tossing it right onto the big guy’s head.
Taking advantage of the tank zombie’s moment of surprise, Lu Chuan controlled the zombie to turn and run.
Roar!
The tank zombie roared towards the sky, its eyes burning with rage.
As a successfully evolved zombie, it no longer even considered these ordinary low-level zombies.
But unexpectedly, it was provoked by one, prompting an immediate chase after Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet.
Controlled by Lu Chuan, the numbers one Corpse Puppet quickly lured this massive guy to a shop a bit farther away.
Lu Chuan had long prepared two unscrewed gas tanks there, and the entire shop was filled with leaking gas.
Boom!
The number one Corpse Puppet barely ran into the shop when the tank zombie charged in, its massive size crashing inside.
Its enormous fist smashed Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet to pieces.
Boom boom boom!
The tank zombie seemed to be venting its anger, relentlessly smashing the Corpse Puppet’s body.
When Lu Chuan controlled the number two Corpse Puppet to enter, the tank zombie was still beating the corpse, and the number one Corpse Puppet was smashed to bits...
Lu Chuan manipulated the number two zombie to enter the shop and shut the slightly bent door behind it, then took out a lighter.
Boom!
A massive explosion rang out, rapidly igniting the two gas tanks in the shop, casting a fiery glow against the night.
The tank zombie, taking the brunt of the explosion, let out a series of shrill roars in the sea of flames.
As it struggled out of the shop with all its might, it collapsed at the doorway.
The zombie’s entire body was charred black by the raging flames, like a piece of coal.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Devouring the Crystal Core, Advancing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: Chapter 17: Devouring the Crystal Core, Advancing!
In the instant of the explosion, Lu Chuan withdrew his consciousness from the two Corpse Puppets in time, so he wasn’t particularly affected.
The fierce fire inside the shop continued to burn intensely, illuminating the surrounding area brightly even during the night.
The explosive power of these two gas tanks made Lu Chuan jump.
Lu Chuan breathed a sigh of relief, fortunately, he had chosen a spot a bit further from the residential buildings, otherwise, he might have been caught by the blast wave.
The most critical aspect is the loud noise created by the explosion, along with the very conspicuous blazing fire.
A few zombies nearby were attracted by the commotion, but maybe the oppressive aura of this massive zombie was too overwhelming.
So average low-level zombies only lingered in the distance, not daring to approach for the time being.
Lu Chuan didn’t rush out directly but continued to remain in the shadows, waiting.
The impact brought by the earlier battle with this massive zombie was so shocking that Lu Chuan didn’t dare to go forward immediately.
After all, a centipede dies but never falls down, what if this zombie wasn’t fully dead and punched him directly... that would be the end for him...Thɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Perhaps some fat still remained on the zombie, so the flames continued to burn this massive zombie relentlessly.
After a good ten minutes, with the zombie immobile despite being burned, Lu Chuan finally confirmed it was likely truly dead and dared to approach cautiously.
Upon closer inspection, the zombie had been burned beyond recognition by the fierce fire, and coupled with the massive impact of the gas tank explosion, its body suffered severe damage.
The pungent stench of burning flesh pervaded the air, and thick black smoke continuously wafted from the zombie’s body.
If a human came close and inhaled such smoke, they might feel dizzy, but fortunately, Lu Chuan, as a zombie, was unaffected by all this.
The appearance of the zombie at this moment was rather unflattering.
Without a word, Lu Chuan swung the machete to break open the zombie’s skull.
Lu Chuan discovered that after the zombie’s evolution, its surface defense was significantly strengthened compared to ordinary low-level zombies.
Even for this charred corpse, he had to exert a lot of effort to break open the back of its head.
With a slashing sound!
As the blade forcefully split the other’s skull in two, Lu Chuan indeed found a unique Crystal Core amidst the bloody brain matter.
However, this Crystal Core was different from the one he saw during the day; instead of pure white, it had some red in it.
Moreover, Lu Chuan noticed that the temptation from this Crystal Core was even stronger than during the day!
Although Lu Chuan didn’t know what these things exactly were, the zombie instincts told him that this red-tinted Crystal Core was definitely more beneficial to zombies than this morning’s pure white one!
"It’s possible that the pure white Crystal Cores are the basic Crystal Cores born after these zombies evolve."
"And when these zombies complete their mutual devouring and further enhance their powers, the Crystal Cores become tinged with red, and if all of them turn red... wouldn’t it make them even stronger?!"
Although Lu Chuan didn’t understand the rules of zombie evolution in the apocalypse, he could speculate some basic patterns after observation.
What surprised Lu Chuan more was that this massive zombie was already so formidable; how terrifying would it become if it continued to evolve?!
As he watched more and more zombies being drawn by the flames, Lu Chuan quickly stashed away the Crystal Core.
Then he chose two fully intact limbed zombies from the ones wandering over, made them his new underlings, and after reconnecting two Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan swiftly returned to the neighborhood.
He assigned these two new Corpse Puppets to guard the entrance downstairs while Lu Chuan went alone to the third floor.
Holding the unique Crystal Core in his hand, Lu Chuan increasingly felt the desire to devour it. His body craved this Crystal Core instinctively!
After ensuring the safety of his surroundings, Lu Chuan no longer suppressed his inner desire and swallowed it down in one go.
The next second, Lu Chuan felt the Crystal Core dissolve instantly within him, and a surge of powerful energy flooded into his entire being!
This energy constantly tempered Lu Chuan’s body, gradually transforming his decomposed skin towards a more human-like form.
However, Lu Chuan noticed that after devouring the Crystal Core, he didn’t gain any special abilities like the two zombies he had observed in battle previously.
He didn’t develop blade-like claws similar to the agile zombie.
Nor did he possess the robust muscles or defenses of the giant zombie.
If viewed from the outside, his appearance was less grotesque and fearsome than before; his physical strength, agility, and stamina had improved slightly compared to previously.
Yet Lu Chuan felt his brain was akin to having a massive explosion.
Vast energies surged into his mind, briefly causing a period of dizziness.
Undergoing the Crystal Core evolution, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but let out a few roars.
Downstairs, the wandering zombies trembled slightly upon hearing Lu Chuan’s roar, then slowly retreated into the distance.
After the evolution, Lu Chuan felt his mind had become extremely clear, and his five senses seemed sharper than before.
The most crucial aspect was that Lu Chuan found controlling zombies was now even easier.
With just a bit of thought, Lu Chuan understood the specific reason.
It was likely that different zombies would awaken different Talent Powers, and it was obvious that he had primarily enhanced his mental abilities.
The two zombies he saw today were melee combat types, one enhancing strength and defense, the other enhancing agility.
Excitedly, Lu Chuan ran to the street for a trial, discovering his telekinetic powers had doubled, allowing him to control up to five zombies simultaneously!
Most importantly, Lu Chuan discovered he gained a new ability, enabling him to share the vision of Corpse Puppets!
Before advancing, Lu Chuan could only control these Corpse Puppets within his sight, but now he could control them remotely after evolution.
Lu Chuan was extremely excited; with this ability, he no longer needed to venture out personally to accomplish tasks, as his henchmen could be remotely commanded to do so.
This method was extremely convenient and greatly enhanced his survival capability.
However, there remained a distance limitation for Corpse Puppet control; after testing, Lu Chuan’s telekinetic range now extended to a maximum of 1000 meters.
It meant that within a radius of 1000 meters, Lu Chuan wouldn’t need to act personally; he could complete tasks simply by remotely controlling these Corpse Puppets.
In that moment, Lu Chuan suddenly felt a bit like a command system from his past life, with a gaggle of unmanned robots at his disposal.
"Hehehe, since I don’t need to show up, then killing, arson, robbery, and looting would be much easier!"

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Zombie Dad Must Be Really Scared Right Now!
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 18: Zombie Dad Must Be Really Scared Right Now!
Seventh-floor bedroom.
"It’s already so late, why hasn’t zombie dad come back yet?"
Ji Ruxue lay on the bed, feeling a bit restless. She had clearly heard the enormous explosion from that shop as well as the terrifying roar of the evolved zombies earlier.
The angry roar of the tank-type zombie in the middle of the night was chilling to hear.
Even though Ji Ruxue was a reborn empress, in her current infant state, facing this strengthened, combat-power-enhanced evolved zombie would only lead to one outcome: death.
Now, being on the seventh floor, Ji Ruxue wasn’t particularly worried about being exposed. However, the zombie dad who hadn’t returned yet made her a bit anxious.
Ordinary zombies without evolution, encountering these evolved zombies only have one path: death.
Even a survivor camp, if lacking enough firepower and preparation, could potentially be wiped out by such tank-type zombies!
"My zombie dad, please don’t get into any trouble..."
"I can’t even walk on the ground yet. If something happens to you, I’m done for."
Ji Ruxue even began to wonder if her destiny was just destined to be that tough. In both her past life and present life, it seems she was somewhat unlucky with her parents...
At last, now she had a zombie dad who had died once before, she just began to feel the warmth of paternal love - could it be that she was about to return to a shattered beginning again?!
Originally Ji Ruxue was practicing the Glazed Breathing Technique, but now all that appeared in her mind were images of Lu Chuan, making her troubled and unable to calm down to practice.
Unconsciously, the father and daughter who accidentally met had already regarded each other as critically important companions in this apocalypse.
Clearly, Lu Chuan’s eyes were full of blood-red, but Ji Ruxue always felt as though she could see the loving kindness of a father through her zombie dad’s gaze.
She didn’t want this hard-won family affection to fade so quickly.
Click!
At that moment, the sound of the door opening came from outside, and Ji Ruxue instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
Ordinary low-level zombies don’t understand locks; only her zombie dad, who retained human consciousness, could do such an odd thing...
"That’s good, thank goodness nothing happened."
A smile appeared on Ji Ruxue’s face.
Lu Chuan walked in and saw the little one smiling at him, such a cute sight made him feel as if his heart was warmed.
For this little one, even when facing stronger zombies, Lu Chuan felt he possessed enough courage.
Lu Chuan went straight to the kitchen and began to prepare formula milk.
He had planned out a trap to kill the big zombie, combined with devouring the Crystal Core, which took quite a bit of time. The little one must be hungry.
Thinking about the significant increase in strength today, and watching the little one drink milk so sweetly, Lu Chuan felt truly delighted.
Though still in an apocalypse now, Lu Chuan increasingly felt hope for his life.
This anticipation and expectation for life were completely unparalleled compared to when he spent his previous month in confusion and chaos.
"Little Qiqi be good, dad’s strength has increased again, in the future I can better protect you and help you survive in this apocalypse!"
Perhaps it’s the continuously strengthening power, perhaps it’s the gradually changing apocalypse, or perhaps it’s the little one’s pure and beautiful smile.
Lu Chuan felt his somewhat decaying body seemed to emit vast vitality.
Although he had become a zombie now, life seemed to have gained new joys.
After all, before reincarnation, his life of working overtime every day at the company, going to and fro like a walking corpse, wasn’t particularly interesting either.
In the two days following the increase in strength, Lu Chuan hadn’t left Building No. 5 again.
Instead, through telekinesis, he dispatched his Corpse Puppets nearby to search for supplies.
Operating several Corpse Puppets to work simultaneously was much faster than Lu Chuan himself transporting things.
Now Lu Chuan directly turned the rooms on several floors downstairs into his warehouse.
All sorts of supplies little Qiqi might need now or in the future were completely collected by Lu Chuan.
This entire building was treated as Lu Chuan’s private property.
Not only these baby supplies and foods, but Lu Chuan also collected a lot of tools to deal with zombies.
Upon witnessing the fierce battle scenes of those two evolved zombies, Lu Chuan also realized that perhaps after that Blood Moon night, this world, already unfamiliar to him, had changed once more.
If he wants to survive better, he must enhance his combat power and make certain defensive preparations.
Lu Chuan transported back some gas tanks through his Corpse Control, obtained fire axes from every closed-off building, beverages that can be ignited to make Molotov cocktails.
Even crowbars, shovels, and kitchen knives weren’t spared - whatever was useful was brought back.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
During this time, Lu Chuan either cared for Little Qiqi or practiced combat techniques in an empty room himself.
Although he basically repeated similar daily routines, Lu Chuan still felt very fulfilled, after all, he could distinctly feel his power continually strengthening.
As long as he keeps getting stronger, the chances of surviving in this apocalypse will increase a fraction.
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue lay in bed, drinking milk every day and practicing the Glazed Breathing Technique.
Now her body was too weak, Ji Ruxue had to use the Breathing Technique to enhance her strength.
The energy factor in the air continually improved Ji Ruxue’s frail body while also enhancing her somewhat weak telekinesis as a baby.
After finishing her training, Ji Ruxue slowly exhaled a mouthful of murky air. After a period of practice, her telekinesis had become a bit stronger than before.
Hearing faint sounds from the living room, Ji Ruxue slightly frowned.
Her zombie dad, perhaps because he retained his consciousness from when he was alive, previously would go out to search for supplies at night.
But now, it had been two days without going out...
Thinking back to the battle between evolved zombies two days ago, and the unexplained explosions and terrifying zombie howls near the community.
Ji Ruxue suspected her zombie dad was probably unlucky and had encountered those transcendent zombies that evolved special abilities.
After transcendent zombie evolution, just the intense aura alone would already be beyond mere lower-tier zombies.
It could be said that evolved zombies and ordinary low-tier zombies, though both are zombies, would gradually split into different species.
The suppression of higher-level power was extremely terrifying, and ordinary low-tier zombies could hardly resist this aura.
More so, the combat power of evolved zombies far exceeds that of ordinary zombies.
Ji Ruxue could imagine, as an ordinary low-tier zombie, zombie dad should be feeling very scared now.

chapters.title: Chapter 19: A Zombie Diligently Learning Martial Arts!
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19: A Zombie Diligently Learning Martial Arts!
The zombie crisis erupted so suddenly that many people didn’t even have time to react before they were devoured by zombies.
At the beginning of the apocalypse, everyone thought that ordinary zombies were already the final result of mutation.
But no one expected that after the Blood Moon, evolution and mutation began to occur globally.
This newly initiated path of evolution caught many people off guard.
My zombie dad, as an ordinary unevolved zombie, was at the bottom of the hierarchy in this world of global mutation.
Not only would he be killed by human survivors, but he would also be slaughtered by fellow zombies, or even those stronger Fierce Beasts...
As a low-level zombie on the front lines, surviving the apocalypse was already extremely difficult.
He also had to put effort into supporting himself, taking care of his own needs and safety, which was truly demanding for him.
Ji Ruxue felt deeply moved in her heart.
Even in such difficult circumstances, it seemed her zombie dad had no intention of giving up on her.
One must know that in the apocalypse, humanity had become an extremely precious commodity.
People who used to be kind could now commit any filthy and despicable act after experiencing the apocalypse’s brutal reality.
Perhaps a gentleman before the apocalypse could transform into a cold-blooded killer after the fall.
It is hard to determine right from wrong, after all, everyone during the apocalypse focused on survival.
For many, merely staying alive was the greatest luxury.
Even those who were alive, even those with abundant resources and strong defenses in survivor camps, would abandon infants and the elderly to escape when necessary.
But her zombie dad had clearly experienced the apocalypse’s harshness, transformed into a creature neither human nor ghost, yet he still retained the glory of humanity...
Ji Ruxue silently gazed at the night sky outside the window, her watery eyes revealing composure and calmness beyond her years.
It seemed she needed to speed up her cultivation, as more Evolved Zombies and Fierce Beasts would emerge as time progressed.
Relying solely on her zombie dad’s capabilities, survival in this apocalypse was extraordinarily challenging.
With Ji Ruxue’s breathing exercises, energy continuously entered her body, making her increasingly powerful.
Ji Ruxue was eager to become stronger, since it was evident her zombie dad couldn’t be relied upon, and she had to depend on herself.
Fortunately, after so many days of training, Ji Ruxue had achieved certain accomplishments.
The intensity of her telekinesis had significantly increased compared to before.
At this moment, driven by Ji Ruxue’s telekinesis, a silver needle on the bedside table swiftly flew into the air.Follow current novels on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Whizz, whizz, whizz!
This extremely fine silver needle danced in mid-air at an incredibly terrifying speed.
Equipped with her Time Control Ability, Ji Ruxue was confident she could now kill undetected.
Even such a tiny silver needle could pierce a skull with the help of her telekinesis boost!
However, Ji Ruxue wasn’t complacent about this; surviving the apocalypse required far more than just a few tricks.
As time went on, more powerful zombies and Fierce Beasts would gradually appear, and she needed to grow stronger to have any hope of survival.
...
In the living room, Lu Chuan was focused on reading a combat textbook.
This was what he found when he sent a Corpse Puppet to search the nearby buildings.
The original owner of the room was probably a combat enthusiast, as there were many combat textbooks.
They detailed various close combat techniques including Sanda, Judo, boxing, free fighting, and grappling.
Lu Chuan continuously explored and trained according to what he read in the room.
Having become a zombie and evolved, Lu Chuan’s physical constitution was already superior to ordinary humans.
In fact, not many professional fighters’ physiques could now surpass that of Lu Chuan.
Moreover, his body was no longer as stiff as that of a low-level zombie, making it easier to perform these complex combat moves.
Humans differ from other creatures in how they develop and use the brain.
These modern combat techniques were scientifically distilled through countless rehearsals in different environments, making for more effective training and attacks on enemies.
From his observations during this period, Lu Chuan noticed that zombie attack methods were primitive and violent.
Without human wisdom, zombies acted on instinct, primarily using claws or sharp teeth in a series of instinctive attacks.
This disorderly attacking method might work against unsuspecting ordinary people, but well-trained combat experts could neutralize the threat.
However, even in real-world situations, no matter how skilled a combat champion is, they wouldn’t dare easily engage zombies up close.
This wasn’t because human combat techniques were inferior, but because zombies lack intelligence and don’t fear death.
Humans are different; they have more concerns because once bitten, they face conversion.
Most humans wouldn’t take such risks.
But Lu Chuan was different; given he was already a zombie, getting bitten didn’t matter, and he didn’t fear the so-called zombie virus.
Retaining human consciousness, Lu Chuan saw it as his greatest advantage, which must be fully utilized.
He differed from other zombies, capable of using weapons most efficiently in battle.
Although his evolution was different from other zombies and didn’t enhance close combat abilities,
This advanced scientific combat method might help bridge the gap in physical prowess.
Strength might crush skill, but skill could also manipulate strength.
Moreover, many joint lock techniques in martial arts are decisive and efficient, making them extremely effective even against zombies.
Furthermore, zombies lack the human drive, which means they cannot learn or defend; they act purely on instinct.
Brains triumph over mindlessness.
However, Lu Chuan knew that learning from books alone was shallow; he’d read many news stories about martial artists who ended up getting fatally stabbed despite their skills...
After mastering some basic combat moves and training for a while, Lu Chuan warmed up as he reached the sixth floor.
He maneuvered a Corpse Puppet into the living room, then lifted his telekinetic control.
This Corpse Puppet became his sparring partner, on which he continuously practised the combat skills learned during this period.
If a zombie knew martial arts, no one could stop it.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 20: The Strange Zombie in Building 1!
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Chapter 20: The Strange Zombie in Building 1!
However, upon initial contact, Lu Chuan found that relying solely on theory and personal exploration really had significant gaps compared to actual combat...
Previously, Lu Chuan didn’t understand why many people could hit a sandbag with great force, yet easily get knocked down in the ring.
It’s because the control of distance and the opponent’s reactions all require actual combat to hone.
Simply punching air or a target doesn’t build strong combat experience.
After truly engaging in face-to-face combat, Lu Chuan realized that relying purely on his fighting techniques to subdue the opponent was somewhat difficult.
The concept of learning from books was clearly ineffective in this context.
Fortunately, with zombies who fear nothing as training partners, Lu Chuan applied all sorts of combat techniques on them.
Through repeated practice, Lu Chuan’s punching speed became faster and faster.
His accuracy also improved significantly, allowing him to retaliate while dodging attacks.
Practicing combat not only enhances real combat experience but also improves body coordination.
Even if there’s no direct confrontation in the future, it would provide an advantage in escape.
Bam bam bam!
Thuds resounded continuously in the living room as the poor zombie incessantly lunged at Lu Chuan with bites.
However, what awaited it was Lu Chuan’s agile moves.
After dodging the zombie’s frontal attack, Lu Chuan grabbed its shoulder and executed an over-the-shoulder throw.
Bang!
As soon as the zombie stood up again, Lu Chuan delivered another back throw, nearly breaking the zombie’s spine, even while controlling his strength.
Looking at the zombie in front of him, now battered and bloody from the fight, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
By now, the zombie’s head was already bruised and bleeding from Lu Chuan’s blows.
The already loose teeth had been knocked out by Lu Chuan, and the nose, flattened and bleeding black blood, had long been broken.
Even the elbows and knees were easily dislocated by Lu Chuan using joint-locking techniques.
Now, facing a single ordinary zombie’s frontal attack, Lu Chuan can easily and skillfully handle it, even to the point of dominating it.
Thanks to this period of training and various combat exercises, Lu Chuan quickly grew from a novice to a fighter with considerable skill.
After all, no matter how advanced modern training methods might be, they can’t provide partners like zombies who are impervious to pain and death.
Lu Chuan felt very satisfied with his current skills. In a one-on-one situation with a regular zombie, further improvement of his combat skills had become challenging.
Then Lu Chuan activated Telekinesis, preparing to summon another Corpse Puppet to increase the difficulty.
But just then, Lu Chuan felt a sudden shift in his mind, with an astonishing image flashing in his head.
Recently, Lu Chuan has been practicing multitasking, honing his combat skills with zombies indoors while dispatching Corpse Puppets outside to gather resources.
Yet in his shared vision, Lu Chuan discovered that the two Corpse Puppets he sent to collect resources in Building One of the Sunshine District had encountered something astonishing!
On the third floor of Building One, two zombies were scavenging for resources, exhibiting strangely human-like behavior.
Just then, a bloody silhouette dashed across the ceiling in his view.
The speed was terrifying; if not for the marks left on the ceiling, Lu Chuan might’ve thought he was seeing things.
He quickly controlled the Corpse Puppets to follow. After all, if a Corpse Puppet dies, it dies; zombies roamed everywhere, and Lu Chuan didn’t care about losing a couple.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
The bloody figure moved rapidly across walls and ceilings, so fast that even Lu Chuan’s controlled Corpse Puppets struggled to keep up!
Quickly, Lu Chuan maneuvered a Corpse Puppet to pick up two wooden sticks for defense.
Perhaps seeing such peculiar behavior from the two zombies, the figure on the ceiling ceased its movement.
Lu Chuan finally saw the bloody figure on the ceiling, and its appearance truly shocked him.
This ceiling-clinging zombie seemed to have undergone a bizarre mutation.
Its skin appeared somewhat peeled, revealing crimson flesh beneath, incredibly grotesque.
While ordinary zombies already looked terrifying, this ceiling clinger was a nightmare among them.
This zombie’s skull was remarkably absent, leaving its gory brain exposed.
Most notably, its gaping mouth housed long, sharp teeth and an unnatural, snake-like red tongue.
Both its hands and feet had mutated significantly, now resembling the claws of a Fierce Beast.
However, Lu Chuan noticed that this transformation seemed to impact its spine, rendering the mutated zombie unable to stand, forcing it to crawl on all fours.
Yet its terrifying muscles and explosiveness granted it incredible speed, and its claw-like limbs easily climbed walls and ceilings.
The bizarre sight startled Lu Chuan, as he never expected such an ugly type of zombie to exist.
Most evolved zombies still managed to resemble humanoid creatures.
But the bloody figure before him had cast aside all semblance of humanity...
From the two Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan sensed an overwhelming fear.
Clearly, this bloody creature posed a significant threat to ordinary zombies.
Lu Chuan immediately controlled the two Corpse Puppets to barrage forward with their sticks.
Yet the terrifying figure clinging to the ceiling leapt with its limbs and, with a flash of its claws, shattered one Corpse Puppet’s skull instantly.
Before the second Corpse Puppet could react, it found a red appendage piercing swiftly through its head in its vision.
The speed of this bloody monster was too fast; even with Lu Chuan’s controlled Corpse Puppets, they were slaughtered without resistance.
"What, what kind of monster is this?!"
Returning to his physical sight, Lu Chuan felt lingering fear.
"Was it its long tongue that finished off my Corpse Puppet just then?!"
Lu Chuan never imagined that a zombie could evolve to disregard human form, even using the body’s vulnerable tongue as a weapon!
That blood-red tongue shot out so fast that his controlled Corpse Puppets couldn’t even react.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Suddenly, Lu Chuan’s heart felt exceptionally heavy; it seemed that the capabilities zombies evolved into after the Blood Moon far exceeded his expectations...
Or perhaps zombies like himself, endowed with special abilities, weren’t anomalies, and he must proceed with greater caution in the future.
Recalling that blood-colored creature capable of walking walls, Lu Chuan felt an immense anxiety,
Realizing that with his current strength, he could hardly stand against it.
Even with five Corpse Puppets swarming, against such absolute power, they would likely be decimated in one fell swoop.
For now, Lu Chuan could only hope that the creature would not venture into Building Five, where he resided.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Proficient in Martial Arts, Taking On Three at Once!
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21: Proficient in Martial Arts, Taking On Three at Once!
The Blood Moon had just begun a few days ago, and already encountering such bizarre zombies made Lu Chuan feel heavy-hearted.
Originally, Lu Chuan thought that the burly giant and the agile type zombie were already considered quite powerful evolved zombies. But now it seemed he had underestimated this strange world.
The blood-colored terrifying figure had too formidable combat power, and Lu Chuan seriously suspected that even if the giant and the agile zombie joined forces, they would still be instantly killed by that blood-colored figure.
Controlling the Corpse Puppet to make close contact with that blood-colored monster, Lu Chuan felt the death perspective of being killed up close. The oppressive feeling from that bizarre blood-colored figure was extraordinarily strong.
Although this peculiar monster zombie no longer had skin, revealing blood-colored muscles, its physical strength was probably not much weaker than the bulky zombie.
The key was that its terrifying speed allowed it to easily move quickly, climbing walls and hanging from ceilings.
Its powerful strength was one thing, but its tricky attack angles made it extremely hard to defend against.
The thing that Lu Chuan feared most was the blood-colored figure’s retractable tongue.
Lu Chuan never imagined that one day he might be killed by a tongue...
Although they were not in the same building now, both were still in the same neighborhood. Lu Chuan had a premonition that he would eventually face that bizarre-shaped zombie.
After all, the neighborhood was only so big, it was hard not to encounter it...
For a moment, Lu Chuan felt heavy-hearted. The joy of dismantling a zombie while practicing combat techniques was now considerably subdued.
Lu Chuan understood that this world was too cruel, and to survive, he must quickly enhance his strength.
Though they were all zombies, clearly these bizarre monsters did not understand what it means to leave each other alone...
In the coming days, Lu Chuan dared not waste a single moment and practiced combat techniques daily.
Through actual combat with zombies, he constantly improved his fighting skills using the simplest method to achieve the greatest enhancement.
While practicing combat, Lu Chuan also did not forget to dispatch the Corpse Puppet to continue searching for resources around.
However, Lu Chuan now had a new target, which was to find other evolved zombies.
He didn’t know much about the full-bodied blood-colored horrifying zombie that appeared on the first floor.
Moreover, such a peculiar monster was very difficult to target, and Lu Chuan did not intend to risk a fruitless effort.
Without enough strength to challenge it, it was no different from courting death.
However, zombies like the giant and the agile type that he first encountered were relatively easier to deal with.
Though both types of zombies had evolved to some extent and their combat power had become significantly stronger,
For Lu Chuan, a thinking zombie who could control Corpse Puppets, they were much easier to handle.
After several days of experimentation, Lu Chuan had discovered that the Crystal Core was mostly produced only in the brains of evolved zombies.
He had killed quite a few normal zombies over the past days, but found nothing in their brains.
Time flew by, and a week passed in the blink of an eye.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
On the sixth floor, Lu Chuan was now simultaneously facing an attack from three burly zombies.
The living room felt a bit cramped due to the growing number of zombies, but within such a tight space, Lu Chuan’s body was very agile.
Faced with the biting attacks of zombies, Lu Chuan easily evaded using flexible body techniques.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
At the same time, taking advantage of a gap in the zombies’ attack, he punched one zombie in the jaw.
Though they had become zombies, knocking out the vagus nerve with a punch had become useless.
However, Lu Chuan’s punch was powerful, knocking the zombie’s head loose and splattering blood.
After knocking down one zombie, Lu Chuan ducked and avoided the bite from the zombie behind, simultaneously hugging the zombie in front around the waist.
Then, using the horse stance and core strength, he executed a direct suplex and snapped the zombie’s neck in half.
Crack!
The spine broke, rendering the zombie harmless even if it wasn’t dead.
Facing the last zombie’s assault, Lu Chuan seized the opportunity and firmly grabbed its wrist with one hand.
Crack! Crack!
Using joint lock techniques, Lu Chuan slightly applied force and directly dislocated the zombie’s joint.
In almost a moment, the three ferocious and terrifying zombies now lay motionless on the ground.
Either Lu Chuan had knocked off their heads, broken their spines, or dislocated all their joints.
The sound of bones cracking in the sixth-floor living room would have given everyone goosebumps before the apocalypse erupted,
and several ambulances would have had to pull in.
Lu Chuan stood in the center of the living room, nodding in satisfaction.
The zombies he found were relatively strong, yet he managed to effortlessly defeat them.
After these few days of training, he had some accomplishments in combat techniques.
At present, many zombies were already piled up outside the gate of Lu Chuan’s neighborhood, lying on the ground.
These zombies had basically been disassembled into parts when Lu Chuan practiced his combat skills...
An excellent sniper is trained with bullets, and likewise, an excellent fighter is honed through real combat.
Now Lu Chuan was very confident that if he ventured out and faced zombie attacks, he would have a certain degree of self-defense.
Even if he went back to the time before the apocalypse, Lu Chuan was confident that he could easily win a gold belt in freestyle fighting.
After all, not even a world boxing champion would dare train as recklessly as he did...
...
Seventh-floor bedroom.
While Lu Chuan was practicing combat skills downstairs, Ji Ruxue, as a baby, did not slack off in her own training.
Although she was just a baby, unable to take care of herself,
using the Glazed Breathing Technique to constantly inhale and exhale the energy factors of heaven and earth, Ji Ruxue’s evolution speed was not slow at all.
At this moment, as Ji Ruxue gathered telekinesis and applied it to herself, her infant-sized body gradually began to float!
Although her body had not shown any accelerated growth, her telekinesis had indeed strengthened significantly!
After this period of focused cultivation, Ji Ruxue’s telekinesis could now make her hover about one to two centimeters off the ground!
It must be known that Ji Ruxue is just a baby, who initially found it exhausting to even move a silver needle. Now she could levitate her body, which was a great progress.
For humans, flying through the air is probably everyone’s dream.
Although Ji Ruxue was still unable to achieve this, after continuous practice during this period, she finally acquired some abilities to protect herself in the apocalypse.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Agile Zombie Returns!
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22: Agile Zombie Returns!
"No way, this is far from enough..."
Even as just a baby, Ji Ruxue’s achievement of being able to levitate her body is incredibly terrifying.
If those large survivor camps knew about Ji Ruxue’s situation, they would all swarm to recruit her.
After all, a baby capable of awakening talent power and levitating in mid-air is something that sounds miraculous.
But Ji Ruxue was not in the slightest complacent; she knew that her current strength was nothing significant.
As someone reborn, Ji Ruxue knew that with more evolved zombies and fierce beasts emerging, the wars between them would become more frequent.
Humans need to rest after battling each other, but for zombies and fierce beasts, the best way to recover is by devouring each other’s crystal cores.
The more frequently powerful zombies and fierce beasts devour one another, the faster their evolution will be.
To survive in this zombie-infested city, one must possess enough strength to achieve that.
The key is that Ji Ruxue knows she is not alone in this; she also has to protect her zombie father.
After the Blood Moon, the zombie father did not undergo any noticeable mutation, obviously just an ordinary zombie.
In this post-apocalyptic world of mutations, ordinary low-tier zombies are actually the most unfortunate.
Encountering evolved counterparts might lead to being killed, and facing human Extraordinary individuals poses an even greater risk of being slain.
Without strong enough power, her zombie father might not last long before falling.
An ordinary zombie surviving the apocalypse is extremely dangerous; Ji Ruxue must quickly enhance her strength.
"The noise downstairs keeps booming; what’s the zombie father busy with all the time down there?"
Despite the separation, Ji Ruxue heard the commotion of Lu Chuan training combat techniques with several zombies in the sixth-floor living room.Thɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Facing zombies insensitive to pain and fatigue, Lu Chuan showed no mercy, whether in wrestling or punching, causing quite a stir.
Though Ji Ruxue worries a bit because her zombie father hasn’t gone out to find supplies for over a week.
Solely relying on the remaining resources in the house isn’t problematic for now, but eventually, it’ll run out.
Ji Ruxue understands this; her zombie father is just an ordinary zombie, after all.
Facing a tremendous gap in power, confronting powerful evolved zombies outside leaves no chance for a counterattack...
The zombie father retains human consciousness, so it’s normal for him to fear this overwhelming power gap.
It’s not her zombie father’s fault; blame lies solely on this cruel world.
As a former empress in another life, Ji Ruxue knows well how cruel this apocalypse truly is.
With evolution ongoing, individual power strengthening, killing not only hasn’t decreased but has become even more frequent.
Without strong enough power, there’s simply no qualification to live in this world.
Before the Blood Moon descended, ordinary zombies faced no pressure in living.
But now, with the Blood Moon, numerous zombies and creatures have begun evolving and mutating, leaving ordinary unevolved zombies as cannon fodder.
Ji Ruxue clearly remembers in the early apocalypse when corpse tides caused great panic.
However, later on, those ordinary zombie-composed corpse tides will easily be wiped out by the strong.
Ji Ruxue didn’t have much hope for Lu Chuan; after all, low-tier ordinary zombies in this evolved world find it incredibly difficult not to be killed.
Let alone raising a baby, which is practically an impossible task.
Ji Ruxue only hopes she can quickly enhance her power through the Glazed Breathing Technique, wishing she could grow up fast.
As a human empress, Ji Ruxue dislikes feeling like a burden or dragging others down.
She hopes to rely on strong combat power to protect her zombie father’s life and safety.
Most importantly, Ji Ruxue doesn’t want to lose this rare family connection, even if it’s a zombie providing her with kinship.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Ji Ruxue practiced the cultivation technique to intake energy factors while controlling silver needles flying steadily in mid-air.
The speed of the silver needle increased, and so did the force.
Given her tiny stature now, relying on her body to move freely is obviously impossible.
Ji Ruxue focused on enhancing telekinesis; as her limbs struggle to support her body, she aimed to achieve levitation using telekinesis.
Though only slightly hovering one or two centimeters now, it’s a huge progress to Ji Ruxue.
At least in this situation, if she falls, she can use telekinesis to catch herself instead of dying from a fall right at the start...
After all, as a dignified human empress, dying from falling or starving is quite unseemly...
With the cultivation technique in constant operation, Ji Ruxue’s gaze became increasingly determined.
After finishing combat training on the sixth floor, Lu Chuan controlled a corpse puppet to specifically handle the zombies he dismantled.
Just as Lu Chuan prepared to go upstairs to feed Qiqi, a corpse puppet gathering resources outside made a new discovery.
On a nearby street, an evolved zombie with a weakened body but obviously evolved claws and greatly enhanced speed was chasing a panicked human.
Lu Chuan immediately recognized the zombie chasing the survivor as the Agile Type zombie he witnessed being smashed by a big guy that day.
In the corpse puppet’s view, this human survivor looked pale, thin, with dry hair and unstable footsteps.
During this time, perhaps hiding and eating all stashed food led to venturing out to find more.
Unfortunately, he was unlucky because soon after leaving, he encountered a zombie.
Most crucially, the type of zombie he met was one Lu Chuan had been searching for a long time without finding, an evolved zombie.
Though the agile zombie appeared slender, its speed was exceptionally fast.
Seeing the agile-type zombie moving like a cheetah, fiercely embedding its claws into nearby car doors, it achieved a perfect drift with inertia.
With just a turn, the agile zombie caught up with the unlucky survivor.
The maneuver was extremely smooth, leaving Lu Chuan to marvel — indeed, fast cornering truly indicates speed.
Without waiting for the survivor to resist, the agile-type zombie’s claws slashed and immediately ended his life.
"Great opportunity!"
Lu Chuan’s eyes lit up; he had been seeking evolved zombies to obtain more crystal cores but had been unable to find any.
He immediately dispatched a corpse puppet to follow and monitor the opponent.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Axe Gang, Attack!
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23: Axe Gang, Attack!
Ever since he consumed the Crystal Core and felt the rush of surging energy, Lu Chuan couldn’t suppress his inner desire to become stronger.
So, during this time, Lu Chuan has been training his fighting skills to enhance his close combat ability and self-protection.
Meanwhile, he dispatched Corpse Puppets to search for materials and track down Evolved Zombies.
Lu Chuan understood in his heart that since these mutated zombies were born, given time, they will certainly evolve into something extremely powerful.
The saying goes, a slow start means a slow journey thereafter.
If he cannot find a way to catch up with the footsteps of the Evolved Zombies in the early stage, he might become cannon fodder and be devoured.
However, at this stage, the number of Evolved Zombies may not be very high.
Currently, Lu Chuan encounters mostly ordinary zombies wandering endlessly on the streets.
He searched for several days without encountering one, and today he finally came across one, he wouldn’t let it pass easily.
He kept one Corpse Puppet at a certain distance, closely monitoring the movements of this Agile Zombie.
The remaining four zombies put down their original tasks, grabbed sharp and heavy Fire Axes, and quickly headed towards the location of the Agile Type Zombie.
The four zombies holding long axes marched with a menacing aura, just like the Axe Gang parading down the street.
The scene looked truly terrifying.
If a survivor saw this, they would probably be shocked speechless.
After all, they had never seen zombies actively use weapons, it was simply defying natural order.
Soon Lu Chuan’s five Corpse Puppets gathered together, each holding a Fire Axe, ready for battle.
Each one glared with blood-red eyes, poised and ready to attack, creating an extremely oppressive presence.
Lu Chuan didn’t act rashly but ordered the five zombies to stagger, pretending to casually walk towards the Agile Type Zombie.
Lu Chuan had the zombies spread out slightly, as having five axe-wielding zombies together would be conspicuous unless someone was foolish.
Moreover, with Fire Axes in hand, gathering together isn’t conducive to combat.
However, Lu Chuan wasn’t stupid enough to completely disperse the zombies, as he intended to encircle the Agile Type Zombie, not face a bulky zombie.
If they dispersed too far, they might be taken out one by one before their axes even touched the opponent.
After killing the human survivor, the Agile Type Zombie feasted on fresh meat.
As the apocalypse progressed, the number of catchable survivors dwindled.
Most zombies wandered aimlessly on the streets each day to conserve energy.
A large number of humans were killed or turned into zombies initially, while a small number of survivors learned survival skills after early blind escapism.
Thus, capturing fresh blood was difficult.
If not for the survivor running out of stored food, they wouldn’t risk searching for supplies.
The Agile Type Zombie hadn’t tasted fresh human meat for many days, and the scent of blood was delectable.
Crunch! Crunch!
The zombie gnawed at the meat recklessly, while nearby zombies, drawn by the noise, instinctively headed over.
Roar! Roar!
Facing ordinary low-level zombies, the Agile Type Zombie roared a few times, intimidating many zombies from approaching with its overpowering presence.
Only then did the zombie contentedly continue its meal.
But just then, it heard another set of footsteps.
Five ordinary zombies fearlessly approached, disregarding its warning.
Roar!
The Agile Type Zombie roared again, its tone tinged with irritation.
Shuffle! Shuffle! Shuffle!
Unexpectedly, the low-level zombies charged straight at it without hesitation.
"Attack! Kill it!"
Lu Chuan directed the five Corpse Puppets to swiftly charge at the Agile Type Zombie.
Initially, Lu Chuan had masked these Corpse Puppets as ordinary low-level zombies, aimlessly moving towards the target.
Given its speed and claw strength capable of tearing cars apart, a misstep might result in all five Corpse Puppets getting destroyed.
Therefore, Lu Chuan initiated the attack when the distance narrowed to ten meters.
Lu Chuan’s controlled Corpse Puppets were physically fit, adult male zombies, and they reached the Agile Type Zombie almost instantly.
Bearing chilling Fire Axes, they swung them down without hesitation.
The Agile Type Zombie, seeing low-level zombies dare to attack, showed immense rage.
It moved instantly, but despite its agility, it got injured in the confrontation.
It dodged most of the attacks thanks to its speed, but Lu Chuan had prepared for a semi-surrounding position.
Unless the zombie fled, it was bound to be injured.
Its right arm and back were wounded on first contact.
But one Corpse Puppet’s axe got stuck between its ribs, and in fury, the Agile Zombie used its claws to tear that puppet’s skull apart.
The Agile Type Zombie evolved mainly for speed and fearsome offense.
Their defense, compared to bulkier zombies, was much weaker.
To Lu Chuan, its defense seemed only slightly better than ordinary zombies.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, two zombies feinted an attack from the front.
Boom!Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
The Agile Type Zombie, with formidable strength, pushed back Lu Chuan’s two zombies several steps with claws.
However, the other two puppets immediately swung their axes.
One chopped downward while the other sliced horizontally, the Agile Type Zombie dodged the top-slashing axe, but one axe buried deeply into its waist.
Slash!
A large chunk of flesh sliced away as the Agile Type Zombie suffered a grievous wound.
Roar!
Enraged beyond measure, it burst with speed, tearing another puppet’s head apart with claws.
Yet the remaining three zombies rushed in.
Though fast, the Agile Zombie couldn’t escape the barrage of axes.
Thunk! Thunk! Thunk!
Three axes struck successively, one severing the zombie’s head!
"High skills don’t beat knives, especially when I have five axes!"
Seeing the fallen Agile Type Zombie, Lu Chuan felt jubilant.
This Evolved Zombie was indeed powerful; without remote control, the five low-level zombies would’ve perished quickly.
Only two losses were incurred now.
Lu Chuan commanded the remaining Corpse Puppets to extract the Crystal Core, pocketed it, then swiftly returned to the residential area.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Second Evolution! Ten Corpse Puppets!
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24: Second Evolution! Ten Corpse Puppets!
These Corpse Puppets, controlled by Lu Chuan, have long lost their own thoughts unless Lu Chuan chooses to disconnect them actively.
Although the Crystal Core is full of temptation for the zombies, these remaining three Corpse Puppets are completely unmoved.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, the three Corpse Puppets sped towards the community.
Along the way, perhaps some zombies caught a whiff of them and wanted to come forward and snatch it; Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppets to raise their axes and strike.
Evolved Zombies are somewhat difficult to deal with, but for these ordinary zombies with no thoughts, Lu Chuan’s controlled Corpse Puppets could basically take them out with one axe swing each.
The Crystal Core escort team cut through like a hot knife through butter, rushing back to the community.
After taking the Crystal Core, Lu Chuan made these three Corpse Puppets wield fire axes and stand guard before the building’s door to ensure the safety of the building.
He then quickly ran to the sixth floor.
Upon seeing the Crystal Core, Lu Chuan was immediately delighted, because he discovered that this Crystal Core was identical to the one he had previously absorbed, white with a touch of red.
This meant that the agile zombie he just encircled and killed was not only an Evolved Zombie but had also devoured a Crystal Core!
"No wonder this Agile Type Zombie was so swift, it turned out it had already evolved once."
Calming the slight excitement in his heart, Lu Chuan then swallowed this Crystal Core.
Instantly, a vast energy once again swept through his body, similar to the feeling before.
Lu Chuan’s brain seemed to have expanded immensely again, but with the prior experience, Lu Chuan found it easy this time around.
Clenching his teeth and enduring the process of his telekinesis rapidly increasing, eventually, a very clear-minded feeling returned to his brain.
A faint smile slowly appeared on Lu Chuan’s lips; he knew his strength had become stronger again.
Lu Chuan’s five senses were once again enhanced, his hearing and vision, among others, had improved significantly compared to before, and most importantly, his telekinesis was far more powerful than before!
Moreover, Lu Chuan’s previously very feeble body had finally significantly improved after devouring two Crystal Cores.
His physical strength and speed, along with the defense of his skin, were all much enhanced compared to before!
Lu Chuan had been genuinely envious when he previously saw the massive size and strength of that large figure.
Especially those two arms that were like refined steel, they could withstand attacks from an agile zombie capable of tearing apart a car.
Though his body has not quite evolved to such an exaggerated level, it was much stronger than before.
Waving his fists with the wind roaring beneath, Lu Chuan felt like a martial arts master from a wuxia movie, who has immersed himself in martial arts for many years.
Feeling his current body, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
Although his evolution direction was always in telekinesis, his previously weak body made him a bit uneasy.
Now, he finally was significantly pleased with himself.
Lu Chuan picked up a steel machete placed by the side and started swinging it.
