In an instant, the living room was filled with flashes of the blade, with fierce and sharp whooshing sounds constantly slicing through the air.
This steel machete in Lu Chuan’s hands seemed like a deadly weapon.
Excitement flashed across Lu Chuan’s eyes; indeed, devouring Crystal Cores accelerated powerups greatly, substantially enhancing his close combat abilities!
Afterward, Lu Chuan concentrated his mind, finding that his telekinesis had also significantly improved than before.
If, initially, after the evolution by the Blood Moon, his telekinesis was roughly like a cup of water.
Now, it had multiplied several times, and could be likened to a washbasin.
Standing upstairs, Lu Chuan conducted a simple test and found that his current telekinetic power was sufficient to control ten zombies!
Moreover, the limit of control distance had reached 3,000 meters!
Feeling extremely excited, Lu Chuan quickly ran downstairs and, among the surrounding zombie hordes, selected ten zombies with healthy limbs and strong bodies to serve as his Corpse Puppet squad.
During this period, Lu Chuan’s dispatch of Corpse Puppets didn’t miss searching for supplies around here.
For weapons like fire axes, Lu Chuan would make the Corpse Puppets bring them back to the building whenever spotted.
Equipping each Corpse Puppet with a sharp fire axe, these robust Corpse Puppets of average height of one meter eighty now stood in front of Lu Chuan.
Each one bearing a fire axe on their shoulder, exuding an extraordinarily mighty aura!
Looking at his zombie squad, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
The zombie version of the Axe Gang seemed to have already taken shape.
Standing in front of this zombie squad, Lu Chuan only felt spirited, having shed all the confusion and depression after the apocalypse.
At this moment, Lu Chuan was already conjuring up an image in his mind of commanding a massive Zombie Army, wielding sharp blades in battles far and wide.The source of this content ɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Heh heh heh, you may be strong, but so what, in a one-on-one fight, I may not be the rival of those close-combat evolved zombies.
But... when Lu Chuan ventures out, he relies on three things!
Ferocity! Telekinesis! Numerous Corpse Puppets!
Surviving the apocalypse requires influence, who would fight solo against a bunch of small fry that only evolve muscles, not brain!
I’m adopting the spawn-troop strategy! Employing a mass mobilization approach!
You’re empty-handed fighting me, sorry, I’ve got axes and machetes together to serve you.
Martial ethics?
Having more men and more axes is the real good!
Looking at his gradually stronger-armed subordinates, Lu Chuan felt increasingly rich in confidence.
Turning his head towards Building No. 1 in the distance, Lu Chuan slightly squinted, a cold killing intent flashing in his eyes.
He had not forgotten that in Building No. 1, there existed an extremely terrifying monster, utterly different from any zombie he had encountered before.
Lu Chuan was even hesitant to call it a zombie because as a member of the Zombie Race, he really didn’t want to acknowledge his kind with such a creature...
Controlling the Corpse Puppets to experience death first-hand at close range, that blood-red figure brought terrifying shock to Lu Chuan.
Especially after facing an agile zombie today, in comparison, that zombie made Lu Chuan even more apprehensive.
Even this twice-evolved agile zombie couldn’t withstand his swarm tactics, but the speed of that blood-red figure was even faster than an agile zombie, and its attacks were even more ferocious.
What Lu Chuan was most concerned about was that the opponent also had a tongue that could serve as a hidden weapon, almost impossible to guard against.
Two zombies were instantly killed; could the ten Corpse Puppets’ strength barely swallow the opponent?
After thinking it over, Lu Chuan shook his head; with his current strength, it’s still hard to guarantee victory over the opponent.
The main problem was the too little knowledge about that monster, having merely met it once while scavenging for resources before.
Lu Chuan glanced towards the direction of Building No. 1, an apprehensive flash in his eyes.
Considering the opponent’s mysterious strength, Lu Chuan decided to find another opportunity in a few days, and send the Corpse Puppets in to test again, to see to what extent this monster’s strength has reached.
There was this ticking time bomb around, Lu Chuan’s mind couldn’t be at ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Fully Armed Corpse Puppet Squad!
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25: Fully Armed Corpse Puppet Squad!
Three days passed quickly.
During this time, Lu Chuan had almost transformed the sixth floor into a training room.
Bang! Bang! Bang!The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Muffled sounds kept emanating from the sixth-floor living room, accompanied by the snarls of zombies.
Crack!
Lu Chuan grabbed a zombie’s arm, locked its joint, and then swung it forcefully.
This zombie slammed into another one that had just approached Lu Chuan’s back, ready to bite.
Lu Chuan swiftly landed a high whip kick, knocking down another zombie beside him, its head flying right off with the blow.
Lu Chuan moved at lightning speed, completing the series of actions almost instantaneously.
After taking down three zombies, the other two barely managed to reach Lu Chuan’s side.
Lu Chuan chuckled coldly, diving down to grab and slam the two zombies together.
Crack! Crack!
With Lu Chuan’s fists swinging, the snarling zombies’ heads were all smashed to a pulp.
Even when attacked by five zombies at once, Lu Chuan now handled it effortlessly.
Lu Chuan found that after evolving, his physical abilities had greatly improved.
Not only strength but also speed, reflexes, and bodily flexibility had all evolved comprehensively!
This significant enhancement made Lu Chuan facing the zombie siege seem like a martial arts master.
His body moved like a dancing butterfly, easily dodging the bites and attacks of these ordinary zombies.
And with the combat skills he had practiced during this period, Lu Chuan could quickly take down several zombies.
With the increase in strength, Lu Chuan could crush zombie heads with powerful punches and kicks!
Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction, his body now truly resembling that of a post-apocalyptic survivor.
Previously, his frail and stiff body struggled to protect itself against ordinary zombie assaults, a concern that no longer exists!
Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppets and moved these zombies, smashed into pieces, out of the room.
Lu Chuan then simply washed the blood off himself, as he had to feed the little guy soon; being covered in blood wouldn’t do.
Returning to the seventh floor, Lu Chuan prepared the formula and fed Little Qiqi spoon by spoon.
Seeing the little one’s pure smile, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but smile too; the little one’s appetite was growing, the milk tasted sweet every day.
Even in this apocalyptic world, Qiqi’s appetite hadn’t diminished.
After feeding Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan fetched a pile of toys he had scavenged.
Included were Barbie dolls, toy cars, teddy bears, and so on.
Ji Ruxue looked at her zombie dad, awkwardly playing with her, feeling exasperated.
Even though she seemed like a baby, her heart was that of a mature, calm, decisive Unparalleled Empress.
How could children’s toys possibly interest her?
But it was still a kind gesture from her zombie dad.
Even as someone who had lived two lives, Ji Ruxue had long outgrown being entertained by small toys.
Yet she felt incredibly warm inside, as she had never felt such love and pampering in either life.
Seeing her zombie dad try so hard, Ji Ruxue forced a slight smile.
Lu Chuan initially felt frustrated seeing Little Qiqi expressionless.
Having never dated or raised a child, he could only imitate what he had seen in dramas.
Thinking he had failed, he was surprised when the little one actually smiled, bringing relief and doubling his efforts in amusing Ji Ruxue.
Ji Ruxue’s eyelids couldn’t help but twitch, "Being too kind might not be a good thing."
"Nevermind, assume it’s training my telekinesis..."
After playing with the little one for a while, Lu Chuan nodded contentedly.
Then he went to the window, a sly grin appeared on his lips.
"Almost ready, time to test that guy’s limits."
Lu Chuan selected his squad anew from the wandering zombie horde.
Though evolved zombies were rare, ordinary low-level zombies were still abundant on the streets.
Even with daily combat training, constantly depleting zombies, he could continually replenish his ranks from the surroundings.
After some selection, Lu Chuan had replenished ten Corpse Puppets.
Each one was tall, strong, fully limbed, not previously bitten by others.
The blood-red monster from last time had left a massive impact on Lu Chuan.
Two zombie Corpse Puppets were completely massacred without resistance.
This stark difference in combat power made Lu Chuan never underestimate the opponent.
Looking at these ten robust zombies wielding fire axes, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
Together, these ten Corpse Puppets exerted a formidable sense of pressure.
Lu Chuan believed that even against giant zombies, the Corpse Puppet squad could chop them to death.
Though looking at these zombies, Lu Chuan felt something still lacked. After some thought, he slapped his forehead.
"I’ve armed these zombies with weapons, but they need at least some armor!"
Lu Chuan remembered a corner store selling electric bikes and helmets.
He led the zombies to break open the shop door, outfitting each Corpse Puppet with a full-face motorcycle helmet.
Seeing his transformed Corpse Puppet squad standing before him, Lu Chuan beamed with joy.
The ten Corpse Puppets, donning black full-face helmets, holding fire axes in formation, might be mistaken for a biker gang reincarnate.
Lu Chuan tapped the helmets, nodding in satisfaction, the defense should now be adequate.
As for other armor, Lu Chuan didn’t provide any, as they were only low-level zombies.
Without armor, he could just control new ones from the zombie horde if necessary.
Zombies are nearly undead, defying biological norms.
For zombies, only the head is fatally vulnerable; protect the head, and even with missing limbs, they can still fight.
Wearing helmets greatly enhances this Corpse Puppet squad’s combat abilities.
Even with body tears, as long as the head remains intact, they can swing back with an axe.
Lu Chuan finally nodded in satisfaction.
Then, leading his Corpse Puppet squad, he boldly marched towards Building One.

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Battle Against the "Aberrant" Zombie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26: Battle Against the "Aberrant" Zombie!
I really don’t know how this monster in Building One evolved into what it is now...
Recalling the last encounter, Lu Chuan felt a bit nauseated by the bloody, hideous appearance of the opponent.
Even if you’re a zombie, at least you should have a human presence.
In the end, that bloody monster was almost unrecognizable as a person from its past life...
Last time, being instantly headshot by this monster, Lu Chuan came prepared this time, feeling somewhat confident.
"I want to see if you can withstand my Axe Gang, monster!"
Lu Chuan still remained in Building Five, concentrating on controlling the Corpse Puppet team.
Now, his telepathic range is three kilometers, eliminating the need to be on the battlefield personally.
What’s more, the zombie is so terrifying, Lu Chuan didn’t think he could withstand it in close combat...
So hiding at home is the safest bet.
Lu Chuan remotely controlled ten Corpse Puppets, entering the gate of a building, and started checking room by room from the first floor.
Lu Chuan wasn’t in a rush, conducting the inspection very cautiously, afraid of missing a single corner.
Especially the ceilings, Lu Chuan paid special attention to any traces.
After all, the structure of this blood-colored mutant monster’s evolved body is very bizarre.
Discarding the human form for combat, it gained limbs with claws and powerful physical strength, allowing it to move quickly between walls and ceilings.
As Lu Chuan slowly searched, the Corpse Puppets inspected inch by inch.
Soon they finished searching four floors, but still didn’t find the trace of the blood-colored monster.
Lu Chuan frowned, "Four continuous floors without seeing it, could this Bloodthirsty Monster have fled early?"
Soon, the Corpse Puppet team reached the fifth floor, continuing their cautious search indoors.
However, they didn’t notice the blood-colored monster right above the door when they entered the room.
Four claws were embedded like steel blades into the wall, lying on top of the door like a spider without a sound.
Its vicious eyes were fixated on the Corpse Puppets below.
The monster’s position was very tricky, precisely in the blind spot of the Corpse Puppets’ sight.
After all, Lu Chuan was remotely controlling the Corpse Puppets, and could only share their vision, making it impossible to observe as directly as if he were there.
"Where on earth did this monster go? Surely it hasn’t run out of this building!"
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but worry; this blood-colored monster was very difficult to deal with.
If it escapes Building One and hides in the shadows, the danger level increases significantly. It’s definitely a top-tier killer zombie.
Swish!
Just then, a sound of something breaking through the air rang out, and a blood-colored figure suddenly dropped from above.
Bang!
As the blood-colored monster swung its claws, a nearby zombie Corpse Puppet was heavily struck, sent flying, crashing hard on the ground.
Fortunately, Lu Chuan was prepared, equipping all these zombies with full-cover helmets.
The motorcycle helmet was almost ripped in half, and the head of the Corpse Puppet was nearly crushed completely.
However, thanks to the helmet, the Corpse Puppet wasn’t entirely dead and could still fight back.
Lu Chuan immediately reacted, swiftly controlling the Corpse Puppets to turn around, swinging their fire axes at the blood-colored figure.
The powerful axes sliced through the air, making a whistling sound.
If Ji Ruxue were present, she would instantly recognize the zombie species before her.Follow current novᴇls on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
It was one of the Licker zombies from her previous life’s memory, which caused massive casualties among human survivors in the early apocalypse!
The bloody Licker appeared to be enraged by the Corpse Puppet squad invading its territory.
Facing the swinging axes, it didn’t care and continued attacking the Corpse Puppets.
Seeing this, Lu Chuan’s lips curled into a cold smile; a zombie is still a zombie, no matter how it evolves, it’s useless without evolving the brain.
The Corpse Licker moved swiftly, maneuvering among the Corpse Puppets.
The terrifying claws swung, and several zombies were slapped away.
However, under Lu Chuan’s command, the Corpse Puppets continued attacking as long as their heads weren’t crushed.
Even if their bodies were pierced, the axes would swing down directly.
Splutch!
The Licker pierced through a Corpse Puppet’s body with a claw, but Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppet to embrace the Licker’s claw firmly.
Without hesitation, it swung an axe down on its head.
Several Corpse Puppets also charged with their fire axes, continuously swinging their blades.
Though the Licker was incredibly fast, being surrounded by the Corpse Puppets, it struggled to dodge the continuous strikes, getting hit several times.
During this time, Lu Chuan trained not only his close combat skills but also practiced slashing techniques with axes.
To maximize the Corpse Puppets’ combat effectiveness, Lu Chuan specifically studied some axe-swinging techniques.
To make his Corpse Puppet team wield axes more swiftly.
Lu Chuan even controlled several Corpse Puppets to attempt consecutive strikes on the same spot of the blood-colored monster.
After all, the monster’s muscles looked really solid.
Lu Chuan knew that relying on the combat power of low-tier Corpse Puppets alone, injuring it seriously was unlikely.
But fortunately, he relied on swarm tactics, not solo fights.
Sure enough, under Lu Chuan’s control, the persistent slashing inflicted numerous wounds on the Licker.
However, just as Lu Chuan expected, the Licker’s muscles were very well-developed.
With only the strength of ordinary zombies, the fire axe could only bring out some flesh, unable to inflict serious damage.
Lu Chuan immediately controlled three Corpse Puppets, directing all axes at one spot.
Splutch!
The three-axe assault finally worked, and with the last Corpse Puppet’s fire axe swing, the Licker couldn’t dodge in time and lost an arm.
After losing an arm, the Licker finally realized the fierceness of the zombie squad before it, completely leaping out of the Corpse Puppets and climbing onto the ceiling.
Lu Chuan immediately commanded the Corpse Puppets to throw their fire axes at the ceiling.
Bang bang bang!
But unfortunately, after escaping the Corpse Puppets’ encirclement, the Licker’s speed became extremely fast.
However, the low-tier Corpse Puppets’ speed, strength, and accuracy plummeted under Lu Chuan’s control.
The Licker reacted quickly, dodging the axes before smashing the window glass and escaping outside.
Lu Chuan’s pupils contracted, watching through the Corpse Puppets’ vision, seeing the blood-colored monster scaling the building’s exterior wall as if walking on flat ground!
Moreover, its movements were so fast that it vanished in the blink of an eye!

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Zombie Dad Really Is a Scaredy-Cat!
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27: Zombie Dad Really Is a Scaredy-Cat!
"Damn it, this guy actually got away!"
Watching the figure disappear outside the window, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but curse silently.
He didn’t expect that even with ten Corpse Puppets and ample preparation, the adversary managed to escape.
This zombie could walk effortlessly even on a ninety-degree building facade.
Its movements were so swift, it was practically a born killer.
Lu Chuan secretly felt fortunate he had prepared a helmet ahead of time, or today not only would he fail to capture this blood-red monster, but he would also lose a large number of Corpse Puppets!
This blood-red monster was so fast that Lu Chuan couldn’t clearly follow its movements.
This inability to kill it during the mission might alert the monster, giving it a sense of caution or even a desire for revenge!
Its limbs had terrifying strength, easily able to hang inverted anywhere, ready to strike at any moment. This was by far the most challenging Mutated Zombie Lu Chuan had encountered.
Letting this monster escape was like having a ticking time bomb.
If it fled the neighborhood outright, it would be fine, but the fear was it might still be lurking inside, posing a huge threat to him.
This zombie moved silently, making it hard to track its whereabouts. In a one-on-one fight, Lu Chuan was not its match.
The worst part was that the building outside wall posed no obstacle to zombies, allowing them to climb freely like spiders...
Lu Chuan’s greatest concern now was that if the blood-red monster sneaked into Building 5, it would be disastrous.
After all, this creature didn’t need stairs; even if he stationed several zombies to block the hallways, it would be of no use.
Should it discover Little Qiqi, it could climb the outer wall, rendering defenses useless...
But at the moment, Lu Chuan was at a loss, having underestimated the creature’s strength and allowing it to escape...
It’s never too late to mend the fold after the sheep have escaped.
Lu Chuan quickly regained his composure and began formulating a defensive plan.
Immediately, he stationed three strong Corpse Puppets, fully armed to patrol inside Building 5 daily, ensuring he would be alerted if the monster infiltrated, preventing a surprise attack.
Looking at the marks the zombie left on the wall, Lu Chuan clicked his tongue in disbelief.
Such a formidable presence, the energy within its Crystal Core was likely far surpassing any large or Agile Type zombies he had encountered before.
If he could devour this zombie’s Crystal Core, his strength would surely ascend to another level.
For now, Lu Chuan could only dispatch other Corpse Puppets to continue patrolling the area, hoping to encounter other evolved type zombies.
Having swallowed two Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan felt very confident, but this blood-red monster had given him a reality check.
Lu Chuan urgently wanted to boost his strength; otherwise, if he faced a more powerful zombie, controlling several Corpse Puppets would be futile.
Lu Chuan could now control Corpse Puppets within a 3000-meter radius. This distance was quite extensive.
In the seventh-floor bedroom, Ji Ruxue’s Telekinesis had also made considerable progress.
At this moment, she was manipulating two dolls, making them fly around in the air.
Being the Unparalleled Empress, Ji Ruxue initially had no interest in playing with such small toys.
But she wanted to respect Lu Chuan’s goodwill, and later found that controlling the dolls was not only fun but also enhanced her Telekinesis, and she became unexpectedly fascinated...
Detecting Lu Chuan’s approach from outside the door, Ji Ruxue quickly stopped using Telekinesis and pulled the dolls into her embrace.
As Lu Chuan entered, he saw Little Qiqi happily playing with the dolls here.
The smile was pure, and her eyes shone with unblemished innocence.
Seeing such a pure and wonderful little creature, Lu Chuan’s mood seemed to be healed.
"Little one, this world is too dark and broken; I hope when you grow you won’t be disappointed by it..."
"I hope you continue growing carefree, and that both of us can keep living in this post-apocalyptic world."
Looking at the little one before him, Lu Chuan felt motivated in everything he did.
Despite the devastation outside the window, there remained a human touch of beauty and purity within this bedroom.
To survive in this world means constant killing, and this bedroom is Lu Chuan’s last haven.
Looking at the bedroom window, Lu Chuan’s expression became exceedingly serious, and he hurriedly left.
Ji Ruxue curiously watched her zombie dad, who hadn’t gone out searching for supplies for days but stayed indoors.
Now coming in and going out with a frown, had something happened outside?
Soon, Ji Ruxue saw her zombie dad returning with a pile of planks and nails.
Then he began nailing the planks onto the window one by one.
That blood-red monster far exceeded ordinary judgment, completely different from regular zombies.
Although it couldn’t walk upright, it could scale walls in an exaggerated manner.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Even the outer building walls posed no obstacle, so the previously safe seventh floor was now no longer secure.
Even though Lu Chuan arranged Corpse Puppets to patrol the hallway for safety...
Such zombies could bypass usual paths. If it climbed through the bedroom window, it couldn’t be guarded against.
He couldn’t constantly monitor the bedroom window, so he had to temporarily board it up.
At least this would prevent being caught off guard, maintaining Little Qiqi’s safety to a certain extent.
As Ji Ruxue lay on her bed, she couldn’t help but feel puzzled by what she saw.
Her zombie dad had been home for days without venturing out, but today he started boarding the window?
Looking at her zombie dad’s serious demeanor, Ji Ruxue lightly raised her eyebrow.
Could it be her zombie dad experienced the formidable strength of Evolved Zombies and was too afraid, wanting to escape the chaos outside?
Ji Ruxue pondered, and it seemed this could be the only explanation since typically zombies wouldn’t board up windows.
Even though Ji Ruxue understood, ordinary low-tier zombies instinctively felt terrified when facing evolved Mutated Zombies.
Normal low-tier zombies had no chance against Mutated Zombies.
However, it shouldn’t scare him to the point of closing up the windows...
Ji Ruxue helplessly shook her head.
"My zombie dad truly is a coward."

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Survivor: That Zombie Can Actually Use Weapons?
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28: Survivor: That Zombie Can Actually Use Weapons?
Ji Ruxue didn’t look down on her zombie dad in her heart, after all, she was aware that being an ordinary zombie, surviving in this end-of-the-world scenario was already a very difficult thing.
In Ji Ruxue’s memory, as more and more evolved zombies and fierce beasts appeared, low-level ordinary zombies were like ants on the roadside, no different from cannon fodder.
Moreover, since the Blood Moon, many Evolvers have also emerged among humans.
At first, humans could only flee in panic when faced with these ordinary zombies, but as they continued to evolve, even humans could easily hunt these low-level zombies...
Without strength or status, it was already very difficult for ordinary zombies to live, let alone taking care of a baby like herself.
Furthermore, Ji Ruxue was very clear in her heart that her dad did this for her safety.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
After all, the bedroom on the seventh floor was her living space, and dad also hoped she wouldn’t be disturbed by other zombies.
Looking at her zombie dad who kept staring at the wooden planks, a wave of warmth flowed through Ji Ruxue’s heart.
Even in this harsh apocalypse, even when faced with countless pressures and life-or-death crises that could arrive at any moment.
Even though her zombie dad was terribly afraid of the apocalypse and too scared to leave the house.
He never thought about abandoning this burden...
Although he didn’t have enough strength, he still tried his best to find ways to protect her safety.
Even though her zombie dad was a zombie, he had already surpassed most people in this apocalypse.
At least to Ji Ruxue, whether in a past life or this life, it’s the first time she’s experienced such a profound father’s love.
"Zombie Dad! Just wait for me, it won’t be long before you won’t have to be so worried and scared anymore."
"As long as I’m given enough time to grow, then I’ll be the one to protect you!"
Looking at the silhouette of her zombie dad, Ji Ruxue’s eyes emanated a determination beyond her years.
The arrival of the apocalypse has made humanity lose too much.
Ji Ruxue didn’t want to lose the precious family love she had never gained in both her lifetimes...
Bang bang bang!
Lu Chuan kept hammering nails and finally finished fortifying the window.
However, Lu Chuan didn’t completely seal it; he left two openings for light and ventilation.
Although safety was very important, Lu Chuan didn’t want Little Qiqi to live in such a stifling and oppressive environment at her young age.
Especially since the bedroom was now boarded up with wooden planks, providing some level of defense.
Looking at the bedroom window, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
That blood-red creature was indeed strong, but even it would take some effort to break through the glass and layers of wooden planks to get inside.
This blood-red creature’s attack on zombies was like a massacre, but its strength was not as great as that of a bulky zombie.
At least the defense of this bedroom window would buy some reaction time.
Time whisked by, and three more days had passed.
Lu Chuan had the Corpse Puppets continuously search the area, but since the blood-red creature disappeared, it hadn’t shown up again.
Not seeing that terrifying figure, Lu Chuan let out a slight sigh of relief.
Nonetheless, Lu Chuan didn’t let his guard down, and still had two Corpse Puppets patrol Building Five constantly.
After all, these zombies neither eat nor drink nor need rest, and he didn’t have to pay them.
Suddenly, Lu Chuan felt a mental wave in his mind.
One of the Corpse Puppets searching for supplies at a distance had made a new discovery.
In order to gather resources, a Corpse Puppet reached a small shop two streets away, and after prising open the door, it began gathering supplies.
"Damn! Why is there someone in this shop?!"
"Doesn’t matter, he’s unlucky to run into us, let’s kill him!"
At that moment, a few human survivors rushed in from outside, all wielding steel pipes and kitchen knives.
Each of them glared fiercely at the Corpse Puppet.
But when Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppet to turn around, they all froze.
"Damn, is this actually a zombie?!"
The few who had just charged in were startled when they saw the Corpse Puppet controlled by Lu Chuan.
The pale body and blood-colored pupils were unmistakable indicators of a zombie.
The aggressive few immediately stiffened in place, their eyes filled with fear.
Even though the apocalypse had been going on for a while, human survivors still had an innate fear of zombies.
Lu Chuan was also taken aback by the group that burst in, not expecting there to be survivors hidden nearby.
Not wanting to stir up more trouble, Lu Chuan planned to control the Corpse Puppet to leave the shop.
"Look at you guys being scared. It’s just a zombie! What’s there to fear?"
Among them, a somewhat brawny man holding an iron rod charged at Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet.
Lu Chuan shook his head helplessly. He hadn’t wanted to cause more trouble, but now he had no option but to control the Corpse Puppet to wield the Fire Axe in defense.
Bam!
The axe and iron rod clashed, and the moment they met, Lu Chuan was greatly surprised.
The Corpse Puppet he chose was fairly strong-bodied, and zombies were generally stronger than average humans.
But Lu Chuan didn’t expect this man’s strength to be so immense. The force from the steel pipe was so powerful that it left the Corpse Puppet’s arm numb.
The Fire Axe wasn’t even firmly gripped and was knocked out of its hand!
The man was decisive in attack, quickly following up the move, and before Lu Chuan could react, the steel pipe smashed down directly.
Bam!
With a dull thud, the Corpse Puppet’s head broke open like a watermelon.
The man approached the body of Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet and contemplatively looked at the Fire Axe that was knocked away.
"The world really is outrageous, even zombies are using weapons now?"
"Could this be some new type of Evolved Zombie?"
Before long, he lost interest in that, turning to urge his companions behind him.
"Alright, let’s quickly move these supplies; we might attract an Evolved Zombie if we take too long."
Upon hearing this, the group promptly got busy, continuously stuffing their backpacks with all sorts of food and bottled water.
In this apocalypse, finding an unlooted store was just like a paradise.
"Luckily we have Gangzi here; otherwise, we wouldn’t find so much food!"
"Yeah, what are Evolved Zombies to us? With Big Brother Gangzi’s Divine Power, it’d be handled in one strike!"
Seeing the robust man defeat the zombie with one strike, the companions praised him while they scavenged supplies.
After all, having a powerful companion significantly increased the chances of survival.
The man known as Gangzi wore a hint of pride on his face upon receiving the admiration and commendation.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Has Little 77 Learned to Walk?
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29: Has Little 77 Learned to Walk?
"I didn’t expect that after such a long time, there would still be survivors alive nearby?!"
In Building No. 5, Lu Chuan frowned slightly, feeling a bit surprised as he recalled the scene just now.
It’s been more than a month since the zombie apocalypse outbreak. Especially recently, Lu Chuan has barely seen any living people.
Besides the unlucky guy who was killed by an Agile Zombie last time, he hasn’t seen any other humans for a long time.
The empty streets were only patrolled by one mindless zombie after another.
But unexpectedly, this time he saw several people directly. It seems that the number of humans surviving the zombie crisis is not that small after all.
However, because these zombies are full of bloodlust, most people can only hide in the dark.
But thinking back to the man who fought with his Corpse Puppet just now, Lu Chuan’s expression turned extremely solemn.
Even though that man appeared to be more robust, relatively speaking, than the few people around him, it was absolutely impossible for him to have such formidable strength.
The Corpse Puppets he selected were all physically strong types, and after turning into zombies, their strength had been enhanced to a certain degree.
Even just the zombies themselves wouldn’t have trouble dealing with such ordinary survivors.
Furthermore, the Corpse Puppets were under his control and could use weapons against enemies.
But he didn’t expect that after clashing with that man, even the Fire Axe in his hand was knocked away, which is simply a natural Divine Power!
Reflecting on his experiences during this time, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but speculate silently.
All the changes seem to trace back to that Blood Moon night, after which zombies seem to have evolved, and it seems that different evolutionary paths have emerged.
The Blood Moon in the sky, bathed in moonlight, affected not just zombies.
Lu Chuan was somewhat skeptical, wondering if other creatures had undergone the same changes?
The mysterious man encountered today might very well be an evolved human.
Such terrifying power is probably something only evolved creatures could unleash.
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but feel that the changes in this world seemed far more complex than he had imagined.
Previously, he had always been focused on those evolved zombies, but now it seems that as the Blood Moon time passes, more and more peculiar creatures are going to appear in this world.
"Forget it, it seems that the Corpse Puppets can’t be sent to that area anymore..."
To Lu Chuan, evolved humans were scarier than zombies.
Because zombies have no brains, he could still use his Corpse Puppets for wave attacks or set traps to kill them.
But the same tactics wouldn’t work so well on humans.
Currently, Lu Chuan doesn’t want to stir up more trouble; he only hopes to have stronger power, live well in this apocalypse, and let Little Qiqi grow up healthy and happy.
Humans have extremely complex thoughts and high intelligence, and the subtleties that zombies don’t detect don’t mean that human survivors won’t find them.
Lu Chuan doesn’t want to risk being targeted by these human survivors for the sake of a bit of resources.
After all, he is not a lone wolf; he can take his Corpse Puppets and escape anytime, anywhere.
In his bedroom, there is a baby, Little Qiqi, which means Lu Chuan has to consider the little one’s safety.
Currently, Lu Chuan only hopes to continue searching via his Corpse Puppets and kill a few isolated Evolved Zombies, using their Crystal Cores to gain more strength and power.
After all, the apocalypse is becoming increasingly complex, and only by having sufficiently strong power can he and the little one continue to live safely.
As for what changes will happen in the outside world, Lu Chuan doesn’t really care.
He himself mysteriously came to this world and was bitten by a zombie out of nowhere.
For Lu Chuan, as long as they don’t disturb his and the little one’s life, the world can do whatever it wants; it has nothing to do with him.
After the interlude of meeting human survivors, a few days passed in the blink of an eye.
Lu Chuan has stopped collecting resources for now, as the efficiency of these few Corpse Puppets is too high, filling every room in Building No. 5 with various supplies.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
These resources are completely enough for Little Qiqi to use, and hoarding too much also has no meaning.
After all, as time goes by, these resources will eventually expire.
If you hoard too much and can’t use it, it’s a waste of time and effort and might even attract some unnecessary trouble.
In the seventh-floor bedroom.
During this time, Ji Ruxue has been continuously practicing the Glazed Breathing Technique day and night, absorbing the Energy Factors in the air, which have continuously enhanced her strength.
In particular, the originally very weak Telekinesis has now greatly improved!
Ji Ruxue initially felt exhausted controlling a leaf, but now she’s even trying to use Telekinesis to lift her own body.
In this world, it would be too inconvenient not to be able to live independently, and at least a certain level of survival ability is required when the apocalypse comes.
Her zombie dad seems like a very ordinary low-level zombie at present, and Ji Ruxue also understands that she absolutely cannot just be a baby lying in bed.
She must quickly adapt to the apocalyptic life, or else they might face a crisis sooner or later.
Ji Ruxue is constantly using her power for crawling training on the bed in the bedroom.
With the Glazed Breathing Technique’s body transformation over time, Ji Ruxue’s strength has far surpassed that of her peers.
As Ji Ruxue gains more control over her body, her crawling speed on the bed increases rapidly.
Ji Ruxue finally began to use Telekinesis to balance her body.
Then, with the support of Telekinesis, she gradually shifted from crawling on all fours to walking upright.
If she directly used Telekinesis for flying, it would consume a lot of energy.
But using Telekinesis to maintain momentum and rapidly learn upright walking wasn’t much of a problem.
And since she was always supported by surrounding Telekinesis, Ji Ruxue didn’t have to worry about falling.
With such assured learning conditions, she quickly began walking upright.
Creak—
Just then, Lu Chuan pushed open the door and walked in. Seeing the scene on the bed, Lu Chuan was immediately shocked, his jaw dropping.
Lu Chuan even doubted if he was hallucinating.
Little Qiqi was only a few months old, and now she was already walking upright on the bed?
He didn’t even know when the little one learned to crawl, and now she was starting to learn how to walk?!

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Zombie Dad’s Swordsmanship Is So Trash!
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30: Zombie Dad’s Swordsmanship Is So Trash!
After the initial shock, Lu Chuan’s eyes were filled with delight, and he couldn’t control the upward curve of his mouth.
Although Lu Chuan was determined to help the little one grow up healthy and happy,
he was very aware that the little one lived in this post-apocalyptic world, an unchangeable fact.
So even if he could always protect Little Qiqi, the little one would eventually have to learn to adapt to life in the post-apocalyptic world.
Though he had this thought in mind, Lu Chuan was not prepared for the little one to start learning to adapt to life in the apocalypse just yet.
Even though he didn’t know Qiqi’s precise age, from her size Lu Chuan guessed she might just be a few months old.
After all, the little one wasn’t weaned yet and could only lie in her crib unable to move.
Originally, Lu Chuan thought it would be a long time before the little one learned to walk.
But surprisingly, after a few days of not paying attention, the little one had taught herself!
Seeing Little Qiqi toddling crookedly on the bed, Lu Chuan quickly picked her up and placed her in the living room to practice walking.
Because the mattress was very soft, and the bed provided an uneven surface, even if the little one learned to walk, it would take more time to master walking on flat ground.
Directly practicing on the flat ground in the living room, the progress would be greater.
As for Ji Ruxue, whether in the living room or on the ground, she could master either with time.
After all, her Telekinesis was now capable of temporarily levitating her body, so balancing herself was a small matter.
Ji Ruxue initially walked a bit clumsily, needing time to adapt to standing and moving with this body.
But quickly, as she got used to this body, combined with the strength she honed, Ji Ruxue was walking very steadily.
Ji Ruxue looked up and saw the zombie dad’s shocked expression, feeling a bit proud inside.
If not fearing the zombie dad’s shock, she could even turn a somersault.
Standing aside, Lu Chuan was impressed by how quickly the little one adapted to walking, and with such stability.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
Little Qiqi finally grew up a bit.
At this moment, Lu Chuan felt a sense of indescribable achievement.
For the little one to walk upright at such a young age, she was completely ahead of her peers.
My daughter has the makings of an Empress!
But after practicing for a while, Ji Ruxue stopped.
Given her current physical condition, relying solely on her body’s strength to maintain upright walking was difficult.
To balance her body, she would need to constantly expend Telekinesis.
Even though her age had broken through considerably over this period, she couldn’t sustain constant consumption and naturally couldn’t continue walking upright.
Lu Chuan, seeing this, thought Ji Ruxue was tired from learning to walk upright.
Lu Chuan quickly picked the little one up and placed her on the living room sofa to rest.
Understanding the principle of gradual progress, Lu Chuan didn’t expect the little one to transition from lying in her crib to walking upright in a single day — that would be too much...
Lu Chuan himself took a steel machete and walked to the balcony to practice ’knife techniques.’
After consuming Crystal Core, Lu Chuan’s body had evolved to some extent.
His speed, reaction time, and strength had improved, and as he swung the steel machete its blade cut through the air with a whooshing sound.
The silver sheen of the blade flashed continuously in the air, giving Lu Chuan the demeanor of a martial arts master.
Regardless of past or present, Lu Chuan had never undergone martial arts training.
His current practice was merely imitation based on memories of martial arts movies from his past life, swinging the machete following simple moves.
Lu Chuan felt that as long as he was fast and powerful enough, even a brick could be effective.
With long periods of training, Lu Chuan could feel his proficiency with the machete increasing, becoming more familiar with wielding it.
Though compared to true experts, his skills were crude and full of flaws.
But Lu Chuan didn’t mind, wondering, no matter how good the knife skills are, wouldn’t you be afraid if even zombies can wield a knife?
The sound of the blade cutting through the air caught Ji Ruxue’s attention, looking at Lu Chuan practicing on the balcony, she was a bit surprised.
Is zombie dad enhancing his skills?
Ji Ruxue had already decided her zombie dad was just an ordinary zombie.
Even after the Blood Moon, he hadn’t awakened any Extraordinary Abilities.
But Ji Ruxue understood her zombie dad had a significant difference compared to ordinary zombies.
That was his human-like consciousness, his greatest advantage.
After all, other ordinary zombies wouldn’t think or use tools.
As long as he held a sharp blade, even though he couldn’t handle powerful Evolved Zombies, he had a significant advantage among ordinary low-level zombies.
Ji Ruxue secretly nodded, realizing her zombie dad seemed lacking in power, but was quite smart.
However... these knife techniques were so trashy!
In her past life as the Human Queen during the apocalypse, Ji Ruxue had experienced countless battles.
She held outstanding insights and experience in close combat and weaponry.
Moreover, she honed many powerful Martial Techniques later on.
In Ji Ruxue’s eyes, her zombie dad’s knife practice looked intimidating but was actually full of flaws.
Against an opponent with greater fighting power, her zombie dad would be instantly beaten...
These flashy moves lacked any real combat effectiveness.
Exerting energy without result—a complete waste.
While Lu Chuan was on the balcony swinging the machete, seeing Little Qiqi staring intently at him, he felt proud.
Lu Chuan thought the little one was drawn to his knife techniques, and he swung even harder.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Mutant Zombies Reappear!
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Chapter 31: Mutant Zombies Reappear!
Watching the zombie father tirelessly wielding a machete on the balcony, Ji Ruxue finally understood why she could hear all kinds of clattering noises from downstairs every day when she was in bed.
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue felt a sudden realization. No wonder the zombie father hadn’t left the house in the past few days; he must have sensed the crisis outside and was practicing combat skills in the house.
Although the zombie father’s swordsmanship was quite unsightly, there was no denying that it was indeed an effective way to strengthen his abilities.
Outside, the zombies mutated by the Blood Moon mutation had all evolved, possessing formidable combat power, and they would also undergo some significant changes.
But her zombie father hadn’t changed at all until now, obviously one of the most ordinary low-level cannon fodder zombies.
So, tirelessly waving swords, improving his skill with the blade, and strengthening his attack and defense as much as possible was not a bad approach.
At least in Ji Ruxue’s memories of her previous life, many survivors would work out to strengthen their bodies for more and better stamina when facing zombies.
As an ordinary zombie without special abilities, it’s only through such simple methods that he can improve his survival rate in this apocalypse.
Ji Ruxue watched Lu Chuan practicing his machete swings and for a moment, her mind wandered elsewhere.
And Lu Chuan, seeing Ji Ruxue watching him so intently, thought the little girl was interested in these things.
For a moment, Lu Chuan wielded the machete even more powerfully, the sound of it cutting through the air echoed in the space.
"I didn’t expect the little one to be interested in such violent things, it seems I need to practice more diligently, so I can teach her this set of techniques when she grows up," Lu Chuan thought proudly.
In this apocalypse, the only method Lu Chuan could think of was to simply increase survival chances.
The little girl, being a girl interested in handling knives and swords, was a good thing in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
After all, the apocalypse is very cruel and won’t be lenient because of your age or gender.
Lu Chuan was also happy to share his experiences with her when she grew up, at least to improve the little one’s chance of survival.The source of this content ɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
In this brutal apocalypse, Lu Chuan still felt that enhancing survival ability was more necessary.
In the following days, Lu Chuan just let Little Qiqi play by herself in the living room.
After all, the windows in the seventh-floor bedroom were boarded up to prevent that bloody creature, so the lighting wasn’t good.
The sixth-floor living room was much brighter, and as he often trained in combat there, it was more spacious.
Lu Chuan practiced his close-combat skills and blade techniques on the balcony, while Ji Ruxue practiced upright walking in the living room, also honing her telekinesis abilities.
Accompanied by Lu Chuan, little Ji Ruxue walked more steadily each day.
Under Lu Chuan’s watch, Little Qiqi was progressing so rapidly compared to ordinary children, it was almost incredible, like a prodigy.
Yet Ji Ruxue’s eyes became more determined, with not a hint of childish innocence in her clear black and white pupils.
As the apocalypse progressed, Ji Ruxue felt a sense of crisis growing inside her, becoming more anxious.
After all, since the Blood Moon mutation, the whole world had become fraught with danger.
The abundant release of energy factors in the air caused many zombies to undergo a series of mutations and evolution.
And now, this was just the beginning, the changes would become more terrifying later on.
Meanwhile, many other creatures joined the ranks of evolution.
For an ordinary cannon fodder like her zombie father, there might soon be no room for survival.
So Ji Ruxue knew she had to grow up quickly.
At the very least, she needed to master upright walking quickly, to have some decent mobility.
Only in this way could she help the zombies, and at least not be a burden in this apocalypse.
In such a gradually more brutal apocalypse, an ordinary unevolved zombie, plus an infant not yet able to move freely, seemed like a catastrophic start to Ji Ruxue.
As an empress, if she wanted to turn the tide with such a start, she had no other option but to find a way to quickly enhance her cultivation progress.
Roar!
Just as Lu Chuan and Ji Ruxue were methodically improving themselves, suddenly a furious roar came from outside the building.
Upon hearing the roar, Lu Chuan, who was watching Ji Ruxue walk, immediately reacted.
In the next second, Lu Chuan’s vision shifted, and he controlled a Corpse Puppet to swiftly arrive at the scene.
He saw, among the greenery of Sunshine District, two zombies who had obviously undergone mutation and evolution post-Blood Moon mutation fighting incessantly.
One of the zombies was very large, standing nearly two and a half meters tall, with muscle-bound strength.
Especially its two strong arms, like bulging dragons, its punches stirred the air with a tigerish wind, causing a chilling sensation.
With its arm swing, it could even smash a crater into the ground.
This was precisely a Tank Type zombie that Lu Chuan had seen and even absorbed a Crystal Core from.
The other one was even more familiar to Lu Chuan, a terrifying blood-colored creature with a quadpedal stance and a low posture.
Though it didn’t have the massive size and visual power of the Tank Type, it was extremely agile.
And each attack was equally remarkable.
The sharp claws streaked through the air, if it were an ordinary zombie, it would probably have been killed several times over.
This uniquely postured zombie appeared very strange to Lu Chuan.
To have evolved into such a monstrous form, other zombies might even loathe it...
However, the combat power of this blood-colored monster was indeed terrifying, even Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet team relied on fully enclosed helmets.
Otherwise, he joked that not many would have survived entering the building.
But through the Corpse Puppet’s eyes, Lu Chuan felt a bit puzzled.
Where did this big zombie come from after he blew one to bits a while ago?
Is zombie evolution this frequent?
Most crucially, Lu Chuan noticed that the wounds on that blood-colored monster zombie were healed.
Even the arm that Lu Chuan’s controlled Corpse Puppet had cut off had grown back!!
The battle between these two powerful zombies was exceptionally frightening in its fury.
Lu Chuan surmised that these two evolved zombies were likely full of killing intent, probably to seize each other’s Crystal Core.

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Both Sides Suffer, Lu Chuan Profits!
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32: Both Sides Suffer, Lu Chuan Profits!
Thinking about the Crystal Core, Lu Chuan’s heart immediately warmed up.
Although the two zombies were large and their attacks were extremely terrifying.
But a hint of desire flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
As the saying goes, fortune is sought in risk; in the apocalypse, it’s a battle of life and death.
Either be killed by other zombies or Human Evolvers, or find a way to devour more Crystal Cores to gain a powerful body.
These days, Lu Chuan had not only been improving his combat skills but also sending out Corpse Puppets to search for traces of Evolved Zombies.
Unfortunately, he hadn’t encountered any in the past few days, and now he finally came across two at once, which was an excellent opportunity.
Moreover, that bloodied monster was simply a killer among zombies, moving silently with swift, ferocious attacks.
In Lu Chuan’s view, this zombie, capable of scaling walls and leaping heights with ease, posed a far greater threat to him than the big-bodied zombie.
He originally planned to find a way to eliminate this type of zombie, and today’s encounter with two zombies fighting was like a pie fallen from the sky.
What’s more, if he could acquire the Crystal Cores of these two zombies, his own strength would surely make significant progress!
The apocalypse is inherently cruel, and a fierce light flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
Get right to it!
With this thought, Lu Chuan immediately left the room, closing the door of the building.
Ji Ruxue also heard the zombie roars from outside and knew there must be a fierce battle between powerful Evolved Zombies.
However, what puzzled Ji Ruxue was why her "cannon fodder" zombie dad pushed the door and left.
He hadn’t dared to go out these past few days; why did he suddenly go out now?
The roaring zombies outside sounded unusual; going out to join the fun seemed like seeking death?
Ji Ruxue found this utterly bewildering, not knowing what madness her zombie dad was up to...
Currently unable to move freely, Ji Ruxue clearly couldn’t go out to stop or help, so she could only silently pray inside.
"This zombie dad is truly worrisome, practicing some trash swordsmanship for a few days and really considering himself a master?"
Completely unaware of Lu Chuan’s Evolutionary Ability, Ji Ruxue hadn’t thought that although Lu Chuan’s body couldn’t match the formidable melee power of those two zombies, he wasn’t alone.
On the way downstairs, Lu Chuan began to gather his Corpse Puppet squad.The source of this content ɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Corpse Puppets patrolling or searching in various places, now under Lu Chuan’s control, picked up Fire Axes, donned full-coverage motorcycle helmets, and stealthily approached the greenery of Sunshine Home.
Now, those Tank Type zombie and blood-colored monster zombie were locked in a fierce and unyielding battle.
At this point, their eyes were only on each other, not caring about the surrounding wandering ordinary zombies.
After all, non-evolved low-level zombies were nothing more than cannon fodder for these Mutated Zombies and not even worth a fight.
Because only Evolved Zombies had Crystal Cores, engaging the surrounding low-level zombies was just a waste of effort...
Bang bang bang!
The battle between these two zombies made Lu Chuan’s scalp tingle slightly.
The blood-colored monster zombie that had given him quite a bit of trouble was now moving with the same swiftness.
Even on all fours, its speed was unaffected.
The terrifying explosive force enabled it to keep maneuvering around the Tank Type zombie, its terrifying claws launching attacks from time to time.
However, the blood-colored monster, which could easily kill ordinary zombies, had finally met its match with this Tank Type zombie.
The Tank Type was extremely robust and, most importantly, had strong defense.
This massive zombie was tough-skinned and thick-fleshed, making it hard for the blood-colored monster to inflict effective damage.
The sickle-like sharp claws kept swinging but were blocked by the Tank Zombie’s tough arms.
The claws that could easily rip apart a normal zombie’s head could only leave shallow blood marks on the Tank Zombie’s arm.
Although the Tank Zombie was bulky and wielded great strength, each slam could create deep craters in the ground.
However, the blood-colored monster was exceptionally agile, and the Tank Zombie’s attacks mostly missed.
Watching the two zombies continue to struggle, Lu Chuan was not in a hurry, patiently controlling the Corpse Puppet squad lurking in the shadows.
Both of these creatures were incredibly powerful, and it wouldn’t be easy to determine a winner in a short time.
Sure enough, as Lu Chuan had expected, these two zombies were tenacious opponents, making it difficult to determine a victor in battle.
And after a prolonged struggle, the fight finally began to heat up.
The greenery in the community had long been destroyed by the devastation caused by these two powerful zombies.
The ground was full of scars, riddled with craters, and the surrounding vegetation was wilting.
These two powerful Evolved Zombies had each sustained injuries after relentless close-quarters combat.
The blood-colored, skin-shedding Bloodthirsty Monster zombie aggressively leapt onto the large zombie’s back.
Its sickle-like claws directly pierced the weak defensive part of the Tank Type zombie’s shoulder joint.
Then, using its terrifying speed and strength, it rapidly tore and ripped, detaching one of the large zombie’s limbs in no time.
However, the large zombie was enraged, slamming a retaliatory punch that broke the zombie monster’s left leg.
Unfortunately for the blood-colored monster, even though the left leg was injured, being on all fours didn’t hinder its movement.
However, with one limb less, the Tank Zombie’s combat ability started to drop sharply.
As the saying goes, arms are two doors; now that one door was cut off, the Tank Zombie’s combat power was reduced by more than half.
The Bloodthirsty Monster continued to harass and attack with its rapid speed.
Its claws were incredibly sharp, and without one arm, the Tank Zombie was continually scratched by them.
Boom!
With a loud crash, the large zombie plummeted to the ground, and the battle between the two Great Evolved Zombies concluded with the blood-colored monster’s victory.
Although the Tank Type zombie was robust, without one arm, it couldn’t defend against the Bloodthirsty Monster’s continuous attacks, and its massive body was nearly dismembered.
As the blood-colored monster prepared to retrieve the Crystal Core, Lu Chuan immediately gave the order, and the Corpse Puppet squad that had been lurking around quickly surrounded it.
Roar!
Seeing this, the blood-colored monster roared in anger, trying to use its aura to drive away the Corpse Puppets.
However, the Corpse Puppets under Lu Chuan’s control were not intimidated by its aura, blindly swinging their Fire Axes at it.
Because this was an open area, the blood-colored monster couldn’t wall-walk or roof-run, losing its greatest advantage.
Yet, it was unwilling to give up the hard-won Crystal Core, and a moment of hesitation allowed the Corpse Puppet squad to encircle it, their sharp Fire Axes hacking away mercilessly.
Thud! Thud!
The Corpse Puppets controlled by Lu Chuan wielded the Fire Ax with fierce strength.
By the time the Licker realized something was wrong and tried to escape, its legs were already severed by the Corpse Puppets, and it could only struggle along the ground with its front claws, moving significantly slower.
Lu Chuan didn’t want to miss the opportunity to let this monster escape, and he immediately ordered the Corpse Puppets to rush up.
In a flurry of axe blows, they nearly hacked it into mince meat.
After extracting the Crystal Cores of the two Evolved Zombies with the Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan was overjoyed.
Two Evolved Zombie Crystal Cores, all acquired!

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Devouring Crystal Cores, Massive Boost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Chapter 33: Devouring Crystal Cores, Massive Boost!
The commotion caused by the zombie battle was too great, so Lu Chuan, to avoid being noticed by anyone with ill intentions, controlled the Corpse Puppet squad to quickly return.
Receiving the Crystal Cores from the blood-covered Corpse Puppet squad, Lu Chuan took a look and found that these two Crystal Cores had already turned mostly red!
Lu Chuan nodded silently to himself, indeed, the evolution of zombies was just as he had guessed. By continuously devouring the Crystal Cores from the brains of their kind, zombies could become more powerful.
Similarly, the more Crystal Cores they devoured, the redder the Crystal Core in a zombie’s brain would become.
Earlier, when I controlled the Corpse Puppet squad to scavenge, the two Evolved Zombies had clearly devoured quite a few Crystal Cores. Their combat power was already incredibly strong, and the Crystal Core in their brain had turned mostly red.
Looking at the two Crystal Cores in his hand and reflecting on his recent experiences, Lu Chuan was able to roughly deduce the current level of the zombies.
Zombies that had mutated and evolved after the Blood Moon night would form a Crystal Core in their brains, which was pure white before they devoured others of their kind.
As more Crystal Cores of their kind were devoured, the Crystal Core’s color would become increasingly red.
Most likely, when this Crystal Core completely transforms to red, a quantitative change might lead to a qualitative change, and it’s possible they could reach the next level.
However, Lu Chuan did not know to what extent a zombie’s power would increase once the Core turned fully red; perhaps it would be enough to crush other zombies effortlessly.
Lu Chuan stopped contemplating these matters, thinking he could just take it one step at a time and then see what happens.
The allure of the Crystal Core was something Lu Chuan could no longer suppress. He quickly controlled all the Corpse Puppets to guard the stairwell, while he himself went up to the third floor.
The two Crystal Cores in his hand were like exquisitely polished crystals, the red and white hues were exceptionally striking.
Lu Chuan quickly swallowed the Crystal Cores, and an overwhelming power instantly erupted within him.
This terrifying evolutionary power surged into every part of Lu Chuan’s body, causing his flesh, bones, and blood vessels to undergo a massive transformation under this terrifying power!
The wound on Lu Chuan’s shoulder began to slowly heal through successive evolutions, completely losing its initial ghastly form.
The intensity of the power eruption from devouring these Crystal Cores had completely exceeded Lu Chuan’s expectations.
The two zombies had already been Evolved Zombies, having devoured many of their kind. In addition, devouring the two crystals at once caused an overwhelming power that made Lu Chuan’s body tremble uncontrollably.
Although Lu Chuan’s evolution was focused on mental faculties, and he wouldn’t develop extremely thick arms or a massive build like a Tank Type zombie.
Nor would he shed his skin and lose his ability to walk upright like a Licker.
Lu Chuan’s body remained about the same size as a normal human, but it also underwent some changes with the continued devouring of Crystal Cores.
Lu Chuan became a little taller than before, and overall he grew more robust.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
As a zombie, his skin originally had some bluish-black veins, which started to fade with the evolution.
His muscles became very toned and sturdy, but since Lu Chuan wore clothes all the time, the changes weren’t too noticeable.
Most crucially, Lu Chuan’s mental faculties were greatly impacted, and his brain felt as though it was about to explode.
Refining two half red and white Crystal Cores simultaneously had exceeded what Lu Chuan’s consciousness could currently bear.
Although Lu Chuan gritted his teeth and persisted, he could only endure for a moment before this terrifying force knocked him out directly.
Seventh floor living room.
Ji Ruxue, who had been anxiously awaiting, grew more and more eager.
The howls of the zombies outside had stopped, mostly indicating that the battle was over.
But her zombie ’dad’ hadn’t returned after leaving for such a long time, which made her very anxious.
"It’s been such a long time, could something really have happened this time?!"
"What on earth were you thinking, getting involved in a fight between Evolved Zombies when you’re just an ordinary zombie?!"
"It’s over, it’s really over this time!"
"Just from the noises those two zombies made, you can tell they weren’t evolved just once. Even typical Evolved Zombies wouldn’t dare to join that level of battle, what were you trying to do?!"
With no further movement at all, Ji Ruxue was truly panicking now.
In her view, her zombie ’dad’ had most likely fallen victim since those two zombies definitely had the power to instantly kill ordinary low-level zombies.
What began as a calamity now felt like a complete loss...
...
No one knows how much time had passed, but finally, Lu Chuan felt his consciousness returning.
Controlling his body, Lu Chuan groggily opened his eyes.
At this moment, his mind felt incredibly clear, and the swelling pain from earlier evolution had completely vanished!
This sense of mental clarity was something he’d never felt before. Evidently, swallowing two Crystal Cores in succession had caused a significant transformation in his mental faculties.
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but smile; the enhancement in his mental faculties meant he could expand his Corpse Puppet squad again.
Though he didn’t know what the future held, for now, it seemed like the strategy of overwhelming numbers was still very effective.
The idea of mobsters beating a master applied here—random hits could take down an Evolved Zombie.
Additionally, Lu Chuan felt as if there was an inexhaustible power within his body.
Bam!
Lu Chuan raised his hand and punched the wooden panel of the wardrobe beside him, creating a big hole with just one punch.
Next, Lu Chuan kicked the wall next to him, peeling off the wall’s surface layer with one kick.
Subsequently, Lu Chuan quickly tested his jumping and running abilities, clearly feeling that his body was now significantly enhanced in all aspects compared to before!
As evolution continued, his skin color became increasingly human-like and even grew tougher.
Lu Chuan pressed hard, feeling that although his skin wasn’t as tough as a Tank Type zombie’s, it resembled leather, and lighter scratches likely wouldn’t leave damage on him.
Lu Chuan was now extremely satisfied with his body, with strength, speed, and reflexes all greatly enhanced, even his defense improved significantly!
Lu Chuan, feeling the powerful changes in his body, could no longer restrain the smile on his face.
With his current physical form, Lu Chuan felt that even if he encountered other Evolved Zombies, he would have a certain level of self-protection.
However, Lu Chuan had a very clear understanding of his evolutionary path, which was focused on mental faculties.
Now, compared to before, his mental faculties had greatly improved, and based on past experience, Lu Chuan estimated that this time his mental evolution could allow him to control around thirty Corpse Puppets!
Moreover, the range of his mental influence had frighteningly extended to about eight kilometers, achieving a qualitative leap this time!

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Little Qiqi Can Call Daddy Now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Chapter 34: Little Qiqi Can Call Daddy Now?
Feeling the terrifying evolution, Lu Chuan instinctively touched his head.
Although he couldn’t feel the Crystal Core inside his brain, Lu Chuan estimated that after continuously devouring several zombie Crystal Cores, his strength had definitely increased significantly.
Especially the two Crystal Cores he recently devoured brought the most noticeable increase in his power.
Lu Chuan estimated that after devouring them so many times, perhaps his Crystal Core inside his brain had turned purely red!
If having a white Crystal Core means a first-tier zombie, then now that his Crystal Core has turned red, does it mean he has entered the second tier of red Crystal Core?
Lu Chuan thought for a while and didn’t immediately control more zombies to replenish his Corpse Puppet squad.
Now that his strength had greatly improved, a bold idea surged in Lu Chuan’s mind.
"Since I can control zombie movements, then evolved zombies should be controllable too, after all they are zombies and they have no brains."
The more Lu Chuan thought about it, the more he believed in this possibility. After all, zombies have no brains, and his mind had become stronger, suppressing zombies seemed like a logical thing.
The thought rushed into his mind and could no longer be contained.
Just thinking about it made Lu Chuan feel very excited.
After all, if he could control evolved zombies, then his combat power would dramatically increase.
Evolved zombies and ordinary zombies are completely different; one evolved zombie is enough to kill a bunch of ordinary low-tier zombies in seconds.
These Corpse Puppets, without his control, absolutely couldn’t kill evolved zombies, not even hoping to pick them off.
Although this world was very unfamiliar to him, after spending a long time here, Lu Chuan had already understood that with the passage of time, all kinds of zombies would continuously break through.
If he continued controlling ordinary zombies, who knows, even with large numbers, it would be hard to truly defeat the opponent.
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan became even more eager and quickly began controlling his Corpse Puppets to search for traces of evolved zombies.
However, the number of evolved zombies is far less than ordinary zombies.
Now Lu Chuan’s mind radiation range had reached a terrifying 8000 meters.
Within this 8000-meter radius, he could control Corpse Puppets to search everywhere, which was much more powerful than before.
Lu Chuan was in a good mood now; the bloody monster hidden in the dark was successfully taken down by him. It counted as eliminating a major threat.
That bloody monster was like a hidden assassin, moving silently and striking swiftly.
Lu Chuan feared one day he’d walk out the building, only to have his head pierced through by a tongue or witness a bloody monster climbing up to the seventh floor.
Now he no longer needed to live in fear.
Just as Lu Chuan was very satisfied with the strong enhancement brought about by his successful evolution, Ji Ruxue was rolling on the sofa in the living room with anxiety.
After such a long time with no news, Ji Ruxue had completely given up hope on Lu Chuan.
Those two zombies were so powerful; there was no doubt zombie dad was utterly defeated this time.
Although Ji Ruxue knew surviving in the apocalypse was extremely difficult.
Zombies that haven’t evolved might perish at any time, but she hadn’t expected the moment to come so soon.
Thinking back on the time spent with zombie dad, although they never communicated, they could feel each other’s emotions.
Although not like normal babies with their parents, as a human-zombie pair, their relationship was still warm and comforting.
In this world, which had long lost all humanity, two lonely souls accompanied each other.
This rare experience made Ji Ruxue feel very beautiful; however, she didn’t expect that after living two lives, the hard-earned fatherly love was snatched away again so quickly.
Thinking about that person who always took care of her, possibly never to be seen again, even though Ji Ruxue was once an Unparalleled Empress experienced in life and death, she still felt a bit sad.
"Just a little more time, then I can grow up, and maybe I’ll be the one protecting you."
"Poor zombie dad, why don’t you wait for me a while longer? Why couldn’t you wait for me to grow up?"
Crack! Crack!
Just as Ji Ruxue was feeling despondent, the door lock suddenly made a sound.
Ji Ruxue was startled at first, but quickly realized—zombie dad is back!
Because ordinary zombies would just crash into the door, they don’t know how to unlock it!
Sure enough, the next second the door opened, and a familiar figure appeared outside.
"Zombie dad isn’t dead?!"
"Really? Am I hallucinating? This survival luck is too big!"
Ji Ruxue was incredibly excited and elated.
Earlier, those two evolved zombies caused such a commotion that even human survivors among Evolvers might not easily handle it.
Let alone her dad, just a regular low-tier zombie that would be mere cannon fodder, purely something to be killed in seconds.
After so long with no signs, Ji Ruxue believed zombie dad had met trouble, but unexpectedly, he stood in front of the door again like a miracle.
At that moment, Ji Ruxue suddenly had a feeling of gaining back what was lost.
Originally she thought, after witnessing the apocalypse’s cruelty, she had become extremely indifferent.
But she hadn’t expected, in the absence of news from zombie dad, she would still feel panic.
It turned out that unconsciously, she had really regarded him as family, rather than just a companion taking care of her daily needs.
Extremely excited, Ji Ruxue, upon seeing Lu Chuan, jumped off the sofa immediately.
She ran directly over to Lu Chuan, though having just learned to walk upright, she wasn’t proficient yet.
Currently walking wobbly and shaking, but it didn’t stop her excitement.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Watching Ji Ruxue wobbling while running towards him, Lu Chuan was also very excited and quickly squatted down ready to support her.
After all, the little one had just learned to walk, Lu Chuan feared she might fall.
"Daddy!"
The babbling sound reached him, Lu Chuan’s body stiffened, as if struck by lightning, he froze in place.
Watching the little one running towards him, Lu Chuan felt his brain explode, similar to a system crash.
Little Qiqi...can call me Daddy now?!!

chapters.title: Chapter 35: I’ve Got Teeth Now, No More Milk!
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35: I’ve Got Teeth Now, No More Milk!
Lu Chuan felt his scalp tingling, frozen there, somewhat at a loss.
He had lived through two lifetimes and hadn’t had a girlfriend yet, but unexpectedly became a father prematurely!
This strange feeling made it difficult for Lu Chuan to describe for a moment.
He now understands why many people become dumbfounded the moment they see their child born, as if their brain has forgotten to think.
He didn’t even think about how Little Qiqi suddenly opened her mouth to speak without anyone teaching her.
Lu Chuan originally thought this was just acting, but it turned out this kind of wonderful feeling really exists.
Looking at this incredibly cute little fellow before him, Lu Chuan felt like his heart was about to melt because of her.
In this cold, bloody, and ruined apocalyptic world, such a tender voice seemed to dispel all death and darkness!Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Lu Chuan was not the only one feeling incredibly shocked; Ji Ruxue herself was also equally surprised.
The moment she spoke, Ji Ruxue stood there dumbfounded with surprise filling her eyes.
How did I suddenly start speaking?!
But Ji Ruxue didn’t mind this too much, as she wasn’t exactly a real baby.
With the soul of her past life, speaking wasn’t really a problem.
However, since being reborn into a baby’s body, she hadn’t gotten familiar with its organs and had not practiced speaking much; otherwise, she could have spoken long ago.
After Ji Ruxue opened her eyes, the apocalypse had already erupted in this world.
Besides having a zombie father with human consciousness, there was no one else to talk to, so Ji Ruxue simply stayed silent.
Clearly, she was too excited and agitated just now, so her thoughts slipped out uncontrollably.
Seeing the zombie father who had accompanied her for many days survive and return unharmed, Ji Ruxue truly felt excited and happy inside.
This feeling of regained loss was the most thrilling.
Even for Ji Ruxue, who was accustomed to seeing life and death separations, experiencing all this now, her heart was filled with joy and excitement.
In Ji Ruxue’s heart, she had long regarded Lu Chuan as her family, as an irreplaceable presence in her life.
Even though the two of them—a human baby and a zombie in the apocalypse—such sentiments were not constrained by racial boundaries.
Watching Little Qiqi in front of him, Lu Chuan found himself so excited that he was gesticulating wildly.
He had never been called "dad" before, and had not expected that the feeling of becoming a father could be so remarkable.
Roar! Roar!
Lu Chuan’s eyes were filled with delight as he looked at the little one in front of him, with countless words wanting to be expressed.
Unfortunately, being a zombie, he had long lost the ability to speak.
Whether he could restore this ability in the future was uncertain, but for now there was no hope.
Therefore, Lu Chuan could only let out a couple of low growls to express his inner excitement and delight.
Just wondering if Little Qiqi could understand his meaning.
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but let the corners of his mouth rise.
Luckily, with constant evolution, his appearance now looked not much different from humans.
Otherwise, making this action would be somewhat creepy.
"Hahaha! I’ve become a dad!"
"I never thought, in my past life, I didn’t even have a girlfriend, and in this life, being reborn as a zombie, I end up becoming a father?!"
"Little Qiqi is awesome! I knew my dear daughter is a genius!"
Lu Chuan was extremely excited at this moment.
As for the matter of the little one speaking, Lu Chuan had already thought about it before.
But currently he’s really powerless, since speaking relies on mutual communication.
If no one teaches her, what if Little Qiqi becomes a mute in the future?
He couldn’t keep roaring like himself, that would be too weird...
So Lu Chuan mostly avoided making sounds in front of Little Qiqi, fearing the little one would learn something she shouldn’t.
But he never expected the little one to stay in the room by herself every day, and could learn to speak all on her own.
She could stand up and walk upright, and even learn to speak all on her own, if this isn’t a genius, what is it?!
Lu Chuan finally understood what it meant to be born knowing.
Little Qiqi is exactly this kind of prodigy!
No, godly infant!
He felt that Little Qiqi living in the apocalypse was truly a waste of innate talent.
If she could live in a stable world, just based on this little one’s wisdom and qualifications, she would definitely become a genius prodigy.
...
"Daddy."
"No milk..."
Seeing the zombie father ready to prepare formula for her, Ji Ruxue quickly ran to Lu Chuan’s side, tugged at his clothes, babbling.
As she spoke she opened her mouth, revealing her two rows of baby teeth.
Drinking milk powder every day, Ji Ruxue was truly sick of it; she felt like her mouth always tasted like formula...
Lu Chuan’s actions paused, feeling a bit embarrassed for a moment.
He didn’t expect the little one to grow this fast, already having baby teeth.
He had virtually no experience in raising children, unexpectedly knowing less than Little Qiqi about these things...
Lu Chuan subconsciously scratched his head, feeling somewhat confused in the kitchen around him.
He had never raised a child; apart from making formula, he didn’t know where to start for a moment.
But quickly Lu Chuan responded by going to the sixth floor, clearing out space in a room there.
Then, Lu Chuan had the Corpse Puppet gather firewood and took out a pot, putting mineral water and some rice together to start cooking.
Lu Chuan didn’t expect he would actually light a fire indoors so soon...
As the apocalypse progressed, there were no longer fresh vegetables, so Lu Chuan could only make some rice porridge for the little one.
Then Lu Chuan added some formula, using a spoon to mash the porridge into a sticky paste.
Looking at the bowl of thick rice paste in front of him, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction, this should be the baby’s food in the apocalypse.
He then let the rice paste cool down, and brought it to the little one.
"Daddy, let me do it myself."
Seeing Lu Chuan clumsily feeding her, Ji Ruxue couldn’t wait anymore.
She simply took the spoon from Lu Chuan’s hand, and started eating bit by bit on her own.
Though Lu Chuan’s baby food was simple and rough, Ji Ruxue didn’t pick on it; having enough to eat in this apocalyptic world was already pretty good, much better than drinking milk every day.
Watching the little one eat heartily, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
"Little Qiqi is finally grown up."

chapters.title: Chapter 36: The First Evolved Corpse Puppet!
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36: The First Evolved Corpse Puppet!
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
The sound of something cutting through the air echoed in the living room, sharper than before.
Lu Chuan brandished the machete in his hand with a fierce momentum, the silver blade casting a cold gleam throughout the room.
