As Lu Chuan evolved by consuming Crystal Cores, his body had improved significantly, no longer the stiff and fragile form it once was.
Even though he didn’t know any blade techniques and hadn’t systematically learned any combat skills.
But with his physical strength not fully enhanced, Lu Chuan just randomly waved the machete based on some simple kung fu segments from memory.
The sharp, relentless knife light made him seem like a top martial arts master.
"Why does it feel like... Dad has become much stronger than before?!"
Ji Ruxue sat on the sofa, watching her zombie father practicing blade techniques not far away, feeling deeply puzzled.
Recalling their first encounter, her zombie father seemed no different from other zombies, just with fewer bloodstains and wounds on him.
His body was equally thin and frail, full of a rotting aura.
But now, her zombie father swinging the machete seemed much more robust.
Through observing the folds in Lu Chuan’s clothes and overall shape, Ji Ruxue could tell that her zombie father’s body underneath the clothes was undoubtedly muscular.
And it seemed even the color of his skin had changed; if not observed closely, one might really think he was a human.
What’s going on? Could it be that zombies, like humans, can also enhance their physique through training?
Why in her previous life did she never encounter such a thing?
But after thinking it over, Ji Ruxue was relieved.
After all, in her previous life, she also never encountered a low-level zombie that could retain human consciousness.
Ji Ruxue chalked these up as secrets of the Zombie Race, after all, her past life was mostly spent surviving or fighting, despite being an Empress of the Human Race.
In the past life, facing zombies meant either fleeing or killing, she really had never observed closely what zombies were like.
Watching her zombie father swinging the machete continuously, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but think of some Body Refining Techniques she knew from her past life.
If one could get stronger through training, could these techniques be taught to her father for cultivation?
Her father wasn’t an Evolved Zombie, and as the apocalypse developed, he would eventually become the lowest cannon fodder.
As long as he could enhance his strength, even a little, it would increase his chances of surviving the apocalypse.
Ji Ruxue was also curious about what it would look like if a zombie trained in Body Refining Techniques and if its combat power could catch up with those Evolved Zombies.
On the balcony, Lu Chuan looked at the sharp machete in his hand, nodding with satisfaction.
Since his body had greatly enhanced through Crystal Core evolution, Lu Chuan clearly felt that the combat skills he practiced had become increasingly proficient.
Compared to before, his physique had improved quite a bit; Lu Chuan felt if he had a weapon, he might even hold his own against other Evolved Zombies in close combat.
At that moment, Lu Chuan suddenly felt a change in his mind; new information came from his controlled Corpse Puppet.
With a shift in perspective, Lu Chuan found that his controlled Corpse Puppet finally spotted an Evolved Zombie on a street several kilometers away.
A giant Tank Type Zombie, muscularly robust, was crouching on the street gnawing something.
Seeing this big fellow, Lu Chuan’s eyes lit up.
His Telekinesis had greatly improved, and Lu Chuan had always wanted to try controlling an Evolved Zombie, now finally had the chance.
Without hesitation, Lu Chuan headed out toward the Evolved Zombie’s direction.
Lu Chuan didn’t act rashly, first surrounding himself with a group of Corpse Puppets, pretending to be a wandering horde of regular zombies, slowly approaching the Tank Type Zombie.
With several Corpse Puppets as cover, this small group of zombies swaying on the street didn’t seem too conspicuous.
The Tank Type Zombie, focused on gnawing flesh, didn’t notice anything unusual, continuing to feed with its head down.
For safety reasons, Lu Chuan didn’t directly launch mind control too early; instead, he used these surrounding Corpse Puppets as cover, gradually getting closer to the target.
Lu Chuan had never tried controlling an Evolved Zombie and didn’t know what it would feel like.
So to be more prudent, he deliberately slowed the Corpse Puppet squad’s pace to avoid attracting the Tank Zombie’s attention.
Finally, without alerting the opponent, Lu Chuan came within less than a hundred meters of the Tank Zombie.
At this distance, Lu Chuan could even see the texture of the zombie’s skin, and the robust muscles emitted a strong sense of pressure.
Lu Chuan immediately began concentrating his Telekinesis, weaving it into threads that steadily enveloped the zombie ahead, attempting to control it.
Sure enough, when controlling other zombies, Lu Chuan could turn them into puppets in an instant.
But when his Telekinesis enveloped this zombie, Lu Chuan felt resistance.
Roar!
The Tank Zombie let out a few roars, resisting Lu Chuan’s psychic power.
However, Lu Chuan’s evolved Telekinesis was incredibly strong, quickly breaking through the Tank Zombie’s defenses.
Invisible threads of Telekinesis surged rapidly into the Tank Zombie’s body, and Lu Chuan successfully turned this powerful Evolved Zombie into his Corpse Puppet!
"Did it actually work?!"
Successfully controlling an Evolved Zombie, Lu Chuan was overjoyed, not expecting to actually achieve this.
Though controlling this particularly strong Evolved Zombie consumed a lot more psychic energy than other ordinary zombies.
But for the evolved Lu Chuan, it was just within an acceptable range.
Exchanging some Telekinesis for a powerful, mighty Corpse Puppet seemed an incredibly worthwhile trade to Lu Chuan.
This giant with a robust physique and thick arms like an intertwining dragon.
The zombie could crush cars with its arm swings, a terrifying strength far beyond ordinary zombies.
This single, massive Evolved Corpse Puppet under his control already surpassed the combat effectiveness of a regular Corpse Puppet squad!
Looking at this giant Corpse Puppet before him, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
With the addition of the Evolved Zombie, his combat strength was significantly boosted!

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Corpse Puppet vs. Mutant Giant Dog!
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Chapter 37: Corpse Puppet vs. Mutant Giant Dog!
Looking at the gigantic creature in front of him, standing over two meters tall, Lu Chuan grew more and more delighted.
As the saying goes, "A thousand troops are easy to come by, but a capable general is difficult to find."
This gigantic evolved zombie before him was undoubtedly a major general among his Corpse Puppet squad.
The muscle, as thick and strong as a knotty dragon, seemed capable of demolishing any obstacle in its way.
This big Corpse Puppet was almost twice the size of ordinary ones, and just its thick arms were as large as two legs of a normal Corpse Puppet!
Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppet to come over to him, and he instinctively reached out to feel its arm.
Sss~ So hard!
This solid arm was simply like forged steel!
It possessed immense strength and an incredibly tough defense!
Lu Chuan knocked on it a few times with his fist, making a "bang, bang, bang" sound.
"It’s really something strong, standing in front of me like a giant. Henceforth, you’ll be called Da Pang!"
Lu Chuan stood with his hands on his hips, quite satisfied, as Da Pang stood in front with ten low-level ordinary Corpse Puppets behind him.
Lu Chuan now felt that his Corpse Puppet squad finally had the capability to survive in the apocalypse.
With his squad, Lu Chuan returned to the Sunshine District, feeling very pleased.
Walking down the street with such a big figure by his side, Lu Chuan felt as if his back was straighter than ever.
Indeed, might makes right. Having such a powerful warrior on his side, the sense of security was overwhelming.
On the way home, Lu Chuan took the opportunity to go to the hardware store with Da Pang.
Skillfully arriving at the back of the hardware store, Lu Chuan pushed away a large pile of equipment and pulled out two one-meter-long, hundred-pound iron hammers from the tools there!
Usually, a hardware store wouldn’t have hammers of such weight.
These hammers required immense strength to wield, and typically, a large hammer would weigh around ten pounds. This was three times that!
Even Corpse Puppets would find swinging a hundred-pound hammer cumbersome, and it significantly reduced attack speed, lacking practicality. It was not as useful as a shorter fire axe.
Therefore, Lu Chuan had left these iron hammers in the store, never expecting he’d actually find a time to use them.
He tossed the two iron hammers to Da Pang, who swung them wildly, one in each hand!
This weighty iron hammer was a bit excessive for other Corpse Puppets.
But for Da Pang, they were practically custom-made, like divine weapons in his hands.
Lu Chuan positioned Da Pang to guard the entrance of Building 5, with the two hammers at his feet, looking much like a Gate God!
With such a powerhouse blocking the entrance, the safety of Building 5 was beyond question.
Having tasted the benefits of evolved zombies, Lu Chuan continued to deploy Corpse Puppets to track down other zombies in the following days.
Currently, for zombies to evolve, they needed to devour Crystal Cores, so the more of these, the better.
Now with Da Pang as a high-level combat force, combined with the cooperation of many Corpse Puppet squad members, Lu Chuan was confident he could take down any solitary evolved zombie.
After all, an armament-equipped Corpse Puppet squad could barely combat beyond their level, not to mention he now had an evolved zombie.
Although Da Pang had tough defenses and immense strength, he was slightly lacking when fighting agile zombies.
Either he needed to kill them while being wounded, or he might be worn down and killed by exploiting agility.
However, the Corpse Puppets controlled by Lu Chuan perfectly made up for these shortcomings.
That was Da Pang’s twin hammers; when swung, any ordinary zombie daring to approach would have bones broken and muscles severed directly.
In Lu Chuan’s hands, this big evolved zombie transformed into a powerful presence integrating offense and defense.
Meanwhile, upstairs, Ji Ruxue was ceaselessly practicing the Glazed Breathing Technique, honing her Telekinesis skills.
The Glazed Breathing Technique continuously absorbed the Energy Factors from the air while strengthening her body and enhancing her Telekinesis.
After constant practice over this period, Ji Ruxue’s ability to walk upright had become more proficient.
No longer did she wobble like before; she could even manage a simple hop.
And while Lu Chuan was out, Ji Ruxue had found a few iron nails from elsewhere, using this time to hone her Telekinesis.
Swish swish swish!
As a series of whizzing sounds arose, the nails, controlled by Ji Ruxue’s Telekinesis, flew out rapidly, piercing straight into the dining table!
Such terrifying force could completely penetrate a human skull, killing easily.
The talent of Telekinesis, combined with her other Talent Ability, Time Control, endowed Ji Ruxue with formidable combat power in this apocalypse, capable of harvesting lives easily!
Even an infant could kill without a trace; imagining such a thing was utterly terrifying.
Watching the nails embedded deep in the dining table, Ji Ruxue nodded in satisfaction.
Her strength might not yet be particularly formidable, but in the early days of the apocalypse, it was enough.
As long as she didn’t encounter those mysterious creatures with special abilities, at least she should have no trouble protecting herself!
Looking out at the desolated world, Ji Ruxue’s gaze grew more determined.
"I believe it won’t be long before I can protect Zombie Daddy while he goes out to gather supplies."
"Although I’m still a baby now, I, the Empress, will not hold us back!"
Ji Ruxue really didn’t want to experience the feeling of losing a loved one again.Follow current novᴇls on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Bang bang bang!
Sounds of clattering echoed from downstairs again, and Ji Ruxue knew it was her zombie father training once more.
Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly. To her, it seemed her zombie father was indeed putting in a lot of effort.
But unfortunately... the harder he tried, the more heartbreaking it became...
Ordinary low-tier zombies, no matter how much they trained, could merely make their bodies slightly stronger at most.
No matter how hard they tried, they were just ordinary zombies.
Without breaking the genetic limits of their body, relying solely on the most basic physical state, it was impossible for them to compete with evolved beings.
"Poor zombie father, I guess I’ll have to help you hunt more evolved zombies in the future..."
Ji Ruxue had already made up her mind; relying on her zombie father to become stronger on his own seemed hopeless.
But luckily, as the Unparalleled Empress, perhaps it wouldn’t take long for her to fight against evolved zombies.
Once she hunted more evolved zombies in the future, even if it meant feeding him these Crystal Cores, she’d try to help her zombie father gain some strength.
Although Ji Ruxue wasn’t sure what changes would occur after an ordinary zombie devoured an Essence Core, it should undoubtedly make them a bit stronger than regular zombies.
Sixth floor living room.
Just as Ji Ruxue was envisioning a future with Lu Chuan in her mind,
Lu Chuan was already on the sixth floor, using his powerful combat prowess to easily defeat the encirclement of ten Corpse Puppets.
Although these zombies didn’t look much different from Lu Chuan in stature, their combat capabilities were utterly incomparable.
It was like comparing a 1.5-ton car to a V12 supercar; the body sizes might be similar, but they’re entirely different in terms of horsepower.
After successfully advancing to the second tier by devouring a zombie Crystal Core, Lu Chuan’s physical attributes had greatly improved.
He had made tremendous all-around breakthroughs in strength, speed, reaction, and defense!
The most crucial advantage Lu Chuan had over the other zombies was his exceptional intelligence.
These ordinary low-tier zombies only attacked instinctively with bites and pounces, but Lu Chuan possessed combat skills he had learned himself.
With advantages in skills and strength, even as a telekinesis-evolved zombie, Lu Chuan could effortlessly fend off ten foes in close combat.
"Oh?!"
Suddenly, Lu Chuan’s mind stirred; his Corpse Puppet had made a new discovery.
A low-tier Corpse Puppet, while patrolling the district, suddenly spotted a giant mutant dog!
This mutant dog was originally on the second floor, but upon noticing the Corpse Puppet, it broke through the window and leaped down!
As this mutant dog charged down, Lu Chuan nearly couldn’t associate this creature with a dog if not for its canine head.
The mutant dog’s body length was nearly two meters, and its fur had turned jet black and hard.
Its physique was incredibly robust, resembling a wild black boar!
This was the first time Lu Chuan had seen other mutated creatures in the post-apocalyptic world.
Lu Chuan wanted to test the strength of this mutant creature, quickly controlling a Corpse Puppet to approach, yet just as the Corpse Puppet took a step, the mutant dog pounced.
Bang!
The low-tier Corpse Puppet was instantly annihilated.
Lu Chuan estimated this mutant dog’s strength was likely no weaker than a typical evolved zombie, and it was far more aggressive!
Without delay, Lu Chuan brought out his trump card, the evolved zombie ’Da Pang’!
Like a Gate God, Da Pang charged at the mutant dog with two large iron hammers.
Da Pang’s imposing momentum was utterly terrifying; any other creature might have already fled in fear.
Yet the giant mutant dog was undaunted, moving like a black lightning bolt, wildly darting with its stout body.
Although strong in stature, this mutant dog was considerably shorter than Da Pang.
Its sharp claws resembled scimitars, scratching the ground and leaving several marks.
If an ordinary evolved zombie faced this mutant dog, it would likely endure a fierce battle.
However, the zombie controlled by Lu Chuan seemed like a War God incarnate.
With two large iron hammers swinging wildly, the mutant dog didn’t dare to approach.
Boom!
Taking advantage of the mutant dog’s unpreparedness, Da Pang smashed its front paw with a hammer, and despite its sturdy build, the mutant dog suffered broken bones and tendons.
Bam!
Lu Chuan wasted no time, commanding Da Pang to deliver a finishing blow.
A hammer slammed down on the mutant dog’s head, causing the massive canine head to shatter like a watermelon.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Mutated Fierce Beast Crystal Core! Double Celebration!
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Chapter 38: Mutated Fierce Beast Crystal Core! Double Celebration!
Looking at the strong mutated dog corpse, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
Indeed, the strength of an evolved zombie is entirely incomparable to a low-level zombie.
This mutated dog was incredibly fast, and its physique was very robust. It could be said to possess both tremendous power and a strong body.
The most crucial aspect was those claws that looked like scimitars, and this was a mutated creature, not a zombie dog.
Therefore, it retained a certain level of intelligence, making it even harder to deal with than an evolved zombie.
However, because it wasn’t a zombie creature, as long as it experienced severe pain, the mutated creature would be stimulated, affecting its subsequent judgment.
This allowed Lu Chuan to easily kill it.
"Zombies have crystal cores in their brains. Other creatures can mutate, possibly because they received some mysterious power after the blood moon."
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan controlled Da Pang to directly reach into the brain of this mutated giant dog and indeed found a white crystal core.
Apparently, this mutated dog had not devoured any of its kind since the apocalypse. Had it evolved a few times, it might not have been so easy to deal with.
Looking at the fresh flesh in front of him, Lu Chuan didn’t waste it. He directly controlled Da Pang to lift the corpse of the mutated giant dog and headed back towards the Sunshine District.
The zombie crisis has been going on for over a month now, and Lu Chuan hasn’t seen fresh meat for a long time.
During the early stages of the zombie apocalypse, he had been eating frozen meat; the only fresh meat he had seen was human...
The scent of fresh blood soon attracted other zombies, masses of zombies were lured by the blood to gather in Da Pang’s direction.
Roar!
Looking at the surrounding zombies, Da Pang suddenly let out an angry roar.
Under his powerful pressure as an evolved zombie, these low-level zombies immediately trembled uncontrollably, frozen in place, too scared to advance.
Roar! Roar!
However, at that moment, an equally angry roar echoed.
A massive creature exuding pressure came charging from a distance.
This monster was nearly two and a half meters tall, its size almost matching Da Pang.
Its physique was also bulky and muscular, filled with terrifying explosive power.
Those very prominent stout arms indicated that it was the same type of evolved zombie as Da Pang.
Roar!
Filled with brutality in its eyes, this zombie was clearly after the corpse of the mutated dog carried by Da Pang, as well as the crystal core in Da Pang’s mind.
"Having looked for so long without finding it, you’ve delivered yourself!"
Seeing the large evolved zombie in front of him, Lu Chuan didn’t panic. Instead, he became more excited!
He urgently needed evolved zombie crystal cores to enhance his strength.
This lure of constant evolution was so enticing, even Lu Chuan could barely resist.
But primarily in this apocalypse, only by constantly evolving can one survive.
Facing this evolved zombie, Lu Chuan’s controlled Da Pang was equally unyielding.
He threw the corpse of the giant mutated dog aside and then began a furious battle.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The two towering behemoths of over two meters clashed, their arms swinging and smashing, crumpling all surrounding cars.
The surrounding ground was full of ruts!
This tank-type zombie battle was like an excavator, crazily destroying the surrounding environment.
And being zombies, they had no concept of pain; each strike was with full force.
The clash of their swinging arms sounded like stones striking metal, something flesh and blood shouldn’t be able to produce.
This evolved zombie was similar in size to Da Pang, and their strength was evenly matched.
However, Da Pang, controlled by Lu Chuan, had even more formidable fighting capabilities.
Using his combat skills, Lu Chuan quickly created a situation of crushing the opponent.The most update n0vels are published on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Meanwhile, other low-level corpse puppets also arrived on the scene, each wielding a fire axe and charging forward.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Unfortunately, low-level zombies were still low-level; their combat capability was incomparable to these evolved zombies.
Even the once invincible fire axe was ineffective this time, merely producing clinks and clanks when hitting the large zombie’s arm, causing no substantial harm.
Roar!
It seemed Lu Chuan’s unfair fighting tactic using a numerical advantage angered the tank zombie completely.
Breaking free from Da Pang’s control, it viciously swung its arms, crushing the head of a corpse puppet that failed to dodge in time.
This level of evolved zombie was immensely powerful, posing a fatal threat to any corpse puppet.
After testing, Lu Chuan finally brought out his own pair of hammers.
Da Pang grabbed the dual hammers from behind, and crazily swung them at his opponent, instantly boosting his combat power several times over.
Crack! Crack!
Under the furious swings of the dual hammers, the giant zombie couldn’t dodge in time, and several bones in its body were snapped.
Lu Chuan’s massive hammers targeted the knees of the big guy.
Even though the defense of this Tank Zombie was strong, Lu Chuan controlled Da Pang, who was equally powerful.
Once the giant’s legs were smashed by Lu Chuan, its massive body faltered and crashed to the ground.
Before it could get back up, Lu Chuan’s terrifying dual hammers followed up and crazily struck its back and arms.
Seize the moment to take his life; the other Corpse Puppets rushed forward again.
These few Corpse Puppets wielded fire axes, chopping madly at the Evolved Zombie, which had already lost most of its mobility, finally killing it successfully.
Crack!
With powerful swings of the fire axe, a Corpse Puppet split the big guy’s head open and extracted the Crystal Core.
Lu Chuan was delighted; he had been searching for Evolved Zombies for many days without seeing one.
Unexpectedly, today was truly a double blessing.
Not only had he encountered and slain a mutated giant dog, but also a similarly powerful Evolved Zombie.
Two Mutated Crystal Cores in hand, his strength could receive a certain degree of enhancement.
Soon, Da Pang brought back both the Crystal Core and the corpse of the mutated giant dog to building number five.
Lu Chuan received the Crystal Core; it was his first time seeing the Crystal Core of a mutated creature.
By sight, it appeared not much different from the Crystal Core in the back of a zombie’s head.
The most crucial part was that, even though he hadn’t consumed such a Crystal Core before, Lu Chuan could feel a strong desire for it within his body.
This desire was no different from that for zombie Crystal Cores.
Lu Chuan was confident that zombies would surely be able to consume this Mutated Giant Dog’s Crystal Core.
After all, he was already a zombie; what would a zombie be picky about eating?
He brought both Crystal Cores before him, and without much thought, devoured them quickly.
Instantly, a surge of massive energy began to roam continuously within Lu Chuan’s body.
This long-lost Evolutionary Power nourished Lu Chuan’s somewhat parched body, making his already mutated form even stronger.
Lu Chuan could clearly feel the strength within his body continuously increasing!
At the same time, the feeling of enhanced defense and speed flooded back into his mind once again.
However, as Lu Chuan was already a second-tier zombie, the two mutated creatures slain today were only first-tier.
The mutated Tank Zombie had a red and white Crystal Core in its brain.
While the mutated giant dog’s Crystal Core was merely white; these two Crystal Cores, after Lu Chuan consumed them, increased his energy somewhat but not particularly much.
Therefore, although two Crystal Cores were consumed together this time, the impact was not as strong as before.
Lu Chuan nodded inwardly, realizing that as his abilities grew, he would need either to devour more Crystal Cores or to defeat stronger opponents to achieve further breakthroughs in the future.
Although the energy brought by the first-tier Crystal Core was smaller, fortunately, the count was rather high; he managed to gain two today.
The power of the Crystal Core made Lu Chuan’s physical strength more condensed than before.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan’s Telekinesis also began to further increase; although he wasn’t overwhelmed like before, he could feel that his Telekinesis had been greatly depleted after he controlled Da Pang.
Now, with the consumption of these two Crystal Cores, the previously depleted Telekinesis was also replenished.
Lu Chuan’s eyes lit up with sudden joy.
With his Telekinesis restored, it meant he could control another Evolved Zombie, which would further boost his power!
After refining both Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan felt refreshed, and his mind cleared substantially.
Seeing the mutated giant dog carried back by Da Pang, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
He hadn’t tasted such fresh blood food in ages; today was simply a feast.
Then, Lu Chuan lay atop the zombie dog and began to tear into it voraciously.
However, unlike before, Lu Chuan wasn’t overly delighted.
Now as he gnawed on this fresh flesh, he found the sensation of hunger was not as intense as before.
Compared to his earlier struggle for a piece of frozen meat, even fighting zombies, this situation was almost too good.
After consuming some of the flesh, Lu Chuan left the rest for Da Pang.
Perhaps due to evolution, Lu Chuan felt his hunger was not as strong as before.
Moreover, for Lu Chuan now, consuming Crystal Cores made him feel more comfortable.
Da Pang, however, was indifferent; faced with fresh blood food, he devoured without hesitation.
As the mutated giant dog’s flesh was consumed, Da Pang’s injuries began to heal rapidly, visible to the naked eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Could Zombie Dad Not Be an Ordinary Zombie?
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Chapter 39: Could Zombie Dad Not Be an Ordinary Zombie?
Lu Chuan did consider leaving some of the mutant giant dog’s meat to make a meat porridge for Little Qiqi.
After all, in this post-apocalyptic world, just drinking milk powder and eating rice cereal would always be lacking in nutrition.
But Lu Chuan really didn’t dare to take the risk with the flesh of the already mutated giant dog, as humans might not be able to consume it.
If the little guy ingests it and gets infected with some virus, that would be terrible...ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Whether the meat of these mutant creatures can be consumed needs to be determined later, after some verification and consideration.
"After that blood moon night, humans, zombies, and these surviving creatures must have undergone some kind of mutant evolution."
"If humans can eat the meat of these mutant creatures, then the little guy’s future diet will be much richer than it is now!"
Lu Chuan still thought it was safer to feed this meat to the zombies, since nobody really knows what might exist within the bodies of mutated creatures.
Anyway, he’ll still encounter more mutated creatures in the future, and if their meat truly is edible, there will be plenty of chances in the future, so it wouldn’t matter to miss this one.
Ji Ruxue, in the living room, didn’t know that Lu Chuan was out with the Corpse Team, killing fiercely. She sat cross-legged on the sofa, meditating and cultivating.
You could see Ji Ruxue’s body trembling slightly, because her current body was still too weak.
With the Glazed Breathing Technique running, a large amount of Energy Factor in the air rapidly rushed into her body, continuously improving Ji Ruxue’s physical strength, while enhancing her telekinesis.
A moment later, the aura emanating from Ji Ruxue suddenly surged!
"Great, after so long of cultivating, I’ve finally broken through to level two!"
Ji Ruxue suddenly opened her eyes, those black and white eyes were completely different from the zombies of the post-apocalypse, appearing very bright in the dim living room.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue’s eyes were full of confidence and excitement, because as a baby, breaking through to level two would greatly improve her ability to protect herself.
In Ji Ruxue’s memory, after the initial chaos of the post-apocalypse, everyone began to live a life of mutant evolution.
Also, human survivors categorized humans, zombies, and fierce beasts into nine levels based on their strength.
Level one being the weakest, and nine being the strongest, symbolizing the utmost strength.
Level seven was the king, level eight was the emperor, and level nine was the most powerful Emperor Level existence!
In her previous life, Ji Ruxue had fought her way through in the post-apocalypse, constantly struggling, eventually breaking through to become an Unparalleled Empress!
After the strange blood moon, those who gained evolutionary abilities through mutations were considered level one existences.
If zombies and fierce beasts want continuous evolution, they must mutually devour each other’s Crystal Core, converting it into their own energy.
Zombies and fierce beasts, we can say, only have one path of relentless killing for evolution.
In some ways, humans compared to zombies and fierce beasts have relatively less intense competition.
Human survivors, shortly after the arrival of the post-apocalypse, began to develop drugs that could provide evolution.
By the mid-to-late stage of the post-apocalypse, they utilized ancient relics to create cultivation techniques, allowing humans to absorb Energy Factor from the air, continuously improving their physical condition and advancing their realm.
But currently, it is still the initial stage of the post-apocalypse, and cultivation techniques for humans have not yet been researched.
So at this time, humans’ power is relatively weak compared to zombies and mutated creatures who can quickly evolve by devouring Crystal Core.
However, for Ji Ruxue, these limits do not apply to her.
As a powerhouse who cultivated up to the Emperor Realm, Ji Ruxue’s Glazed Technique was top-tier even in the later post-apocalypse.
Although she is still just a baby, Ji Ruxue still managed to step into the second stage of cultivation with the Glazed Breathing Technique.
In Ji Ruxue’s memory, there should be no humans breaking through to level two at this stage.
Swish! Swish!
Along with Ji Ruxue’s thoughts, the two nails that were deeply embedded in the table quickly flew back to Ji Ruxue’s hand.
You could see the flight speed of the nails was faster after the breakthrough.
Moreover, after continuous practice over this time, Ji Ruxue’s control over the nails became increasingly skilled.
Even recalling it with such a fast speed didn’t cause any harm to her tender little hands.
Ji Ruxue nodded in satisfaction, confident in her dual talents. Now, with her Object Manipulation Ability and Time Manipulation, she could completely protect herself in this post-apocalypse, even protect her zombie dad.
Click!
The sound of the door opening emerged, and Ji Ruxue hurriedly hid the nails and with a wave of her small hand, a nearby plush bear flew into Ji Ruxue’s hand.
When Lu Chuan entered, Ji Ruxue pretended to be a typical child, playing with toys.
In a very good mood, Lu Chuan saw the little one looking lively and cute, and the smile on his face became even brighter.
He quickly walked over to Ji Ruxue’s side, picked up a Barbie doll on the side, and started teasing the little one.
Although Lu Chuan’s way of teasing children was quite rough, Ji Ruxue was sensible, pretending to like it very much, giving Lu Chuan plenty of emotional value.
Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly in her heart, just wishing she could grow up quickly...
"Huh? Wait?!"
Distractedly playing along with Lu Chuan, Ji Ruxue suddenly sensed a faint hint of a bloody smell on her zombie dad!
As one who emerged victorious from a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood, Ji Ruxue was exceptionally keen on that scent.
Taking advantage of Lu Chuan’s inattentiveness, Ji Ruxue carefully observed, and indeed found traces of blood on Lu Chuan’s body.
Though not obvious, it could be confirmed that it was freshly left.
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue also found a small tuft of hair.
She quietly picked it up, and when Lu Chuan turned and went into the kitchen to cook, Ji Ruxue cautiously brought the hair to her eyes for inspection.
"What kind of hair is this, completely black and a bit hard, and also long and coarse..."
"This is absolutely impossible for humans or zombies to grow, could it be... a mutated fierce beast?!"
Ji Ruxue guessed silently to herself.
Besides the mutated fierce beasts, she really couldn’t figure out what kind of creature would have such hair.
But the problem is, mutated fierce beasts usually have very strong powers; just with her zombie dad who hasn’t evolved, how could he possibly be a match for a mutated fierce beast?
Could it be... Zombie Dad is not an ordinary zombie?!

chapters.title: Chapter 40: I Must Uncover Dad’s Ability!
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Chapter 40: I Must Uncover Dad’s Ability!
After having doubts in her heart, Ji Ruxue’s mind became restless.
The evolution level of ordinary zombies is limited, and they are likely to be eliminated over time.
But evolved zombies are different, as they can gradually grow stronger in this post-apocalyptic era.
The thought that her zombie father might become a formidable force in the future made Ji Ruxue a bit excited.
When Lu Chuan returned to the room, Ji Ruxue began to scrutinize him closely.
She hadn’t paid much attention to him before, but a careful examination today revealed that her zombie father was indeed completely different from those ordinary zombies wandering the streets.
Those zombies that didn’t evolve after the apocalypse gradually become emaciated over time.
After all, zombies are inherently an illogical existence — people who should be dead continue to roam like the living dead.
Moreover, as the apocalypse progresses, the fresh flesh zombies can consume becomes scarcer, making their appearance gradually more gaunt and grim.
But just from his physique and appearance, her zombie father was completely different from those zombies outside, and if not examined carefully, he might even be mistaken for a human.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Lu Chuan returned home and ran to the balcony to practice his self-created ’Lu’s Sword Technique.’
The steel knife was brandished in Lu Chuan’s hand with vigorous force, easily executing movements that required high demands on joint and body coordination.
This further confirmed Ji Ruxue’s suspicions.
Because those zombies that haven’t evolved, though they might receive some enhancement after the Blood Moon, are far from reaching a human’s level of agility.
Regardless of joints or muscles, they are relatively more rigid and could never achieve the level of flexibility that Lu Chuan displayed.
Through the long time spent together, Ji Ruxue completely confirmed that her zombie father’s physique had indeed changed significantly from when she first saw him.
He appeared evidently stronger, with more muscular build, and his shirt was stretched by his muscles, almost resembling a male model with an outstanding physique.
This is very rare among zombies.
Even though she knew her zombie father was different from common zombies, Ji Ruxue couldn’t find anything amiss after looking him over multiple times.
Usually, after that round of Blood Moon, potential zombies would mutate and evolve.
And when zombies evolve, they acquire certain extraordinary abilities.
However, no matter how she examined, Ji Ruxue couldn’t identify the unique ability of her zombie father.
He was just stronger than ordinary zombies, more agile, and more handsome.
Instead of undergoing any significant physical changes, he looked more and more like a human.
Zombies and mutated fierce beasts typically show their evolution through their physique, with unique abilities discernible from their appearance.
For example, in Ji Ruxue’s memories from her previous life, some early post-apocalyptic evolved zombies underwent substantial physical changes.
Tank Type zombies, for instance, become extremely robust and muscular upon evolving, with remarkably sturdy muscles, especially those thick and solid arms, almost like forged steel.
The extraordinary aura could be sensed merely from their appearance.
Then there are Agile Type zombies, although their body remains somewhat skinny, their hands become extraordinarily strong.
Their originally human palms evolve into something like beastly claws, especially with fingernails as tough as steel blades.
These two are the more common types of evolved zombies early in the apocalypse, and are also the types that give many survivors headaches.
Even worse, there’s the Licker, which becomes so grotesque with its skin peeled away revealing blood-red muscles, that it looks like a scarlet monster.
Though many evolved zombies with significant physical changes eventually transform through mutations and evolve into Elemental type zombies over time,
in the early apocalypse, most zombie evolutions and mutations are mainly reflected in their limbs or overall physique.
Besides these zombies with physical evolutions, there are some zombies that gained very special abilities after the Blood Moon.
For example, some zombies can adjust their body’s appearance like a chameleon to achieve invisibility.
Others look no different from ordinary zombies but possess unique talents.
In a survival base from her past life, Ji Ruxue once saw a zombie indistinguishable from an ordinary zombie in appearance yet possessing the Earth Escape ability, sneaking into the base causing it to be overrun.
But this type of zombie is absolutely one in a million, with remarkable growth talent, and as long as they don’t perish prematurely, could essentially become a Corpse King by the late apocalypse.
Looking at her zombie father with an unchanged body yet entirely different from ordinary zombies, Ji Ruxue suddenly had a bold idea.
Could it be that her zombie father is not only an evolved zombie?
But also one in a million, having successfully awakened an extremely rare talent ability?!The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFirenᴇt
If that’s truly the case, her zombie father is hiding far too deep!
Despite living with him day in and day out for such a long time, she still didn’t know what his talent ability was.
Ji Ruxue decided that she must figure out her father’s talent ability!
Although her zombie father was hiding deeply, Ji Ruxue felt no dissatisfaction about being kept in the dark, instead, she was very happy.
Zombies themselves are creatures devoid of thought, usually extremely bloodthirsty, with only a portion of them evolving wisdom in later stages.
Zombies that possess human consciousness early on are very rare.
If not for an evolved talent, it wouldn’t be worth mentioning, but coupled with a continuously evolving talent, it’s a winning start!
At least, even as Empress in her previous life, Ji Ruxue hadn’t come across such a zombie until now.
And talents that are less noticeable are often the ones with great potential and value!
Thinking that her zombie father wasn’t a mediocre individual, even having the potential to become a Corpse King, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile.
"Little Qiqi, why are you grinning at me foolishly?"
Lu Chuan came up beside Ji Ruxue and saw her looking at him with a curious smile, which put him in an especially cheerful mood.
Seeing Ji Ruxue’s clothes had dust on them, Lu Chuan quickly ran downstairs.
After all, an infant’s body is very fragile and might get sick with no place for treatment.
Among the large heap of baby clothes he’d collected, Lu Chuan found a light pink princess dress.
After helping Little Qiqi freshen up, he dressed her in the new outfit, nodding in satisfaction.
Little Qiqi in a pink princess dress looked extremely adorable, her skin fair and tender, and her jet-black lustrous hair unaffected by the apocalypse remained incredibly smooth.
Especially those big, moist eyes, which made Lu Chuan feel as if his spirit was being cleansed.
Don’t worry, Little Qiqi.
Daddy will keep getting stronger, and even in the apocalypse, I’ll let you live like a princess!

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Two Survivor Teams!
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Chapter 41: Two Survivor Teams!
In a flash, a week has passed.
You could say these past few days have been both peaceful and comfortable for Lu Chuan.
The bloody Licker in the district that resembled a zombie killer has been put down, so there’s basically no need to live in daily fear.
And with the continuous improvement in strength, various matters are handled by Corpse Puppets, while Da Pang, like a Gate God, guards the entrance as an evolved zombie.
Lu Chuan currently doesn’t have to worry about danger arriving unexpectedly.
"Dad’s dad is called grandpa..."
"Dad’s mom is called grandma..."
A series of childish voices echoed from the living room; those unaware might think it was the entrance to a shop.
In the living room, Ji Ruxue was holding a blue and white learning machine, and the rhymes were emanating from it.
In the past few days, Lu Chuan had specifically arranged for Corpse Puppets to help the little one acquire this item.
The little one is growing too fast, almost like a child prodigy.
In such a short period, she has learned to speak without any guidance, catching Lu Chuan off guard.
It’s said parents are a child’s first teacher, but having turned into a zombie, he is incapable of teaching.
Thinking about the little one’s future, Lu Chuan specifically had Corpse Puppets search for such learning machines with built-in batteries, which didn’t require power.
This learning machine could emit sounds and interact with people, effectively compensating for his inability to speak.
At least the little one wouldn’t turn into a mute later, only able to babble or roar.
Moreover, this learning machine is very advanced and can effectively guide a child’s learning.
Lu Chuan had seen many learning machine ads before his journey, but he always deemed them useless at that time.
Lo and behold, after crossing into this apocalypse, learning machines turned out to be genuinely useful.
"Mom no longer has to worry about my studies," it turns out this ad slogan wasn’t just talk; it’s really effective!
Watching Little Qiqi hold the learning machine and working hard, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
The little one’s enthusiasm for learning is quite strong; at least with this learning machine around, she won’t become illiterate.
If she can master normal human communication by just following the learning machine, all the better.
But little does Lu Chuan know, Ji Ruxue doesn’t need such infant enlightenment learning.
Before rebirth and before the zombie apocalypse erupted, Ji Ruxue had already enrolled as a graduate student at a prestigious university...ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
During this time, Ji Ruxue has adapted to this infantile body and can speak normally, but she dares not reveal herself.
After all, her current identity is merely that of an infant who hasn’t been born long; speaking too fluently would be absurd.
Even as a prodigy, mastering a language system without hearing typical human dialogues is very unreliable.
Although Lu Chuan has become a zombie, Ji Ruxue does not believe her zombie dad is naive enough to perceive nothing.
Thus, while holding the learning machine, Ji Ruxue’s attitude is serious, earnestly learning every word and every sentence.
It’s all in hopes of eventually communicating normally, more relaxed, without being exposed.
Otherwise, pretending to talk like a child is really unpleasant.
"Dad... Mom..."
"Grandpa... Grandma..."
Though with her experience from two lifetimes, uttering such simple terms is awkward, Ji Ruxue still tries hard to mimic the sounds of a child learning to speak.
Glancing at her zombie dad standing excitedly to the side, Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly.
My zombie dad, I’m relearning this enlightenment knowledge for your sake.
Thanks to you for finding a learning machine; why don’t you just get me a rocking car...
Ji Ruxue didn’t expect that after arduously graduating from graduate school, surviving the apocalypse, and becoming a female empress through countless hardships...
Now, she starts over completely, even beginning to learn infantile education...
Unaware of this next to her, Lu Chuan observed Little Qiqi’s enthusiasm and efficiency in self-learning, which made him very pleased.
Seems his dear daughter truly has an uncommon talent, a prodigy!
Seeing the little one learning to recognize words and speaking just through the learning machine, with her pace continuously quickening, Lu Chuan was thoroughly satisfied.
Ever since hearing Little Qiqi speak, Lu Chuan has been collecting various infant enlightenment books, educational toys, and literacy cards.
Nothing should be too hard for the child, nothing should stunt their education; this is Lu Chuan’s most genuine thought as a parent.
During this period, although Lu Chuan didn’t encounter evolved zombies, he did come across some human survivors.
But seeing those survivors frantically fleeing, Lu Chuan had no intention of intervening.
Even hearing their heart-wrenching cries and pleas couldn’t stir Lu Chuan’s gaze; not everyone is Little Qiqi.
In the apocalypse, life and death are destined, and with the outbreak of this crisis, human nature’s dark side would gradually reveal itself.
Lu Chuan couldn’t guarantee what this group of survivors would do after surviving.
Betraying companions in the apocalypse is almost too common.
Lu Chuan wouldn’t be led by some sort of Mary-Sue syndrome to assist people who are complete strangers.
Even companions can betray; not to mention him, who isn’t even human.
Lu Chuan even suspects that if he were exposed, he could likely be sliced up by human survivors...
During this week, Lu Chuan mapped out a radius of eight kilometers using Corpse Puppets.
Within an eight-kilometer radius of Sunshine District, there are two relatively large survivor teams.
One of which is the team led by the strong Evolver encountered last time in the shop.
The group consists of about twenty people, hiding in the northwest corner of Sunshine District, occupying a three-story building in a small park.
This group has set many simple traps inside and outside the park, and even locked the entrance with barbed wire.
The other survivor team is the nearest police station to Sunshine District.
Lu Chuan sent several Corpse Puppet waves to explore, finding many sandbags placed in front of the police station, a makeshift stronghold.
The surroundings were fortified with barbed wire, there were many zombies slain outside, shell casings on the ground, and bullet holes on the walls.
Although the police station near Sunshine District is small, it does have gun reserves.
The remaining police officers, along with rescued survivors, total about thirty people, making it one of the stronger survivor teams sheltered inside the station.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: The Second Evolved Corpse Puppet
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Chapter 42: The Second Evolved Corpse Puppet
Looking at the current situation, the strength of these two survivor teams is quite remarkable.
One has an evolved new human, and the other has stronger firepower reserves.
Having such strength in the early stages of the apocalypse is already quite uncommon.
Even though Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet team has improved significantly compared to before, he also doesn’t want to be enemies with these two factions.
"We each mind our own business; I hope you won’t disturb me..."
Lu Chuan himself is human, and he has little interest in human flesh.
From the apocalypse until now, Lu Chuan has been gnawing on frozen meat from the fridge, with the only fresh meat being the Mutated Fierce Beast.
Moreover, after experiencing the Blood Moon mutation, Lu Chuan discovered that the Crystal Core in the mutated zombie’s brain is more tempting to him than fresh meat.
After evolving, Lu Chuan has rarely consumed flesh.
Of course, Lu Chuan has no intention of contacting these humans, as he is no longer human, not only a zombie but an evolving one.
Lu Chuan has no doubt that if he appeared in front of these two teams, they would solve him first without saying a word.
After thinking carefully, the only companion Lu Chuan can get along with now is Little Qiqi.
Being a zombie, Lu Chuan is unwilling to associate with those bloodthirsty monsters, especially since zombies lack consciousness and only act on instinct to create carnage.
Even evolved zombies, when meeting, would only think about devouring each other’s Crystal Core.
And having human consciousness, Lu Chuan is even less likely to return to the human camp.
The principle that "if they are not of our kind, their hearts must be different" is understood by these survivors too.
Due to zombies, countless humans have fallen since the apocalypse began, and they harbor a deep hatred that prevents them from accepting a zombie into their camp.
Even if humans really accepted him, Lu Chuan would sleep with one eye open at night.
As long as these humans don’t bother him, Lu Chuan has no interest in dealing with them.
Although he still has human consciousness, Lu Chuan does not think he should live like these human survivors.
Surviving in the apocalypse is fundamental, and Lu Chuan won’t spare someone just because they’re human.
In fact, for Lu Chuan, humans are more troublesome than zombies.
Zombies act only on instinct, opposing him directly.
But human thoughts are far more complex, making it hard for Lu Chuan to guarantee he won’t fall into a trap.
For Lu Chuan, living without disturbing each other is the best way.
However, if these humans were to disturb him and disrupt his rare peaceful life with Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan wouldn’t mind showing his bloodthirsty side.
Thrown into this world inexplicably, and infected by zombies, Lu Chuan harbors a stomach full of anger.Thɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Now that he finally has a peaceful and good life, if anyone dares to break this, Lu Chuan will make them pay.
Next to him, Ji Ruxue raised her head in confusion; just now, she had felt the surrounding temperature drop sharply.
She unexpectedly felt a strong killing intent from her zombie father who always cared for her!
Could something have made zombie dad angry?
Recalling the Mutated Fierce Beast fur and some fresh blood she found on zombie dad earlier.
Ji Ruxue is even more certain that her zombie dad is definitely an evolved zombie, and is probably not easy to provoke either...
Lu Chuan felt something, turned his head and saw Little Qiqi cutely looking at him.
Lu Chuan quickly restrained his murderous aura, revealing a ’gentle’ smile.
Just then, Lu Chuan suddenly felt a movement; his Corpse Puppet had some new activity.
Sharing perspective with the Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan pushed open the room door and went downstairs under Ji Ruxue’s puzzled gaze.
...
Inside a small shop near the police station.
Zhao Lin and several police officer colleagues are collecting supplies.
Although there are some reserve resources inside the police station, the quantity is limited.
As time in the apocalypse progresses, food is already noticeably insufficient.
Mainly because the police station initially overestimated their own strength and underestimated the horror of this apocalypse.
Leading the police station to consume a large amount of supplies and manpower early on, hoping to quickly receive support from above, but now more than a month has passed without any sign.
This made the survivors inside the police station realize that this time they probably have to rely on self-help.
The small shop has long been scoured by humans, but there are still some supplies left,
The police officers, carrying their police backpacks, were cautious and gathering items.
The shop only had the heavy breathing of everyone and the sound of gathering supplies.
Clip-clop!
Suddenly, everyone heard a slight noise, causing everyone’s hands to pause, immediately vigilant and scanning their surroundings.
"What was that sound just now? Did you hear it?"
A police officer frowned and asked softly.
The others remained silent.
Zhao Lin glanced around and whispered, "It might be a zombie passing by outside, don’t waste time, quickly gather supplies and return to the police station, don’t get blocked by zombies!"
However, it seems this team’s luck is not too good, as Zhao Lin’s words fell, a somewhat skinny zombie appeared at the shop’s entrance.
Though this zombie looks no different from ordinary zombies, those enormous sharp claws revealed its identity as an evolved zombie.
"Quick, run! Retreat to the police station! This is a mutated zombie!"
Zhao Lin’s face turned pale, quickly urging everyone to withdraw.
The police officers moved swiftly, turning and running with their backpacks.
But although they are well-trained officers, clearly against this evolved agile zombie they stood no chance.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
This agile zombie moved extremely fast, closing several meters of distance almost instantly with everyone.
Bang bang bang!
The officers immediately opened fire, but they were not special forces personnel, their marksmanship was relatively weak.
Adding to it, the quickness of the evolved zombie kept dodging between the shelves, and no shot hit.
Seeing the mutated zombie and her teammates, a trace of sadness flashed in Zhao Lin’s eyes.
Bang bang bang!
Zhao Lin fired three shots at the mutated zombie, loudly shouting to attract its attention.
"You all go! Quickly take the supplies back to the police station; the survivors there need you more!"
While saying, Zhao Lin even threw the supplies she collected to her teammates.
"As police officers, we must protect everyone’s safety; you must bring these supplies back!"
The other officers didn’t expect that at such a time, Zhao Lin still thought of those survivors.
"I’ll distract the zombie, you all take the chance to escape from here!"
With Zhao Lin continuously firing and shouting, the evolved zombie indeed charged straight at her.
Zhao Lin desperately dodged, but her speed couldn’t compare to the evolved zombie.
The shelves that blocked the path were slashed open by the zombie’s terrifying claws, and when the last bullet missed, Zhao Lin ran into a corner.
Seeing the chasing zombie, Zhao Lin’s heart sank.
But just as she thought she was doomed, the pursuing evolved zombie suddenly stood still.
This bloodthirsty zombie seemed to have empty eyes at that moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Oh My God! Just How Many Supplies Has Zombie Dad Hoarded?
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chapter 43: Oh My God! Just How Many Supplies Has Zombie Dad Hoarded?
Zhao Lin opened her eyes in disbelief, seeing the Evolved Zombie in front of her standing still, unmoving, which puzzled her.
However, in such a life-and-death situation, Zhao Lin didn’t have the mind to ponder what had actually happened and quickly bypassed the zombie, running towards the police station.
Escaping from the clutches of a zombie is extremely difficult, let alone when the opponent is an Evolved Zombie.
Currently, Zhao Lin’s face was filled with panic, rendering her incapable of thinking.
Just after she left, the Evolved Zombie resumed moving.
The formerly fierce zombie suddenly seemed to be controlled by some force, dumbly walking to the side of a shop.
The next moment, a figure slowly emerged from the corner, it was Lu Chuan who had rushed here swiftly.
The reason the Evolved Zombie didn’t continue to chase Zhao Lin was because Lu Chuan, at the last moment, successfully controlled it using his own abilities.
"Who would have thought, even after all this time during the zombie crisis, there are still people with such a saintly heart?"
Lu Chuan had observed the situation inside the shop just moments ago.
One must understand, in this apocalyptic world, self-preservation is the rule of survival.
During this time, he had seen too many cases of humans killing one another, working together one moment only to betray the next, pushing companions into the clutches of zombies.
This was the first time he had seen someone willing to sacrifice themselves for their companion, choosing to stay behind voluntarily.
Even as she was about to die, she was still concerned about the survivors at the police station whom she didn’t know at all...
In fact, Lu Chuan admired this kind of person.
But he didn’t agree with their actions.
After all, in such a selfish and sinister world, to preserve such purity in humanity is the mark of a very noble and good person.
Yet, the problem is that kindness and justice are the most useless things in the apocalypse; only survival is fundamental...
This selfless act is very rare in the post-apocalyptic world, it’s just a pity that such good people typically do not end well in the apocalypse.
Because human nature is the most unreadable thing.
However, Lu Chuan didn’t mind, this time rescuing Zhao Lin was just a spur-of-the-moment decision.
And today also allowed Lu Chuan to witness firsthand that Evolved Zombies do indeed exhibit considerable combat power over ordinary humans.
Even armed police officers were unable to kill such an Evolved Zombie.
Lu Chuan looked at the Evolved Zombie before him, its torso was a bit thin, but its hands had turned into sharp claws, nodding with satisfaction.
Though both were Evolved Zombies, this one was completely different from the Da Pang he subdued earlier.
Da Pang was evidently on the route of large build combined with attack and defense.
While this Agile Type zombie moved extremely fast, even these trained officers couldn’t score a hit.
Lu Chuan stepped forward to examine the claws of this Evolved Zombie, they were indeed extremely sharp.
"From now on, you’ll be called Lightning..."
When Lu Chuan arrived at the scene earlier, he happened to see this zombie continuously dodging bullets, and its rapid speed made "Lightning" a fitting description.
Then Lu Chuan took his ’acquisition’ back to the Sunshine District.
Seeing the two figures, one large and one small, guarding the entrance, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction.
With Da Pang and Lightning, these two powerful Evolved Zombies, Lu Chuan felt a great sense of security.
During this period of evolution and stockpiling, Lu Chuan had amassed over twenty ordinary low-level zombie Corpse Puppets, as well as these two different types of Evolved Zombie Corpse Puppets.
Da Pang and Lightning are two distinct types of Evolved Zombies, with Da Pang having a massive build with immense strength and defense maxed out.
Whereas Lightning focuses on speed and attack, one handles offense, and the other defense, effectively covering any weaknesses.
Even just one mindless Agile Type Evolved Zombie is enough to drive a team of armed officers to a dead end.
Now, wielding over twenty low-level zombies, plus two Evolved Zombies, Lu Chuan felt as though he could walk sideways in this apocalypse.
Unless encountering human militaries with heavy firepower, Lu Chuan didn’t believe he would face much threat.
After all, even his most defensively capable subordinate Da Pang couldn’t withstand human thermal weaponry.
As for whether it would eventually evolve to withstand human thermal weaponry in the future, Lu Chuan wasn’t sure.
But right now, with the world already collapsed, and the apocalypse having started over a month ago, Lu Chuan had yet to see any military enter the city for rescue.
Only small-scale police forces within the city organized relief efforts, which eventually fell apart due to the overwhelming number of zombies and lack of manpower.
This sudden zombie outbreak caused the entire world to fall.
Lu Chuan guessed the situation in the military was probably not good either, after all, it’s illogical that only city residents were infected, leaving the military unaffected.
...
While Lu Chuan was inspecting his Corpse Puppet army, he was unaware that Ji Ruxue was no longer in the bedroom.
Earlier, as soon as Lu Chuan sensed the Evolved Zombie, he quickly left, and Ji Ruxue, seeing him leave, secretly used Telekinesis to open the door.
Now that Ji Ruxue had broken through to the second tier, she regained quite a bit of confidence.
Possessing two powerful abilities and breaking through to the second tier, Ji Ruxue felt she wasn’t in much danger as long as she didn’t encounter a particularly strong Evolved Zombie.
Since her rebirth, Ji Ruxue had always stayed indoors.
She hadn’t felt a sense of freedom in a long time, and her small body greatly restricted her movements.
After continuous cultivation and the support of Telekinesis, Ji Ruxue’s body was now able to move normally.
So Ji Ruxue started to try and see what life was like outside.
After all, staying indoors all the time would drive anyone insane.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Especially someone like Ji Ruxue, who was once an Unparalleled Empress standing at the pinnacle of the pyramid.
Staying indoors all day was unbearably uncomfortable for her.
Previously, she tolerated her weakness, but now that she had the power to defend herself, Ji Ruxue didn’t want to stay cooped up in a room any longer.
At the very least, she needed to figure out where she was and which area she was in.
She descended to the sixth floor and entered through an open door, only to be amazed by the scene before her.
The sixth-floor room was packed with all sorts of supplies.
These various supplies filled the storage spaces initially prepared in the room without leaving any wasted space.
Looking at the rooms packed full of supplies, Ji Ruxue was momentarily left in awe.
Her zombie ’dad’ in this apocalypse had hoarded so many supplies, it was enough to open a store.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Is Dad’s Evolutionary Ability Earth Escape?
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Chapter 44: Is Dad’s Evolutionary Ability Earth Escape?
Although Sunshine District where Lu Chuan lives is an old community, it also has two households per floor.
The doors of the two rooms on the sixth floor are still open, and after checking, Ji Ruxue found that they were filled with all kinds of supplies.
Upon entering the room, several bags of rice piled up in the kitchen can be seen.
Ji Ruxue looked around and found nearly ten bags of rice, each weighing fifty pounds!
And there’s a huge pile of milk powder needed for her, with several famous brands available.
Canned milk powder filled the cabinets, and outside a large pile was stacked like a hill, with even bagged milk powder on top.
Looking at the mountain of milk powder piled up in front of her, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but widen her eyes, unable to imagine how long it would take her to consume so much milk powder.
She’s afraid that by the time all the milk powder is consumed, she would have been saturated with the taste.
There is also a large amount of bottled water piled up in the house, reaching three meters high, meeting the ceiling.
Similarly stacked like a small hill, Ji Ruxue’s young body couldn’t even climb up.
Besides this, there were many daily necessities, mostly for infants and toddlers.
Such as various types of diapers, baby bottles, and bibs, etc.
Various infant toys, literacy cards, and fairy tale books were also brought back by Lu Chuan.
After all, Lu Chuan has never taken care of a child and doesn’t know what exactly to gather for an infant during growth.
Thus, whenever he saw baby products during his scavenges, Lu Chuan had the zombies bring all of them back.
Anyway, it’s the end of the world now, and these things are free.
Moreover, Lu Chuan knew that the world had become so cruel that it would not always be smooth sailing, so bringing supplies home early is more reassuring.
And he kept moving until all kinds of supplies filled the place.
Only the living room was left with space, which Lu Chuan used to practice his combat skills.
Looking at the array of items in the room, Ji Ruxue was shocked while feeling a warmth at heart.
The zombie dad collected so many supplies undoubtedly for her sake; after all, as a zombie, he didn’t need these baby items.
Ji Ruxue’s small hand gently caressed these supplies, her black and white eyes were filled with emotion.
In such a chaotic world, collecting this many supplies and bringing them home must have taken great effort by zombie dad.
Even she felt shocked just by looking at so many supplies.
"How did zombie dad manage it?"
"It must not be easy to bring so many supplies back, right?"
Looking at a room full of supplies, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but fall into contemplation.
Though zombies don’t get overly tired like humans do, having only two hands still limits their capabilities; bringing back all this rice must not have been easy.
Usually, dad is either caring for her or practicing combat skills, rarely going out.
To move so many supplies as a zombie would surely take a lot of time.
Yet she hasn’t seen her zombie dad spending so much time collecting supplies...
Thinking about this, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but fall into contemplation, but soon her eyes lit up sharply.
Right, zombie dad might not be just an ordinary low-level zombie!
If he were an evolved zombie, then it could be explained.
It is very likely that the ability to transport so many supplies has something to do with zombie dad’s evolutionary ability.
The more Ji Ruxue thought about it, the more she believed it could be possible; after all, if he were just an ordinary zombie, how could he move so many supplies?
"But what exactly is dad’s evolutionary ability? For so long, I haven’t seen any sign of it."
Usually, after zombies evolve, it is somewhat reflected in one aspect or another.
But so far, Ji Ruxue hasn’t found any clues, only feeling her zombie dad is stronger and more agile than ordinary zombies.
Aside from this, there doesn’t seem to be anything special.
Ji Ruxue sat on the sofa, starting to search through her memories of rare evolved zombies and their unique abilities she encountered in her past life.
Actually, there are indeed quite a few zombies with unique abilities, but Ji Ruxue thought for a long time without knowing how her zombie dad could match any of them.
Moreover, it’s only the early apocalypse now; most zombies with unique abilities appear gradually in the mid-to-late stages.
Zombies that awaken special abilities early on are like martial arts prodigies among human sects, definitely one in ten thousand.
Looking at a room full of supplies, Ji Ruxue frowned, could it be... Earth Escape Ability?
Earth Element Zombies who awaken Earth Escape Ability can freely travel underground, greatly reducing travel time.
If one wanted to quickly move so many supplies into the house, Ji Ruxue thought it might only be possible for Earth Escape Zombies to achieve.
Apart from this, it might be possible for zombies with spatial ability, like using the Power of Space to directly transfer various supplies into the room.
But this possibility Ji Ruxue dismissed after thinking about it, because Power of Space is an exceedingly rare talent.
Space and time are always the two strongest existences, when time doesn’t emerge, space reigns supreme; entities with spatial talent have the potential to become top-tier powerhouses in the future.
In her previous life, Ji Ruxue had heard of only one such zombie with spatial talent; this talent is too rare.
Moreover, despite its immense potential and powerful capabilities, spatial ability, like her Time Control, requires massive energy to utilize in its early stages.
Even now, having broken through to the second tier, Ji Ruxue mostly uses Object Manipulation Ability in battles.
In the early stages before strength is established, such high-level talents are impossible to use frequently, applying spatial ability to transport supplies would be somewhat wasteful.
Ji Ruxue thought about it and decided to temporarily assess zombie dad’s ability as Earth Escape.
Compared to spatial talent, Earth Escape has a greater possibility and meets the needs for stockpiling supplies.
Ji Ruxue wanted to continue downstairs, but just then she heard movement from the unit door.
No surprise, it’s dad returning from outside; to not reveal her current abilities, Ji Ruxue hurried back to the bedroom on the seventh floor, pretending to be nonchalant.
Though inside, she felt a bit excited.
Unexpectedly, dad, you truly surprised me!The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFirenᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 45: You’re the Police, So It’s Your Job to Protect Us!
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Chapter 45: You’re the Police, So It’s Your Job to Protect Us!
Lu Chuan was in high spirits after gaining a great asset.
He could already imagine that in the near future, with a powerful group of zombies behind him, he could thrive in this apocalyptic world.
The two evolved zombies were left to guard on the first floor, while Lu Chuan returned to the seventh floor.
Just as he pushed open the door and entered the room, Lu Chuan discovered a shocking scene.
Little Qiqi was using the copybook he had bought, lying on the floor practicing writing!
Although the characters Little Qiqi wrote were crooked and looked quite ugly, one could vaguely recognize what characters they were.
Of course, the reason they were so crooked was because Ji Ruxue did it on purpose.
She didn’t want to expose her identity as a reborn person too early; being able to read and write at this young age would be too extraordinary.
Therefore, she deliberately wrote the characters crookedly, barely pretending that she was in the process of learning.
If she had written neatly from the start, even a fool would have noticed something was off.
Yet, even though the writing was very ugly, Lu Chuan was still both shocked and delighted.
Although Lu Chuan had been single for many years and had neither dated nor had children, he knew that at Little Qiqi’s age, most infants were still crawling on the ground.
When he first met Little Qiqi, the little one could only lie in the crib, not even having the energy to cry.
In such a short period, not only did the little one learn to stand and walk, and talk, now she was even self-learning to write!
Lu Chuan increasingly felt that his precious daughter was a prodigious genius, beyond what words like prodigy could describe.
After all, in Lu Chuan’s previous life, he never heard of any child at Little Qiqi’s age being so exceptional.
Moreover, this was achieved without him providing any guidance, solely through Little Qiqi’s self-learning!
However, Lu Chuan didn’t think much of it, attributing the achievements to Little Qiqi’s intelligence and the learning machine.
"As expected of the genius learning machine, truly a worry-free tool for parents!"
Watching the little one practicing writing stroke by stroke, despite the careless handwriting now, it was already groundbreaking.
Lu Chuan’s heart filled with pride and satisfaction, perhaps this is the inner sense of accomplishment a parent feels hoping for their child to succeed.
My daughter, Lu Chuan’s daughter, is truly extraordinary!
Then Lu Chuan gently squatted down and carefully pinched Ji Ruxue’s cheek.Googlᴇ search No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The little one’s skin was very smooth, even in the apocalypse it was kept clean by Lu Chuan, very fair like a porcelain doll and adorable.
"Daddy seems really happy today; apparently he has had a good haul on this outing."
Ji Ruxue secretly speculated in her heart.
During their time together, zombie dad would pinch her cheek whenever he was free.
Ji Ruxue might not understand what zombie dad wanted to say, but she could sense it was an expression of his happiness.
...
The Police Station.
After escaping the evolved zombies, Zhao Lin returned to the police station alive, only to find an intense argument occurring inside.
One side was her colleagues, the officers within the police station.
The other side was the survivors their station had rescued and sheltered.
At this moment, the survivors were highly emotional, pointing at the officers and scolding them harshly.
"What are you guys doing? Why are you sending us ordinary people out to search for supplies?!"
"You’re wearing uniforms, as police you should be protecting us, that’s your duty!"
"We are taxpayers, paying you guys so much to feed you, and you expect us to risk our lives outside? Hah! Don’t even think about it!"
Being scolded by the survivors, the officers’ faces turned extremely pale, their expressions filled with gloom.
"Alright, alright, what happened here? Why is everyone suddenly arguing?!"
Zhao Lin quickly stepped in to separate the two sides.
Seeing Zhao Lin had actually returned alive, her colleagues were filled with surprise.
When they left, they saw Zhao Lin had been cornered by the evolved zombie, but unexpectedly she was able to return from such a situation.
The survivors who were originally scolding harshly changed their expressions upon seeing Zhao Lin, showing excitement.
"Wonderful Officer Zhao, we didn’t expect you to still be alive."
"Officer Zhao, quickly come judge this! Officer Li and Officer Wang are actually sending us out to search for supplies, this is no joke!"
"We are just ordinary people, the outside is so dangerous, what if we encounter a zombie?!"
"The outside is so dangerous, sending us out to search for supplies is truly too much!"
Listening to their grievances, the officers inside increasingly found it difficult to accept.
They never expected that risk their lives to gather resources would not receive praise but be met with intensified criticism.
Officer Li and Officer Wang, thinking about today’s situation in the shop, felt a surge of nameless anger.
"Enough! Is your life precious and ours should be thrown away?"
"Why should it always be us risking our lives to gather resources, while you just sit inside waiting for distribution without needing to exert any effort?!"
Hearing their colleagues’ complaints, Zhao Lin frowned.
"Alright, let’s stop arguing."
"Let the task of gathering supplies be handled by us, we’re police after all, it’s our duty to protect the people, facing danger is our responsibility."
Hearing Zhao Lin’s words, the survivors inside applauded joyously.
"Officer Zhao is indeed just and righteous! Not like some people who are selfish!"
"Yes, Officer Zhao is a real good cop, thank you Officer Zhao!"
The survivors knew how dangerous the outside world was; once they went out there was a chance they wouldn’t come back, they didn’t want to take that risk.
Officer Li and Officer Wang’s faces turned extremely gloomy, but thinking of how today Zhao Lin drew the zombies away, they just exchanged a glance, snorted coldly, and said nothing further.
Then the officers began distributing the resources.
Seeing the decreasing amounts of supplies in their hands, the survivors couldn’t help but complain.
"Officer Zhao, can’t you gather more food next time? This isn’t enough to eat."
"Yes, yes, every night I’m hungry, the food you bring back isn’t enough."
Hearing their complaints, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but frown.
Nonetheless, witnessing everyone’s plight in the apocalypse, Zhao Lin felt a duty to care for them, so she always allocated herself the least supplies.
Others could still have two meals a day, while Zhao Lin would only eat a small packet of biscuits a day.
The prolonged malnutrition often made her feel dizzy.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Future Powerhouse—Nine-Death Demon Cop!
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Chapter 46: Future Powerhouse—Nine-Death Demon Cop!
Sunshine District.
The originally peaceful garden path was now filled with the sounds of something slicing through the air and the clash of metal.
Two figures moved with incredible speed, like martial arts masters from a kung fu movie.
In an instant, blades flashed continuously in the area, the sound of the knife slicing through the air sending shivers down one’s spine.
The two figures engaged in combat were Lu Chuan and his latest Evolved Corpse Puppet, ’Lightning’.
As Lu Chuan kept consuming Crystal Cores and evolving, his physical fitness had significantly improved compared to before.
Along with continuous combat training, ordinary low-level Corpse Puppets were no longer sufficient to meet Lu Chuan’s combat demands.
Even if these Corpse Puppets attacked together, Lu Chuan felt no significant threat from them.
The previously controlled ’Da Pang’ was really unsuitable as a sparring partner.
’Da Pang’s physique was very robust and incredibly strong, wielding its hammer like it was sweeping across an army.
Standing before ’Da Pang’, Lu Chuan felt like an infantryman trying to confront a tank.
So he wasn’t foolish enough to engage ’Da Pang’...
’Lightning’ was undoubtedly his best sparring partner at present.
’Lightning’ didn’t have ’Da Pang’s exaggerated physique and strength, but as an Evolved Zombie, its force wasn’t lacking either.
In fact, because ’Lightning’ was an Agile Type, its force was even stronger than the Lu Chuan’s, who had consumed several Crystal Cores.
Recently, Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet had frequently searched for resources in the area and found two machetes in a hardware store.
After giving the two steel knives to ’Lightning’, Lu Chuan issued an order to attack him.
This led to the sight of two figures clashing like martial arts masters on the garden path.
The steel knives were constantly slicing through the air, even bursting into sparks.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
As an Agile Type Evolved Zombie, ’Lightning’ had an extremely fast burst of speed, moving much quicker than Lu Chuan.
Even though Lu Chuan had undergone long periods of combat technique training, he could now only defend himself when facing the dual-wielding ’Lightning’.
Even the slightest mistake could result in injury.
However, Lu Chuan’s body coordination and combat awareness also continued to grow with constant honing.
With each clash of blades, Lu Chuan felt like his arms were being heavily repelled.
In their exchanges, Lu Chuan unleashed all the memory of movements from his past life and the combat skills he’d learned recently.
Now Lu Chuan realized just how important it was to have a strong and suitable sparring partner!
After fighting for a long time, Lu Chuan called off the order.
Looking at ’Lightning’, who held the dual blades, Lu Chuan nodded silently to himself.
Although ’Lightning’ was only at the first tier, it was indeed a physique-advanced zombie.
In close-quarters combat, Lu Chuan’s current strength was still slightly inferior to ’Lightning’.
Though the battles were more dangerous compared to low-level zombies, Lu Chuan was very exhilarated.
Even though he was always on the defensive, Lu Chuan experienced a sense of exhilaration.
His combat skills improved rapidly during this combat process, far more so than when honing them with low-level zombies.
Lu Chuan never stopped preparing to refine his strength, although his evolved ability was controlling zombies through Telekinesis Control.
