However, Lu Chuan felt he couldn’t rely too heavily on this ability, since if one day he had no Corpse Puppets around him and couldn’t control his opponent, he must rely on his own capabilities.
Only possessing enough personal strength is the key to surviving in the apocalypse.
Looking at the Evolved Zombie in front of him, Lu Chuan thought for a moment and then issued another command, leading to another flurry of flashing blades in the area.
After all, zombies didn’t need to consume a lot of time resting or eating various foods to replenish their energy like humans.
After briefly summarizing his battle experiences, Lu Chuan began his training again.
...
Inside the room, after Lu Chuan left, Ji Ruxue started wandering again.
Ji Ruxue continued to search through various odds and ends in the room, hoping to find some useful information.
Since her rebirth, Ji Ruxue had always lived in the bedroom, still unsure of where exactly she was.
She pulled out a pile of documents and quickly began checking them one by one.
"So this is Jianghai City."
Among the scattered documents, Ji Ruxue found a contract that recorded the property’s information here.
Finally understanding her current location, Ji Ruxue secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, with memories from her previous life, she could still make use of them after rebirth.
Unfortunately, Ji Ruxue felt a little regretful that she wasn’t very familiar with the situation in Jianghai City.
In Ji Ruxue’s memory, there were two very famous strong individuals in Jianghai City.
These two strong individuals were one human and one mutated Fierce Beast, neither of which were Evolved Zombie types.
The human was a powerful individual who had reached the Emperor Realm, known as the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
The name sounded very strange, but Ji Ruxue heard that the Nine Deaths Demon Police was in the police force before the apocalypse.
And was even a policewoman.
Most importantly, this woman had very peculiar abilities, possessing an eerie Resurrection Technique!
In the apocalypse, the ability to resurrect was like a cheat, and crucially, the Nine Deaths Demon Police could perform it nine times in a row.
She had nine chances to resurrect.
Moreover, with each death, her power would surge several times upon resurrection!
It was indeed a very formidable existence, and this cheat-like Talent Ability could almost render one invincible.
This policewoman relied on such incredible abilities, enduring betrayals and deaths in the early period of the zombie apocalypse.
Her initial patriotic fervor was gradually frozen by the detestable nature of humanity in the apocalypse, transforming into a cold-blooded killing machine.
Ultimately, she grew to become one of the top-tier strong individuals.
Meanwhile, the other evolved Fierce Beast was a giant white bear from a zoo.
After the zombie crisis broke out, the zoo was left unmanaged, with these Fierce Beasts either being devoured or mutating to become incredibly powerful.
This originally massive white bear boasted explosive combat power.
This beastly king was called Thunderous Roar, a mutated giant bear that wielded the Power of Thunder.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Ji Ruxue: I Will Train Dad to Become the Strongest Zombie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Chapter 47: Ji Ruxue: I Will Train Dad to Become the Strongest Zombie!
Regarding the white bear called Thunderous Roar, which possesses the Power of Thunder, Ji Ruxue actually doesn’t know much.
After all, she is the empress of the human race, and even if she meets fierce beasts, most of the time it’s just a fight.
However, this human race powerhouse, Nine Deaths Demon Police, Ji Ruxue had some dealings with her in her previous life.
Ji Ruxue even personally killed this female officer before.
It was this encounter that revealed to Ji Ruxue the peculiar evolutionary ability of the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
Reviving after death is much stronger than ordinary talents.
The most crucial point is that after dying she can strengthen herself, which is incredibly extraordinary.
Other talents may be strong, but once a person dies, that’s it.
But this policewoman is different, she can resurrect multiple times, which is a talent many dream of having.
However, this human race powerhouse from Jianghai City had rather poor luck. The time Ji Ruxue killed her was already her ninth death...
Though the Nine Deaths Demon Police in Jianghai City wasn’t as powerful as Ji Ruxue, who was an empress in the previous life, she had reached the Emperor Realm, counting as one of the top-tier powerhouses post-apocalypse.
Jianghai City producing such a top-tier powerhouse is not easy, mainly because her ability is incredibly extraordinary.
Reflecting on her memories from her previous life, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile.
"I wonder if, after rebirth, I can meet that woman with the peculiar talent..."
It is extremely difficult to meet someone in the vast sea of people, let alone in an apocalypse where anyone could die at any moment.
Although Jianghai City isn’t huge, it’s not a small city either. So meeting each other might not be easy, Ji Ruxue estimates that it’s hard to encounter her again after rebirth.
"I never imagined someone could possess the ability to resurrect. If I could encounter her earlier, perhaps I could consider recruiting her."
Ji Ruxue pondered secretly.
After the Blood Moon night of the apocalypse, the enhancement of human survivors mainly depends on their awakened evolutionary abilities.
The more outstanding the awakened ability, the more likely one could be a top-tier powerhouse in the future.
Someone like the Nine Deaths Demon Police, who possesses resurrection ability, and can strengthen herself several times after resurrection, are indeed rare.
Moreover, this female officer truly reached the Emperor Realm and became a top-tier powerhouse in her memory.
With such extraordinary ability, the Nine Deaths Demon Police should have gone further, the Emperor Realm should just be a transitional phase for her kind of person.
Yet perhaps due to her personality, she wasted too many precious opportunities to resurrect in the early apocalypse.
If she had adapted to apocalypse life earlier, begun enhancing her power as early as possible, preserving the precious resurrection opportunities for later, she had the chance to break through to the Emperor Realm!
Breaking through to the Emperor Realm would mean being a top-tier powerhouse on this planet.
If she were ordinary, it wouldn’t matter; but a person with Emperor Level potential is indeed worth recruiting and controlling.
As for the talent ability of the Zombie Daddy, Ji Ruxue cannot be completely sure.
In her memory, Jianghai City hasn’t actually produced particularly strong zombies.
This means that according to the evolutionary trajectory of her previous life, her Zombie Daddy is likely to encounter various life-threatening crises later.
By recruiting some talented powerhouses, she can better protect the safety of the Zombie Daddy.
After confirming her current location, Ji Ruxue returned the files she had dug out back to their original place with ease and then felt relieved to return to her bed, sitting cross-legged to start cultivating.
As Ji Ruxue’s power breached further, the operation speed of the Glazed Breathing Technique also accelerated.
Ji Ruxue’s sensitivity to the energy factors in the air had become more acute than before.
A large amount of energy factor merged into Ji Ruxue’s body, continuously tempering her currently somewhat petite physique.
Most of these energy factors were used to strengthen Ji Ruxue’s telekinesis.
Perhaps it’s because of cultivating the Glazed Breathing Technique, Ji Ruxue absorbed a large amount of energy factors from the air, so her growth is slightly faster than ordinary infants.
Thus Ji Ruxue cultivated for a long time, after another cycle had circulated within her body, she opened her eyes slowly.
But looking at the empty room around her, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but feel a bit puzzled.
"Zombie Daddy has been out for quite a long time, why hasn’t he returned yet?"
"Could it be that he went out to gather supplies again? Just the supplies downstairs are sufficient for a long time."
"I hope there won’t be any accidents..."
Since knowing her current location is Jianghai City, Ji Ruxue has become more concerned about Zombie Daddy’s safety.
Because currently Zombie Daddy has human consciousness and might possess some special talent ability, this kind of zombie should logically become increasingly powerful.
But in her previous life, no such existence was found in Jianghai City, so there’s only one possibility that her Zombie Daddy most likely faced danger...
Ji Ruxue stood up and walked to the door. Hearing no sound or movement downstairs, she thought for a moment and quietly opened the door to sneak downstairs.
This time, Ji Ruxue went directly to the fifth floor, where she discovered clear signs that the door had also been pried open.
When Ji Ruxue opened the door and walked inside, she was immediately shocked by the scene in the room.
The two rooms on the fifth floor were identical to those on the sixth floor, with a massive pile of resources, primarily food and water.
There were also various baby clothes, toys, and the like, with a particular abundance of baby supplies.
There was no doubt these were all prepared by the zombie father for her.
Looking at the mountain of supplies, Ji Ruxue felt an even greater shock in her heart compared to before. She was deeply moved, realizing the zombie father had done so much behind her back.
She never expected that what she saw on the sixth floor was merely the tip of the iceberg.
Now it seemed she had underestimated the special abilities of the zombie father, who had silently transported so many supplies.
Ji Ruxue suddenly had a new idea and continued to head downstairs.
As she expected, the locks on the doors of the rooms on the fourth and third floors had also been forcefully pried open, and a large amount of supplies was piled inside each.
Ji Ruxue was dumbfounded, unable to believe that her father had nearly filled the entire building during this time.
Could it be that every time her father went out, he brought back everything usable from the vicinity?!
Who would have thought the zombie father had such a hoarding instinct.
Others might stockpile a lot, but her zombie father stockpiled an entire building!
Ji Ruxue was increasingly moved, feeling that all these supplies were her father’s love, the foundation the zombie father had built for her.
No, to be precise, the mountain of supplies he brought back...
Ji Ruxue smiled and continued heading downstairs.
But as soon as she reached the second floor, her expression changed instantly.
Ji Ruxue sensed a very fierce and formidable aura, completely different from that of ordinary zombies.
What was going on? Could there be an evolved zombie downstairs?
Ji Ruxue quickly lightened her steps and quietly moved to the balcony on the second floor.
Looking down from the window, she indeed saw a being with an extremely robust physique and a powerful aura.
’Da Pang’, holding two hammers, was guarding the entrance of the building, looking very much like a gate god from afar!
"What’s going on? Why is there a tank type zombie downstairs?!"
Ji Ruxue’s pupils contracted; she hadn’t anticipated an evolved zombie appearing right below her and the zombie father!
Strangely, how did her father manage to go out with such a strong evolved zombie guarding downstairs?
Oh, right, she almost forgot that the zombie father was also an evolved zombie.
With this in mind, Ji Ruxue was sure her father’s awakened ability must be the Earth Escape ability!
The ’Da Pang’ guarding downstairs made Ji Ruxue more certain of Lu Chuan’s awakened talent.
Ji Ruxue believed that only an Earth Escape talent could allow the zombie father to slip out unnoticed in front of an evolved zombie.
And only such an Earth Escape talent could enable her zombie father to transport so many supplies back in a short time.
Ji Ruxue didn’t alarm the ’Da Pang’ at the entrance and stealthily returned to the seventh floor.
Though she had already advanced to a second-tier ability, with telekinesis and time control as her talents, even a first-tier evolved zombie couldn’t do much to her.
However, Ji Ruxue had no intention of engaging in combat with it.
Having confirmed the zombie father’s talent ability, Ji Ruxue felt very happy.
Although the Earth Escape zombie’s combat ability wasn’t particularly prominent and might not become a future Corpse King, its survival ability was top-notch, which relieved Ji Ruxue greatly.
"Since Dad is an evolved zombie, that simplifies things. I need to find ways to hunt more evolved zombies for him to devour their crystal cores and evolve. This way, even with the Earth Escape talent, he can become a powerful zombie!"Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue nodded to herself and began planning.
Soon, she would take down that big guy on the first floor, especially with such a strong being guarding outside, making it very inconvenient for her father to come and go.
She could still use the crystal core of the evolved zombie to further enhance her father’s strength.
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue also recalled the formidable Beast Emperor in Jianghai City.
The white bear, known among survivors as the Thunderous Roar, became extremely ferocious after its evolved mutation.
In her previous life, Ji Ruxue had heard that this Thunderous Roar wreaked havoc in Jianghai City.
Several relatively stable large human survivor bases were destroyed by this giant bear.
She decided that, in the future, if she ever encountered this giant bear, she would take it down as a way to protect the people.
Moreover, the crystal core of Thunderous Roar, this mutated fierce beast with potential to become Beast Emperor, would surely benefit her father.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: News from the Survivor Base
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Chapter 48: News from the Survivor Base
Lu Chuan, who was currently fighting ’Lightning’, had no idea that his great general was now on his precious daughter’s hunting list...
After all, Lu Chuan could hardly imagine that a baby who was recently lying motionless in a crib and had just learned to walk a few steps, could actually open the door and go down the stairs by herself.
After battling with ’Lightning’ for a long time, their sharp machetes had turned the surrounding greenery into a scene like fallen leaves sweeping in the autumn wind.
Looking at the Agile Type zombie wielding dual knives in front of him, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
After a bout of fighting, his combat skills had greatly improved.
Controlling ’Lightning’ to return to Building No. 5 with him, Lu Chuan left ’Lightning’ downstairs with ’Da Pang’ to guard the door, while he went upstairs to shower.
Even though he was a zombie now, he still lived with a little one.
If it were the first month of the apocalypse, Lu Chuan wouldn’t have cared about cleaning up, as long as there weren’t too many bloodstains on him.
But today was different. With a little baby by his side, Lu Chuan had to wash clean every day.
Since he had gathered a large amount of resources through Corpse Puppets, the precious drinking water others valued was now stacked up in his building.
One reason was to prevent bacteria because Little Qiqi’s resistance was not as strong as an adult’s, so hygiene and safety had to be prioritized.
Another reason was that Lu Chuan didn’t want his body odor to affect Little Qiqi at close quarters.
However, Lu Chuan noticed that as he kept evolving, the zombie traits on his body seemed to have become less apparent than before.
The ferocious scar on his shoulder had even gradually healed after absorbing Crystal Cores.
Looking in the mirror, he felt that although he was still a zombie, his appearance wasn’t as bad as it used to be.
After washing up, Lu Chuan changed into a simple and clean shirt and even sprayed that faint-scented branded perfume.
When he returned to the seventh floor, he discovered that Little Qiqi had fallen into a deep sleep on the sofa.
The little one looked very peaceful and serene, lying there like a little angel that attracted everyone’s affection.
Even though Ji Ruxue had already broken through to the second tier through the Glazed Breathing Technique, she was still just a little baby.
Under normal circumstances, a baby of Ji Ruxue’s age would be doing well just to crawl back and forth on a bed.
Yet Ji Ruxue could now crawl up and down seven flights of stairs all by herself, she was simply the Valkyrie among infants.
But after all, the original strength of the body was too weak, and even though breaking through to the second tier mainly enhanced Telekinesis, the boost to physical strength was not particularly evident.
After crawling back to the room, Ji Ruxue soon fell into a deep sleep.
Looking at the adorable Little Qiqi on the sofa, Lu Chuan decided that since the little one could already walk on the ground, it was time to take her out for some fresh air.
Always staying indoors, without anyone able to communicate with her normally, and with the windows boarded up, Lu Chuan was really worried that such a closed environment would affect Little Qiqi’s personality.
Moreover, as he evolved in strength, the zombies in Sunshine District had already been cleared out by his Corpse Puppets.
Lu Chuan selected some with intact limbs and robust physiques to replenish his team of Corpse Puppets, and the rest he destroyed.
After all, the apocalypse was never short of zombies; even if his Corpse Puppets were killed by Evolved Zombies, he could just control a few from the streets. The safety of the district mattered most.
Over time, Lu Chuan had familiarized himself with the surrounding terrain. Though the Sunshine District was an old community, it also had an enclosed environment.
By then, he could let ’Da Pang’ guard the district gate with dual hammers while ’Lightning’ secretly followed to ensure Little Qiqi’s safety.
There was no longer anyone in Sunshine District who could pose a threat to the little one, especially since he would be by Little Qiqi’s side; even going out for a breath of fresh air wouldn’t be risky.
Not long ago, Lu Chuan was worried about survival in the apocalypse, but now, having controlled two Evolved Zombies in succession, his confidence had grown significantly.
The following days passed very peacefully.
Lu Chuan continued to dispatch Corpse Puppets around the area to act like surveillance cameras, patrolling everywhere or searching for supplies.
Little Qiqi practiced standing and walking at home every day, or held a learning machine to practice speaking, communication, and handwriting.
In a few days, Little Qiqi’s progress was astonishing, making Lu Chuan increasingly feel that his daughter was simply a prodigy.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan practiced daily in the open space of the community, engaging in battles with ’Lightning’.
As an Agile Type zombie, ’Lightning’, wielding dual knives, was Lu Chuan’s best sparring partner.
In the course of the few days’ confrontations, Lu Chuan’s combat experience skyrocketed, greatly enhancing his use of various fighting techniques and the flexibility of his body.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Suddenly, a massive roar came from the sky, and Lu Chuan quickly hid under a big tree, cautiously looking up.
A military green helicopter flew across the sky.
Lu Chuan saw sheets of paper scattering densely from above; the helicopter was dropping leaflets.
Initially thinking the army had been overrun, Lu Chuan was surprised to see a helicopter entering the city after all this time.
He picked up the information on one of the leaflets and realized that not just Jianghai City, but the entire world had fallen.
The military of Jianghai City had established a Survivor Base in a township outside the city.
The leaflet primarily urged survivors everywhere to voluntarily head to the Survivor Base.
Moreover, Lu Chuan noticed that the leaflet specifically mentioned human Evolvers, to inspire the remaining humans to hold out hope for life.
"It seems that after all this time, the military has regained its footing and has even established a Survivor Base,"
Lu Chuan observed the information on the leaflet briefly before tossing it aside.Follow current novels on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Obviously, as he was a zombie, the human survivor base had nothing to do with him, as meeting humans would probably result in them trying to shoot him right away.
In the seventh-floor bedroom, Ji Ruxue also heard the commotion from the plane, and quickly used her Telekinesis to obtain one of the leaflets.
Seeing the information on it, Ji Ruxue sneered coldly.
Ji Ruxue recalled that in her past life, she had hope in humanity in the early days of the apocalypse and joined a human survivor base.
But after entering, Ji Ruxue discovered that even in such large human survivor bases, darkness still prevailed.
With the progression of the apocalypse, the original public order and social conduct of equality had long since been overturned.
Evolvers became the elite, and the stronger one’s abilities, the better the treatment they received.
While ordinary survivors could only become the lowest level of workforce.
The upper echelon of the Survivor Base could drink red wine, eat steak, and live in the most cozy and comfortable environments, while ordinary survivors had to huddle in cold and damp communal dormitories, receiving only fixed, minimal supplies.
The crucial issue was that even amid the apocalypse, humans couldn’t unite to resist the zombies, always scheming and plotting against one another.
In her past life, before Ji Ruxue had grown strong, she was once plotted against by rogues and nearly perished in the Corpse Tide.
Glancing at the leaflet in her hand, Ji Ruxue sneered and tossed it away.
In her view, living among such scheming humans wasn’t as worthwhile as staying by her zombie dad’s side.
At least her zombie dad wouldn’t betray her.

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Could I Be an Evolver?
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Chapter 49: Could I Be an Evolver?
"What’s going on? Why did that plane fly away?!"
"We’ve been waiting for so long, finally seeing a plane, and it just left without stopping!"
"Damn it! We’ve held out for so long in the apocalypse, and the plane wasn’t even here to rescue us!"
When the buzzing in the sky was first heard, the survivors in the police station were extremely excited.
Everyone thought that after the apocalypse had lasted so long, they’d finally be rescued by the military, so they rushed outside immediately.
But as everyone waved their arms on the ground and waited for a long time, the plane just flew away without stopping at all; it wasn’t here for them.
If they hadn’t seen the plane, it might have been easier to accept; watching it come and go caused many of the survivors present to nearly break down, cursing aloud continuously.
Watching the departing helicopter, everyone felt incredibly disappointed and angry.The most update n0vels are published on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
A flash of helplessness appeared in Zhao Lin’s eyes, but everyone still picked up the flyers to take a look.
"Great! It’s a survivor base, we are saved!"
"I knew it! Humanity couldn’t have all perished, there’s still a powerful enough force to establish a survivor base!"
"The base is just outside the city where there are fewer zombies, maybe there are warm rooms and plenty of food there, let’s set off for the survivor base too!"
The survivors who were very disappointed just moments ago became excited after reading the information on the flyers, reigniting hope.
However, these ordinary people were unarmed and powerless, so they quickly turned their attention to Zhao Lin and the police force members.
"Officer Zhao, you are the police, it’s your duty to protect our safety, you must escort us to the survivor base!"
"Exactly, we don’t have any guns, you have to protect us."
The survivors spoke with a sense of entitlement, as if protecting their lives in the apocalypse truly was Zhao Lin’s and the others’ responsibility.
Hearing the survivors’ words, the other officers present immediately became displeased.
"Are you crazy? If you want to die, don’t drag us with you!"
"Idiots! Look at where that survivor base is, it’s so far from our precinct, we might already have been eaten by zombies before we arrive!"
"Exactly! You hide inside every day barely eking out an existence, while we risk our lives outside, of course you don’t find it dangerous."
Initially, there were many more officers than there are now, but due to their duty, a large number of officers went out for search and rescue as the apocalypse’s danger arrived.
They underestimated the zombies’ strength, resulting in a significant loss of manpower.
Even while collecting supplies over time, surviving officers unavoidably suffered casualties.
Yet now these survivors were shamelessly demanding the remaining officers escort them to the survivor base, infuriating the officers.
The two sides started arguing again.
Seeing the heated argument, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but feel a headache, quickly stepping forward to stop it.
"Alright, alright, everyone stop arguing for now, let’s calm down and discuss this properly."
"I understand everyone wants to leave the city and go to the survivor base. As police officers, we will definitely protect you; I promise to lead you to the base."
Once Zhao Lin had spoken, the previously angry survivors immediately cheered, surrounding Zhao Lin.
"Officer Zhao is a good person, this is what a real police officer should be like!"
However, the other officers looked very unpleasant, as the journey to the survivor base was very long and what might happen was uncertain.
They could easily get surrounded by a corpse tide or even encounter an evolved zombie.
"Zhao Lin! Now is not the time for stubbornness, don’t you realize how dangerous the outside is?!"
"How do you plan to escort them to the survivor base? We might not make it far before we’re eaten by zombies!"
Seeing her colleagues protesting, Zhao Lin hurriedly started to persuade them.
"I know it’s dangerous to go to the survivor base, but think about it, there are already evolved zombies now, those guys are very powerful!"
"Staying in the city is not a long-term solution with so many zombies around, it will only become more dangerous."
"Plus, our supplies are running low and need replenishment. The survivor base is outside the city, away from the huge corpse tide, giving us a much higher survival chance than staying in the city."
After hearing Zhao Lin’s persuasion, the officers one by one looked serious and fell silent.
Everyone barely managed to reach a compromise, then started making plans.
It’s a very long distance to the survivor base; it’s impossible to walk there.
"Firstly, we must find some vehicles for transportation, preferably with a high chassis and solid construction!"
The zombie apocalypse struck so suddenly that many vehicles were abandoned or exploded on the road.
Plus, the chance of encountering zombie attacks on the way was high, demanding a lot from any vehicles used.
"Ideally, we could get our hands on some large trucks, with high chasses and heavy bodies; they could drive right over zombies blocking the way."
Zhao Lin analyzed with a frown.
"And the abandoned vehicles on the road could be directly rammed aside; a large truck would fit all of us inside."
"We just need one heavy-duty truck!"
After hearing Zhao Lin’s plan, a middle-aged man among the survivors raised his hand.
"Officer Zhao! If you need a truck, I can help. Before the apocalypse, I drove long-distance transport trucks."
"But the apocalypse happened so quickly, my truck isn’t nearby, it’s parked at my house."
Zhao Lin was thrilled to hear this, not expecting to find a truck driver among the survivors.
Solving the truck problem could greatly increase everyone’s chances of survival.
Zhao Lin quickly asked, "Where’s your house? Let’s bring the truck back as soon as possible."
"Not far from the police station, my house is in the Sunshine District."
...
Meanwhile, in a basement somewhere.
There were nearly twenty survivors living here, both men and women.
The basement was very dark, piled with a lot of feces and urine, filled with a foul smell.
Various supplies were thrown around haphazardly, and the surrounding environment was extremely messy and dirty, with ventilation issues causing an utterly nauseating smell inside.
"Gang! Gang! There’s good news!"
"Why are you shouting? Do you want to attract zombies, believe me I’ll slap you to death!"
The man called Gang was sleeping, embracing a woman, and he was very displeased to be awakened by his underling.
"Gang, look, this is a flyer from the helicopter, they’ve established a survivor base!"
"Zhang, the brothers really can’t stay here anymore; your strength is great, take us to the survivor base!"
However, faced with the underlings’ request, the man just lazily waved his hand.
"Get lost! Why go anywhere?!"
"Outside are zombies everywhere; if you’re not afraid to die, go yourself!"
Before the apocalypse, Gangzi was just at the bottom of society, with no status and ignored by everyone.
Now, after the apocalypse, by relying on his strength, he became the leader in the survivor team.
Every day he indulges with women, gets the priority on food, and has people around him praising him.
In his eyes, this was a godly life.
But when he flipped to the back of the flyer, which mentioned information about evolvers among humans, Gangzi’s eyes lit up.
"My divine power surged suddenly a while ago."
"Could it be... I am the legendary Evolver?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Whatever Your Intentions, I’ll Just Kill You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Chapter 50: Whatever Your Intentions, I’ll Just Kill You!
"Dad went out to do something again? Why has he been so often away from home lately?"
Ji Ruxue opened her eyes from cultivation and realized that her zombie father was not in the room again.
Ji Ruxue had gotten used to the time spent with her zombie father, but recently he was often not at home, leaving her a bit puzzled.
Especially after confirming that her zombie father was an Evolved Zombie, she became even more curious about what he did every day when he went out.
Left alone in the room, Ji Ruxue felt rather bored and restless.
While sitting on the sofa, Ji Ruxue suddenly thought of something. She then ran to a drawer and pulled out a large black telescope.
This was left by the original owner of the room.
When Ji Ruxue found the house contract before, she also discovered this.
Holding this huge telescope, Ji Ruxue excitedly pushed a small stool to the balcony, then used her hands and feet to climb onto the stool.
The black telescope was very large, and Ji Ruxue’s current body was just that of a small baby.
The black telescope was almost as wide as her head, so Ji Ruxue couldn’t view normally and had to use one eye to look.
The little one kept peering through the telescope at the outside, looking very comical and cute.
In the telescope’s view, the outside city was a scene of utter ruin.
Not far away, there were still raging fires burning.
After all, the zombie crisis erupted too suddenly; many people were still working or driving their cars when they suddenly transformed into zombies, resulting in numerous explosions in the city.
There simply weren’t enough firefighters, so many of the fires were quenched by the heavy rains that followed.
Yet even so, the explosions caused by the zombies continued, with large fires flaring up intermittently.
Thick black smoke gathered over the city, making Jianghai City appear extremely dilapidated.
On the streets, horrifying and terrifying zombies roamed aimlessly.
Ji Ruxue scanned persistently with the telescope but couldn’t find any sign of human survivors.
"It’s all zombies everywhere, no sign of any human survivors..."
Seeing the devastation before her, Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly; it was indeed exactly the same as the world she lived in her past life, without any change.
Indeed, in the early stages of the zombie apocalypse, the city was filled only with endless death...
"Eh? Why did that big guy go to the entrance of the district?"
Ji Ruxue noticed that the Tank Type Evolved Zombie in the telescope, which she usually saw downstairs, had moved to the entrance of the Sunshine District.
Its massive iron hammers stood by its side, almost like a Gate God.
That’s good, although she’s not sure why the big guy suddenly went over there, at least without it blocking the entrance, her zombie dad can come and go more easily.
Ji Ruxue had accepted that Lu Chuan had awakened the Earth Escape ability, so she always believed that with such a Tank Type Evolved Zombie around, Lu Chuan had to solve going in and out through Earth Escape.
Ji Ruxue continued using the telescope to search for Lu Chuan’s figure, but perhaps due to the angle, she couldn’t overlook the entire district, so she didn’t spot his figure.
Unable to find her zombie dad, a trace of boredom and disappointment flashed in Ji Ruxue’s eyes.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Surrounded by ruins and zombies, there was nothing new to see.
Ji Ruxue put the telescope back, feeling a bit disappointed, and returned to the sofa to continue her cultivation.
In her current situation, besides cultivation, there was nothing else she could do every day.
Little did Ji Ruxue know that in a corner she couldn’t see, Lu Chuan was in the midst of a high-level duel with ’Lightning.’
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The sound of blades clashing was exceptionally sharp, as Lu Chuan’s machete clashed nonstop with ’Lightning’s’ steel blade.
Sparks erupted in all directions, and their mighty blade auras sliced through the air, generating a whistling sound that made one’s scalp tingle.
’Lightning’s’ movements, as always, were unbelievably swift, the shimmer of the blades wielded flickering unceasingly.
However, due to continuous battles with it recently, Lu Chuan’s fighting skills had improved dramatically.
After daily high-intensity training, Lu Chuan progressed from initially only being hit passively to barely parrying later on.
Now, with significant improvement in combat skills, Lu Chuan could battle ’Lightning’ on equal terms.
Although he was inferior in speed compared to ’Lightning,’ excellent combat skills made up for this aspect.
Purely from the standpoint of combat skills, Lu Chuan had already surpassed the opponent.
As for power and speed, they couldn’t be enhanced solely through training; only by relying on the Crystal Core could he evolve.
However, given equal physical conditions, Lu Chuan was confident that he could defeat the opponent in a few turns.
Looking at the machete in his hand, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction.
Indeed, the hard training during this period had not been in vain, as this high-pressure combat training rapidly enhanced his strength.
"Today’s practical training could just about end; Little Qiqi has probably woken up, and it’s time to go back and make her a meal."
Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction, then prepared to return home for a bath.
Just as he was about to leave, a thought struck him, prompting him to switch his perspective to ’Da Pang.’
...
At the entrance of Sunshine District, a few sneaky silhouettes suddenly appeared.
These four silhouettes were Zhao Lin, two police officers, and that middle-aged man who drove the large truck.
They sneaked to the vicinity of Sunshine Home, evading zombies as they went, intending to drive the truck and escape from here.
However, when they saw ’Da Pang’, a massive figure standing at the community gate, Zhao Lin and the others were all startled.
The other officers and the truck driver immediately wanted to retreat. Having encountered Evolved Zombies before, they knew its combat power was incomparable to regular zombies.
Nonetheless, Zhao Lin insisted on continuing the action.
"Don’t be afraid, everyone. The truck is just inside; it’s our hope of leaving the city."
"We’ve encountered these big guys before while scavenging for supplies. I’ll draw him away."
Tank Type Zombies, although extremely strong, had a flaw—their size was simply too large.
Zhao Lin, with her slender figure, could easily run into narrow passages to evade.
Silently, Zhao Lin appeared near ’Da Pang,’ picked up a stone from the roadside, and threw it directly at ’Da Pang,’ aiming to lure the zombie away.
"Hmm? Is it that policewoman?"
Lu Chuan, after switching perspectives, recognized Zhao Lin in front of him, but he couldn’t understand why Zhao Lin, instead of looking for supplies near the police station, came all the way to Sunshine Home.
Zhao Lin was also bewildered.
Normally, the Evolved Zombie should be charging at her now, but ’Da Pang’ stood motionless.
After throwing several more stones without a response from it, Zhao Lin decided to pull out her gun.
When Lu Chuan saw this, he was instantly furious.
Although he didn’t know her purpose, if she dared to aim a gun at his Corpse Puppet, there was only one outcome—death!

chapters.title: Chapter 51: This Brute Is So Fierce, Dad Must Have Been Terrified!
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Chapter 51: This Brute Is So Fierce, Dad Must Have Been Terrified!
Bang!
A gunshot suddenly rang out on the silent street.
Seeing that ’Da Pang’ was not moving at all, Zhao Lin fired a shot directly at his head.
Because evolved zombies have a significant intimidation factor over ordinary zombies, ’Da Pang’ standing at the entrance of the community prevented the wandering zombies on the street from approaching this area.
Seeing no zombies around, Zhao Lin dared to shoot.
Otherwise, even if she managed to escape the chase of the tank-type evolved zombie, she would be torn to pieces by ordinary zombies attracted by the gunshot.
However, Lu Chuan was already prepared when he saw Zhao Lin draw her gun, directly manipulating the two giant hammers to block his head.
For tank-type zombies, as long as their head is not injured, other issues are not significant.
Zhao Lin was stunned in place at this moment; she never expected that the tank-type evolved zombie would be able to use a hammer to block, and her bullets were intercepted by the opponent’s giant hammer.
During this time, Zhao Lin had fought with many zombies while searching for supplies, but it was the first time she had seen such a strange zombie.
Hmm?! A gunshot?!
The sudden gunshot startled Ji Ruxue, who was in the middle of cultivation.
She quickly stopped cultivating, her short legs moving frantically, ran to the balcony, and took out a telescope to look towards the entrance of the community.
She saw Zhao Lin holding a gun confronting ’Da Pang.’ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"What’s going on? How come there’s a cop here?!"
"And this cop is so brave?! How dare she shoot at an evolved zombie all by herself, and it’s even a tank-type zombie with a substantial build?!"
Ji Ruxue was incredibly surprised as she observed the scene at the entrance of the community through the telescope.
It’s known that tank-type zombies have extremely strong defense and immense strength.
Because of their substantial build, a regular handgun shot on them hardly affects their combat power, unless it directly explodes the head.
In the early apocalypse, the biggest threat to human survivors comes from these tank-type zombies and agile-type zombies.
These zombies are abundant and challenging, causing much suffering for many survivors.
"Hmm? Why does this cop seem familiar to me?"
Ji Ruxue adjusted the telescope’s distance, and after enlarging the view, she felt that Zhao Lin’s face looked somewhat familiar, but she couldn’t recall from where...
This was because Zhao Lin hadn’t begun to evolve and strengthen yet, with no change in physical appearance compared to before.
So she looked quite different from the Nine Deaths Demon Police Ji Ruxue met in the apocalypse’s later days.
Thus, Ji Ruxue couldn’t recall it at the moment.
Mainly, in her past life, when Ji Ruxue met the Nine Deaths Demon Police, the opponent had continuously evolved and reached Emperor.
Ji Ruxue found it hard to associate that Emperor-level powerhouse with this clueless little cop in front of her.
After the gunshot, a potent killing intent flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
This time he was genuinely angry.
He had coincidentally saved the opponent’s life once before, unexpectedly, this cop with mental issues dared to provoke him and even attempt to shoot his Corpse Puppet dead.
"No matter who you are, if you dare attack me, it’s a dead end."
Lu Chuan manipulated ’Da Pang,’ holding twin hammers, and chased after Zhao Lin.
Zhao Lin, unhurried, smiled as her plan succeeded.
She turned to run, intending to lure ’Da Pang’ to a secluded spot.
But at that moment, Zhao Lin suddenly heard the sound of something breaking through the air behind her.
She instinctively looked back, and was immediately shocked by what she saw.
A giant iron hammer was flying through the air!
"Oh damn! This zombie is not playing by the rules?!"
Before dying, Zhao Lin just felt darkness enveloping her vision, and blood gushed from her mouth.
Only this thought remained in her mind.
Zhao Lin could not understand why the zombies she encountered today were completely different from before...
The giant hammer thrown with full force by ’Da Pang’ was as heavy as a thousand pounds, and Zhao Lin’s frail body was unable to withstand it, directly being smashed to death.
Lu Chuan manipulated ’Da Pang’ to walk over to Zhao Lin’s corpse, picked up the hammer, and took away the handgun from Zhao Lin’s body.
Looking at the blood-stained giant hammer in his hand and the blood-stained corpse at his feet, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
Accuracy’s not bad, but further practice is needed.
’Da Pang,’ as a tank-type zombie, has immense strength, but his speed is much slower compared to the agile-type zombies.
However, having twin hammers in hand changes everything. When wielded, they roared like a storm, and now they can be used as long-range weapons, suitable for offense or distant fighting, which pleases Lu Chuan.
As for the cop he smashed to death, Lu Chuan was indifferent.
Anyone who dares to shoot at him would be killed without hesitation, regardless of who they are.
Even if a saint came, Lu Chuan would still smash her brains with a hammer.
The two cops hiding and observing from the shadows, along with the truck driver, were terrified and panicked when they saw Zhao Lin being smashed dead.
The three dared not even gather Zhao Lin’s corpse, turning to flee.
They wished they had more legs, scared of being chased by the evolved zombies behind.
Thinking about the giant hammer that flew through the air just now, their legs weakened.
Ji Ruxue on the seventh floor, holding the telescope, watched everything happening below.
"Wow, this big guy is unbelievably ferocious, actually smashing that cop dead with one hit."
"While part of the reason is the cop’s mental issues, this zombie is still overly cruel..."
Seeing the tank-type zombie’s brutality, even Ji Ruxue exclaimed.
Yet at the same time, she felt deeply puzzled. This tank-type zombie may be tremendously powerful and large.
But judging by appearance, it should still be within the range of a first-level zombie, without advancing to second-level.
Though such zombies have successfully evolved, they still largely act on their bloodthirsty instinct, with clumsy battle techniques and methods.
In Ji Ruxue’s past life memory, zombies typically only regain intelligence when they evolve to later stages.
Only when they break through at that point do zombie powerhouses learn the proper use of weapons for battle.
For low-level zombies like the big guy in front of her, they’re far from achieving this, usually attacking by swinging fists, arms, etc.
If first-level zombies learned to use weapons for attack this early, it would spell certain doom for human survivors!
"Such ferocity during battle was unexpected, Dad must have been really shocked, passing by him every day!"
PS: There’ll be more during the day, my treasures!

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Damn! The Lady Cop Came Back to Life?
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Chapter 52: Damn! The Lady Cop Came Back to Life?
This big brute absolutely cannot stay for long!
Such fierce killing, it must be swiftly put to death!
This guy guards the entrance of the community every day, posing a significant threat to my zombie father!
Thinking of my zombie father, having to face such a powerful tank-type zombie daily, even entering and leaving the community must be nerve-wracking.
Ji Ruxue made a decision in her heart.
This big brute, even at the first stage, was able to fight with weapons, who knows what it’ll evolve into in the future.
Tank-type zombies are inherently body-strengthened types, and now they have learned to use weapons, making them incredibly formidable, so it absolutely cannot be allowed to grow.
Ji Ruxue believes that if she can secretly kill this powerful zombie, her zombie father would definitely be very pleased.
Moreover, the Crystal Core of this evolved zombie can be absorbed by her zombie father, which would significantly enhance his strength.
However, Ji Ruxue also understands that she absolutely cannot reveal her powers too early.
After all, she is still just an infant under one year old, while her peers are busy trying to crawl on the ground.
If she can kill even evolved zombies, that would be quite shocking.
Ji Ruxue can’t imagine, if her current self shows too much, how her father will perceive her.
Thinking it over, she decided to keep her true abilities hidden.
As for this powerful evolved zombie, she will wait for her father to be out, and then secretly find a way to kill it.
Though she’s still just an infant, she has already broken through to the second stage through the Glazed Breathing Technique.
By relying on her awakened powers of Telekinesis Control and Time Control, Ji Ruxue is very confident about killing this evolved zombie.
But it must be said, this big brute doesn’t seem like any ordinary low-tier zombie.
The action of throwing a hammer to kill the female police officer just now was somewhat astonishing.
The mighty hammers he swung were fierce, and when thrown from a distance, they were incredibly accurate.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The human policewoman just now was smashed until she bled from all orifices, her bones shattered, bleeding from the mouth like a fountain, the scene was quite gory.
Ji Ruxue really doesn’t want to see her zombie father suffer such a blow from this guy someday...
Although her zombie father is also an evolved zombie, and his body is more robust than typical zombies.
But Ji Ruxue is certain, with such a powerful strike, her father’s slightly frailer body absolutely cannot withstand it.
...
"I never expected to become a zombie and actually find a real gun."
"I’ll keep this gun for now, it might come in handy later."
Lu Chuan controlled Lightning in front of Building Five to pick up the handgun Zhao Lin had dropped.
Playing with the police handgun in his hand, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction.
After doomsday, although various evolved zombies and mutated giant beasts appeared.
Guns like these still hold significant power; ordinary zombies will surely die with a shot to the head.
Even Da Pang, if shot in the head, might not survive.
After all, a zombie’s weakness is where the Crystal Core is located, in the brain.
As for the female police officer he smashed to death, Lu Chuan felt nothing.
Although it was his first time killing in two lives, Lu Chuan felt as though he was used to it.
Arriving inexplicably in this world, experiencing the zombie crisis inexplicably.
With so much time passing, Lu Chuan had long grown indifferent to human life.
In this apocalyptic world, life is as insignificant as grass, constantly facing death.
The streets are filled with wandering corpses, one more police officer makes no difference.
Moreover, in this apocalyptic world, he had seen too many cases of human depravity.
To Lu Chuan, staying alive is the primary goal.
It’s the end times; you’d be a fool if you hesitated when others aimed to harm you.
Although he still retains human consciousness, Lu Chuan wouldn’t impose past life moral standards on himself.
As a zombie, restraining his bloodthirsty impulses, avoiding hunting down survivors, is already commendable.
Lu Chuan doesn’t feel obliged to care much for the surviving humans.
To date, Lu Chuan’s attitude towards these human survivors is:
He won’t provoke them.
But if they provoke him, he shows no mercy.
They must be killed without exception.
He still has Little Qiqi to take care of, and nothing can happen.
Otherwise, leaving Little Qiqi as an infant in this doomsday world, how would the little one survive?
Subsequently, Lu Chuan hurriedly washed and went upstairs, fearing his precious daughter might be starving by now.
However, he hoped that the sudden gunshot didn’t frighten the little one.
...
Deep night.
The moonlight descended.
Zhao Lin’s body still lay at the entrance of the community, unattended.
Because Da Pang was still stationed at the gate by Lu Chuan to guard the entire community, the pressure of an evolved zombie kept ordinary zombies at bay.
Although Zhao Lin was fresh flesh, Lu Chuan retained his human consciousness.
He could kill humans mercilessly but didn’t want his Corpse Puppet to devour former comrades.
Besides, evolved zombies no longer need to consume the powerless flesh of low-tier zombies to evolve.
What no one noticed was that under the moonlight, Zhao Lin’s long-dead body emitted traces of a blood-red glow.
This light, though not apparent in the night, was enough to catch attention.
Crack! Crack!
Under this light, Zhao Lin’s bones made sounds, and her broken bones began to realign.
The fractured bones healed under this glow, and her previously shattered body was mysteriously restored.
Her long-dead chest and abdomen began to rise and fall, and then, with blood oozing from her seven orifices, Zhao Lin suddenly opened her eyes.
Her blood had turned dark brown, yet this supposed-to-be-deceased body eerily stood up from the ground!
Under the blood-red glow, the bloodied female officer stood motionless.
Lu Chuan, in the seventh-floor bedroom, seemed to sense something and switched to Da Pang’s perspective.
When he saw the eerie scene outside the community gate, he was stunned.
What the hell! A ghost! The policewoman came back to life?!

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Strange, Why Isn’t the Big Guy Attacking Dad?
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Chapter 53: Strange, Why Isn’t the Big Guy Attacking Dad?
"I... I’m still alive?"
"Could this be hell?"
At this moment, Zhao Lin felt dizzy and unsteady as she got up from the ground and looked around in confusion.
Before Da Pang smashed her to death with a hammer, she had been beaten to the point of bleeding from her seven orifices.
Therefore, everything she saw was covered in dried blood, and as she looked around now, it was nothing but a bloody haze in her vision.
Feeling discomfort in her eyes, Zhao Lin instinctively wiped them and finally regained clarity.
She saw the familiar street around her, the familiar district, and even the giant zombie not far away seemed so familiar.
This wasn’t the Underworld; wasn’t this the Sunshine District she saw right before she died?!
Zhao Lin’s pupils constricted as she realized she seemed to still be alive.
"No, wait! How am I still alive?!"
Zhao Lin was completely stunned.
She hurriedly checked her body, touching and looking all over, finding herself covered in bloodstains but unable to find a single wound, not even a broken bone.
"No, it’s impossible. Wasn’t I smashed to death by that zombie’s hammer? How...?"
This inexplicable turn of events left Zhao Lin utterly bewildered; she clearly remembered a massive hammer striking her abdomen before she died.
The excruciating pain caused her to cough up blood, and then she lost consciousness.
Zhao Lin remembered that before dying, she seemed to hear the sound of her bones breaking, but now, there was nothing wrong.
If it weren’t for the blood covering her, Zhao Lin might have doubted everything before as a mere illusion.
Looking at the towering, demon-like Tank Zombie not far away, Zhao Lin shivered.
Recalling the scenes from earlier in the day, she dared not linger here further and hurriedly fled towards the police station.
Lu Chuan, through Da Pang’s perspective, watched as this person, who had been hit by his flying heavy hammer and was obviously dead with fractured bones, bleeding from the seven orifices—undeniably dead—suddenly stood up eerily in the dark.Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Most crucially, she patted herself off as if nothing had happened and turned to run at an incredible speed.
At this moment, Lu Chuan was utterly bewildered by the situation.
Could this woman be like an unkillable cockroach?
Even something like this couldn’t kill her?!
Lu Chuan was certain that this woman was not a zombie.
Because when he saw the body stand up, Lu Chuan immediately went downstairs and arrived at the district entrance.
He immediately began using his Telekinesis to try and control it.
But this woman was entirely different from a zombie; ordinary zombies were like thoughtless empty vessels.
In Lu Chuan’s Telekinesis perspective, all the zombies on the street were mindless puppets, easily controlled by his Telekinesis.
Yet when Lu Chuan tried to use Telekinesis on this woman, he discovered that her body contained a power only humans possess: willpower.
This meant that the policewoman in front of him hadn’t turned into a zombie and still retained human consciousness.
This bizarre phenomenon reminded Lu Chuan of the strong man he had encountered in the shop earlier.
That man looked no different from an ordinary person, maybe just slightly more muscular.
Yet he possessed incredibly strong Divine Power, even managing to knock away the axe of Lu Chuan’s controlled Corpse Puppet, an unimaginable strength for an ordinary person.
The military’s flyers mentioned that Evolvers have appeared among human survivors.
Connecting all these pieces, although Lu Chuan didn’t know what had happened to this mysterious policewoman, he could vaguely guess.
Perhaps after the Blood Moon, the woman had also mutated, and her resurrection was due to being an Evolver.
If not, it would be far too eerie for Zhao Lin, who had fractured bones and muscles torn, to be resurrected.
...
"What on earth happened? Why am I still alive?!"
Zhao Lin ran a great distance and stopped in a secluded corner.
The cool breeze during her sprint cleared her head a little, and now far away from the threat of the Evolved Zombie, Zhao Lin finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Looking at her bloodstained clothes, Zhao Lin frowned.
"The events during the day really happened; I definitely was smashed to death by that Evolved Zombie, and the bloodstains on me can’t be fake."
Zhao Lin just couldn’t understand why, when her bones were clearly shattered, she was now perfectly fine.
She pinched her ribs and arms but felt no pain whatsoever.
There were not even bruises on her, an unreal level of recovery!
"No, there’s something different about me now!"
Zhao Lin glanced behind her, realizing she had run quite a distance in her panic.
Yet she still felt full of energy, much stronger than she was before.
Zhao Lin clenched her fists, feeling strength coursing throughout her body.
After a round of testing, I found that my physical fitness has greatly improved compared to before, with significant enhancements in strength and speed!
Feeling as if reborn, Zhao Lin’s beautiful eyes widened in surprise, filled with astonishment.
Recalling the information she saw on a flyer earlier, Zhao Lin suddenly felt her scalp tingle.
"Could it be... am I also an Evolver?!"
Besides this reason, Zhao Lin really couldn’t understand why not only was she still alive, but her physical condition had undergone such terrifying changes!
...
"Daddy, check."
The next day, in the bedroom on the seventh floor, Ji Ruxue handed her math homework to Lu Chuan for review. The little girl’s manner was adorably charming.
Lu Chuan hadn’t paid much attention initially, but after taking a glance, he was stunned.
What’s going on? Little Qiqi can even do math now?!
Little Qiqi is not even one year old yet, but has already accomplished what other children can do only at a few years old!
Lu Chuan widened his eyes, his whole body a bit stiff as he stared at Little Qiqi’s math work in a daze.
Seeing such a big reaction from Lu Chuan, Ji Ruxue also felt a little flustered.
"Oh no, did I go too far?"
Ji Ruxue really didn’t want to keep pretending to be clueless; acting like a baby who doesn’t understand anything was truly difficult.
She wanted to slowly reveal her extraordinary attributes, hoping to gradually let her zombie father get used to her remarkable progress.
For example, by creating the persona of a genius baby, even if she did things far beyond her age, her zombie father wouldn’t be too shocked.
After the shock, Lu Chuan was extremely delighted.
"Hahaha, Little Qiqi is truly amazing, worthy of being a rare prodigy!"
Lu Chuan didn’t feel anything was wrong; instead, he was incredibly excited.
Perhaps seeing that female police officer die and come back to life before, witnessing her climb up from a corpse, had a huge impact on Lu Chuan.
Lu Chuan was already quite unfamiliar with this world, and with the appearance of Evolvers among humans after the Blood Moon changes,
now even such outrageous things like resurrection can happen, so what if our Little Qiqi is just a bit smarter?!
What’s wrong with being able to do arithmetic before turning one?
This is called a prodigy!
Very reasonable!
In such a strange large environment, Lu Chuan felt that unless the little one personally crafted a nuclear bomb, he wouldn’t find anything wrong.
Hehehe!
My daughter possesses the makings of an emperor!
Seeing the little one’s extraordinary intelligence, Lu Chuan was also very pleased.
Being smart enough, at least it could allow the little one to survive longer in the brutal apocalypse of the future.
Lu Chuan looked at Little Qiqi, who was staring up at him with wide eyes like a porcelain doll, feeling all his negative emotions in the apocalypse alleviated.
The little one was so adorable that Lu Chuan instinctively pinched her little cheek.
And this action made Ji Ruxue breath a sigh of relief; in Ji Ruxue’s understanding, the zombie father pinching her cheek meant he was really happy inside.
Seeing the zombie father so happy, Ji Ruxue knew her current situation hadn’t been exposed yet.
Without her father thinking too much, she felt more at ease, seeing that she could continue doing unconventional things to let the zombie father gradually adapt to her.
After all, pretending to be clueless all the time was really tough...
Moreover, after the Blood Moon, almost all living beings are constantly evolving.
Ji Ruxue didn’t want to always face the ever-harsh doomsday in the form of a baby.
With a thought, Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet outside spotted the trail of an Evolved Zombie once more.
Lu Chuan immediately placed the little one on the bed, then hurriedly went downstairs.
After Lu Chuan left, Ji Ruxue quickly moved her little legs to the balcony, picking up the massive black telescope to look at the gate of the district again.
She wanted to see if the body of the female officer killed by the Tank Zombie yesterday was still in place.
Seeing the female officer who was crushed by the Tank Type Zombie yesterday, Ji Ruxue felt she had met her somewhere but couldn’t recall where at the moment.
However, a more peculiar scene within the community attracted Ji Ruxue’s attention.
A group of well-built zombies gathered from various corners of the community.
Each of these zombies wore fully enclosed motorcycle helmets, wielding sharp fire axes.
However, a figure in the zombie crowd caught Ji Ruxue’s attention, from familiar clothing it was clearly the zombie father who had just gone downstairs!
This group of zombies moved towards the outside gate of the community, then followed the muscle-bound zombie guarding at the door, leaving Sunshine District together.
Ji Ruxue was stunned: "Strange, at such close range, why didn’t that big guy attack daddy?"

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Could There Be a Corpse King in Sunshine District?
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Chapter 54: Could There Be a Corpse King in Sunshine District?
In Ji Ruxue’s memory, once evolved zombies get close to each other, they would attack each other to seize the other’s crystal core.
Low-level evolved zombies also lack their own consciousness, and their only distinction from ordinary zombies is their enhanced power and potential for evolution.
Low-level evolved zombies still act based on their most primal desires.
Ordinary zombies follow their bloodthirsty desires, capturing survivors everywhere to devour fresh flesh.
However, evolved zombies do not devour flesh everywhere like ordinary zombies because they crave more concentrated energy, such as the crystal core in the brains of evolved zombies and mutated fierce beasts.
If two evolved zombies encounter each other, it is sure to be a life-and-death situation, until one side successfully kills and devours the other.
But the situation observed through the telescope just now was very bizarre; how could Dad, an evolved zombie, coexist peacefully with this hulking tank zombie?
Could it be that my assumption was wrong?
Is Dad actually just an ordinary zombie, not an evolved zombie?
In Ji Ruxue’s view, if they are not attacking each other, it must be evolved zombies and ordinary zombies being together.
Because ordinary zombies cannot produce crystal cores, they have no valuable resource for evolved zombies, so they won’t waste effort.
But Ji Ruxue was puzzled; if Dad isn’t an evolved zombie, how was he able to transport so many supplies right under this hulking zombie’s nose?
The rooms on several floors downstairs were filled with an immense amount of supplies, gathering so many materials wouldn’t have been easy and would require quite a bit of time.
Moreover, previously this hulking figure had been blocking the entrance. Even if her father wasn’t an evolved zombie and didn’t trigger its devouring desire, its imposing presence would deter ordinary zombies from approaching.
Additionally, evolved zombies may lack consciousness, but their instincts never easily allow an ordinary zombie to run rampant in their territory.
Ji Ruxue originally thought that her hidden identity was deep enough, but now she suddenly discovers that her zombie father also appears to be very mysterious.
No, I need to find an opportunity to carefully test this out.
To see if Dad is really an evolved zombie, and what kind of talent ability he has awakened.
...
Lu Chuan was not aware that the little girl had already noticed various clues on him through the telescope.
He led his corpse puppet squad, making a grand march toward a shopping center in the southern part of the district.
Lu Chuan has been using corpse puppets to search for the whereabouts of evolved zombies during this period.
Evolved zombies and low-level corpse puppets are entirely different strategic levels!
Controlling an evolved zombie can easily destroy a whole corpse puppet squad!
Furthermore, he must rely on evolved zombie crystal cores to continue his breakthrough.
Although he battles with Lightning daily, this only improves his combat skills.
Gaining true enhancement and strengthening telekinesis cannot be achieved merely through these measures.
And just now, one of Lu Chuan’s corpse puppets, while wandering this pedestrian street, discovered the traces of an agile zombie.
So Lu Chuan set off immediately, bringing his army of corpse puppets to this area.
Though the apocalypse caused zombies to roam the streets, most are still just low-level zombies.
Even after the Blood Moon Mutation, evolved zombies only account for a small portion, and the ones Lu Chuan encountered in several days are very few indeed.
After arriving at this commercial street, Lu Chuan quickly spotted that evolved zombie.
However, this time Lu Chuan brought Da Pang with him, and as soon as he approached, the agile zombie discovered him.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
With Lu Chuan’s control, Da Pang remained motionless.
But the agile zombie, brandishing claws like curved blades, charged towards Lu Chuan.
Lu Chuan hurriedly controlled his army of corpse puppets to intercept.
The agile zombie had strong combat capabilities, and these low-level corpse puppets were no match for it.
However, Lu Chuan equipped each corpse puppet with helmets, ensuring they wouldn’t lose combat effectiveness unless beheaded.
Soon, the agile zombie that had been radiating powerful energy suddenly stood still.
Seeing this, Lu Chuan was overjoyed; his spiritual power had recovered a lot recently.
The mental power previously consumed to control evolved zombies had all been restored, allowing him to quickly draw this evolved zombie under his wing.
Looking at the evolved zombie in front of him, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction, as this was the third evolved zombie he controlled.
"Since it’s the second agile zombie, you’ll be named Lightning Two!"
Thinking that he now had three evolved corpse puppets under his command, Lu Chuan felt incredibly excited.
If this pace continues, his corpse puppet army will continue to expand.
Initially, Lu Chuan didn’t feel that his talent was exceptional.
But now, as his power continues to grow, Lu Chuan increasingly realizes his unique talent is terrifyingly powerful!
If his telekinesis continues increasing, Lu Chuan can control more corpse puppets.
With stronger corpse puppets, he can acquire more crystal cores.
This cycle of using crystal cores to enhance telekinesis, then telekinesis to control corpse puppets, represents an ideal evolution method!
Lu Chuan was immensely excited as he seemed to see the majestic scene of commanding countless evolved corpse puppets in the future.
"Dad has been out for so long this time, why hasn’t he come back, could something have happened outside?!"
Ji Ruxue, in order to figure out what is going on with her zombie father, had been lying on the balcony waiting for Lu Chuan to return.
But her body was still just a baby less than a week old.
Her height was insufficient, so she had to stand on tiptoe with her small feet on a stool to rest on the balcony.
However, standing for a long time caused Ji Ruxue’s legs to feel numb.
She kept stomping her feet, letting blood circulate in her legs to prevent losing feeling.
Soon, Ji Ruxue made a new discovery.
She saw the departing horde of zombies return, and in addition to the original zombies beside Dad, there was another agile zombie!
"What’s going on? How did another evolved zombie appear?!"
This scene had a tremendous impact on Ji Ruxue.
She furrowed her brows, recalling memories of her past life, and Ji Ruxue finally thought of only one possibility.
Being able to gather several brainless evolved zombies, controlling their mutual devouring desires, and peacefully coexisting, there’s only one situation possible.
That is the presence of a Corpse King within the Sunshine District!

chapters.title: Chapter 55: I Must Help Dad Break Free from the Corpse King’s Control! (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Chapter 55: I Must Help Dad Break Free from the Corpse King’s Control! (Part 2)
Ji Ruxue stood on the balcony on the seventh floor, and her whole being felt a bit numb.
In her past life memories, there are many types of evolved zombies, among which there is an extremely rare existence.
Survivors also refer to this type of zombie as king zombies.
From the outside, king zombies seem no different from ordinary zombies, blending into the horde without any noticeable differences.
Although these king zombies are evolved zombies, they don’t possess the extremely strong physique or super defense of tank-type zombies.
Nor do they have the terrifying speed or intense aggression of agile-type zombies.
Their appearance doesn’t drastically change with evolution, nor do they awaken peculiar special abilities like other elemental zombies.
In fact, in terms of combat power, king zombies aren’t always stronger than other evolved zombies.
King zombies possess only one talent, but this talent power is terrifyingly potent in the apocalypse, striking fear into countless people: they can command other zombies!
These king zombies, capable of leading their kind, are also known by survivors as Corpse Kings.
Because in this apocalyptic world, they truly are like supreme rulers, leading zombie armies rampaging and leaving desolation in their wake!
For other evolved zombies, humans have methods to deal with them; but when it comes to Corpse Kings, everyone dreads facing them.
Ji Ruxue had encountered a Corpse King in her past life.
At that time, Ji Ruxue joined a very powerful survivor base, surrounded by sturdy defenses and with strong military reserves and numerous evolution teams.
Such a survivor base, if continuously developed, would inevitably give rise to many human elites in the future.
However, what terrified Ji Ruxue and all the survivors within the camp was, in a silent and dark night,
A bizarre tremor suddenly resonated on the originally calm street, followed by a torrential downpour.
Lightning streaked through the night sky, and the sentries on the city walls discovered a massive corpse tide outside the base.
Numerous zombies frantically charged toward the base, and crucially the traps designed to target zombies around the base were eerily bypassed by these zombies.
This corpse tide seemed to be controlled by someone, able to acutely attack the weak points of the base.
Initially, the base didn’t take the corpse tide seriously, but soon paid the price for their negligence.
Lax defenses allowed a large number of zombies to flood the base front.
Moreover, hidden among the vast corpse tide were many powerful evolved zombies.Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFirenᴇt
When the corpse tide reached the city walls of the base, these evolved zombies finally revealed their claws.
By then, the human survivors were too late to defend and thus Ji Ruxue’s survivor base was brutally destroyed by this terrifying corpse tide.
The reason this corpse tide could bypass human traps and focus attacks during human defense was due to the command of a Corpse King!
Though Corpse Kings lack combat ability themselves, they possess formidable intelligence not inferior to humans.
The key is they can transform these brainless, bloodthirsty zombies into a powerful army, even controlling evolved zombies!
Realizing this, Ji Ruxue felt momentarily incredulous.
To know that king zombies are extremely rare, even among a hundred thousand zombies, it’s hard to find one.
Could it be that she and zombie dad are just so unlucky, encountering a Corpse King in the Sunshine District?
Recalling how these zombies got along peacefully with each other just now, and appeared disciplined.
Gathered twenty or so zombies together, not at all showing signs of bloodlust, but rather like a team on a mission!
Such a bizarre scene, unless orchestrated by a Corpse King in the background, otherwise it’s unlikely to appear this way.
Ordinary zombies would dread the oppressive presence of evolved zombies, avoiding them, while evolved zombies would fight viciously over each other’s crystal cores.
How could it possibly be a peaceful coexistence as she witnessed?
"Could it be that dad and other evolved zombies are under the command of the Corpse King within this district?!"
Or maybe, dad is the Corpse King?
This thought was instantly dismissed by Ji Ruxue as soon as it occurred to her.
Because in Ji Ruxue’s memory, Corpse Kings lack strong combat power, but have exceptionally high intelligence.
Hence, such zombies hide their identity to live more safely, naturally staying out of sight.
Corpse Kings typically hide away somewhere, commanding other zombies to act for them, even during corpse tides, they remain concealed.
But today her zombie dad actually went along with the zombie horde, which is a taboo for Corpse Kings.
For caution, Corpse Kings absolutely avoid exposing themselves to danger.
Furthermore, wherever a Corpse King appears, there must be a multitude of zombies around, providing it a sense of security.
But her zombie dad...
Apart from honing combat skills or occasionally going out, he mostly spends time with her.
She, just a tiny infant, certainly cannot provide any sense of security to a Corpse King...
It’s like a chess game where there are always soldiers flanking the king.
But except for today, Ji Ruxue has never seen other zombies around dad before.
Moreover, based on Ji Ruxue’s knowledge, Corpse Kings have a strong sense of race.
And they are violent, extremely bloodthirsty, enjoying consuming fresh flesh, typically emitting a heavy scent of blood.
However, zombie dad isn’t just not smelly, he even has a fragrance.
Besides, with a Corpse King’s personality, they wouldn’t take in a human infant and even care for her daily.
She hasn’t even seen zombie dad losing his temper.
Based on these, Ji Ruxue temporarily ruled out the possibility of zombie dad being the Corpse King.
However, her zombie dad also belongs to evolved zombies, and still must obey the Corpse King hidden in the district.
Ji Ruxue suspects that zombie dad’s ability to adopt her is largely due to retained human-like consciousness in his mind.
Allowing dad, though controlled by the Corpse King, to still make decisions independently.
No, I must find a way to free dad from the Corpse King’s control!
Helping zombie dad break free from control is simple because a Corpse King finds it hard to control beings vastly superior in level.
So, by seizing lots of zombie crystal cores for dad to consume, and raising his level far above the Corpse King’s, he naturally becomes immune to its control.
Ji Ruxue looked at the zombies below, a cold gleam flashing in her eyes.
"Hmph! Who cares about the damned Corpse King, my dad Ji Ruxue can’t be ordered around by a creature like you!"
"You’d better keep hidden in the neighborhood, or if I find you, I’ll definitely kill you!"
...
Lu Chuan, with an additional evolved Corpse Puppet, was quite cheerful at the moment, unaware that he and his puppet have already been added to Little Qiqi’s death note...
After returning with ’Lightning Two,’ Lu Chuan began assigning tasks.
’Da Pang,’ continued sitting at the district gate wielding dual hammers, his huge size and defensive capabilities are wasted if not guarding the entrance.
As agile zombies, ’Lightning’ and ’Lightning Two’ each led ten fully armed ordinary Corpse Puppets to patrol the district.
Seeing each puppet team in its role, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction; he aims to turn the whole district into his impregnable fortress!

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Is This Policewoman Here to Die Again? (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Chapter 56: Is This Policewoman Here to Die Again? (Part 3)
On the other side, Zhao Lin, who had been smashed to death by a hammer but then resurrected on the spot, was overjoyed when she realized she might have become an Evolver.
Feeling the overwhelming energy within her, Zhao Lin felt as if she was bursting with strength that she wanted to unleash.
After confirming her direction, Zhao Lin quickly ran towards the direction of the police station.
She encountered a few wandering zombies along the way; after a brief thought, she drew her dagger and fought them bare-handed.
As a result, Zhao Lin was pleasantly surprised to find that her combat abilities had indeed improved significantly compared to before.
These ordinary zombies were no match for her at all, and with her exceptional combat skills, Zhao Lin killed all the zombies blocking her path.
The Sunshine Home was several kilometers away from the police station, and Zhao Lin didn’t feel any fatigue after running back.
However, when Zhao Lin, covered in blood and looking a bit disheveled, returned to the police station, she was immediately met with a gun pointed at her head.
"Don’t shoot, I’m Zhao Lin, I’m still alive!"
Seeing her colleague directly aiming a gun at her, Zhao Lin was startled and quickly explained.
"What?! Officer Zhao, you’re not dead?!"
The officers responsible for guarding were dumbfounded.
They had already learned from the few people who went out today that Zhao Lin had been hammered to death at the entrance of the Sunshine District by an Evolved Zombie.
Yet now she was standing in front of them, looking fine except for the blood on her, resembling a living person.
Although Zhao Lin’s current state looked a bit eerie, the officers, out of trust for a fellow comrade, let Zhao Lin in.
When Zhao Lin returned to the hall, everyone in the police station was looking at her with disbelief.
"Officer... Officer Zhao?! Are you human or ghost?!"
A truck driver pointed at Zhao Lin tremblingly, his face a bit pale.
"Zhao Lin? Is it really you?! We thought you had been taken out by that Evolved Zombie..."
The officers looked at Zhao Lin, swallowing hard, their eyes filled with indescribable shock.
"It’s really me. I discovered that I became an Evolver, which is how I survived!"
After Zhao Lin finished speaking, she recited a few police protocols, which finally dispelled everyone’s doubts.
However, everyone still looked at Zhao Lin with eyes full of surprise.
Zhao Lin said with an unpleasant expression, "The zombies are getting stronger, I think we should leave the city as soon as possible."
Today, at the Evolution District, a Tank Type zombie was able to attack with a flying hammer, completely overturning Zhao Lin’s perception.
In her previous encounters with Evolved Zombies, she had never seen zombies who could use weapons.
This could very well indicate that the zombies in the city are evolving at a faster rate, and continuing to hold up at the police station might just lead to death.
But even after Zhao Lin shared these thoughts, the people inside still shook their heads, unwilling to leave together.
"Officer Zhao, you must be kidding, there’s an Evolved Zombie at the gate of Sunshine Home, that huge zombie is no match for us!"
Even the officers this time shook their heads, unwilling to leave together.
"Everyone, don’t worry, I’ll deal with that Evolved Zombie. I’m an Evolver now, follow me, and you don’t have to worry!"
Immediately after, Zhao Lin demonstrated to everyone her massively increased strength and speed post-evolution.
She also picked a few colleagues to spar with her, and with her overwhelmingly superior physical prowess, she defeated them all within a few rounds.
Such impressive combat power left everyone in the hall amazed.
Zhao Lin spread out her hands and said somewhat helplessly, "Now you all believe me, right? With my current strength, luring that big guy away shouldn’t be an issue."
In Zhao Lin’s view, luring that big guy away was not impossible.
The reason she was killed so quickly before was that she didn’t expect this zombie to use a weapon.
Everyone saw Zhao Lin’s insistence, and having witnessed her formidable strength as an Evolver, they nodded and agreed.
For the officers, in any case, it was Zhao Lin who would lure away the Evolved Zombie.
If Zhao Lin succeeded, it would be for the best, as everyone could escape with trucks to head to the human Survivor Base.
If Zhao Lin met with misfortune, they could just retreat back to the police station.
After all, if Zhao Lin died, it had nothing to do with them and meant one less person to share food with.
After that, under Zhao Lin’s encouragement, the police station began a new round of preparations.
...
