In the bedroom on the seventh floor, Lu Chuan turned off the flame of the gas stove, pouring fragrant fried rice with eggs into a bowl.
This gas stove and the matching cookware were brought over by a Corpse Puppet from a nearby restaurant.
After all, one couldn’t always collect wood and burn it inside the building...
Due to practicing the Glazed Breathing Technique, Ji Ruxue, under the catalysis of a large amount of Energy Factors, grew at a rate significantly faster than ordinary infants.
Now, even her milk teeth had fully grown in.
Lu Chuan was quite surprised after discovering this, not expecting the little one to grow so fast.
However, in his heart, he was also very happy; the faster the little one grew in the apocalypse, the better.
That’s why Lu Chuan made fried rice, filling the room with the aroma of cooking.
"Oh heavens, finally I can eat normal food!"
Ji Ruxue held her little bowl, her eyes moist as she gazed at the golden fried rice.
This period, she had been drinking rice gruel and formula every day, feeling like she would throw up if she continued. Her whole body carried the smell of formula, almost marinating into a milky scent...
This delicious rice cooked over a flame was something she hadn’t eaten in a long time.
Grabbing a small spoon, she ate voraciously, showing a satisfied smile.
"Who would’ve thought that Zombie Dad’s cooking skills weren’t bad!"
The only regret Ji Ruxue felt was that there were only eggs and no meat. She secretly resolved that she would hunt some Fierce Beasts in the future so Zombie Dad could make some barbecue.
That’s what people should be eating!
Seeing Little Qiqi burying her head in her bowl and eating heartily, Lu Chuan smiled with satisfaction.
After Little Qiqi finished, Lu Chuan gently wiped the rice off Ji Ruxue’s mouth with his hand and poured a cup of warm water.
Ji Ruxue took the cup and drank it in one gulp.
This feeling of warm water mixed with rice flowing into her stomach during the zombie apocalypse made her feel incredibly comfortable.
The next day, in the morning.
In the district, Lu Chuan practiced his combat skills with a machete, continuously sparring with ’Lightning One’.
After long periods of practice combat, Lu Chuan could now hold his own against ’Lightning One’.
At that moment, Lu Chuan switched his attention to Da Pang’s perspective.
He saw several figures appear at the entrance of the district.
These people were wearing black police riot gear, holding batons and riot shields, or brandishing police pistols and rifles.
The slender figure leading them had their face visible through the transparent visor of the riot helmet, and Lu Chuan identified her as the female officer who was supposed to have been killed by a hammer yesterday.
"Huh? Is this female officer coming here to die again?"

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Ji Ruxue – Back from the Dead? Could This Woman Be the Nine Lives Demon Cop?
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Chapter 57: Ji Ruxue – Back from the Dead? Could This Woman Be the Nine Lives Demon Cop?
Lu Chuan frowned tightly, not expecting that the female police officer who had only just been resurrected would be so reckless as to provoke him again, and this time bringing so many people.
At the same time, it further strengthened Lu Chuan’s determination to eliminate her completely.
"This time I’ll smash you into mince, let’s see if you can resurrect again!"
Lu Chuan immediately controlled ’Da Pang’, brandishing dual hammers as he charged towards Zhao Lin.
Zhao Lin quickly repeated her old trick, raising her gun to shoot at ’Da Pang’s’ head again.
Luckily, Lu Chuan was prepared and directly used the massive hammer to block in front of ’Da Pang’s’ head.
Bam!
The iron hammer accurately intercepted the bullet, followed by Lu Chuan’s sudden arm swing, sending the giant hammer smashing violently towards Zhao Lin.
"Hmph! Still trying to play this game with me?"
This time Zhao Lin was already prepared for ’Da Pang’s’ attack, her leg muscles tensed, bursting with giant strength, her body shot out like a spring.
Bam!ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Zhao Lin’s speed was extremely fast, causing ’Da Pang’s’ hammer swing to miss.
Lu Chuan was slightly surprised, but quickly swung his hammer to chase after.
Yet he found that even with ’Da Pang’ in sprint mode, he still couldn’t catch up to this female police officer.
The slender figure in front of him was wearing police riot gear, yet her running speed was insanely fast.
’Da Pang’s’ two nearly one-meter-long massive hammers couldn’t land a hit on her.
Every time he threw out the hammer, this female cop could keenly dodge away.
Even if Lu Chuan threw two hammers in a row, this female cop could still bizarrely avoid them.
Bam bam bam!
Lu Chuan controlled ’Da Pang’ to continuously swing the dual hammers, yet no matter what, he couldn’t hit the female police officer in front of him.
He never imagined that in just one day, the reflex speed of this female cop had improved so much!
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue in the bedroom was immediately alerted upon hearing the sudden gunshots.
The little one quickly ran to the balcony, leaning on the window to check the situation in the district with a telescope.
Through the telescope, Ji Ruxue again spotted the female cop who was smashed to death yesterday.
The other person was now vivacious at the entrance and extremely agile!
"What’s going on? Wasn’t this woman directly killed by the big zombie yesterday? How is she lively again today?"
"Eh, there are a few more people today?"
Ji Ruxue noticed that not just the resurrected female cop, through the telescope, she also saw a few more police officers in riot gear today.
These guys, clad in police riot gear, were clearly more than ready to fend off zombie bites.
Now these officers took advantage of ’Da Pang’ being led away by Zhao Lin to enter the Sunshine District.
"What are these fully armed police doing in the Sunshine District?"
"There are no survivors waiting for rescue in the district, only other powerful evolved zombies, and even a zombie king!"
Ji Ruxue’s brows knitted tightly together, feeling that the police below were simply courting death.
Damn, where did Dad go?!
Only then did Ji Ruxue realize that her zombie dad wasn’t in the room.
That made her somewhat anxious.
After all, these officers downstairs were armed with guns, which posed a significant threat to zombies in this stage.
As long as a bullet hits the head, even evolved zombies can be killed.
Why did Dad run out at this time?
Won’t he encounter danger?!
Ji Ruxue was a bit worried inside; she didn’t want her dad to bump into these people below.
But thinking that her dad had human consciousness, he shouldn’t be so foolish as to throw himself in front of these guys, right...
At this point, Ji Ruxue could only secretly pray, hoping her zombie dad wouldn’t do anything rash and walk into the crosshairs.
"Everyone move quickly, we don’t know how long Zhao Lin can hold on over there, hurry and find the truck keys then leave here fast."
The officers reached the Sunshine District, and after witnessing ’Da Pang’ standing like a gate god, they were shocked by the power of this evolved zombie.
Even after entering the district, they could still hear the occasional thud of the giant hammer hitting the ground, making their scalps tingle.
Without Zhao Lin the Evolver luring away the zombies, they wouldn’t have made it here.
The group quickly searched the Sunshine District, but soon encountered Lu Chuan’s team of Corpse Puppets patrolling with fire axes, and the evolved zombie ’Lightning One’.
The officers froze in place, their minds going blank at the sight of the zombies.
Bam bam bam!
Outside the district gates, ’Da Pang’, controlled by Lu Chuan, kept swinging the hammers, but the slender Zhao Lin seemed to have endless stamina.
She continued to maneuver right in front of him, and no matter how the hammers swung, they couldn’t hit her.
This was the first time since controlling ’Da Pang’ that Lu Chuan encountered such a troublesome opponent.
After successfully evolving, Zhao Lin had avoided ’Da Pang’s’ attacks a few times, gaining more confidence in her own prowess.
With exceptional agility and speed, she led ’Da Pang’ in circles, handling herself with ease at the gate.
"Big guy, is this all you’ve got?"
Zhao Lin ran ahead, casually picking up a stick from the roadside and hurling it at ’Da Pang’ to provoke the evolved zombie.
She had already seen her team members enter the Sunshine District, not wanting this evolved zombie to return inside.
Though Zhao Lin’s evolved strength was beyond an ordinary human’s, for the Tank Type zombie ’Da Pang’, this level of attack was still no more than an itch.
Lu Chuan forced a frown, the woman before him obviously didn’t match ’Da Pang’ in strength, yet her reflexes and agility were a notch above, leaving him momentarily stumped.
Moreover, the woman was deliberately maneuvering in circles right in front of him, clearly trying to lead him on a wild goose chase.
Lu Chuan was puzzled as to why this group of officers came to the Sunshine District unprompted.
There had been no interactions with them before yesterday.
What surprised Lu Chuan more was that after resurrecting, this female cop seemed completely different compared to yesterday!
Ji Ruxue, who was also puzzled, watched from the balcony through binoculars, continually observing the situation below.
"It seems this female cop is deliberately attracting the big guy’s attention to allow her subordinates to infiltrate the Sunshine District."
"Yet why has her strength improved so significantly?"
Wait a minute!
Ji Ruxue’s pupils suddenly contracted, recalling memories from her past life.
Yesterday, she was clearly killed in a single blow by the big guy, yet she resurrected with significantly enhanced abilities.
This is Jianghai City... and the person before her is a female cop...
All the pieces were coming together!
Could this woman be the Nine Deaths Demon Police she encountered in her past life?!

chapters.title: Chapter 58: This Corpse King Really Is Impressive!
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Chapter 58: This Corpse King Really Is Impressive!
Ji Ruxue stood on the balcony, carefully observing the female police officer below with binoculars. The more she looked, the more familiar it seemed.
Yesterday, she noticed this person looked very familiar, but couldn’t recall immediately.
Today, combining the strange changes in the other person, Ji Ruxue finally recognized the identity of this person during the apocalypse.
However, the female officer before her still had some differences compared to the Nine Deaths Demon Police she met in the apocalypse.
In Ji Ruxue’s memory, the Nine Deaths Demon Police had very neat short hair and looked very intimidating.
Back then, the Nine Deaths Demon Police was decisive in killing, powerful, and never showed mercy once in action.
Now, Zhao Lin had long hair and looked like a gentle and charming girl.
Aside from appearance, the two looked different in every other aspect, which is why Ji Ruxue didn’t remember immediately.
But now, seeing the other’s resurrection changes, Ji Ruxue understood.
Appearance and personality can change due to various events during the apocalypse, but a resurrection ability can’t be faked.
Her pre-apocalypse occupation was a police officer, and she could revive after being killed, strengthening herself through resurrection.
Who else could she be but the Nine Deaths Demon Police from Jianghai City?
Ji Ruxue didn’t believe such a rare talent ability could be possessed by a second person in a small place like Jianghai City!
Watching Zhao Lin outside the gate, circling with the big zombie, Ji Ruxue felt a surge of excitement.
Just days ago, she was wondering how to recruit Jianghai City’s top future experts.
Unexpectedly, she quickly encountered this Nine Deaths Demon Police who hadn’t yet grown.
The revival power of the Nine Deaths Demon Police is simply heaven-defying. If she can be more calm and cautious early on, dying fewer times, she could eventually break through to the Emperor Realm!
If I can capture the Nine Deaths Demon Police before she grows, she can be a formidable general in the future.
Even if I’m not around, the Nine Deaths Demon Police will be enough to ensure the safety of my zombie father.
On the other side, Lu Chuan’s eyes flashed with endless coldness upon discovering more people entering the district.
"’Da Pang’! Beat that policewoman to death for me!"
Lu Chuan gave up control, directly commanding ’Da Pang’ to act freely.
At the same time, Lu Chuan switched his view back to the Corpse Puppet squad within the district.
Sure enough, he saw several people also in police riot gear, holding guns.
These people had already advanced into the district, but they apparently didn’t expect so many zombies inside.
Seeing Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets, they looked stunned, their faces seemingly pale under the riot helmets.
Lu Chuan’s eyes were full of murder intent.
Although unsure of these people’s intentions, the Sunshine District was his territory.
Since these people broke into his territory, they only have a dead end!
"Die, all of you!"
Lu Chuan commanded the Corpse Puppet squad to charge forward.
Seeing the charging zombies, the officers finally reacted, pulling the trigger hurriedly.
Bang bang bang!
The dense gunfire echoed in the district, instinctively frightening all who heard it.
On the seventh floor, Ji Ruxue’s face changed dramatically, immediately thinking of her zombie father.
The Nine Deaths Demon Police outside the gate was undoubtedly an Evolver.
And among the other humans who came, it’s still uncertain if there are more Evolvers.
If there are more Evolvers, the combined firepower from firearms would be extraordinary!
Ji Ruxue suddenly shuddered, remembering that a Corpse King existed in the Sunshine District.
"Could these humans already know about the Corpse King and came early to slay it?!"
The more Ji Ruxue thought, the more possible it seemed; otherwise, why would these fully armed police come to the Sunshine District?
There’s no supply here, no survivors, only the Corpse King to attract people...
The more Ji Ruxue thought, the more worried she became. To prevent her zombie father from dying at the hands of these human Evolvers, she quickly left her apartment, running from the seventh to the second floor.
Upon reaching the balcony, Ji Ruxue found that the combat power of the Corpse Puppet squad was far more potent than she imagined!
Despite the officers’ gunfire, the Corpse Puppets raised their fire axes to shield their heads, charging madly forward.Google seaʀᴄh
The sudden appearance of the Corpse Puppets panicked the officers, and seeing bullets blocked by axes left them completely dumbfounded.
"Are these really zombies? How can they block bullets?"
Bang bang bang!
The officers tried to go for headshots, but their pistols and rifles couldn’t penetrate the fire axes to kill the zombies behind.
Moreover, Lu Chuan had also equipped these Corpse Puppets with full-cover motorcycle helmets.
"Damn Zhao Lin! If it weren’t for wanting that truck, we wouldn’t be in this mess!"
The officers cursed while shooting. These zombies were nothing like the ones they usually encountered, completely disrupting their tactics.
From the second-floor balcony, Ji Ruxue looked at the battlefield but still didn’t see her father, causing her to worry.
But after scanning the district, she suddenly spotted her father hiding at a building corner.
Seeing her father safe, Ji Ruxue sighed in relief.
It seemed her zombie father was unusual, not following the Corpse King’s orders to be cannon fodder at the front.
And since the Corpse Puppets had fire axes and helmets for defense, plus Agile Type zombies drawing most of the fire, the Corpse Puppet squad quickly reached the officers.
Among these officers, only Zhao Lin was an Evolver, making the ordinary humans’ fate grim once zombies got close.
If they faced regular zombies, it would be manageable since their riot gear could resist bites.
Unfortunately, they encountered Lu Chuan’s controlled Corpse Puppet squad.
"Fire in turns, watch for reloading!"
"Retreat, retreat, everyone retreat now!"
Facing these bizarre zombies, the officers lost all resolve and frantically fled towards the district gate.
They initially couldn’t effectively kill the Corpse Puppets, and their formation broke instantly upon close encounter.
Under Lu Chuan’s order, once the Corpse Puppets reached the officers, they immediately swung axes at their necks and joints.
Blood-curdling screams echoed throughout the district.
"Damn you, Zhao Lin! I’ll haunt you even in death!"
"Bastard! Where the hell did these zombies come from?!"
Amid the agonized screams, several officers were hacked to death with the axes.
The gunfire in the district ceased.
Ji Ruxue stood on the balcony, gasping involuntarily.
"I never expected the Corpse King in the Sunshine District to be so terrifying, with zombies knowing how to arm themselves and even block bullets!"
This terrifying Corpse King is hiding somewhere unknown...
Ji Ruxue frowned, secretly pondering whether to take this opportunity to eliminate the Corpse King.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: If You’ve Got Guts, Come Back to Life Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Chapter 59: If You’ve Got Guts, Come Back to Life Again!
Ji Ruxue never expected that this Corpse King would be even more outrageous than she imagined.
At least according to Ji Ruxue’s memories from her past life, the Corpse King inside Sunshine Home was even more exaggerated than the ones she’d encountered before!
The Corpse Kings she’d encountered in her past life could at most control other zombies to launch attacks, but the one inside the district clearly had far superior zombie combat skills!
Ji Ruxue thought for a moment, then ultimately shook her head.
Forget it, it’s best not to alert the enemy for now.
So far, she hadn’t reached a point of no return with this Corpse King, and the most crucial thing is she doesn’t know where it’s hiding.
Nor does she know what kind of power this Corpse King has; if she fails, it might become wary.
Based on Ji Ruxue’s understanding of the Corpse King, once startled, it would definitely switch locations immediately, then continue to lay low.
If the Corpse King ran away, it wouldn’t be that big of a deal, but the problem is that it would influence the behavior of her zombie dad.
It might even control zombie dad to leave Sunshine District.
If they left now, all the supplies in the building that dad collected would be wasted; it’s been dad’s effort over this period of time.
Besides, Ji Ruxue couldn’t guarantee what would happen if an assassination attempt failed.
For a highly intelligent Corpse King like this, Ji Ruxue decided she must ensure she’s absolutely certain of a fatal strike before taking action.
After all, there are three Evolved Zombies inside this district alone.
Controlling three Evolved Zombies simultaneously isn’t easy, which means the Corpse King here is probably already at the second stage!
It’s an existence equivalent to her level.
The most critical point is that Ji Ruxue is still just a baby; although she’s broken through to the second stage, her combat power is still limited by her body and other factors.
"Better wait until I reach the third stage before taking action..."
"By then, with the advantage in realm, there should be a chance to completely eliminate this Corpse King!"
Ji Ruxue was confident in her cultivation breakthrough, considering that for a zombie in the early stages, the only way to breakthrough was by continuously accumulating Crystal Cores.
But Ji Ruxue now mastered the most scientific training method humans developed in the later stages of the apocalypse, making her cultivation speed relatively fast.
"Dad, please wait for me a while longer. I believe I can soon help you break free from the control of the Corpse King!"
Ji Ruxue took a deep look at her zombie dad hidden in the shadows before decisively turning and heading upstairs.
By now, those humans who had run into Sunshine District were all chopped to pieces by the Corpse Puppets, posing basically no significant threat.
Evolved Zombies are sensitive to the scent of living people, and this was the second floor, which made exposure more likely.
To avoid involving her zombie dad, Ji Ruxue quickly returned to the seventh floor.
...
"It’s really strange; why did these fully armed police leave their station and come all the way to Sunshine District?"
Looking at the bodies of the police officers chopped up by the Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but be puzzled.
Lu Chuan had already dispatched Corpse Puppets to search the entire Sunshine District, but he couldn’t figure out what attracted these policemen...
However, Lu Chuan didn’t think much of it; after all, his strength was growing increasingly strong, so he wasn’t worried about the attacks from this small band of survivors.
Unless the kind of heavily armed military arrives, Lu Chuan won’t be particularly concerned.
Seeing the handguns in the hands of the corpses, Lu Chuan smiled slightly,
then took away all their guns and bullets.
Weighing the black firearms in his hand, Lu Chuan suddenly felt a strong sense of security.
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but ponder if it would be possible to equip each of the Corpse Puppets with a gun, given the firepower potency?
Who could withstand zombies wielding guns?
Zombies were already incredibly hard to eliminate unless decapitated.
Otherwise, even with just half a body left, they can still continually attack, and coupled with firearms, they’d be nearly invincible!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
At that moment, sounds of banging still came from outside the district entrance. Lu Chuan remembered that there was still a female police officer outside, and quickly switched his focus to ’Da Pang’.
Through the resurrection and evolution ability, Zhao Lin’s physical fitness had been significantly enhanced.
Faced with the clumsy and slow-moving ’Da Pang’, Zhao Lin could easily dodge and tease this Tank Type zombie.
But Zhao Lin also understood that, with her current strength, directly confronting this Tank Type zombie would still be extremely challenging.
However, leading it around in circles posed no problem.
Zhao Lin originally planned to just stall for time, to let her companions enter the district to find truck keys. Once they had the truck, they had hope of leaving the city.
However, Zhao Lin didn’t know her police companions had already been slain in the district by zombies.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
In this group that came from the police station, only she, as an Evolver, was still alive.
Under Lu Chuan’s direct control, ’Da Pang’s combat power suddenly increased dramatically.
Lu Chuan’s combat awareness in recent times had significantly improved compared to before.
Controlling Evolved Zombies’ combat power also became stronger. Originally, Zhao Lin could easily handle ’Da Pang’s attacks.
But she suddenly noticed that ’Da Pang’s dual hammer swings were becoming faster and more fierce.
The critical point was that each hammer strike’s target became more cunning, often able to precisely predict Zhao Lin’s moves.
Zhao Lin could only use her evolved body to narrowly dodge attacks.
Feeling the sudden surge of pressure, Zhao Lin’s pupils contracted, knowing a single misstep could result in being hit by ’Da Pang’.
"What’s going on? Why did this big dummy suddenly become so smart?!"
Faced with increased battle pressure, Zhao Lin was sweating profusely.
She looked at the big figure behind her, her eyes full of disbelief.
Zhao Lin never expected that in just a moment, her opponent’s combat strength had increased so much, that she couldn’t withstand it.
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue continued observing the battle from the seventh floor.
Seeing Zhao Lin quickly being suppressed by ’Da Pang’, Ji Ruxue became immensely helpless.
"This idiot! There are only nine lives in total, and now she’s going to waste one again!"
Just as Ji Ruxue expected, under Lu Chuan’s intense and vigorous assault, Zhao Lin soon couldn’t hold on anymore.
Bang!
Lu Chuan seized the opportunity, using his left hand’s giant hammer like a poker, directly making Zhao Lin stumble.
Then, before Zhao Lin could react, he threw the right-hand giant hammer down fiercely, breaking Zhao Lin’s spine, the sound of bones breaking clear as day.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Having seen this woman come back to life with his own eyes, Lu Chuan furiously swung his dual hammers this time.
Like pounding meatballs, Lu Chuan shattered all the bones in Zhao Lin’s body and crushed her internal organs, with blood splattering everywhere.
Watching Zhao Lin breathe her last, Lu Chuan finally stopped.
Lu Chuan would never show mercy to someone actively seeking trouble.
Furthermore, Zhao Lin resurrected yesterday and came back with manpower today; who knows if she’d come with the army next time.
"I’ve smashed you to bits, try resurrecting again if you can!"

chapters.title: Chapter 60: No Way! Is This Woman Cheating?
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 60: No Way! Is This Woman Cheating?
"Could this woman be any stupider?! Such a precious chance for resurrection, and she wastes it just like that?!!"
"You idiot! Do you even know that you only have nine resurrection chances, and you’ve already wasted two for nothing?!!"
From the balcony, Ji Ruxue saw Zhao Lin get killed again and felt utterly speechless.
This talent ability to resurrect and enhance multiple times after death was truly monstrous to the extreme.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Yet such a monstrous talent was squandered by Zhao Lin!
Based on Ji Ruxue’s memory, the Nine Deaths Demon Police’s talent was beyond extraordinary, practically a stats monster.
Because Zhao Lin’s talent was calculated based on her strength at the time of death, each death would directly multiply her strength.
If Zhao Lin could save these rare resurrection chances for later, the enhancement effect would be terrifying.
In Ji Ruxue’s memories of her past life, the Nine Deaths Demon Police wasted such a monstrous talent by using too many resurrection chances early in the apocalypse.
Otherwise, with such heaven-defying extraordinary abilities, she wouldn’t have stopped at merely the Emperor Realm.
Ji Ruxue had been thinking that if she could recruit her early on, maybe the Nine Deaths Demon Police could eventually reach the Emperor Realm.
But clearly, this woman was even dumber than she thought in the early apocalypse days, leaving her with just one life left when Ji Ruxue encountered her...
At the entrance of the district, Lu Chuan controlled Da Pang and finally killed the resurrected woman.
He manipulated Da Pang to go forward and remove the police gun from Zhao Lin’s hand.
Combined with the guns from the previous officers, Lu Chuan had now accumulated six police guns.
He also found quite a few bullets by searching the officers.
Holding this cold weapon in his hands, Lu Chuan’s eyes glimmered with a cold light.
With a weapon in hand, the killing intent arises.
Originally, the zombies only wielded fire axes, but now with firearms in his hands, his combat power shot up dramatically.
Lu Chuan even began considering whether to just wipe out the police station.
Presumably, there must be a lot more guns and ammunition in the police station, and generally, police stations have pretty complete firearms equipment.
If possible, maybe he could re-equip the Corpse Puppets and directly form a team armed with firearms!
Lu Chuan had discovered the survivor team at the police station long ago, though despite becoming a zombie, he still retained human consciousness.
Although he had no emotions towards the humans of this world, having a human soul made Lu Chuan reluctant to actively attack these human survivor teams.
But he didn’t expect that when he didn’t bother these human survivors, they would come to his doorstep instead.
If that female cop coming to Sunshine District yesterday was a coincidence, then her bringing more members today as a resurrected zombie was clearly premeditated.
Today, an Evolver showed up, along with several armed officers, and Lu Chuan couldn’t be sure if a SWAT team would roll in tomorrow...
Furthermore, forming a Corpse Puppet team equipped with firearms was simply too tempting.
A zombie that neither fears death nor pain and can fire from a distance is terrifying just to think about!
If he had such a team, Lu Chuan felt he could literally walk sideways through the city.
With this in mind, Lu Chuan decided to send an Evolved Zombie tomorrow to check the situation near the police station.
Mainly because Lu Chuan wanted to ascertain if there were other Evolvers in the police station; this resurrected woman was truly unexpected for him.
Resurrected overnight and fully healed, she was more heaven-defying than zombies.
A gentleman does not take revenge too late, but as a zombie, revenge must be immediate!
Lu Chuan’s principle was always: If people don’t offend me, I won’t offend them.
If people offend me, they must be eradicated!
The police station’s repeated disruptions left Lu Chuan unwilling to tolerate any longer.
If anything threatens Little Qiqi’s and my safety, no matter who it is, they must be eliminated.
At the very least, Lu Chuan was sure that if he stood in front of those police officers, they would shoot him without hesitation, so there’s no need for him to hold back either.
"Damn it, I was planning to take Little Qiqi downstairs to play and get some sun soon, but how can we do that with all this fighting and killing?"
"Initially, I didn’t want to deal with these human survivors, but it seems now, for the safety of Sunshine District, I may need to drive away these two survivor teams nearby if necessary!"
After resolving the fight in the district and ordering the Corpse Puppets to clean up the battlefield, Lu Chuan returned upstairs.
Opening the door, he saw Little Qiqi doing homework on the coffee table, and the sight of the diligent and adorable little one lifted Lu Chuan’s gloomy mood instantly.
My daughter is still the cutest.
No matter who you are, don’t think about disturbing my daughter’s studies!
As night fell, Lu Chuan watched Little Qiqi obediently go to bed, then returned to the living room.
Sitting on the sofa, Lu Chuan frowned and began to ponder his next plans.
Little Qiqi’s growth rate was noticeably faster than ordinary infants, and his daughter was undoubtedly a prodigy.
Lu Chuan contemplated deeply about how to provide a better environment for Little Qiqi’s growth.
Raising a child is a marathon process, and ensuring Little Qiqi’s healthy growth would require many years.
Firstly, the Sunshine District where they were currently situated was definitely not a place to stay long-term.
Although he had stockpiled a lot of food, it wouldn’t last forever, and one day it would run out.
Even if it didn’t run out, it would spoil due to temperature changes, unable to be preserved for long periods.
Being a zombie, he didn’t care, but the little one needed to grow healthily, and he had to consider these issues.
"There must be a way to create food; a sustainable source of new food is necessary to ensure the little one has a continuous supply of food and nutrition in her life ahead..."
Lu Chuan really had no experience in this area, having been just an ordinary worker in his previous life.
Thinking about apocalypse survival, Lu Chuan could only recall those post-apocalyptic games.
"How about farming myself?"
"After all, there are so many Corpse Puppets, and they’re free labor..."
Clearing land and consistent farming could indeed be a sustainable development plan.
But at that moment, Lu Chuan suddenly felt a stir in his heart, and his eyes were filled with shock.
Switching to ’Da Pang’s view, he saw that the female cop he had smashed to bits during the day was standing up intact once again!
"What the hell?!"
"Is this woman cheating?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Working with the Nine-Lives Demon Cop to Take Down the Corpse King?
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 61: Working with the Nine-Lives Demon Cop to Take Down the Corpse King?
Lu Chuan was dumbfounded.
Outside the gate of the community, the corpse that had been smashed into a mess slowly reshaped into a graceful human form under a blood-colored glow!
When the light disappeared, Zhao Lin appeared perfectly intact on the street!
Lu Chuan felt his brain was overwhelmed.
"Aren’t you my dude?! Which one of us is the real zombie?"
"I smashed you into pulp, and you can still live?!"
Lu Chuan felt his worldview was being continuously refreshed.
He felt as if the world had no limits; even when people are dead, they can continuously resurrect?!
Even zombies without pain sensation, smashed to this extent, should be dead beyond dead.
And not only resurrected, but this woman was unharmed from head to toe; isn’t this cheating?!
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue, who had been pretending to sleep in the bedroom, had already rushed to the window, observing the situation below through the hole left before.
Ji Ruxue had always been curious in her past life about how the Nine Deaths Demon Police managed to resurrect, or if there were special conditions for resurrection.
For example, the preservation status of the corpse or the manner of death, etc.
She had wondered if the Nine Deaths Demon Police’s physical body were completely destroyed, whether they could still resurrect, but she had no chance to experiment.
The scene of Zhao Lin resurrecting was watched and taken to heart by Ji Ruxue.
Even though Ji Ruxue had reached the Emperor Realm in her past life, she was still shocked by this.
This talent ability is ridiculously extreme; it’s more than just simple resurrection—broken bones and flesh can even regrow!
Blood and flesh rebirth is not as simple as that; it involves the power of life principles.
Based on Ji Ruxue’s memory from her past life, the Power of Law could only be comprehended by Emperor Level experts!
Yet, in the early days of the apocalypse, this Nine Deaths Demon Police had already mastered Law Level power, terrifyingly enough.
Although Ji Ruxue knows such powers are passive for the Nine Deaths Demon Police, it proves their extraordinary talent.
"Recruit her! This woman must be recruited!"
Looking at Zhao Lin below, Ji Ruxue’s eyes glowed.
With such extreme and extraordinary talent, Ji Ruxue must bring her over to her side.
If nurtured well, this Nine Deaths Demon Police’s future achievements will be beyond imagination, completely capable of becoming a major aid during the apocalypse.
At the same time, Zhao Lin, who had shocked both Lu Chuan and Ji Ruxue, stood frozen.
Zhao Lin looked at her flawlessly intact body, also in disbelief.
She even doubted she was having hallucinations or that everything was just a long dream.
The experience of being killed in daylight was still vivid, that feeling couldn’t be fake, truly happening to her.
"I’m reborn again?"
"Am I still an Undead Body?!"
Zhao Lin’s eyes widened, her breathing hastened due to exhilaration.
It’s not just about dying and coming back to life.
Zhao Lin clenched her fists, realizing her strength now seemed much greater than during the day.
Compared to earlier in the day, her strength has increased significantly?!
So, this is what an Evolver’s ability is? You can get stronger just by dying, that’s too defying fate!
Zhao Lin couldn’t suppress her upturned mouth corner any longer, growing immensely excited.
Leaflets dropped from military helicopters said Evolvers with Extraordinary Ability possess incredibly strong combat power.
Now Zhao Lin believes it; this Evolver ability is downright terrifying!
"Haha, what can mere zombies do to me?!"
Although killed twice, Zhao Lin’s confidence surged.
It’s only natural; if anyone knows they’re already dead but resurrect again, their mindset will transform tremendously.
Especially when the resurrection also boosts strength several folds.
Seeing the Tank Type Zombie that killed her twice, Zhao Lin’s eyes flashed with murderous intent before charging towards ’Da Pang’.
Though she’s revived, the feeling of being killed was real.
Recalling it instills a lingering fear in Zhao Lin, intensifying her anger.
Lu Chuan was still in shock from the zombie-like resurrection act of this female officer, then saw the female officer actively charging at ’Da Pang’.
Lu Chuan instantly felt a surge of anger in his heart.
"Cheating, is it? Resurrection, is it?"
"Damn it! If I can kill you twice, I can kill you a third and fourth time. I refuse to believe you can keep resurrecting!"
Thinking the fight was over, Lu Chuan didn’t expect this woman to resurrect again.
The events surrounding Zhao Lin directly refreshed Lu Chuan’s worldview, leaving him both surprised and increasingly murderous.
This kind of resurrecting existence must be eradicated at the source, otherwise, who knows what might happen in the future.
Lu Chuan, controlling ’Da Pang’, swung double hammers in combat.
"Can resurrect, huh? Then let’s see how many lives you have!"
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Furious, Lu Chuan swung ’Da Pang’s iron hammers with intense force, the air-splitting sound chilling anyone’s spine.
"Heh, big guy, if you can kill me twice, I refuse to believe you can kill me a third!"
Zhao Lin’s eyes turned slightly red, her murderous intent stirred like Lu Chuan’s.
Having failed to kill her after two attempts ignited Lu Chuan’s wrath.
Zhao Lin felt similarly. Being killed twice by the same zombie, especially the humiliating second death with a shattered body, is unbearable.
Though Zhao Lin is kind-hearted and tender, her moves are vicious now.
Lu Chuan frowned; after clashing, he noticed the female officer’s strength had increased!
The opponent’s speed was evidently faster than during the day, his hammers swung faster and viciously, yet couldn’t threaten her.
Boom, boom, boom!The source of thɪs content is novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Lu Chuan’s massive hammers thrust, swung, or smashed, yet Zhao Lin evaded them all.
Then Zhao Lin’s body exploded like a leopard, swiftly arriving behind ’Da Pang’.
Bam!
Then she whipped out a leg, striking ’Da Pang’s knee joint.
The overwhelming force made ’Da Pang’ unable to bear it momentarily, dropping into a half-kneel.
Lu Chuan hurriedly swung hammers to force Zhao Lin back.
Watching from the seventh floor, Ji Ruxue nodded secretly.
"As expected from the Nine Deaths Demon Police, her strength increased after resurrection."
"This woman is stupid but strong, maybe she can be used to eliminate the Corpse King in the community..."

chapters.title: Chapter 62: If You Can’t Win Alone, Gang Up!
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 62: If You Can’t Win Alone, Gang Up!
Ji Ruxue thought more and more that this plan was very feasible.
Although the Nine Deaths Demon Police, at the beginning of the apocalypse, still seemed not quite adapted to the post-apocalyptic lifestyle, and his mind didn’t seem very sharp.
But there was no way around it; his resurrection and strengthening talent was simply too overwhelming.
In Ji Ruxue’s view, this policewoman was completely the type that the heavens chased after to feed.
She could both resurrect and double her strength.
Such a monstrous talent had never been seen by her in the entire doomsday world...
Although this was only the beginning of the apocalypse, and the Nine Deaths Demon Police was killed twice by the same Evolved Zombie.
This maneuver was indeed somewhat against the odds, but due to her even more outrageous talent, dying twice had already multiplied her strength several times, surpassing a first-tier Evolved Zombie.
She had even already reached the strength of the second tier!
If it were Ji Ruxue herself, facing a Zombie King capable of controlling several Evolved Zombies might still carry some risk.
However, if joined by this undead policewoman with second-tier strength, the success rate would greatly increase!Follow current novels on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
If there was this undead policewoman at the front, and she used her talent ability to strike from the shadows, they might really have the chance to kill this Zombie King in one go!
The Zombie King inside the Sunshine District brought such immense pressure on Ji Ruxue.
This was just the beginning of the apocalypse, and the battle tactics of this Zombie King controlling other zombies were already very skilled.
Even surpassing those Zombie Kings capable of controlling corpse seas that she encountered in her past life!
Ji Ruxue didn’t dare to imagine, if this Zombie King continued to grow, how terrifying its strength would become?
Moreover, her own zombie father was still living inside the Sunshine District, under the control of this Zombie King.
So no matter what, she had to quickly find a way to kill it.
But how to cooperate with this Nine Deaths Demon Police, left Ji Ruxue deep in thought again.
After all, she wasn’t the same as in her past life, and her current infant body was somewhat awkward.
...
Outside the gate of the Sunshine District, Lu Chuan was continuously engaging in combat with this Nine Deaths Demon Police, but as the fight went on, the pressure in Lu Chuan’s heart grew stronger.
He found that this woman’s strength was increasing too abnormally.
Bam bam bam!
Lu Chuan controlled ’Da Pang’, swinging those iron hammers continuously, turning the ground at the entrance into a mess.
But no matter how Lu Chuan attacked this time, Zhao Lin could dodge accurately without fail.
Her slender and graceful body erupted with horrific speed and strength, and her greatly enhanced physical coordination kept Lu Chuan’s hammers from even touching a corner of her clothes.
Now, Zhao Lin could even close the distance quickly to ’Da Pang’s’ side, launching counterattacks while dodging the giant hammers.
The terrifying force often caused ’Da Pang’s’ stout body, known for its strong defense, to tremble, and was sometimes hit at the joints, causing it to kneel down partway under the dissipated force.
Lu Chuan could only rely on his weapon’s double hammer attack to constantly swing and create distance from her.
Gazing at this slender policewoman in front of him, Lu Chuan’s eyes were full of gravity.
In less than a day, her combat power had multiplied many times.
Speed, strength, agility, and reflexes had all comprehensively improved greatly!
Yesterday, he could still take her down at a moment’s notice, but now this woman’s combat power had exceeded ’Da Pang’s’, which was simply insane!
Lu Chuan was shocked by this woman’s absurdity.
Being undefeated after being killed is one thing, but her power doubling in such a transformative way, how is he supposed to play this game?
Lu Chuan thought it was already quite unusual for him to have traveled to this apocalyptic world and to retain human consciousness, even as a zombie.
He had often questioned during countless nights if he was the main character from those web novels he read in his past life.
After all, the probability of something like this was incredibly low.
But now, seeing this policewoman, Lu Chuan’s thoughts wavered.
He realized that this policewoman was the true child of fortune, and compared to her, he was just like an NPC...
"All right, all right, since you’re cheating, don’t blame me for playing dirty!"
Lu Chuan mobilized his remaining Corpse Puppets to support the battle.
Since ’Da Pang’ couldn’t handle it alone, don’t blame him for using a group tactic.
"Your talent is to resurrect and become stronger, while mine is Corpse Control. Let me show you my full strength now!"
In an instant, Lightning One and Two, along with other regular Corpse Puppet squads, charged from all directions of the district.
Even though this woman’s strength had evolved greatly, Lu Chuan refused to believe his three Evolved Corpse Puppets, plus so many regular Corpse Puppets, couldn’t take her down.
Lu Chuan himself even ran down from the seventh floor.
Mainly because Lu Chuan relied on his own Telekinesis to control zombies, similar to wireless networks or Bluetooth from his past life.
His brain was the signal source, and those controlled Corpse Puppets were individual terminals.
The further apart they were, the weaker the signal, with the current maximum control distance being 8,000 meters for Lu Chuan.
However, this distance was influenced by the number of zombies being controlled and the complexity of the battle.
Currently, Lu Chuan was controlling all the zombies simultaneously, and ensuring each could fight according to his will was a huge consumption for his Telekinesis.
With so many zombies under his control, keeping his Telekinesis from depleting meant staying closer to the action.
Zhao Lin naturally heard the sounds from the district, and when she looked up, she was startled by the mass of zombies charging at her, making her scalp tingle.
She didn’t expect so many zombies in the district, and seemingly Evolved Zombies mixed in as well.
With so many zombies charging, even her recent power boosts might not make her a match.
"Oh no! If there are this many zombies in the district, then everyone else..."
Thinking of the others who entered the district to get keys during the day, Zhao Lin suddenly had a bad premonition.
If there were so many zombies in the district, even someone like her as an Evolver would feel overwhelmed, let alone her companions.
And given that it was already night, most of them were probably in danger.
...
"Huh? Did Dad go downstairs?"
Inside the bedroom, Ji Ruxue sensed Lu Chuan leaving.
"Could it be Dad was summoned by that Zombie King again to fight the Nine Deaths Demon Police?"
Ji Ruxue pondered for a moment and then followed him downstairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Thank You, Expert, for Saving Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 63: Thank You, Expert, for Saving Me!
Ji Ruxue went down the stairs and pushed open the unit door, this was the first time she had left the building since her rebirth.
Lu Chuan chose to live in Building No. 5, which was still a distance from the entrance of the district.
After glancing at the terrain, Ji Ruxue quietly used the green belts and various public facilities to shield herself as she ran to the vicinity of Building No. 1.
Building No. 1 was close to the district gate, and to observe more closely, Ji Ruxue directly opened the unit door and sneakily went up to the second floor of Building No. 1.
Here, through the window on the second floor, she could just see the battle happening at the entrance.
Since single combat could not defeat the opponent, Lu Chuan assembled all his Corpse Puppets to the entrance.Thɪs updatᴇd by N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Under his control, Lightning One and Two respectively joined the battle.
For Zhao Lin, the rest of the ordinary Corpse Puppets actually posed not much of a threat, only serving as a slight nuisance.
Though these Corpse Puppets were different from ordinary zombies, able to continuously wield axe blades, there was still a significant gap in physical quality between the two sides.
Simply relying on these cold weapons, it was very difficult to close the power gap with the Evolvers.
After all, these ordinary zombies didn’t even have one-tier power, while Zhao Lin had now reached equivalent to a two-tier expert after continuous breakthroughs.
Luckily, Lu Chuan’s defense for these ordinary zombies was very thorough, each wore a helmet, otherwise, they might have been counter-killed by Zhao Lin as soon as they met.
Lu Chuan simply let the ordinary zombies retreat to the side, allowing the Three-headed Evolved Zombies to join forces, instantly putting huge pressure on Zhao Lin.
Besides Da Pang, standing at the front as a tank-type zombie for offense and defense, there were also two agile zombies.
At this moment, Zhao Lin could only continuously dodge the attacks from the evolved zombies, using the terrain outside the district to distance herself from Da Pang, while meticulously avoiding the encirclement of the two agile zombies.
Although constant roars were heard in her ears, Zhao Lin still showed no intention of retreat.
Perhaps having experienced life and death, Zhao Lin became bolder at this moment.
Moreover, she had been killed twice by Da Pang, feeling the sensation of death twice, her originally sensitive nerves became somewhat desensitized.
"A bunch of bloodthirsty monsters! Today I’ll see what strength you have to wantonly slaughter humans!"
After becoming an Evolver, Zhao Lin’s strength grew stronger and her confidence increased.
Relying on her combat skills trained in the police force, Zhao Lin temporarily exploded with remarkable strength during the zombie siege.
Especially realizing her allies might have died among the zombies, this enraged Zhao Lin greatly.
To Zhao Lin, she had been fighting life and death alongside these allies.
Since the apocalypse descended, for survivors, more or less, family members, relatives, or allies were killed by zombies.
Alongside these officers at the police station for over a month, Zhao Lin developed very deep emotions towards everyone.
Her life-and-death allies might have perished, which fueled Zhao Lin’s anger to kill the zombies for revenge.
Though Zhao Lin appeared slender and weak, at this moment, she fully erupted with power, even the Three-headed Evolved Zombies found it hard to suppress her temporarily.
The more she fought, the fiercer she became, because she remembered she had the ability to resurrect.
Originally she kept dodging, but now she directly charged into the zombie horde, fighting recklessly, as if she didn’t care about her life.
Ji Ruxue upstairs glanced around the battlefield, finding her father hidden among those ordinary zombies not engaging in combat.
This allowed Ji Ruxue to breathe a sigh of relief.
"As expected, although Dad is influenced by that Corpse King, maybe because he possesses human consciousness, he isn’t completely controlled to act as cannon fodder!"
As for other zombies, Ji Ruxue didn’t care, so long as her zombie father was safe that was enough.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan’s true self was mixed among several ordinary Corpse Puppets, his figure not conspicuous at all.
Seeing the Three-headed Evolved Zombies couldn’t manage Zhao Lin alone, this surprised Lu Chuan a bit.
At that moment, he split his telekinesis to control six Corpse Puppets, directly raising the police guns in their hands targeting Zhao Lin.
Bang bang bang!
In the silent night, the urgent gunfire suddenly erupted.
Zhao Lin’s heart tightened immediately, hastily dodging as much as she could.
But although she was a second-tier Evolver, she still couldn’t outpace bullets.
Moreover, there were the Three-headed Evolved Zombies harassing from the side.
Despite Zhao Lin’s best efforts to evade, she was ultimately shot in the arm, blood flowing continuously.
The pain of the bullet piercing her body made Zhao Lin gasp uncontrollably, cold sweat instantly forming on her forehead.
Zhao Lin looked at the group of zombies wielding guns in front of her, shock filling her eyes.
"How is this possible?! These ordinary zombies only know how to bite, how could they even use guns?!"
Staring at the dark gun barrels before her, Zhao Lin’s heart skipped a beat.
Even as an Evolver, she couldn’t withstand bullet shots.
Being shot by zombies using guns originally meant for humans, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but feel utterly humiliated at the thought.
From the second floor, Ji Ruxue observed the scene thoroughly, subconsciously exclaiming, "What a terrifying Corpse King!"
"It already learned how to use human weapons in such a short time, absolutely extraordinary!"
Ji Ruxue frowned tightly, "Looks like this Corpse King in Sunshine District must be eliminated quickly, if allowed to grow further, the consequences are unimaginable!"
People just died in Sunshine District during the day, and by nightfall the Corpse King had learned to use firearms, Ji Ruxue truly didn’t dare let it grow anymore, lest anything unexpected happen.
On the other side, Lu Chuan saw Zhao Lin’s arm injured, immediately controlling the evolved zombies for a swift attack.
The injury to one arm greatly reduced Zhao Lin’s combat power, for a time she could only dodge continuously in the face of the assault.
Due to the massive blood loss, her speed was also somewhat affected.
Originally Zhao Lin barely managed to fend off the Three-headed Evolved Zombies’ siege, but now injured, she gradually fell behind.
"While you’re sick, I’ll take your life! Die!"
Lu Chuan seized the chance to control Da Pang, swinging the iron hammer, preparing a fatal blow.
But at that moment, Da Pang’s sturdy body suddenly halted for a second in mid-air.
Just that brief moment allowed Zhao Lin to narrowly avoid that fatal strike.
Simultaneously, a slightly childish voice echoed in Zhao Lin’s mind.
"What are you looking at? Hurry and run!"
"Remember to meet me at the breakfast shop next to the district tomorrow night!"
Only then did Zhao Lin realize she had just been saved, immediately seizing the chance to flee towards the distance, while shouting around, "Thank you, senior, for your help!"

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Staying Low Is the True Path to Survival
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 64: Staying Low Is the True Path to Survival
In the silence of the night, Zhao Lin’s voice suddenly rang out loudly.
Ji Ruxue on the second floor was left speechless upon hearing the commotion.
Mystic?
Mystic my ass!
Do I look like a mystic to you?
Does this policewoman have some serious brain issues?
Even at a time like this, she’s not hurrying to escape and has to say such a thing.
Does she think she’s shooting a martial arts film?!
To Ji Ruxue, it even seemed like Zhao Lin shouting out loud in front of all the zombies was no different from selling out her teammates...
If she hadn’t seen this policewoman getting killed twice by evolved zombies, Ji Ruxue would have suspected Zhao Lin of intentionally tipping off the zombies.
"Was she this stupid even before the apocalypse? No wonder she, despite her monstrous talent, stopped short at the Emperor Level."
"I originally thought she encountered some danger in the early apocalypse, which is why she used her revival chances so quickly. Now it seems that this woman might have died from her own stupidity!"
Glancing at the zombie horde below, Ji Ruxue shook her head helplessly.
Thankfully, the opponents were just zombies; after all, such level of zombies shouldn’t possess intelligence to communicate with humans normally, probably not understanding human language either.
What Ji Ruxue had just used was a special ability she learned from a secret realm in her previous life.
It’s a secret technique that transmits sound silently, using her own telekinesis to convey her words directly into the other party’s consciousness for mental communication.
This secret technique allowed Ji Ruxue to communicate with others successfully in the apocalypse without making any sound.
Although the technique was only half-successful today, as she indeed didn’t make a sound, Zhao Lin’s parting proclamation announced it to the world...
Ji Ruxue’s purpose in taking action this time was to establish a connection with the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
Slaying the Corpse King inside Sunshine District was urgent, Ji Ruxue didn’t want to see it continue developing its strength.
Therefore, she had to quickly establish cooperation with the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
Without this demon police officer with second-level strength and the ability to keep reviving, Ji Ruxue herself wasn’t confident in taking down the Corpse King completely.
Moreover, Zhao Lin had been killed twice in two consecutive days at Sunshine District’s entrance; Ji Ruxue didn’t want this fool to waste another life here.
"Better hurry back to the bedroom; after the battle, my dad should be returning soon."
Seeing many zombies starting to head back into the district, Ji Ruxue rushed to leave Building One, quickly running back into Building Five.
With continuous practice and the enhancement of telekinesis over this time, Ji Ruxue had gained impressive speed.
Lu Chuan stood still, watching the injured policewoman disappear swiftly into the night, choosing not to send Corpse Meat to chase.
He just watched her leave with a serious expression.
After all, earlier in the day, Lu Chuan had just faced a diversion tactic; thankfully, the Corpse Puppets in the district were strong enough to wipe out that squad. Who knows if other characters will appear here?
But Lu Chuan was puzzled by Zhao Lin’s words just now.
"Thanks to the mystic for the rescue? Could there be another hidden human formidable nearby?"
Lu Chuan cautiously scanned the surroundings, but these streets looked no different from usual.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFirenᴇt
There was not a hint of disturbance, nothing seemed out of place.
Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets stationed nearby hadn’t detected any anomalies either.
Nonetheless, Lu Chuan was very mindful of Zhao Lin’s words; he immediately started dispersing numerous Corpse Puppets to search around.
But even after turning the place inside out, Lu Chuan found no trace of other humans.
The lack of human presence didn’t relieve Lu Chuan; instead, it made him even more cautious.
Lu Chuan believed that the policewoman’s words couldn’t be baseless. After all, facing such a group of ’brain-dead’ zombies, there was no reason for her to do that just before escaping.
That behavior clearly seemed like a signal to others.
"Strange... Who on earth is this policewoman talking to?"
Lu Chuan recalled controlling Da Pang’s state earlier. Initially, he could have dealt a lethal blow to the policewoman.
But at that moment, for some reason, his actions seemed to pause, allowing her to escape by luck.
These thoughts furrowed Lu Chuan’s brow.
His controlled Corpse Puppets wouldn’t stall for no reason. Could there really be another human hiding nearby?
And able to go undetected by him?!
The thought that a potential evolver might have intervened silently affecting the fight with Zhao Lin caused a chill in Lu Chuan’s heart.
The abilities of these human evolvers, each one seems more bizarre than the last?!
Lu Chuan initially thought that post-Blood Moon, the ability he gained to control zombies was already quite extraordinary.
Yet the recent string of events made him realize there are many evolvers in this apocalypse, not to be underestimated.
Even this seemingly dim-witted policewoman could revive twice and have her combat power double,
it’s hard for Lu Chuan to ensure what level of power other human evolvers already have now...
Zhao Lin’s shouts tonight also made Lu Chuan more cautious.
Lu Chuan nodded to himself secretly, deciding to remain well-hidden henceforth. One never knows when an evolver might pop up from some corner.
If these human evolvers discovered that all these zombies are under his control, they would surely think of capturing him first to remove the leader.
Given that he had only reached level two and was not the kind focused on physical enhancement,
If targeted by human evolvers, he might face grim odds.
Lu Chuan decided to stay careful, staying low and not acting recklessly is the best strategy.
This policewoman, although smashed to a pulp by him, could still revive on the spot and even have her strength doubled. Such a talent ability was simply too absurd.
Lu Chuan didn’t believe he shared a similar revival ability like that policewoman.
On the other side, Ji Ruxue, who had saved Zhao Lin, returned to her bedroom and began pondering how to connect with the Nine Deaths Demon Police tomorrow.
If it were in her previous life, there would naturally be no hesitation, directly meeting the opponent. But the problem is, she’s been reborn...
Looking at her now petite and delicate infant body, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but feel utterly speechless.
Meeting others in this state would surely leave anyone flabbergasted...

chapters.title: Chapter 65: New Type of Zombie—Tyrant
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 65: New Type of Zombie—Tyrant
The next day.
After the police invaded the district yesterday, Lu Chuan was furious and prepared to take over the police station with his Corpse Puppets.
However, the formidable strength Zhao Lin displayed last night made Lu Chuan reconsider and abandon this plan.
He hadn’t expected this female officer to be so abnormal, dying so many times yet still capable of reviving and growing stronger.
With such a powerful Evolver in command, plus the possibility of other officers in the station, Lu Chuan had no absolute confidence he could take them down.
The most crucial issue is that an Evolver can continuously break through and advance. If this female officer escapes, it would be a hidden threat.
Lu Chuan prefers to eliminate threats completely, ensuring no latent dangers remain.
The problem is... this female officer can resurrect...
Lu Chuan now even hesitated to kill her completely, fearing that she would revive right after being killed.
He never imagined that the female officer whom he casually killed with one blow upon their first meeting would become such a vexing presence.
Not killing her leaves a threat that could potentially harm him.
Killing her might even help her evolve faster, making her even stronger...Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Right, next time I encounter her, I’ll just break her limbs to restrict her movement; if killing her makes her stronger, why not just avoid killing her?
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction. Dealing with someone who can revive, just make sure she can’t use her Resurrection Ability.
Lu Chuan didn’t believe that this woman could restore her body to normal if she was left in a half-dead state.
However, there was another concern troubling Lu Chuan.
Standing on the balcony, Lu Chuan looked down at the district and the surrounding streets, his crimson eyes filled with solemnity.
Yesterday, Zhao Lin’s mysterious shout was, in Lu Chuan’s view, definitely not without basis.
This means there’s another, even more mysterious Evolver around Sunshine District, besides the strange female officer!
His controlled Da Pang suddenly stalled, allowing the female officer to avoid a fatal blow.
Coupled with her nonsensical words, Lu Chuan was convinced that there might be other Human Evolvers around who could evade his detection.
Crucially, these two Human Evolvers appeared to be helping each other, standing united to confront him...
"Who did I provoke?"
"I’m just guarding my own district, why do Evolvers keep showing up to trouble me?!"
Lu Chuan was exasperated; he had discovered the Survivor Base long ago but didn’t bother them.
He just wanted to live peacefully with Little Qiqi, but unexpectedly found himself being coveted.
If he had occupied some strategic location, that would be one thing, but what value does this rundown district have?!
Enough to warrant two such monstrous Evolvers working together?!
After venting helplessly, Lu Chuan’s mind became heavier. Recent events made him feel the onset of a crisis, filling him with unease.
Originally, having advanced to the second stage and controlling three Evolved Zombies and over twenty ordinary zombies was considered a formidable force to him.
Yet the abnormal Evolvers he encountered recently made Lu Chuan realize his strength was still insufficient; he urgently needed to enhance his power.
As a zombie, the only way to increase his strength is through constantly devouring Crystal Cores.
Thus, early in the morning, Lu Chuan dispatched ten ordinary Corpse Puppets to patrol the surroundings, hoping to find more zombies.
...
Police Station.
"Zhao Lin, where are Wang and the others? Why did only you return?"
Officer Liu, responsible for defending the police station, was surprised to see Zhao Lin returning alone and asked this.
Meanwhile, Zhao Lin’s return drew the attention of everyone in the station, and they all ran out immediately.
Seeing Zhao Lin’s bloodied arm and her solitary return, everyone’s faces changed.
With a pained expression, Zhao Lin shook her head under the astonished eyes of her comrades.
"I thought that after drawing away the Evolved Zombie at the entrance, everyone would safely retrieve the keys, but I didn’t expect that inside the district were three Evolved Zombies and over twenty ordinary zombies."
"I’m sorry, everyone, we underestimated the zombies’ power in the district..."
Upon hearing Zhao Lin’s words, everyone in the police station couldn’t help but gasp.
They hadn’t expected so many zombies in just an old district.
"Wait, if there were so many zombies in the district, how did you make it back?"
Officer Liu looked at Zhao Lin with some suspicion and asked, his tone full of doubt.
"Xiao Wang and the others all went out with guns, and they all ended up dead in the district, yet you came back alive alone? Could it be that you alone could handle that many zombies?!"
Zhao Lin immediately recounted everything that happened in the Sunshine District, even revealing to everyone that her evolutionary ability was resurrection.
However, Zhao Lin’s words only provoked laughter from the people in the police station.
"Zhao Lin, don’t you think your words are too ridiculous?"
"Resurrection? Do you think we are three-year-olds?"
"Besides, after resurrection, you can handle so many zombies at the same time? Are you fooling a ghost?!"
Hearing Zhao Lin talk about resurrection, some survivors became agitated and shouted at Zhao Lin in anger: "You’re ridiculous! In the apocalypse, so many have died, none have come back, yet you can resurrect, why?!"
"We all have relatives and friends who have died and left us forever, and you’re saying you can resurrect? Are you deceiving us or insulting us?!"
"So many officers sacrificed themselves for us to get to the survivor base, why didn’t you die? I think you ran away and got them all killed, right?!"
"Exactly, maybe she implicated everyone because she was scared!"
People criticized Zhao Lin endlessly, even those officers who had faced life and death with her now looked very grim.
Zhao Lin’s resurrection ability seemed too defiant of nature, and no one was willing to believe her.
Faced with incessant accusations, Zhao Lin was stunned for a moment.
She didn’t understand why everyone’s attitude had changed so drastically, clearly she was the one trying to help everyone leave the city and safely relocate to the human survival base.
Clearly, she risked her own life battling zombies, even dying twice at their hands.
If it weren’t for the help of a master, she might have lost her third life as well.
Yet the survivors who greeted her with smiles not long ago, all changed their tune overnight.
Not only did they not believe her words, but they also began to accuse and insult her.
It seemed that her successful escape from the zombie siege was a mistake, as if she should have died along with the team members in the Sunshine District...
Zhao Lin clenched her fists; since no one believed her, she simply stopped explaining.
At this moment, Zhao Lin quietly decided in her heart that she must go to the Sunshine District to get the truck keys and avenge her fallen comrades.
Recalling her agreement with the master last night, Zhao Lin decided to go to Sunshine District again tonight.
...
Lu Chuan brought the fried rice to Ji Ruxue, who then started wolfing it down.
Seeing the little one being so cute, Lu Chuan felt some relief from the stress caused by these human survivors.
"Little one, you can really eat, I think calling you Little Taotie suits you better."
Seeing Ji Ruxue being so adorable, Lu Chuan became more determined to quickly increase his strength, ensuring that no one disturbed the peaceful life with his daughter.
As Lu Chuan watched Little Qiqi eating continuously, a sudden thought struck him.
A Corpse Puppet that was out patrolling suddenly noticed a commotion on the street.
A group of survivors was fleeing, being chased by an Evolved Zombie.
This Evolved Zombie was unlike any that Lu Chuan had seen before.
The creature appeared extremely irritable, radiating an aura of violence, causing even the Corpse Puppets under Lu Chuan’s control to tremble.
Most critically, the zombie’s arms had completely transformed into claws, and with a swing of those powerful claws, it ripped deep grooves into the concrete road, flipping parked cars with ease.
Moreover, the power and speed displayed by this zombie were unparalleled, far exceeding any zombie Lu Chuan had encountered.
The survivors stood no chance against this zombie.
Among them, only a man in a black vest could barely fight it with a steel blade, while the others were slaughtered one by one.
Lu Chuan noticed that the man in the black vest was the strong Evolver he had encountered before.
"Such a strong self-healing ability!"
Switching perspectives, Lu Chuan observed that the wounds the blade-wielding Evolver inflicted on the zombie healed in no time!
Could this be a new type of zombie?
Furthermore, that aura had obviously advanced to the second tier.
Seeing this Evolved Zombie resembling a Tyrant, Lu Chuan was quite shocked.
Lu Chuan hurried downstairs with Lightning One and Da Pang towards the scene.
Lightning Two was left in the district to protect Little Qiqi.
As Lu Chuan hastily left the district again, Ji Ruxue frowned: "Is dad going to carry out Corpse King’s task again?"

chapters.title: Chapter 66: The Undead Body, Right? Then Do Me a Favor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 66: The Undead Body, Right? Then Do Me a Favor!
"Gangzi! Help!"
"Help, don’t leave me behind! I don’t want to die!"
"Gangzi, didn’t you say you would look out for us?!"
The survivors’ bleak cries echoed endlessly on the streets, but all that was returned was the frenzied slaughter by the Evolved Zombie.
This Evolved Zombie seemed even more brutal than any zombies seen before, with arms like claws swinging wildly; those holding short steel bars were no match for him.
"Damn it! I can’t even protect myself!"
Gangzi’s hand holding the machete was trembling uncontrollably, watching his followers around him fall one by one, his legs felt weak.
What kind of monster is this?!
Looking at the corpses sprawled on the ground, Gangzi’s body shook uncontrollably.
In this apocalypse, Gangzi had encountered many zombies, some who could even wield axes.
But those zombies had been easily slaughtered by him after evolving.
Yet the terror standing in front of him now felt like an apocalyptic Tyrant, pushing forward with unstoppable force.
Gangzi couldn’t believe such a terrifying existence could be in the world!
Roar!
Originally, there were over a dozen followers with Gangzi, but against this zombie, they were almost instantly wiped out.
Gangzi looked down at his machete, which had become nicked and chipped from constant battle.
Yet on the zombie’s body, wounds would heal in an instant.
"Damn it! Why can these zombies evolve so quickly?"
Seeing he was no match, Gangzi turned to flee, as there was no hope in defeating this zombie with tremendous power.
As for the cries of his fallen comrades, he couldn’t afford to pay any attention to them.
In the apocalypse, one must fend for oneself, especially those who hadn’t been with him long.
Gangzi quickly ran to a pile of abandoned cars, trying to use them to block the zombie’s attack.
But the zombie’s physique was incredibly robust, with terrifying strength, his massive claws pushing through the debris like making a path.
Feeling the wind behind him, Gangzi turned abruptly, swinging his machete defensively.
Bang!
With just one strike, the Tyrant Zombie sent him flying.
He crashed heavily into a car, denting the door.
The Tyrant Zombie’s immense force and recoil made Gangzi cough up blood.
Whoosh!
The zombie sprang suddenly from his position like a spring.
Its huge body descended like a cannonball, causing Gangzi’s pupils to dilate as he rolled to the side quickly.
Without hesitation, Gangzi turned to flee, but he couldn’t match the speed of the already two-tier Tyrant Zombie.
What the hell is this thing?!
These Evolved Zombies are either incredibly strong or incredibly fast, why is this one both?!"
Boom boom boom!
With his evolved strength, Gangzi could barely exchange a few blows with the Tyrant, but only in defense.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
In just moments, Gangzi’s body was cut with several wounds, even revealing bone on his back.
Had he not been an Evolver, he’d be torn in half.
With several injuries, Gangzi reached a narrow alley and leapt in.
Bang!
As Gangzi landed, a loud crash erupted behind him, the Tyrant’s evolved massive body unable to fit in the narrow alley.
This alley was so narrow, only an average adult could pass through, and the Tyrant was too large to enter.
"Damn it! Someday I’ll kill you!"
Watching the blocked Tyrant Zombie at the alley entrance, Gangzi gasped for breath, his face pale.
One more second, and he would’ve been torn apart mid-air by the zombie.
...
This big guy seems a bit troublesome!
I didn’t expect even a Human Evolver could barely fight back against it...
The brutal scene of the Tyrant Zombie was entirely captured by Lu Chuan through the Corpse Puppet.
The previously powerful evolving man, who almost sent his Corpse Puppet Axe flying, nearly died at the hands of this zombie.
Having witnessed the Tyrant’s great combat abilities, Lu Chuan didn’t dare let Lightning or Da Pang engage directly.
Initially, he hoped to defeat it by numbers, but the zombie’s evolution seemed to have transformed its power amazingly!
With current abilities, neither Da Pang nor Lightning could defeat it, possibly even getting killed in return.
Lu Chuan only had three Evolved Zombies, and he couldn’t afford to lose generals like Da Pang and Lightning.
Lu Chuan frowned, having advanced to tier two, consuming first-tier Crystal Cores had little effect now.
After searching around so long with the Corpse Puppet, he couldn’t bear to let this tier two zombie go.
There’s always a way, I refuse to believe I can’t take you down!
After pondering awhile, Lu Chuan’s eyes brightened with a new idea.
With a decision of mind, he controlled Lightning to swiftly charge toward the Tyrant Zombie.
As fellow Evolved Zombies, the Tyrant immediately sensed Lightning’s presence.
Missing a human already made the Tyrant very angry, and now seeing Lightning approach, blood lust flashed in its eyes.
Compared to humans, the Crystal Cores in Evolved Zombies’ heads were far more tempting.
Seeing the Tyrant Zombie notice him, Lu Chuan quickly controlled Lightning to flee in the opposite direction.
The Tyrant chased after him, trampling the still-alive survivors into mud along the way.
This Tyrant Zombie was already a tier two and in terms of speed, no weaker than the agile Lightning One.
But Lu Chuan proved once again the difference between brains and brawn.
Controlling the Lightning zombie, and with his familiarity of the terrain and leveraging agility, Lu Chuan kept ahead by several positions.
Failing to catch Lightning, the Tyrant Zombie became angrier.
Yet because Lu Chuan deliberately chose complex terrains, the Tyrant was constantly blocked by obstacles.
The more it raged, the less it kept up, only being distanced by Lu Chuan.
Controlling Lightning, Lu Chuan soon saw the heavily guarded police station ahead.
Lu Chuan’s plan was to lead the Tyrant Zombie to confront the eerie revived policewoman.
When snipe and clam quarrel, the fisherman benefits.
Both of these entities were troublesome, for now, Lu Chuan did not want to face either solo.
So he’d resort to driving the tiger to swallow the wolf: see whether the tier two zombie or the tier two Evolver was stronger.
"Don’t you have an Undead Body, policewoman? Lend a hand!"

First time writing original, skills are lacking, please bear with me, be gentle... The author will try hard to finish and improve the plot.
Regarding readers’ concern about the protagonist’s identity revelation, it should be explained in a dozen or so Chapters, please be patient, complain less and toss the book less...

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Zhao Lin’s Battle Against the Tyrant
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Chapter 67: Zhao Lin’s Battle Against the Tyrant
Inside the dilapidated store, the goods that used to fill the shelves have long disappeared.
Even the remaining few items are now rotting and foul-smelling.
Inside, many splattered bloodstains could still be seen, long congealed and dried into black patches.
There are several corpses visible in the store, but oddly, none of them show signs of being torn apart.
Zhao Lin glanced at them briefly and determined that these bodies were all the work of humans.
Evidently, after the apocalypse erupted, people resorted to every means possible to acquire supplies.
Human morality was thrown aside; even for a loaf of bread, someone could stab another in the back.
Looking at the desolation before her, Zhao Lin furrowed her brow tightly.
"Damn it, the food is becoming increasingly scarce now."
Looking at her somewhat deflated backpack, Zhao Lin felt quite helpless.
The entire morning she had searched the neighborhoods and stores within a two or three-kilometer radius around the police station, yet still came up empty-handed.
Yesterday, everyone who accompanied Zhao Lin on an outing died in the Sunshine District, resulting in no one willing to venture out with Zhao Lin for supplies today.
However, the reserve resources at the police station are dwindling; if they fail to find enough supplies soon, sustaining everyone will be impossible.
To ensure everyone could continue on with enough resources, Zhao Lin had no choice but to search for funds alone.
But even as an Evolver, she only has two hands and two legs, unable to manage quick searches.
All morning, she’d only gathered two bottles of mineral water, a bottle of juice, two pieces of bread, and a block of chocolate – hardly enough for herself.
"It seems post-apocalypse living in the city requires attention not only to zombies but also to these increasingly scarce resources."
Zhao Lin sighed softly, her gaze full of helplessness.
The start of the apocalypse signaled the world ceasing, and city resources that used to update daily became limited products.
Looking at these corpses from human hands, Zhao Lin felt both anger and helplessness in her gaze.Thɪs updatᴇd by Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
As a police officer, combating crime was her duty before the world ended.
Yet she never thought that what she once upheld, societal order, would collapse entirely when zombies appeared...
Zhao Lin clasped her fist and then reluctantly loosened it.
Taking out the map she carried, she checked the surrounding areas.
Most places on the map were marked already – sites she’d searched before.
Even unmarked places, like the shop she was currently in, had experienced plundering from other survivors.
"If there’s no food anymore, I honestly don’t know what everyone will do next..."
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Suddenly, amid Zhao Lin’s contemplation, distant gunshots rang out.
"Oh no! Something’s happened at the police station!"
Upon hearing the shots, Zhao Lin’s complexion changed instantly; she sprinted towards it.
Returning to the police station, Zhao Lin was instantly stunned by what she saw.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
The Tyrant Zombie, led by Lu Chuan, had arrived at the police station.
However, since Lu Chuan anticipated the station’s defenses, he hid among various buildings upon arrival.
The massive Tyrant appeared in the survivors’ sight; the police fired without hesitation.
But this zombie was terrifyingly powerful, charging directly to the station entrance while enduring bullets.
Despite reinforced doors, they now seemed precarious under the Tyrant’s crazed strikes.
Survivors inside the station were all pale with fright – never had they seen such a terrifying Evolved Zombie in their two months of apocalypse survival.
