Especially civilians who’ve relied on police aid, never scavenged for resources, never faced zombies – they were more bewildered.
The iron-door thuds from zombie blows were like heavy hammers on their hearts.
As the station’s iron door threatened to break under the Tyrant’s assault, everyone held their breath, eyes full of terror.
The Tyrant Zombie’s massive body, and power beyond comprehension, drove the crowd into despair.
Zhao Lin arrived just as the Tyrant Zombie crazily battered the station doors.
Fearing the door collapse, Zhao Lin rushed forward without hesitation.
Without a word, she raised her gun to shoot the Tyrant Zombie.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Ignoring everything else, Zhao Lin fired at the zombie, trying to divert its attention.
It worked – upon seeing a human firing at it, the Evolved Zombie felt gravely provoked.
Roaring madly now, its enormous claws unleashed terrifying power.
Hearing gunfire outside, everyone inside the station reacted, hurrying out to investigate.
They realized it was Zhao Lin, who had ventured for supplies alone today, returning single-handedly to divert the zombie.
Survivors who had mocked Zhao Lin that morning suddenly changed their tune, all faces warmed and delighted.
"Officer Zhao, please save us!"
"Officer Zhao, quickly divert this zombie. Otherwise, the door will be breached."
"Officer Zhao, aren’t you the one always protecting the defenseless survivors like us? If the zombie gets in, none of us will survive; please lure it away!"
The survivors sobbed, viewing Zhao Lin as their savior.
Engaged in shooting the zombie, Zhao Lin paused hearing their voices.
The gunfire halted; discontent reverberated inside the station.
"Officer Zhao, didn’t you say you could revive yesterday? Was that a lie?"
"Since you can revive, dying once more shouldn’t matter – exchanging your life for ours, isn’t that right?"
"True, as an Evolver, you can revive, so why fear? Divert the zombie quickly!"
Once sobbing survivors sounded impatient toward the end.
Zhao Lin tightly clenched her fist, feeling tremendously conflicted.
Yet gazing at her police badge on her chest, thinking of her duty as an officer, determination flashed through Zhao Lin’s eyes.
She continued shooting to attract the Tyrant Zombie, deciding to lead it away.
Lu Chuan watched from the shadows, shaking his head helplessly.
"This woman... she’s admirably stupid indeed..."

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Gas Station! Burning the Tyrant!
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 68: Gas Station! Burning the Tyrant!
Lu Chuan also didn’t expect that even though the apocalypse had already been ongoing for over two months, there were still people like Zhao Lin in this world.
After the apocalypse, what was known as humanity had long been abandoned by everyone, and survival was the only king in this cruel world.
As a zombie, Lu Chuan had seen with his own eyes how survivors, in order to stay alive, had long learned what it means to stop at nothing.
And Zhao Lin in front of him was just a pure fool, a fool who doesn’t even realize she’s being used.
It’s quite clear that these survivors in the police station are no different from vampires, constantly draining the value of these officers.
Lu Chuan could see that there were actually quite a few survivors inside the police station.
If these survivors had swarmed yesterday, his district might really not have withstood the attack of so many people.
But these despicable, greedy guys just want to reap without sowing, and even now, they don’t care in the slightest about Zhao Lin’s life.
Although this kind of character is very vile, for the apocalypse, precisely such selfish people can live longer.
A silly woman like Zhao Lin, if she still maintains this self-sacrificing mindset, is doomed not to survive in the apocalypse.
At this moment, Zhao Lin, for the faith in her heart, unhesitatingly decided to use her life to attract this second-tier zombie. As someone who was once human, Lu Chuan did have a modicum of respect for her in his heart.
After all, Lu Chuan asked himself, he couldn’t be so selfless, he couldn’t contribute his life for a group of strangers.
Such behavior seemed utterly foolish to him.
"Stupid woman, I hope you can help me seriously wound this second-tier zombie, so I didn’t save your life in vain back then..."
The Tyrant was also successfully attracted by Zhao Lin’s attack, immediately charging fiercely towards her.
Its massive body sped across the ground, and even though it had yet to rush close, it was already exerting immense pressure on Zhao Lin.
Even though she was a strong second-tier, Zhao Lin could clearly feel that this Tyrant zombie was exerting immense pressure on her.
Bang!
As soon as they clashed, Zhao Lin was sent flying, shock filling her beautiful eyes.
Damn! How is this Evolved Zombie so strong?!
Last night, she fought the Three-headed Evolved Zombie of Sunshine District without faltering, but today she found herself having difficulty handling this one zombie alone.
Could it be that this zombie has successfully evolved once more on its original base?
Its strength is simply not one that ordinary Evolved Zombies can compare to!
Zhao Lin was momentarily extremely shocked, and after the clash, she could only rely on her agile physique and rich combat techniques to keep dodging.
Bang, bang, bang!
The Tyrant zombie’s terrifying claws swung like a spear thrust, bringing a sound of air being pierced.
Zhao Lin’s eyelids twitched, these claws brushed past her body, the car behind her was easily pierced through like tofu!
Zhao Lin was shocked, if these terrifying claws attacked her, they could probably pierce right through her in an instant!
Zhao Lin seized the opportunity to land a fierce punch on the zombie’s body, but unexpectedly, the muscles of this Evolved Zombie were so refined that her attack didn’t cause it any effective harm!
Helplessly, Zhao Lin could only backflip away from the claws, using the car roof to jump several meters away, then turned and fired directly at the Tyrant.
Bang, bang, bang!
This zombie was extremely fast, Zhao Lin didn’t hold back at all and emptied the magazine.
Fortunately, she was already a second-tier Evolver, and her marksmanship had significantly improved.
Although the zombie dodged many bullets, several still hit its body.
But the next second, Zhao Lin was shocked by the scene before her.
These bullets that hit the zombie didn’t affect its combat capability at all.
Soon after, Zhao Lin noticed the muscles on the Tyrant’s body began to writhe continuously.
The 9mm bullets she had shot in were actually forced out by its muscles.
The bleeding wounds were healing visibly, and before long, the wounds had closed up.
"Damn! What kind of monster is this?!"
Both are zombies, why is this Evolved Zombie so formidable?
Not only does it have formidable combat power, it also possesses outstanding healing abilities?!
Zhao Lin’s beautiful eyes were filled with shock.
Damn it, I absolutely can’t go head-to-head with this guy anymore!
Realizing the enormous power gap between them, Zhao Lin didn’t fight back anymore and turned to run away.
Now, all she could do was run as far as possible, trying her best to lure this zombie away.
With such formidable strength, Zhao Lin really didn’t have the confidence to engage with it.
The Tyrant zombie let out a loud, angry roar, and the zombies wandering by the roadside shuddered uncontrollably upon hearing it.
The Tyrant immediately charged towards Zhao Lin, and trailing behind the two second-tier powerhouses was an Agile Type first-tier zombie.
Which was exactly ’Lightning One’ under Lu Chuan’s control.
Zhao Lin was being chased by the zombie, forced to flee franticly.
But just then, she noticed a gas station not far away, her eyes suddenly lighting up.
You monster, I’m going to burn you to death today!
Controlling Lightning One, Lu Chuan hung back at a distance.
Seeing Zhao Lin running straight towards the gas station, Lu Chuan’s pupils shrank.
"Oh boy, that crazy woman wouldn’t be thinking of..."
Soon, a gunshot confirmed Lu Chuan’s guess.
Bang!
Along with the gunshot, the gas station not far away instantly burst into blazing flames.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
The massive explosion startled even Lu Chuan watching from afar, the terrifying shockwave shattered all the glass in a radius of several miles.
Fortunately, this was a small gas station, so the oil reserves weren’t much.
Plus, after the apocalypse, it had been almost emptied, so it only ignited massive flames and small explosions, not enough to destroy the surrounding area.
Zhao Lin also escaped from the blaze, though her body was smoking, clothes tattered, looking like a beggar, extremely disheveled.
The shockwave also made blood constantly overflow from the corners of her mouth, and she collapsed after just a few steps out of the fire, gasping heavily.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
Within the blaze, came the angry roars of the furious Tyrant.
Lu Chuan and Zhao Lin could see a massive silhouette within the flames, thrashing and struggling.
Zhao Lin looked at the blazing fire, a cold smile curling on her lips.
"Can’t you self-heal? I don’t believe you won’t burn to death this time!"
The massive explosion began attracting zombies from all around, seeing the increasingly dense horde, Zhao Lin hurriedly limped away.
Moments later, a huge figure burst out from the flames, its whole body scorched, letting out sharp, painful roars.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Strike While He’s Down, Take His Life!
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 69: Strike While He’s Down, Take His Life!
The powerful second-tier zombie rushed out from the raging flames, its body still ablaze and charred beyond recognition.
Yet even so, its massive body continued to struggle incessantly.
The creature roared angrily and rolled around on the clearing, seemingly trying to extinguish the flames on its body.
"Are you kidding me, it’s not dead yet?!"
Watching the furious Tyrant zombie in the distance, Lu Chuan’s pupils shrank. He hadn’t expected that after enduring the explosion at the gas station, this Tyrant zombie could still survive.
Moreover, Lu Chuan noticed that not only was the zombie alive, but the charred parts of its skin seemed to be writhing, with the wounds from the explosion showing signs of healing!
Charred crispy skin continuously fell off it, revealing the new flesh underneath.
Although he’d seen the sword and gun wounds on this zombie heal before, Lu Chuan still hadn’t anticipated he had underestimated the foe.
Combat-type zombies advancing to the second tier are terrifying?!
Seeing the second-tier Tyrant zombie showing signs of recovery, a glint of frost flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes as he made a decisive move!
While you’re vulnerable!
I’ll take your life!
I don’t believe you can still be as ferocious as you were after the gas station explosion!
Lu Chuan immediately controlled Lightning along with ’Da Pang,’ quickly heading to the vicinity of the gas station.
Under the pressure of the Evolved Zombies, the ordinary zombies that had been drawn by the explosion sounds scattered away in avoidance.
Sensing the approach of fellow evolved zombies, the Tyrant, though heavily injured, struggled to stand up and roared towards ’Da Pang’ and Lightning.
Roar!
Lu Chuan’s heart grew heavy; the oppressive aura of this Tyrant zombie was indeed strong.
The key issue was that post-evolution, its size surpassed ’Da Pang’ by a significant margin, now pitch-black and emitting thick black smoke, with some flames yet to be extinguished.
Standing upright, this behemoth truly resembled a Demon Lord of Chaos.
Controlled by Lu Chuan, ’Da Pang’ said nothing and swung its double hammers, charging forward directly.
Seeing this, the Tyrant zombie instinctively attempted to dodge; however, though it survived the explosion, it had been severely wounded.
Bam!
Its movements slowed significantly due to its injuries, directly struck by ’Da Pang’s’ dual hammers on its back.
The body that had just risen fell again, with ’Lightning One’ closely following.
Under normal circumstances, ’Da Pang’ combined with ’Lightning One’ wouldn’t have been a match for the Tyrant.
But now, the heavily injured Tyrant was hammered down by ’Da Pang,’ rendering its body stiff.
Before it could react, ’Lightning One’ was already wielding dual blades, successfully closing in.
Roar!
The wounded Tyrant let out an angry roar, hoping to use its second-tier zombie aura to intimidate ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning One.’
But little did it know, Lu Chuan was controlling the two zombies from behind.
Faced with the Tyrant’s roar, Lu Chuan was unfazed, controlling ’Lightning One’ to swing the blades and sever the Tyrant’s arm
Without its arm, this heavily injured Tyrant’s actions became even more challenging.
’Da Pang,’ under Lu Chuan’s control, swung its hammers madly in relentless blows.
Despite the formidable flesh of the second-tier zombie, multiple bones broke under ’Da Pang’s’ furious hammering.
The massive-bodied Tyrant zombie was hammered down by ’Da Pang,’ unable to stand.
Simultaneously, ’Lightning One’s’ steel blade never ceased, continuously slicing the Tyrant’s legs.
To prevent a final desperate counterattack from the dying Tyrant, Lu Chuan prepared to sever its limbs first.
"Aren’t those Sunshine District’s evolved zombies? How did they end up here?!"
Seeing several evolved zombies fighting together, Zhao Lin was momentarily astonished.
Following the explosion at the gas station earlier, Zhao Lin chose to temporarily retreat when faced by the surrounding horde due to her severe injuries.
However, she hadn’t gone far, instead continuing to watch secretly.
Witnessing the charred Tyrant zombie emerge from the flames and still not die, Zhao Lin felt both aghast and anxious.
"Are you kidding me, even the gas station explosion couldn’t kill it?!"
Zhao Lin furrowed her slender brows, contemplating the next move.
Yet the next second, unexpectedly, two evolved zombies emerged from the shadows.
Soon, three evolved zombies began their relentless battle.
Upon seeing the Tyrant zombie hammered down by ’Da Pang,’ then having its arm and leg chopped off by ’Lightning One,’ Zhao Lin finally relaxed.
Though Sunshine District zombies were powerful, they remained within her coping range.
But the second-tier Tyrant zombie was truly unparalleled; seeing it now on the brink of death, Zhao Lin could finally rest easy.
"Let them tear each other apart! Hopefully, all three will mutually perish!"
Watching Sunshine District’s zombies, Zhao Lin recalled last night’s battle.
"Who exactly was that competent rescuer? To even influence evolved zombies, what kind of powers did they awaken?"
Reflecting on the voice heard the previous night, Zhao Lin felt this expert’s voice seemed rather youthful...
Quite a peculiar individual, but in this apocalyptic world, he must be like me a fellow evolver in order to survive.
No matter, we’ve already arranged a meeting tonight to unveil the identity of this mysterious figure.
With this thought, Zhao Lin glanced at the battlefield before limping away with her severely injured body.
Her current physical condition left much to be desired; if blocked by other evolved zombies, it would be disastrous.
After Zhao Lin departed, ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning One’ in Lu Chuan’s control pressed their advantage.
One exhaustedly swung the giant hammer, restricting the Tyrant’s actions.
The other wielded the steel blade incessantly, rapidly diminishing the opponent’s vitality.
In no time, the Tyrant finally lost all signs of life.
To ensure its complete demise, Lu Chuan first used ’Da Pang’ to shatter the brain with a distant strike.
Then ’Lightning One’ swiftly stepped forward, swinging the blade to decapitate the Tyrant.
Simultaneously extracting the Crystal Core from the Tyrant’s skull, Lu Chuan observed that the second-tier zombie’s core was indeed as he predicted: red with a substantial orange hue.
Seeing the second-tier zombie’s core, Lu Chuan was overjoyed, quickly controlling the zombies to hurry back to Sunshine District.
Considerable time had been spent for this second-tier core; perhaps Little Qiqi was already hungry.
Considering that each time he devoured a core, he’d fall into a coma, Lu Chuan decided to return home first to prepare a meal for Little Qiqi.
After all, he had no idea how long he’d be unconscious this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Devouring a Tier 2 Crystal Core! Power Boost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 70: Devouring a Tier 2 Crystal Core! Power Boost!
Sunshine District, seventh-floor bedroom.
"He’s been out for so long, why isn’t Dad back yet?"
"Could something have happened?"
Ji Ruxue stood on the balcony with binoculars, looking into the distance, her brows furrowed with worry.
The gas station caught fire, and even though Sunshine Home was some distance away, it was still visible.
Staring at the blazing flames and the billowing black smoke, Ji Ruxue instinctively thought of her zombie father.
Could the sudden fire at the gas station be related to Dad?
The thought barely surfaced when Ji Ruxue quickly shook her head.
Her zombie father always handled things steadily. Even under orders from the Corpse King, he would hide in the back and never be the cannon fodder; it shouldn’t be a problem.
Gurgle!
Lu Chuan hadn’t returned for so long that Ji Ruxue’s stomach began to rumble with hunger.
As she continued to grow, her ability to move had improved, but the energy consumption was also increasing.
Seeing that her zombie father still hadn’t come back, Ji Ruxue reluctantly went downstairs to scavenge for supplies.
Fortunately, her zombie father had stocked up quite a bit, and Ji Ruxue took out some biscuits to munch on.
Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but think about her agreement with the Nine Deaths Demon Police last night.
That silly woman isn’t exactly bright. I hope she doesn’t bail on me this time...
"Hmm? Back already?!"
At that moment, Ji Ruxue noticed her zombie father and some Corpse Puppets returning to the complex.
Seeing her zombie father safe, Ji Ruxue finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Now successfully obtaining a second-tier Crystal Core, Lu Chuan was delighted. While cooking for Little Qiqi, he even added an extra fried egg for her.
After all, just as he needed to devour Crystal Cores to evolve as a zombie, the little one needed energy to grow.
Watching the little one gobble up her food, Lu Chuan then grabbed the paper and pen Ji Ruxue used to practice writing.
"Dad has something to do this afternoon, so you stay home and do your homework."
Seeing the words her zombie father had written, Ji Ruxue wasn’t surprised anymore.
She had already accepted that her zombie father, though transformed, still retained his human consciousness.
"Got it, Dad. You go ahead with your work."
Ji Ruxue swallowed a bite of rice, looked up, and flashed a cute smile at Lu Chuan.
She felt secretly pleased, as she still needed to prepare for her meeting with the Nine Deaths Demon Police that night, and her zombie father unknowingly facilitated her plan.
After Little Qiqi finished eating, Lu Chuan turned and left.
This time, he intended to devour a Crystal Core from a second-tier Tyrant zombie, something he hadn’t done before, so he wasn’t sure what transformation it would bring.
Concerned that any commotion might disturb Little Qiqi’s studies, Lu Chuan relocated to the fourth building next door.
’Lightning Two’ was stationed below the fifth building to safeguard Little Qiqi.
’Da Pang,’ still wielding dual hammers, stood guard at the entrance of Sunshine District like a Gate God, valiantly holding the fort.
’Lightning One’ accompanied Lu Chuan to the fourth building.
He anticipated that after devouring the Crystal Core, he might fall into a coma and would rely on ’Lightning One’ for protection.
The enigmatic lady cop who had previously escaped had shouted a warning, making Lu Chuan aware that capable Evolvers might be lurking around his district.
Standing on the balcony, Lu Chuan looked outside a few times, ensuring all doors and windows were tightly closed to avoid detection by these Evolvers.
Taking the red-orange Crystal Core from ’Lightning One’s’ hand, Lu Chuan was thrilled.
It had been a while since he last consumed a Crystal Core, and he was eager to become stronger.
The Crystal Core was an entire blood-red color, mostly surrounded by an orange aura.
Lu Chuan speculated that when he reached the third tier, the Crystal Core might turn orange.
The Crystal Core looked exquisite, almost like a real crystal.
Holding it in his hand, his blood-red eyes seemed to bleed, filled with desire for the Crystal Core.
Without a second thought, Lu Chuan swallowed the red-orange Crystal Core.
Instantly, a vast power exploded within him.
This terrifying power surpassed all the Crystal Cores Lu Chuan had previously devoured, so intense that his body trembled uncontrollably.
Simultaneously, an invisible pressure emanated from Lu Chuan, causing ’Lightning One’s’ body, which was supposed to ensure safety, to shudder under this power.
Although Lu Chuan knew the Crystal Core from a second-tier Tyrant zombie would carry incredible energy, he underestimated the magnitude of its power!
Abundant energy surged into his body, filling every part with a terrifying force.
Lu Chuan, as a non-physically evolved zombie, had devoured numerous Crystal Cores with little change to his body.
Yet, once he ingested the second-tier Core, the monstrous power made his meridians swell, his bones felt reforged like ingots of steel.
Lu Chuan felt an intense heat radiating from his body, a sensation he missed as a long-deceased zombie.
Under this scorching heat, his flesh seemed to reorganize, with his muscles becoming more solid.
If Lu Chuan removed his clothes now, he would find his already angular muscles had swelled dramatically.
His frame became robust, muscles sharply defined, exuding an incredible explosive power.
Even his visible tendons were distinct, his body looked like a meticulously crafted work of art!
The most profound change wasn’t physical, but the sudden surge in terrifying Spiritual Power!
About seventy percent of the potent energy from the second-tier Core streamed into Lu Chuan’s mind.
The sudden boost in Spiritual Telekinesis felt overwhelming, as if his brain was about to explode.
Under this terrifying mental impact, Lu Chuan barely held consciousness before slipping into a haze.
The rapid surge in Telekinesis was astonishing, exceeding any previous evolutionary scale for Lu Chuan.
Meanwhile, in the bedroom of the fifth building, Ji Ruxue, who was writing something, froze and quickly ran to the window.
Looking out in astonishment, Ji Ruxue felt like she had just heard the voice of her zombie father!Thɪs updatᴇd by ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Zhao Lin Arrives for the Appointment!
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 71: Zhao Lin Arrives for the Appointment!
Ji Ruxue looked out the window and frowned; within the district, it remained as calm as ever without any anomalies.
The hulking zombie was still stationed at the gate, and her zombie father was nowhere to be seen.
"Looks like I had an illusion..."
......
Two hours later, Lu Chuan, who had been asleep for a long time in Building Four, finally woke up.
The throbbing sensation in his mind before fainting had long disappeared by now, and Lu Chuan felt incredibly refreshed.
It was as if his entire being had a sense of enlightenment, and his mind seemed to be able to spread freely across all regions.
Lu Chuan immediately began to unleash his Spiritual Power, extending it as far as possible.
After some experiments, Lu Chuan discovered that the range he could currently control his Corpse Puppets had expanded to a full ten kilometers!
This vast distance even surprised Lu Chuan.
After all, his Spiritual Power did not need to consider the existence of buildings, but rather a ten-kilometer radius centered on himself!
Lu Chuan stood up, feeling as if his entire body was brimming with endless power.
Lu Chuan subconsciously lifted his clothes. His body under the jacket had expanded to fill out his clothes.
The dimensions of his musculature were two to three times larger than before, with his whole body packed with muscles like a super soldier.
He found a room with a bedroom and a mirror in Building Four, and looking at himself in the mirror, Lu Chuan was stunned.
The muscle lines all over his body had become angular, filled with terrifying explosive power.
Moreover, Lu Chuan found that he seemed to look more and more human.
The strange green-black skin of a zombie was gone, and his veins, which were previously purplish-black all over, had returned to a normal state.
He appeared paler than an average human, due to his blood not circulating.
Meanwhile, his pupils were still blood-red, but there was already some distinction between the whites of his eyes and his pupils, no longer the uniform blood-red like other zombies.
Lu Chuan always felt that although he had evolved, his physical close-combat strength was not very powerful.
However, after devouring the Crystal Core of a second-tier Tyrant zombie this time, Lu Chuan could clearly feel that even his physical close-combat strength had greatly improved.
Looking at the somewhat trembling ’Lightning One’ beside him, Lu Chuan smiled slightly.
Lu Chuan controlled ’Lightning One’ and led it to a spacious green space downstairs.
Then he issued a command for it to attack him, and instantly ’Lightning One’ burst out with terrifying speed like a cheetah.
As an Agile Zombie, ’Lightning One’ was extremely fast. Even in the past, under Lu Chuan’s control, a second-tier Tyrant zombie couldn’t catch up with ’Lightning One’.
Although it was only at the first tier, it was not comparable to the former Lu Chuan.
However, after his physical strength increased this time, when Lu Chuan faced off against ’Lightning One’ again, he found he could completely keep up with its speed.
’Lightning One’ no longer had the speed advantage in front of him, and Lu Chuan even intentionally used a stopwatch to measure their running speeds, finding that they were indeed neck and neck.
Then Lu Chuan couldn’t wait to engage in actual combat.
Bang!
With a powerful swing of Lu Chuan’s arm, he directly knocked ’Lightning One’ flying.
The physical prowess of both was no longer on the same level.
Lu Chuan looked at his sturdy arms and fists in surprise, unable to imagine the power that could erupt from his own body.
While ’Lightning One’ was an Agile Type zombie and weaker in strength compared to ’Da Pang’, it was still a physically evolved type of zombie, much stronger than his Spiritual Power type zombie self.
At least before devouring Crystal Cores, his pure physical prowess couldn’t even match ’Lightning One’, but now he successfully overwhelmed it.
Feeling the abundant power within, Lu Chuan was extremely excited.
Now, after continuously devouring Crystal Cores, his physical prowess was no weaker than that of ordinary combat-type evolved zombies.
However, Lu Chuan did not forget that his greatest advantage lay in his mind.
With his human consciousness, he could train a variety of combat skills, constantly summarizing experiences and enhancing his combat power in battle, which was much more efficient than zombies’ instinctive fighting methods.Thɪs updatᴇd by NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Lu Chuan was very confident now. Even if he faced a Tyrant zombie again, he would have the power to put up a fight, even if he couldn’t win.
But for Lu Chuan, these physical strengths were supplemental.
His biggest change was still his Spiritual Power. Feeling his surging Spiritual Power, Lu Chuan estimated that he could now control second-tier evolved zombies.
He had witnessed firsthand the powerful combat capabilities of that Tyrant that swept through everything uncontested.
Unsure of when he might encounter another Tyrant zombie.
If he could control a powerful Tyrant, combining its strong physical prowess with his combat skills, the combat effectiveness of his Corpse Puppet squad would greatly increase!
If he could control a strong Tyrant, he wouldn’t have to worry too much if that strange, reviving female cop came back.
Then Lu Chuan controlled his Corpse Puppet team, heading further afield to track down evolved zombies.
Although sometimes that female cop seemed foolish, today she has indeed given me a reminder.
In this apocalypse, all kinds of resources can be used by me, without worrying about the moral censure of the past life.
When encountering powerful zombies from now on, I should be more strategic, rather than just thinking about brute force solutions.
...
On the seventh floor, in the living room.
A piece of paper flew around in the air, seemingly filled with writing.
"Hehe, that’s how it’ll be done tonight!"
Ji Ruxue nodded in satisfaction as she looked at the paper flying in the air.
She thought for a long time in the afternoon and decided not to meet with Nine Deaths Demon Police for the time being.
After all, her current body was just an infant’s; meeting the Nine Deaths Demon Police might cause the latter to have brain atrophy...
......
Soon, night fell.
"Dad, I’m sleepy."
Ji Ruxue greeted Lu Chuan early and returned to her bedroom.
It had been over two months since the end of the world, and the once bustling city had long lost its former hustle and bustle.
The neon lights were gone, leaving the city in utter darkness.
However, the moon in the sky was exceptionally bright; with humans gone and many factories halted, the sky over Jianghai City had become much clearer.
Under the moonlight, Zhao Lin stealthily moved along the street.
After bypassing a few wandering zombies, she successfully slipped into a breakfast shop called ’Sunshine Station’ on the outskirts of Sunshine District.

chapters.title: Chapter 72: If the Corpse King Is Not Eliminated, Disaster Will Surely Follow
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 72: If the Corpse King Is Not Eliminated, Disaster Will Surely Follow
After arriving at the breakfast shop, Zhao Lin vigilantly scanned the surroundings, searching for the silhouette of the expert who had saved her that day.
At this moment, Zhao Lin looked utterly haggard, with many burns on her body.
The blast shockwave had left her with some injuries that had not yet healed.
Although her physical condition was poor, she remembered that she had made an appointment with the expert last night.
Believing that people should keep their promises, Zhao Lin gritted her teeth and persisted in coming to the meeting.
Despite limping a bit as she walked, Zhao Lin believed that people need to uphold certain principles in this world.
As a police officer, she had always adhered to principles when dealing with issues, thus valuing credibility very much.
"That woman actually really came..."
Ji Ruxue looked out through the window hole left in the bedroom towards the outside, indeed seeing movement in the breakfast shop outside the district.
This breakfast shop was just outside the district, close to the location of Building No. 5, not in the same direction as the district gate.
There was a strong Evolved Zombie guarding the gate, making the area near the breakfast shop relatively safer.
The most important thing was that it was very close to Building No. 5.
Looking at the stumbling silhouette below hiding in the breakfast shop, Ji Ruxue helplessly shook her head.
Had heard some tales about Nine Deaths Demon Police in the past.
Perhaps because she was a police officer herself, she held her principles firmly.
The problem was when the apocalypse struck, principles were already nonexistent...
According to Ji Ruxue’s knowledge, Nine Deaths Demon Police overly trusted companions, wasting several revival opportunities early in the apocalypse.
Even held onto the belief that saving other survivors was her duty because of her professional faith.
Upon hearing this news in the previous life, Ji Ruxue found it hard to believe such people still existed post-apocalypse.
And after being repeatedly betrayed by those she saved and sacrificing herself multiple times, Nine Deaths Demon Police became thoroughly disappointed with this world, and her personality drastically changed, killing with impunity.
Becoming extremely cold-blooded.
Ji Ruxue originally doubted the authenticity of such news, but now she finally witnessed it firsthand.
Fortunately, Nine Deaths Demon Police has not turned evil yet, indeed easy to deceive.
Next, Ji Ruxue took out the paper she had prepared during the daytime.
She folded it into the shape of a paper airplane and manipulated it through Telekinesis to fly out of the window hole.
Utilizing the Glazed Breathing Technique, she absorbed the Energy Factor between heaven and earth.
Ji Ruxue’s Telekinesis had grown extremely powerful.
Controlling a paper airplane to fly outside the district from the seventh floor was no problem for her at all.
Zhao Lin was anxiously waiting inside the fast food restaurant, constantly looking around from the window.
However, at that moment, a paper airplane fluttered into the fast food restaurant, nudging Zhao Lin’s back.
"A paper airplane?"
Looking at the paper airplane behind her, Zhao Lin was a bit stunned.
But as she watched the paper airplane hovering before her.
Zhao Lin suddenly realized.
This could very well be a message left by the expert.
She quickly received it.
Upon opening the letter, Ji Ruxue saw delicate small characters.
The letter only bore three words as a signature: Invisible.
Zhao Lin tilted her head, expressing some confusion: "Invisible?"
"Is that the name of the expert who saved me?"
"Or does it mean he has the ability of invisibility?"
After Zhao Lin read the information recorded in the letter, her pupils constricted sharply.
"What? Corpse King?!"
"Is there really such a monster?"
"Capable of controlling other zombies, including Evolved Zombies?!"
This information made Zhao Lin’s heartbeat accelerate involuntarily; she couldn’t believe there was such a powerful and unique zombie!
Is there an entity in Sunshine District that can control Evolved Zombies?
No wonder I saw those Evolved Zombies together earlier without any fighting...
And today at the gas station, those two Evolved Zombies teamed up to attack a Tier 2 Tyrant, were they all commanded by the Corpse King?!
Zhao Lin furrowed her brows, unable to calm her mind.
The information on this paper airplane completely exceeded her expectations.
She originally thought zombies only had a few evolutionary paths.
Unexpectedly, those powerful Evolved Zombies were just puppets before the Corpse King...
If she had not experienced the battles at Sunshine District before, she might have been skeptical of the expert’s words.
But recalling her encounters at the entrance of Sunshine District...
It seems what the other side said is true!
Getting to the window, Zhao Lin under the moonlight gazed toward Sunshine District, but the entire area was silent.
Yet Zhao Lin knew there were multiple Evolved Zombies inside, along with many regular zombies.
Humans, after transforming into zombies, lose all reasoning and become bloodthirsty monsters.
Even Evolved Zombies are no exception.
But if there’s such a highly intelligent Evolved Zombie, with the ability to command others...
Zhao Lin couldn’t imagine how terrifying it would be!
The Corpse King was equivalent to unifying scattered zombies into a single cord, forming extremely formidable combat strength.
If left unchecked to grow, it would inevitably become a great threat to humans in the future.
The Tyrant Zombie she saw today had already reached level 2, which indicated to Zhao Lin that the zombies evolved rapidly.
She had no problem facing ordinary Evolved Zombies alone, but was powerless against the Tyrant.
This meant post-apocalypse, zombie evolution might be faster than that of Human Evolvers.
Let this Corpse King control Evolved Zombies like the Tyrant and human survivors will have no resistance!
Zhao Lin clenched her fists, as a police officer.
The beliefs in her heart made her eyes extremely resolute.
This Corpse King must not be allowed to continue living!
Looking at the paper airplane in her hand, Zhao Lin smiled slightly.
"This Invisible must be one of the human Evolvers too; wanting to ally with me to eliminate Corpse King shows he, like me, is a righteous person!"
"I knew despite the apocalypse unfolding, there are still many who uphold humanity and justice!"
Looking at the letter in her hand, Zhao Lin felt like she found a fellow kindred spirit.
Despite still having many injuries, she appeared exceedingly excited; she then carefully put the letter away and left quietly by moonlight.
Ji Ruxue observed everything from the bedroom’s hole.
"Seems it worked; I knew Nine Deaths Demon Police’s personality early in the apocalypse would absolutely not refuse me."
Doubtful about communication, Ji Ruxue left a message on the letter.
If unwilling to cooperate, just tear it to pieces.
Now the other side chose to keep it close, meaning she agreed.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Operation Begins, Zhao Lin Breaks into Sunshine District at Night!
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 73: Operation Begins, Zhao Lin Breaks into Sunshine District at Night!
The next morning.
Ji Ruxue ate the breakfast Lu Chuan made with an uncontrollable smile at the corners of her mouth.
Currently, the Zombie King within the Sunshine District was considered to be her greatest threat.
This Zombie King was far more cunning than any she had encountered in her previous life.
If it wasn’t removed quickly, it would inevitably become a significant future threat.
The crucial point was, the Zombie Father was also under its control.
This was the fundamental reason why Ji Ruxue was determined to eliminate it.
Only by removing it could the Zombie Father be freed from control.
Fortunately, she had successfully allied with the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
The other party had agreed to collaborate with her to eliminate the Zombie King.
The Nine Deaths Demon Police had now become a second-tier evolver, with the heaven-defying ability to grow stronger upon resurrection.
With the Nine Deaths Demon Police at the front, and her supporting in secret, she believed they could successfully slay the Zombie King.
As she looked at the Zombie Father before her, Ji Ruxue clenched her small pink fists while eating.
Don’t worry, Father.
Soon, you will be able to break free from the Zombie King’s control!
Ji Ruxue calculated the time as she ate breakfast.
The appointed time was fast approaching.
She had already set the attack time with Zhao Lin in a letter.
The night two days later was when the plan would be implemented.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue felt a bit of anticipation.
The Zombie King in the Sunshine District was no ordinary being, at least of second-tier strength!
Don’t worry, Father.
As long as I’m here, even if I have to feed you crystal cores.
I’ll definitely make you the strongest zombie!
A Zombie King’s crystal core, combined with other evolved zombies in the district, would surely allow Father’s strength to rapidly increase!
Ji Ruxue was also eager to see how much stronger Father would become after devouring these crystal cores.
She believed that by then, the Zombie Father would have the ability to protect himself.
And the Zombie King, who Ji Ruxue longed to defeat, was actually Lu Chuan himself.
He was utterly unaware that his crystal core had already been reserved by his daughter.
She even planned to dig out his crystal core and feed it back to him...
Since devouring the second-tier Tyrant’s crystal core two days ago, Lu Chuan’s strength had greatly increased, especially with a burst of spiritual power.
The combat power of a second-tier evolved zombie was leaps and bounds above a first-tier zombie.
If he could successfully control a second-tier evolved zombie, the strength of his corpse puppets would undergo a qualitative change!
Just imagining having several powerful Tyrants at his side made Lu Chuan’s mouth curl into a smile.
He thought he could then roam the city unchecked.
Only this way could he provide Little Qiqi with a safe and stable environment to grow.
However, it was a pity that after sending out corpse puppets to expand the search range, two full days yielded nothing.
Evolved zombies were scarce, and Lu Chuan’s current range of corpse control was still very limited.
Nonetheless, Lu Chuan found some comfort in that the troublesome female cop had finally been quiet lately, allowing him some peace.
But Lu Chuan still couldn’t let his guard down.
After all, besides the peculiar resurrecting policewoman, there was another evolver hidden near his district who had never shown up.
Over the past few days, Lu Chuan had been continuously controlling corpse puppets to conduct carpet searches, turning over every room that could be used for hiding.
To no avail, they still found nothing.
Even after searching inside and out of the district, there was no sign of that person.
The more the other party remained unseen, the more worried Lu Chuan became.
This proved that the hidden evolver’s skills were far superior to the female cop’s.
And they were likely very powerful as well.
What did my Sunshine District do to deserve this?
Does this vast Jianghai City have to target me?
Lu Chuan was utterly perplexed.
Thinking about these human evolvers relentlessly targeting his Sunshine District.
He couldn’t help but feel some anger.
They’d better stay hidden in the dark and never show themselves.
Once he found a second-tier evolved zombie, none of them should think about escaping.
Standing on the balcony, looking out the window, a cold glint flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
He already had a plan in mind.
Once he controlled a second-tier evolved zombie, he would clear out all human survivors within a ten-mile radius!
Although he was unwilling to act against humans, if they threatened him, Lu Chuan wouldn’t hesitate to leave no trace.
The events of the past few days had made Lu Chuan increasingly aware that kindness to others was cruelty to himself.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Little Qiqi was still so young, and Lu Chuan didn’t want to leave any hidden dangers for the future.
If something went wrong, he would have no time for regrets.
...
As night slowly descended, Ji Ruxue’s heartbeat gradually accelerated.
Eating the egg fried rice Lu Chuan brought over, she carefully contemplated the plan ahead.
"Dad, I’m going to sleep."
After dinner, Ji Ruxue greeted Lu Chuan early and went into the bedroom.
Tonight was the night she had agreed to slay the Zombie King with the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
Instead of fear, the thought of facing a powerful Zombie King excited her.
In her past life as an Empress of the Human Race, Ji Ruxue never feared battle.
Let alone fighting in her reborn body, which made Ji Ruxue look forward to it even more.
Seeing the little one head to sleep, Lu Chuan stayed in the living room to rest, recovering the spiritual power he had spent during the day.
He wanted to remain in peak condition to not miss any second-tier evolved zombies.
And at that moment.
Under the clear moonlight, Zhao Lin successfully arrived outside the Sunshine District.
Seeing the evolved zombies guarding the entrance, Zhao Lin exhaled slowly to calm her slightly hurried breathing.
"The truck keys are still inside the district, might as well take the chance to retrieve them!"
She could eliminate the hidden human threat and take everyone from the city to the Survivor Base.
This action was perfect for Zhao Lin.
She just didn’t know how well-prepared that master was now.
Looking at the district ahead, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but feel a bit nervous.
Zombie King...
Is there really such a powerful zombie in this world?
What would happen against the Zombie King with her current strength?
But thinking about her two consecutive resurrections.
It gave her immense courage.
At most, she’d die once.
And revive again.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: As Expected, There Are Other Evolvers!
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 74: As Expected, There Are Other Evolvers!
Zhao Lin pondered while surveying the surrounding streets.
The area was very dark, with only a faint moonlight illuminating the street.
With Da Pang guarding the gate of the community, even common wandering zombies wouldn’t approach the vicinity.
It was extremely quiet around, without a single sound, as Zhao Lin kept looking around.
"This Evolver called the Invisible, shouldn’t break the appointment, right?"
"The other party was so full of confidence; they shouldn’t be the kind of person to renege on the agreement."
Zhao Lin kept examining the surroundings, speculating whether the Invisible had already arrived beside her.
"The ability of Invisibility is truly powerful, coming and going without a trace, even I can’t determine their position."
But soon Zhao Lin regained her composure.
Though the Invisibility Skill is good, my Resurrection Ability is still the most practical.
After all, if it weren’t for my Resurrection Ability, I’d probably already be dead.
"Invisible one, we’ve agreed beforehand, don’t mess with me tonight!"
Zhao Lin quietly said in all directions, hoping the invisible expert could hear her.
Then she walked straight towards the community gate.
Seeing the big guy holding a giant hammer, battle intent and killing intent flashed in Zhao Lin’s eyes.
Being killed twice by this big guy, even a clay figure would have some anger.
"Hey! Big guy, I came to play with you again!"
Approaching the Tank Type Zombie, Zhao Lin shouted loudly.
This was part of her prior agreement with that mysterious expert, where she’d draw the attention of the zombies.
Zhao Lin’s voice was starkly abrupt on this quiet street, instantly attracting Da Pang’s attention.
Meanwhile, in the seventh-floor living room, Lu Chuan, who was recovering his Spiritual Power, was instantly alarmed.
"It’s you again! It’s never-ending!"The most update n0vels are published on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Anger flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes as well.
With Little Qiqi, he stayed disciplined within the community, without offending anyone at all.
Yet this female officer seemed to have her sights set on him, repeatedly coming to cause trouble.
He thought he could stay peaceful for two days; unexpectedly, she came again tonight.
Hmph!
"Since you insist on asking for death, no matter what, tonight I’ll ensure you stay here forever!"
Undead Body, is it?
Then I’ll break your limbs, never to see the daylight again.
Undead... does it mean no need to resurrect?
Lu Chuan promptly dashed downstairs, heading straight for the community gate.
His blood-red eyes were filled with killing intent.
This female officer coming to provoke time and again had completely angered him.
Ji Ruxue, who had been feigning sleep in the bedroom, hurriedly got up upon hearing the commotion outside.
"The plan is underway!"
"Hehe, Corpse King, it’s time for the hunt!"
Ji Ruxue stealthily crept downstairs, then sneaked to the second floor of Building One.
This was the room where she had previously helped Zhao Lin.
From here, she had a clear view of the gate’s environment while minimizing the chance of being discovered.
When Ji Ruxue reached Building One, the fight outside the community gate had already begun.
Lu Chuan was still hiding nearby, manipulating Da Pang and two Agile Zombies to take action first.
Lu Chuan controlled Da Pang, whose dual hammers swung with extreme ferocity.
With his Spiritual Power breakthrough, aided by ample Spiritual Power, Lu Chuan could control Da Pang more effectively during the battle.
Avoiding Zhao Lin’s attacks while counterattacking accordingly.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, Da Pang’s dual hammers swung vigorously, one strike following the next.
The hammers pounded with perfect coordination, leaving Zhao Lin hardly any breathing space.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The sound of the giant hammers pounding the ground created muffled echoes, making Zhao Lin’s feet feel slightly numb.
The harsh wind whipped up by the hammer’s swings sent chills down her spine.
"What’s happening? How come this Evolved Zombie’s attack angles are much trickier than before?"
Zhao Lin frowned as she kept dodging, feeling greater pressure from the Tank Type Zombie compared to before.
Although its strength didn’t seem to have increased, it could always accurately predict her evasive position, and even block her sneaky attacks with the giant hammer.
Can these brainless zombies also learn human combat techniques?!
With this thought, Zhao Lin frowned even deeper.
However, as a second-tier Evolver, with her outstanding physical strength and rich combat skills,
though more risky than before, Zhao Lin was still at ease.
Swish! Swish!
Just then, two sonic booms sounded, and Zhao Lin felt a chill on her body, reacting with successive backflips to dodge.
Just as Zhao Lin landed, the scene before her sent chills down her spine.
Right on the path she avoided, two Agile Zombies appeared, each holding two steel knives.
If she had been a second slower, she might have been dismembered by those blades!
Zhao Lin dared not be careless, quickly drawing two tactical knives.
"Heh, think you’re invincible because you’re an Evolver? Today, I’ll make you pay the price!"
Lu Chuan’s eyes were filled with killing intent at this moment.
After his Spiritual Power enhancement, Lu Chuan’s control over these Corpse Puppets became more flexible.
Additionally, his ability to seize battle opportunities was more accurate than before.
With continuous fighting, Lu Chuan’s combat techniques were constantly manifesting.
The two Lightning Zombies swiftly formed a pincer attack, the silver-white blades glistening under the moonlight, making Zhao Lin wary.
Da Pang, controlled by Lu Chuan, launched a frontal assault, its hammers’ terrifying force leaving Zhao Lin unable to meet it head-on, forcing her to dodge.
With Lu Chuan’s increased strength, Zhao Lin found it harder to fight three on one.
Each evasion was perilously close.
In just a few rounds, Lu Chuan used his powerful Telekinesis to discern Zhao Lin’s moves.
Immediately, the dual hammer assault from the left hand changed, while Zhao Lin was caught off-guard by Lightning One and Two’s harassment.
Seeing the giant hammer about to slam into her abdomen, Da Pang’s body strangely paused mid-air for a second.
Seizing this opportunity, Zhao Lin narrowly dodged.
Lu Chuan frowned.
Then launched another attack.
He discovered that whether it was Da Pang or Lightning One and Two,
each time they were about to strike Zhao Lin, their actions inexplicably paused for a second.
This allowed Zhao Lin, who should have been defeated, to escape repeatedly.
A cold gleam flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes: "As expected, there are other Evolvers nearby!"

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Damn, Bullets Can Curve?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 75: Damn, Bullets Can Curve?!
Every time his attack was about to land on the opponent.
It was as if some mysterious power made his attack stagnate, and even his body froze in mid-air.
This bizarre situation made Lu Chuan frown intensely.
"When I fought with that female officer a few days ago, the same thing happened. What kind of power is this? It can affect my actions!"
Lu Chuan hid in the shadows, controlling the zombies to attack Zhao Lin while constantly looking around.
No matter how he searched, he couldn’t find any trace of an evolver around.
"What kind of ability has the evolver hidden in the dark awakened? It can influence my movements invisibly?!"
"Every time my attack was about to land on Zhao Lin, it suddenly felt as if time around was frozen... Could it be that the evolver hidden in the shadows has a time-stopping ability?!"
If it was before encountering this troublesome female officer, Lu Chuan might have thought this idea was somewhat absurd.
But even resurrection happened right in front of him, so it’s not impossible for an evolver to awaken the ability to manipulate time...
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan became even more vigilant.
He gathered all the Corpse Puppet teams inside the district to the direction of the entrance, while blending himself in among them.
No matter what special ability the opponent has awakened, that evolver is likely lurking nearby, and Lu Chuan doesn’t want to expose himself in front of them.
To test his suspicions, Lu Chuan controlled the three-headed Evolved Zombies to attack continuously, becoming even more ruthless in his assaults.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
This made Zhao Lin, already struggling to cope, face imminent danger.
However, Lu Chuan found that as always, every time his attack was about to land on Zhao Lin, the Corpse Puppets he controlled froze inexplicably.
And this pause lasted exactly one second, just enough for Zhao Lin to escape.
If it happened once, it might be a coincidence, but until now, it had happened more than a dozen times, which definitely wasn’t just a coincidence.
"Damn it, why are these two targeting me relentlessly?"
Lu Chuan could now almost certainly confirm that there is another evolver around Sunshine District, always hidden in the shadows.
Two days ago, when he watched the battle between the female officer and the Tyrant Zombie, the female officer didn’t show the power to make the Tyrant pause.
This was enough to indicate that the mysterious evolver able to control time, or limit his actions, was a different person than the female officer.
While Lu Chuan was growing increasingly angry, Zhao Lin was quite excited.
Facing three enemies alone was very stressful, but every time she fell into danger, the evolver in the shadows would intervene.
So far, she had been saved by them more than a dozen times.
"It seems that the master who claimed to be the Invisible wasn’t lying; he’s now hidden near the battlefield."
"My frequent escapes from danger must be because he’s secretly aiding me — using the invisibility ability to influence the zombies’ movements?"
Not only Lu Chuan, but Zhao Lin was also speculating about the identity and abilities of the evolver hidden in shadows.
"I really didn’t expect that the invisibility ability could have such a significant impact at critical moments..."
Because of Ji Ruxue’s previous letter, Zhao Lin was increasingly convinced that the evolver hidden in the shadows had awakened the invisibility ability.
Lu Chuan was already at his wit’s end because of Ji Ruxue.
Clearly, he had suppressed the female officer, but because of some unidentified force, he struggled to defeat her successfully.
Feeling constantly thwarted, Lu Chuan also became somewhat irritable.
"Since you like saving people so much, let’s see if you can be faster than bullets!"
Having his melee attacks restricted, Lu Chuan directly summoned the Corpse Puppet snipers.
A few zombies picked up their guns, aimed at Zhao Lin, and started shooting.
Zhao Lin, pressured by the three-headed Evolved Zombies, hadn’t even noticed the zombies aiming their guns at her.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Upon hearing the gunshots, Zhao Lin realized the danger, but she had no time to react.
Though she had become an evolver, she was well aware that her current speed, no matter how fast, couldn’t be faster than bullets.
Moreover, the three-headed Evolved Zombies restricted her movements, making her as vulnerable as a living target.
But to Zhao Lin’s surprise, despite the gunshots, all the bullets missed her body.
"Hahaha! That aimless shooting made me laugh to death!"
Having thought she was certainly doomed, she found the outcome unexpectedly dramatic.
This made Zhao Lin ride an emotional rollercoaster, unable to hold in her laughter.
"I knew it, even if zombies could shoot, how could they possibly be that accurate!"
To Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin’s laughter sounded extremely abrasive...
He hadn’t anticipated the female officer’s luck to be so good; all his zombies missed despite a coordinated volley.
Meanwhile, neither Zhao Lin nor Lu Chuan noticed the small silhouette at the second-floor window of Building No. 1 near the gate, watching the battlefield.
"Good thing I have prior experience; I’ve been observing the battlefield continuously. Otherwise, this Nine Deaths Demon Police would die again..."
Ji Ruxue breathed a sigh of relief; it was through her Telekinesis Control ability that she made the bullets miss Zhao Lin.
On the other side, Lu Chuan was still unrelenting, personally controlling a few zombies to aim at Zhao Lin, before pulling the trigger and emptying the clips.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Intense gunfire rang out again, with Zhao Lin’s expression changing.
This time, she clearly saw several zombies aiming at her; even if she dodged a few miraculously, she would certainly be hit.
Yet... the situation repeated itself...
Ji Ruxue used Telekinesis to deflect all the bullets off course.
"Are you freaking kidding me?!
"Bullets can curve?!"
Lu Chuan couldn’t hold back any longer.
He saw clearly how those bullets meant to hit the female officer changed directions mid-flight!
Zhao Lin watched all the bullets perfectly avoid her body, utterly shocked.
"This... Letting bullets curve — invisibility alone couldn’t achieve this, right?!"
"What level has this master hidden in the shadows evolved to?!"
As both Lu Chuan and Zhao Lin were caught in astonishment, Ji Ruxue, influencing the battlefield from behind the scenes, was filled with pride.
"Luckily, after reincarnating, not only did I retain the Time Control ability, but also awakened Telekinesis Control."
"Otherwise, relying solely on controlling time, I really wouldn’t have been able to stop so many bullets."
Ji Ruxue secretly felt grateful, being a double-talented possessor; otherwise, even if he teamed up with Nine Deaths Demon Police, they might not have been able to take down that Corpse King.
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue smiled slightly: "Sorry, Corpse King, with Telekinesis and Time Control, no one can touch the person I want to protect."
"With double talents, you can do as you please!"

chapters.title: Chapter 76: You Can’t Touch This Zombie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 76: You Can’t Touch This Zombie!
Realizing that the hidden evolver was an absolute master, Zhao Lin relaxed after being helped multiple times by him.
Initially, worried about getting hurt, Zhao Lin was constrained in battle, mostly dodging continuously.
But now seeing bullets capable of bending around her, Zhao Lin completely let loose.
This hidden high-level expert was practically an invincible cheat for her, and Zhao Lin’s attacks became brazen for a time.
She wielded a pair of tactical daggers, and even when facing the Three-headed Evolved Zombie, she began to attack without defending.
Though this fighting style seemed suicidal, Ji Ruxue’s protection made Lu Chuan’s attacks repeatedly miss.
In such a scenario, Zhao Lin grew bolder with combat, originally suppressed, she started inflicting injuries on ’Da Pang’, ’Lightning One’, and ’Lightning Two’ with her daggers.
Lu Chuan was nearly spitting blood with anger; he controlled three powerful evolved zombies, yet couldn’t land a hit!
In melee combat, attacks were forced to stop, and after ranged shooting, bullets could still bend — if this wasn’t cheating, what was it?!
Lu Chuan hadn’t expected this; in his past life, playing games without spending money, big spenders treated him like prey.
Now reincarnated into this foreign world, he still couldn’t escape fate’s punishment.
According to the normal script, he should defy destiny and rise powerfully, but he was now being trampled.
This policewoman had a revival ability, and now it was troublesome; he couldn’t even hurt her...
Originally, when Lu Chuan came downstairs, he was full of confidence, certain he could deal with this policewoman this time.
Yet in a moment, he felt utterly frustrated.
And Zhao Lin, having Ji Ruxue, a strong teammate, single-handedly suppressed the three zombies in combat with pleasure.
Ji Ruxue, watching the battlefield, frowned deeply and quickly telepathically communicated to Zhao Lin: "Stop lingering in the fight, don’t focus on these three evolved zombies, our target today is to kill the Corpse King!"
Ji Ruxue rubbed her temples, feeling utterly helpless.
"This Zhao Lin really has no sense; she’s having fun fighting, did she forget the plan?"
"Such reckless fighting, does she really take me for an eternal machine?!"
The Power of Time, though strong, consumed a lot each use.
Zhao Lin wasn’t initially a match for these three evolved zombies, and relying on my escort, she was even more reckless now, constantly taking risks.
Zhao Lin was having fun, but poor Ji Ruxue was suffering from the consumption; she couldn’t hold on for long.
In battle, hearing Ji Ruxue’s reminder, Zhao Lin realized her mission this time.
She stopped her aggressive attacks, adjusting her direction, gradually moving toward the gate.
Seizing an opportunity in the encirclement of the three evolved zombies, Zhao Lin dashed rapidly into the Sunshine District.
Her sudden change in action caught Lu Chuan off guard, hastily commanding ’Da Pang’, ’Lightning One’, and ’Lightning Two’ to block her.
However, Lu Chuan found his three evolved zombies inexplicably restrained by an unknown force, immobilized.
"Damn! What kind of skill is hiding in the dark?!"
"If you’ve got guts, come out and fight openly!"
This feeling of being targeted from the shadows made Lu Chuan very unhappy, and he let out an angry roar.
With his three evolved zombies restrained, Lu Chuan had no choice but to intercept Zhao Lin himself.
Even at the risk of exposure, Lu Chuan wouldn’t allow anyone to enter the district, threatening Little Qiqi’s safety.
"What? There’s another evolved zombie here?!"
Seeing Lu Chuan rush out from the zombie horde, Zhao Lin was amazed.
Hiding on the second floor, Ji Ruxue was also shocked; Lu Chuan’s action disrupted her plan.
"Why did daddy also take action?"
"He doesn’t have to follow the Corpse King’s orders, he doesn’t need to be cannon fodder."
Ji Ruxue was troubled; she had no issue attacking other zombies, but she couldn’t harm the zombie dad.
In her dilemma, Lu Chuan had already engaged Zhao Lin in battle.
Lu Chuan drew a machete from his back, slashing toward Zhao Lin, showing no intention of sparing her.
Zhao Lin frowned, swinging her daggers as she fought fiercely with Lu Chuan.Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
For a moment, the district was ablaze with the cold gleam of blades, and Zhao Lin’s eyes showed surprise.
She hadn’t expected this evolved zombie to be so adept in combat, with swift and vicious moves aimed directly at her vital points.
The more they fought, the more alarmed Zhao Lin became; using her two tactical daggers, she found it hard to hold her ground against this zombie.
"Damn, the Sunshine District is deeper than I thought; this evolved zombie seems ordinary but is more challenging than those three guys outside?!"
Zhao Lin didn’t expect this seemingly ordinary zombie to be so troublesome.
"What’s going on? Is there a zombie evolved specifically for combat? How does he seemingly predict my next move?!"
While battling Zhao Lin, Lu Chuan controlled the freed ’Da Pang’, ’Lightning One’, and ’Lightning Two’, rapidly guiding them to support him.
He realized the hidden evolver’s power was likely limited.
While they could restrict his actions, it was almost for just a moment.
Seeing the three evolved zombies rushing into the district, about to join the battle,
Ji Ruxue knew that if it dragged on further, tonight’s assassination mission might fail.
Looking at her zombie father’s figure, Ji Ruxue’s eyes were full of conflict.
She naturally didn’t want to harm her zombie dad.
But seeing the three approaching evolved zombies, Ji Ruxue finally gritted her teeth, couldn’t help but use Time Control on Lu Chuan.
"Daddy, don’t blame me; I’m doing it to kill the Corpse King."
"Once I slay the Corpse King and free you from his control, you’ll be completely liberated..."
At the same time, Ji Ruxue hurriedly telepathically communicated to Zhao Lin: "Quick, enter the district, don’t waste time!"
Zhao Lin saw the evolved zombie in front of her restrained and was about to kick it.
But in the next second, she suddenly found herself suspended in mid-air, motionless.
Zhao Lin: ???
What was the meaning of this? Even teammates weren’t spared?
Just then, Ji Ruxue’s voice echoed in Zhao Lin’s mind.
"You can’t touch this zombie!"

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Why Are All the Zombies Gathering at Building 5?
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Chapter 77: Why Are All the Zombies Gathering at Building 5?
Hearing Ji Ruxue’s words, Zhao Lin was immediately stunned.
What does it mean that this zombie can’t be moved?
Could it be that this zombie is actually "one of our own"?
Ji Ruxue’s sudden action left Zhao Lin completely baffled.
"What is this Invisible up to? Do they not understand the concept of ’those who are not of our kin are sure to have different hearts’? Why are they treating these zombies differently?"
Zhao Lin shook her head, unable to understand what the Invisible was thinking.
But Ji Ruxue didn’t care about Zhao Lin’s confusion and simply continued to transmit her message: "Remember what I just said. Our target is the Corpse King in the Sunshine District."
"You absolutely cannot touch this zombie!"
Out of a police instinct, Zhao Lin faintly detected a hint of threat in Ji Ruxue’s tone.
She realized that if she really took action against this zombie in front of her, the Invisible in the shadows might turn against her.
Although she didn’t know what was going on with the Invisible, Zhao Lin knew that killing the Corpse King was the top priority.
Helplessly, she could only abandon her attack on Lu Chuan and rushed straight into the district.
Seeing this, Lu Chuan immediately intended to follow, but found himself again restrained by a force.
Even with all his strength, he was unable to exert it and could only stand stiff and motionless like a petrified figure.
This made Lu Chuan feel extremely frustrated, as he had been targeted by this force all night; otherwise, he would’ve resolved this female cop already.
"Damn it!"
"You stop right there!"
Lu Chuan was infuriated at the sight of Zhao Lin’s back, his blood-red eyes filled with murderous intent.
At this moment, he could see clearly that the female cop had a very specific target in mind.
From provoking ’Da Pang’ at the start to battling his three zombies.
Her main goal was to break into the Sunshine District!
Although he didn’t know her exact purpose, Lu Chuan was only concerned about the little one’s safety.
He had turned this Sunshine District upside down, and in his view, the only thing that could attract these Human Evolvers, apart from Little Qiqi, was nothing else.
Thinking that Little Qiqi might get hurt, Lu Chuan was enraged and desperately tried to break free from the restraint.
Even after continuously consuming multiple Crystal Cores to greatly enhance his physical strength, he still couldn’t move.
This mysterious force enveloping him made him feel as if the time around his body was frozen.
Lu Chuan could only stand there and watch helplessly as Zhao Lin quickly entered the Sunshine District.
A monstrous killing intent emanated from Lu Chuan, even seeming to lower the surrounding temperature.
"Damn woman, I absolutely won’t let you off this time!"
Lu Chuan let out a series of piercing howls, which in the dead of night were horrifying to hear.
The terrifying sound made the nearby zombies tremble with fear.
Ji Ruxue, standing upstairs, watched the zombie father unleash furious roars of anger, her heart filled with apology.
She never expected that one day she would attack the zombie father.
"I’m sorry, Dad, I’m doing this for your own good."
"Once tonight is over, everything will get better."
Seeing Lu Chuan in such rage, Ji Ruxue felt a deep heartache.
For the first time, she sensed such gut-wrenching emotion from her zombie father.
Looking at the back of the zombie father, Ji Ruxue’s eyes became inexplicably moist.
But she quickly withdrew from this emotion.
Because Ji Ruxue noticed that after Zhao Lin rushed into the district, she was like a headless fly, not knowing where to start.
She hurriedly transmitted another message to Zhao Lin inside the district: "The Corpse King is cunning and sly, though smart, it is extremely afraid of death."
"So wherever the Corpse King hides, there must be a large number of zombies protecting it."
"If these zombies are desperately trying to stop you, it proves that the Corpse King is definitely still in the Sunshine District!"
Ji Ruxue’s eyes also flashed with anger.
Thinking that her zombie father was being used as cannon fodder by this Corpse King, she wished she could tear the enemy to pieces.
This also strengthened Ji Ruxue’s resolve to kill the Corpse King.
Though her zombie father still retained human consciousness, he couldn’t completely resist the control of the Corpse King.
If the Corpse King wasn’t completely killed, the zombie father would never be truly free.
He could forget about any stable life in the future.
"Keep searching within the district, as long as there’s a large group of zombies trying desperately to block you, that’s definitely where the Corpse King’s hideout is!"
After hearing this, Zhao Lin felt it made a lot of sense.
She nodded, then carefully began her search according to Ji Ruxue’s hint.
Although Lu Chuan was restrained by a mysterious force, unable to move for a time.
There were still a considerable number of Corpse Puppets in the district, and he immediately controlled them to start moving.
A portion of the Corpse Puppets rushed towards Zhao Lin under Lu Chuan’s control, while others were moved to Building No. 5 by Lu Chuan.
Little Qiqi was both Lu Chuan’s weakness and his reverse scale.
After becoming a zombie following the apocalypse, Lu Chuan found no hope at all.
The appearance of Little Qiqi changed Lu Chuan’s muddled state of mind.
Thus, Little Qiqi became Lu Chuan’s motivation to continue surviving.
To him, the most precious thing was Little Qiqi.
Under no circumstances would Lu Chuan allow Little Qiqi to come to any harm.
Even if something happened to him, Lu Chuan would never let his daughter face any danger.
At this moment, Zhao Lin crashed through the district, searching for the scenario Ji Ruxue had described.
The ordinary zombies along the way posed no threat whatsoever to Zhao Lin, a second-tier Evolver.
After killing a few of the Corpse Puppets controlled by Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin paused in confusion in the center of the district.
She searched around the district, yet still failed to find a possible hiding place for the Corpse King.
"Strange, all the information provided by the Invisible fits, so why can’t I locate the possible hiding place of the Corpse King?"
Zhao Lin stood in the district, looking around at the residential buildings, scratching her head in puzzlement.
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue was also observing the situation in the district from the rooftop.
Her ability was limited, and she couldn’t control so many zombies for long.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Progress needed to be accelerated to find and kill the Corpse King quickly.
But then Ji Ruxue was shocked to discover that indeed a large group of zombies had gathered together.
However, the gathering place of this zombie horde was none other than Building No. 5, where she and the zombie father had spent countless days together...

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Could This Zombie Be the Invisible’s Relative?
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78: Could This Zombie Be the Invisible’s Relative?
"What is going on with these zombies? Why are they all running to my building?!"
Ji Ruxue felt very puzzled when she saw the zombies below Building No. 5.
Within the Sunshine District, whether they are evolved zombies or ordinary ones, they’re generally under the control of the Corpse King hidden in the shadows.
Given the current situation, the zombies should be rushing to protect the Corpse King first.
Ji Ruxue remembers clearly that while the Corpse King can control zombies, its combat strength isn’t actually that strong.
If the Corpse King is approached by human evolvers, danger is highly likely to occur.
So every Corpse King is very afraid of dying and wouldn’t leave the protection of the zombie horde.
"It’s really strange. I’ve already checked every room in Building No. 5, and there’s only the supplies moved by the zombie dad. Just what’s up with these zombies?"
While Ji Ruxue was still feeling puzzled, Zhao Lin, following her directions, had already found Building No. 5 where the zombies were congregating.
Seeing the zombies tightly shielding Building No. 5 behind them, a resolute look flashed in Zhao Lin’s eyes.
"Just as the Invisible said, the Corpse King gathers zombies when it senses danger!"
Zhao Lin could now clearly see the four evolved zombies she had previously encountered were gathered together with many ordinary zombies, without any conflict among them.
To Zhao Lin, this was a very bizarre situation.
"Looks like the Corpse King that can control the zombies is hiding inside Building No. 5!"
Roar! Roar!
The zombies under Lu Chuan’s control let out furious warning cries.
In the silent moonlit night, these zombie screams were extremely terrifying.
Yet the thought that this Corpse King could pose a huge threat to humans filled Zhao Lin’s eyes with determination.
No matter what, the Corpse King must be eliminated today, or humanity in Jianghai City will never have peace.
"Today, the Corpse King must be removed!"
Zhao Lin shouted angrily, waving her tactical dagger and charged directly at Building No. 5.
"What’s wrong with her? Why is this policewoman charging towards Building No. 5?!"
"Did she have brain damage after coming back to life? Why is she fixated on me!"
Standing in front of Building No. 5, Lu Chuan felt both shocked and enraged seeing Zhao Lin sprinting towards him.
Originally, he wanted to guard the entire Sunshine District, but didn’t expect the abilities of that secret evolver to be so strange.
The power that could freeze him in place filled Lu Chuan with great dread.
Thus, he had no choice but to pull back, relinquishing other areas of the Sunshine District, and consolidate his forces to defend around Building No. 5.
After all, the entire Sunshine District wasn’t important to him; the only thing he couldn’t tolerate was these two human evolvers disturbing Little Qiqi on the seventh floor.
As long as his daughter was unharmed, everything else could be left to these two evolvers to mess around with.
But what Lu Chuan didn’t expect was that even after he chose to compromise, these two evolvers were still relentlessly aggressive.
"Damn it!"
"Why are you forcing me!"
"I’ve already given you the Sunshine District, yet you still push me; if that’s the case, today I’ll fight you to the death!"
Lu Chuan’s blood-colored eyes radiated a chilling murderous intent; in the pitch-black night, his eyes seemed to glow with a faint red light.
"Come on! Since you’ve decided to push me, let’s fight to the end!"
"I have already died once, so even if I put my life on the line today, I won’t let you take a step into Building No. 5."
Today these two human evolvers thoroughly touched Lu Chuan’s scales.
Lu Chuan looked up at the seventh floor, a gentle look flashed in his eyes; it was the only solace for his soul since coming to this strange world.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, Da Pang swung his double hammers and charged in the front.
Bang bang bang!
Due to Lu Chuan’s anger, Da Pang’s combat power was even stronger than usual; every move was without reservation.
Facing the increasingly fierce zombies, Zhao Lin showed no fear.
Swish swish swish!
Her twin tactical daggers danced like buzzing bees and flitting butterflies, their blades stained with zombie blood.
Even though wounded, Da Pang’s hammers still swung powerfully, cracking the surrounding concrete ground.
Swish! Swish!
Amidst the sound of slicing through the air, two slender figures darted from the zombie horde, their snow-white blades shimmering silver in the moonlight.
Zhao Lin hastily retreated, but Da Pang relentlessly pursued, his giant hammer aimed at Zhao Lin’s stomach.
At this moment, Lu Chuan once again felt the arrival of that mysterious power; Da Pang’s body froze, allowing Zhao Lin to narrowly avoid the edge of the giant hammer.
Immediately, Lightning One and Two swung their twin blades, trapping Zhao Lin from both sides to cut off her retreat.
But just as Lu Chuan was about to succeed again, this force once again descended upon Lightning One.
Zhao Lin seized the chance to evade from the immobilized Lightning One’s right rear, dodging this fatal blow.
Repeatedly restrained by the mysterious hidden evolver, Lu Chuan was filled with fury.
Roar!
Letting out a roar, Lu Chuan grabbed a machete and joined the battle himself.
With powerful combat skills, the enraged Lu Chuan immediately suppressed Zhao Lin, leaving her unable to lift her head.
But to Lu Chuan’s frustration, every time his attack was about to strike Zhao Lin, that strange power would intervene.
Even though he struggled with all his might, he couldn’t break free from the opposing constraint.
"Damn it! If you have guts come out and fight!"
Lu Chuan was immobilized again, letting out a howl of anger.
At this moment Zhao Lin took advantage of Lu Chuan’s immobility, her tactical dagger immediately thrust forward, aiming straight for Lu Chuan’s neck.
"Let’s see if you die this time." Zhao Lin thought with a chilling smirk.
But in the next second, she suddenly discovered in shock that she too was frozen in place.
This instantly darkened Zhao Lin’s expression.
Next, Zhao Lin deliberately exposed a weakness, her feet wobbling as she stumbled backward.
Sure enough, Lu Chuan swung his blade down instinctively.
Just as Zhao Lin had anticipated, the Invisible once again restrained this zombie.
Zhao Lin seized the gap and advanced with her dagger, but unexpectedly, she was stopped again.
Unable to bear it any longer, Zhao Lin shouted in anger: "Enough, which side are you on?!"
Ji Ruxue’s face was similarly dark as she responded coldly: "I’ve told you, you cannot touch this zombie!"
Feeling the coldness in the other’s tone, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but speculate about the connection between the Invisible and the zombie in front of her.
"Could it be... this zombie is a relative of the Invisible?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 79: No One Can Hurt My Dad!
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: No One Can Hurt My Dad!
As a police officer, Zhao Lin keenly sensed that the invisible person in the shadows must have some kind of connection with the zombie before her.
Otherwise, when she attacked other zombies, the invisible person did not react at all.
But uniquely for this zombie in front of her, the invisible person repeatedly warned her not to harm it.
And now, she’s even restricted by a force directly applied on her...
"This Invisible one is an Evolver, yet hasn’t joined the human team. Could it be for this zombie?!"
Feeling Ji Ruxue’s unique attitude towards Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin’s mind instantly filled with various scenarios.
The other party is clearly a strong Human Evolver, yet has always hidden in the shadows and refused to show themselves.
Evidently wanting to destroy the zombies, yet using this peculiar ability to restrict her movements...
At that moment, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but recall the early days of the apocalypse, participating in rescue operations as a police officer and seeing many survivors who had lost loved ones.
Many could not accept that their family and friends had turned into zombies, insisting it was just a disease and refused to take action against them.
Sentiments of family loyalty made these people unwilling to accept the fact that their loved ones were gone.
