Now, Zhao Lin considered this invisible person as someone like those she encountered before.
After imagining a scene of family separation by life and death, a trace of sympathy flashed in Zhao Lin’s eyes.
"This invisible one is still too indecisive..."
"Apocalypse comes and family leaves, it is undoubtedly a sad thing, but the opponent in front is obviously a bloodthirsty zombie, and now a puppet of the Corpse King..."
Zhao Lin sighed helplessly, feeling obligated as a police officer to let this Evolver see the truth.
Immediately, Zhao Lin shouted loudly, "Open your eyes and take a good look, he is now a zombie!"
"Do you think you are saving him? No, you are harming him!"
"He has long lost his sanity and is no longer human, could you wake up?!"
"If you really care for him, you should let him escape this bloodthirsty body soon!"
At this time, Zhao Lin was firmly convinced that the Evolver hidden in the shadows couldn’t let go of past family ties, hence the indecision.
Zhao Lin’s sudden actions left Lu Chuan dumbfounded.
"Why is this woman suddenly shouting at the air?"
"Is she talking to the Evolver hiding in the dark?"
Lu Chuan glanced at the zombies beside him, feeling puzzled.
"Is it possible that within the Corpse Puppets I control, there exists a relative of that Evolver? Is that why they keep watching my Sunshine District?"
Focused on stopping Zhao Lin, Lu Chuan was unaware that Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue were discussing him, not other zombies.
Away from the scene, Ji Ruxue naturally heard Zhao Lin’s words but had no intention to explain.
Because Ji Ruxue knew that even if she explained, the other would never believe it.
After all, if she hadn’t experienced it herself, she wouldn’t believe it either.
Although her father is a zombie, he remarkably retains human consciousness!
In this matter, Ji Ruxue holds only one stance: no one can harm her father!
Though having two lifetimes, she has never felt the warmth of family.
Only after rebirth did she feel in her zombie father the care and attention, being remembered and looked after every day...
With her zombie father, Ji Ruxue felt real familial affection.
After the apocalypse, humans had long abandoned humanity, and for Ji Ruxue, those despicable humans were no more noble than her zombie father.
Seeing the invisible person fall silent after hearing her words, Zhao Lin thought she had successfully convinced them.
In her heart, Zhao Lin sighed quietly, "Just as I thought, this invisible one has an unspeakable past."
"It doesn’t matter, since you can’t be ruthless, let me help you sever ties with the painful past!"
"Zombies are zombies, humans are humans, it’s time for you to fully awaken!"
Zhao Lin immediately attacked Lu Chuan again, with moves becoming even more ruthless than before.
Lu Chuan grew in constant combat, while Zhao Lin, as an Evolver, was also learning. Both their combat skills were continually improving.
Though Zhao Lin wished to kill the zombie, Lu Chuan’s combat skills were entirely above hers.
Furthermore, with several other Evolved Zombies assisting, Zhao Lin was no match for Lu Chuan and had to rely on Ji Ruxue saving her from the shadows time and again.
Even after being saved multiple times, Zhao Lin’s resolve to kill Lu Chuan only grew stronger.
In Zhao Lin’s view, only by killing the zombie before her could she truly help the invisible one in the shadows.
For the living, having family members turned into zombies feels like an invisible chain binding them to the pre-apocalypse.
"Poor invisible one, even as an Evolver, why can’t you see the truth?"
"No matter who he was in life, he has now turned into a zombie, a bloodthirsty, killing zombie!"
"He doesn’t recognize your face, can’t discern your voice, he will only rabidly hunt you because of the scent of the living on you..."
Zhao Lin’s dagger swung faster and faster, seemingly making aiding the invisible one by severing the past her more significant goal.
In Zhao Lin’s eyes, the dead are gone, and the living continue; dwelling in the past benefits no one.
Since the dawn of the apocalypse over two months ago, Zhao Lin had helped numerous survivors by killing zombies that were once family many times.
At this moment, Lu Chuan was unwilling. Clearly stronger than Zhao Lin, yet the hidden Evolver repeatedly stopped him.
The feeling of having strength but unable to use it made Lu Chuan burn with rage but left helpless.
Once more enslaved by the mysterious force holding him in place, watching Zhao Lin’s dagger nearing his forehead, Lu Chuan struggled but to no avail.
At that moment, only the image of Little Qiqi appeared in Lu Chuan’s mind.
"Little Qiqi, I’m sorry, Dad tried his best."
"I never expected I could not keep my promise; it’s Dad’s fault for not protecting you..."
Just as Zhao Lin’s dagger was about to pierce Lu Chuan’s forehead, she was once again immobilized by Ji Ruxue.
"I’ve told you, you cannot harm him!"
Ji Ruxue’s voice was filled with anger, even carrying a trace of chilling killing intent!

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Dad Is Actually the Corpse King!
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80: Dad Is Actually the Corpse King!
"Damn it, this idiot is unbelievably foolish!"
Upon hearing Ji Ruxue’s slightly threatening words, Zhao Lin felt a surge of anger.
"Clearly possessing such powerful strength, yet so indecisive, does this Invisible plan to live with their memories forever?!"
Zhao Lin cursed inwardly, not anticipating that her originally flawless plan would go off course due to her teammate’s indecision.
Previously at the police station, her colleagues often said she was too kind and naïve, and that she always hesitated in this apocalyptic world.
Yet, Zhao Lin couldn’t believe she’d encounter someone even more indecisive today...
"The end of the world has been here for so long, doesn’t this fool understand yet?!"
"Zombies are just zombies; they have no connection to the people they were before, even if they look identical, they are completely different entities!"
At this moment, Zhao Lin’s eyes were filled with murderous intent, wanting to kill Lu Chuan before her.
Among the zombies she’d been battling repeatedly, the one with the most ordinary appearance was the most intimidating.
The outstanding combat skills were so pressuring that even Zhao Lin, a police officer, struggled to handle it.
Despite having numerous opportunities to kill the opponent, her teammate was not up to the task.
With the Invisible continually obstructing in secret, Zhao Lin knew it was impossible to kill the zombie before her.
Helplessly, Zhao Lin chose not to fight these zombies anymore, but dashed towards building number five.
At least tonight she had to kill the Corpse King; otherwise, everything she did would be for naught.
Seeing Zhao Lin trying to reach building number five, Lu Chuan immediately brandished a knife to block her.
Building five was his final boundary, and Lu Chuan would never allow anyone else to enter.
However, just as Lu Chuan swung his knife in mid-air, that strange force descended again, restricting Lu Chuan’s body once more.
"Damn it! I’m definitely going to kill you all!"
"Stand still!"
"If you have the guts, set me free and let’s have a real fight!"
Roar!
Trapped and unable to move, Lu Chuan could only let out roars, his face twisting into a terrifying grimace.
Lu Chuan’s frightening roars made the surrounding zombies shiver uncontrollably.
Fortunately, Ji Ruxue’s Telekinesis was limited now and couldn’t hold for too long, and after briefly being released, Lu Chuan quickly caught up with Zhao Lin.
"I told you, no one is allowed to enter!"
With red eyes, Lu Chuan kept swinging his machete at Zhao Lin, and although Zhao Lin was almost at the door, she was forced to turn and defend.
Bam!
This time Lu Chuan’s attack was strong, and Zhao Lin failed to block it temporarily, being knocked straight back against the unit door.
Screech~
The old iron door emitted a teeth-chattering sound, and even the iron sheet on the door bent.
"Damn it! This zombie is really troublesome!"
Zhao Lin’s face turned pale; the enormous recoil made her insides quake.
But Zhao Lin ignored this, quickly reaching back to yank the door open.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, the sound of something breaking through the air came from behind, and Zhao Lin instinctively dodged aside.
Only to see a steel knife flying past, slicing straight into the door, sparking metal upon impact.
Even the iron sheet on the door was shaved significantly by this knife.
"Damn it, are you done yet!"
Zhao Lin was at a loss for words, initially believing today’s plan to eliminate the Corpse King would go without a hitch, but hadn’t expected the invisible teammate to be so indecisive that she couldn’t even kill a zombie.
In the end, she was stuck outside the building, unable to proceed with her mission.
At this moment, she could fully relate to Lu Chuan’s earlier feeling.
Zhao Lin felt at a loss; fighting seemed pointless, as did not fighting.
Meant to kill zombies, but being restricted by a fellow human Evolver, she was almost furious enough to spit blood.
Bam bam bam!
Using this opportunity, Lu Chuan approached Zhao Lin directly; though unarmed, his well-honed combat skills kept him on par in the confrontation.
Unable to harm the opponent, Zhao Lin could only keep dodging, while Lu Chuan’s fists pounded the iron door, leaving one imprint after another.
In the distance, Ji Ruxue saw her zombie dad fighting so desperately and felt very confused.
"What’s up with dad today? I’ve seen him always laying low among the zombie hordes, why is he so fiercely fighting against Evolvers today?!"
Lu Chuan’s unusual behavior today left Ji Ruxue utterly puzzled.
"Is the Corpse King really in building number five?"
"I’ve been to every floor and room of building five, and besides supplies, there’s no sign of the Corpse King anywhere!"
"Could the zombies here be protecting the supplies my dad has gathered? Does that stuff even matter to zombies?!"
Ji Ruxue irritably ruffled her hair, unable to comprehend where her flawless plans had gone wrong.
"Did these zombies come here because the Corpse King senses danger and summoned them?"
"What exactly is inside building number five?"
"Could it possibly be for me?"
Wait...
"Protect me?!"
Ji Ruxue, deep in thought, suddenly froze.
Something occurred to her, and she quickly glanced at her zombie dad who was furiously trying to stop the policewoman.
At this moment, her zombie dad’s face was twisted into an incredibly gory visage that Ji Ruxue had never seen before.
Ji Ruxue was left staring blankly, her gaze somewhat dazed.
"So dad’s desperation, even willing to be hurt, isn’t to protect the Corpse King, but actually me on the seventh floor?"
"It’s not the Corpse King’s danger making dad angry, but the possibility of me being discovered?!"
"His unusual actions tonight were all because he didn’t want me to be harmed!"
Realizing all this, Ji Ruxue was filled with emotion; in her two lifetimes, no one had ever fought so fiercely for her.
"But if dad came to building five for me, why did the other zombies also come?"
"Could it be... dad can command their movements?!"
Ji Ruxue’s eyes widened suddenly.
If this were true, then it would explain why dad could gather supplies from an entire building while spending every day at home with her.
Even during zombie battles in the community, dad always hid somewhere close.
And when going out, dad mingled among other ordinary zombies.
If she didn’t recognize dad by his clothes, there’d be no way to distinguish him from other zombies...
All these signs could suggest only one possibility...
Could it be... dad really is the Corpse King?!

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Ji Ruxue: I Really Am Stupid!
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81: Ji Ruxue: I Really Am Stupid!
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue’s mind went completely blank.
This was something she had never imagined.
But now, all these phenomena connecting together left no other possibilities.
Ji Ruxue frantically ruffled her hair, finding it hard to accept this fact.
"How could my dad possibly be the Zombie King?..."
For a moment, Ji Ruxue felt her brain was in chaos.
She couldn’t help but recall the Zombie King she had seen in her previous life.
Those guys were all bloodthirsty and brutal, slaughtering humans mercilessly upon sight.
Even though the Zombie King’s own combat prowess wasn’t particularly strong, these guys were all vicious.
Many large Corpse Tides that occurred in the apocalypse were actually controlled by the Zombie King behind the scenes, and countless human survivors perished under these tides!
In the apocalypse, the Zombie King was nothing short of a disaster and a harbinger of doom for human survivors.
The emergence of a Zombie King always accompanied a frenzy of killing.
Moreover, every one of these creatures was cowardly and greedy for life, willing to manipulate zombies to do anything for survival and never exposing themselves to danger.
Possessing intelligence not inferior to humans, and even surpassing them, they were exceptionally deceitful and sinister.
They would even set traps to harm human survivors.
In the early days of the apocalypse, human survivors were busy trying to survive in this mutated world.
Coupled with the lack of experience, they had little understanding of the types and habits of zombies.
Without knowing the existence of a Zombie King, humans, with their inherent thinking, believed zombies were unintelligent beings.
As a result, in the early days, many human survivors died because of the Zombie King.
Many survivors and camps were destroyed.
Even many human warriors Ji Ruxue knew from the early apocalypse.
They perished in the Zombie King’s trap before they could grow stronger.
Even the survivor camp where Ji Ruxue lived was eventually overtaken by the Zombie King leading the zombies.
It could be said that the Zombie King was far more dangerous to humans than any other Evolved Zombie!
Yet the Zombie King in her memories couldn’t possibly connect to her zombie dad...
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The fierce battle below Building Number Five continued.
Ji Ruxue could see her zombie dad displaying a ferocity and brutality not usual for him.
The blood-colored pupils revealed a chilling intent to kill.
Each move was ruthless, devoid of the tenderness he usually showed her.
Punches left dents on the iron doors, proving his current anger.
Looking at her dad fighting so desperately for her.
Ji Ruxue truly couldn’t associate him with the sinister and deceitful Zombie King.
How could this be?!
If it hadn’t been for the zombie dad showing up in time, she would have starved to death.
At that time, he was like a ray of light illuminating her world.
Afterward, all he did every day was make milk for her, cook meals for her, and play with her.
He even collected various supplies for her to give her a better life.
Though her dad, like other zombies, couldn’t speak, whenever excited, he would pinch her cheeks to express joy and love.
Such a gentle and caring zombie dad couldn’t possibly be the bloodthirsty and brutal Zombie King she had seen in her previous life.
Even when Ji Ruxue was the Empress in her past life, having experienced many life-and-death crises.
But when this happened before her eyes, she still felt a bit confused and lost.
Though unwilling to believe it, all the signs suggested that her dad was not an ordinary Evolved Zombie but the Zombie King controlling the Sunshine District...
Ji Ruxue found it hard to imagine that in the apocalypse, not to mention zombies, even humans wouldn’t be as caring as her dad in such situations.
How could a Zombie King have the brilliance of humanity?
Wait a minute...
"I almost forgot! My dad is a zombie who retained his human consciousness!"
Ji Ruxue’s previously confused eyes instantly brightened.
"It must be this way! Zombie dad retained his human consciousness for some reason, so after turning into a zombie, he still lives like a human!"
"Because he has human consciousness, he’s fundamentally different from those Zombie Kings I encountered before!"
Once Ji Ruxue understood this, she suddenly saw the light.
Even though the Zombie King possessed intelligence, it ultimately had a zombie’s mindset.
But her dad was different, his body had turned into a zombie, but his consciousness hadn’t changed!
Ji Ruxue thought of all her actions during this time and couldn’t help but smile wryly at her own foolishness.
"I didn’t think I could be this stupid..."
"Actually trying to help dad break free from supposed Zombie King control by teaming up with the Nine Deaths Demon Police."
"Clearly, all the signs were so obvious, I should have thought of this long ago!"
"All of dad’s actions were beyond normal logic, yet I failed to link him with the Zombie King."
Especially when thinking about how she had planned to kill the Zombie King and let dad consume the Crystal Core, Ji Ruxue felt unbelievably ridiculous.
"I was so incredibly stupid to think about gouging out dad’s Crystal Core!"
Looking at the dad below who was still fighting desperately for her, Ji Ruxue felt immense regret.
If she hadn’t stopped in time, zombie dad might have been in danger today.
If that had happened, it would have been too late for her to regret!
Though she always aimed to protect dad’s safety, she had instead placed him in danger.
In an instant, Ji Ruxue’s heart was filled with guilt.
Just as Ji Ruxue cleared her thoughts, the battle below had reached a fever pitch.
Zhao Lin had determined that the Zombie King was in Building Number Five and tried desperately to break in to kill the Zombie King.
However, she was no match for Lu Chuan and a group of Evolved Zombies.
And without Ji Ruxue’s secret help, she instantly fell into a precarious situation.
Lu Chuan maneuvered ’Da Pang’, ’Lightning One’, and ’Lightning Two’ to encircle her, putting Zhao Lin in extreme danger facing the four Evolved Zombies.
The key was because she was confident the Invisible was helping her in secret, so many times she didn’t defend against attacks.
As a result, she suffered miserably.
Hiss~
The rib broken by Lu Chuan’s punch left Zhao Lin gasping in pain with every breath.
"Damn Invisible! We agreed to work together to kill the Zombie King, but you’re just watching?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Zhao Lin: Invisible, You Really Screwed Me Over!
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82: Zhao Lin: Invisible, You Really Screwed Me Over!
The security door of Building Five was right behind, but Zhao Lin had no chance to open it amidst the onslaught of zombies.
"Is this Invisible one out of her mind? The plan is about to succeed, where did she run off to?!"
Zhao Lin cursed endlessly in her heart; she never expected that at such a critical moment, her teammate would be so unreliable.
Bang bang bang!
Before Zhao Lin could think further, Lu Chuan’s fist, the size of a sandbag, directly smashed toward her.
Having devoured a second-tier Tyrant Crystal Core, Lu Chuan’s physical strength had seen a massive boost.
Moreover, he was furious for Little Qiqi’s safety, filling his every move with ferocity.
The wind from Lu Chuan’s fist was enough to alarm Zhao Lin.
Facing Lu Chuan’s attack, she could only keep dodging.
But the enemy she faced wasn’t just Lu Chuan alone.
Zhao Lin had just evaded Lu Chuan’s fist when a large hammer descended upon her head in the next second.
Her face went pale with fright immediately, using her right foot to pedal hard against the security door to dodge the blow with the rebound force.
The area in front of the unit door was narrow, and Zhao Lin had little chance to dodge while facing many foes.
At this moment, Zhao Lin couldn’t bother with killing the Corpse King upstairs; she fled to a more open space.
After all, continuing like this, she feared for her life.
Yet, Ji Ruxue was still in shock, not having recovered from the revelation that Lu Chuan was the Corpse King.
Without Ji Ruxue’s Time Control Power, Zhao Lin facing Lu Chuan and multiple Evolved Zombies simultaneously was nothing short of a fool’s dream.
In just two rounds of engagement, Zhao Lin was punched in the abdomen by Lu Chuan.
The force was so strong that it made Zhao Lin’s eyes roll back; even as a second-tier Evolver, Lu Chuan’s punch broke Zhao Lin’s ribs directly.
With two ribs broken, Zhao Lin’s movement speed decreased considerably.
After all, she was only human and couldn’t endure pain like a zombie.
Even breathing caused sharp pain due to her ribs.
Seeing Zhao Lin slow down, Lu Chuan’s attack speed became even more ferocious.
In an instant, Zhao Lin was overwhelmed by Lu Chuan and the Evolved Zombies to the point of crying out in pain.
"Da Pang" and "Lightning One" along with "Lightning Two" were all fighting with weapons, making Zhao Lin’s situation more difficult.
Zhao Lin knew too well, whether it was a giant hammer or a machete, if they landed on her, it would instantly render her powerless.
At this moment, she was utterly helpless and could only choose to take Lu Chuan’s punches head-on.
Bang bang bang!
Lu Chuan’s fists also made Zhao Lin suffer, a few punches later she was spitting blood, and several of her bones were broken.
Even her once beautiful face was swollen from Lu Chuan’s hits.
Zhao Lin’s gaze, initially filled with determined resolve, now brimmed with terror.
She felt as if her whole body was about to fall apart.
Under the assault of four zombies, Zhao Lin was treated like a punching bag by Lu Chuan.
Lu Chuan didn’t know why, but the peculiar force previously enveloping them vanished, and he could attack the others now.
At this moment, his exhilaration grew with each punch.
All night he had been suppressed by this woman cop, holding back his strength, and now he finally had the opportunity for revenge.
Lu Chuan only knew survival of the fittest, never understanding what it meant to show mercy.
Bam!
Another dull thud sounded as Lu Chuan landed a heavy punch, sending Zhao Lin flying four or five meters before crashing heavily to the ground.
This punch made Zhao Lin spew blood and nearly lose consciousness.
Zhao Lin could no longer hold back, shouting loudly, "What are you doing?! If you don’t intervene, I’m going to be beaten to death!"
Hearing Zhao Lin’s cry for help, Ji Ruxue finally snapped out of her daze.
Seeing the scene below Five Building, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but cover her face, she really couldn’t watch...
Thinking about working with the Nine Deaths Demon Police to deal with her father, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but feel ridiculous.
"To think I, Ji Ruxue, in my past life was... and now I’ve ended up in such a fiasco, it’s truly embarrassing..."
If she had to choose between the Nine Deaths Demon Police and her father.
Even if her father was the Corpse King, Ji Ruxue would still choose her father without hesitation.
But... the Nine Deaths Demon Police was someone she had brought along...
Looking at Zhao Lin being battered and mishandled below, Ji Ruxue felt a twinge of guilt.
Yet, the issue was, at this point, she had no good way to stop this fight.
Was she to come clean with Zhao Lin?
Would she tell Zhao Lin to stop the fight because the Corpse King planned to be slain was actually her father?
Ji Ruxue shook her head involuntarily.
Even she found the thought absurd.
She couldn’t figure out how to explain to the other side, after all, to humans, zombies were a menace to be eradicated.
Moreover, her father was the Corpse King, capable of commanding zombies and building an undead army.
"Forget it, I better not save her."
"If I save her now, it’ll be harder to explain later."
"That’s right, this woman doesn’t know me at all, hasn’t seen me before, she doesn’t know who I am, so it doesn’t matter if I let her down."
With this thought, Ji Ruxue nodded decisively.
Looking at Zhao Lin below, Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly, "Blame your own bad luck, besides you have nine lives, even if you die now, you can revive, it’s just a bit of suffering."
"If I hadn’t saved you back then, you might have lost this life, so now it’s your turn to repay..."
Ji Ruxue’s mind quickly shifted perspective in just an instant.
From beginning to end, the one she wanted to protect was her father.
As for the Nine Deaths Demon Police... this
woman was all bust and no brains, in the early post-apocalypse, she would be tricked countless times, one more time wouldn’t hurt...
Downstairs, Zhao Lin was barely holding on, hoping for Ji Ruxue to help.
But she didn’t know she had already been abandoned by Ji Ruxue...
Without Ji Ruxue’s aid, Zhao Lin was left to be beaten by Lu Chuan alone.
After suffering several more heavy blows from Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin collapsed to the ground, unable to get up.
Lu Chuan walked over to Zhao Lin, lifting her up with one hand.
Looking at the policewoman who caused him so much trouble, Lu Chuan’s blood-red eyes gleamed with murderous intent.
As Lu Chuan tightened his grip, Zhao Lin felt breathing became increasingly difficult, her vision plunged into darkness, and she passed out.
"Invisible one, you’re really useless!"

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Dad’s Identity Must Never Be Exposed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83: Dad’s Identity Must Never Be Exposed!
Looking at Zhao Lin, whom he had just choked unconscious, Lu Chuan mentally sneered.
He had been holding back his anger all night, and now he finally vented it!
"Aren’t you able to revive? This time I won’t kill you, I want to see how you’ll revive!"
Lu Chuan always liked to eliminate threats completely.
But the situation with this woman was completely different.
Lu Chuan remembered clearly, he had previously smashed this woman to a pulp with a giant hammer, breaking her bones to pieces.
Yet, despite this, she was somehow able to revive.
Not only did she appear lively in front of him, but her combat power had inexplicably increased several times!
Learning from past lessons, Lu Chuan wasn’t planning to let Zhao Lin die this time.
He threw Zhao Lin’s unconscious body to the ground, then instructed ’Da Pang’ to come over and swing a large hammer at Zhao Lin’s legs.
Crack!
With a loud sound, Zhao Lin’s legs were instantly broken.
"Ah!!!"
The next second, a scream like that of a slaughtered pig echoed between the buildings, Zhao Lin’s voice was particularly piercing in the dead of night.
The excruciating pain from her legs being forcibly broken awakened Zhao Lin from her oxygen-deprived stupor.
But the agony from her broken legs surged to her heart in the next moment, once again forcing Zhao Lin into unconsciousness.
Before passing out, her mind was filled with thoughts of Ji Ruxue.
"You damn Invisible, you’ve really screwed me over this time!"
"Don’t let me find you, or I won’t let you off!"
But at this point, Zhao Lin felt like crying because she realized she had never actually seen the other person’s face!
She couldn’t even hold a grudge against the Invisible in her mind because she didn’t know what they looked like...
When Lu Chuan lifted Zhao Lin again, he found that she had once more fainted from the pain, but two streams of tears had rolled down from the corners of her eyes.
"Did this woman cry from the pain?"
Seeing Zhao Lin in such a miserable state, Lu Chuan felt not an ounce of pity, his eyes still full of indifference.
Today this woman almost killed him and even threatened the safety of Little Qiqi.
If he could kill her, he would have already hacked her to pieces in anger.
Lu Chuan disliked letting danger linger beyond his control.
So he planned to keep this policewoman alive, treating her like a caged dog if necessary.
This woman’s ability to grow stronger upon revival made Lu Chuan somewhat uneasy,
The best response was to keep her under his watchful eyes, always under his control.
Anyway, now that Zhao Lin’s legs were broken, Lu Chuan didn’t believe she could stir up any more trouble.
As long as he didn’t let the policewoman die, she couldn’t revive and retaliate against him.
Then Lu Chuan picked up an iron chain from in front of Building No. 5, originally used to lock the unit door, perfect now for binding Zhao Lin.
Ji Ruxue watched all this unfold through the balcony on the second floor.
She hadn’t expected her gentle and caring father to have such a ruthless side!
But seeing her father acting so decisively, Ji Ruxue felt not repulsed, but rather delighted.
In this apocalyptic world, kindness would only lead to one’s own demise.
Ji Ruxue had experienced countless killings amid her journey to becoming the Human Queen in her previous life.
Being betrayed by those around her was even more common, so Ji Ruxue had long understood that to survive in this world, one must become cold and ruthless!
Initially, Ji Ruxue had been concerned that her zombie father, retaining human consciousness, might struggle to survive after the apocalypse, due to his gentle demeanor towards her.
But now Ji Ruxue was completely at ease, realizing her father was far more resolute than she had imagined.
"This time, Dad didn’t kill the enemy, only broke her legs. Seems he already understood the Nine Deaths Demon Police’s power to become stronger upon revival."
Ji Ruxue nodded in admiration, a faint smile unconsciously appearing on her lips.
To Ji Ruxue, the dumber the Corpse King was, the happier she would be, as such an existence would pose a significant threat to humanity.
But if the Corpse King was her father, Ji Ruxue only wished for him to be as smart as possible...
After all, surviving the apocalypse wasn’t easy.
Given the current situation, having this Nine Deaths Demon Police in her father’s hands was the best outcome.
Though this woman was easily deceived, she wasn’t exactly a fool.
Now that she knew about the Corpse King in Sunshine District, she must not be allowed to leave.
If her knowledge leaked, it would put her father at great risk.
The Corpse King was extremely dangerous for humanity.
However, the combat power of the Corpse King itself wasn’t strong, and if targeted by a Human Evolver, it might easily fall into danger.
Facing a Corpse King, humanity’s main problem was being unable to locate it and identifying which among the horde was the King.
Thus, the Corpse King blending in with the hordes without standing out was the best concealment.
The current issue was that Zhao Lin already knew about the Corpse King’s existence in the Sunshine District.
If she escaped and exposed this to the Survivor Base, it would pose great danger to her father.
Knowing the Nine Deaths Demon Police’s initial mentality, she was confident that if the enemy could leave,
whether out of revenge against the Corpse King or some inner sense of justice, the Nine Deaths Demon Police would find countless ways to carry out an assassination plan against the Corpse King.
Her father’s strategy of crippling the enemy’s legs to restrict her movements was undoubtedly the best solution.
As for whether Zhao Lin felt pain because of this...
Ji Ruxue didn’t care in the slightest.
Initially, she had intended to ally with the Nine Deaths Demon Police mainly because she thought her father was too weak and wanted to rely on the police’s strength to protect him.
In Ji Ruxue’s heart, her father was always the most important.
Even if the Nine Deaths Demon Police were a future human powerhouse and might be a useful ally if subdued,
to Ji Ruxue, they were still not as important as her father.
Her father’s identity as the Corpse King must never be revealed.
At least not yet.
Unless in the future her father or she became strong enough to withstand an attack from Human Evolvers without fear.
Presently, she and her father still needed to keep a low profile and live cautiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: From Now On, I Am Dad’s Strongest Bodyguard!
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84: From Now On, I Am Dad’s Strongest Bodyguard!
Ji Ruxue is still very confident about the future direction.
She has memories of her past life, with the cultivation technique humans only researched at the late stage of the apocalypse.
She even became a dual talent holder after rebirth, and both are exceptionally top-notch talent abilities. Ji Ruxue believes she will surely surpass the achievements of her previous life.
"Don’t worry, Dad. Once I grow up, no one will be able to hurt you!"
After the apocalypse, fists are the hard truth.
As long as one has sufficiently strong strength, even black can be said as white.
This is the principle Ji Ruxue summarized through experience in her past life.
What does it matter if it’s the Corpse King?
What does it matter if humans criticize her?
As long as she possesses mighty strength.
Even if Dad’s identity as the Corpse King is exposed, she can still protect him completely.
At this moment, the battle below is nearing its end.
Seeing Dad has captured the Nine Deaths Demon Police, Ji Ruxue rushed downstairs and ran towards home.
After all, if Dad finds out she’s not home, it would be bad; now is not the time to expose herself.
But because of her plan, a large number of zombies gathered under Building Five.
To protect the safety of Building Five, Lu Chuan actually gathered all the zombies in the entire community.
Ji Ruxue could only helplessly run to Building Four, then all the way to the rooftop.
Now she can’t go downstairs; she can only think of a way to move from above.
Building Four is the closest building to Building Five, which can save her maximum telekinesis power.
Feeling the cool breeze blowing around, Ji Ruxue took a deep breath and then operated her telekinesis to lift herself up.
The next second, this petite body of Ji Ruxue directly floated into the air, successfully reaching the rooftop of Building Five without being discovered by other zombies.
Ji Ruxue patted her chest, a hint of smugness flashing in her eyes.
"It seems rebirth as a baby has its benefits; her body weight is much lighter than when she was an adult. Just breaking through to the second stage, she already has a certain sky-controlling power!"
After a successful landing, Ji Ruxue didn’t dare to delay, afraid of being discovered by Dad. She quickly returned to the bedroom on the seventh floor from the rooftop of Building Five.
Cautiously returning to the room, Ji Ruxue directly closed the bedroom door pretending to sleep.
...
After dealing with Zhao Lin, Lu Chuan rapidly deployed the Corpse Puppet to patrol the surroundings of the neighborhood.
Although he doesn’t know why the Evolver who could restrict his actions stopped fighting later, Lu Chuan will not give up looking for the opponent.
With such an Evolver awakened with a peculiar ability around, he has to sleep with one eye open.
"Even time can be controlled... Can this world awaken even more heaven-defying talents?!"
However, Lu Chuan also doesn’t know if the opponent has already left or is just hiding too well.
He dispatched a large number of Corpse Puppets to meticulously search the surroundings but couldn’t find the opponent’s trace.
"Hmph! You’d better keep hiding and not be found by me."
"Otherwise, I’ll definitely make you understand the cost of angering me!"
Lu Chuan’s eyes flashed scarlet in the dark night, looking extremely terrifying.
Tonight’s two Evolvers have thoroughly touched his reverse scale; given the opportunity, he would definitely root them out.
Glancing at the female officer who had fainted from pain at his feet, Lu Chuan controlled ’Lightning One’ to carry her directly to the sixth floor of Building Five.
At present, Zhao Lin’s legs have been smashed by ’Da Pang’, rendering him almost powerless to resist, even moving is problematic.
Just looking at the female officer lying in the corner, Lu Chuan still felt uneasy; this person is too difficult to deal with.
Such talent ability, full health resurrection upon death, compounded by enhanced strength, is simply like an unbeatable cheat.
Lu Chuan thought for a while and then tied the officer’s hands, after all, if she wakes up and commits suicide, upon resurrection, she might come looking for him again.
To be extra cautious, Lu Chuan also assigned ’Lightning One’ to specifically watch her.
If there’s any unusual movement from this woman, he could know the situation first-hand.
After completing all this, Lu Chuan could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
Tiptoeing back to the seventh floor, he pushed open the door and saw Little Qiqi sleeping soundly on the bed, and Lu Chuan finally showed a smile on his face.
"Little one, as long as you can grow healthily, even if it costs Dad’s life, it’s worth it!"
Seeing Little Qiqi’s blanket uncovered, Lu Chuan carefully stepped forward to cover the little one with the blanket.
Then gently closed the door, feared disturbing Little Qiqi’s sleep.
When the door closed, Ji Ruxue opened her eyes.
Her pure and bright eyes carried extremely complex emotions beyond her age.
Dad is still the same as before, so gentle and caring towards her.
No matter that he’s the Corpse King, as long as Dad loves her, he will forever be her closest person!
Thinking of this, a hint of a smile flashed across Ji Ruxue’s face.
"I never thought I’d guess for so long what Dad’s awakened evolutionary ability is, yet didn’t think of him being the Corpse King."
"Originally, I believed Dad was an ordinary zombie, likely becoming cannon fodder after the apocalypse. Now, I don’t need to worry about this issue anymore."
Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but recall those powerful Corpse Kings she saw in her past life, each incredibly cunning and extremely afraid of death.
Beside the Corpse King, there are usually clusters of evolved zombies protecting them, fearing even the slightest danger.
Yet until now, there hasn’t been another zombie besides Dad approaching her.
Ji Ruxue understood well this is due to Dad’s preserved human consciousness leading all this.
Dad wishes for her to grow up healthy and happily, hence doesn’t want other zombies approaching her, affecting her...
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue felt increasingly touched.
This feeling of being cherished is something she never experienced in her past life.
For Ji Ruxue, she struggled amidst water and fire in her past life, constantly fighting on life and death lines.
In the apocalypse, walking alone without betrayal or being framed is already considered a great joy.
This precious familial affection made Ji Ruxue cherish it even more.
"Don’t worry, Dad, you are not alone now; you still have me by your side!"
"From now onwards, I will be your strongest bodyguard!"

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Why Is This Corpse King Hoarding So Much Baby Formula?
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 85: Why Is This Corpse King Hoarding So Much Baby Formula?
After resolving tonight’s crisis, Lu Chuan finally sat on the sofa to rest.
Leaning against the back of the sofa, Lu Chuan closed his eyes and pondered, feeling a wave of exhaustion inside.
Although he had now become a zombie and could hardly feel fatigue or pain physically,
to deal with the female cop who could continually resurrect, he had controlled a large number of zombies to fight together tonight, consuming a great deal of his Spiritual Power.
Even as a zombie now, Lu Chuan still felt tired and wanted to rest a bit.
Though tonight’s events were somewhat tortuous and cost much of his energy,
he finally managed to capture this troublesome female cop who could also resurrect.
For now, it was considered removing a major threat to his heart.
Yet, what puzzled Lu Chuan was, exactly what is in this Sunshine District?
It’s just such a dilapidated old neighborhood, yet two Evolvers are eyeing this place?
Lu Chuan rubbed his temples, a subconscious motion he used in his previous life after working overtime to relieve fatigue.
Although he had now become a zombie, this action still brought him some mental comfort.
"I just don’t get it, one can resurrect after dying and their power increases several folds, the other can secretly restrict people’s actions."
"The abilities of these two guys are astronomical. Instead of taking advantage of the chaos to make a name for themselves, why do they insist on opposing my Sunshine District?"
"Could it be they’re specifically targeting me? I shouldn’t have been exposed..."
Lu Chuan frowned, unable to figure it out at the moment.
He was quite worried about the Evolver who hadn’t shown up, despite him searching extensively yet finding nothing.
That guy didn’t even need to show up to be able to restrict Lu Chuan’s actions.
If it weren’t for the fact that the other party kept intervening, this female cop would have been captured long ago, without wasting so much time and effort.
"Fortunately, it seems that the Evolver lurking in the shadows has a limited number of uses for their ability."
"If his ability could be used indefinitely, I would have had no chance of winning tonight."
Lu Chuan recalled that towards the end of the battle tonight, that peculiar force restricting him finally disappeared.
Most likely, that Evolver had reached the limit of his power, unable to continuously exert it.
At least in Lu Chuan’s view, it made no sense for these human Evolvers to have been ready to cooperate, only to abandon their partners when success was near.
Isn’t that too outrageous?
Reflecting on tonight’s battle, a vague sense of worry crept into Lu Chuan’s heart.
"It seems I must quickly gain control of a stronger second-tier combat-type zombie, otherwise, these human survivors will only grow stronger and become increasingly troublesome..."
Currently, it takes three of his first-tier Evolved Zombies together just to restrain the female cop, clearly showing that their power is nearing its limit; gaining control of a second-tier combat-type zombie is imperative.
With sufficient strength, he could live in this post-apocalyptic world with peace of mind.
...
The next morning.
After a night of struggle, Zhao Lin gradually regained consciousness.
Looking at the somewhat unfamiliar environment, Zhao Lin’s mind was muddled.
"What’s going on? Did I not die?"
Ssss~
Just as her consciousness returned, a sharp pain suddenly struck Zhao Lin.
She quickly looked down and realized that her legs had been smashed, still oozing blood.
The once graceful, well-proportioned legs were now a bloody mess, and glancing down at them sent a shiver through her spine, forcing her to quickly look away.
Such a gory sight, even she dared not stare directly.
Meanwhile, after being treated as a punching bag by the zombies last night, Zhao Lin felt like her whole body was falling apart, aside from her legs.
Everywhere Lu Chuan had struck her was either fractured or bruised...
"Damn Invisible! Just when the plan was about to succeed, and it still failed!"
"We agreed to kill the Corpse King together, yet you left me alone at the foot of the building?! You bastard!"
This time Zhao Lin truly understood the fear of facing enemies like gods and allies like pigs.
Encouraging her to charge into the zombie horde, yet abandoning her immediately after.
Marvelous, truly marvelous!
"Damn Invisible, you’d better hope I don’t meet you again. If I do..."
Zhao Lin was suddenly stunned, realizing she didn’t even know what the other person looked like, losing even the chance for revenge...
After venting her anger, Zhao Lin, enduring tremendous pain, began to survey her surroundings.
With one glance, she saw the Evolved Zombie standing at the door, staring intently at her.
The sight of the Agile Type Evolved Zombie, caught off guard, startled Zhao Lin.
Though the figure appeared thin, standing there dumbly without moving, Zhao Lin dared not underestimate him.
She had witnessed this creature’s ferocity the previous night, slashing wildly with dual blades, showing formidable combat prowess.
"This Evolved Zombie just keeps staring at me without doing anything, could it be controlled by the Corpse King?"
Zhao Lin frowned.
"Am I now in the hands of that Corpse King?"
"Really strange, having captured me, why not kill me?"
Zhao Lin felt deeply puzzled, believing zombies to be a bloodthirsty monster focused solely on slaughter.
Yet, they captured her, without taking any further action, which was indeed abnormal...
"It can’t be that the zombie noticed I can revive, so deliberately chose not to kill me?!"
At this suspicion, Zhao Lin’s pupils contracted, her eyes flashing with profound horror.
"That can’t be, if this is true, that zombie’s intelligence is way too high?!"
Since the apocalypse began, Zhao Lin had never seen a zombie with intelligence.
The Corpse King now had her limbs tied, and if this was to prevent her from committing suicide and reviving, that level of intelligence is too exaggerated?!
Zhao Lin soon examined the room she was currently in, and found it filled with infant supplies.
Milk powder, diapers, baby clothes, even books and toys!
One might mistake this place for a warehouse of an infant supply store.
The sheer amount of baby supplies utterly confused Zhao Lin, as this room looked nothing like a place where a Corpse King would reside.
"Even stacking milk powder and diapers into mountains—what exactly is this Corpse King planning?"

chapters.title: Chapter 86: The Despicable and Shameless Corpse King!
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 86: The Despicable and Shameless Corpse King!
Zhao Lin had only heard of zombies devouring human flesh, but she’d never heard of one needing milk.
She truly could not understand what was going on in this Sunshine District.
Not only was there a Corpse King capable of controlling other zombies, but its manner was also so bizarre...
On the other side, Lu Chuan had already learned that Zhao Lin had awakened through the perspective of ’Lightning One.’
Looking at the woman before him, Lu Chuan frowned.
This resurrectable policewoman had caused him quite a bit of trouble lately, and Lu Chuan had no goodwill towards her.
If it weren’t for her unique Resurrection Ability, Lu Chuan would have made sure she was as dead as could be.
Seeing Zhao Lin awaken and examine her surroundings, Lu Chuan closely monitored her actions through ’Lightning One.’
This woman was both dangerous and troublesome, and most critical of all, dealing with her was extremely tricky.
He had already crippled her legs, making her unable to stir up much trouble within Building Five.
However, Lu Chuan was most concerned about the possibility of the policewoman suddenly committing suicide.
What if she resurrected and her power increased once again?
That would be a huge problem for him...
"Damn it, how can there be such an abnormal power that resurrects and strengthens?!"
"Isn’t this woman practically carrying a cheat code?!"
Lu Chuan was truly bewildered by this world he had come to; is there anything left that won’t happen?
They say birth, aging, sickness, and death are unavoidable events, yet this person could be crushed to pulp and still resurrect?!
Is there any justice in this?
Lu Chuan remembered the first time he encountered the policewoman when ’Da Pang’ killed her with a casual blow, only for her to resurrect that night and be able to contend with an Evolved Zombie.
For safety’s sake, he had smashed all her bones to bits, but even then, she could resurrect completely unscathed, with combat power multiplying!
Originally, Lu Chuan thought the emergence of zombies in this world was already defying reason.
But compared to the woman before him, zombies seemed perfectly reasonable...
The most troublesome part for Lu Chuan was figuring out how to deal with this woman.
He couldn’t release her, and couldn’t kill her.
Even though he had currently broken her legs, restricting her mobility, who could guarantee that she wouldn’t simply commit suicide swiftly?
Extinguishing her suicidal thoughts wouldn’t be that easy.
If she truly resolved to die, Lu Chuan might have a hard time stopping her.
Based on the multitude of TV shows and movies he’d seen in his previous life, Lu Chuan could easily summarize dozens of suicide methods.
"Damn! This woman is troublesome, why did I have to encounter her?!"
The more he thought about it, the more irritated Lu Chuan became, unable to resist rubbing his increasingly full head of hair.
Suddenly, Lu Chuan’s eyes lit up, and he smirked coldly.
"Got it! Aren’t you quite the altruist? I’ll satisfy your world-saving sense of justice."
"Let’s see if you can keep on being so self-sacrificing!"
Stopping someone from committing suicide forcefully is exceedingly difficult. To truly prevent her, he could only completely quash the policewoman’s notion of suicide.
Lu Chuan picked up the paper and pen used by Little Qiqi for practice and started writing awkwardly.
"Dad, what are you doing?"
Curious, Ji Ruxue, who was holding her milk bottle drinking, came closer upon seeing this scene.
Written crookedly on the paper were the words: "Live well; if you die, everyone at the police station will be buried with you."
Ji Ruxue immediately realized this was intended for that Nine Deaths Demon Police.
Thinking for a moment, Ji Ruxue understood Lu Chuan’s intention.
"Dad knows that the Nine Deaths Demon Realm has the Resurrection Ability, so he’s worried they’ll choose suicide and further trouble him."
"He intends to use the lives of the people at the police station to completely extinguish the Nine Deaths Demon Realm’s thoughts of suicide."
Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile secretly to herself; this method might not have any effect on others, who might even find the threat ridiculous.
But for the Nine Deaths Demon Police who was highly responsible before the apocalypse, this method might indeed work.
Currently, the Nine Deaths Demon Police in the early apocalypse is still at a stage where they believe in kindness, beauty, and willingness to sacrifice for others’ lives.
...
On the sixth floor.
After waking up, Zhao Lin glanced around her surroundings and caught her breath to regain some strength.
Looking at ’Lightning One’ standing motionlessly at the door, Zhao Lin tried to move slightly, seeking a better angle to relax her limbs.
Her hands and feet were bound, unable to move or do anything.
Zhao Lin shifted her body slightly, attempting to free the chains on her hands by finding a spot to unchain them.
But the next second, a whizzing sound came, and a steel knife was suddenly poised at her neck.
Zhao Lin’s body quivered, looking back to see ’Lightning One’ at the door.
"So this thing’s been watching me all along..."
But staring at the steel knife at her neck, Zhao Lin coldly smirked, showing no fear at all.
Her legs were already crippled; unable to move or fight, she might as well end it all.
The key thing was that Zhao Lin had figured out she possessed the skill to resurrect.
At worst, she could let the zombie kill her, and upon resurrection, her legs would be restored, leaving her the ability to fight these zombies.
Clearly, Lu Chuan wasn’t about to let that happen.
Then Zhao Lin heard footsteps and saw the highly human-like zombie she encountered last night, possessing great combat skills, walk in.
"Isn’t this the Invisible’s relative? What’s he coming to me for?"
Zhao Lin frowned, recognizing Lu Chuan before her.
This was the zombie who repeatedly stopped her from acting yesterday, resulting in her being treated like a punching bag on the ground.
Last night, this guy broke several of her ribs, making it painful to breathe now.
Zhao Lin turned her head away unwilling to look at Lu Chuan, but Lu Chuan approached her, handing her a sheet of paper.
Zhao Lin looked up puzzled, and upon seeing the message on the paper, she was suddenly furious.
"Damn Corpse King! Such despicable and shamelessness!"
"The Invisible was right; these Corpse Kings are indeed a group of deceitful scoundrels!"

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Just Treat Her Like a Pet
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 87: Just Treat Her Like a Pet
After being threatened by Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin felt both shocked and angry.
She widened her eyes, filled with fury.
However, after tossing the note to her, Lu Chuan turned and left.
He believed that with this saintly lady cop’s temperament, in order to protect the lives of the survivors in the police station, she definitely wouldn’t attempt suicide anymore.
Zhao Lin was trembling with anger, she never expected this Corpse King to be so despicable, to threaten the survivors in the police station to prevent her from committing suicide.
At the same time, she was deeply shocked, despite knowing from the Invisible that Corpse Kings usually possess very high intelligence.
But today she experienced firsthand that this Corpse King not only recognized her ability to resurrect but even resorted to threatening the survivors to stop her from resurrecting!
Zhao Lin seriously doubted, is this really something a bloodthirsty zombie could do?
Probably only humans adept at plotting and scheming could accomplish this?!
Though Zhao Lin was very reluctant to agree with the other party, thinking about the innocent survivors in the police station, she could only compromise with resignation.
Before the apocalypse, as a police officer, Zhao Lin’s duty was to protect the lives and property of the citizens.
Zhao Lin could sacrifice herself without hesitance to save others but could never cause someone to lose their life because of her.
Guided by her own values, Zhao Lin wouldn’t allow her personal issues to harm others or the innocent survivors.
The police station now was not like the initial phase of the apocalypse, with ample resources, numerous manpower, and plenty of ammunition.
After more than two months of living in the apocalypse, the police station’s combat strength was not like before, with barely a few officers left.
Zhao Lin was crystal clear that now she is the only Evolver in the entire police station.
In this constantly changing apocalypse, ordinary people find it increasingly difficult to survive.
If the police station loses her protection, should the Corpse King indeed make a move on the survivors, they are doomed.
Looking at the handwriting on the note, Zhao Lin felt endlessly ironic.
Absolutely unbelievable, she was actually captured by a zombie and even threatened by it.
Zhao Lin turned her head to glare at the ’Lightning One’ standing at the door, viciously saying, "You better not harm them, or... or I’ll show you my death!"
Seeing ’Lightning One’ remain unmoved, Zhao Lin then looked around and shouted at the top of her lungs, "Corpse King! I know you can hear me!"
"I warn you not to hurt them, dare hurt others, I’ll show you my death!"
Shouting frantically at her surroundings, but receiving no response, Zhao Lin could only brood alone on the sixth floor.
...
Returning to the seventh-floor living room, Lu Chuan, upon hearing the sound from downstairs, couldn’t help but show a peculiar expression.
Show me your death?
This is indeed a terrifying threat.
Lu Chuan remembered the last time he heard such words were in a melodramatic love-hate plot where the heroine used it to threaten the hero...
"Using suicide as a threat, how terrifying."
Lu Chuan smirked internally, hearing Zhao Lin say this, he knew this woman wouldn’t easily commit suicide.
Indeed, dealing with a saint requires such an approach to be most effective.
Beside him, Ji Ruxue naturally also heard Zhao Lin’s voice.
"Seems like Daddy has confined her on the sixth floor, maybe if I get a chance I can go and see her."
"After all, if it weren’t for me inviting her to Sunshine District, maybe this Nine Deaths Demon Police wouldn’t have ended up like this..."
Ji Ruxue felt somewhat embarrassed when recalling this.
This Nine Deaths Demon Police was indeed a formidable figure among humans, yet because of her, now captured by zombie Daddy.
Even her legs were smashed, unable to die or escape, truly a pitiful sight.
If not for her sudden betrayal last night, she wouldn’t have ended up like this.
Thinking back to last night’s scene of Zhao Lin being surrounded and beaten by zombies, Ji Ruxue’s face couldn’t help but blush.
"I never thought I, Ji Ruxue, would pull such a joke..."
Well, anyway, the identity of the Invisible no longer exists from now on.
She planned to find a chance to visit Zhao Lin downstairs.
In Ji Ruxue’s heart, she always wanted to recruit this Nine Deaths Demon Police.
After all, she’s a formidable foe who survived the human’s late stage.
If Nine Deaths Demon Police’s mind wasn’t so flawed, wasting too many resurrection opportunities early, she actually had a great chance to break through to the Emperor Realm.
Even looking across the apocalypse, Evolvers with such heaven-defying abilities are rare.
If she could really recruit such a powerful Evolver, the difficulty of future apocalypse life would greatly decrease.
Most importantly, now during the apocalypse’s early stage, this Nine Deaths Demon Police is naïve and easily trusting.
If she doesn’t seize this opportunity, it will be hard to deal with this woman once she darkens.
Thinking this, Ji Ruxue moved to Lu Chuan’s side, pretending ignorance and innocently asked, "Daddy, I think I heard some sounds."
"What’s the noise downstairs?"
Hearing Little Qiqi’s innocent and cute voice, Lu Chuan was slightly stunned.
He couldn’t help but turn his head, seeing Little Qiqi’s very pure and adorable appearance, with eyes pure and untainted by the world.
Though apocalypse life is cruel, Little Qiqi is still young, Lu Chuan didn’t want the child to have a harsh childhood.
This world might not be so beautiful, could be very dark, but he was willing to be this dark person, blocking all dangers outside.
Parental love is like a mountain; since he considered Little Qiqi as his daughter, he has the responsibility to provide her a wonderful world.
Little Qiqi, as a newborn, came into this unfamiliar world already without parents, is very pitiable, Lu Chuan didn’t want the little one to bear more hardships.
However, the female cop downstairs who can resurrect poses a great threat, he absolutely couldn’t let her go.
After some thinking, Lu Chuan took the note and wrote on the paper: "That’s a pet Daddy keeps."
He couldn’t release this woman now, nor could he kill her directly, she could only be kept in Building No. 5.
As long as he’s feeding her water and food regularly, keep her alive, it would be like keeping a pet in the building.
This woman didn’t know when she’d end up dead outside, at least here she could stay alive.
She should be thankful to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Invisible, Hurry and Save Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 88: Invisible, Hurry and Save Me!
Pet?!
Ji Ruxue heard Lu Chuan’s words and couldn’t help but suppress a laugh inside.
Never would she have thought that in her past life, the renowned and decisive Nine Deaths Demon Police was now being treated as a pet by her father...
The Nine Deaths Demon Police was exceptionally beautiful and had an outstanding physique, along with strong combat prowess, making them a well-known existence in the apocalypse.
After the fall into darkness, the Nine Deaths Demon Police’s cold and decisive personality sparked a desire for conquest among many human evolvers, with many wanting to subdue her.
But the fate of these people was without exception; either they fled in disgrace or died at the hands of the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
If the powerful humans of the past life knew the Nine Deaths Demon Police was being kept as a pet by her father, their jaws would surely drop in astonishment.
Ji Ruxue was curious about what kind of shock her father would show if he learned of the Nine Deaths Demon Police’s past identity and status.
Yet, Lu Chuan wasn’t thinking so much at the moment.
After hearing what Zhao Lin said earlier, Lu Chuan knew that this woman had already compromised, which made him sigh in relief.
This woman, who could resurrect, was like a ticking time bomb in the community if she couldn’t let go of her suicidal intentions.
If she ever decided to commit suicide on a whim, upon resurrection, she might crazily cause trouble for him.
As expected, everyone has weaknesses. Once you seize someone’s weakness, you can easily control them.
People like Zhao Lin, who have a saint-like nature, are the easiest to deal with in the apocalypse.
Lu Chuan didn’t think there was anything wrong with using others’ lives as leverage. Doing whatever it takes to survive the apocalypse is a necessary skill.
People like Zhao Lin, who are willing to sacrifice themselves for strangers, are truly peculiar. Were it not for her resurrection ability, she’d have died long ago.
However, Lu Chuan also knew he was not invincible and had his own weaknesses too.
Lu Chuan turned to look at Little Qiqi, who was holding a bottle and drinking milk. Her adorable appearance made him feel tender affection.
Though this world was very unfamiliar to him, with no sense of attachment at all.
But now, with Little Qiqi in his life, Lu Chuan knew he had his reverse scale and attachment...
He absolutely would not allow any existence to threaten Little Qiqi’s safety.
...
"Hey hey hey, Corpse King, can you hear me?!"
"I’m hungry, I want to eat. Can you give me something to eat?!"
"You’re so afraid of me dying, you surely wouldn’t want me to starve to death directly!"
Zhao Lin looked around in frustration, her stomach was already growling loudly with hunger.
Since yesterday she hadn’t eaten, and all the hard-earned, sparse supplies she had collected were basically given to the survivors at the police station.
After going through a series of battles last night, her physical strength was greatly exhausted.
Plus, being hit by ’Da Pang’ and having both legs broken, causing a lot of blood loss, she hadn’t had a drop to drink for a long time, continuously depleting her energy. Even as a second-level evolver, Zhao Lin was struggling.
Lu Chuan looked at Zhao Lin’s complexion, as it turned out, this woman already had a bloodless face and her lips were somewhat dry and pale.
The sixth floor only had some baby supplies, so Lu Chuan controlled ’Lightning One’ to carry the policewoman away.
Upon opening the door on the fifth floor, Zhao Lin’s eyes widened immediately.
She originally thought the stockpile of supplies on the sixth floor was outrageous, but never expected the fifth floor to also be filled with all kinds of living supplies.
The room was stacked high with bottled water and infant formula, fifty-pound bags of rice were piled to the ceiling.
There were all sorts of breads, biscuits, noodles, etc., foods with longer shelf lives.
Seeing these foods, Zhao Lin’s eyes became a bit dazed, even sparkling with a burst of bright light.
My heavens, in the two months she had spent in the apocalypse, when had she seen so many resources?!
Did this Corpse King collect all the supplies from the surrounding areas and brought them here? Surely the entire building couldn’t be filled with supplies, right?!
Zhao Lin almost wanted to cry but had no tears, because she hadn’t eaten a single full meal in these past two months, just looking at all this food made her drool.
Thinking of this made Zhao Lin grit her teeth, no wonder she couldn’t gather any supplies from outside.
Everything had been moved here by the Corpse King?!
In these two months, she couldn’t even bring herself to swallow a mouthful of water, living frugally every day, what kind of hellish days were those?!
But then Zhao Lin furrowed her brow and felt puzzled.
"Why would the Corpse King collect so much human supplies? A bunch of bloodthirsty monsters don’t need to eat these things?"
"Surely it’s not to force human survivors to venture out in search of food, right?"
Apart from that, Zhao Lin really couldn’t think of any other possibility...
Lu Chuan controlled ’Lightning One’ and just tossed Zhao Lin onto the ground, making Zhao Lin grimace in pain and continuously gasp.
"Damn Corpse King! I won’t let you get away with this!"
"I advise you to treat me gently, if you mess me up, don’t blame me!"
But before Zhao Lin could finish her sentence, ’Lightning One’ tossed two breads and a bottle of mineral water into her lap.
There was even a piece of dried beef jerky among them, Zhao Lin’s eyes widened like light bulbs.
Then Zhao Lin stopped caring and directly tore open the packages, eating vigorously.
Zhao Lin began to feast, a mouthful of bread and a mouthful of water; this feeling of substantial food in her stomach was something she had not experienced before.
The wheat scent emanating from the bread made her feel like her bones were softening.
As the apocalypse progressed, resources were becoming more and more scarce.
Upholding a self-sacrificing attitude, Zhao Lin had distributed most of the supplies she collected to the survivors, keeping only a small portion for herself.
Consequently, Zhao Lin later relied only on sips of drinking water, her stomach growling with hunger every day.
Now, this feeling of eating till she was full made her feel completely satisfied.
Especially when she tore open the packaging and gnawed on the beef jerky, Zhao Lin’s eyes even welled up with tears.
"So this is the taste of meat?! How wonderful!"
"I already forgot how long it’s been since I felt so full, staying here like this every day really doesn’t seem so bad..."
Suddenly Zhao Lin shook her head vigorously.
"What am I thinking? Everyone is waiting for me to lead them to the base, how can I be so selfish and indulge here!"
But when Zhao Lin looked down and saw her own broken legs, she immediately became downcast again.
"Now with my legs crippled and unable to commit suicide to resurrect, what can I do..."
Zhao Lin’s eyes lit up as she suddenly remembered someone, the Invisible, whom she had never met.
Though she was tricked by the Invisible this time, Zhao Lin still held hope.
"Since the Invisible wants to get rid of the Corpse King, she shouldn’t give up easily, with her strong power, she surely can save me."
"Invisible, I don’t blame you for tricking me, just hurry up and save me!"
Thinking of this, Zhao Lin took a ruthless bite of the bread.
"So good..."

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Dad, I Want to Go Downstairs and Play!
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 89: Dad, I Want to Go Downstairs and Play!
After dealing with Zhao Lin’s matter, Lu Chuan stayed inside Building Five for the next two days.
Although he had managed to deal with the tricky policewoman who could revive, her evolver companion did not show up at all.
Even if the opponent was hidden in the dark, they could restrict his movements; this peculiar ability made Lu Chuan very apprehensive.
This guy never showed up; in Lu Chuan’s eyes, it was like a time bomb lurking in the dark, making him not dare to relax for a moment.
During these two days, Lu Chuan retracted all his corpse puppets within the scope of Sunshine District.
After all, Lu Chuan didn’t know if this evolver would launch a surprise attack on him, so to ensure Little Qiqi wasn’t threatened, Lu Chuan had to ensure that Sunshine District had enough defensive power.
At the same time, Lu Chuan controlled the corpse puppets to patrol inside and outside the district relentlessly, attempting to find traces of that evolver.
But in these two days, he hadn’t found any trace, and the evolver remained still.
Only then did Lu Chuan start dispatching corpse puppets to search for traces of others evolving.
However, to be cautious, Lu Chuan kept all the three-headed evolved zombies he was controlling currently in Building Five.
The evolver hidden in the dark seemed far more difficult to deal with than the policewoman, in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
Although the policewoman who could revive had quite the extraordinary talent, her mind wasn’t functioning well, plus she was rather naive, allowing Lu Chuan to easily control her.
But that evolver, who could limit his movement capabilities, seemed to be the real hidden threat in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
Not only was their ability outstanding, able to pose a significant threat, but the key point was their intelligence seemed to be on a vastly different level from the policewoman.
After so much time, he couldn’t even find where they might be lurking.
’Da Pang,’ as usual, wielded dual hammers, guarding the entrance of Building Five like a gate god.
Those corpse puppets equipped with firearms were also left behind by Lu Chuan this time, similarly guarding the entrance of Building Five.
The strength of hot weapons was indeed quite considerable, even evolvers had to be cautious of them.
As for ’Lightning One,’ Lu Chuan arranged to closely monitor Zhao Lin. Although the policewoman seemed to have given up the thought of suicide at the moment,
who knows if she might suddenly come around one day? If she suddenly decided to commit suicide after realizing something, it would be troublesome.
Currently, to prevent any unexpected incidents, Lu Chuan even chose to only hone his combat skills indoors.
After all, it was clear now that there was a very powerful evolver nearby his district, always watching him.
Lu Chuan worried that if he trained outdoors, the opponent might discover he was the Corpse King.
With ’Lightning Two,’ he came to the fourth floor, cleared an area in the living room, and then gave the command to attack.
Zombie Two immediately charged toward Lu Chuan; its actions were very swift, yet for Lu Chuan at that moment, they were full of flaws.
Lu Chuan did not rush to attack, but kept dodging.
Although ’Lightning Two’ was agile, at present, Lu Chuan’s combat skills were very high, merely relying on dodging, leaving ’Lightning Two’ helpless.
A faint smile curled at the corner of Lu Chuan’s mouth; this battle with the policewoman had significantly improved his combat skills.
Whether it was bodily coordination, agility, reflexes, or judgment of attacks, all had markedly improved.
The swift zombie that Lu Chuan once could barely withstand in the past was now being toyed with in a one-on-one fight.
Lu Chuan’s footwork was incredibly nimble, complemented by his body’s evolution after absorbing crystal cores, resembling a martial arts master.
In the narrow space of the fourth-floor living room, he could execute various daring dodge moves.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
The agile zombie’s attack speed was getting faster, yet Lu Chuan remained calm.
Now, Lu Chuan excelled in timing his strikes and controlling the distance between the opponent during the fight.
Watching the zombie persistently pressing toward him, Lu Chuan merely lifted his leg to intercept, landing a direct kick on the zombie’s thigh.
While controlling the distance between them, he made the zombie’s steps somewhat unstable.
Then, Lu Chuan quickly moved, like lightning, grasped ’Lightning Two’s’ wrist, and then violently threw it backward, directly causing it to lay solidly on the ground.
Lu Chuan continued to control ’Lightning Two’ to attack him, but as his combat skills became more proficient, whether it was throwing techniques, boxing, or kicking techniques, all had improved significantly.
’Lightning Two’ became nothing more than a punching bag at Lu Chuan’s mercy.
Watching it get knocked down again by him, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
From initially only being able to barely hold off the opponent, to now being able to subdue ’Lightning Two’ with one hand.
His combat prowess has seen a tremendous leap forward in recent times!
Meanwhile, Zhao Lin was leaning against a pile of rice in the fifth-floor room.
These food supplies scarce in the apocalypse had now become Zhao Lin’s sofa.
Crunch! Crunch!
After eating bread and beef jerky and drinking water, Zhao Lin searched the room and surprisingly found quite a bit of puffed food, like potato chips and shrimp sticks, etc.
With the mindset of not dying hungry, and wanting to eat the Corpse King out, Zhao Lin directly opened the packaging and started eating.
Lazily basking in the sun outside the window, eating snacks only available before the apocalypse, without needing to collect resources to deal with crises that could happen anytime.
At that moment, Zhao Lin felt as if she had returned to the time before the apocalypse.
As a second-tier evolver, Zhao Lin had super recovery ability, and her originally broken legs didn’t hurt as much anymore.
At this time, the whole person was leaning on a sofa made of rice, feeling very comfortable.
"I never thought the happy life I’d lead after the apocalypse would be given by zombies..."
"These tomato-flavored chips are delicious!"
But then Zhao Lin frowned, sighed helplessly.
Since the apocalypse, she didn’t know how long it had been since she lived like this.
If it weren’t for thinking about survivors outside still waiting for rescue, she would like to stay here forever.
In the seventh-floor bedroom, Ji Ruxue was getting quite bored alone.
She wanted to go downstairs to see the Nine Deaths Demon Police locked up by dad but feared dad discovering she knew his secret.
"So boring. If it wasn’t for messing around with the Nine Deaths Demon Police in that nonsensical Corpse King decapitation operation, dad wouldn’t be so sensitive now, not having gone out for two days..."
Reflecting on her previous behavior, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile bitterly, feeling immensely foolish.
When Lu Chuan finished training his combat skills and returned to the seventh floor, Ji Ruxue’s eyes lit up, rushing quickly over.
"Dad, dad, it’s so stuffy staying at home. I want to go downstairs to play."

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Zhao Lin Meets Ji Ruxue for the First Time!
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Chapter 90: Zhao Lin Meets Ji Ruxue for the First Time!
"Want to go downstairs and play?"
Hearing Little Qiqi’s words, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but hesitate a little.
If it were before, Lu Chuan would have readily agreed to Little Qiqi’s request to go out.
After all, a healthy growing environment shouldn’t just stay confined indoors.
Even before these recent events, Lu Chuan was already preparing to take Little Qiqi out to experience the outside world.
After being bathed in sunlight, one’s mood would change.
And although the world had become quite rundown, Lu Chuan had already cleaned up Sunshine District a bit, making it look less frightening.
But things are different now.
The female officer and that Evolver lurking in the shadows came to Sunshine District to stir up trouble just days ago, and to Lu Chuan, the surroundings still seemed very dangerous.
The Sunshine District, originally under Lu Chuan’s control through Evolved Zombies, didn’t seem as safe as imagined.
The most critical thing is that Lu Chuan has been dispatching Corpse Puppets to search nearby, but the Evolver companion of the female officer still hasn’t been found.
Lu Chuan still doesn’t know what that hidden Evolver looks like.
He heavily suspects that the other party might still be hiding around the Sunshine District, maybe even still closely watching his Sunshine District.
With such bizarre abilities, that Evolver is even more dangerous than the female officer.
If Little Qiqi were exposed to their view, Lu Chuan was very worried that the little one’s safety would be compromised.
He could threaten the female officer with the survivors at the police station to surrender, but Lu Chuan couldn’t guarantee that hidden Evolver wouldn’t use similar tactics against him.
Resultantly, Lu Chuan was very conflicted at this moment, as he didn’t want Little Qiqi to face the slightest harm.
But seeing the little one’s big, fluttering eyes looking at him, Lu Chuan felt soft-hearted again.
Taking a glance around the room, earlier to prevent that full-blood-red zombie or monster from climbing in, the windows on the seventh floor were all reinforced with boards.
The room indeed felt very oppressive and dark, which didn’t seem suitable for infant development.
Thinking that keeping Little Qiqi locked in on the seventh floor didn’t seem like a solution, considering the oppressiveness around, Lu Chuan hesitated for a while before nodding in agreement.
However, Lu Chuan took the little one’s paper and pen and wrote: "You can go out, but you must only stay within Building Five."
The little one is still too young, and Lu Chuan didn’t want her exposed to enemy sights.
But if it was just walking around inside the building, there shouldn’t be an issue.
With Evolved Zombies guarding inside the building and the concrete structure blocking the view, it would relatively be much safer.
Ji Ruxue nodded obediently when she saw the words on the paper.
"Don’t worry, Dad, I won’t run outside recklessly."
Ji Ruxue knew her father was worried about her safety, especially since she and Nine Deaths Demon Police pulled a stunt on her dad not long ago, leaving him likely still sensitive.
"But Dad, you probably don’t know, with my current strength, no one can harm me."
"And the upheaval in the district recently, I was actually the cause of it all..."
Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly to herself, thinking it was her rashness that triggered everything.
If she had understood the situation instead of causing trouble initially, her father wouldn’t be so tense now...
Then Lu Chuan led Ji Ruxue downstairs, carefully holding Little Qiqi, fearing that she might stumble and fall.
The little one might be a prodigy, speaking, writing, and walking much earlier than her peers.
But she was still very young; if on flat ground it wouldn’t be a problem, yet falling on the stairs was unimaginable for Lu Chuan.
So Lu Chuan wouldn’t dare let Ji Ruxue walk alone on the stairs like she did in the room.
Thus, a zombie was leading a little girl, step by step, on the stairs, which looked somewhat odd.
"Dad, I want to see your pet," Ji Ruxue looked up at Lu Chuan, her pure and innocent eyes revealing a naive smile.
Ji Ruxue was still curious to see how the Nine Deaths Demon Police was doing now.
As a formidable figure in the apocalypse, Ji Ruxue wanted to successfully recruit the Nine Deaths Demon Police.
However, Ji Ruxue still hadn’t figured out how to tame this rather eccentric Evolver.
Although she retained some secret techniques from her past life controlling life and death, Ji Ruxue knew Zhao Lin’s personality wouldn’t respond to that...
So Ji Ruxue planned to bide her time, first getting in touch with Zhao Lin.
Lu Chuan was stunned hearing the little one’s words; there’s no pet downstairs, only a living human...
Was Little Qiqi talking about that female officer?
After a moment of thought, Lu Chuan nodded because, either way, the female officer was at least a human being.
Exposing the little one more to humans was not a bad thing.
At least Little Qiqi could communicate with humans normally, not like him, only expressing through writing.
Thus, Lu Chuan took Little Qiqi to the fifth floor, where upon opening the door, "Lightning One" was still standing motionless like a bodyguard, closely monitoring Zhao Lin inside.
Seeing this Agile Zombie controlled by her father, Ji Ruxue feigned curiosity and asked, "Dad, who is this?"
Lu Chuan took out his paper and pen, writing, "This is Dad’s friend."
Taking the note, Little Qiqi nodded respectfully: "Hello, Uncle."
Zhao Lin, leaning on a rice bag inside, was awakened by Ji Ruxue and Lu Chuan’s noise.
"Am I hallucinating? Did I just hear someone talking?"
Ji Ruxue’s innocent voice left Zhao Lin momentarily bewildered inside.
"And why does this voice sound familiar? Why does it feel somewhat recognizable?"
Upon waking, Zhao Lin instinctively looked towards the door, only to see an additional pair of figures apart from the Evolved Zombie watching her.
The big figure was naturally the powerful zombie she had fought before. But upon seeing Ji Ruxue’s petite form held by Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin’s entire brain seemed to short-circuit.
She stared at Ji Ruxue in disbelief, her eyes widening, filled with shock.
"This...isn’t this the Corpse King’s lair?!"
"Where did this little girl come from?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Damn it, I’m Not a Pet!
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 91: Damn it, I’m Not a Pet!
Zhao Lin was dumbfounded.
She had never imagined that in a zombie lair, she would see a living person, especially a girl!
