It had been over two months since the apocalypse began, and Zhao Lin had experienced countless life-and-death situations, encountering all kinds of terrifying zombies.
She was well aware of the terrifying allure a living person holds for zombies. These bloodthirsty creatures would frantically tear a living person apart, having an almost insane craving for human flesh.
In the early days of the apocalypse, the police station where Zhao Lin worked organized rescue efforts and other operations.
However, they later discovered that these zombies were too terrifying and crazed, and the police force alone was entirely insufficient for conducting rescues. In the end, they were forced to retreat and defend within the station.
During the subsequent period, the number of officers continued to dwindle due to frequent outings in search of food.
These zombies have an extremely terrifying craving for fresh flesh. They are eager to devour it all.
But Zhao Lin couldn’t understand how, in such a terrifying zombie gathering point, there was such an adorable-looking human little girl!
The girl in front of her, Ji Ruxue, had fair and tender skin without a trace of dirt or dust. Even in the apocalypse, she remained spotless.
She was wearing a pink princess dress, and her appearance was as cute as a porcelain doll.
Her big, bright eyes exuded innocence and seemed capable of purifying the world.
This clean and pure aura was something absent from the current apocalypse.
In Zhao Lin’s view, the little girl stood there looking out of place in the broken world.
Zombies generally have altered pupils, either blood-red or pure black. But the little girl’s clear black-and-white eyes unmistakably marked her as human!
What made Zhao Lin feel very strange was that such a pure and beautiful little girl held the hand of a zombie.
What kind of combination was this?!
Zhao Lin glanced at Ji Ruxue and then at Lu Chuan beside her, feeling her head start to swim.
"How on earth did this little girl survive?!"
"Could these bloodthirsty zombies be restraining their longing for fresh flesh? Surely they’re not planning to fatten her up before eating?"
"That would be way too costly for a single meal..."
While Zhao Lin kept observing Ji Ruxue, Ji Ruxue was also observing her.
Zhao Lin was bound with chains, which, although not completely immobilizing her, severely limited her movement.
Crucially, her legs had been smashed by the Evolved Zombie, and she was now moving by crawling on the ground.
Having been locked in this room for a long time, she looked utterly disheveled.
Recalling the beautiful and stunning image of her in police uniform before, and then looking at her now, Ji Ruxue felt a little guilty.
If it weren’t for the mistake I made putting this Nine Deaths Demon Police in this mess, she wouldn’t be like this now...
But despite the misery and pity, compared to this Nine Deaths Demon Police, my father’s safety is more important.
To prevent my father’s identity as the Corpse King from being exposed, I can only temporarily wrong this Nine Deaths Demon Police.
Anyway, with so much food on the fifth floor, this female cop won’t starve to death.
Ji Ruxue had noticed numerous food wrappers around, indicating they were undoubtedly eaten by this female cop here.
Though she looked pitiful, at least under dad’s control, she could fill her stomach.
A young girl and woman silently exchanged glances.
Then Ji Ruxue was the first to break the silence.
Looking at the once ferocious and ruthless Nine Deaths Demon Police, Ji Ruxue’s gaze carried a hint of mockery as she asked, "Are you the pet dad keeps downstairs?"
Ji Ruxue’s voice was incredibly pleasant; Zhao Lin hadn’t heard such an innocent child’s voice in ages.
"Pet?!"
"Did you say I’m a pet?!"
Zhao Lin was originally marveling at Ji Ruxue’s cuteness, but the next second she heard herself called a pet, leaving her flabbergasted.
How did a dignified police officer, and an Evolver at that, suddenly become a pet?!
But soon Zhao Lin realized a more critical aspect in Ji Ruxue’s words.
"Dad?!"
Frowning, Zhao Lin asked with some confusion, "Little one, who is your dad?"
She couldn’t comprehend that someone in these times would keep zombies near their daughter without fear of them eating her.
What kind of father would do such a thing?
His confidence in the zombies was misplaced!
As a police officer, Zhao Lin had seen people, who cherished their deceased family members in the apocalypse.
Even when they become zombies, these people still treat them as if they were alive.
Usually, those people face the consequences of their actions themselves.
After all, a zombie is just a zombie, devoid of any emotions, merely a group of bloodthirsty creatures.
Upon hearing Zhao Lin’s words, Ji Ruxue glanced at Lu Chuan beside her but did not clarify their relationship directly.
She only smiled innocently at Zhao Lin, "My dad is my dad."
Listening to the little one’s words, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but praise internally.
"Little Qiqi is so smart, understanding the importance of guarding oneself at such a young age."
"My girl is indeed a prodigy; surely she has the potential to become an emperor!"
Zhao Lin now recognized Lu Chuan standing beside them.
"Isn’t this one of the Evolved Zombies under the Corpse King? And he’s related to the Invisible."
"It’s because of this guy that I was beat up by a group of zombies, so how is it that he looks so calm facing the little girl, yet so aggressive towards me?!"
This zombie-child pairing was totally baffling to Zhao Lin.
Ji Ruxue observed the now utterly disheveled policewoman before softly asking, "What’s your name, dad’s pet?"
In the past life, Ji Ruxue met the Nine Deaths Demon Police during the later stages of the apocalypse.
Back then, she had become cold and ruthless, and people only knew her by her title. No one knew her real name.
"My name’s Zhao Lin."
Zhao Lin instinctively replied out of politeness.
But then she quickly realized, "I am not a pet!"

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Encountering a Tier 2 Evolved Zombie Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 92: Encountering a Tier 2 Evolved Zombie Again!
"Zhao Lin? So your name is Zhao Lin?"
"Judging by the uniform you’re wearing, you must be a police officer, right?" Ji Ruxue asked, pretending to be very naive.
Seeing Ji Ruxue looking so adorable at the moment, Zhao Lin lowered her guard.
Perhaps it was the innate sense of duty as a police officer that made Zhao Lin feel a natural affinity towards Ji Ruxue.
Hearing Ji Ruxue mention her occupation, Zhao Lin instantly puffed out her chest with pride.
"Of course, as a police officer, I’ve saved many people after the apocalypse."
Seeing Zhao Lin’s proud expression, Ji Ruxue shook her head inwardly, confirming that this Nine Deaths Demon Police was indeed as gullible as the rumors in the past life claimed.
Zhao Lin was also scrutinizing Ji Ruxue, wondering why there was a little girl among so many zombies.
"Little sister, can you tell me your name? Where has your father gone?"
Ji Ruxue glanced at Zhao Lin and then chuckled lightly, "Daddy says my nickname is Little Qiqi. You can call me that too."
After saying this, Ji Ruxue just kept smiling foolishly at Zhao Lin, blocking out any other questions she had.
Zhao Lin had a lot more to ask, but seeing Ji Ruxue keep smiling foolishly, Zhao Lin could only sigh helplessly.
Zhao Lin assumed this little girl was innocent and cute due to her young age, not realizing that Ji Ruxue housed the soul of an empress within her petite frame.
"Little Qiqi, can you tell me why there are so many zombies here?"
"And living here with your father, aren’t you afraid zombies will harm you?"
Thinking it over, Zhao Lin finally voiced her confusion; these zombies had tormented her enough, and she couldn’t understand how the little girl managed to coexist peacefully with them.
However, Ji Ruxue simply ignored her words as if she hadn’t heard them.
This left Zhao Lin feeling quite helpless.
"Auntie, at your age, do you have kids too?" Ji Ruxue came over to Zhao Lin, tilted her head, and directly changed the topic.
"What did you say?!"
At that moment, Zhao Lin was dumbfounded. She didn’t expect such a sweet-looking girl to deliver such a blow with her words.
"What do you mean by saying I’m old?!"
"I’m only twenty-four, okay? Little sister, don’t you think you’re being very presumptuous!"
"Besides, I’ve always been single, haven’t even dated, so where would I get kids?!"
Zhao Lin was furious; despite her current miserable state, she was a beauty of Jianghai City before the apocalypse!
Lu Chuan stood nearby, watching Zhao Lin chat enthusiastically with Little Qiqi, and inwardly shook his head helplessly.
This female officer was indeed as he had thought before, with large breasts and little brain.
In just this moment, she had already leaked all her personal information.
But Lu Chuan also knew, this was mostly because Zhao Lin hadn’t put her guard up against Little Qiqi.
After all, they were merely chatting casually, and Little Qiqi was just an ordinary little girl, so Zhao Lin naturally felt at ease speaking freely.
Yet she would never have imagined that not only did Lu Chuan retain human consciousness, he could understand their conversation.
Lu Chuan once again admired his daughter’s intelligence; throughout the conversation, Little Qiqi had only revealed her nickname.
If one didn’t know better, they’d probably think Little Qiqi was the police officer.
Despite the generational gap between these two women, they managed to chat happily, which was surprising to Lu Chuan; perhaps this was just a talent women have...
Seeing Little Qiqi seemed interested in Zhao Lin, Lu Chuan let her stay.
After all, having a human to communicate with was crucial for building Little Qiqi’s language skills and preventing isolation.
He had abruptly arrived in this world, only to become a zombie on the same day.
During all this time, Lu Chuan deeply understood what loneliness meant.
Although there were plenty of humans in this world, they wouldn’t communicate with him, a zombie.
Those zombies knew nothing but bloodlust and slaughter; Lu Chuan had enough of the feeling of having no one to talk to.
And as a zombie with human consciousness but unable to communicate, wasn’t that similar to Little Qiqi’s situation now?
Little Qiqi was human, but surrounded by zombies incapable of communication.
Lu Chuan didn’t want the same thing to happen to Little Qiqi.
With Zhao Lin around, Lu Chuan believed Little Qiqi’s future would be much brighter.
Although Zhao Lin didn’t seem like the kind of person who’d harm a child, to be safe, Lu Chuan picked up the chain from the ground and re-bound Zhao Lin.
He’d release Zhao Lin when it was time to eat, but since she was now going to interact closely with Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan had to restrict Zhao Lin’s actions.
Then Lu Chuan took out a pen and paper and wrote down a warning for Ji Ruxue: "Do not undo her chain or get close to her."
Lu Chuan handed the note to Ji Ruxue, who read it and nodded heavily. Seeing this, Lu Chuan felt at ease leaving.
As for "Lightning One," it remained stationed at the door, keeping a close eye on Zhao Lin to prevent any extreme actions.
Lu Chuan was about to continue sparring with "Lightning Two" when a Corpse Puppet sent out to search for traces of Evolved Zombies returned with new clues.
Lu Chuan focused his mind and switched to the perspective of one Corpse Puppet, seeing a massive zombie chasing a weak human.
This human looked familiar to Lu Chuan; he seemed to have seen him somewhere before.
Upon careful reflection, Lu Chuan realized this person had been running away during his last encounter with the Tyrant Zombie.
"Damn it! Why do all the unlucky things happen to me?!"
Gangzi was sprinting along the street, glancing back frequently.
Behind him, a massive Tier Two Evolved Zombie was chasing him!
This Tier Two zombie wasn’t just ordinarily huge! If Da Pang’s physique was like that of a 300-pound fatty,
then the zombie in front was clearly of the same evolved flesh type, its exaggerated size comparable to a small car!
Its enormous size caused the ground to tremble as it ran through the streets.
Gangzi looked extremely pale; his injuries from being torn by the Tyrant had yet to completely heal, and he had just ventured out to scavenge for supplies only to be targeted by another Tier Two zombie.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Subduing a Tier 2 Zombie!
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 93: Subduing a Tier 2 Zombie!
Gangzi was almost furious to the point of spitting blood, he really couldn’t understand who he had offended recently, to be so unlucky time and again.
"This Survivor Base flyer didn’t say it like this, didn’t it say that Evolvers are one in a million and extremely powerful?!"
"Why, as an Evolver, do I keep getting chased by zombies?!"
Gangzi kept running wildly on the street, feeling like crying without tears.
He truly couldn’t understand what he did wrong to be so unlucky as to encounter Evolved Zombies wherever he went.
"Just you wait till I evolve and get stronger, I’ll take your head off!"
Gangzi, panting as he was chased by this Evolved Zombie, climbed to the top of a car and roared angrily at it.
Bang!
This level two Tank Zombie was extremely large, with a wave of its hands it pushed all the cars along the way aside.
Seeing this, Gangzi was startled, originally thinking to use these simple obstacles to slow it down.
He hadn’t expected that this large zombie, just like the Tyrant he encountered before, wouldn’t be affected by simple obstacles like cars piled on the street at all.
To speed up his escape, Gangzi looked at the bent steel bar in his hand and simply threw it out.
The original machete was lost during the fight with a level two Tyrant, and even if found, it was already dull and unusable.
So Gangzi found this piece of rebar at a construction site, using his tremendous strength to knock down ordinary zombies with a single blow.
But when facing this powerful zombie, when Gangzi struck down with a staff, not only was it unharmed, but the steel bar in his hand was greatly twisted.
Especially the recoil made Gangzi’s palm tingle and it was still bleeding.
Gangzi no longer dared to clash head-on with such a zombie, he just wanted to escape as soon as possible.
...
Lu Chuan was overjoyed when he discovered the Evolved Zombie’s tracks through the Corpse Puppet’s perspective.
He had been sending out Corpse Puppets for several days without any results.
Finally, heaven rewarded his perseverance, he finally encountered one.
Lu Chuan was about to go and subdue it immediately, as such a powerful level two zombie could only be controlled by getting close due to his current Spiritual Power.
But before he could set out, his brows furrowed deeply.
The Evolver who came with Zhao Lin to Sunshine District had not been seen for several days, leaving Lu Chuan uneasy.
After all, that Evolver’s strength was extraordinary and much smarter than Zhao Lin.
Without finding his whereabouts, it would be risky for Lu Chuan to go out or leave Little Qiqi alone in Sunshine Home.
Lu Chuan thought it over and made a decision, immediately sending ’Lightning Two’ to attract this big guy.
Although he couldn’t easily go out himself, leading this zombie to Sunshine District would play into his hands.
’Lightning Two’, as an Agile Zombie was very fast, plus Lu Chuan’s continuous manipulation of Corpse Puppets in the area gave him familiarity with the terrain.
Now under Lu Chuan’s control, ’Lightning Two’ quickly approached this big guy.
Seeing the human Evolver being chased and turning pale with fear, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but shake his head, this guy was really unlucky...
After nearing, Lu Chuan was once again stunned by its massive size.
With an Evolved Zombie approaching, the level two Tank Zombie immediately howled at the sky, its attention drawn instantly to ’Lightning Two’.
More accurately, it was drawn by the Crystal Core in ’Lightning Two’s head.
Without a word, it abandoned Gangzi and charged towards ’Lightning Two’.
Lu Chuan controlled ’Lightning Two’ to turn and run.
Using its speed and agility, Lu Chuan kept this level two Tank Zombie always trailing behind.
Gangzi was at a loss, watching the Evolved Zombie run away, his back was drenched in cold sweat.
He had already been cornered, seeing the big guy’s terrifying thick arms about to smash his head.
Unexpectedly, the zombie suddenly paused, then ran off for some unknown reason.
Having narrowly escaped death, Gangzi’s heart was pounding in his throat.
"Damn it! I can’t stay in this place, there are monsters everywhere!"
"No way, I’ve got to run, staying in Jianghai City any longer and I might lose my life!"
With that, Gangzi ran off without hesitation.
...
The level two Tank Zombie was much more terrifyingly furious than ’Da Pang’.
The obstacles on the way seemed like paper to this level two Tank Zombie.
The abandoned cars along the way were either knocked aside or smashed flat, even the street lamps were toppled by this large Evolved Zombie.
Lu Chuan controlled ’Lightning Two’ to flee while watching over his shoulder, noticing the level two Tank Zombie was even bulkier than before.
Especially its extraordinarily thick arms, they now looked like they were made of metal, clearly stronger in defense than ’Da Pang’.
In Sunshine District, after chatting with Zhao Lin for a while, Ji Ruxue went back to the seventh floor.
Boom boom boom!
Hearing the rumbling sounds from outside, Ji Ruxue was startled and rushed to the balcony to check.
She saw a huge level two Tank Zombie chasing her dad’s level one Agile Evolved Zombie arriving at the entrance of Sunshine District.
’Da Pang’, armed with dual hammers, was also at the entrance, ready to fight.
Ji Ruxue instantly realized her dad was going to control the Evolved Zombies to fight this level two Tank Zombie.
"This is a level two Tank Zombie, can dad really stop it with just three level one Evolved Zombies?!"
Frowning with concern for her dad, Ji Ruxue stealthily followed towards the main gate.
Roar! Roar!
The level two Tank Zombie sensed multiple Evolved Zombies inside Sunshine District, instinctively excited.
Lu Chuan was already at the gate, surprised by the zombie’s size,
Yet Lu Chuan didn’t hesitate, directly releasing Telekinesis to forcibly control it.
Roar!
The level two Tank Zombie suddenly stiffened, then let out a series of terrifying howls.
Its massive body began to tremble incessantly, but in just a few moments, the Evolved Zombie suddenly calmed down, standing quietly in place.
Ji Ruxue hiding in the shadows was stunned by this sight.
"He, he tamed it just like that?!"
Her dad was even more amazing than she imagined, truly worthy of being the Corpse King...

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Evolution Team
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 94: Evolution Team
Ji Ruxue knew that the Corpse King had absolute suppressive power over ordinary Evolved Zombies.
But when she witnessed the process firsthand, she was still extremely shocked.
On the other side, Lu Chuan watched the second-tier Tank Zombie he had subdued, unable to suppress the upward curve of his lips.
The combat power of a second-tier zombie was incomparable to that of a first-tier zombie.
If it weren’t for his use of the terrain and personally controlling ’Lightning Two’ to frantically flee, ’Lightning Two’ probably wouldn’t have withstood a single punch from this second-tier Tank Zombie!
Now that the second-tier Evolved Zombie he had long desired was finally in his grasp, Lu Chuan felt like a child with a new toy, starting to test this big guy’s combat capabilities.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The massive figure of the second-tier Tank Zombie made the earth tremble with every move.
Lu Chuan controlled this second-tier Evolved Zombie to approach the roadside and directly punched a nearby car.
Bang!
With just a single punch, the glass shattered instantly, and the car body was dented!
Such immense strength made Lu Chuan’s eyelids twitch, his eyes filled with excitement.
He then controlled the second-tier Tank Zombie to lift its strong arms and threw the smashed car over a hundred meters away, hitting the ground with a loud crash.
Such horrifying giant strength startled Lu Chuan.
It’s essential to note that the car weighed several tons, but in front of the second-tier Tank Zombie, it was like a toy.
Lu Chuan maneuvered the second-tier Tank Zombie to the entrance of the district, standing beside ’Da Pang’ for comparison, finding its size several times larger!
’Da Pang’ was already enormously bulky for a Tank Zombie, standing at about two meters tall with an exceptionally robust torso, and even its forearm was several times thicker than other zombies’ thighs.
However, the second-tier Tank Zombie was three meters tall just in height!
Its massive body was as sturdy as a small car, and Lu Chuan surmised it would take two ’Da Pangs’ stacked together to barely equal this second-tier Tank Zombie.
Lu Chuan deliberately approached this zombie and punched its body several times.
This resulted in a sound akin to iron being struck, with its terrifying defense causing his fist to ache!
"As expected of a second-tier Evolved Zombie, its power truly is formidable!"
With this mighty second-tier Tank Zombie, the combat power of Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet team soared severalfold!
Lu Chuan patted the second-tier Tank Zombie gently, saying, "Since you’re the second big guy, from now on, you’ll be called ’Er Pang.’"
Lu Chuan controlled ’Da Pang’ and ’Er Pang’ to stand together, grinning from ear to ear.
"This is great, ’Da Pang’ now has a brother."
With the arrival of ’Er Pang,’ the responsibility of guarding fell from ’Da Pang’s’ shoulders.
’Er Pang’ stood at the gate of Sunshine District, its enormous figure blocking half of the entrance.
His deterrence was even greater than that of the hammer-wielding ’Da Pang’!
Hiding in the shadows, Ji Ruxue saw that not only was her father unharmed, but he had also gained a powerful second-tier zombie, which made her very happy.
"With this powerful second-tier Tank Zombie around, there shouldn’t be any immediate safety issues for Dad."
To avoid being exposed, Ji Ruxue swiftly returned to Building Number Five before Lu Chuan came home, pretending as if nothing had happened.
...
Gangzi was leaning against a hidden alley at this moment, panting heavily, his heart pounding as he recalled the massive Evolved Zombie he had just encountered.
"Damn it! Life really isn’t livable."
He took out a flyer he had found earlier from his pocket and glanced at the introduction to the Survivor Base, a look of determination flashing across his eyes.
"If I had known the zombies in this city were evolving so fast, I wouldn’t have stayed here."
Ptew!
Gangzi spat out a mouthful of bloody saliva, a hint of ferocity flashing in his eyes.
After being chased by the second-tier Evolved Zombie, all the lackeys that were with him had been swatted to death.
Even the few women he had picked up after the apocalypse to satisfy his desires didn’t escape the zombies’ killing.
Now, Gangzi found himself alone once again.
Opening the attached map on the flyer, Gangzi began carefully planning his escape route.
The area he was currently in was devoid of supplies and frequently encountered Evolved Zombies.
He would have to be out of his mind to choose to continue hiding here.
However, looking at the city map in his hands, Gangzi found himself at a bit of a loss.
Having not been in Jianghai City for long after coming here for work, he was unfamiliar with the place, making it difficult to navigate with just a map.
After simply identifying a few landmarks to determine the general direction, Gangzi grabbed a steel bar from the roadside, preparing to head toward the Survivor Base.
Swish! Swish!
As an Evolver with awakened Giant Strength, Gangzi’s combat abilities, although not comparable to a second-tier Evolved Zombie, were more than sufficient against ordinary zombies wandering near the roadside.
The thumb-thick rebar in his hand was as effective as a divine weapon.
With a single strike, the head of an ordinary zombie would explode.
Watching the blood splatter after the zombie’s head exploded, a cruel glint flashed in Gangzi’s eyes.
With the recent relentless pursuit by second-tier Evolved Zombies, the apocalyptic life he once somewhat enjoyed had vanished, taking a significant toll on Gangzi’s mental state.
Seeing the zombies fall easily at his hand, a smirk appeared at the corner of Gangzi’s mouth.
He then seemed to forget his original aim and charged at the zombies ahead.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
As Gangzi exerted his strength, the zombies ahead fell one by one.
Yet, the bliss was short-lived, as the commotion caused by the rampaging Gangzi attracted two Evolved Zombies.
A Tank Zombie and an Agile Zombie charged at Gangzi when they saw him being so fierce.
Even though Gangzi was an Evolver, he found himself at a disadvantage when fighting two opponents at once. In just a few rounds, the Agile Zombie slashed a huge wound across his abdomen.
The intense pain snapped Gangzi back to his senses, making him realize he was surrounded by a horde of zombies.
"Hey! Run this way!"
Just then, Gangzi suddenly heard a call and saw four people standing at the corner of another street, gesturing for him to come over.
Without thinking, Gangzi ran towards the four, with the two Evolved Zombies hot on his heels.
Unexpectedly, all four people turned out to be Evolvers, working so well together that they quickly killed the two Evolved Zombies!
Then the four came over to Gangzi, eyeing him up and down.
"Bro, you were quite good at killing zombies just now. You must be an Evolver too, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Genetic Evolution Potion!
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 95: Genetic Evolution Potion!
Gangzi saw the agility and strength of the four people in front of him, and couldn’t help but swallow nervously.
It had been over two months since the apocalypse began, and it was the first time he encountered so many Evolvers. The cooperation among the four was seamless, clearly not their first time.
This naturally aroused some curiosity in Gangzi about the four’s identity.
...
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan was in the Sunshine District, looking at the newly acquired second-order Evolved Zombie below, feeling overjoyed.
The recent incident in the Sunshine District made Lu Chuan realize that he must enhance his strength as quickly as possible.
Lu Chuan controlled ’Er Pang’ and ’Da Pang’ to stand within the district, and without using weapons, the two giants crashed together.
As a result, the originally very sturdy ’Da Pang’ was directly knocked away by ’Er Pang’.
Although both were Tank Type zombies, ’Er Pang’ was like an adult picking a fight with a kindergarten, and they weren’t on the same level.
’Da Pang’ swung its massive iron hammers, which, to the more enormous second zombie, were akin to holding two toothpicks.
Lu Chuan stood on the balcony, stroking his chin, and fell into deep thought.
From his experience controlling zombies, those with weapons were on a completely different level than those without.
The issue was how to equip ’Er Pang’ with a suitable weapon.
’Da Pang’ and the agile zombies could rummage through the hardware store for contraband, but it wasn’t as easy for ’Er Pang’.
The strength of a second-order evolved zombie had grown absurdly, capable of throwing cars weighing several tons hundreds of meters away, making ordinary things far from being able to exhibit its power.
Lu Chuan’s eyes lit up. Through his exploration, he found a construction site and a steel mill not far from Sunshine Home, which might house a suitable weapon for ’Er Pang’.
Lu Chuan then controlled ’Er Pang’ and ’Lightning Two’ to head to the nearest steel mill from Sunshine Home.
The steel mill had long been abandoned post-apocalypse, with a littering of discarded materials.
There were quite a few bodies and wandering zombies inside the mill, but they dared not approach after sensing ’Er Pang’s powerful aura.
Lu Chuan directed ’Er Pang’ to keep searching for a handy material in the mill.
Finally, Lu Chuan set his sights on a massive metal rod nearly three meters long and roughly thirty centimeters in diameter!
Though he didn’t know what it was for, just its weight was intimidating, much more imposing than ’Da Pang’s iron hammer.
This solid steel rod weighed a terrifying amount. Anyone else wouldn’t think of using such an exaggerated thing as a weapon.
It weighed over a ton, which normal people couldn’t even lift, let alone wield as a weapon!
Lu Chuan maneuvered ’Er Pang’ to the open center of the steel mill and immediately swung the rod around.
In ’Er Pang’s hands, the rod, weighing more than a ton, was swung with ferocity; watching this from ’Lightning Two’s perspective made Lu Chuan’s scalp tingle.
To test the weapon’s power, Lu Chuan directed ’Er Pang’ to use the rod on an abandoned car on the street.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
With one swing, the roadside car was smashed to smithereens, and even when thrown, the rod could pierce through thinner concrete walls!
Seeing ’Er Pang’ with a new weapon, Lu Chuan was dumbfounded.
With this three-meter-long steel rod, ’Er Pang’ became a Demon Lord of Chaos, possessing the terrifying strength to stop anyone in his tracks!
"As time goes by, there’ll be more Evolvers and Mutated Zombies, so I need to accelerate my evolution too."
A cold gleam flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes. This incident at Sunshine District had made him deeply aware of the importance of strength.
Now, with ’Er Pang’s formidable combat strength, it was time to continue hunting other second-order zombies and Mutated Fierce Beasts, absorbing Crystal Cores to enhance his power.
Inside Building Five of the Sunshine District.
In the room on the fifth floor where Zhao Lin was held, the adorable, princess-dressed Ji Ruxue was feeding Zhao Lin bread, bit by bit.
If one ignored ’Lightning One’ standing at the door with a steel knife and Zhao Lin’s bindings, it would indeed be a very warm scene.
Lu Chuan recently noticed Little Qiqi seemed to enjoy chatting with Zhao Lin, so he let the little one feed Zhao Lin.
This way, Zhao Lin wouldn’t have to be unchained every mealtime, reducing risk while allowing the little one more social interaction to break the monotony.
Zhao Lin ate the fragrant bread while observing the numerous supplies in the room.
"Little Qiqi, all this baby formula must be for you, right?"
Zhao Lin was quite puzzled about how this amount of formula and baby supplies were gathered...
Compared to the supplies amassed with her team over more than two months, this room’s collection was abysmal.
Reflecting on the previous battles and the oddities in Building Five, a glint of suspicion flashed in Zhao Lin’s eyes.
"Little Qiqi, be honest with sister, Corpse King is probably your dad, right?"
Zhao Lin felt the situation in Building Five was too bizarre, so she looked at Ji Ruxue inquisitively.
Facing Zhao Lin’s question, Ji Ruxue only beamed innocently, continuing to tear pieces of bread to feed Zhao Lin.
Ji Ruxue chuckled inwardly, thinking that this Nine Deaths Demon Police wasn’t too dumb, but obtaining information about her father from her was impossible.
...
In an alley in Jianghai City, four Evolvers were using medical supplies to tend to Gangzi’s abdominal wound.
"So, you’re all from Jianghai City?" Gangzi said solemnly.
One of them, a muscular man with slicked-back black hair, nodded: "Yes, we originally lived nearby, and we came back to see if we had any surviving relatives left."
"Hiding in Jianghai City, you probably don’t know, by hunting these evolved zombies and beasts mutated after the red moon, you can obtain Crystal Cores from them."
"These Crystal Cores are treasures post-apocalypse, exchangeable for Evolution Potions at the Survivor Base. Only by becoming an Evolver can one gradually grow stronger!"

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin’s Promise
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 96: Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin’s Promise
Gangzi looked at the clean clothes and excellent equipment on the four people, then glanced at his own tattered attire, resembling a beggar, further disheveled from continuously evading pursuit by second-tier zombies.
Though both sides were Evolvers, the gap between them was evidently substantial.
This reinforced Gangzi’s resolve to go to the Survivor Base.
The reason why this Evolution Team of four people saved Gangzi was also because they valued his identity as an Evolver.
After the apocalypse, those who awakened as Evolvers held a high status in the Survivor Base.
Yet, the power of Evolved Zombies and Mutated Fierce Beasts in the apocalypse was equally terrifying, meaning even Evolvers were not invincible.
They could only enhance their combat power by continuously taking Evolution Potions, and recruiting Evolvers into their team could undoubtedly greatly lower death risks.
Although Gangzi appeared untrained and very disheveled, he was undoubtedly a capable melee combat Evolver.
As an Evolver, Gangzi’s injury recovery speed was much faster than that of ordinary people. Coupled with just undergoing a simple bandage, he stood up and looked at the four people in front of him.
After the apocalypse arrived, it allowed him, originally just an ordinary person, to experience the thrill of power,
Having underlings to scold at will, and women to satisfy his desires, this lifestyle was something he couldn’t have imagined before.
But the arrival of second-tier zombies completely shattered this brief debauched life.
"Anyway, I have no ties left in Jianghai City, so I’ll go with you to the Survivor Base!"
...
Inside building number five, after feeding Zhao Lin some bread, Ji Ruxue thoughtfully found a straw for Zhao Lin to drink mineral water.
Looking at the materials piled like mountains around her, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but smile bitterly.
"Who would have thought that the most comfortable days I would spend after the apocalypse would be in the territory of the Corpse King..."
After these frequent interactions over the past two days, the young and older women talked a lot, drawing closer in their relationship.
After all, Ji Ruxue’s external appearance was merely that of an infant, so Zhao Lin was almost entirely unguarded around such a cute Ji Ruxue.
"What did you say?!"
"You’re not even one year old?" Zhao Lin couldn’t help but exclaim.
Upon learning Ji Ruxue’s true age, Zhao Lin felt her worldview crumbling.
Which family’s child under one year old can run upstairs and downstairs and can communicate normally with people?
Is this reasonable?!
But then as Zhao Lin looked at Ji Ruxue, her gaze showed a trace of pity and heartbreak.
"Such a pity for such a kind and adorable girl, someone as smart as her should be treasured by her parents."
"Yet she was born into such a cruel apocalypse where hope is invisible."
"And even had to live amongst these bloodthirsty zombies, what kind of hellish life is this..."
Immediately, Zhao Lin’s eyes showed a flicker of determination.
If she still had a chance to get out alive, she would take Little Qiqi with her no matter what!
Since she was human, she should live in human society; Zhao Lin absolutely could not allow Little Qiqi to live a precarious life with these bloodthirsty monsters.
Looking at Zhao Lin, Ji Ruxue lifted her head with an innocent smile: "Mrs. Zhao Lin, if you can get out, what would you want to do?"
Hearing this from Ji Ruxue, Zhao Lin was momentarily stunned, but then her eyes showed a flicker of resolve.
"Call me sister!"
"Sister, I’m a police officer, naturally in this apocalypse, I must use my ability to protect survivors, protect ordinary people from the harm of zombies!" Zhao Lin said quite matter-of-factly.
Hearing this, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile bitterly internally, "No wonder she’s been conned so many times, this woman is adorably naive."
"In this apocalypse where survival knows no limits, she still thinks of sacrificing herself for others..."
Then Ji Ruxue feigned casualness and asked, "But what if those people aren’t worth protecting?"
Hearing this, Zhao Lin was stunned, recalling scenes from the police station.
Obviously, she risked her life outside to find supplies, yet not only did the survivors not appreciate it, they even blamed her for bringing less and less.
Initially, there were numerous officers at the station, but as rescue missions and searches continued, their numbers dwindled gradually.
Yet their efforts did not bring any gratitude from the survivors.
Even her life seemed insignificant to the survivors...
Ji Ruxue’s words awakened Zhao Lin’s memories, plunging her into silence.
But as Zhao Lin looked down and saw the police badge on her clothes, recalling the vow she made upon joining the force, it strengthened her resolve once more.
"I’m a police officer, as such I must protect the safety of ordinary people, keeping danger away from them!"
Seeing Zhao Lin so determined, Ji Ruxue helplessly sighed inwardly, "Indeed, this Nine Deaths Demon Police remains naive in the early days of the apocalypse..."
Then Ji Ruxue showed an innocent and cute smile: "Sister Zhao Lin, I’m just an ordinary person too, won’t you protect me as well?"
"If one day you find the world isn’t as beautiful as you imagined, when you feel you don’t want to protect others anymore, remember to protect me."
Seeing Little Qiqi’s cute demeanor, Zhao Lin instantly smiled and promised: "Don’t worry, Sister promises you, if that time comes, I’ll find you."
Looking at Zhao Lin’s current radiant smile, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but pity this woman whose beauty hid her brainless nature.
"Hopefully, you’ll continue smiling like this when you truly see the ugliness of humans in the apocalypse, and understand what heart despair is."
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue also held some anticipation, that in this life, starting the Cultivation Technique early, a Nine Deaths Demon Police who previously halted at the Emperor Realm might achieve what heights?!
...
Through continuous enhancement recently, Lu Chuan’s Spiritual Power can now manipulate over a hundred ordinary Corpse Puppets.
In pursuit of continually obtaining Crystal Cores for breakthroughs, Lu Chuan manipulated ’Lightning One,’ accompanied by more than twenty Corpse Puppets, tirelessly searching for Evolved Zombie tracks.
Suddenly, Lu Chuan felt a twitch in his mind and swiftly shifted to the Corpse Puppet’s perspective.
There, on a street not far from the Corpse Puppet Squad, was a mighty second-tier Tyrant Zombie.
But at this moment, the Tyrant Zombie was besieged, with several human survivors continuously launching attacks around it.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: The Mantis Stalks the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 97: The Mantis Stalks the Cicada, While the Oriole Waits Behind
The Evolution Team fighting against the second-stage Tyrant Zombie was exactly Gangzi and the others from earlier.
To continuously gain strength and acquire a higher status, Gangzi also chose to join this Evolution Team.
Looking at the second-stage Tyrant Zombie in front of him, Gangzi’s eyes were filled with rage.
Enemies become especially furious upon meeting; Gangzi’s survivor team was once broken by a second-stage Tyrant Zombie.
His subordinates and woman were brutally killed one by one by the other side, and even he himself almost died at the hands of this kind of second-stage Tyrant Zombie.
Although Gangzi knew the one in front of him wasn’t the same one that had attacked him, he needed a target to vent the anger in his heart.
However, Gangzi didn’t act rashly because the combat power of a second-stage Tyrant Zombie is extremely terrifying; with his strength, he doesn’t even have the qualification to retaliate.
Among the four-person squad, the burly man with slicked-back black hair was still able to remain calm in the face of the second-stage Tyrant Zombie.
As the captain of this Evolution Squad, he issued orders while pulling out a jet-black machete from behind his back.
The machete was more than half a meter long, with a very hefty blade, clearly a weapon of overwhelming power.
Like Gangzi, his evolution direction was similar, both being strength-type close-combat Evolvers.
"Gangzi! We’re both strength-type Evolvers; let’s pin him down front and back!"
Upon hearing the squad captain’s order, Gangzi hesitated for a moment.
He had fought against these kinds of Tyrants before, and back then, his machete had even gotten dull without injuring the opponent at all, while he himself nearly got killed by a single strike from the enemy.
Faced again with this zombie, although he had anger in his heart, the psychological shadow still made Gangzi somewhat indecisive.
At that moment, Gangzi suddenly felt the wound on his abdomen was rapidly healing, and he quickly looked behind him with an astonished expression.
He saw a young man in his twenties with slanting bangs, releasing some kind of peculiar energy towards him from his raised arm.
During Gangzi’s split-second distraction, the second-stage Tyrant Zombie had already rushed up to him.
Whoosh!
With a piercing sound hitting the air, a crossbow bolt accurately shot towards the torso of the second-stage Tyrant Zombie. Although blocked by it, it bought Gangzi some time to dodge.
He saw a man wearing glasses standing atop a distant car roof, holding a black military crossbow in his hands.
"Bro, my ability is reconnaissance; I’ll provide you guys with remote support."
After launching the crossbow bolt to harass the Tyrant, the man smiled at Gangzi: "Gangzi, don’t be afraid. Just go up, our team brought along a healer!"
Gangzi then realized that his wounds had accelerated healing due to the awakening ability of that Evolver.
With an Evolver who could provide healing, Gangzi felt more confident.
Immediately he ran to the back of the second-stage Tyrant with two pieces of rebar, forming a pincer with the squad captain.
The second-stage Tyrant Zombie was terrifyingly strong and fast, its claws could tear apart even cars with a swing.
Among those present, only the squad captain and Gangzi could barely withstand the opponent’s attacks head-on.
The front-and-back formation they formed now somewhat confused the Tyrant Zombie.
But the second-stage Tyrant didn’t think much, roaring as it charged directly at the squad captain, its terrifying claws creating a fierce wind in mid-air.
Bang!
The strength of the second-stage Evolved Zombie was immense. Even though the squad captain had Giant Strength and held a steel blade in front of him, he was still forced to retreat repeatedly.
Though he looked a bit embarrassed, he managed to block the attack with his machete.
Gangzi also rushed over wielding rebar, striking hard at the Tyrant Zombie’s knee joint.
The terrifying Giant Strength in him made the Tyrant Zombie’s left leg quiver uncontrollably.
Even as powerful as the second-stage Tyrant Zombie was, under such heavy damage, it couldn’t help but stumble and kneel on one knee.
Whoosh!
While the Tyrant Zombie’s body was tilting, a swooshing sound filled the air.
A silver-white blade flash sliced through the sky.
A bald man with a determined face appeared, wielding a steel blade, instantly slashing a huge cut at the Tyrant Zombie’s neck!
Before the Tyrant Zombie could swing its claws, he stepped on the Evolution Team’s captain’s shoulder and quickly retreated to a distance.
This bald man was the assault member of the squad, becoming an Evolver after the Blood Moon event, possessing tremendous speed.
Though the second-stage Tyrant Zombie’s body defense was extremely tough, the bald man’s slash created a massive wound at its neck but still couldn’t kill it.
Roar!
Being obstructed at both ends and constantly harassed by two other Evolvers, made the second-stage Tyrant incredibly furious.
The Tyrant’s claws swung, sending the first-stage Gangzi flying away.
Gangzi’s grip on the rebar tore his tiger mouth open, and blood flowed uncontrollably.
But then, a warm flow surged through his hands, immediately healing the wounds at his tiger mouth.
Gangzi nodded towards the teammate providing treatment and charged again.
Fighting alongside the Evolution Team made Gangzi feel a lot more relieved.
Despite the second-stage Tyrant’s formidable strength, under the relentless siege of Gangzi and four others, it gradually started falling into a disadvantage.
From time to time, getting shot by military crossbows or left with long, narrow cuts by the bald man’s steel blade.
But the Tyrant’s recovery ability was extremely strong, and the injuries would return to normal not long after.
...
"Hmm? Isn’t that the unfortunate guy who was chased by second-stage Evolved Zombies before?"
Lu Chuan operated ’Lightning Two,’ hiding in the darkness, observing the scene while recognizing Gangzi’s familiar face.
"Since when did so many Evolvers appear around here?! And they cooperated seamlessly, their team’s combat strength is quite impressive."
Lu Chuan could tell the team’s setup was very standard, with someone dealing with close combat control, others continually harassing and assaulting, and even having a healer.
Although now the second-stage Tyrant can persist through its powerful recovery ability, eventually, it will surely be the zombie that falls.
Lu Chuan had a difficult time finding such a second-stage zombie, he definitely wouldn’t let someone else take it.
Immediately he operated ’Er Pang,’ carried the newly acquired steel rod, and headed from Sunshine District to this place.
"Go ahead, fight as fiercely as you want."
"I’ll teach you the meaning of the mantis chasing the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind!"

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Since When Do Zombies Use Weapons?
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 98: Since When Do Zombies Use Weapons?
Ji Ruxue had just returned to the seventh floor when she found her father sitting motionlessly on the couch. Even as she entered the room, there wasn’t the slightest reaction.
Her father stared blankly ahead, and upon closer inspection, his blood-red pupils now seemed somewhat hollow.
Ji Ruxue immediately realized that her father must be focusing intensely on controlling other zombies, causing his own body to enter a state of suspension.
"Has father encountered some special situation again?"
The Corpse King can act on its own while controlling zombies, but with her father’s current state, he must have personally taken over a zombie body.
Sure enough, the Tier 2 Tank Zombie that almost blocked half of the Sunshine District entrance was now gone.
This further confirmed to Ji Ruxue that her father was currently controlling a Tier 2 Zombie in action.
"Looks like father has encountered a Tier 2 Zombie again?"
"I wonder what type of zombie it is this time, but given father’s current zombie control combat power, it should be manageable."
...
Roar! Roar! Roar!
The Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie, being besieged by Gangzi and others, was now furious. Despite having formidable combat power, it was being restrained by this Evolution Team, rendering it unable to inflict effective damage.
Every charge by the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie was countered by the team captain and Gangzi head-on.
This Tier 2 Tyrant was indeed very powerful, sometimes able to simultaneously push back both Gangzi and the captain.
However, the Evolver responsible for reconnaissance would accurately shoot crossbow bolts to disrupt the Tyrant’s actions.
With the team’s close cooperation, they consistently confined the Tier 2 Tyrant between Gangzi and the captain, preventing it from attacking the others.
Although the Tier 2 Zombie was extremely strong, Gangzi and the captain would occasionally get injured.
But because the team included an Evolver who could heal, both could quickly recover their combat strength even if injured.
The recovery ability of the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie was indeed formidable. Despite being hit by many crossbow bolts and secretly slashed countless times by the bald man,
the team captain and Gangzi, during direct confrontation, would occasionally leave some wounds unnoticed, but they never brought the Evolved Zombie down.
It was clear, however, that under the relentless targeting by the team, the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie was also reaching its limit.
The healing speed of the wounds on its body had slowed significantly compared to before, and the multiple cuts from the bald man’s machete had not healed yet.
"Kneel down for me!"
Just as the Tyrant Zombie and the captain were clashing head-on, Gangzi launched another ambush, and the rebar in his hand smashed heavily onto the zombie’s kneecap.
Crack!
The crisp sound of bone breaking echoed along the street.
The massive body of the Tier 2 Tyrant then half-knelt on the ground.
After enduring successive attacks from the team, the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie finally couldn’t hold on any longer.
An injury to one leg severely impacted the Tier 2 Tyrant, drastically reducing its movement speed, and even due to the loss of support from its leg, its attack frequency and power also decreased significantly.
This made the Survivor Squad, which could already restrain him through cooperation, even more at ease. Seeing the Tier 2 Tyrant half-kneel on the ground, the people present immediately beamed with joy.
In front of them was a genuine Tier 2 Zombie; if they could successfully kill it and obtain the Tier 2 Zombie’s Crystal Core, they could exchange it for five bottles of primary Evolution Potion back at the Survivor Base!
They might even exchange it for a bottle of medium Evolution Potion, allowing an Evolver to advance to Tier 2!
Currently, for survivors, the key to enhancing their strength relies on these Evolution Potions.
In the current Survivor Base, the Demon Core of such a Tier 2 Evolved Zombie is extremely precious!
The five were so excited that their offensive became increasingly fierce.
But at this moment, the Evolver responsible for recon and long-range zombie harassment suddenly noticed something amiss. He felt the ground beneath him starting to tremble slightly.
After the apocalypse, his sensory ability increased significantly, allowing him to perceive the ground shaking and hear a series of sounds.
Not long after, he spotted a gigantic being at the other end of the street, a terrifying presence with a body even larger than the Tier 2 Tyrant!
The oppressive aura emanating from that Tier 2 Tank Zombie left the Evolver responsible for reconnaissance utterly stunned.
"Everyone, be careful, there’s another Tier 2 Tank Zombie coming!"
Upon hearing the warning from their companion, the faces of the Evolver Team members instantly changed as they were engaged in battle.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
During their moment of shock, the ’Er Pang’ controlled by Lu Chuan had already bulldozed its way near the battlefield.
Seeing the imposing Tier 2 Tank Zombie charging forward, the Evolver Team was startled.
They had already been holding their ground against a Tier 2 Tyrant for a long time; facing another zombie was already the limit. If another Tier 2 Zombie arrived, these people might no longer have a way out!
"Damn it! How come we encounter another zombie at this particular moment?!"
The Survivor Squad captain was infuriated seeing the Tier 2 Tank Zombie charging towards them.
Though reluctant, for survival’s sake, he had no choice but to give the order to retreat.
"Brothers, our lives are important, retreat quickly!"
Under the captain’s orders, the team quickly withdrew in a direction opposite to the two zombies.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
’Er Pang,’ under Lu Chuan’s control, had reached the battlefield. The two Tier 2 Evolved Zombies, upon meeting, immediately became enraged.
The Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie ignored the retreating Gangzi and others, rushing straight towards ’Er Pang.’
However, due to its injured leg from the joint attack of the team, it was now staggering.
Lu Chuan noticed this and a cold smirk appeared on his lips, then the metal rod forged from steel in his hand started to swing rapidly.
The sound of the over one-ton metal rod being swung was enough to make one’s scalp tingle.
Bam!
One swing from Number Two was all it took to send the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie flying with the steel rod.
Already unstable, the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie stood no chance against the steel rod-wielding ’Er Pang.’
With one strike after another, ’Er Pang’ took down the already injured Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie, leaving its bones fractured in many places.
Those watching secretly, including Gangzi, were all shocked and terrified at this scene.
The slicked-back crew haircut team captain was even more astonished with his mouth agape: "Are you kidding? Since when can zombies use weapons too?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Let’s Name This New Type of Zombie "Weapon-Type"!
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 99: Let’s Name This New Type of Zombie "Weapon-Type"!
This Evolver team hurried from the Survivor Base to Jianghai City, encountering quite a few types of Evolved Zombies along the way.
They encountered both Agile Zombies and Tank Zombies, and even had skirmishes with them.
Among the zombies they faced, the fighting style of these zombies resembled wild beasts.
To them, zombies are just zombies, nothing more than a group of thoughtless Bloodthirsty Monsters.
Their attacks merely consist of swinging claws or biting and pouncing, which can be fatal to regular people.
But these powerful Evolvers, with their abundant combat skills and coordinated teamwork, often manage to achieve final victory.
However...
The zombie before them is simply too outrageous!
The few of them stared wide-eyed, their gaze filled with shock!
They had encountered many zombies before, but this is the first time they’ve seen a zombie that can use weapons!
"What kind of monster is this, why can it use weapons?!"
"According to the base’s information, isn’t this a Tank-type Evolved Zombie? Since when did Tank-type Evolved Zombies get this powerful?"
Everyone in the team wore a look of astonishment.
As time progressed, the Survivor Base gradually published the types and characteristics of zombies currently discovered.
Before setting out, they had already reviewed much of this information.
The attack methods of Tank-type Zombies usually rely on their strong arms to destroy everything in front of them in a destructive manner.
The characteristics of Tank-type Zombies are that their bodies are unusually strong with extremely high defense.
Especially their arms, which seem forged of steel, making it hard even for ordinary Evolvers to inflict serious damage.
However, in terms of speed, Tank-type Zombies are slightly inferior.
The new Tier 2 Zombie in front of them, while matching the feature of a large, muscular and powerful physique, has a combat style that’s entirely different from the records!
"Could this Evolved Zombie have mutated?"
The bald Agile Evolver among the team, wielding a steel knife, spoke with a serious expression.
"The base says these zombies usually fight head-on, relying on strength to overpower the opponent."
"Look, this zombie is waving that metal stick; even though it follows the line of overwhelming power, the stick technique is very skilled, rather than mindless swinging."
"Its coordination between each attack and the utilization of various stick techniques make it resemble not a zombie but a skilled martial artist!"
Upon hearing this, all the members of the Evolution Team present wore serious expressions.
And while they were discussing in secret, ’Er Pang,’ under Lu Chuan’s control, relied on its strong physique and the more than one-ton steel staff, had already beaten the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie to the ground, unable to move.
Crack! Crack!
The originally strong Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie’s bones were now fractured all over, unable even to stand.
Seeing the Tyrant Zombie in such a sorry state, Lu Chuan nodded satisfied.
Not long ago, he could only control zombies to flee crazily in front of him; now the tables have turned!
Lu Chuan controlled ’Er Pang’ to smash the Tyrant Zombie’s head to pieces with one swipe, simultaneously obtaining the Evolution Crystal Core from the zombie’s brain.
The Evolver team, who were hiding and observing from afar, felt unwilling upon seeing this scene.
They had spent quite a long time here to get the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie’s Crystal Core.
Seeing that they had injured the Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie and would soon be able to defeat it, they would return to the Survivor Base to exchange it for a priceless Evolution Potion.
But they didn’t expect plans to change.
The suddenly appearing Tier 2 Tank-type Zombie disrupted their original plans.
Forget about obtaining the zombie’s crystal core; if they ran slower, they might have already perished under the stick.
Gangzi’s face was very dour; being chased by the Tier 2 Zombie so many times, finally having a chance to slay it, yet having to give up in vain, made him very unhappy.
Gangzi asked unwillingly, "We’re just going to let him go?!"
The four people next to him from the Survivor Squad turned to look at Gangzi bizarrely, and the squad captain made a gesture of invitation.
"You can go ahead; if you’re not afraid of dying, we have no objection."
That’s a joke.
A weapon-wielding Evolved Zombie’s combat strength is immediately doubled compared to ordinary Tier 2 Zombies.
Several squad members watched clearly; the steel stick wielded by this suddenly appearing Tank-type Zombie smashed the nearby small cars to scrap.
If this terrifying force struck them, they couldn’t withstand it.
Facing the Tier 2 Tyrant, they could still engage with coordinated teamwork, but against this Tank-type Zombie, there would be certain death.
Seeing Gangzi’s dissatisfaction, the squad captain lightly patted his shoulder.
"Live to fight another day; only by surviving can we gain more power."
"Furthermore, this zombie can even use weapons, which the base hadn’t discovered yet; if we report this new type of zombie, we can also earn Contribution Points."
The Contribution Points the captain spoke of, serve as currency within the base; after the apocalypse, past currency, and valuables from all countries are no longer applicable to life after the catastrophe.
Instead, Contribution Points can be used to buy anything inside the Survivor Base.
Acquiring Contribution Points is simple, like hunting zombies and mutant beasts, or collecting various supplies.
Collecting various intelligence also earns Contribution Points, especially if they report this information on the new type of zombie; the amount of Contribution Points earned would likely be considerable.
"No idea what this zombie is called; since it can use weapons, let’s call it Weapon-type Zombie."
The Evolver holding the military crossbow couldn’t help but say softly.
The others nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
However, Gangzi still showed traces of killing intent when looking at the massive Evolved Zombie.
"This zombie differs entirely from ordinary zombies, being able to use weapons."
"If it could be successfully killed, the Zombie’s core would surely be extremely valuable!"
Upon hearing Gangzi’s words, the few in the team exchanged glances, momentarily tempted.
Such an unusual zombie is incredibly rare; if they could bring back the crystal core, it’s sure to earn a massive amount of Contribution Points!

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Devouring the Crystal Core! Breaking Through to Tier 3!
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 100: Devouring the Crystal Core! Breaking Through to Tier 3!
At the same time, on the seventh floor of the Sunshine District, a smile curved on Lu Chuan’s lips.
"I really didn’t expect, ’Er Pang’ wielding this over one-ton metal long stick, could unleash such terrifying combat power!"
This time, by easily obtaining a second-tier zombie crystal core, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but grin widely.
To avoid any accidents, Lu Chuan controlled ’Er Pang’ to quickly return to the Sunshine District after grabbing the crystal core.
After the battle ended, Lu Chuan’s consciousness finally returned to his body.
As Lu Chuan opened his eyes, Ji Ruxue was busy over there with her computer, writing and calculating.
A smile curved on Lu Chuan’s lips; his daughter was not only smart and clever but also possessed a rare diligent and studious attitude.
Then Lu Chuan walked over to Ji Ruxue’s side, picking up the paper and pencil placed at the side, and wrote: "Little Qiqi, Daddy needs to go out for a while, during this time make sure to stay at home and don’t wander around."
Lu Chuan handed the note to Ji Ruxue, who quickly and obediently nodded her head.
"Don’t worry, Daddy, I will stay home properly."
Seeing the little one’s adorable smile, Lu Chuan quickly reached out and pinched her little cheek.
The little one’s skin was extremely fair and smooth, as delicate as a freshly peeled egg.
After instructing Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan quickly headed downstairs.
Ji Ruxue could clearly feel that Daddy seemed to have an excited emotion.
Because she observed that even Lu Chuan’s steps down the stairs were different from usual; although still fast, it was obviously a relaxed joy.
And when Lu Chuan reached downstairs, ’Er Pang’ carrying the steel rod successfully returned inside the Sunshine District.
Lu Chuan immediately took the second-tier crystal core from ’Er Pang’ with great interest.
Indeed, it was like the one he got before, originally entirely blood-red, now with large patches of orange-yellow as the second-tier tyrant zombie continued to evolve.
Seeing this crystal core, a trace of greed flashed in Lu Chuan’s mind, as if the crystal core had endless allure.
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but swallow nonexistent saliva, then quickly pocketed the crystal core and walked briskly towards Building Four.
Lu Chuan hadn’t devoured such a second-tier evolved zombie’s crystal core for a while now.
The rich energy aura before him filled Lu Chuan with extreme excitement.
However, amidst the excitement, Lu Chuan didn’t forget the preparations.
Lu Chuan ordered ’Er Pang’ to continue blocking the Sunshine District’s main entrance as usual.
’Da Pang’ returned to his old post, guarding the unit door downstairs of Building Five.
’Lightning One’ remained in the room watching over Zhao Lin, also keeping an eye on the goings-on inside Building Five.
To be on the safe side, Lu Chuan divided the gunner corpse puppet squad into two groups, arranging three each in Buildings Four and Five.
The other corpse puppets patrolled the district in batches like guards.
With ’Er Pang’ guarding the district’s gate and ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning One’ closely guarding Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan felt much more at ease.
After all, after devouring the crystal core, he very likely would faint again for a period.
No one knew when he would wake up, so setting up defenses in advance was reassuring.
As for ’Lightning Two,’ it continued to follow alongside, ensuring his safety.
With ’Lightning Two’ in tow, Lu Chuan headed to Building Four, the room where he last devoured a crystal core.
Looking at the gorgeous crystal core in his hand, like a crystal gem, Lu Chuan swallowed it in one gulp.
The terrifying energy erupted within an instant, the energy contained within a second-tier tyrant zombie’s crystal core far surpassing ordinary zombies.
But with prior experience, Lu Chuan felt much more relieved this time.
A large amount of energy spread through Lu Chuan’s limbs and bones, his entire body’s muscles were being refined step by step, and his bones became increasingly resilient!
Lu Chuan clearly felt his physical quality was drastically improving, becoming extremely horrifying!
Meanwhile, that familiar feeling came again, terrifying telekinesis surged into his mind, and at that moment, Lu Chuan felt as if his brain exploded!
Meanwhile, in the room on the seventh floor of Building Five, Ji Ruxue seemed to vaguely hear her father’s voice again.
"That feeling again, this definitely isn’t an illusion!"
Ji Ruxue frowned slightly and asked with some doubt, "Could it be that Daddy is about to evolve?!"
Under the overwhelming energy impact, Lu Chuan soon fainted again.
This time, to be cautious, Lu Chuan had placed a clock in the room.
When the dizziness faded and Lu Chuan’s consciousness returned to his body, he sluggishly opened his eyes to find that several hours had passed according to the clock.
After evolving, that dizziness had disappeared, and his mind became exceptionally clear.
His perception had greatly increased, most crucially, Lu Chuan discovered his physical strength had now become extremely terrifying!
The explosively powerful muscle lines, and his form growing increasingly similar to a human made Lu Chuan very satisfied.
With continuous evolution, the color of Lu Chuan’s skin, his somewhat disheveled hair, previously loose teeth, and sharp claws were all returning to a human state.
What surprised Lu Chuan the most, however, was the change in his telekinesis after devouring the crystal core.
Lu Chuan could clearly feel that this time it wasn’t just an energy boost, he successfully broke through to the third tier!
So both his spiritual power and physical quality underwent a huge leap from their original basis!
With a surge in spiritual power, Lu Chuan could control more second-tier zombies.
Lu Chuan even felt he could successfully control third-tier zombies.
As for first-tier evolved zombies and ordinary zombies, he could easily command them in his current state.
Lu Chuan felt that he was now worthy of the name Corpse King, such terrifying spiritual power could lead an entire zombie army on the streets!
Even more terrifying, his control range for spiritual power had multiplied several times from its original basis!
When Lu Chuan was at the second tier, his range of thought covered about ten thousand meters, now it’s multiplied several times, possessing a range of several tens of kilometers!
Lu Chuan’s breathing was slightly fast, knowing this wasn’t just the distance between two points, but thought control diameter that ignored obstacles!
After successfully breaking through to the third tier, Lu Chuan’s strength experienced a qualitative change from its original basis, and this change even exceeded Lu Chuan’s expectations!

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Blood Evil Blade Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 101: Blood Evil Blade Technique
This time, the sudden strength enhancement made Lu Chuan extremely excited. He hadn’t expected to successfully break through to the third level, causing a qualitative change in his body!
Feeling the powerful surge of strength within him, a hint of excitement flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
Immediately, he ran downstairs, controlling ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning Two’ to come to him.
To test his current melee strength, Lu Chuan brought the two evolved zombies to an open space in the community, eagerly issuing a command for the two evolved zombies to attack him.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
’Da Pang’ swung its hammers directly towards Lu Chuan with great force. The huge figure carried an intense pressure, each movement of the giants hammers stirring up strong winds.
’Lightning Two’ simultaneously swung a knife towards Lu Chuan’s side, the silver-white blade cutting through the air with a fierce glint.
However, facing such aggressive attacks from both, Lu Chuan remained calm even while fighting one against two, with a faint, elusive smile always playing at his lips.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Lu Chuan exerted force under his feet, his entire body shooting out like a spring, moving with terrifying speed that even surpassed ’Lightning Two’.
With a ghost-like agility, Lu Chuan continuously weaved between the two zombies, even clasping his hands behind his back, not using any weapons.
No matter how ’Lightning Two’ tried to slash, Lu Chuan could easily dodge these attacks.
As an Agile Zombie, ’Lightning Two’ was now easily outpaced by Lu Chuan.
"Slow! It’s just too slow!" Lu Chuan couldn’t help but laugh aloud at this point.
Even facing attacks from both ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning Two’ at the same time, he could handle everything with ease.
Accompanied by the sound of slicing through the air, ’Lightning Two’s blade came down directly on Lu Chuan.
A glint of coldness flickered in Lu Chuan’s eyes as he stepped forward to avoid ’Da Pang’s hammer strike, then swiftly caught the wrist of ’Lightning Two’ before its attack could land.
Lu Chuan skillfully twisted and disarmed ’Lightning Two’, tossing it flying with ease.
This series of operations flowed like water, defeating ’Lightning Two’ with just one move.
At this moment, another gust of wind came from behind Lu Chuan, as ’Da Pang’ closed in, seizing the opportunity to swing its double hammers down towards Lu Chuan.
The strength of ’Da Pang’ was far greater than ’Lightning Two’, but this time Lu Chuan didn’t choose to dodge; instead, he raised both hands and caught the giant hammers of ’Da Pang’ mid-air!
Lu Chuan immediately felt a great force transmitting into his body from above, which, if it were before, he would definitely not have been able to withstand.
But now, Lu Chuan felt...like ’Da Pang’ wasn’t that powerful after all...
"Stand up for me!"
Exerting force with both arms, Lu Chuan actually pushed ’Da Pang’s huge body backward several steps!
Then, like a cannonball, Lu Chuan swiftly darted out, grabbing ’Da Pang’s thick arm and with a twist of his waist and legs, slammed ’Da Pang’ to the ground!
Looking at his hands, Lu Chuan’s eyes were full of excitement, not expecting his strength to have advanced so much in such a short time!
Not long ago, he found it difficult to face even one evolved zombie, but now, with two zombies attacking together, they were respectively crushed by his strength and speed!
Lu Chuan stretched lazily, feeling invigorated after dealing with ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning Two’.
Though controlling zombies with his mind and hiding was a very steady approach,
as a passionate man, Lu Chuan wanted to possess strong and close-range combat skills; now he finally achieved this.
Though he wasn’t a combat-type zombie, after several evolutions, he successfully broke through to the third level, with physical qualities now stronger than one-stage combat-type zombies!
Lu Chuan estimated that with his current strength, even second-stage zombies wouldn’t be able to do anything to him!
Ji Ruxue on the seventh floor hadn’t seen her father return after a long time, so she sneaked onto the terrace, using her mind to fly to the rooftop next door.
Upon landing, she saw her father fighting fiercely against ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning Two’.
Watching Lu Chuan repel the Tank Type Zombie and subsequently outperform the Agile Zombie in speed, even Ji Ruxue was amazed.
"Dad has evolved to the third level? This breakthrough speed is already remarkable among zombies!"
Ji Ruxue watched for a while longer on the rooftop, but then she couldn’t help shaking her head.
Although Lu Chuan’s combat skills were already very impressive,
to Ji Ruxue, who was once an Empress in her past life, they were terribly crude.
Having experienced numerous life and death situations in the post-apocalyptic world and having trained in many advanced combat techniques, Ji Ruxue’s skills were unrivaled on this planet.
"It’s unfortunate that Dad’s breakthrough speed is quick, yet this mediocre training method, even if continued, the improvement will still be very limited."
"It seems I should teach Dad the martial techniques I practiced in my previous life, otherwise continuing like this won’t yield much result."
Despite having powerful Time Control Ability in her past life, facing strong enemies required using Time Control to fight them,
Ji Ruxue started from an ordinary person, slowly growing to become an Unparalleled Empress, enduring countless life and death situations with skills also unrivaled.
Having made up her mind, Ji Ruxue searched her memory for cultivation techniques, soon furrowing her brows.
She indeed acquired many powerful techniques in her previous life, but the problem is they were too strong, mostly requiring Spiritual Essence to perform.
Spiritual Essence can only be generated after breaking through to level five and forming a Spirit Pill in the body.
At this early stage of the apocalypse, breaking through to level five is evidently impossible. It’s already impressive that her dad reached level three in such a short time.
Ji Ruxue didn’t expect that she would feel troubled by her past life’s strength...
Flashes of powerful cultivation techniques surged in her mind, yet without exception, none were suitable for her dad to train in at this stage, making Ji Ruxue momentarily perplexed.
A moment later, Ji Ruxue’s eyes brightened.
"Got it! The Blood Evil Blade Technique is perfect for Dad right now!"
A blade technique appeared in Ji Ruxue’s mind, which she had obtained from a secret realm before breaking through to the fifth level in her previous life.
This is a purely slaying blade technique that can be executed without Spiritual Essence.
Even though Dad is only at level three now, he can still unleash terrifying combat power through this blade technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Who the Hell Took Everything and Left Nothing Behind?
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 102: Who the Hell Took Everything and Left Nothing Behind?
Just do it.
Now that she finally thought of a cultivation technique suitable for her father’s practice, Ji Ruxue immediately returned to Building No. 7.
After finding a new notebook in the room, Ji Ruxue began to write and draw on it.
In her mind, various key points of the Blood Evil Blade Technique started flashing.
This blade technique focuses on killing, and once executed, blood energy envelops the body, strong and formidable.
It will definitely give father’s strength a huge boost.
At this moment, a blood-red long blade phantom even appeared in Ji Ruxue’s mind.
She recorded everything related to the cultivation technique of the Blood Evil Blade Technique.
She also noted down some insights from her own past training process to facilitate her father’s practice.
As Ji Ruxue wrote intensively, the originally blank notebook was filled with intricate mantras.
She even noted the precautions for wielding and slashing with the blade, demonstrating extreme detail and comprehensiveness.
Since this blade technique was for her father to practice, Ji Ruxue didn’t pretend her handwriting was bad like before, but wrote very neatly.
A moment later, looking at the densely packed content about the blade technique on the notebook, Ji Ruxue nodded with satisfaction.
The handwriting on it was entirely different from what she usually displayed.
Father would never guess that this cultivation technique was created by her.
...
Meanwhile, two kilometers away from Sunshine District, inside a large supermarket.
Gangzi and the others were gathering supplies in the supermarket, but unexpectedly, this large supermarket was empty, except for scattered bloodstains left after the apocalypse!
They searched every corner of the place inside and out, but apart from rotten vegetables and spoiled meat, everything edible had been taken away, even a bottle of mineral water and bread were not left.
The dry-mouthed Evolution Team was furious upon seeing this.
"What the hell? Who the hell did such a heartless thing, leaving nothing in such a big supermarket?!"
The captain of the Evolution Team couldn’t help but curse in his heart.
Previously, in other areas, while searching for supplies, because of the apocalypse, survivors were avoiding zombies, so even when looting supplies, some scattered items would remain.
After all, for ordinary people, survival is more important than obtaining more supplies.
The Evolution Team traveled all the way from the Survivor Base to Jianghai City’s center, and it’s the first time they encountered such a cleaned-out situation.
Looking at the empty shelves, everyone’s eyebrows furrowed tightly.
Since leaving the Survivor Base, some time had passed, and the supplies they carried were almost running out.
Initially, they believed that despite survivors looting supplies in such a big city, there would still be some left for them.
But they did not expect reality to be harsher than their ideal, with not even the residual supplies they imagined left, everything was simply cleaned out.
Gathering together, they opened their bags, and now the remaining supplies were so sparse that they couldn’t last long.
Even though they were Evolvers, they hadn’t reached the level of fasting and still needed regular meals.
Thinking that they’ve been striving for so long without even obtaining a second-level zombie’s Crystal Core, and now not even any supplies, they all felt depressed.
At this moment, the bald-headed man and the Evolver responsible for reconnaissance in the team returned. Gangzi and the others showed a hopeful look, only to find the two equally dejected.
"Don’t look at us. We went around the nearby districts and found nothing left."
"Not to mention the supermarkets and shops, even the households in those buildings have nothing left!"
They were all very frustrated, encountering such a situation of not finding a single bit of supplies in the massive modern city for the first time.
"What should we do now? If we can’t find supplies, we’ll have to find a way back to the base, or we’ll starve before getting the zombie’s Crystal Core."
Gangzi frowned and looked at the others, speaking in a deep voice.
The rest of the team looked at each other after hearing this, knowing that what Gangzi said was something they had to consider for the present.
After all, as Evolvers, they also need energy to replenish their physical strength; without eating for a long time, their bodies would weaken, and by then they wouldn’t have the strength to handle zombies.
Although they wanted to bring back more zombie Crystal Cores to exchange for Evolution Potions and enhance their strength.
But unfortunately, they didn’t seem to have much luck on this journey.
Especially after arriving nearby, misfortune struck them one after another.
Despite being close to getting the zombie Crystal Core, it was mysteriously snatched away, and now after searching several districts, they couldn’t even find a bottle of mineral water.
As they were feeling utterly frustrated, the Evolver with awakened reconnaissance ability suddenly noticed something unusual outside.
He quickly pointed out the shop and his voice was filled with doubt.
"Look, outside there are two zombies, they seem to be carrying something!"
Upon hearing his words, the team turned their heads and discovered two zombies walking down the street carrying large bags.
They faintly saw that the zombies were carrying human-needed supplies, including food and water.
This bizarre scene left all the Evolvers present stunned.
"Am I seeing things? Did I just see two zombies carrying supplies?"
"Are you kidding me? How come zombies started gathering supplies? What do these bloodthirsty monsters need human supplies for?!"
They felt extremely puzzled, never having heard of a zombie liking to eat human bread!
Seeing zombies searching for supplies made them even doubt if hunger had caused them to hallucinate.
The captain of the team, looking over the empty shelves around, suddenly narrowed his pupils.
"I was wondering before, under the pressure of this apocalypse, although everyone strives to search for supplies, they would inevitably miss a few items due to panic or various reasons."
"But in this surrounding area, we haven’t found any supplies at all, which is very unreasonable!"
The others reacted upon hearing the captain’s words, looking incredulous.
"Captain, are you saying the supplies in this area were taken by zombies?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 103: A Swordsmanship Manual Falling from the Sky!
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 103: A Swordsmanship Manual Falling from the Sky!
