The team leader couldn’t help but give a wry smile at the group’s words, then helplessly spread his hands.
"Although I know this guess is quite absurd, at the moment there seems to be no other possibility."
As the captain’s voice fell, several Evolvers in the store felt as if their brains had crashed.
Looking at the two zombies walking outside the window, everyone felt completely bewildered.
Are you kidding me? How come the zombies in this area are so weird?!
These zombies, which originally only attacked on instinct, have now learned to use weapons and even mastered certain combat skills!
If it was just that, it would be fine, but now they’re even starting to compete with humans for resources. What is going on?!
Zombies competing with humans for resources—that’s completely against the natural order!
Before setting off, the team had made preparations and had studied the various information collected by the base.
They thought they were fully prepared, but upon entering the city, they found it completely different from the records they understood!
The bizarre events they encountered were not documented at all in the base, catching them totally unprepared.
"Captain, should we follow and take a look?"
The bald man, who had awakened speed-related evolutionary abilities, looked at the zombies outside the window and eagerly suggested.
"We’ve never encountered such a strange situation before. We might as well follow and see. If we can bring back some new intelligence, we can exchange it for some contribution points."
"Even if we don’t find anything else, if we kill these zombies, we can still obtain a large amount of resources. We won’t lose out."
Gangzi, on the side, nodded in agreement with this suggestion: "I suspect these resources nearby were taken by these zombies. We might as well follow and take a look. Who knows, we might directly acquire a huge pile of resources!"
The team members were all eager to give it a try, and after pondering, the captain nodded.
The Crystal Core of the second-stage Evolved Zombie hadn’t been obtained by them yet, and the supplies they had were running low. They might as well take this opportunity to see if there are any new gains.
Then the group quietly followed behind the two zombies, quickly arriving at the outskirts of Sunshine District.
But when they arrived at the entrance of the district, they were all stunned.
Standing at the entrance was an extremely large-sized giant zombie.
And this zombie was the one they had seen earlier, the second-stage Tank Type zombie that had effortlessly broke the bones and muscles of the second-stage Tyrant in a few moves.
Recognizing the powerful second-stage zombie, the group couldn’t help but gasp and quickly stopped, not daring to approach.
Having witnessed the zombie’s strength firsthand, they dared not underestimate its power, so they hid nearby to observe more closely.
...
On the clearing in Sunshine District, Lu Chuan was simultaneously facing the assault from ’Lightning Two’ and ’Da Pang’.
He intended to use these two Evolved Zombies to further enhance his combat skills.
Despite their aggressive attacks, Lu Chuan appeared extremely at ease, able to handle their fierce assaults with composure.
The freedom in this battle made Lu Chuan incredibly thrilled.
Ji Ruxue appeared again on the rooftop of Building Four, having already recorded the Blood Evil Blade Technique in her notebook.
Watching her dad below, using the two Evolved Zombies to enhance his combat skills, Ji Ruxue shook her head helplessly.
Her dad was certainly working hard, but the results were not as expected.
"Dad, you’d better not train in such a rough way. I hope this blade technique can lend you a helping hand."
Ji Ruxue immediately used Telekinesis to drop the notebook she compiled from the sky, landing precisely at Lu Chuan’s feet.
The sudden drop made Lu Chuan pause, quickly ending his fight with the two Evolved Zombies.
After picking up the notebook, Lu Chuan looked around but found nothing unusual.
Seeing the three big words "Homework Notebook" on the cover made Lu Chuan freeze.
"What’s going on? A homework notebook fell from the sky?!"
But when Lu Chuan opened the notebook, he saw four words on the first page: "Blood Evil Blade Technique."
Seeing such an imposing name instantly captured Lu Chuan’s attention, compelling him to continue reading out of curiosity.
The Blood Evil Blade Technique uses blood as a guide, condensing evil energy to unleash endless killing intent, breaking all techniques with an invincible and violent stance.
To cultivate the Blood Evil Blade Technique, one must be resolute, fear not death, and use one’s own Essence Blood to trigger towering evil energy, refining Blood Evil Qi in endless slaughter.
At the cultivation technique’s Great Success, there is no need for external weapons, as one’s Blood Evil Qi becomes the world’s strongest blade!
Just reading the introduction of the Blood Evil Blade Technique made Lu Chuan feel a rich bloody aura rush towards him.
Even though it was just a few simple words, Lu Chuan felt as if he was seeing a terrifying scene of corpses and seas of blood before him!
In his mind’s eye, Lu Chuan saw a blood-colored long blade bearing immense, world-shattering evil energy, a blade that shattered mountains and rivers wherever it passed!
Clutching the notebook, Lu Chuan continued to read with excitement.
The Blood Evil Blade Technique is divided into five forms.
Boundless Sea of Blood, Blood Shadow Devouring Soul, Fierce Blade Piercing the Clouds, Blood Evil Cycle, and the final stroke, Blood Evil Slash the Heavens!
The first form is to condense one’s Blood Evil Qi, followed by executing horizontal slash and vertical chop techniques.
These are the simplest techniques in the blade arts, but Lu Chuan remembered a phrase clearly: All techniques return to one.
Sometimes it’s the simplest techniques that are the most effective and the hardest to master.
The second form of the blade technique adopts a rapid route, gathering an overwhelming knife light, making it impossible for the enemy to defend against the extremely sharp attacks.
What shocked Lu Chuan the most was that this blade technique could even manifest ghostly shadows to psyche the enemy with mental attacks.
The fourth form blends the previous techniques, allowing each strike to be executed seamlessly and continuously, making the enemy feel as if they’re trapped in an endless cycle.
In Lu Chuan’s view, reaching the fourth form was still attainable.
But the fifth form seemed incredibly mystical.
To condense a blade edge with one’s Blood Evil Qi, achieving the final stage requires no blade in hand, as one’s Blood Evil Qi forms a powerful blood blade.
After quickly reading the whole notebook, Lu Chuan was extremely shocked.
"Is there actually such a profound blade technique in this world?! It’s just incredible!"
Lu Chuan had also gathered some combat techniques recently, but those martial arts books couldn’t compare to the blade technique before him.
Lu Chuan looked around again but still found nothing.
"It’s really strange, why did such a miraculous blade technique just fall at my feet from nowhere?"

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Oh My God, Did We Just Enter a Zombie Den?
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 104: Oh My God, Did We Just Enter a Zombie Den?
The Blood Evil Blade Technique recorded in this manual amazed Lu Chuan immensely.
He never imagined that there could be such a peculiar cultivation technique in the world, beyond his previous understanding of martial arts.
But in a world where even zombies exist, having some extraordinary martial arts doesn’t seem impossible.
The myriad of mysteries left Lu Chuan feeling fascinated and reluctant to leave.
However, after Lu Chuan closed the manual, he seemed to feel something wasn’t quite right.
This manual looks familiar, where have I seen it before...?
The more Lu Chuan looked, the more he felt this martial arts manual that fell from the sky resembled Little Qiqi’s exercise book?
But the only difference was that the handwriting for the Blood Evil Blade Technique was much more elegant than the little one’s.
If it weren’t for the different handwriting, Lu Chuan would’ve suspected it was something the little one scribbled for fun.
After all, aside from the penmanship, both the cover and the interior pages were identical.
Although the origins of this manual were unknown, with such a peculiar cultivation technique landing by his side, there was no reason not to cultivate it.
Lu Chuan wasn’t bothered about the manual’s origins and immediately began delving into it with great perseverance.
The manual described the blade technique as so powerful that Lu Chuan was eager to witness its might with his own eyes.
Lu Chuan then began wielding his machete, starting his training step by step according to the chants of the cultivation technique.
As his strength continued to improve, Lu Chuan became increasingly aware of how crucial combat skills were to victory or defeat.
After all, even if zombies were of the same level, the outcome was entirely different when he controlled them versus when he didn’t.
...
Meanwhile.
Across from the Sunshine District, Gangzi and his Evolution Team hid inside a store, watching the zombies outside constantly transporting supplies into the Sunshine District, causing them to grind their teeth in frustration.
"Damn it! I was wondering why we couldn’t find a scrap around here; turns out these zombies took everything away?!"
"But this group of zombies are just a bunch of bloodthirsty creatures, feasting on flesh every day. Why are they transporting human mineral water and bread? When did zombies start going vegetarian?"
The few of them looked at Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet team outside, bewildered.
However, a bold idea came to the minds of the Evolvers as they exchanged glances, each seeing the same thought in the eyes of the others.
"Why concern ourselves with why these zombies are transporting supplies; we know for sure that a massive stockpile must be in that Sunshine District now!"
"These zombies took all the supplies, and we went hungry for days because of it!"
Gangzi then nodded and proposed, "If we can get our hands on the supplies in the district, we won’t have to worry about food and clothes afterward!"
They’re almost out of supplies and desperately needed a resupply, or else they faced long-term hunger.
Everyone nodded at Gangzi’s suggestion.
But soon, the Evolver in charge of healing said apprehensively, "If it were just ordinary zombies, that’d be fine, but don’t forget, there’s a new type of zombie capable of wielding weapons at the district’s entrance!"
"That big one is evidently at Tier 2 strength. Are you sure we can handle it?"
Upon hearing this, everyone began to ponder, realizing that such a powerful Tier 2 zombie was indeed a problem.
If it were just a Tier 1 evolved zombie, it wouldn’t pose much of a threat to them.
Even with an ordinary Tier 2 evolved zombie, their team’s coordination could whittle it down over time.
But the zombie before them wasn’t just any Tier 2 evolved zombie; it was an unknown existence they hadn’t encountered before!
Upon witnessing Er Pang wielding a massive steel rod against a Tier 2 Tyrant Zombie, breaking bones and sinews, it left the Evolver team apprehensive, unwilling to act rashly.
The team leader, the man with slicked-back hair, looked at the supplies carried by the zombies outside. A ruthless glint flashed in his eyes as he gathered the team for discussion.
"We’ve been hungry for so long, and are you just going to watch the supplies slip right through our fingers, letting a bunch of zombies take it all away?"
"Since there’s a Tier 2 zombie guarding the gate, why don’t we sneak in from the outer wall?"
"Although the district’s walls are high, that’s only a problem for ordinary people. Do we Evolvers fear a high wall and barbed wire?"
Upon hearing this plan, they briefly contemplated it before nodding in agreement.
As the team leader said, scaling into the district with their skills wouldn’t be an issue.
Furthermore, with so many supplies in front of them, they were all tempted to take the risk.
...
Meanwhile, after a brief period of practicing the Blood Evil Blade Technique, Lu Chuan felt incredibly revitalized.
This blade technique was indeed as profound as described, far surpassing Lu Chuan’s previous understanding of martial arts.
Returning to his room, Lu Chuan was making egg fried rice for Little Qiqi, who quickly ran to his side.
"Daddy, make a serving for Sister Zhao Lin too."
Ji Ruxue was still contemplating about winning over Zhao Lin. In the apocalypse, showing some care often helped gain favor significantly.
Moreover, the Nine Deaths Demon Police was still in a state of naive trustfulness.
Lu Chuan nodded and made a portion for Zhao Lin.
But at that moment, Lu Chuan was suddenly alerted.
From the Corpse Puppets patrolling the district, he discovered that someone had sneaked in again overnight.
The Evolver team, eyeing the supplies, had no idea of the terrifying presence residing in the Sunshine District.
Apart from the Evolver on lookout, providing cover fire with a military crossbow, the others climbed into the Sunshine District’s yard.
Gangzi and his team were unaware that the moment they climbed in, they were already noticed by Lu Chuan.
Now, hiding in the greenery, they remained undercover, but upon seeing the district teeming with patrol-like zombies, they were terrified.
"What the heck is going on? Is this a zombie stronghold?"
The sight left them speechless with fright.
Watching the swaying figures under the moonlight, Gangzi and his team felt a chill run from their soles straight up their spine.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: First Time Killing Someone with My Own Hands!
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 105: First Time Killing Someone with My Own Hands!
The terrifying scene inside the district made the few Evolvers that climbed over the wall feel uneasy.
Although they were strong, and ordinary zombies would hardly pose any danger to them, even Evolved Zombies could potentially die at their hands if they worked together.
However, as Evolvers, they had a certain sense for crises, and seeing such a bizarre situation, they all felt something was off.
Even Gangzi, who was relatively simple-minded, realized that the Sunshine District was not just a mere storage site for supplies.
The Evolver responsible for providing healing abilities in the squad glanced around and quickly said to the captain, "Captain, I feel something’s off, maybe we should retreat first."
"We’ve never encountered something like this before. We must not risk our brothers’ lives for some supplies."
Hearing his words, the rest all nodded in agreement.
The district exuded an eerie atmosphere, and they really didn’t want to linger there any longer.
However, the squad captain felt confident in his skills and courage. Looking at the neat formations in the district, even the zombies were wielding weapons.
These originally scattered zombies were patrolling inside the district like well-trained soldiers.
This filled him with excitement, "Wait a little longer, don’t rush, don’t you think this is a great opportunity?"
"In all the base’s information on zombies, there’s never been a record of zombies resembling human soldiers like this!"
The squad captain stared at the faint figures in the darkness, not frightened but with a glint of excitement in his eyes.
He had a feeling that this district was extraordinary, likely hiding an earth-shattering secret. If their squad could uncover it first, it would surely lead to great rewards!
They had never heard of zombies using weapons before, but they encountered plenty of such zombies inside the district.
Moreover, they were even transporting supplies that zombies couldn’t possibly use. Could it be that these zombies were controlled by some being?
The thought made the captain’s eyes light up, growing more excited by the moment.
He seemed to see a grand secret’s solution beckoning to him.
The captain was extremely curious about what kind of being was behind everything, believing that the high-ranking officials at the Survivor Base would be very interested in such information.
If they could successfully bring back the situation here, they would certainly be richly rewarded.
In this apocalypse, evolving wasn’t easy, and gaining an edge in the early stages was undoubtedly crucial.
But at this moment, the survivors felt a shiver, sensing a looming crisis.
The three urged, "Captain, maybe we should retreat, this district feels off!"
"Yeah, these zombies aren’t simple. There are second-tier evolved zombies, and so many ordinary ones that even together we might not be their match!"
Persuaded by them, the captain also nodded, deciding to take this information out.
Just as he excitedly fantasized about the huge reward awaiting him, the threat of death silently loomed.
The moment they fell from the high wall, Lu Chuan had spotted them, already prepared a trap awaiting them.
As the Survivor Squad turned to run out of the yard, they suddenly found Lightning Two standing behind them with a steel knife.
The white blade gleamed coldly in the moonlight’s reflection.
The sudden scene made them tremble, and soon a large squad of Corpse Puppets started encircling them.
If not for the zombies’ appearance, they might have believed they were surrounded by assembled human soldiers.
Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet squad encircled faster than their retreat, and after a few steps, they were already heavily surrounded by the zombies he arranged.
Seeing the shadowy figures, the survivors turned pale with fright.
Gangzi’s hands began to tremble—he hadn’t imagined he’d escape so many second-tier zombies only to be trapped in a district.
The little zombies said nothing, immediately pouncing to bite.
"Damn it! Brothers, let’s charge out together!"
The Survivor Squad captain waved his broadsword, leading them to retreat.
But the dense zombies filled them with despair.
Crucially, the zombies included numerous Evolved Zombies.
Lightning Two’s dual blades swung like thunder, emitting icy glares in the dark night. A weaker healing Evolver was decapitated in a mere clash.
Seeing the comrades’ grim deaths, Gangzi and others were aghast, hastily fleeing.
At that moment, Da Pang swung his dual hammers, easily knocking Gangzi and the captain back a few steps with his Giant Strength.
Lu Chuan smirked coldly, watching the survivors who had entered his Sunshine District.
These guys dared to target his district, which meant they touched his reverse scale.
Da Pang’s fierce hammers overpowered Gangzi and the Survivor Squad captain, leaving them struggling to fend off.
Then again, blades flashed through the air—Lightning Two seized the opportunity amid the ordinary zombies’ chaos to deal the pair a fatal blow with steel blades.
They died not understanding why these zombies were wielding weapons like humans.
Now, entering the Sunshine District, only the speed-type bald-headed man remained.
As he broke through the Corpse Puppets with a machete, he found a man’s silhouette blocking the road.
Watching the determined machete-wielding man blocking his path, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
This man was deliberately allowed out by him, for besides Zhao Lin, he hadn’t yet faced other humans, and Lu Chuan wanted to test his combat power post-three-tier advancement.
The bald man, seeing Lu Chuan alone, charged with the machete without a word.
But then, he suddenly saw Lu Chuan’s right hand move, followed by a blood-red blade light slicing through the air.
Lu Chuan’s horizontal slice split the bald man in two.
The bald man stared blankly at his lower half left behind, "Such a fast blade..."

chapters.title: Chapter 106: It’s Time for a New Home!
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 106: It’s Time for a New Home!
Lu Chuan swung the blade at an extremely fast speed, so much so that the bald man didn’t even see how Lu Chuan struck.
The cold, cutting blade light left him without any chance to block, only feeling a horrifying surge of blood as he was cleaved in two at the waist.
Seeing the bald man’s body split in two, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
He hadn’t expected that his martial skills would improve so much in such a short training time.
It proved that the Blood Evil Blade Technique was indeed a powerful martial art.
At this moment, the Sunshine District echoed with eerie screams and the roars of numerous zombies; the dark courtyard seemed like a terrifying man-eating monster.
The Evolver left outside for reconnaissance, upon hearing his companion’s screams, was already pale with fear, uncontrollably trembling.
He hadn’t anticipated that the seemingly peaceful Sunshine District would be this terrifying!
Though his body was shaking like a leaf, the Evolver still thought of his teammates awaiting his support, forcing himself to stay put despite his fears.
Under the moonlight, the entire Sunshine District appeared as if enveloped in darkness.
It wasn’t until the zombie roars decreased and the screams gradually faded that the Evolver truly realized his teammates had all perished within the Sunshine District!
He felt his heart clench violently; several Evolvers dead without a survivor, this Sunshine District was like hell.
Comrades he’d experienced life-and-death battles with had all fallen, causing deep sorrow within him.
Not long ago, they were all gathered discussing material supplies, yet now only he was left.
He knew the matter was grave and that he needed to leave quickly.
He forced down the sorrow within and turned to leave for the distance.
But suddenly his moving body seemed struck by a heavy blow, his entire figure immobilized.
Swoosh!
The next second, his body fell straight to the ground.
His occiput had been penetrated by a nail, even his brain matter thoroughly shredded, resembling tofu brain with chili sauce mixed in.
This Evolver was as dead as can be.
Ji Ruxue hovered in the air at this spot, watching the last Evolver she killed, and a smile spread across her face.
Lu Chuan had originally been cooking rice but suddenly left in haste, making Ji Ruxue realize something had likely happened.
Though she knew her zombie father was a genuine Corpse King with formidable strength now, Ji Ruxue still worried about any unexpected scenarios.
She smoothly made her way to the balcony, observing the battles happening below.
She was surprised to see so many Evolvers climb over the walls today.
But Ji Ruxue understood, regardless of their intents, if they were allowed to leave, her zombie father’s identity might likely be exposed.
Even without exposing father’s exact identity, the Sunshine District might face human military siege.
Such potentially threatening matters to her father would decisively never happen according to Ji Ruxue.
So after father slew the Evolvers in the courtyard, Ji Ruxue filled in the gaps by eliminating the Evolver outside responsible for reconnaissance and support.
After killing all these Evolvers, Lu Chuan began searching for useful items.
With so many Evolvers gathered, Lu Chuan didn’t believe it was just by chance.
Indeed, Lu Chuan found identification from Jianghai City’s Survivor Base on them during his search.
Furthermore, through letters and information on them, Lu Chuan discovered that human survivors had passed the initial stage of confusion.
The Survivor Base began actively hunting zombies, researching evolutionary gene potions to cultivate more powerful human Evolvers.
Lu Chuan’s initially joyful expression suddenly turned tense.
"Didn’t expect Survivor Base people would come here!"
Lu Chuan realized he underestimated human strength.
He initially thought the world’s drastic changes would cause a temporary chaos among humans.
Even if a Survivor Base was established in this devastated world, it would take time to stabilize.
Yet unexpectedly, in such a short time, not only had the Survivor Base stabilized, but expanded externally!
The Evolver team members he killed accepted a task to hunt zombies and search for resources in Jianghai City District.
Lu Chuan suddenly felt immense pressure, shocked by the rapid development of the human Survivor Base.
Undoubtedly, establishing such a large Survivor Base required a powerful military foundation.
Lu Chuan was certain that a large Survivor Base must have military presence.
Though it’s the apocalypse’s early stage and Evolvers are few, relying solely on Evolvers to manage the Base is impossible.
Thus, to resist zombie attacks, manage survivors and Evolvers, and have the strength to research genetic potions, powerful military backing was needed.
This meant Jianghai City’s Survivor Base had a strong military energy support.
Lu Chuan’s expression turned grim.
Even after reaching Tier 3 and commanding his own zombie army, only barely resembling a small force.
Yet unexpectedly within two days of joy, he received such a heavy blow of bad news.
Against ordinary survivors, his zombies exerted a terrifying suppression.
Like today, the survivor team entering the Sunshine District was slaughtered at first encounter.
But with formal military involvement now, Lu Chuan feared his zombies would be shot to pieces, possibly bombarded by artillery.
He lacked sufficient strength to rival human survivors, looking around at the familiar high-rise buildings with only helplessness.
"Didn’t expect survivors to be more resilient than I imagined; it’s time to find Little Qiqi a new home."

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Qiqi Must Eat Fresh Vegetables!
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 107: Qiqi Must Eat Fresh Vegetables!
The variables in the apocalypse are truly overwhelming, and Lu Chuan must be prepared for all contingencies.
Otherwise, if danger really arrives, it might be too late for everything.
In this ruined world, one needs to prepare in advance to ensure sufficient safety.
Although the Sunshine District is not exposed to many human survivors for various reasons.
But since this place consistently attracts the attention of human survivors, it means that eventually, it may be exposed one day.
After all, Jianghai City is neither too big nor too small.
Considering the growth rate of these Evolvers, it’s only a matter of time before they notice the Sunshine District.
After all, Lu Chuan is very aware that gathering a group of Evolved Zombies like this is hard to go unnoticed.
Therefore, to prevent unforeseen events in the future, Lu Chuan decided to relocate as soon as possible.
After all, he is no longer alone; carrying Little Qiqi means he must ensure the safety of the little one, not letting her face any danger.
Lu Chuan glanced at his Corpse Puppet army in the district, deciding that before leaving, he must enhance the strength of his Corpse Puppet army.
Currently, he has broken through to the third stage, and his Spiritual Power has significantly increased compared to before, easily controlling more second-stage zombies.
In this apocalypse, everywhere is filled with changes, so even if he wants to move, he must prepare thoroughly in advance.
As time in the apocalypse progresses, the overall strength of either Human Evolvers, zombies, or Mutated Fierce Beasts is becoming stronger.
"Although the number of ordinary Corpse Puppets under my control is already large, it’s far from enough against real mutated strong beings, I still need to expand by several second-stage Corpse Puppets."
The doomsday has persisted for a long time now, and even though Lu Chuan has been tireless during this period, fundamentally, he has only been centered around the Sunshine District, operating within his radiation range.
Lu Chuan is actually unaware of the external situation, enhancing enough strength is the only way to acquire a sense of security.
When Lu Chuan returned to the seventh floor of Building Five from outside, Ji Ruxue had already flown back ahead of him using Telekinesis Control, pretending to act nonchalant.
Seeing Lu Chuan return, Ji Ruxue happily looked up and then raised the painting in her hand in front of Lu Chuan.
"Daddy, daddy, see if my painting looks alike."
Ji Ruxue lifted the painting before Lu Chuan and he was instantly stunned when he lowered his head to look.
Little Qiqi had painted a zombie holding the hand of a little girl in her artwork.
Even though the picture was eerie, it exuded a hint of warmth.
Instantly, Lu Chuan felt a soothing warmth coursing through his heart.
Looking at adorable Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan’s heart trembled.
Reaching for paper and pen, Lu Chuan gently pinched Little Qiqi’s cheek.
Then he wrote, "Looks like it, you did a great job Qiqi!"
Gazing at his innocent and adorable daughter, Lu Chuan became even more determined to leave this place.
One never knows when the Sunshine District might get exposed, so he must ensure Little Qiqi’s safety.
Moreover, Little Qiqi is still young, right in a critical growth stage, she can’t remain cooped up in this confined space forever.
Although Lu Chuan has never taken care of a child, he knows how important a sunny and cheerful environment is for the growth of infants.
"Since we’re relocating this time, I might as well find Little Qiqi a healthy and happy environment to grow up in."
Lu Chuan made up his mind that since he was moving, he had to carefully plan ahead.
In fact, Lu Chuan had thought about this before, about giving Little Qiqi a more suitable environment to grow in.
It was just that various things delayed it, and now, due to the surviving human bases outside, Lu Chuan decided it’s better to temporarily keep Little Qiqi away from the crowd.
Lu Chuan directly took out a map, for he had long planned the location of their new home in his heart.
Firstly, the new home environment must be spacious enough, certainly not as enclosed as the current Sunshine District.
Little Qiqi’s age is increasing, and due to her natural brilliance, she seems too precocious.
In the future, Little Qiqi can’t be kept in a closed environment any longer.
A life without seeing the sky is extremely oppressive for a living person.
As for Lu Chuan’s second criterion for choosing a new home, it is ironically the opposite of human preferences.
Human survivors would usually pick a more remote place with fewer crowds as a suitable residence.
Since such locations usually have fewer zombies.
However, Lu Chuan was different, he decided that when moving to a new home, he would choose a place that had high foot traffic before the apocalypse, as this means more zombies around.
To human survivors, zombies are terrifying beings, but for Lu Chuan, they are a resource, the more zombies there are, the safer he is.
The more zombies there are, the more likely it is for more Evolved Zombies to be born, be it controlling zombies or consuming Crystal Cores to evolve, Lu Chuan needs a sizable base of zombies.
Those Cannibal Demons that others avoid are what Lu Chuan uses to become stronger.
The third factor Lu Chuan hoped to find on the map for the new home was that there should be enough fertile land around it.
Lu Chuan understood the logic of not using up an entire mountain and now with the apocalypse advancing, the world has come to a halt, all major factories have stopped production.
If he truly wanted to raise Little Qiqi to maturity, he had to have a piece of fertile land he could use for production.
Otherwise, all the resources collected within the city wouldn’t be sufficient to support the little one all the way to adulthood.
Having a land of his own, cultivating farmland, and continuously producing is paramount.
After all, he has the Corpse Puppet army to do free labor for him.
Lu Chuan suddenly remembered, Little Qiqi hadn’t had fresh vegetables for quite a while...
Little Qiqi is at a stage where she needs nutrition for healthy growth, fresh vegetables are essential for nutrients.
However, in the world after the apocalypse, there is no possibility of having fresh vegetables to eat within the city.
Thinking about the little one’s very monotonous diet for such a long time, Lu Chuan felt some heartache.
Lu Chuan still remembered his memories from a past life, in this era of technological and economic rapid development, where infants could derive nutrients from all kinds of food.
But his Little Qiqi completely lacked such conditions, many items that were nonchalant before the apocalypse had become extremely precious after it.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Preparations Before Leaving
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 108: Preparations Before Leaving
Lu Chuan was constantly searching for a suitable place to live on the map based on his requirements, and eliminating options one by one.
Finally, Lu Chuan successfully identified a location on the map that met his criteria.
It was a farm not far from the urban area of Jianghai City, offering a vast plot that could accommodate his large corpse puppet army.
Additionally, the farm had fertile soil that could be used for planting, and if conditions allowed, he could even have a large number of corpse puppets cultivate the land to grow crops.
Perhaps he could let the little one enjoy some fresh vegetables, and the farm was quite close to the urban area.
Lu Chuan believed that the number of zombies around the farm would likely be substantial, satisfying his needs for corpse control and acquiring Crystal Cores to grow stronger.
After much contemplation, Lu Chuan felt increasingly satisfied with this location.
In that vast farm, the little one could experience the beauty of nature.
Escaping the long confinements of the concrete jungle, changing the environment and living style could benefit Little Qiqi’s growth.
Lu Chuan found this place more and more suitable, and he marked it on the map with a pen.
After Lu Chuan left, the curious Ji Ruxue quickly came over to check.
"Why did Dad suddenly start looking at maps? What’s he planning?"
It’s really strange and eerie for a Corpse King to be staring at a map for so long.
Thankfully, Ji Ruxue knew that her zombie father retained human memories, so it wasn’t all that odd to her.
Searching the map, Ji Ruxue quickly found the Qingshui Farm marked by Lu Chuan.
That place was right next to the urban area of Jianghai City, and upon seeing it, Ji Ruxue frowned.
"Why did Dad suddenly circle this Qingshui Farm? Could he be planning to go there?"
"The distance from Sunshine District through Jianghai City to the suburban Qingshui Farm is not short..."
Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but feel puzzled; such a long distance was entirely outside of Dad’s usual habits.
However, with quick thinking, Ji Ruxue quickly guessed Lu Chuan’s reasoning.
"Could it be because so much has happened here lately that Dad realized Sunshine District is no longer safe, so he’s planning our next residence?"
"Looks like Dad is likely preparing to evacuate here, with his next target being the suburban Qingshui Farm."
With this hypothesis, Ji Ruxue suddenly recalled her previous joint operation with Zhao Lin, where they attacked Sunshine District at night...
She still remembered how enraged her father was on that occasion; perhaps it was then that he started to have major concerns about the safety surrounding Sunshine District.
Realizing that her actions had caused her father significant stress, Ji Ruxue felt a bit embarrassed, as she hadn’t known the Corpse King of Sunshine District was her father.
Since she spent every day with Lu Chuan, Ji Ruxue knew her father still arranged for corpse puppets to patrol around the neighborhood, searching for traces of her collaboration with Zhao Lin.
With this in mind, Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly, knowing that Dad might never find the Human Evolver who secretly acted in Sunshine District.
First came the incident with her and Zhao Lin, and now there were so many Human Evolvers showing up here mysteriously.
The crucial part was finding out that some of them had information about the human Survivor Base.
Ji Ruxue knew that her father likely thought Sunshine District had already been exposed to the survivors’ view.
By then, as the Corpse King, her father might be exposed.
Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile wryly, realizing that it was understandable that Dad wanted to move due to so much happening recently.
"It seems the pressure Dad is under is even greater than I imagined."
Ji Ruxue didn’t care much about relocating; all she wanted was to stay by her father’s side.
No matter where Dad went, she would follow—whether to the outskirts or any other location.
With her eyes gleaming with determination, Ji Ruxue resolved to train harder.
As the apocalypse progressed, the pressure on zombie Dad kept increasing, so she needed to improve her strength, too.
If she could become strong enough to protect her zombie dad, he wouldn’t need to move just to find a safer place.
Ji Ruxue understood that only by becoming powerful could she become the greatest support for her father in the apocalypse.
After a glance at the map, Ji Ruxue returned to her training, determined to further enhance her capabilities.
...
Meanwhile, once Lu Chuan had decided to abandon Sunshine District and move to another area, he began controlling his corpse puppets to prepare for his departure.
To control more second-tier zombies, Lu Chuan had intensified his search efforts recently.
He dispatched more corpse puppets within his control range, searching for more traces of Evolved Zombies.
Now that he had broken through to the third tier, his Spiritual Power had increased greatly compared to before.
Before leaving, Lu Chuan had to convert this growth in Spiritual Power into enough strength.
The post-apocalyptic world was too dangerous, and he couldn’t guarantee safety on the long journey across the city with Little Qiqi without sufficient force.
If he didn’t have a strong enough fighting force, ensuring Little Qiqi’s safety would be impossible.
Moreover, Lu Chuan planned to take all kinds of supplies he had collected during this time, particularly those that could be preserved for long durations.
After all, these were his hard-earned resources, and Lu Chuan didn’t want anyone else to take advantage of them.
Besides, baby supplies would be hard to find after leaving the city for the suburban farm.
However, looking at the room full of supplies, Lu Chuan felt a bit troubled.
Initially, he had collected everything to ensure the little one would have enough resources for growth, taking whatever was useful, even including three-year college entrance exam preparation materials...
Now, the entire fifth building was filled with supplies, making relocation a significant challenge with all this material.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Ji Ruxue Breaks Through to Tier 3!
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 109: Ji Ruxue Breaks Through to Tier 3!
Time flew by, and another three days had passed.
During these three days, Lu Chuan had been preparing to leave the Sunshine District,
while Ji Ruxue had also been far from idle.
Since learning of her father’s plan, Ji Ruxue had not relaxed her training during this period.
At this moment, in the seventh-floor bedroom, Ji Ruxue was sitting cross-legged on the bed, practicing the Glazed Breathing Technique, continually absorbing the energy factors in the air.
Ji Ruxue’s breathing was very steady, and the rhythm was so long and smooth that it didn’t seem like a one-year-old infant.
In her cultivation state, a peculiar energy seemed to surround Ji Ruxue’s body.
This cultivation technique, developed by late post-apocalyptic humans, was an incredibly advanced ability in the early stages.
With this technique, Ji Ruxue could quickly advance without consuming Evolution Potions.
In these few days, Ji Ruxue did not waste a moment of her training time and even secretly trained at night, just to increase her strength and help her father more when moving.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue’s petite body was trembling continuously, with a faint powerful aura emanating from her small frame.
Boom!
With a roar, Ji Ruxue successfully stepped into the third tier, becoming a third-tier Evolver.
The power within her surged exponentially like a floodgate opened, and Ji Ruxue’s body trembled even more violently.
The majestic power ran wildly inside Ji Ruxue, her bones starting to crackle like popping beans.
The bones and flesh in her body became very refined; although Ji Ruxue’s body was small, it unleashed a formidable aura.
After breaking through to the third tier, a strong pressure began emanating from Ji Ruxue’s body.
Her snowy and tender skin became even more fair after the successful breakthrough.
Ji Ruxue’s body grew slightly on its original foundation, though she still appeared small, but the power contained within her had become extraordinarily vast!
With the breakthrough, Ji Ruxue’s strength increased significantly.
Her telekinesis also surged, strengthening her mental force incredibly.
After a while, Ji Ruxue’s trembling body gradually began to stabilize, and she seemed to possess an ethereal aura.
Opening her eyes, a gleam flashed in Ji Ruxue’s eyes, filled with a steadiness beyond her age.
Clenching her fists, a smile played on Ji Ruxue’s lips, her strength now several times what it had been!
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Through telekinesis, Ji Ruxue controlled her body, briefly flying in mid-air, her movement speed greatly improved from before.
Previously, Ji Ruxue had only relied on her small size, using telekinesis to hover in mid-air.
Now, with her increased speed, Ji Ruxue had much better attack and self-defense capabilities.
Clenching her little pink fist, Ji Ruxue looked very satisfied.
At this stage, if her memory hadn’t failed her, the strongest human was only second-tier at most.
Now, with her advanced cultivation technique and having stepped into the third tier, her speed of breakthrough far exceeded her previous life.
With her advancement beyond others, coupled with the dual innate talents she possessed after reincarnation, Ji Ruxue was confident she was top tier globally.
With her current strength, she could absolutely thrive in the post-apocalyptic world!
...
Just as Ji Ruxue broke through to the third tier, the sound of an engine came from outside the Sunshine District gate.
The engine’s sound was very conspicuous in the silent apocalypse; with the outbreak, this city hadn’t heard such noises for a long time.
A large truck was parked at the Sunshine District’s gate, and when the door opened, a bizarre scene emerged.
From the driver’s seat, a figure stepped down with unnaturally pale skin and a menacing appearance, even with crimson blood between its teeth—this was a zombie driver!
Three large trucks were parked at the Sunshine District entrance.
Lu Chuan stood atop the complex, nodding contentedly at the scene below.
"Another two trucks should be enough."
The supplies in Building Five were too abundant; moving them by manpower would take forever, like ants relocating.
Traversing the city with people was extremely dangerous, and Lu Chuan didn’t have the energy to control so many zombies to help him move.
Utilizing trucks for transport was undoubtedly the most efficient and convenient method, and these trucks could transfer the supplies completely and save a lot of time.
With the supply issue resolved, Lu Chuan would fully focus on searching for Evolved Zombies.
In these three days, Lu Chuan hadn’t stopped using Corpse Puppets to continue the search.
He hadn’t encountered even a second-tier zombie, but he wasn’t without any gains.
Second-tier Evolved Zombies might still be scarce, making encounters rare.
However, there were still some first-tier Evolved Zombies; over the days, Lu Chuan added two more Agile Type first-tier Evolved Zombies, now expanding to Lightning Four.
A powerful Tank Type Evolved Zombie was also added, reaching San Pang.
Although Lu Chuan’s strength had increased significantly and his Corpse Puppets had grown,
he knew his current power wasn’t sufficient. As time passed, all forces were evolving, and first-tier Evolved Zombies no longer imposed the same early dominance.
Lu Chuan regretted not finding any second-tier zombies despite the long search; second-tier zombies were far superior in combat strength to first-tier zombies.
Despite having many Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan felt he only had Er Pang, a second-tier Tank Type Zombie, that could truly fight.
Luckily, Lu Chuan found a suitable weapon for Er Pang, which immensely enhanced its combat capabilities.
Otherwise, Lu Chuan thought that traversing the city to the outskirts with his current forces was still a risky endeavor.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: How Should Zhao Lin Be Dealt With?
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 110: How Should Zhao Lin Be Dealt With?
Seventh-floor bedroom.
Ji Ruxue looked through the hole in the window at the truck parked at the entrance of the complex, her expression turning somewhat strange.
"Oh my, letting zombies drive the truck, only Dad could think of that..."
Able to control zombies with such a strong sense of initiative, other than her dad, there was probably no one else.
"Is Dad planning to take all the supplies from the complex? How come he prepared so many trucks?"
If these zombies were just moving house, trucks wouldn’t be necessary at all, since zombies, unlike humans, can walk openly on the streets without any problem.
Other issues didn’t worry Ji Ruxue, but what about Zhao Lin, who was locked downstairs...
The cargo could be loaded directly onto the trucks by the zombies and driven to the outskirts, but Zhao Lin was a human and who knows what Dad planned to do with her.
Could he intend to take Zhao Lin along?
However, given that woman’s current personality, she probably wouldn’t easily leave with Dad.
Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but recall, a few days ago Zhao Lin discovered living in a zombie nest and wasn’t fatally harmed, becoming even bolder.
She even demanded Dad deliver some food to the survivors at the police station...
This woman was deep in the tiger’s den, with her life hanging by a thread, yet still worried about strangers, truly deserving of the name "saint."
Ji Ruxue felt a bit helpless towards Zhao Lin, no wonder in the past life Zhao Lin could die so many times in the early apocalypse.
With Zhao Lin’s current personality, even nine lives might not be enough in the apocalypse.
"Even in this situation, this woman can’t stop worrying about the police station’s survivors; she’s unlikely to leave Jianghai City with Dad easily."
"I don’t know where this person gets so much sense of responsibility, after being betrayed by those survivors so many times, she still thinks of them."
Ji Ruxue was very concerned about the Nine Deaths Demon Police, as they could likely become a strong force in the Emperor Realm in the future.
If Ji Ruxue could bring them in as allies, it would become a great help in the future.
But Zhao Lin is a woman with a big chest and little brain, stubbornly clinging to her beliefs.
Convincing her to give up on those survivors and escape with us is unlikely to be easy.
The most troublesome part is that Zhao Lin can’t be killed or allowed to commit suicide.
After thinking it over, Ji Ruxue decided to speak with Dad straightforwardly.
When Lu Chuan returned to the seventh floor, the little one approached him immediately.
Ji Ruxue looked at him with innocent big eyes and curiously asked, "Dad, why do you drive so many trucks to the entrance every day?"
Faced with the little one’s inquiry, Lu Chuan did not hide the truth.
Since they would be moving soon, there was no way to hide it, so Lu Chuan told the little one directly.
Taking a pen and paper, Lu Chuan gently wrote, "Little Qiqi, Dad is planning to move with you to a new place, and these trucks will be used to transport supplies."
After all, we have so many supplies in the building; we can’t waste them.
Dad has chosen a new home at a farm in the suburbs where you can see the outside scenery every day.
Little Qiqi, would you be willing to leave here with Dad?"
Lu Chuan asked proactively after some thought.
After all, Little Qiqi now had her own opinions, and he wanted to consider her input.
Ji Ruxue had no objections to this and nodded with a smile, "Sure, wherever Dad goes, I go!"
I’ve grown up without seeing what the outside world looks like."
When Lu Chuan heard this from Little Qiqi, a warm feeling surged in his heart, filling him with joy.
It seemed that the time he spent doting on his beloved daughter was not in vain.
That the little one was so willing to change her environment surprised Lu Chuan greatly.
After all, children of this age tend to fear the unknown and become attached to familiar places.
The little one’s willingness to leave with him indicated that she valued him as her dad greatly.
Ji Ruxue then posed her concern, "But what about Zhao Lin downstairs? Dad, are you planning to take her too?"
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan nodded immediately.
He wrote, "Of course, this woman is Dad’s pet, so naturally, she must be taken along."
Other things can be temporarily left behind, but definitely not Zhao Lin.
Lu Chuan wouldn’t feel secure letting this woman go.
After dying, this woman can resurrect, with her strength doubling.
If she escaped his control, who knows what she might become.
Having crushed her legs and imprisoned her for so long.
If this woman returns to her previous state, who knows how she might seek revenge on him.
Lu Chuan did not want to burden himself with so much trouble.
Since his moving to Qingshui Farm was to avoid too much contact with humans.
If Zhao Lin were let go, who can say if she would come back with other human survivors for revenge.
Releasing the tiger back to the mountain is something Lu Chuan absolutely wouldn’t do.
Keeping her by his side is the best method.
"But Dad, will she be willing to go with us?"
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan felt a cold chuckle within.
What if Zhao Lin wasn’t willing, given her current condition, what choice did she have?
A cold gleam flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
This involves the safety of himself and Little Qiqi, with no room for error.
If Zhao Lin refused to leave, he would break her arms and legs and take her by force!
Regarding those survivors Zhao Lin worried about, what concern was it to a zombie like him?
But soon, Lu Chuan’s expression turned grave again.
"Almost forgot this woman’s evolutionary ability.
"What if she commits suicide if taken by force?"
Thinking of this left Lu Chuan exasperated.
He couldn’t understand why such a heaven-defying ability existed.
Dying and coming back to life isn’t enough; she even becomes stronger!
This heaven-defying ability paired with Zhao Lin’s equally heaven-defying personality made for a truly abstract combination...
Lu Chuan’s principle was always that any threat to him and Little Qiqi must be rooted out.
Yet, he was helpless with Zhao Lin.
Zhao Lin’s talent ability left him unable to kill nor release her.
This thought only made Lu Chuan feel vexed.
This woman is truly a headache!
PS: I forgot to say, Happy New Year to all readers, wishing you a prosperous Year of the Snake, good health, and may all your wishes come true!

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Little Qiqi, I Will Definitely Take You Away From Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 111: Little Qiqi, I Will Definitely Take You Away From Here!
When it comes to murder, Lu Chuan admits he no longer has any psychological burden.
When it’s time to kill, he’ll definitely not soften his heart.
But facing Zhao Lin, who possesses the ability to come back to life, truly makes him feel a bit troubled.
A thought flickered through Lu Chuan’s eyes; before this, he could use the people at the police station to threaten Zhao Lin, deterring her from considering suicide.
However, once he leaves Jianghai City’s downtown, the humans from the police station can no longer be used to threaten Zhao Lin.
He can’t kill her, nor can he set her free. Lu Chuan is momentarily unsure how to deal with the situation.
Rubbing his forehead, after contemplating for a moment, Lu Chuan finally made a decision.
"Forget it, I’m planning to leave here anyway. Qingshui Farm is not close to this place, maybe in the future, we won’t intersect again."
"Since that’s the case, might as well just let her go directly."
Since he doesn’t know how to deal with this woman.
Simply let her leave, then Lu Chuan himself would have less trouble.
During this period, Little Qiqi often ran downstairs to chat with Zhao Lin; the two women, one big and one small, got along quite well.
In this wretched apocalyptic world, finding someone who doesn’t have bad intentions and is willing to interact with Little Qiqi is indeed difficult.
Even though Zhao Lin’s brain isn’t very functional, she truly has a kind heart, so Lu Chuan isn’t too worried about letting Little Qiqi chat with Zhao Lin.
Since a decision has been made, considering the relationship between Little Qiqi and Zhao Lin.
Lu Chuan decided to inform the little one about it.
After all, Zhao Lin is currently considered Little Qiqi’s first friend, and Lu Chuan is prepared to give them some time for a farewell.
In any case, this also counts as Little Qiqi’s first separation since she has memories of coming to this world.
Can’t leave any regrets in the little one’s heart.
Afterwards, Lu Chuan found Little Qiqi and handed her the prepared note.
Seeing the note that her father has already made a decision, Ji Ruxue nodded thoughtfully.
She wasn’t surprised at Lu Chuan’s decision.
After all, her father wasn’t just any ordinary zombie but retained human intelligence.
Her father already knows about Zhao Lin’s resurrection ability; if she’s killed, she would revive and become stronger.
Thus, there’s no way to get rid of Zhao Lin completely.
Given this woman’s character, troubles would keep coming.
And her father isn’t foolish enough to bring upon himself such a big trouble unnecessarily.
Trying to forcibly take Zhao Lin away is even more difficult.
From her father’s perspective, since they’re leaving here anyway, it’s better to just send Zhao Lin away, never seeing each other again and saving a lot of trouble.
......
Fifth floor.
"Little Qiqi, did your father agree to my previous request?"
Seeing Ji Ruxue’s arrival, Zhao Lin hurriedly asked with eagerness.
Staying in a room filled with so many supplies every day, Zhao Lin might be eating her fill, but there’s a tinge of guilt in her heart.
All this time, she couldn’t put those survivors in the police station out of her mind.
Thinking about many survivors starving daily while she eats and drinks well.
It makes Zhao Lin feel very uneasy.
"Little Qiqi, if your dad doesn’t agree, I... I’ll really commit suicide!"
Zhao Lin was extremely anxious inside.
Now, the supplies near the police station are getting scarcer and scarcer.
Last time when she went out, she only managed to collect a few bottles of water and a piece of bread, which wasn’t even enough for her.
Moreover, she’s the only evolver in the police station now, and she’s imprisoned here.
The issue is whether the survivors in the police station can survive in this zombie-ridden apocalyptic world, let alone venture out to find supplies.
Thinking of this, Zhao Lin looked at Ji Ruxue anxiously.
She’s genuinely worried that the survivors at the police station might have starved to death.
Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly in her heart.
Zhao Lin asks the same question every time they meet these days.
Even when her own life hangs by a thread, she constantly worries about those survivors in the police station.
This woman is hopeless...
Sighing, Ji Ruxue said helplessly: "My dad has decided to let you leave here."
"What? What did you say?!"
Zhao Lin widened her eyes, utterly incredulous.
She even suspected whether she was hallucinating.
Being imprisoned by the Corpse King, Zhao Lin almost gave up the hope of ever escaping.
Unexpectedly, she heard news of being able to leave.
In disbelief, she looked at Ji Ruxue, seeing her nod again.
Ji Ruxue’s heart felt like a huge stone suspended in the air had landed, and she couldn’t suppress the smile on her face.
"Um... if I can leave, can I take some food with me?"
"I want to bring it to those folks at the police station; collecting supplies in the apocalypse is becoming increasingly difficult, and if there’s nothing left, they might die of starvation..."
Zhao Lin felt a bit embarrassed but still plucked up the courage to ask.
She couldn’t stop worrying about the survivors in the police station.
As a Level-two Evolver, Zhao Lin’s physical recovery speed is fairly fast.
Though her legs, previously crushed by ’Da Pang,’ haven’t fully healed.
But under Lu Chuan’s imprisonment, she has eaten well and can walk, albeit with a limping gait.
Ji Ruxue felt speechless hearing this woman...
She’s bound for trouble!
"Alright, I’ll agree on my dad’s behalf; you can carry some food out of here."
Anyway, food here is stocked up, and dad couldn’t take them all.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin was overjoyed; she seriously doubted whether she was dreaming, with so many good things happening today!
Ji Ruxue suddenly spoke: "Do you remember our previous agreement?"
Upon hearing her words, Zhao Lin recalled their earlier pact.
Looking at the innocent and kind-hearted Little Qiqi, her gaze shifted to firm determination.
She secretly made a promise in her heart.
Little Qiqi, rest assured.
I will definitely take you away, to a place where humans truly belong!
Then Ji Ruxue winked at Zhao Lin, and they skillfully blocked the view of ’Lightning One.’
Afterwards, Ji Ruxue stealthily slipped a tiny ball of paper into Zhao Lin’s hand.
Zhao Lin immediately understood and didn’t unwrap it there; she held it tightly in her palm and tucked it into her pocket.
Lu Chuan, through ’Lightning One,’ witnessed Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin’s farewell, then controlled ’Lightning One’ to swiftly carry Zhao Lin to the entrance of the district.
’Lightning One’ carried a backpack in another hand, filled with food Zhao Lin planned to bring back to the police station.
Leaving the gate of Sunshine District, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but glance back at Er Pang stationed at the entrance, secretly making up her mind.
Little Qiqi, wait for me, I will definitely come back!
After walking far, reaching a secluded corner, Zhao Lin finally opened Ji Ruxue’s little ball of paper, which only had four words written on it: Qingshui Farm.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: The Second Evolved Corpse Puppet at Stage 2!
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 112: The Second Evolved Corpse Puppet at Stage 2!
Lu Chuan stood upstairs, watching Zhao Lin limping away from the gate in the distance.
"I hope we never meet again."
This woman is really a problem.
She can’t be killed, nor can she be let go.
If it weren’t for the fact that he was moving now, Lu Chuan would never have let her go.
But since he didn’t plan to live around here anymore, in such a chaotic post-apocalyptic world, Lu Chuan believed it would be hard to meet this woman again.
It would be best never to see her again!
As for Zhao Lin’s current limping state, whether she can make it back to the police station alive is no longer Lu Chuan’s concern.
Allowing Zhao Lin to leave alive is already a great mercy from him.
Anyway, this woman has powers defying heaven, even if she dies, she’ll be able to resurrect.
"Finally got rid of this ticking time bomb, now I can wholeheartedly search for Evolved Zombies."
Now that he was about to leave Jianghai City, Lu Chuan planned to find the whereabouts of other Evolved Zombies as much as possible during this time.
Strengthening himself as much as possible before leaving to reduce the risks during the moving process.
Suddenly, Lu Chuan felt something and was immediately overjoyed.
Speak of the devil, and he shall appear!
One of his Corpse Puppets had discovered the whereabouts of an Evolved Zombie.
"That stupid woman really is a jinx. Just as she left, there was immediately good news!"
Lu Chuan didn’t expect such a coincidence, just chased Zhao Lin away and on the other side, a new Evolved Zombie was discovered.
Having searched for so many days, Lu Chuan finally had a trace of an Evolved Zombie, and immediately controlled the Corpse Puppet to go there.
However, to be safe, Lu Chuan arranged for ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning One’ to stay in Building Five to protect Little Qiqi.
Lu Chuan himself, with other zombies, rushed towards the newly discovered Evolved Zombie.
Has Dad made a new discovery again?
Ji Ruxue stood upstairs, quickly noticing the movements of all the zombies in the community.
They were now quickly heading out under her father’s lead.
Hurriedly running to the door, Ji Ruxue saw that ’Lightning One’, which Lu Chuan had originally arranged to guard Zhao Lin on the fifth floor, was now arranged to guard the door for her.
Ji Ruxue felt warmth and was touched in her heart.
Dad really can’t stop worrying about me all the time.
"But Dad, you’re underestimating me a bit; with my current strength, there’s probably no one who can hurt me."
Ji Ruxue had now broken through to the third stage, becoming a genuine third-stage Evolver.
And her two Talent Abilities were extremely powerful.
Not to mention Jianghai City, even looking at the entire world, Ji Ruxue now could be considered one of the top human experts.
At least currently in Jianghai City, there’s absolutely nothing that could injure Ji Ruxue.
However, this feeling of being constantly cared for and remembered by Dad was something Ji Ruxue had never experienced before.
A soft expression appeared in Ji Ruxue’s eyes.
In her past life, she struggled non-stop amidst various life and death crises, facing all kinds of conspiracies, plots, and difficulties.
Ji Ruxue still remembered that, in her past life, even when sleeping at night, she had to keep one eye open and be constantly on guard against potential threats.
Even when she was in the Survivor Base of humanity at that time, she had to be constantly wary of all sorts of human conspiracies and plots.
Although she became the Empress of humans in her past life, with unmatched strength and status.
To Ji Ruxue, however, such a life was far less than staying beside her Dad now.
No family love or care whatsoever, even if possessing great strength, was nothing but loneliness.
After being reborn, Ji Ruxue always lived under the protection of her zombie father’s wings.
Although Ji Ruxue’s wings were gradually growing strong nowadays, Dad’s care for her had never lessened.
Seeing the two Evolved Zombies left in Building Five to protect herself, Ji Ruxue felt very fortunate.
To others, zombies are very terrifying existences,
But in Ji Ruxue’s eyes, these zombies are all expressions of Dad’s love for her.
It’s really nice to be constantly protected.
...
Roar!
At this moment, in Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet vision, a human was frantically fleeing on the street.
Behind him was a terrifying second-stage Tyrant Zombie.
The attack power of this Tyrant Zombie was extremely powerful, and the many vehicles along the way were all being overturned.
The terrifying claws created gashes along the ground with every swing, and if the person being pursued by the zombie was not quick, they would have already been torn apart.
The Tyrant Zombie, enraged by its unsuccessful attacks, became increasingly furious, directly grabbing a small car and throwing it at the person ahead.
Hearing the whistling sound behind him, the person did a quick roll and deftly avoided the smashing car.
But seeing the car smashed flat by the Tyrant Zombie, the face of the human desperately escaping turned deathly pale with fear.
They did not expect the zombie they encountered this time to be so terrifying; while their heart was filled with shock, their feet dared not slow down.
Because the claws of the second-stage Tyrant Zombie were about to reach him, slowing down would mean losing his head.
The survivor being chased by the Tyrant Zombie was even more terrified at this sight.
But it seemed as if a certain potential had been unleashed, allowing him to once again narrowly escape the Tyrant Zombie’s attack.
The survivor seemed to notice the Tyrant Zombie’s large body as a weakness and directly rushed into the twisting and turning alleys.
As the survivor entered a narrow passage between the buildings, the second-stage Tyrant Zombie got stuck between the close walls, unable to move.
"Roar!"
The Tyrant Zombie kept swinging its claws, causing the wall coverings to fall off continuously, but it couldn’t do anything to the human in front of it.
When Lu Chuan arrived here, he saw the Tyrant Zombie’s half-body stuck in the wall crack, swinging its arms wildly forward.
And deep within the passage of these two buildings, a human was trembling with fear, bloodless and legs shaking uncontrollably.
Seeing the state of the Tyrant Zombie, Lu Chuan shook his head helplessly.
This big guy was the dumbest zombie he’d encountered.
Without hesitation, Lu Chuan successfully took control of it with his Spiritual Power.
Then Lu Chuan controlled ’Er Pang’ to go forward, forcibly pulling out the Tyrant Zombie stuck between the two walls with a mighty pull, tearing off pieces of the wall in the process.
The human hiding in the alley did not know what was happening outside, only seeing the Tyrant Zombie seeming to retreat after failing to catch him.
Feeling as if he had narrowly escaped death, he went limp on the ground, breathing heavily.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 114: Officer Zhao, You’re a Good Person!
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 114: Officer Zhao, You’re a Good Person!
After leaving the Sunshine District, Zhao Lin soon encountered many wandering zombies.
Looking at the numerous zombies ahead, Zhao Lin’s brows knitted tightly.
If she were in her prime, she naturally wouldn’t fear them.
But the problem was that her legs, which had been broken, hadn’t fully healed yet.
Now she limped as she walked, and after a long time on the road, Zhao Lin could even feel the pain coming from her legs.
She hadn’t walked long before she was already panting heavily.
"Damn Corpse King, one day I’ll definitely get my revenge on you!" Zhao Lin cursed angrily in her heart.
Had it not been for the Corpse King, she wouldn’t be in this situation...
Using the moonlight above, Zhao Lin had no choice but to take a longer detour to avoid the zombies on the street.
This made her, already limping, use up even more energy after the detour.
At the same time, she had to continuously kill the pursuing zombies on the way back.
By the time Zhao Lin reached the police station, it was already daytime, and her clothes were soaked in cold sweat.
As a second-tier Evolver, Zhao Lin had taken an entire night to cover just a few kilometers.
At this moment, her pretty face was extremely pale, and her lips had lost their color.
However, seeing the police station, Zhao Lin thought of the survivors’ happy expressions upon seeing her bring back so many supplies, and felt that everything she had done was worth it.
As a police officer, protecting the lives and safety of ordinary people had always been Zhao Lin’s principle.
Even now, in the apocalypse, Zhao Lin still adhered to her responsibilities.
Because of her legs, Zhao Lin was a bit clumsy when climbing over the police station wall, her movements attracting the attention of the remaining survivors in the station.
The survivor on lookout at the gate was instantly surprised upon discovering Zhao Lin’s return.
"Officer Zhao?! You’re... you’re alive?!"
For some reason, the survivor’s tone was mixed with some panic facing the suddenly returned Zhao Lin.
His voice trembled slightly for a moment, and he didn’t dare to look Zhao Lin in the eye.
But having narrowly escaped the Corpse King, Zhao Lin, who had painstakingly brought supplies back to the police station, didn’t notice these details at all.
Upon learning of Zhao Lin’s return, the survivors inside the station all rushed out, each looking at Zhao Lin with a strange gaze.
Back inside the station, Zhao Lin found that everyone seemed to have become silent and reserved.
Each sat in place without moving much, and even when she approached, they all subconsciously retreated.
And since she came in, these people were unwilling to talk to her voluntarily and seemed to be deliberately avoiding her gaze.
Zhao Lin didn’t care much about it and directly put her large backpack in the room, emptying out all the supplies inside.
There were bread, mineral water, biscuits, even beef jerky, and chocolate, all items that could replenish energy in the apocalypse.
Upon seeing this heap of supplies, the survivors who deliberately kept their distance from Zhao Lin suddenly revealed a hint of greed in their eyes, instinctively gathering towards Zhao Lin.
"Strange, where are Old Liu and the others?"
Looking around the station, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but feel puzzled.
Only now did Zhao Lin realize that not only her colleagues, but even the survivors in the police station were much fewer than when she left.
According to the usual regulations of the officers, even when going out, some would be left to ensure the station’s safety, but now there wasn’t a single person.
"Where did everyone else go?" Zhao Lin asked, puzzled.
Upon hearing Zhao Lin’s words, the few people around immediately started hemming and hawing, unable to give a clear answer after speaking for a while, with each one seeming to deliberately avoid Zhao Lin.
"Officer Zhao, here’s the thing..."
"They’ve all gone out to search for supplies, because there’s not much left in the station, and without tangible materials, people can’t survive."
Hearing their explanation, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but shake her head and smile bitterly.
The food around here had all been moved to the Sunshine District by the Corpse King; it would be a miracle if they found anything.
Seeing everyone grabbing food and devouring it ravenously, Zhao Lin revealed a genuine smile.
Everyone must have been starving for so long without supplies. Watching them eat the food she brought back, Zhao Lin felt a great sense of accomplishment in her heart.
Her perseverance during this time hadn’t been in vain.
After returning to the familiar police station, the exhaustion from the journey finally overwhelmed Zhao Lin, and she found a bed and fell into a deep sleep.
In her dreams, Zhao Lin vaguely heard the sound of sharpening knives.
She opened her eyes in confusion, only to find herself already tied up!
And in front of her were those survivors who had just eaten the supplies she brought back, and they had started a bonfire inside the police station.
They were sharpening knives while glaring at her viciously, their eyes like wolves staring at their prey on the prairie.
"What are you trying to do? Why did you tie me up? Let me go immediately!"
Zhao Lin looked at them in disbelief, never expecting to end up like this after going through so much trouble to bring food back for them.
"Sorry, Officer Zhao, the food you brought back isn’t enough; now there’s no food, and we need to survive!"
Upon hearing these words, Zhao Lin was initially stunned, and then she felt a chill run down her spine.
The burning bonfire, the sharpened knives, herself tied up, and the missing people...
Could it be...
"What did you do to them? Where are they?!"
"Sorry, Officer Zhao, the food is too scarce. We originally only planned to target the elderly and children because they are burdens in this apocalypse."
"But your colleagues were very stubborn, unwilling to eat with us, and we had no choice but to wait until they were asleep and turn them into food too!"
Zhao Lin’s mind went blank.
She couldn’t imagine that the survivors she had rescued had turned into demons in just a few days.
"Bastards! You’re no different from those zombies!"
"We risked our lives to save you, yet you’re so ungrateful?!"
Thud!
Before Zhao Lin could finish speaking, the survivors came over, one after another, swinging their sharp knives at her.
Zhao Lin felt her strength rapidly draining from her body, and the physical pain paled in comparison to the pain in her heart.
One young survivor, holding a dagger, came up to Zhao Lin, with tears streaming down his guilt-ridden face: "I’m sorry, Officer Zhao, you are a good person."
Before losing consciousness, Zhao Lin only felt an overwhelming sense of irony upon hearing these words.
"Good person... ha ha, I am a good..."

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 115: Leaving Sunshine District!
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 115: Leaving Sunshine District!
The bonfire crackled inside the police station, and under the illumination of the firelight, the originally solemn and somber police station now appeared incredibly eerie and terrifying.
At this moment, under these flames, one could see blood and grease everywhere around, the very places where the survivors had dismembered the bodies.
As for the bed where Zhao Lin originally lay, there was only a pool of blood left along with cut ropes and clothes, along with the remaining corpses and bones by the bonfire.
After eating and drinking their fill, these survivors, who had now turned into cannibals, all fell into a deep sleep.
The last survivor, who had walked up to Zhao Lin and stabbed the dagger into Zhao Lin’s body, slowly sat up from the bed at this moment.
His body was trembling non-stop, tears and snot continuously streaming down.
This young man surveyed the room’s occupants and saw that none were awake before cautiously approaching the bonfire.
He picked up a piece of clothing and wrapped all of Zhao Lin’s bones together, then cautiously left the room.
Holding Zhao Lin’s remains, he made his way to a greenbelt area within the police station’s courtyard, dug a pit with his hands, and buried Zhao Lin’s bones there.
Looking at Zhao Lin’s remains, his body began to tremble uncontrollably.
"I’m sorry, Officer Zhao, don’t blame me, if you must, blame them, they are a bunch of demons!"
His body continued to shake as he spoke.
"Officer Liu and the others were all killed in their sleep one after another because they refused to go along with these guys."
"I... I was forced, if I didn’t eat, they would have eaten me too!"
"I had no choice, I had no choice! I’m just trying to survive!"
This young man felt a twinge of guilt for Zhao Lin, and he sobbed continuously for a while.
After speaking, perhaps out of guilt or perhaps out of fear, he knelt down and kowtowed several times to Zhao Lin’s remains.
...
At the entrance of the Sunshine District, over a hundred figures had gathered.
Each of these figures wore fully enclosed motorcycle helmets, holding either a baseball bat, a fire axe, or even a kitchen knife or rebar.
If someone unaware of the situation saw this, they might think it was a scene from a sequel of a gangster movie.
In fact, these were all Corpse Puppets controlled by Lu Chuan.
After breaking through to the third stage, Lu Chuan could control as many as a hundred ordinary Corpse Puppets.
Over this period of accumulation, Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet team had grown into a small-scale zombie horde.
Although these were ordinary zombies, the shock of so many zombies gathered together was not insignificant.
At the entrance of Building No. 5 in the Sunshine District, Lu Chuan walked out from the building holding Ji Ruxue, who was wearing a princess dress.
Looking at the familiar surroundings of the district, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but feel a little sentimental.
Since arriving in this post-apocalyptic world, he initially lived a muddle-headed life alone in a shop, subsisting on frozen meat in a human-ghost existence.
It wasn’t until he met Little Qiqi that he finally found a new goal and hope in life.
This Sunshine District was the new home for the two of them, and it was living on the seventh floor that inspired the name Qiqi for the little one.
There were many memories of the two here during this time.
Lu Chuan hadn’t realized that, unknowingly, he and Little Qi had been living in the Sunshine District for such a long time.
In the Sunshine District, he evolved from an ordinary zombie into an Evolved Zombie, advancing step by step.
With the powerful strength he now possessed, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but marvel at how fast time flies.
The first time they met, Little Qiqi could only lie in the crib unable to move; now, the little one could read, write, and had no problem walking or talking.
Although the Sunshine District in front of him was an old community and appeared even more desolate after the apocalypse, Lu Chuan still felt deeply reluctant.
Because this was the first home he and Little Qiqi had in this world.
Looking down at Little Qiqi’s bright smile and gleaming eyes, a smile curved on Lu Chuan’s lips.
Then he controlled the Corpse Puppets to move various supplies from Building No. 5 to the big truck at the entrance of the district.
Ji Ruxue stood by watching these zombies move the supplies around the community like ants, and couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Daddy really moved all the nearby supplies, filling an entire building!"
Lu Chuan had arrived with five large trucks days in advance to transport these supplies.
He had collected supplies from an entire building and filled all five trucks.
Seeing these ample supplies, Lu Chuan felt satisfied and got in the last truck with Ji Ruxue.
After breaking through to the third stage, Lu Chuan’s Spiritual Power had seen a leap compared to before.
For others, multitasking might be extremely difficult, but Lu Chuan, having always tried to control various Corpse Puppets simultaneously, found multitasking a piece of cake.
Lu Chuan sat in the last truck, simultaneously controlling five Corpse Puppets at the wheel, driving each one towards Qingshui Farm on the outskirts.
Seeing her father in such a powerful scene, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but gasp in amazement.
"I really can’t believe that, unknowingly, Dad’s strength has grown to this level!"
Simultaneously controlling five Corpse Puppets to drive and transport supplies was probably something only a Corpse King retaining human consciousness like Dad could accomplish.
Ji Ruxue smiled slightly, feeling a warm surge pass through her heart.
The supplies Dad was transporting were all exclusively for her.
They were either various human foods or baby products, which zombies didn’t need at all.
Ji Ruxue understood that this was because Dad was worried there wouldn’t be enough supplies for her growth after reaching Qingshui Farm.
Looking up at Lu Chuan, Ji Ruxue’s watery eyes were filled with emotion.
Besides these five speeding trucks, Lu Chuan’s zombie army was relentlessly following behind the vehicles.
Sitting in the truck, Lu Chuan looked at the rapidly retreating scenery around him and the closely following zombie army in the rearview mirror, feeling an overwhelming sense of grandeur.
"Tsk tsk tsk, I now have the demeanor of an ancient emperor on a parade!"
"No wonder those with great ambitions in ancient times wanted to build an empire of their own; this feeling is truly extraordinary!"
The apocalypse had only begun a little over two months, yet he already commanded such a zombie army.
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but fantasize that as his power continued to grow, the number of zombies following him would also increase, and by then, the scale of his zombie horde would be even more massive!

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 116: Oh My God! Zombies Can Drive Now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 116: Oh My God! Zombies Can Drive Now?
On the long-silent streets of Jianghai City, the long-lost sound of car engines suddenly echoed.
It’s been nearly three months since the apocalypse began, and almost all survivors in Jianghai City were gone within the first few days of the zombie crisis outbreak.
So much time has passed that there are no longer any living people visible on the streets, only various scrapped cars and torn-apart bodies.
As for the car engine sounds, they stopped altogether a week after the apocalypse started.
