But now, in this desolate and rundown city, the loud noise of cars is reverberating.
Vroom vroom vroom!
A convoy of five large trucks is speeding along the streets, pursued by a horde of zombies.
These zombies behave very strangely. Unlike those that usually stagger on the streets, each is holding a weapon and wearing a helmet.
Upon closer inspection, you can see that zombies are also sitting in the driver’s seats of the trucks!
Even when the convoy encounters obstacles, these zombies actively run ahead to help clear the way!
Though they are merely a bunch of mindless zombies with only a thirst for blood, now they appear well-organized.
Looking at the scenery swiftly retreating past the window, Lu Chuan’s mind was filled with many thoughts.
He had been holding out in the Sunshine District for more than two months and wasn’t clear on what was happening outside.
While such a grand approach might attract some attention, Lu Chuan didn’t care.
Having reached the third tier and accompanied by many evolved zombies and corpse puppets, Lu Chuan didn’t believe anyone in Jianghai City could pose a threat to him now.
Looking at Little Qiqi sitting by the window, a smile spread across Lu Chuan’s face, and he picked up pen and paper.
"Little Qiqi, if you’re tired, take a nap."
Ji Ruxue smiled sweetly at Lu Chuan after reading.
"Dad, I’m not sleepy."
After her rebirth, this was Ji Ruxue’s first time really looking at the outside world.
Since gaining consciousness, she had lived in the bedroom of Sunshine District, which was relatively closed.
Even after leaving Building No. 5, she only moved within the district.
This was her first time sitting in a car, admiring the city scenery.
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but smile at the adorable sight, then kept switching his perspective among the corpse puppets to observe the surroundings.
Since Lu Chuan was simultaneously controlling five corpse puppets to drive, he dared not increase the speed excessively, to avoid any unforeseen incidents that couldn’t be controlled in time.
Because the truck speed wasn’t too fast and, being in the city, Lu Chuan was uncertain about what might happen, he positioned several agile zombies atop the trucks.
Should anything unexpected occur, these agile zombies could immediately act.
The agile zombies, evolved in speed and strength surpassing regular zombies, were perfect for guarding the convoy.
Thus, Lu Chuan’s convoy slowly moved out of the Sunshine District.
Lu Chuan manipulated the corpse puppets while watching the map.
At the current convoy speed, they were unlikely to reach Qingshui Farm on the outskirts until nightfall.
The convoy made quite a commotion in the Jianghai City District, attracting many zombies with its loud noise.
However, under the evolved zombies’ pressure, the regular zombies seemed like headless flies desperately trying to evade.
Those unable to dodge were mercilessly crushed by the cars.
...
A survivor searching for supplies in a shop suddenly froze in place.
"Am I hallucinating from hunger? It sounds like there’s a car engine!"
This shop survivor, about thirty-years-old, with a strong build, had awakened the giant strength Evolver ability.
Originally, he lived fairly comfortably in the apocalypse with his evolved abilities.
However, with increasingly scarce supplies, even Evolvers had to constantly search for resources in shops.
Vroom vroom vroom!
The loud noises grew nearer.
"Holy crap! It’s not a hallucination! There’s really a car?!"
"Could it be the army has come?!"
Realizing a large convoy was passing nearby, the survivor became extremely excited, even tossing aside the bottle of mineral water he had just found.
He quickly ran to the shop window to look outside, and sure enough, saw a large convoy in the distance.
The five heavy trucks in the lead were plowing through abandoned cars, crushing wandering zombies into a bloody pulp.
Seeing this, the survivor was overjoyed, ready to rush out and join the convoy.
As his supplies dwindled, he hoped to join a survivor team.
Driving five heavy trucks at high speed in the post-apocalyptic city undoubtedly meant a powerful survivor team.
Just as the survivor was about to rush out, he keenly noticed that those following the trucks weren’t human soldiers!
"Wait... could they all be zombies?!"
The action of opening the door froze in place as he couldn’t believe his eyes.
There were over a hundred zombies following the trucks, seemingly resembling humans.
But some zombies bore visible bite marks, which weren’t wounds a normal human would have.
There was only one possibility: all those following the trucks were zombies!
As Lu Chuan’s convoy approached, the Evolver looked into the trucks, only to see a sight he’d never forget.
In the driver’s seats of those five trucks sat menacing, terrifying zombies!
"Am I hallucinating?! Zombies can drive trucks now?!"
Watching Lu Chuan’s convoy drive far away, the survivor finally realized it wasn’t a human convoy but a zombie convoy!
Gulp, gulp, gulp.
The Evolver in the shop chugged several gulps of water to calm his excited emotions.
If not for the convoy’s loud noise and the trail of debris left behind, he would’ve suspected he was hallucinating from hunger.
The zombie outbreak was already beyond comprehension, but zombies driving trucks was an extraordinary sight.
Survivors noticing Lu Chuan’s convoy along the way felt their scalps tingle.

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 117: Encounter with the Mutated Golden Python
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 117: Encounter with the Mutated Golden Python
Lu Chuan focused on controlling the zombies driving, unaware of the immense shock his zombie convoy brought to the survivors in Jianghai City’s downtown.
A group of zombies acting purposefully and organized, even driving human vehicles, was far more terrifying to survivors than a mere horde.
After all, even a gathered horde of zombies seems to survivors no more than a group of mindless zombies.
But when these zombies can use weapons and drive human vehicles, it changes everything.
The five heavy trucks and the zombies in pursuit behind them created quite a commotion in the silent downtown.
Being in the city center, they attracted quite a number of wandering zombies.
However, there were quite a few evolved zombies in Lu Chuan’s convoy, and their powerful presence intimidated ordinary zombies from coming close; any unlucky ones that ran into the street got crushed.
Ordinary zombies were scared off, but this time some evolved zombies were attracted over.
Among them were agile types and tank-type zombies; these evolved zombies, eager to obtain crystal cores, were not afraid to face the convoy.
Lu Chuan immediately embraced these incoming evolved zombies, using his spiritual power to turn them into part of his corpse puppet army.
Along the way, not only did Lu Chuan’s corpse puppet army not diminish, but it grew with a few more capable generals.
However, Lu Chuan felt a bit disappointed as all the evolved zombies he encountered were only first-tier; so far, no new second-tier evolved zombies had appeared.
"How long until I can be like Jiang Taigong, fishing with willing catch; when can I attract a few second-tier evolved zombies for me to control?"
Lu Chuan looked out the window and sighed helplessly.
The combat prowess of second-tier evolved zombies was significantly stronger than first-tier ones; his spiritual power had increased enough to control several second-tier evolved zombies.
Suddenly, Lu Chuan’s mind stirred.
The corpse puppet at the front of the convoy suddenly noticed something had changed ahead.
The wide street was suddenly blocked by something unknown, causing Lu Chuan to feel puzzled and quickly controlled the corpse puppet to slow down and stop.
"What’s going on here? Could it be that an isolation wall was established after the apocalypse?"
Through the corpse puppet’s perspective, Lu Chuan looked ahead and found a golden high wall, several meters tall, blocking the entire street.
Out of curiosity, Lu Chuan controlled two ordinary corpse puppets, holding baseball bats, to explore forward.
As the corpse puppets kept advancing, Lu Chuan realized that this was no human-built isolation wall.
The vast expanse of gold in front was clearly scales from a reptile!
Lu Chuan was stunned; he had never imagined such a large reptile could exist in the world—scenes like this typically only appear in movies!
Lu Chuan felt a shock, quickly controlling the corpse puppets to retreat.
Hiss~
A hissing sound rang out, and the gigantic golden body before him began to move; the two scouting corpse puppets were swallowed whole!
The enormous creature sprawled on the street finally revealed its true form—a giant python with a golden body!
But this python was beyond Lu Chuan’s previous understanding; the enormous monster had scales of pure gold, making anyone feel chills just by looking at it from afar.
Especially with its exaggerated length of twenty meters, equivalent to the length of two of Lu Chuan’s trucks; two corpse puppets swallowed whole!
As the python moved, cracks appeared on the cement road, and the cars and street lamps along the way were smashed away; the power of this massive golden python was extremely terrifying.
A giant beast of this size appearing in a modern city shocked Lu Chuan.
He quickly took out a map to check and found that there was a large zoo in Jianghai City nearby, and without a doubt, this golden python had mutated and escaped from the zoo.
"Oh my, this mutated fierce beast seems even fiercer than the evolved zombies!"
Just as Lu Chuan was pondering, the second-tier golden python charged at the convoy from the street like lightning, its hiss making one’s heart tremble.
Lu Chuan’s pupils contracted, and he quickly controlled the evolved zombies to advance.
Er Pang stood at the forefront, with Da Pang leading a few tank-type zombies distributed on both sides.
Several agile zombies brandished steel knives, continuously leaping on the rooftops of the vehicles, quickly approaching the middle section of the mutated golden python’s body.
The speed of the mutated giant python was incredibly fast, crossing a distance of over two hundred meters in just a few seconds.
Er Pang swung the steel rod weighing over a ton with force, smashing it towards the mutated giant python’s head.
The mutated giant python attempted to dodge, but Da Pang and the other tank-type zombies were prepared in defensive postures on both sides.
Bang bang bang!
Even with defense postures, the first-tier tank zombies were smashed away by the second-tier mutated golden python, flying like cannonballs in all directions.
However, with these first-tier tank zombies delaying, Er Pang’s attack successfully landed on the mutated giant python.
The iron bar weighing over a ton struck the massive python’s body, even this enormous beast couldn’t withstand it for a moment.
As the mutated giant python fell into a stalemate, numerous agile zombies swiftly closed in, wielding pairs of steel knives, slashing furiously, leaving scars on the python’s body.
However, the python’s body was too large, and the first-tier agile zombies’ attacks made little impact.
Just as the mutated giant python was about to regain consciousness, suddenly a massive figure fell from a high-rise building, its terrifying blade stabbed straight into the python’s crucial point.
The great wound exposed large scales, and the golden python was ripped open—a massive wound, splattering blood everywhere.
Among the zombies now, purely in terms of attack power, the second-tier tyrant zombie was undoubtedly the strongest.
Its claws could easily tear apart cars, even the second-tier mutated giant python’s scales were no match.
In pain, the mutated giant python writhed crazily, turning the street into a mess in an instant.
But Lu Chuan had anticipated this and controlled his zombies to dodge swiftly.
Lu Chuan used this strategy of encirclement for two rounds, and the massive mutated giant python eventually lost a large amount of blood, collapsing heavily on the ground, lifeless.
Staring at the large python’s corpse, Lu Chuan’s spirit surged with boundless enthusiasm, quickly controlling the tyrant zombie to tear open the python’s head and retrieve the crystal core.
In the carriage, Ji Ruxue looked at the mutated giant python’s corpse with gleaming eyes.
"Meat! I want to eat meat!"

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 118: Zhao Lin Rampages!
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 118: Zhao Lin Rampages!
Ever since her rebirth, Ji Ruxue’s diet has been extremely monotonous.
Due to her infancy, Lu Chuan prepares either powdered milk or egg fried rice for Ji Ruxue every day, sometimes cooking some rice paste.
Lu Chuan believes that this is what one eats at Ji Ruxue’s age. Although he wants to feed the little one some vegetables, unfortunately, he lacks the means.
Despite Lu Chuan’s diligent efforts in preparation each day, eating the same thing constantly can make even the tastiest food nauseating.
Ji Ruxue is on the verge of breakdown lately, feeling like her entire body is covered in the smell of milk powder and eggs.
Without tasting meat for so long, Ji Ruxue is close to forgetting what it even tastes like.
*Slurp~*
Looking at the massive mutated giant python before her, her eyes uncontrollably curve into crescents of happiness, and her saliva drips continuously down the corners of her mouth.
"Oh heavens, finally some meat to eat!"
"After so long on powdered milk, this Emperor can finally taste meat today!"
Ji Ruxue keeps swallowing her saliva, holding onto Lu Chuan’s sleeve, excitedly saying, "Daddy, I want to eat snake meat!"
In Ji Ruxue’s mind, countless gourmet dishes float, whether snake soup or roasted snake meat, both are delicacies for her long-deprived of meat.
However, upon hearing the little one’s request this time, Lu Chuan did not agree immediately but hesitated instead.
So far, he hasn’t verified if the meat of these mutated fierce beasts can be consumed by humans, and Lu Chuan was reluctant to take that risk.
Suddenly finding himself in this world, inexplicably becoming a zombie, Lu Chuan still doesn’t understand what this world truly entails.
He hadn’t even had the chance to interact with humans here, remaining ignorant of the information post-apocalypse.
Lu Chuan truly dared not gamble; no one knows what adverse effects may occur if the little one eats the flesh of these mutated fierce beasts...
Seeing Lu Chuan’s expression, Ji Ruxue quickly realized that daddy was unsure if she could eat the meat of the mutated giant python, hence his indecision.
This made her anxious, knowing well the effects of the mutated giant beasts.
Humans can eat the blood and flesh of these mutated giant beasts, and it’s indeed a great supplement for humans.
Because the bodies of mutated giant beasts contain a large amount of energy factors, the early human evolutionary path relied on genetic potions, later developing a Breathing Technique.
Another way to acquire energy is by consuming the flesh of mutated giant beasts.
Although Ji Ruxue knew this information, she didn’t know how to explain, having not revealed her identity to her dad yet.
"Daddy, I want to eat meat, please let me eat snake meat."
Ji Ruxue said while clinging to Lu Chuan’s arm, shaking it, her pitiful face filled with pleading.
Lu Chuan was surprised that such a young little one already craved meat, genuinely taken aback.
Lu Chuan thought for a moment and then wrote with portable pen and paper, "Little Qiqi, the meat of mutated animals might have unknown side effects; let your daddy test whether it can be consumed first!"
Seeing how much Little Qiqi craved meat, Lu Chuan decided to find a human survivor to test it out when he gets the chance.
Then, he’ll see if consuming the blood and flesh of these mutated beasts causes any changes in humans.
If the survivor remains unharmed, then in the future, he can enjoy these mutated giant beasts with the little one.
Lu Chuan also understood that infant growth requires all kinds of nutrients, just having milk powder and eggs truly isn’t enough.
Though she felt a little disappointed about not having meat today, at least she made her dad understand her desire.
Thinking about the possibility of eating meat in the future, Ji Ruxue suddenly felt utterly excited.
...
Outside the police station.
A faint blood glow emerged over a small mound; the next second, the soil mound started moving.
Then, a dirt-covered hand astonishingly extended from the ground.
Next moment, Zhao Lin emerged unscathed from the mound, her aura significantly enhanced compared to before!
Zhao Lin’s once beautiful cheeks now stained with dirt, her eyes filled with anger and coldness.
Recalling all that happened, Zhao Lin was burning with rage, never expecting to be killed by the survivors she saved.
Revived from death, Zhao Lin’s injuries fully healed, her legs agile as ever.
Gazing at the police station still ablaze, Zhao Lin’s eyes were ice-cold.
An eerie killing intent radiated from this once gentle and kind policewoman, dropping the surrounding temperature significantly.
Zhao Lin stormed into the police station, kicking open the door, and saw a group of survivors feasting on a roasted charred corpse.
Though the body on the fire was cut into pieces, its human features were still distinguishable.
Moreover, Zhao Lin noticed that there seemed to be one less survivor in the room!
Recalling how she went through so much, even sacrificing so much to save individuals who turned out to be cannibalistic demons, Zhao Lin’s fury raged!
Even when captured by the Corpse King, she worried about the safety of lives in the police station.
Yet, all this only led to merciless betrayal in return.
After the apocalypse eruption, she and her police colleagues risked their lives to save these people, only for them not to die by zombies’ hands but by human-shaped demons!
"Damn it!"
"You beasts!"
"You selfish, self-serving demons! To survive, you even eat humans. I should have let you fend for yourselves, to die in the zombie siege back then!"
Zhao Lin’s voice was chilling, even those survivors present felt shivers despite the burning flames in the room.
"Zhao, Officer Zhao? How could this be?!"
Seeing Zhao Lin’s silhouette at the door, the survivors inside were utterly terrified, as if seeing a ghost.
All gazed at Zhao Lin incredulously, disbelief filling their eyes.
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible! Are you human or ghost?!"
Those who were eating human flesh moments ago were so shocked that they dropped their roast on the ground, bodies trembling uncontrollably.
No one could have predicted that Zhao Lin, who was dissected and ingested, would come back to life, standing alive before everyone’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 119: Little Qiqi, I’m Coming to Find You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 119: Little Qiqi, I’m Coming to Find You!
The sudden appearance of Zhao Lin caught all the survivors in the police station off guard.
The person who should have already died stood right before them, even these demons who started eating people felt endless fear.
"Could it be that Zhao Lin wasn’t lying? Is she truly an Evolver, and can actually resurrect?!"
Some survivors realized that Zhao Lin had previously informed them of her talent ability, and at this moment everyone turned pale with fright.
"Officer Zhao, we were wrong before, we were forced into it!"
"We couldn’t find any supplies, we were too hungry, otherwise how could we have possibly eaten people?!"
The survivors, who had a ferocious look while eating human flesh just now, all changed their expressions to a pitiful appearance.
Facing Zhao Lin’s extremely cold gaze, many survivors cried and pleaded continuously.
Zhao Lin had previously managed to lure away the powerful Tyrant zombie, dealing with these ordinary people was practically a one-sided crush.
Thump~ Thump~
Seeing Zhao Lin unmoved, the survivors panicked and knelt on the ground one after another.
"Officer Zhao, please spare us, we know you’re the kindest among the officers!"
"We were wrong before, we were driven mad by hunger, please forgive us, we won’t do this ever again!"
Zhao Lin’s fists were tightly clenched, and her teeth were itching with hatred.
These guys pretending to be pitiful, but Zhao Lin clearly remembered how terrifying they were before she died!
Those greedy eyes, staring at her like hungry wolves!
"Ha, when you killed me, did you ever think about how I felt?"
"If I didn’t have the ability to resurrect, I would have already become a mound of dust by now!"
Although Zhao Lin was inherently kind and gentle, facing these backstabbers who killed her with their own hands, she felt nothing but raging fury.
These trash not only slashed her with knives, but even continued eating human flesh now.
Undoubtedly, if she hadn’t revived, these guys would continue to harm humans for survival.
They dared not face the fierce zombies outside but only raised the butcher’s knife against the weaker.
Zhao Lin stepped forward, the chilling aura emanating from her growing stronger, the killing intent in her eyes almost turning tangible.
"Officer Zhao, don’t forget, I was saved by you from the pile of zombies!"
The survivor closest to Zhao Lin cried bitterly, trying to awaken Zhao Lin’s kindness, unknown to him it only made her angrier.
Crack!
Zhao Lin swiftly made a move and directly snapped the person’s neck.
Looking at the heavy body falling to the ground, everyone felt a chilling sensation rush to their brain.
Casually killing an adult male, this powerful force was beyond what these ordinary people could compare.
At this moment, everyone inside only wanted to escape frantically, but Zhao Lin blocked the exit at the door.
"Help! Don’t kill me!"
"Officer Zhao, please spare me..."
The screams inside echoed endlessly, corpses hit the floor heavily one after another, these demons harming their own kinds were continuously killed by Zhao Lin.
Soon, only one survivor was left in the police station, the very one who had buried Zhao Lin.
"Officer Zhao, you’re a good person, I was forced by them, I had no choice, please spare me!"
Zhao Lin recognized this person, inherently weak, bullied frequently before the apocalypse, fundamentally good-natured.
Looking at his pleading eyes, she hesitated momentarily.
After a moment, Zhao Lin couldn’t bring herself to kill him, turned around, intending to leave.
Crack!
As Zhao Lin turned, the sound of a gun being cocked echoed from behind.
Her gaze chilled, she immediately lunged at the survivor with incredible speed.
Seizing the handgun, she punched him hard in the chest.
The powerful strength broke his ribs, with the sharp bones puncturing the heart, killing him instantly.
"Why?!"
"Why deceive me?!"
Looking at the corpses all over the room, Zhao Lin felt utterly broken.
She shouted continuously into the empty room, her heart filled with agony.
Zhao Lin couldn’t understand why she would risk her life to save someone, only to be betrayed.
Why did inherently kind people become so terrifying and vicious in the apocalypse?!
For a bite of food, they could ruthlessly kill their companions!
Do people like this even deserve to be called human?!
"What if those people weren’t worth protecting?"
At this moment, Ji Ruxue’s words flashed in Zhao Lin’s mind.
Indeed!
Do such despicable beasts truly deserve her protection?
Zhao Lin suddenly realized how ridiculous she had been.
For the sake of these unrelated survivors, she dared not eat much food.
After the apocalypse started, the most comfortable time she had was when she was captured by the Corpse King, only during that period could she eat to her fill.
To save these survivors, she fought fierce zombies, even sacrificing her life several times, yet ended up like this.
Looking at these corpses, Zhao Lin finally realized the peaceful and harmonious world she remembered was gone forever.
"If one day you realize this world isn’t as beautiful as you imagined, when you feel like not protecting others anymore, remember to protect me."
The promise between her and Little Qiqi flashed through Zhao Lin’s mind.
Lost and confused, Zhao Lin regained clarity in her eyes.
"Yes! In this world, I still have people to protect!"
"Little Qiqi is still waiting for me!"
Although this world is vastly different, human nature amplified infinitely during the apocalypse.
But Little Qiqi is different, the child is pure and adorable, her eyes filled with innocence and goodness.
She just arrived in this world, deserving a wonderful life.
Only someone as pure and kind deserves a police officer like herself to protect with life.
Thinking this through, Zhao Lin took one last look at the police station, a place she originally intended to dedicate her life to, then left disheartened.
But when Zhao Lin returned to Sunshine District, she found it empty, the zombies inside gone, even all the supplies in Building No.5 were taken.
Where did Little Qiqi go?
Then she suddenly remembered the note Little Qiqi had given her before leaving.
"Qingshui Farm."
"Little Qiqi, did you move to Qingshui Farm? Don’t worry, I’m coming to find you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 120: Quality over Quantity—Preparing to Forge a High-Rank Corpse Puppet Legion
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 120: Quality over Quantity—Preparing to Forge a High-Rank Corpse Puppet Legion
Inside the truck, Lu Chuan received the Crystal Core of the second-tier Mutated Golden Python from the grasp of the second-tier Tyrant Zombie.
The Crystal Core shimmered with an orange-yellow brilliance, as exquisite as a yellow crystal.
Lu Chuan merely held the Crystal Core, seemingly able to feel the immense energy contained within.
After all, the twenty-meter-long Mutated Giant Python before him drew its primary energy from this Crystal Core.
However, Lu Chuan chose not to consume this second-tier Crystal Core this time.
After all, he was now a third-tier Evolved Zombie, and the mere Crystal Core of a second-tier Mutated Giant Beast offered little benefit to him.
One might even say that the second-tier Crystal Core only serves to restore Spiritual Power and has no other effect on him.
Holding the second-tier Crystal Core, even its temptation seemed much weaker than before.
"If I can improve my strength by consuming Crystal Cores, then perhaps giving other Evolved Zombies can achieve the same result?"
Lu Chuan recalled when he consumed the Crystal Core of a mutated animal and successfully evolved, meaning that the Crystal Cores of mutated animals could provide significant energy just like Evolved Zombies.
Since the second-tier Crystal Core had no effect on him, leaving it for his Evolved Corpse Puppets might enhance their strength further.
After all, he as a non-combat type Evolved Zombie, primarily relies on controlling Corpse Puppets for fighting.
Moreover, high-tier Evolved Zombies are currently scarce and difficult to encounter; thus, he should cultivate them himself.
Lu Chuan thought about the two second-tier zombies he successfully controlled, the Tank Type Zombie ’Er Pang’ and the recently subdued second-tier Tyrant Zombie ’Tyrant One’.
These two Evolved Zombies are the main combat force among his Corpse Puppets.
After a moment of hesitation, Lu Chuan decided to let ’Er Pang’ devour the second-tier Crystal Core.
On the one hand, ’Er Pang’ is already a leading figure among second-tier zombies; consuming the Crystal Core, even if it doesn’t break through to the third-tier, could get them infinitely close, potentially boosting their strength.
Additionally, wielding a over-ton-heavy metal staff, ’Er Pang’ is invincible with his immense power and integrated offense-defense capabilities.
This formidable Corpse Puppet could be considered the strongest in my collection, and even ’Tyrant One’ is slightly inferior compared to ’Er Pang’.
However, Lu Chuan chose not to let Er Pang consume it now, as the priority was to reach Qingshui Farm quickly and stabilize in the new home.
After all, devouring the Crystal Core could lead to a prolonged stupor; ’Er Pang,’ the strongest combat force, cannot be absent at this time.
This massive Mutated Golden Python made Lu Chuan realize that as the apocalypse unfolded, ordinary zombies’ combat power was increasingly inadequate.
The successful defeat of the Mutated Golden Python mainly relied on the duo of second-tier zombies - ’Er Pang’ and ’Tyrant One’.
Even first-tier Evolved Zombies were practically powerless against the Mutated Golden Python, only capable of minor disruption.
Quality over quantity, what he needed was stronger high-tier combat power.
"I’ve now broken through to the third-tier; Crystal Cores below third-tier are practically useless to me."
"If I find a third-tier Crystal Core in the future, I might keep it for myself; those below third-tier should be left for Corpse Puppets for better evolutionary value."
Lu Chuan’s lips curled into a smirk; over time, he might cultivate a pure army of Evolved Zombies.
Just the thought of such a lineup was terrifying!
If that truly happens, he might be unstoppable in the apocalypse.
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue, sitting next to Lu Chuan, was also looking at the orange-yellow Crystal Core.
"Faced with the Crystal Core of a second-tier Mutated Giant Beast, dad the Evolved Zombie can resist the temptation to devour it; I wonder what he’s planning again?"
"Unfortunately, it’s just a second-tier Crystal Core and has no effect on me."
In her past life as the empress of the human race, she once possessed the recipe to create Genetic Evolution Potions.
In the late apocalypse, perfected by the human survivor forces, they reached the optimal level in the Extraordinary Gene drug formula.
However, Ji Ruxue has now broken through to the third-tier, and this second-tier Crystal Core also holds no effect for her.
The Mutated Golden Python had an immense size and monstrous strength within.
The road ahead of the convoy lay in ruins, thanks to the second-tier Mutated Golden Python, leaving Lu Chuan no choice but to send Corpse Puppets to clear the Golden Python’s corpse.
This colossal being, over twenty meters long, required all of Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets to move it due to its terrifying weight.
This massive existence was longer even than two of Lu Chuan’s heavy trucks combined, and the originally smooth concrete road was now full of trenches from the Mutated Giant Python.
Lu Chuan could only command numerous zombies to step forward, performing simple repairs on the surrounding roads so the convoy could continue.
After encountering the Mutated Giant Python, the road was indeed quite peaceful.
Lu Chuan speculated that most other animals in the zoo might have been devoured by the Mutated Giant Python, hence there were no further encounters.
Throughout the journey, occasional Evolved Zombies appeared but they were all low-level creatures.
Having broken through to the third-tier, Lu Chuan could control first-tier Evolved Zombies in mere moments.
These first-tier Evolved Zombies barely showed up before being successfully controlled by Lu Chuan’s Telekinesis, joining his Corpse Puppet army.
The journey from Sunshine District to the outskirts of the city saw Lu Chuan not losing any Corpse Puppets; in fact, the massive moves of the convoy drew numerous Evolved Zombies, adding to Lu Chuan’s ranks.
The Evolved Zombies gained during this journey were much more than when he was stationed in Sunshine District.
With the convoy’s continuous rumbling, they finally left the city center of Jianghai City. Although several incidents were met along the way, Lu Chuan managed to handle them all successfully.
Modern skyscrapers lined the road less frequently, gradually transitioning into clusters of low-rise buildings.
Lu Chuan checked the time; he and Little Qiqi had been away for a while, and it was already evening, while they finally reached the suburban area of Jianghai City.
He opened the map to compare the current area and, at current speed, calculated that the convoy should arrive at Qingshui Farm in another ten minutes!

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 121: Arrival at the New Home, Eliminating Threats
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 121: Arrival at the New Home, Eliminating Threats
The massive convoy continued to drive on the silent suburban roads for ten minutes. Lu Chuan then followed the map and road signs onto a forest path where he drove for a while until he finally saw the sign for Qingshui Farm.
The farm’s entrance gate stood nearly three meters high, and the entire gate’s width extended several meters.
The gate was forged entirely from steel, its pitch-black color exuding a sense of security.
On either side of the gate were the walls of Qingshui Farm, composed of sturdy wooden stakes and a large amount of barbed wire.
Inside the walls was the vast land of Qingshui Farm, containing various buildings and large expanses of farmland.
Lu Chuan even noticed signs of high voltage hanging on these walls, indicating that the barbed wire was originally electrified.
However, so long after the apocalypse, the city had long since lost power, and these electric fences had now lost their support.
Lu Chuan saw many signs of forced damage on these electrified wires.
It was clear that after the outbreak, some people or zombies chose to force their way through these walls into the farm.
Lu Chuan sat in the truck, nodding in satisfaction as he looked at the expansive farm before him.
Qingshui Farm was located on the outskirts of Jianghai City, a very quiet place where others were unlikely to notice them.
The vast area within the farm was enough for him and Little Qiqi to live comfortably. It was much larger than the Sunshine District and could also accommodate his massive Corpse Puppet army.
The most important thing was that this place was not a closed urban environment, so it didn’t feel as oppressive.
In Lu Chuan’s view, this place was very suitable for the little one’s growth.
A place where one could be close to nature to some extent, could improve an infant’s physical and mental health, much better than the dilapidated Jianghai City district.
In the depressive city district of Jianghai City, filled with death, even a normal person living there for a long time would likely become depressed.
Even Lu Chuan himself felt lost, sensing that life was filled with only despair before he met Little Qiqi.
From the perimeter of the farm, it was apparent that there were still many modern buildings inside that could fully satisfy the daily needs of him and Little Qiqi.
"Daddy, are we there yet?"
Ji Ruxue stretched lazily, looking at the sign for Qingshui Farm ahead with some confusion and asked.
After being in the car for so long, even Ji Ruxue felt a bit sleepy.
Lu Chuan nodded in response but did not bring Little Qiqi out. Instead, he first dispatched a group of Corpse Puppets through the broken wall to investigate the farm.
Since the situation at Qingshui Farm hadn’t been thoroughly investigated, Lu Chuan couldn’t risk bringing the little one along without ensuring safety.
He had already reached the third stage, so he did not fear potential threats, but the little one was still very young.
For the little one, even a slight danger could pose a life threat.
The broken walls signaled that some battles might have happened within the farm.
The barbed wire fences had been damaged, and Lu Chuan easily controlled the Corpse Puppets to enter Qingshui Farm.
But as soon as he entered, Lu Chuan frowned.
Within the sight of the Corpse Puppets, there lay large patches of blood in the silent farm, now dried and turned dark brown, looking rather terrifying.
The ground was visibly littered with many bones and pieces of flesh, emitting various unpleasant odors after such a long time.
The strong smell of blood and rotting flesh filled the entire farm; the place looked more like an abandoned slaughterhouse than a farm.
Furthermore, Lu Chuan found many signs of battle on the ground, with ravines crisscrossing the surface, some fissures even appearing in places.
The black blood and decaying flesh mixed with the dirt made it look like the demon’s garden.
"It seems a fierce battle did occur at Qingshui Farm, and it was quite brutal."
Lu Chuan murmured to himself, suspecting, then continued to control the Corpse Puppets to explore the farm.
He focused on finding the vegetable gardens since he mainly came to Qingshui Farm to improve Little Qiqi’s diet.
When Lu Chuan found the gardens, he discovered they had been destroyed.
The fields that originally grew vegetables were all ruined, and the ground was covered with many trampled crops.
"It seems many survivors came to the farm in search of food after the apocalypse, making the farm’s gardens a particular focus for many."
Lu Chuan discovered many traces of blood and human remains in these gardens.
As time passed, these bloodstains had turned dark brown, clearly showing that battles occurred in this area and the food-seeking survivors faced danger.
Lu Chuan also found giant footprints in the gardens, which were very deep, indicating their owners had tremendous strength.
The shape of these large footprints looked like those left by animals such as cattle and sheep.
"It seems that there are mutated animals within this farm, and the surrounding gardens may have been destroyed by them..."
Lu Chuan couldn’t help feeling a bit regretful, as today’s farm gardens were a complete mess.
Not only were the crops trampled, but even the land was almost completely overturned, full of ravines.
If he wanted to get vegetables, he’d have to control the Corpse Puppets to plow and farm again.
Besides the human survivors’ bones, Lu Chuan found several slain mutated zombies as well.
The bodies were violently dismembered; the severed limbs scattered around looked extremely terrifying.
The scene before him made Lu Chuan slightly on guard.
It seemed that Qingshui Farm was not as peaceful as it appeared.
Capable of ravaging zombies this way, the power behind it certainly couldn’t be underestimated.
They were either Evolved Zombies or Mutated Animals.
After investigating the farm’s perimeter, Lu Chuan didn’t find any living entities left, not even zombies, just corpses on the ground.
After passing through the devastation, Lu Chuan continued to control the Corpse Puppet squad to head further into the farm.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Just then, Lu Chuan heard some noises from within the farm, sounding like fighting.
Amidst it, there were also some animal growls.

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 122: The Meat-Eating Mutant Giant Bull!
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 122: The Meat-Eating Mutant Giant Bull!
The sounds from the farm attracted Lu Chuan’s attention, and he maneuvered the Corpse Puppet squad to continue deeper into the farm.
It seems Qingshui Farm is far from peaceful as it appears from the outside; even just the outskirts have already witnessed quite a few battles.
Upon entering the farm, they encountered marks left by Mutant Beasts, human survivors, and Zombie remnants, putting Lu Chuan on high alert.
Following the sounds, Lu Chuan kept searching and found the peculiar noises coming from the area where poultry and livestock were kept.
"Is the commotion coming from here? Could it be the mutant animals on the farm?"
Continuing to explore with the Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan noticed the ground near the cow and chicken pens was extremely messy, with quite a bit of fresh blood.
Animal dung mixed with ground meat bits and blood gave off a stench that was extremely nauseating.
Upon closer inspection, Lu Chuan found the blood on the ground was still flowing, distinctively bright red, unlike the surrounding dark brown stains.
If the blood had been left previously, it would have dried and changed color, clearly indicating a recent battle had occurred here.
Lu Chuan frowned, realizing he had arrived too late, just missing out on the previous battle.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Suddenly, noises came from one side of the cow pen, instantly catching Lu Chuan’s attention.
The branches are now overshadowed by the moon, and the bright moon hangs high in the sky.
The bright moon and the surrounding desolate environment created a stark contrast, making the farm under the moonlight no longer so dark.
Moo~
Under the moonlight, Lu Chuan indeed spotted a mutant animal.
It was a massively mutated yellow cow, with a height of over three meters and a body length of around five meters!
Although this mutated yellow cow’s size wasn’t as exaggerated as the Mutated Golden Python, Lu Chuan could see the terrifying muscles on this mutated yellow cow.
The sharp and high-raised muscles resembled those of a bodybuilder on steroids, and the exaggerated muscle lines made one’s scalp tingle at first glance.
Crunch! Crunch!
Sounds of chewing came from the front, and Lu Chuan was momentarily stunned by the scene before him.
This Mutated Giant Bull was gnawing on the body of an unidentified animal, its enormous crimson eyes strikingly visible in the dark night.
This yellow cow had grown incredibly sharp teeth, even more exaggerated than those of lions and tigers, with blood constantly dripping and bits of meat hanging between its teeth.
"What’s going on? Even cows started eating meat in the apocalypse?!"
"Could it be that this guy’s terrifying muscles are all built up by eating meat?"
Lu Chuan sighed helplessly; ever since crossing into this world, he seemed to encounter all kinds of bizarre things...
Moo!
The sound of Corpse Puppet’s movement seemed to alert the Mutated Giant Bull. The beast suddenly lifted its head and glanced around, instantly spotting the Corpse Puppet hidden not far away.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
This Mutated Giant Bull directly abandoned the carcass at its mouth and charged at Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet without a word.
Its massive hooves kept scraping the ground, causing the surrounding area to feel like an earthquake.
The terrifyingly muscular giant bull exploded with incredible speed, reaching Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet in an instant.
Squish!
Lu Chuan had sent ordinary zombies into the farm to scout, but against the massively powerful Mutated Giant Bull, the ordinary zombies were completely defenseless.
In just an instant, the Corpse Puppet was smashed into a pile of minced meat by the Mutated Giant Bull.
Seeing the Corpse Puppet smashed to pieces, Lu Chuan finally understood where all the zombie corpses came from on the farm’s outskirts.
This Mutated Giant Bull’s temperament was exceptionally volatile, charging directly without a word.
Seeing so many remains in the farm, Lu Chuan could basically confirm that any living creatures inside have likely been devoured by this Mutated Giant Bull.
The giant bull’s speed and explosive force truly reached an extremely exaggerated level, definitely a second-tier being.
Ordinary Corpse Puppets were no match for it, and even zombies like Da Pang, Lu Chuan wouldn’t dare let them face this Mutated Giant Bull.
The giant bull’s charge speed was akin to a speeding heavy truck or like a small mountain crashing down from the sky.
Lu Chuan didn’t want to waste his few Evolved Zombies on this Mutated Giant Bull.
Only Er Pang and Tyrant No. 1, also second-tier, could handle a mutant giant beast of such size and power.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
After basically scouting out the situation, Lu Chuan quickly commanded Er Pang and Tyrant No.1 to support deeper inside the farm.
The massive commotion created by the second-tier zombie run quickly drew the attention of the Mutated Giant Bull.
Moo!
This Mutated Giant Bull’s eyes turned incredibly bloodshot, like a maddened bull.
Gathering all its strength, it charged directly towards Er Pang and Tyrant, truly terrifying.
Even Er Pang and Tyrant No. 1, despite being second-tier zombies, felt immense pressure from the Mutated Giant Bull.
The surrounding ground trembled continuously, seemingly causing even the buildings to shake.
The wooden farm fences along the way simply couldn’t stop the mutated gigantic yellow cow.
Seeing the Mutated Giant Bull almost upon them, Lu Chuan controlled Er Pang to swing his over-ton-heavy metal rod down fiercely.
Bang!
Despite the Mutated Giant Bull’s immense strength, it acted as if it had mad cow disease and didn’t dodge at all.
Lu Chuan’s blow landed firmly on the mutated yellow cow’s head, causing Er Pang to be knocked back two meters by its sheer force.
Yet the giant bull also got hammered till it saw stars.
A terrifying force of over a ton was not something even this mutated giant beast could withstand.
The mutated yellow cow staggered in place for a long time before Lu Chuan directed Tyrant No. 1 to move rapidly forward.
The horrific claws swung instantly, tearing a large gouge into the mutated yellow cow.
However, what surprised Lu Chuan was that the cow’s skin had evolved to be incredibly tough.
Initially, he thought a single strike could slice it in half, but it only left some wounds.
Wounded, the mutated yellow cow twisted its body more violently in pain.
The Mutated Giant Bull, acting like a mad bull, only knew to charge endlessly.
Facing the indiscriminate charging of the Mutated Giant Bull, Lu Chuan repeatedly used the same tactic, eventually bringing the mutant giant beast heavily to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 123: Damn, That’s a Huge Turtle!
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 123: Damn, That’s a Huge Turtle!
The Tyrant zombie’s sharp claws pierced directly through the mutated giant beast’s skull, extracting an energy-filled crystal core.
Just as Lu Chuan had judged, this mutated giant bull had already reached the second tier, and the crystal core in its brain was almost turning orange-yellow.
’Tyrant No. 1’ delivered the crystal core to Lu Chuan’s side. Looking at the two second-tier crystal cores in his hand, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
"The second-tier crystal core from that mutated Golden Python earlier, combined with this mutated bull’s crystal core, should contain enough energy to allow ’Er Pang’ to successfully break through to a third-tier zombie."
Now that the threats within the farm had basically been resolved, Lu Chuan began to dispatch a large number of Corpse Puppets into the internal areas of the farm.
After extracting the crystal core, Lu Chuan did not waste the body of the mutated bull, much like how he had preserved the flesh of the mutated Golden Python he encountered before.
Although there were no issues for him consuming this flesh, Lu Chuan couldn’t guarantee that Little Qiqi would be unaffected.
Once a human survivor is found for experimentation, this meat can then be utilized.
Lu Chuan could imagine that if this meat could be consumed, he could showcase his culinary skills.
This beef certainly wouldn’t be finished soon, but the rest could be made into beef jerky, along with large amounts of marinated beef, and so on.
Enough for Little Qiqi to eat to her heart’s content.
Of course, the premise is that the meat of this mutated giant bull is edible.
Looking at the fresh giant beast’s corpse of the mutated bull, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but feel a little tempted, he must definitely have a good taste of it.
Although he no longer needed to consume flesh daily to maintain his body’s functioning.
But fresh blood and flesh have a fatal attraction for zombies.
After dealing with the mutated bull, Lu Chuan continued to control the Corpse Puppets to search within the farm.
The farm covers a very large area, and the Corpse Puppets Lu Chuan sent in had only searched a small portion, leaving many areas unexplored.
Before thoroughly searching every corner of Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan absolutely wouldn’t let Little Qiqi enter the farm.
After all, the little one was far too young, and her body was extremely delicate.
Lu Chuan was not going to allow any potential danger to befall the little one.
In the future, this Qingshui Farm would be the home for him and Little Qiqi, so Lu Chuan had to ensure the farm was completely safe.
Not a single safety hazard could go unnoticed; the entire area must be guaranteed to absolute safety.
Continuing to control a large number of Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan kept patrolling through this Qingshui Farm.
After searching the farm inside and out, examining every nook and cranny, Lu Chuan finally felt relieved.
Within the entire Qingshui Farm, only the mutated bull was a living being.
Everything else, whether the original animals, human survivors, or zombies, all perished at the hands of this mutated bull.
With the extensive patrol by numerous Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan had now gained a detailed understanding of the specific situation of Qingshui Farm.
The central area of Qingshui Farm was the residential area for humans, with modern houses that would not affect the daily life of him and Little Qiqi.
Surrounded by towering walls, and in the southern part of Qingshui Farm, near the entrance, was the cultivation area.
This area could be used to plant a variety of crops, with many plots for growing vegetables.
However, both the crops and the gardens had suffered extensive damage, and he could only re-cultivate and plant anew.
The eastern side was for breeding poultry and livestock, but it too had long been devoid of living creatures, with only a ground full of blood and dung.
The only surviving entity was the mutated giant bull, which had just died at his hands.
The northern side of Qingshui Farm housed a large orchard while the western side had a fish pond.
It could be said that each area of Qingshui Farm was clearly demarcated and could basically meet various needs.
After circling around for a search, Lu Chuan found that he wasn’t completely without gain, as quite a few fruits still hung on the trees in the northern orchards.
"That’s great; I never expected to find such fresh fruits in the apocalypse!"
Lu Chuan was very pleased to see these ripe fruits; the little one could replenish her vitamins this time.
In these apocalyptic days of extreme resource scarcity, finding something to eat was already extremely difficult.
Even though Lu Chuan had gathered a large quantity of resources in the city, what he had collected was mostly rice, bread, biscuits, etc.
As for fresh vegetables and fruits, they were almost impossible to encounter, these things were rare treasures in an apocalypse.
Lu Chuan then controlled a Corpse Puppet to approach the fish pond on the west side, wanting to check if there were still fish living in the pond.
Finding living beings on land was hopeless, so he could only turn his attention to the water.
If there were still some fish in the pond that hadn’t been infected or killed, he could help the little one get some fish to eat.
However, near the fish pond Lu Chuan discovered the pond’s water had become very turbid, making it almost impossible to discern the pond’s specific situation.
Most critically, there were wide crawling marks along the bank, instantly alerting Lu Chuan.
Such marks in the apocalypse suggested something unusual in that pond.
After the encounter with the mutated giant bull, Lu Chuan remained cautious, as there might very well be a mutated fish waiting in that pond.
Lu Chuan cautiously controlled the Corpse Puppet to slowly approach the fish pond, while carefully surveying the surroundings.
Just then, the water surface suddenly churned, and in the next second, a massive giant turtle emerged from the murky water.
This giant turtle was beyond Lu Chuan’s comprehension, its enormous size was at least two to three meters across.
Even under normal circumstances, a sea turtle would be dwarfed by this massive turtle.
Undoubtedly, this too was a mutated giant beast post-apocalypse, just with a different evolutionary trajectory.
Crunch!
The giant turtle bit down on the ankle of a corpse without hesitation, the crisp sound of bone breaking echoing clearly!
"Holy crap! What a huge turtle!"
Seeing the giant turtle suddenly emerge from the water, Lu Chuan was taken aback, never expecting such a large creature in the murky waters.
The most crucial part was that such a massive turtle was almost silent in this water, and if it hadn’t burst out, Lu Chuan might not have discovered its presence!
The terrifying strength caused the Corpse Puppet’s ankle to break instantly, the giant turtle’s immense power and bite force were extremely astonishing!

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 124: From Now On, This Is Qiqi and My New Home!
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 124: From Now On, This Is Qiqi and My New Home!
Lu Chuan had never seen such a massive turtle before. He controlled a Corpse Puppet to punch the turtle hard.
However, the black shell of this "bastard" was extremely tough, and the recoil directly fractured the wrist of the Corpse Puppet.
Lu Chuan was somewhat surprised, as he didn’t expect such a creature to exist in the fish pond. Even the turtle could grow this large!
Looking at the big fellow in front of him, Lu Chuan decided not to take further action, as this turtle’s shell was too hard.
If he wanted to kill it, he would need to put in quite a bit of effort.
"A millennium turtle and a ten-thousand-year tortoise, such a large turtle must be very nutritious!"
"If future tests prove that the meat of these mutated animals is edible, we could keep it for Little Qiqi to nourish her body."
Lu Chuan chuckled softly. Although many mutated animals appeared in the apocalypse, adding many risks to life in the apocalypse, they might also provide a significant supplement to food.
Once he verifies whether the meat of mutated animals is edible, numerous ingredients will be added to Little Qiqi’s diet, making it less monotonous and providing more nutrients.
However, considering the threat of this turtle, Lu Chuan dispatched two Corpse Puppets to guard the shore to prevent the turtle from crawling ashore.
After all, the biting force the turtle displayed just now was quite astonishing, easily able to break the bones of a Corpse Puppet.
If it crawled ashore unknowingly, it would be a threat. Coupled with its extremely tough shell, keeping it in the water was the best choice.
After confirming that there was no other danger on the farm, Lu Chuan began dispatching a large number of Corpse Puppets into Qingshui Farm, mainly to clean up the residential area.
Although the farm was fully equipped, it was covered in dust and blood due to earlier attacks.
The stench of blood and rotting flesh was truly nauseating, and Lu Chuan didn’t want the little one to live in such an environment.
At the same time, many supplies on the truck were also moved into the farm by Lu Chuan controlling the Corpse Puppets successively.
An eerie scene unfolded, with innumerable figures suddenly appearing in a slightly dilapidated farm.
Some of these figures were shoveling soil, some were wiping away bloodstains, and others were tidying up dusty beds, etc.
The most crucial point was that each of these figures was a bloodthirsty zombie!
If other survivors saw this scene, they would surely be dumbfounded.
After all, no one would expect zombies to be cleaning...
Lu Chuan controlled a large number of Corpse Puppets along the way. Although these ordinary Corpse Puppets were not as combat-capable as those Evolved Zombies, they demonstrated the advantage of numbers in this situation.
Many hands make light work, and with the massive army of Corpse Puppets working together, the hygiene of the residential area was quickly cleaned up by Lu Chuan.
Seeing the nearly renewed residential area, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction, feeling that he had used the Corpse Puppets effectively.
Once all the preparations were complete, Lu Chuan held Little Qiqi’s hand and slowly entered the farm.
The farm looked completely different from how Lu Chuan had just seen it; the pungent odors were blown away by the wind, and the scattered corpses and flesh were collected by the Corpse Puppets.
The dark, sticky blood on the walls had been cleaned, and the entire farm now appeared vibrant and prosperous.
"Is this the home where I and daddy will live in the future? It really does look pretty nice."
Ji Ruxue curiously looked around, finding the farm indeed seemed better than Sunshine District.
Qingshui Farm covered a larger area and allowed people to see various natural sceneries in the wild.
Living on the farm spared them from spending long periods in those concrete high-rises, and different areas had their respective functional divisions, allowing them to meet basic living needs through labor.
Feeling the beauty of the new residence, Ji Ruxue suddenly felt a lot of hope for the future.
She never imagined being adopted by a zombie, let alone by a Corpse King.
Ji Ruxue had never tried living with the Corpse King in a zombie-infested area. If it were in a previous life, she wouldn’t have dared to imagine such a thing.
Back then, it was either her life or killing zombies; there was no scenario of living together.
Unexpectedly, after being reborn as a baby, she encountered this bizarre situation.
"Having a Corpse King as a daddy, this childhood life should definitely be enjoyable!"
In her previous life, Ji Ruxue had never experienced fatherly love or familial bonds. She didn’t even know what it felt like to be cared for.
Although her daddy is now a zombie after rebirth, he brought the kind of intimate care she never had before.
......
After moving into Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan’s main concern was the safety around the farm.
He dispatched the sturdy Er Pang, holding a large stick, to guard the south gate.
Er Pang inadvertently exuded an aura of invincibility, proving it to be the best Gate God.
As for the east, north, and west sides of the farm, Lu Chuan dispatched agile zombies Lightning One, Two, and Three to lead their respective teams of ordinary Corpse Puppets as guards.
These forces were sufficient to defend the periphery of Qingshui Farm, allowing him to remain vigilant in case of danger.
Near the residential area, Lu Chuan assigned Da Pang and Tyrant One to close-protection duties for Little Qiqi’s safety.
With these powerful Evolved Zombies, Lu Chuan believed the combat power of Qingshui Farm had increased several times!
Lu Chuan, through a large number of zombies, quickly transformed a rundown Qingshui Farm into an impregnable cage!
With heavy defenses both inside and outside the farm, the safety of himself and Little Qiqi living here could be fully assured.
Seeing the now-sleeping Little Qiqi, a sense of accomplishment surged in Lu Chuan’s heart, feeling fulfilled by everything he had done.
The reason he made so many preparations was to provide the little one with a healthy environment to grow up in.
He hoped Little Qiqi could grow up healthily, unaffected by the apocalypse.
As long as the little one lives happily and joyfully, everything he did would be worthwhile.
"Little Qiqi, rest assured and sleep. This Qingshui Farm will be our new home from now on."

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 125: Using Zombies to Farm—Dad Really Has Ideas!
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 125: Using Zombies to Farm—Dad Really Has Ideas!
After moving to a new environment, Ji Ruxue did not feel the slightest discomfort.
Perhaps it was because of the fatigue from a day of traveling by car, or perhaps because she had left the concrete jungles of the city to come to these rural fields, Ji Ruxue’s body and mind completely relaxed.
She slept very soundly, and when she woke up the next day, she found that her father had already prepared breakfast.
What’s most crucial is that today, unlike usual, there was even a plate of freshly cut fruit on the table!
Ji Ruxue’s eyes lit up. In the post-apocalypse, these fresh fruits and vegetables were extremely scarce resources!
She sat up on the bed in one swift move and hurried to the table, her small, delicate nose slightly twitching as she sniffed the fragrance of the fruit.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue felt a bit intoxicated; she could hardly remember how long it had been since she last smelled the scent of fruit.
Though today’s breakfast was still the same old fried rice with egg, which she had been eating for a long while in the apocalypse.
But Ji Ruxue was already very content with it, knowing that this was, after all, the post-apocalypse after the zombie outbreak.
Many human survivors could only hide in dark basements or cramped, enclosed spaces, and just having a bite to eat was already considered extremely lucky.
At this moment, most people were unable to fill their stomachs and had to live with the fear of each moment being their last.
Not only did they have to be on guard against zombie attacks, but they also had to constantly worry about being betrayed by their companions.
Being able to wake up naturally every morning, with hot breakfast and fresh fruits ready to enjoy as soon as she opened her eyes, it was practically a heavenly life for her.
Ji Ruxue picked up a spoon and filled her mouth with fried rice with egg, looking at the verdant trees and fields outside the window, feeling utterly contented.
Even in the apocalypse, smelling the fragrance of fruit while eating steaming fried rice, Ji Ruxue felt happiness become tangible at that moment.
After finishing the fried rice, Ji Ruxue started on the fruit, the sweet and sour juice bursting in her mouth, instantly replenishing the vitamins her body lacked.
After eating her fill, she went outside, only to see squads of fully armed zombies patrolling the farm in an orderly fashion, almost as if they were human soldiers.
"Dad sure is amazing; controlling these zombies is much more skillful than ordinary Corpse Kings. Is this the advantage of retaining human consciousness?"
Looking at the orderly farm, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but admire her father.
"Although Qingshui Farm is located on the outskirts of the city, without much concrete and steel defensive structures around it, with these zombies controlled by dad, this farm has become an impregnable fortress overnight!"
Just as Ji Ruxue was observing the situation on the farm, not far away, Lu Chuan noticed that the little one had woken up and hurriedly ran in her direction.
While running, Lu Chuan pulled out paper and pen he carried with him and began to write.
"Little Qiqi, this is our new home; make sure to stay well within the farm, and do not wander around."
Although he had dispatched Corpse Puppets to search the farm thoroughly, and was pretty sure there were no dangers here.
However, since he was new to this place, Lu Chuan wasn’t completely familiar with the surroundings, so he wasn’t assured about letting Little Qiqi run around unsupervised.
However, Ji Ruxue wanted to take a walk around and see the sights; she had finally left the closed Sunshine District and could breathe some fresh air, so she really didn’t want to go back inside and feel cooped up again.
Ji Ruxue hugged Lu Chuan’s leg, shaking it incessantly, and pouted cutely, "Dad, we’ve moved to a new home; just take me around to have a look~"
Seeing Ji Ruxue’s sweet and adorable appearance, Lu Chuan immediately gave in.
"The area around the farm has mostly been scouted by Corpse Puppets, and there shouldn’t be much danger. Besides, with me as a Tier-3 Evolved Zombie by her side, Little Qiqi ought to be pretty safe..."
After thinking for a while, Lu Chuan agreed to Ji Ruxue’s request, then took her little hand and led her to the vegetable field they saw earlier.
From a distance, Ji Ruxue could already see silhouettes diligently working in the vegetable field ahead.
These figures were wielding various farm tools, some using hoes to loosen the soil, others pulling up weeds that had grown in the field.
Ji Ruxue was momentarily stunned; could there actually be living people at Qingshui Farm?
No, if there were living people, how could they coexist so harmoniously with dad?
With her mind filled with doubts, Ji Ruxue slowly approached the vegetable field, and as she got closer, she was astonished by the sight before her, her mouth wide open in shock.
These diligent figures weren’t farm workers at all; they were the zombies her father was controlling!
Ji Ruxue was stunned.
Controlling zombies to farm, her dad really had an innovative mind!
Looking at her dad beside her, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile wryly. Her dad was really using the Corpse King’s abilities to the fullest, not letting even a piece of land go untended!
Ji Ruxue had to admit that her dad was indeed quite clever; these ordinary zombies might not be strong fighters, but they were perfectly suited for work.
Having not undergone evolution, the ordinary zombies’ physiques were comparable to humans, with no major changes occurring.
Additionally, Lu Chuan was very particular in selecting Corpse Puppets, choosing only those that were strong, healthy, and not extensively mutilated, ensuring they wouldn’t affect the zombies’ work performance.
The most crucial point was that these zombies didn’t feel fatigue, nor did they require wages.
They didn’t even need to eat or drink, making them the ideal workforce in a heartless boss’s mind, capable of continuous, 24-hour production!
Lu Chuan didn’t know the extent of Ji Ruxue’s awe; at the moment, he nodded in satisfaction as he looked at the farm’s initial setup.
Earlier that morning, Lu Chuan had already gone to inspect the farm’s warehouse.
The farm possessed various unplanted vegetable seeds, along with a complete set of farming tools and even a considerable amount of remaining fertilizers.
In his previous life, Lu Chuan had been born in the countryside and had farmed with his grandparents in the village during his childhood.
Although many years had passed, those memories had never faded from Lu Chuan’s mind.
He had a good understanding of planting crops, and now, equipped with all the necessary tools and a large number of Corpse Puppets as workforce.
Lu Chuan was confident that he could reclaim the damaged vegetable field through his labor, ensuring that Little Qiqi could enjoy fresh vegetables every day from then on!

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 126: The First Tier 3 Corpse Puppet
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 126: The First Tier 3 Corpse Puppet
The Qingshui Farm was littered with zombies that had already died long ago; however, these once bloodthirsty monsters had transformed under Lu Chuan’s control into diligent laborers.
Even though the main workforce consisted of cold corpses, it brought the abandoned Qingshui Farm back to life.
Under Lu Chuan’s arrangements, the once desolate farm was now thriving with vitality, presenting a scene of prosperity.
Once everything on the farm was properly arranged, Lu Chuan remembered that he had two Crystal Cores left by second-tier mutated animals.
Earlier on the journey, worried about possible accidents, Lu Chuan hadn’t let ’Er Pang’ consume these Crystal Cores midway.
Now that everything was ready, it was a good time for ’Er Pang’ to attempt a breakthrough to the third-tier Evolved Zombie.
If it could break through to the third tier, the combat power of the entire farm would rise another level.
Lu Chuan, full of anticipation, handed these two orange Crystal Cores to ’Er Pang’ to swallow.
Quickly, a powerful surge of energy emanated from ’Er Pang’.
Roar!
As expected, with the energy provided by these two Mutated Giant Beast Crystal Cores, ’Er Pang’ successfully advanced to a third-tier zombie.
The oppressive force was so powerful that many nearby zombies couldn’t help but tremble, with a glimpse of terror in their eyes.
Crack! Crack!
The sound of bones shifting came from within ’Er Pang’.
Lu Chuan widened his eyes, shocked to see that after breaking through to the third tier, ’Er Pang’s size became even larger than before, as if inflated!
This sudden growth in size was almost comparable to a truck!
Simply standing in the open space, ’Er Pang’s’ powerful presence was enough to intimidate all around!
Lu Chuan manipulated ’Er Pang’ to test its strength, finding that the power increase after reaching the third tier was truly terrifying!
Squeak~
’Er Pang’ exerted both arms effortlessly lifting the heavy truck on the ground!
This strength was far superior to before the advancement.
The metal rod, over three meters long and weighing over a ton, that lay to the side was now wielded by ’Er Pang’ with ease!
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
The swirling wind from the long rod swept everywhere.
The silver afterimage of the long rod even appeared mid-air, such terrifying power made Lu Chuan feel a bit panicky.
As a Tank Type zombie focused on defense, breaking through to the third tier, ’Er Pang’ actually began growing scales!
These scales were dark black, resembling high-strength alloy, and covered ’Er Pang’s entire body, making it look like a giant warrior clad in heavy armor!
Lu Chuan took a machete to test it, these scales could be considered impenetrable, no matter hacking or stabbing, it couldn’t pierce through, only leaving slight abrasions on these robust protective scales!
Lu Chuan patted these scales with a hand, the robust defense was truly astonishing.
"With this terrifying armor, as long as the head isn’t hit, ’Er Pang’ is practically invulnerable, even capable of blocking bullets."
"Now, ’Er Pang’ has directly become the main battle tank in the Zombie Realm!"
This third-tier general guarding the farm gate gave Lu Chuan a great surge in confidence.
Looking from afar towards the farm entrance, ’Er Pang’ almost blocked the whole gate, plus a three-meter-long thick metal rod, truly resembling an immensely powerful Gate God!
’Er Pang’s’ breakthrough to the third tier showed Lu Chuan a new path to becoming stronger.
"In the future, I can hunt more Evolved Zombies and Mutated Animals, and save the Crystal Cores I don’t need for these Corpse Puppets."
"Since high-tier zombies are rare, I’ll cultivate my own!"
Whether high-tier Mutated Animals or high-tier zombies, the number is indeed scarce at this early stage post-apocalypse.
Although Lu Chuan doesn’t fully understand this strange post-apocalypse yet, based on his experiences so far, he can guess that his own evolution speed has been quite fast.
To break through, one can only absorb same-tier Crystal Cores, yet this method of increasing strength is inefficient.
So instead of that, he would slay a large number of low-tier zombies and Mutated Giant Beasts, using these relatively easily obtainable Crystal Cores to feed his Corpse Puppets.
Since there are no high-tier zombies, I’ll just use Crystal Cores to elevate these low-tier Corpse Puppets to high-tier zombies!
Having a group of high-tier Evolved Zombies is a completely different concept from a group of common zombies.
The formidable combat power shown by ’Er Pang’ after advancing to the third tier made Lu Chuan realize the importance of high-tier zombies.
If he could have a few third-tier Corpse Puppets, their powerful combat capability would be enough to surpass an army of ordinary Corpse Puppets.
Lu Chuan was quite confident that if he had over a hundred third-tier Corpse Puppets now, he wouldn’t even fear encountering a real human army.
Of course, this is under the premise of using conventional weapons.
Lu Chuan was momentarily filled with anticipation for the future, believing that he could definitely establish an extremely strong force in time.
The thought alone, with hundreds of high-tier Evolved Zombies behind, brought a smile to Lu Chuan’s face.
After all, with sufficient strength, he could ensure the safety of Little Qiqi.
"Oh no! I almost forgot! The corpses of that Mutated Golden Python and Giant Bull haven’t been dealt with yet!"
Lu Chuan spent an entire day and night busying with farm affairs.
Now that all his tasks were done, Lu Chuan suddenly remembered the bodies of the Mutated Giant Beasts.
He had previously slain two second-tier Mutated Giant Beasts, although he retrieved the Crystal Cores, the bodies remained unattended.
If not processed in time, these precious flesh could spoil over time.
Even though zombies can devour rotten meat without issue, Lu Chuan still wanted to save this meat for Qiqi to consume.
Should his experiment show that human consumption of these Mutated Animals’ flesh is possible, Qiqi’s future menu could become less monotonous.
He could then prepare a variety of meat dishes for the little one to enjoy, instead of having to eat fried rice with eggs every day.
Every day, eating fried rice with eggs, not only Qiqi was tired of it, even Lu Chuan felt like he was smelling of it now...
Moreover, Lu Chuan found that there was a generator in the farm, and there was stored oil in the warehouse for power generation.
The refrigerator was large enough to temporarily freeze and preserve this meat.

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 127: The Little One Can Finally Eat Meat!
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 127: The Little One Can Finally Eat Meat!
Dissecting the mutated golden python and the mutated giant bull carcass is an extremely tedious task, and Lu Chuan does not intend to do it himself.
With such massive bodies, if I were to do it all by myself, who knows how long it would take.
Within the farm’s range, Lu Chuan manipulated a group of idle Corpse Puppets to approach the carcasses of these two giant beasts.
Looking at the enormous pile of carcasses in front of him, even though he had seen it several times, Lu Chuan still found it somewhat unbelievable.
"Who would have thought these ordinary animals before the apocalypse could become even more terrifying than Evolved Zombies after mutation!"
"With such massive size, if it weren’t for my army of Corpse Puppets, I’m afraid it would be very difficult to kill them..."
The carcass of the mutated giant bull is still manageable; after all, although its size has grown considerably, it’s not too exaggerated.
But the mutated giant python is quite frightening.
Lu Chuan manipulated at least over twenty Corpse Puppets to transport the python’s carcass.
Back then, to quickly reach Qingshui Farm, I divided the golden python’s body into several sections and loaded it onto a heavy truck.
Yet the twenty-meter-long enormous snake body still resembled a small mountain.
Lu Chuan manipulated the Corpse Puppets, each holding a machete, to approach the carcasses of the mutated animals, cutting tirelessly with one stroke after another.
The entire process was operated like a production line.
After breaking through to the third phase of the zombie, Lu Chuan’s Spiritual Power received a considerable boost.
Controlling these Corpse Puppets to carry out simple mechanical tasks was no problem, although the scene of dismemberment was somewhat bloody...
"Daddy, I want to eat meat~ I want to eat meat~"
Ji Ruxue looked at the many carcasses of mutated Fierce Beasts, drooling uncontrollably from the corner of her mouth.
Holding onto Lu Chuan’s thigh, she refused to let go, continually employing her coy tactics.
Lu Chuan was startled by the sudden appearance of Little Qiqi; he didn’t want the little one to witness such a bloody scene.
But upon noticing that Ji Ruxue seemed accustomed to the dismemberment scene, with no apparent emotional fluctuation, Lu Chuan silently breathed a sigh of relief.
He didn’t want to leave any shadows in the little one’s young mind.
But although Little Qiqi’s coy tactics were usually effective, they still couldn’t sway Lu Chuan’s attitude on such a principled matter.
The carcasses of these mutated animals could potentially contain some peculiar substance; should humans consume them and experience side effects, there would be no time for regret.
He wrote on the ground with his finger dipped in nearby fresh blood: "Not yet, Little Qiqi, be good, wait two more days."
Seeing Little Qiqi with a furrowed brow and a pitiful expression, Lu Chuan felt quite heartbroken.
After all, Little Qiqi has grown so much and still hasn’t had a proper meal.
But this involves the little one’s safety, and Lu Chuan absolutely cannot allow any mishaps.
He secretly decided that if mutated animal meat was safe for human consumption, he would definitely let Little Qiqi eat her fill then, turning the little one into a chubby girl!
...
The next day.
Qingshui Farm is located on the outskirts of Jianghai City; even the nearest urban area is about ten kilometers from the farm.
At this moment, on the intercity highway, a heavy truck slowly came to a halt.
A figure leapt off the truck, wearing a full motorcycle helmet on his head.
Wearing leather gloves and draped in a loose overcoat, overall looking quite flashy.
And inside the truck’s compartment were two pieces of already cooked giant python meat.
This flashy figure wearing the overcoat was none other than Lu Chuan’s ’Lightning One’!
After Lu Chuan carefully dressed ’Lightning One,’ it looked almost indistinguishable from humans in appearance.
The primary mission of Lu Chuan’s control over ’Lightning One’ this time was to find human survivors in Jianghai City’s urban area, to ascertain whether humans could consume mutated animal meat.
After all, Little Qiqi is growing increasingly interested in those meats now; Lu Chuan doesn’t want to face the little one’s pitiful eyes every day.
Lu Chuan could only quickly complete the experiment so that Little Qiqi could successfully eat meat.
’Lightning One’ hadn’t walked far when it heard a rapid sound of footsteps ahead.
It soon saw a very frail human frantically fleeing on the street, with several wandering zombies chasing from behind.
Evidently, this was a survivor who had risked venturing out for food, but his luck seemed poor.
Not only did he fail to find any food, he even encountered a zombies’ chase.
Rumble, rumble, rumble!
Upon hearing the sound of a car engine, the fleeing human survivor thought he was hallucinating from hunger.
But soon after, he saw ’Lightning One’ driving the heavy truck, heading in his direction.
"Help! Save me!"
Faced with the sudden appearance of ’Lightning One,’ this person grasped like a drowning man clutching at straws, frantically waving his hand for help.
’Lightning One’ steered directly towards him, crushing the zombies chasing the survivor into fragments.
"Brother, thank you so much; without you, I would’ve been caught and eaten by the zombies."
"I wonder if I can hitch a ride with you so we can escape together?"
Upon seeing the meat, the survivor’s eyes immediately lit up.
Although ’Lightning One’ didn’t agree to his request to ride together, he still looked at ’Lightning One’ with gratitude.
After all, in the apocalypse, helping others wasn’t common practice; even if someone died before one’s eyes, it would hardly matter.
He didn’t expect not only to be rescued, but also to receive a substantial piece of food out of the blue.
This made him extremely excited.
Watching ’Lightning One’ drive away, the survivor wasted no time in hugging and devouring the cooked python meat.
The meat aroma almost made him bite his tongue.
’Lightning One’ didn’t leave but secretly followed the survivor.
Seeing the survivor devouring the meat without any abnormal reactions until the next day, and his body that was weak from malnutrition appeared energized and glowing, Lu Chuan relaxed.
"It seems that the carcasses of giant beasts not only work for zombies like me, but humans can still be nourished greatly by consuming them!"
At Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan, through watching ’Lightning One,’ found immense joy.
Turning to look at Little Qiqi, who was doing homework nearby, the corner of Lu Chuan’s mouth curled up.
Great! The little one can finally eat meat!

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 128: Dad, I Want to Keep This Old Turtle as a Pet!
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 128: Dad, I Want to Keep This Old Turtle as a Pet!
"Hmm? What’s that smell? It’s so fragrant!"
In the early morning, Ji Ruxue, who was originally asleep, suddenly smelled a fragrance entering her nostrils, waking her up from her slumber.
Gulp~
Smelling the enticing aroma, Ji Ruxue instinctively swallowed her saliva, feeling both familiar and unfamiliar with this scent.
