After sitting up from the bed, her eyes, like searchlights, scanned the surroundings constantly, trying to locate the source of this fragrance.
Lu Chuan, busy in the kitchen, came over holding a bowl of meat porridge.
The rich aroma filling the room was precisely from the bowl of meat porridge in Lu Chuan’s hands.
Ji Ruxue’s eyes widened instantly upon seeing it.
"What... what is this?!"
"Today, we’re not eating fried rice with egg?!"
Looking at the deliciously fragrant meat porridge, Ji Ruxue felt an urge to cry for a moment.
No wonder she felt both familiar and unfamiliar with this aroma; it had been a long time since she last smelled the fragrance of meat.
After being reborn, she lived on milk powder every day. As she grew older, she could only eat fried rice with egg. Ji Ruxue was almost numb from it.
The long-lost aroma of meat made Ji Ruxue’s saliva involuntarily secrete.
Glossy, fragrant, sticky rice grains mingled with tender meat slices, just seeing it made one’s mouth water.
Taking the spoon from her dad’s hands, she began to gobble it down.
"It’s delicious! Boohoo~ This is what people should be eating. What kind of days was I living before!"
Eating the sweet meat porridge filled Ji Ruxue’s heart with happiness.
In the post-apocalyptic world, being able to have a meal was already an incredible fortune.
Having such hot and delicious meat porridge was an incredibly luxurious experience.
The sweet meat porridge entered her stomach, and Ji Ruxue felt a surge of energy throughout her body.
The tender meat slices from the mutated animals were succulent with every bite, like the most delicious delicacy in the world!
It had been a long time since Ji Ruxue had eaten such delicious porridge. For a moment, she gobbled it up like a storm sweeping away the clouds.
In no time, she had finished the entire large bowl of porridge.
"Dad! I want more!"
Ji Ruxue excitedly lifted the large bowl in front of her, holding it up to Lu Chuan with anticipation.
But Lu Chuan shook his head, not letting the little one continue eating.
Before, in the city, Lu Chuan had seen a survivor, extremely weak from hunger, become energetic and full of life the next day after eating cooked mutated giant python meat.
Little Qiqi is still young, and Lu Chuan worried that eating too much of this mutated animal meat would be too much for her.
Besides, in Lu Chuan’s view, this was the first time the little one had eaten meat, and he worried that she wouldn’t know when to stop because she hadn’t had it before. He worried that if she ate too much and hurt her stomach, it wouldn’t be worth it.
Seeing the little one still full of anticipation, Lu Chuan could only take out a pen and paper.
"Don’t worry; Dad made a lot of meat for you. I promise you’ll have meat every day from now on."
"But you must promise Dad to control your portions, don’t overeat and hurt yourself."
Seeing the note left by Lu Chuan, a hint of disappointment flashed in Ji Ruxue’s eyes.
She thought she could have another feast, but she didn’t expect she could only have one bowl.
"Oh, heavens, why was I reborn as a baby? I can’t even eat meat porridge freely..."
Although she was a bit unhappy for not being able to continue eating, Ji Ruxue’s heart was actually very satisfied.
After all, in such a devastated and resource-scarce world, having a bowl of hot meat porridge felt like a godly life.
For instance, Zhao Lin, who is an Evolver, had difficulty even getting enough to eat during the apocalypse.
After being brought to Sunshine District by her dad, it was the most carefree time Zhao Lin had since the apocalypse.
And Ji Ruxue also saw the note her dad left for her.
Dad was worried she would eat too much and overstuff herself.
Thinking of having meat every day in the future, Ji Ruxue’s heart was filled with anticipation.
Having meat every day, this is how life should be!
No!
This is practically a heavenly life!
Ji Ruxue remembered her past life’s self during this time; back then, she was struggling desperately for survival.
Not to mention moving from Sunshine District all the way to Qingshui Farm, just being able to walk a few more blocks safely was satisfactory.
As for a life like now, Ji Ruxue never dared to imagine it before; it was too carefree.
And so, Lu Chuan and Ji Ruxue gradually settled into their life at Qingshui Farm.
During this time, Lu Chuan controlled a large number of Corpse Puppets to inspect every inch of Qingshui Farm, eliminating any potential threats within.
So Lu Chuan no longer restricted the little one’s actions, letting her play freely within the farm’s perimeter.
Now, not only did he have second-tier Corpse Puppets, but he also had a third-tier Corpse Puppet.
With such formidable strength, Lu Chuan didn’t believe anything could breach his defenses.
After stabilizing Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan continued dispatching Corpse Puppets to the nearest city district from Qingshui Farm, which was Jiangnan City District, the southern part of Jianghai City.
Lu Chuan searched for other Evolved Zombies while continuing to collect various supplies, also gathering information about the city’s southern area’s environment.
As Lu Chuan controlled Corpse Puppets to patrol the city, suddenly, the Corpse Puppet guarding near the fish pond signaled a new disturbance.
Why was Little Qiqi at the fish pond!
Lu Chuan was shocked; the Old Turtle had been living underwater, rarely surfacing, causing him to almost overlook the mutated animal in the pond.
This Old Turtle had an incredibly strong bite force, which Lu Chuan had witnessed before; it could easily crush a Corpse Puppet’s bones.
Little Qiqi appearing here was extremely dangerous; given her small size, the mutated turtle in the pond could easily kill her with just one move.
Seeing this from a Corpse Puppet’s perspective, Lu Chuan was terrified, not daring to delay, and quickly ran towards the pond.
Quickly arriving at the pond, Lu Chuan immediately grabbed Ji Ruxue and retreated to a safe distance.
Then he took out a pen and paper and quickly wrote, "Little Qiqi, there’s danger near the pond; you can’t play here. You can play elsewhere."
Compared to the anxious Lu Chuan, Ji Ruxue remained very calm.
After being picked up by her dad, she still pointed at the pond calmly.
In the pond, there was now a large turtle shell.
Ji Ruxue then said to the Old Turtle basking in the water, "Dad, I want to keep this Old Turtle as a pet!"

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 129: Little Qiqi Is Right, These People Aren’t Worth Saving!
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 129: Little Qiqi Is Right, These People Aren’t Worth Saving!
Hearing the little one’s request, Lu Chuan was completely stunned.
For a moment, he suspected that his ears must be playing tricks on him.
Keeping a turtle as a pet?
Although he knew that children are very curious about other forms of life, Lu Chuan still couldn’t understand what the little guy saw in this old turtle.
This old turtle is so ugly, yet it managed to capture the little one’s attention?
Even wanting to keep this turtle as a pet?
Lu Chuan shook his head helplessly, then wrote in his notebook: "This turtle can bite, and its bite is strong enough to fracture a person’s leg bone in one go."
"Little Qiqi, be obedient, this old turtle is more dangerous than you think."
"Daddy promises to catch you some cute little animals as pets in the future, like bunnies or kittens, but let’s forget about this turtle."
Seeing this, Ji Ruxue shook her head, clearly not satisfied with the suggestion.
She reached out and held Lu Chuan’s arm, shaking it continuously, with a pitiful look in her eyes.
"No, Dad~ I want this turtle as my pet."
"Rest assured, I’m not going to enter the pond; I’ll only feed it from the shore, so there won’t be any danger."
Ji Ruxue said, looking at Lu Chuan pleadingly.
The reason Ji Ruxue insisted was because she was well aware of her past life memories.
Not all mutated fierce beasts would lose their minds after the apocalypse.
Some have relatively gentle temperaments and a deep bond with their owners.
Even after gaining evolutionary power, they not only wouldn’t harm their owners but would even protect them from harm!
In Ji Ruxue’s memory, there were many such fortunate ones in the past life.
By the late post-apocalypse, this world would face an invasion from across the starry sky, and the immense energy in the world would greatly increase.
This world would then give birth to numerous mysterious realms containing all sorts of peculiar treasures.
It was during her training in these mysterious realms that Ji Ruxue acquired a mysterious Ancient Beast Taming Technique!
Now, this turtle could choose to calmly stay in the fish pond without causing mindless slaughter for evolution.
Compared to other mutated fierce beasts, this turtle obviously retained some intelligence, making it relatively easier to tame.
And turtles have a very long lifespan; with continuous nurturing, it could eventually become a top-notch power and a great aid in the future.
Lu Chuan was already baffled by the new world he found himself in, let alone understanding what would happen after the apocalypse.
However, seeing Little Qiqi’s eager expression, Lu Chuan’s heart softened, and he reluctantly nodded in agreement.
The little one rarely begged him for anything, and this was the first time Lu Chuan saw Little Qiqi plead so earnestly for another creature.
Faced with the little one’s enthusiasm, Lu Chuan found it hard to refuse.
So Lu Chuan wrote directly: "Since you like this turtle so much, I’ll allow you to keep it as a pet."
"But Daddy reminds you not to get close to this big guy; always maintain a safe distance and only feed it from the shore."
With Lu Chuan’s consent, Ji Ruxue was overjoyed and nodded repeatedly: "Don’t worry, Dad, I promise I’ll pay attention to safety!"
Still concerned for the little one’s safety, Lu Chuan assigned ’Lightning One’ to follow Ji Ruxue to prevent any accidents.
...
The chaotic street.
A disheartened Zhao Lin searched toward Qingshui Farm to find Little Qiqi.
At this moment, Zhao Lin heard a series of urgent cries for help.
Initially, Zhao Lin, who had already given up hope on other humans, didn’t want to meddle, but his legs seemed to automatically navigate him toward the people.
Having died once, Zhao Lin’s combat power had become extremely strong.
These ordinary zombies were not even a match for him.
Almost instantly, several zombies chasing human survivors were completely killed by Zhao Lin’s powerful fists.
This sudden scene left the survivors in a daze.
"Thank you! Thank you for saving our lives!"
"Such strong power, could this really be one of those legendary Evolvers? Truly extraordinary!"
Several people walked toward Zhao Lin, continuously expressing their gratitude.
However, Zhao Lin remained cold throughout, merely glancing at them coldly as they approached him.
The chilling coldness in his eyes instantly froze the survivors in their tracks.
After casually saving these survivors, Zhao Lin didn’t concern himself further and walked toward Qingshui Farm.
However, at that moment, the survivors saved by Zhao Lin noticed he was wearing a police uniform.
"Please wait, since you’re wearing a police uniform, you must be a policeman, right?"
"You must know about the human Survivor Base, so why not escort us a bit?"
At these words, Zhao Lin’s lips curled into a cold smile: "Why should I?"
The saved survivors were struck with disbelief at Zhao Lin’s words, clearly feeling Zhao Lin shouldn’t speak this way.
"What are you saying? You are a policeman!"
"Since you’re a policeman, isn’t it your duty to protect us?"
"Moreover, you’re a powerful Evolver; these zombies mean nothing to you."
"We are all defenseless, and in such a dangerous world, we can only rely on police like you to protect us, surely you will escort us to the Survivor Base!"
The survivors, just saved by Zhao Lin, immediately began to accuse him.
Their ugly yet familiar faces reminded Zhao Lin of those at the police station before.
The depravity of humanity was fully evident in them.
Zhao Lin turned to leave without another word, but one of the survivors noticed the backpack Zhao Lin was carrying, his eyes flashing with greed.
"Since you, a policeman, refuse to escort us, you should at least provide us with some food and water."
"I think you should hand over all the food in your backpack; that’s what being a qualified policeman means!"
Zhao Lin paused his steps, then slowly turned to gaze at the people in front of him.
He had just saved them, and they wanted to stab him in the back, no different from those at the police office.
Looking at the survivors who kept pressuring him, Zhao Lin’s eyes flashed with cold light.
The next moment, he suddenly struck, punching the man in the chest.
The immense force sent the man flying, vomiting blood, killing him instantly.
"Ah!"
Seeing this, the remaining people looked terrified.
The commotion attracted several more zombies.
Zhao Lin, indifferent to the cries for help, turned to leave.
Little Qiqi was right; these people weren’t worth protecting.

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 130: Lightning One and Da Pang Advance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 130: Lightning One and Da Pang Advance!
On the other side, Lu Chuan was controlling the Corpse Puppet, exploring bit by bit throughout the city district.
The area of Jianghai City was extremely vast. Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppet to the city district closest to Qingshui Farm, which was near the Jiangnan City District of Jianghai City.
Now that Qingshui Farm had stabilized, Lu Chuan needed to continuously improve his own strength, so he continued dispatching the Corpse Puppets to search for new Evolved Zombies in the Jiangnan City District.
’Er Pang’ was left by Lu Chuan to guard the gate, so the Corpse Puppet that came to the Jiangnan City District this time was ’Tyrant One’, controlled by Lu Chuan.
’Tyrant One’ appeared extremely imposing, just like a real tyrant.
Moreover, its pair of arms had turned into something resembling sharp claws, capable of easily tearing through steel.
"Hmm? There’s a new discovery!"
Apart from the powerful ’Tyrant One’, Lu Chuan also brought a team of ordinary Corpse Puppets into the Jiangnan City District, dispersing to search for Evolved Zombies.
One of the scouting Corpse Puppets successfully found traces of an Evolved Zombie.
A slightly emaciated Agile Zombie was seen darting continuously along the street, seemingly searching for traces of humans.
Although this zombie in front was a Tier One Zombie, Lu Chuan was nonetheless pleased.
Bang bang bang!
The Tyrant quickly dashed towards the Agile Zombie, and shortly arrived at the other end of the street.
The Tier One Evolved Zombie that was recklessly wandering the street began to tremble uncontrollably after sensing the powerful presence of ’Tyrant One’.
The gap between the two was a full major realm; this Tier One Agile Zombie was by no means a match for Tyrant One.
Next, to Lu Chuan’s slight amazement, the Tier One Evolved Zombie fled into the distance without saying a word.
Watching the frantically escaping Agile Zombie, Lu Chuan’s lips curled into a cold smile.
Then, controlling ’Tyrant One’, he charged towards the opponent with terrifying force, as if sweeping everything before him.
Feeling the tyrant’s oppressive aura, the ordinary zombies were overwhelmed and began retreating helplessly, some even collapsing on the ground.
However, Lu Chuan’s target was clear: the agile zombie fleeing at high speed.
Even though it was an Agile Zombie, ’Tyrant One’ was a Tier Two Zombie, and in terms of speed, it was nearly on par with such Agile Zombies.
The key difference was that the Corpse Puppet was directly controlled by him, showing the clear distinction between having a brain and being brainless.
’Tyrant One’ was always able to pursue using the shortest path, and even though the Agile Zombie was fleeing desperately, it was constantly kept in close pursuit by ’Tyrant One’.
Bang bang bang!
As a Tier Two Evolved Zombie, ’Tyrant One’, with its massive stature, plowed through as if sweeping away fallen leaves in autumn, directly smashing aside vehicles that stood on the street.
’Tyrant One’s’ speed was not at a disadvantage to the Agile Zombie, and soon the work was done as it caught up with the opponent.
The Agile Zombie tried one last act of resistance, hastily employing its ghostly speed to approach ’Tyrant One’.
Lu Chuan, seeing this, let out a cold smile and delivered a heavy punch to the Agile Zombie’s body.
The terror-inducing power emanating from ’Tyrant One’s’ claws sent the Tier One Agile Zombie flying backward.
The gap in realms ended the battle very quickly.
’Tyrant One’, controlled by Lu Chuan, approached the Agile Zombie, the recent strike having left it half-dead, its side completely caved in.
Splatter!
Lu Chuan directly controlled ’Tyrant One’, piercing through the Tier One Zombie’s skull to extract the Crystal Core inside.
Having obtained a Crystal Core, Lu Chuan was not satisfied and continued to control ’Tyrant One’ to commence a new round of hunting.
This time, he set the target very low, deciding not to let any Tier One Evolved Zombies off the hook since Tier Two Zombies weren’t encountered.
Anyway, he could use Crystal Cores to feed his Corpse Puppets later.
Perhaps due to the dense population in this area leading to a large zombie count, and the fact that it hadn’t been hunted.
Before long, Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet team detected the traces of several Tier One Zombies in the area one after another.
’Tyrant One’ acted like a diligent worker, traveling from location to location under Lu Chuan’s control.
Due to its formidable combat strength, these Tier One Evolved Zombies were no match for it.
Even the most defensively strong Tier One Tank Type Zombies could only be ripped apart under the terrifying claws of this Tier Two Tyrant.
Upon seeing Tyrant One appear, the survivors living in this region were utterly shocked.
The continuous zombie roars left them clueless about what was happening outside.
They could only feel powerful presences passing by, hiding in shelters and secretly praying for the battles outside to end soon.
The successive battles rendered ’Tyrant One’s’ clothing tattered, but this time the Corpse Puppet team returned to Qingshui Farm with a bounty of Crystal Cores.
Receiving the Crystal Cores from ’Tyrant One’, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
Afterward, he also called ’Lightning One’ and ’Da Pang’ to his side.
As Evolved Zombies that had followed him the longest, ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning One’ had commendably contributed to many achievements.
Over such a long period of companionship, Lu Chuan had developed some affection for these two Corpse Puppets.
Previously, he worried whether upgrades in power would lead to replacing these old companions, but now those concerns were unnecessary.
He took out several Crystal Cores and then fed them to ’Lightning One’ and ’Da Pang’.
Feeling the surging aura emerging from them both, Lu Chuan couldn’t resist rubbing his hands in excitement.
Finally, the two Evolved Zombies that had been with him the longest could now advance.
Boom! Boom!
Vast energy erupted within the two Evolved Zombies, the powerful fluctuations from their advancement causing the bodies of some ordinary Corpse Puppets nearby to tremble.
The Agile Zombie, after breaking into Tier Two, showed no significant change in body size compared to before.
However, its muscles visibly became more condensed, its entire body packed with explosive strength.
Moreover, the speed at which this Agile Zombies’ legs moved was extreme, propelling it forward like a cannonball!
Next to it, ’Da Pang’, in front of Luo Chuan, experienced an observable increase in body size.
Each second passed witnessing ’Da Pang’s’ body growing significantly larger.
In mere moments, ’Da Pang’s’ size became comparable to the previous ’Er Pang’.
Lu Chuan controlled ’Da Pang’ to execute a set of martial arts on the open ground, the terrifying force creating air explosions, one punch after another thundering like bursts of thunder.

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 131: Contract! Old Turtle Accepts Its Master!
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 131: Contract! Old Turtle Accepts Its Master!
With the promotion of Da Pang and Lightning One, Lu Chuan obtained two Tier-2 Corpse Puppets.
This boosted the combat power of the entire Qingshui Farm by another level!
Seeing the powerful strength of these two Corpse Puppets after their promotion, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
It seems that my method of enhancing Corpse Puppet strength by feeding them Crystal Cores is indeed very viable.
Lu Chuan climbed to a tower in the farm and looked down. Currently, the farm is covered with his Corpse Puppets.
These Corpse Puppets are either responsible for guarding or engaged in the maintenance of the farm or cultivation of the land.
In just a few days, the farm, which originally looked somewhat rundown and abandoned, has been completely revitalized.
Lu Chuan then conducted a simple tally of the Corpse Puppets under his control.
Currently, only one of the Corpse Puppets has successfully reached Tier-3, which is ’Er Pang’, fed with two Mutated Giant Beast Crystal Cores.
As a Tank Type Zombie, ’Er Pang’ has grown incredibly tough scales after breaking through to Tier-3.
These resilient scales can even block bullets, like wearing extremely heavy armor, covering the whole body except the head, giving ’Er Pang’ terrifying defensive power!
Combined with the massive physique and terrifying Giant Strength, among the many Corpse Puppets, ’Er Pang’ is undoubtedly the most powerful in combat.
Paired with the giant metal club weighing over a ton, it’s simply like an invincible War God!
The number of Tier-2 Corpse Puppets reached three after ’Lightning One’ and ’Da Pang’ evolved!
The three zombies followed different evolutionary paths: Agile Zombie ’Lightning One’, Tank Zombie ’Da Pang’, and Tyrant Zombie ’Tyrant One’.
Each Corpse Puppet has a different evolutionary route, and the cooperation between different types of Corpse Puppets can strengthen their team’s combat power!
As for the Tier-1 evolved Corpse Puppets, because of the lower threshold, Lu Chuan controls more, totaling five!
They comprise three Agile Zombies and two Tank Zombies.
After all, these two types of evolved zombies are the most common in the apocalypse.
But at least during this current period, these Tier-1 evolved zombies still possess certain combat capabilities.
Lu Chuan’s eyes were full of excitement; unconsciously, he had already accumulated so much wealth!
He still remembered at the start of the Blood Moon, he could only control one or two ordinary zombies, but now he has so many evolved zombies!
Originally, after traversing to this unfamiliar world and inexplicably becoming a zombie, Lu Chuan only thought of muddling through life.
But unexpectedly, within such a short time, his Corpse Puppet army had grown stronger!
Although Lu Chuan was only a worker in his previous life, as a man, he still harbored ambition.
"Though this apocalypse is dangerous, it seems I might have the power for domination!"
The gradually strengthening power made Lu Chuan more confident.
This apocalypse has already turned chaotic; human societal order has long collapsed.
Mass numbers of humans have become zombies, which is practically a boon for someone like him who can control zombies.
Unknowingly, Lu Chuan’s mindset had shifted.
Originally, he just wanted to find stability in this apocalypse with Little Qiqi, but now he considers possibly establishing a powerful zombie kingdom.
Having strong enough power enables one to protect themselves in this world; if I become the true Corpse King, with countless zombies under my command, Little Qiqi’s safety will be truly assured.
Little Qiqi, as my apple of the eye, would then be the princess of the entire zombie kingdom!
...
While Lu Chuan was envisioning a glorious future, Ji Ruxue was bringing Mutated Giant Python meat to the pond.
Seeing the turtle in the pond, leisurely basking in the sun, Ji Ruxue’s lips curled into a smile.
The massive turtle in front, though a Mutated Fierce Beast, clearly belongs to the intelligent type among Mutant Beasts.
When Ji Ruxue appeared by the pond, the sunbathing turtle glanced at her indifferently.
After all, unless Ji Ruxue unleashes her powers, no one would believe that this seemingly one-year-old infant could be a Tier-3 Evolver.
To the Mutated Old Turtle, Ji Ruxue’s innocent and cute appearance posed no threat.
However, Ji Ruxue soon tossed a piece of Mutated Giant Python meat into the air and dropped it into the water.
The rich bloody scent instantly spread through the murky pond water, making the Mutated Turtle widen its eyes and rush towards the python meat.
Opening its blood-red maw, it swallowed the chunk of python meat, even crushing the bones.
Ji Ruxue noticed the originally calm eyes of the giant turtle gleam with light after devouring the python flesh.
The body of the Tier-2 Mutated Golden Python contains substantial energy, and after tasting a bit, the Mutated Turtle seemed reluctant to part.
Ji Ruxue smiled slightly and threw another piece of meat into the pond, quickly devoured by the Mutated Giant Turtle.
For three days, Ji Ruxue continuously fed it, secretly infusing her blood into the python meat.
Having not eaten for a while, the Mutated Old Turtle unsuspectingly gobbled each piece, greatly satisfied by the energy within the python.
On the third day, as Ji Ruxue tossed the meat into the air, a splash of water rose.
The giant turtle leaped from the pond, catching the python meat mid-air.
After landing back in the water, its eyes locked onto Ji Ruxue, still filled with longing.
"It’s time!"
Ji Ruxue’s lips curved into a smile, then searched her mind for the Ancient Beast Taming Secret Technique she cultivated in her last life.
Ji Ruxue’s palm gathered Energy Factor, forming a mark.
While the turtle’s forehead also revealed a crimson mark, vivid and striking.
At the moment the mark appeared, Ji Ruxue clearly felt a connection between her and the giant turtle.
Though they are different species, Ji Ruxue felt a familiar bond with the turtle.
With the enhancement of the Ancient Beast Taming Technique, Ji Ruxue and the Mutated Turtle have signed a contract-like agreement.
Ji Ruxue can now issue simple commands to the Mutated Old Turtle.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 132: Building a Playground for the Little One!
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 132: Building a Playground for the Little One!
"Hehe, little turtle, just be happy you get to follow me, the Emperor."
Ji Ruxue looked at the mutated Old Turtle she had just tamed before her and felt very pleased.
Maybe it was because this Mutated Giant Turtle hadn’t had anything to eat at the abandoned farm for a long time, so in just three days, it succumbed to the allure of the mutated giant python’s meat.
Because this mutated giant turtle had let down its guard with Ji Ruxue, she was able to tame it quite easily.
Ji Ruxue still remembered that in her past life, there were many extremely powerful Fierce Beasts, among which a Black Tortoise was a mighty Beast Emperor level being!
The size of that giant turtle was so terrifying it was like an island, and its slightest movement could trigger an earthquake or tsunami.
Such a powerful giant beast in the apocalyptic world had an extremely terrifying combat power.
However, even a mighty Beast Emperor level existence evolved step by step.
Ji Ruxue planned to nurture this mutated Old Turtle into a being like that Black Tortoise in the future.
"With a powerful giant turtle, exploring the secret realms within the East Sea would be much more convenient!"
Ji Ruxue remembered clearly that in the vast East Sea, many secrets were hidden beneath the waves.
In her past life, she missed many opportunities for various reasons, but now with her past life’s memories and experience, she was sure she could grow faster and stronger than before. She vowed to explore it thoroughly this time!
Maybe she could even find some heaven-defying treasures in that mysterious East Sea, which would be best if it could restore her father to a flesh and blood body!
The zombie crisis was just beginning, and with the emergence of the Blood Moon, the whole world would undergo a huge transformation, and anything could happen.
If humans could randomly turn into zombies, Ji Ruxue believed that there must be a way for zombies to become human.
After all, some zombies that evolved to a later stage had already regained intelligence, so returning to a flesh and blood body didn’t seem like a dream.
"Although father is a zombie, he retained human consciousness, which means he can’t fit into either the human or zombie factions."
"I believe father must feel very lonely and certainly wants to regain his flesh and blood body."
With a determined look, Ji Ruxue waved her small fists. She made a silent vow: "Father, don’t worry, I will definitely help you achieve this goal!"
Then Ji Ruxue turned her gaze to the huge mutated giant turtle before her.
In her past life, Ji Ruxue obtained the Ancient Beast Taming Technique within a secret realm and naturally had methods to train her pet beasts to become stronger, even cultivation techniques for Fierce Beasts!
With so many resources at hand, Ji Ruxue was confident that in this life, she could certainly develop the turtle into a powerful Fierce Beast like the Black Tortoise.
...
On the other side, Lu Chuan stood outside the vegetable plot, watching the seeds sown over time gradually sprout, with a touch of green already dotting the soil.
Seeing the seeds sprout, Lu Chuan was very happy.
"It seems the farming experience in my memory is proving useful at this time!"
"At this rate of growth, it won’t be long before the vegetable plot becomes lushly green, and Little Qiqi can eat fresh vegetables."
Under the work of many ordinary zombies, the vegetable plot had started to develop positively, and Lu Chuan further reinforced the outer walls.
Originally, this world was a law-based society, and even the outskirts of Jianghai City were not lawless lands.
The walls of Qingshui Farm were initially made with simple wooden stakes and wire mesh, merely to mark the farm’s territory.
Although the wire mesh was electrified, the problem was that three months into the apocalypse, even the power plants exploded and went out of operation due to being unmanned.
The whole of Jianghai City had been without power for quite some time, and Lu Chuan did not have enough electricity to supply the walls.
So for reinforcing the walls, Lu Chuan chose the most traditional way, which was to stack stones directly.
Zombies have no emotional fluctuations and won’t feel hunger or fatigue, so lifting stones without complaint makes them the best labor force.
Moreover, with many second-tier evolved zombies present, especially ’Da Pang’ and ’Er Pang,’ the tank-type zombies with terrifying Giant Strength, lifting boulders becomes very easy, accelerating the speed of reinforcing the walls several times directly!
Lu Chuan intended to use these boulders to build a high wall surrounding the entire farm.
Wooden stakes and wire mesh were too low in defense against zombies and mutated giant beasts in the apocalypse.
Without such a solid wall for defense, Lu Chuan always felt uneasy.
Although there were many of his Corpse Puppets patrolling the farm, the farm’s area was so vast that Lu Chuan worried there might be oversights with the patrolling of the Corpse Puppets alone.
If a towering city wall could be built, it would undoubtedly greatly increase defense.
Lu Chuan manipulated numerous Corpse Puppets to work while continuously switching perspectives to observe the surroundings of the farm.
"Little Qiqi has gone to find that Old Turtle again."
From the perspective of ’Lightning One,’ Lu Chuan could see Little Qiqi often ran to the pond to play with the Old Turtle.
Originally, Lu Chuan was worried that this mutated giant turtle might pose a threat to Little Qiqi, so he specifically had Corpse Puppets guard closely.
But over time, Lu Chuan found that this ferocious-looking mutated giant turtle turned out to be very gentle in front of Little Qiqi!
Lu Chuan didn’t expect this mutated giant turtle to have two faces.
He still remembered the first time his Corpse Puppet encountered the turtle, it got its leg bitten off...
But this is good as well, at least the child’s safety wouldn’t be threatened.
However, seeing the child come to play with the mutated giant turtle out of boredom, Lu Chuan felt a bit guilty.
"It seems Little Qiqi must be too bored on the farm, so much that she seeks the mutated giant turtle for entertainment..."
In Lu Chuan’s view, the reason the child often sought out the mutated giant turtle to play with was certainly because the farm was full of zombies.
Without any companions for proper communication, Little Qiqi turned to other creatures, with the pond’s giant turtle being the best option.
"Anyway, there’s plenty of empty space here, so I might as well build an amusement park for Little Qiqi, letting her play freely, so she won’t find life here boring!"
Children are naturally fond of play, and Lu Chuan believed Little Qiqi was no exception.
With this in mind, Lu Chuan immediately began to prepare.
Now that the world had entered the apocalypse, Jianghai City’s amusement parks had long been abandoned.
Conveniently, he could have the Corpse Puppets dismantle some existing amusement facilities to assemble a playground just for the child!

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 133: Invisibility Ability Evolver
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 133: Invisibility Ability Evolver
Early in the morning, the sound of a truck engine broke the silence of the suburbs.
’Lightning One’ drove a large truck into Qingshui Farm, filled to the brim with amusement park parts.
These were all brought back from the amusement park in the city by Lu Chuan controlling the Corpse Puppets.
Lu Chuan also walked out of the house at this time.
Nowadays, around the residential area of Qingshui Farm’s center, Lu Chuan has already set up some of the entertainment facilities, including slides, trampolines, and rocking rides suitable for children.
However, due to the post-apocalyptic situation, the rocking rides can no longer be started electrically, so Lu Chuan directly found two Corpse Puppets to rock the rides for the little ones.
Although the way of starting them has changed a bit, the feeling after getting on them is still not much different.
These amusement facilities were continuously moved back from the amusement park by Lu Chuan during this period, controlling the Corpse Puppets.
Lu Chuan then controlled a group of Corpse Puppets to unload the cargo beside the truck and assembled it on a piece of empty land inside the farm.
With the power of many, Lu Chuan, who now has a large number of Corpse Puppets, can complete whatever he wants quickly.
Although the combat power of these ordinary Corpse Puppets is not strong, they are still fine for doing work.
In no time at all, this amusement facility was successfully assembled, adding a unique landscape to Qingshui Farm.
This time, Lu Chuan brought back a carousel; just these few horses took two trips by ’Lightning One’ alone.
During the assembly process at Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan made simple modifications to the original basis of this carousel.
Because this amusement facility needs electricity to drive, but now electricity is a very scarce resource in the apocalypse.
Even though Qingshui Farm has engines, Lu Chuan does not dare to squander the electricity recklessly.
The limited amount of power needs to be used after dark, and the oil for power generation needs to be stored up for contingency.
Due to the lack of electricity, Lu Chuan directly thought up a new method during the installation process.
What Lu Chuan lacks the least now is manpower, so he directly converted this electrically driven carousel into a manpower-driven one.
He found a group of Corpse Puppets to stand beside the carousel, having these Corpse Puppets manually push the carousel.
After all, these Corpse Puppets won’t feel tired or hungry, and they are all over the streets and can be replenished anytime, anywhere.
After installing the carousel, Lu Chuan personally took to the field to test it, sitting on the carousel and controlling the Corpse Puppets to continuously push the supporting frame of the machine.
Under the vigorous pushing of the zombies, this carousel began to slowly turn, operating no differently from normal conditions.
Looking at the facility in front of him, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
"I really am a genius!"
"A few more amusement facilities and it should be enough."
Lu Chuan surveyed the gradually forming small amusement park at Qingshui Farm, feeling very proud for a moment.
Being able to set up such a small amusement park in the apocalypse, besides himself with the ability to control zombies, probably no one else could do it.
Now Little Qiqi won’t be lonely at Qingshui Farm, the little fellow will definitely have a great time!
Although Lu Chuan has never raised a child, he remembers being very envious of these amusement parks when he was little.
Because he lived with his grandparents in the countryside as a child, Lu Chuan could only imagine the facilities in amusement parks through TV and flyers.
So in Lu Chuan’s view, for a child like Little Qiqi, who is at the age of being lively and active, this kind of small amusement park is just perfect.
It’s just that...
Ji Ruxue, looking through the window at Lu Chuan busy outside, rubbed her temples helplessly.
"Is Dad... planning to build a theme park for me?!"
Ji Ruxue shook her head with a wry smile.
If she were a child, perhaps she would have been really happy with these entertainment facilities.
As an orphan, Ji Ruxue did imagine in her childhood that someday she would freely play in an amusement park, enjoy various activities without worrying about time and money.
But that was many years ago...
These are things only children would like; as an empress in her past life, she’s not interested in such things.
However, Ji Ruxue knows that her dad does all this to make her happy.
Watching her busy dad below, Ji Ruxue decided that even if she wasn’t interested in these entertainment facilities, she would still cooperate well at that time, so as not to waste her father’s painstaking efforts.
As a reborn empress, Ji Ruxue has experienced various life-and-death tests in the brutal apocalypse of her previous life, but she has never experienced being truly cared for and cherished by anyone.
Ji Ruxue still enjoys this feeling of being cherished by someone.
...
’Lightning One’ had just finished unloading a truckload of goods and was directed by Lu Chuan to drive back to the Jiangnan City District.
It then drove smoothly into an amusement park.
"Are you kidding me, why is this guy here again?!"
"The point is, why is this guy moving these amusement facilities? Does he plan to set up his own amusement park at home?!"
At this moment, an Evolver who had awakened invisibility ability was lurking in the shadows, observing every move of ’Lightning One’.
He had seen ’Lightning One’ several times before, and for the past few days, ’Lightning One’ has been transporting amusement facilities, which is not something normal people would do in the apocalypse.
Seeing ’Lightning One’s’ unusual behavior, this Evolver couldn’t help but feel very surprised.
After the apocalypse broke out, he had seen many survivors fight fiercely over a bottle of mineral water, or push their companions into the zombies’ mouths for a loaf of bread.
Once the apocalypse broke out, humanity seemed to disappear among people.
But even though he considered himself well-versed in many things, this odd situation was something he saw for the first time.
The apocalypse has already broken out, yet someone is not transporting life-saving survival supplies but instead is running to the amusement park to transport amusement facilities?
In the apocalypse, is someone still thinking of opening an amusement park?
Are they planning to charge zombies for tickets too?!
Watching ’Lightning One’, who kept transporting the amusement facilities, this invisible survivor was also at a loss.
If the Evolver knew that the figure continuously transporting amusement park facilities was a zombie, he might as well have dropped his jaw in shock.
’Lightning One’ was still wearing a full-face motorcycle helmet, a loose coat, and even gloves.
Thanks to Lu Chuan’s dressing, ’Lightning One’ looked no different from a human, and even this invisible Evolver did not notice anything suspicious during his observations in recent days.

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 134: Has the World Gone Mad? Even Zombies Have Learned to Farm?
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 134: Has the World Gone Mad? Even Zombies Have Learned to Farm?
As an Evolver, Li Ying’s Invisibility Ability enabled him to live relatively peacefully in the post-apocalypse.
Though his combat prowess wasn’t as strong as other Evolvers’, he managed to protect himself among zombies without much issue.
Leveraging his talent for Invisibility, Li Ying ventured into hordes of zombies to scavenge for supplies, and he had even infiltrated the survivor team for food.
He had encountered mutated Evolved Zombies and met other human Evolvers while witnessing the extent of human malice unleashed after the apocalypse.
But it was his first time seeing someone not load up on food supplies but rather haul amusement park facilities.
It’s crucial to know that driving in the apocalypse is extremely perilous, not only because of zombies trailing you but also humans targeting you.
Moreover, gasoline is an extremely rare resource during the apocalypse, using it to haul amusement park gear seems incredibly extravagant!
And this has been happening several times over.
Barely finished transporting the carousel and back at it again, just how obsessed is this guy with amusement parks?!
"Those hundreds of pounds of metal equipment were effortlessly lifted by him, looks like this guy’s an Evolver too."
"But what exactly does he intend to do?"
Li Ying furrowed his brows slightly, his eyes full of confusion.
’Lightning One’ hasn’t revealed its unique Evolved Zombie ability, but as a second-stage Evolved Zombie, its physical prowess caught Li Ying’s attention.
The unusual behavior of ’Lightning One’ left Li Ying baffled, why would an Evolver be transporting amusement facilities here? It seemed odd no matter how he thought about it.
Li Ying immediately cloaked himself in invisibility and approached ’Lightning One’.
"Huh? Does this guy not need to breathe? Why is there no fog at all on his helmet?"
Because ’Lightning One’ wore a full-cover helmet, Li Ying couldn’t see its features clearly.
After getting closer, Li Ying noticed the helmet was unexpectedly clean, miraculously fog-free.
This puzzled Li Ying; the weather was fit for wearing short sleeves, yet this Evolver wore a thick coat and engaged in manual work.
Even so, he was still wearing the fully-covered helmet, even if to guard against zombies, it seemed overly cautious, with no intention of even slightly raising the visor?
Screech!
While putting the equipment in the truck, ’Lightning One’ accidentally had his shirt inside torn by barbed wire.
However, ’Lightning One’ didn’t mind and continued executing Lu Chuan’s orders.
This scene, however, was seen by Li Ying not far away.
His pupils shrank abruptly; he covered his mouth with both hands to prevent a shout.
Under ’Lightning One’s’ torn shirt, he saw a menacing bite mark!
"How could this be possible? Is this guy a zombie?!"
Li Ying felt his brain short-circuit; he didn’t expect the real identity of the person he’d observed for days to be a zombie!
The bite mark on ’Lightning One’s’ abdomen was the remnant of when he was bitten and mutated by zombies initially,
Although he has now evolved to the second stage, the vicious wound remains far from fully healed, looking unsettling.
Since the apocalypse began, Li Ying had never heard of someone bitten by zombies recovering.
There can only be one possibility: this guy is truly a zombie!
No wonder, in such a hot working environment, this guy’s motorcycle visor has no fog whatsoever since zombies don’t need to breathe!
After a brief shock, Li Ying suspiciously glanced at the parked truck nearby.
"Seriously? Zombies can drive now?!"
"Moreover, driving this truck requires a B2 license; even before the apocalypse, I only had a C1!"
Li Ying felt like his brain was inadequate, in his mind, zombies were just mindless bloodthirsty creatures, since when did they have this skill?
And what do zombies need amusement facilities for?
Could these monsters require entertainment as well?!
The scenes before Li Ying left him utterly perplexed.
Meanwhile, ’Lightning One’ had loaded the equipment and proceeded to drive back to Qingshui Farm.
While driving past Li Ying, Li Ying used all his strength to climb onto the truck’s roof.
"I have to see what this zombie is up to!"
Relying on his Invisibility Ability, Li Ying had infiltrated various danger zones since the apocalypse, always leaving unscathed.
Even though this zombie defied previous perceptions, he felt no fear.
Li Ying clung to the top of the truck, riding all the way to Qingshui Farm.
Only when he saw ’Er Pang’ at the entrance, resembling a mountain, was he scared senseless.
"Is this a Tank Type Evolved Zombie? But why is it so terrifyingly huge?"
"Could it be... this creature has already evolved to the third stage?!"
Li Ying gulped nervously, a third-stage Tank Type Evolved Zombie guarding the entrance, Qingshui Farm seemed too surreal!
Due to Li Ying’s invisibility, these Corpse Puppets failed to notice his presence, allowing ’Lightning One’ to drive straight into the farm’s interior.
Faced with the scene ahead, Li Ying froze in place, realizing he had been amazed far too soon.
Within Qingshui Farm, he spotted a vegetable plot, and the soil was already greening up, clearly indicating that planted crops had successfully sprouted, possibly reaching maturity shortly.
The most absurd thing was, the ones working the fields weren’t the former farmers, but terrifying zombies!
Since this was the farm’s internal area, Lu Chuan hadn’t equipped them with helmets or other gear.
Skeleton-like bodies, crimson pupils, cyan-black veins, and coarse hair, alongside numerous terrifying wounds—their appearances leave no doubt that these figures were all zombies!
Li Ying felt his brain about to crash, losing the ability to think.
He couldn’t trust his eyes.
The city outskirts farm wasn’t worked by humans but mindless, undead zombies!
Not only were these zombies farming, but shockingly, crops were actually sprouting?!
Has the world gone mad?!
Even zombies know how to farm?
Witnessing these scenes, Li Ying felt his worldview collapsing.
Where has this truck led me?
Is this still the apocalypse I am familiar with?!

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 135: Did These Zombies Build an Amusement Park for This Little Girl?
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 135: Did These Zombies Build an Amusement Park for This Little Girl?
Have I been on the roof of the car for too long, blown by the cold wind, leading to problems in my brain?
Not only did I see zombies driving trucks, but I also saw zombies farming?!
Can it get any more ridiculous?!
However, after a brief shock, Li Ying’s face instantly turned grim, filled with fear in his eyes.
"When did zombies evolve to such an extent? They’re practically indistinguishable from humans!"
"If you don’t observe carefully, you can’t even tell whether these figures are humans or zombies!"
The entire world has fallen into an apocalyptic crisis, billions have turned into zombies, and the number of human survivors continues to decrease over time.
If this situation continues to develop, won’t these zombies replace humans and become a new race on the planet?!
Thinking of this made Li Ying’s hands and feet instantly feel cold, his blood seemed to freeze.
If things really develop as he imagines, where will humans find space to survive?!
Now the life of human survivors is already extremely difficult; if these zombies continue to evolve, there won’t be any space for normal humans to live in the future!
...
At Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan was inspecting the vegetable field at the moment. The seeds planted earlier had started to sprout, and it wouldn’t be long before vegetables could grow.
The truck returned to Qingshui Farm, and Lu Chuan controlled ’Lightning One’ to start unloading with the other Corpse Puppets.
Seeing zombies pouring in from all directions, Li Ying, lying on top of the truck, panicked for a moment.
But he quickly realized that he was still in invisibility mode, meaning these zombies were not after him.
Li Ying breathed a sigh of relief, then jumped off the truck and hurriedly dashed to the side.
He then saw these zombies starting to unload the cargo. If it weren’t for their ferocious faces, Li Ying might have thought he was at some unloading site...
"In such a big forest, there’s all sorts of birds. What do they plan to do by bringing these amusement park facilities back?"
After coming to his senses, Li Ying again forgot his fear. Driven by curiosity, he followed behind these Corpse Puppets, heading towards the factory interior.
Soon, Li Ying was stunned by the scene in front of him.
He never imagined that these zombies had actually built a small amusement park within the farm!
The amusement park facilities that had been moved earlier were reassembled at Qingshui Farm.
What do these zombies plan to do?
Could they really be trying to build an amusement park?
That’s too absurd, isn’t it?!
Li Ying was dumbfounded at the moment. Along the way, he thought about many possibilities, even wildly speculating that these zombies experienced some mysterious evolution.
For instance, zombies awakening special abilities that could further process this equipment into some kind of super weapon.
Yet he never expected that the zombies brought back these amusement park facilities just to rebuild an amusement park!
The crucial point is that a group of zombies is building an amusement park...who’s it for?!
Could it be that after eating too much human flesh, the zombies need to decompress?
Then why bother going to such great lengths to move these facilities to the farm? Why not just go play in the city?
You are zombies yourselves, what is there to be afraid of?!
Li Ying found it hard to comprehend the scenes in front of him, it was completely beyond his understanding.
Just then, a little girl walked out from the residential area of the farm.
This little girl looked very petite and cute, but what shocked Li Ying most was that she was human!
Glossy and smooth black hair, fair skin, rosy cheeks, and those striking black-and-white eyes all marked this little girl’s human identity.
The little one was extremely cute, like a doll, and her clothes were very clean and tidy.
Such a sight was common before the apocalypse, but the problem now was the apocalypse.
Even adults find it extremely difficult to live decently in this apocalypse, let alone such a small girl.
The most crucial point...there are zombies everywhere here?!
A human little girl appears in a zombie-infested farm, isn’t this scene too eerie?!
Li Ying frowned and then looked at the amusement park not far away, momentarily stunned on the spot.
A bold hypothesis emerged in Li Ying’s mind.
Could it be...
The amusement park at the farm was built by these zombies for this little girl?
Impossible! Absolutely impossible!
As soon as the thought arose, Li Ying frantically shook his head.
"I really must have brain issues to have such thoughts!"
"A group of brainless zombies only interested in blood, how could they possibly build an amusement park for a little girl?"
"That’s too niche, isn’t it?!"
Thinking of this made Li Ying laugh softly, secretly wondering at how his imagination was growing wilder.
Although now it seems somewhat far-fetched and unrealistic that the park was specifically built by zombies for the little girl.
Li Ying was still unbelievably curious. Clearly, they are different species, but it’s a fact that this little girl lives with zombies.
From the apocalypse to now, Li Ying had lost count of how many scenes he’s seen of zombies eating humans.
These zombies are extremely ferocious and terrifying, once they find humans, they would kill non-stop like crazy.
He had never heard of zombies living peacefully with humans, as these zombies originally have a mysterious desire for human flesh.
But thinking about it, he had already seen many strange things.
Zombies can drive trucks and farm now, so perhaps this isn’t incomprehensible, at least it’s within the range he can accept...
However, Li Ying was extremely curious about this little girl’s identity.
This little one lives in a farm filled with zombies and can still remain so calm, proving she’s no ordinary infant.
If it were a normal child, they would probably have been crying their lungs out by now.
Curious about Ji Ruxue’s identity, Li Ying decided to follow from afar.
He wanted to see what else at the Qingshui Farm was beyond his knowledge, how bizarre could things get.
Subsequently, Li Ying followed behind Ji Ruxue, heading towards the direction of the pond.
To his surprise, this little one showed no emotional fluctuation facing so many ferocious and terrifying zombies!

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 136: Could This Little Girl Be Commanding the Zombies?
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 136: Could This Little Girl Be Commanding the Zombies?
By the fish pond at Qingshui Farm, Ji Ruxue was feeding mutated old turtle with a huge basket of giant python meat.
The enormous turtle shell occasionally stirred waves in the pond.
Ever since Ji Ruxue and this giant turtle signed a contract, although they were different species, they could communicate simply through intention.
Ji Ruxue continuously threw the blood and flesh of the mutated giant python into the water, causing splashes one after another.
Looking at the giant turtle in front of her, Ji Ruxue nodded in satisfaction; since signing the contract, she had been communicating with the turtle through intention.
During these days, Ji Ruxue had already taught the breathing technique to this old turtle.
And the reason this guy was able to be so quiet lately was because it was constantly cultivating in the water.
Li Ying observed this scene from not far away.
He saw the little girl come to the side of the pool, and instead of attacking, the enormous mutated giant turtle behaved like a dog trying to be friendly...
Li Ying was stunned for a moment, unable to believe his eyes.
This little girl lives among so many zombies, and now even the mutated fierce beasts seem to have a very close relationship with her?
Seeing Ji Ruxue pet this giant turtle like a pet, Li Ying’s scalp tingled.
"What is the origin of this little girl? How can she be in such harmony among these zombies and mutated beasts?!"
Li Ying furrowed his brows tightly, having a feeling that the little girl probably harbors a huge secret.
It’s very likely that the eeriness of Qingshui Farm is closely related to this little girl!
Li Ying quietly moved closer to Ji Ruxue, wanting to observe up close to see whether this little girl truly is human.
After all, given all the phenomena the little girl has exhibited, she really doesn’t seem like a normal human.
Moreover, as Li Ying made his way here, he noticed that the zombies at Qingshui Farm seemed to act not much different from humans.
Li Ying even started to suspect whether the little girl could be some kind of new mutated zombie...
"Hm? Something’s wrong?!"
Li Ying just approached a bit when Ji Ruxue keenly sensed something was off.
Ji Ruxue slightly frowned and then scanned the area with Telekinesis, instantly catching Li Ying’s presence.
"Daddy’s defenses are so tight, yet a human has infiltrated the farm?!"
Ji Ruxue was greatly shocked; she never expected someone could sneak into Qingshui Farm.
The sudden appearance of this unfamiliar presence instantly made Ji Ruxue vigilant.
Living through two lives, she’s experienced everything, yet Ji Ruxue’s expression remained unchanged.
Still calm and unflustered, she walked towards home, not letting the intruder’s aura disrupt her composure.
"Able to sense his breath yet unable to see his figure, it seems like this is an Evolver who awakened the invisibility ability; no wonder he could break through Daddy’s defenses."
"Just not sure what this guy’s purpose is for coming to Qingshui Farm..."
The zombies arranged by Daddy were always nearby, so Ji Ruxue chose not to act impulsively.
After all, once she made a move, Daddy would notice, and currently Ji Ruxue was not planning to reveal her abilities.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan had already returned home from the vegetable garden, slicing meat from a mutated giant bull to make meat porridge for Little Qiqi.
As Lu Chuan started to cook, the alluring aroma began spreading throughout the residential area of the farm.
"Such a fragrant smell?"
"Has my sense of smell also gone amiss? Smelling such a delicious scent among a group of zombies?!"
Li Ying shook his head with a bitter smile, then followed the aroma, finally finding Lu Chuan cooking porridge in the residential area kitchen.
What the hell?
Why can zombies cook now?!
Have I time-traveled?
Is this still the apocalypse I originally lived in?!
Li Ying couldn’t resist holding his forehead; everything felt so unreal to him now.
These zombies, which in his memory were only known for bloodlust and slaughter, in Qingshui Farm seemed indistinguishable from normal humans!
Though he’d seen zombies drive trucks and farm already, seeing them in the kitchen might not be that hard to understand...
Seeing Little Qiqi returning from the fish pond, Lu Chuan immediately brought out the meat porridge and then sliced fresh fruit.
Even though Ji Ruxue knew the mysterious intruder was nearby, her expression didn’t change at all, as if completely unaware of everything.
After receiving the meat porridge, she began to feast heartily.
Standing to the side, Li Ying watched Ji Ruxue eat so sweetly, his mouth watering, his eyes full of envy.
Previously, he never imagined anyone could live so comfortably in this dilapidated apocalypse!
As an Evolver with an awakened invisibility ability, Li Ying was actually living quite abundantly compared to other humans.
At least he could use invisibility to avoid zombie pursuits and could easily infiltrate various regions for food.
While most humans, even those with awakened combat abilities, inevitably faced the threat of death.
Yet still, Li Ying had never lived a life as enviable as Ji Ruxue’s.
Without lifting a finger, there’s already piping hot meat porridge to eat and extremely rare fresh fruit available in the apocalypse; Li Ying’s unwilling tears started slipping down his cheeks.
"Wait... is this large farm only inhabited by this one little girl?"
"And from what I see, all the zombies seem to act solely to serve this little girl..."
Li Ying recalled the small amusement park being constructed outside; obviously, such facilities held no interest to zombies, and could only be to fulfill human emotional value.
And those zombies farming...
To his knowledge, zombies only feed on various blood and flesh; vegetables or crops don’t allure zombies at all.
Instead, humans need such grains and vegetables to replenish energy.
And the zombie cooking for the little girl—since when do zombies need to cook before eating?
While devouring humans raw, zombies hadn’t mentioned needing to cook first...
So there’s only one possibility: they’re all serving this little girl!
Li Ying’s pupils contracted; he had a bold guess.
"Could it be... this little girl can command all the zombies here?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 137: Dad Has Worked Hard Enough, So I Won’t Trouble Him Anymore!
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 137: Dad Has Worked Hard Enough, So I Won’t Trouble Him Anymore!
After this speculation emerged in his mind, Li Ying immediately felt a tingling sensation on his scalp.
He couldn’t imagine how terrifying it would be if someone possessed the ability to control zombies in this apocalypse!
From the onset of doomsday till now, the most terrifying thing Li Ying had encountered was the hordes of zombies filling the streets.
After the apocalypse broke out, of the billions of humans, only a small part remained, while the rest had died and transformed into zombies.
Such a vast number determined that zombies were the most terrifying existence at present!
These bloodthirsty zombies wandered endlessly on the streets, making human survivors only dare to hide in the shadows.
Yet, despite their fearsome nature, these zombies were more like a scattered crowd. At least with mindless zombies, humans still had room for survival.
But Li Ying couldn’t imagine, if these zombies could be controlled by someone, what a terrifying force they could be turned into!
And this little girl before him could actually control these mindless zombies; what kind of heaven-defying ability is this?!
With such a talent ability, wouldn’t she have reached an invincible state in this world full of zombies?!
"Truly, the world is full of wonders, and any kind of talent ability can appear."
Watching this extremely absurd scene, Li Ying’s pupils contracted for a moment.
The phenomenon in this Qingshui Farm made him feel a tingling on his scalp, and a chilling sense spread down his spine.
If it were only controlling ordinary zombies, it could be tolerated, but Li Ying remembered very clearly, when the truck arrived at Qingshui Farm, guarding the gate was a Tank Type Evolved Zombie!
Moreover, judging by its massive size and aura, that zombie had clearly reached the third tier.
Even being able to control third-tier evolved zombies, Li Ying couldn’t fathom how terrifying this little girl’s power could be!
Having this hefty group of powerful zombies, in this apocalypse, one could almost walk sideways.
However, after a brief shock, Li Ying’s gaze suddenly turned sinister.
"The ability to control zombies is indeed heaven-defying, but having this ability is just a little girl..."
"If I could successfully control this little girl before me, wouldn’t I then have an extremely powerful and terrifying zombie army at my disposal?!"
"If I could establish a strong army composed of zombies in this apocalypse full of zombies, who could possibly stand against me?!"
A glint of ambition lit up in Li Ying’s eyes.
Now, due to the outbreak of the zombie apocalypse, the original order had already collapsed.
If I possess strong enough power, establishing my own dynasty in the apocalypse wouldn’t be impossible!
Thinking this, Li Ying looked at Ji Ruxue with greed, a cold smile curling at the corners of his mouth.
As for Ji Ruxue, in Li Ying’s eyes, she was insignificant, merely a little girl not worth fearing.
"Tsk tsk tsk, possessing such strong talent ability, yet she’s playing utopia in this remote Qingshui Farm, indeed a childish thought!"
Li Ying scoffed coldly; in his eyes, Ji Ruxue was just an ordinary little girl.
Otherwise, she wouldn’t have such powerful ability, yet merely play house at Qingshui Farm.
Even the extremely powerful third-tier evolved zombies were reduced to mere gatekeepers, which was simply a waste.
Recalling everything seen earlier, it seemed to further confirm Li Ying’s speculation, and made him even more dismissive of Ji Ruxue.
Nearby, Lu Chuan saw Little Qiqi eating sweetly, and without much interruption, turned and left the room.
He walked directly towards the orchard, intending to practice the formidable Blood Evil Blade Technique.
This Blade Technique was indeed mysterious; just by looking at the cultivation technique’s incantation, Lu Chuan could feel the power of this technique.
Although he didn’t know where this Blade Technique came from, it didn’t stop Lu Chuan from enhancing his power through it.
Ji Ruxue saw her father leaving but didn’t call him back, as the evolvers who sneaked in clearly harbored ill intentions.
If she let her father know someone infiltrated, life might become precarious again.
Ji Ruxue remembered vividly how the previous joint operation with Zhao Lin had worried her father for a long time...
After spending time together, Ji Ruxue understood her father was particularly sensitive to those human evolvers.
The sole reason they moved from Sunshine District to Qingshui Farm was due to interruptions from human evolvers.
If her father found out another human evolver had infiltrated Qingshui Farm, he’d likely start worrying about her safety again...
Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly; her current identity wasn’t the time to be exposed.
She couldn’t showcase her power before her father; to maintain a stable life, she must resolve any potential danger.
Now that she finally settled down with her father at Qingshui Farm, with meat, fresh fruit, and sprouting seeds from the repaired vegetable plot, the entire farm was flourishing.
If her father found out the defenses he worked hard to arrange had been infiltrated by human evolvers, the newly stabilized home would become chaotic.
"Dad has taken great care of us, and this time, I won’t cause him more trouble."
"As for this evolver... let me quietly take care of him!"
With that thought, Ji Ruxue wiped her mouth and walked calmly towards her bedroom.
Seeing this, a cold glint flashed in Li Ying’s eyes.
In this world where each fights for oneself, as long as one gains enough power, one could do anything, even if the opponent was a little girl!
However, having lived in the apocalypse for a long time, Li Ying remained vigilant, not acting rashly, but first carefully examining the surroundings.
He only relaxed after confirming there were no zombies nearby, and a sly smile flickered in his eyes.
Li Ying stealthily followed Ji Ruxue, sneaking into the bedroom.
In the bedroom, Ji Ruxue looked like an ordinary infant, playing with a stuffed doll, emanating an innocent aura.
Seeing Ji Ruxue like this, Li Ying felt even more assured, as if he could already see himself commanding a vast zombie army, controlling the emperors with a captive royal.
Thinking of this, Li Ying’s smile deepened.
"Little girl, you can’t escape my grasp now!"
Li Ying pulled out a dagger from his body, and slowly walked toward Ji Ruxue playing with a doll in the bedroom.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 138: Enslavement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 138: Enslavement!
Looking at the petite and charming little girl before him, Li Ying felt no sense of caution.
He didn’t even regard Ji Ruxue with any seriousness, though he was somewhat shocked that this little girl could control the entire Qingshui Farm.
But in his view, Ji Ruxue’s main combat power lay with zombies, and if there were zombies around, then this girl would undoubtedly be a terrifying existence.
The key, though, was... there weren’t any zombies inside the house for her to control.
A person whose talent ability involves controlling zombies, if there are no zombies nearby, is no different from an ordinary person in Li Ying’s eyes.
"Heh, mere little girl, I don’t believe you won’t listen once I’ve got this knife against your neck?"
With a dagger in hand, Li Ying followed Ji Ruxue towards the bedroom.
But idealism is bountiful, reality is slender.
As Li Ying held the dagger in front of Ji Ruxue, he didn’t realize that, despite thinking he was invisible, he had long been exposed before Ji Ruxue.
Just as his steel blade was about to descend on Ji Ruxue’s neck, suddenly his whole body froze, unable to move.
"Hmm? What’s going on?!"
Li Ying’s actions suddenly froze, shock filling his eyes.
He felt an enormously powerful force acting on him, no matter how he struggled, he could not move an inch!
At that moment, Ji Ruxue, still playing with a doll on the couch, suddenly turned her head sharply towards Li Ying.
It was precisely she who had suddenly performed a time pause, causing Li Ying to freeze in place.
"How is this possible? Could she have discovered me?!"
Li Ying and Ji Ruxue’s gaze clashed in mid-air, sending a chill down his spine.
He finally realized that this little girl wasn’t as simple as he had thought.
The most important part was that this girl’s ability was clearly to control zombies; why is his body now unable to move?!
Bang!
In Li Ying’s surprised gaze, Ji Ruxue suddenly jumped up from her place, delivering a heavy blow that sent him flying.
As a third-stage Evolver, the terrifying power Ji Ruxue unleashed was hard for Li Ying, an Evolver, to withstand.
Although Ji Ruxue could directly kill this Evolver, she chose not to, merely knocking him unconscious.
She wanted to see whether the person feared death; if he did, then naturally there’d be no problem.
And after being knocked unconscious, Li Ying’s invisibility ability naturally stopped functioning, his body exposed within the bedroom.
"As expected, an Evolver who awakened invisibility ability, no wonder he managed to bypass father’s defenses and sneak in."
After the Blood Moon night shortly after the apocalypse erupted, Evolvers could awaken all sorts of bizarre abilities.
In Ji Ruxue’s view, Evolvers like this who could become invisible were actually quite ordinary.
In her previous life, she had encountered many of these, and several invisibility Evolvers had died at Ji Ruxue’s hands.
She considered such people not particularly rare; even Zhao Lin, who could resurrect, had appeared, so invisibility was not strange at all.
In the apocalypse, there were many powerful evolutionary abilities; invisibility ability users usually gather intel, collect various resources, etc.
After all, no matter how they evolve, it merely grants invisibility, not amplifying like other combat abilities.
Generally in the apocalypse, invisibility type Evolvers usually take on scout roles in survivor bases.
Though not outstanding in combat, they excel at gathering information.
"Should this guy be killed or not?"
Looking at Li Ying lying on the ground, visible and corporeal, Ji Ruxue frowned as she pondered how to deal with this intruder.
"Forget it, there’s no one around who can be ordered around yet, count your lucky stars, I’ll spare you this time!"
Energy flickered between Ji Ruxue’s fingers, and with the swift motions of her fingers, she pressed on Li Ying’s acupoints, keeping him immobilized and unable to speak.
Ji Ruxue searched her mind, then her lips curled into a cold smile.
"Soul Contract Technique!"
In her previous life, Ji Ruxue once, by chance, acquired this cultivation technique for signing life-and-death contracts with humans or other creatures in an Ancient Secret Realm.
Using powerful spiritual power, Ji Ruxue could bind others with life-and-death contracts, no matter how strong the opponent, they would be bound by her.
With a simple thought, she could control the opponent’s life and death; with the life-and-death contract, there was no worry about betrayal from those subdued.
Energy within Ji Ruxue started to circulate continuously as she formed seals with both hands, then squeezed out a drop of blood from her fingertips.
The blood suspended in mid-air, and with the casting of the Soul Contract Technique, her pupils, black and white, seemed to be covered with a layer of frost.
The drop of blood in mid-air, with Ji Ruxue’s energy gathering, slowly coagulated into a mysterious rune.
With a gentle point, Ji Ruxue directed that blood-red ancient rune towards Li Ying, which then seeped into his mind.
Now, having reached the third stage, Ji Ruxue’s spiritual power was as vast as the ocean.
Her surging spiritual power rushed towards Li Ying, aiming to forcibly engrave this blood-red ancient rune in his mind.
Li Ying was about to instinctively resist, but before Ji Ruxue’s overwhelming spiritual telekinesis, his measly mental defense was negligible, swiftly conquered by Ji Ruxue’s own powerful spiritual power.
Although reborn, Ji Ruxue no longer wielded the formidable strength from her previous life, dealing with an ordinary evolver was still no problem.
She swiftly engraved the ancient, blood-red mark into Li Ying’s mind.
Ji Ruxue’s mouth curled into a cold smile; with the Soul Contract Technique, she could demand Li Ying’s life anytime, anywhere.
Awakening slowly from unconsciousness, Li Ying found himself lying on the ground.
That little girl he thought he could easily deal with was now staring down at him from above.
In her black-and-white pupils, Li Ying sensed an unsettling aura.
Just as he was about to speak, he realized he was unable to move, not even speak; even his awakened invisibility talent was disabled.
And his dagger was now in Ji Ruxue’s hand.
Playing with the dagger, Ji Ruxue said calmly: "Do you wish to live or die?"

chapters.title: Chapter 138 139: Infiltrating Humanity, Planting Pawns!
chapters.content:
Hearing these words, a flash of terror crossed Li Ying's face!
From the outbreak of the apocalypse till now, Li Ying had been through countless life-and-death situations and encountered all sorts of characters.
At this moment, Li Ying could completely confirm that the little girl in front of him was not lying.
She truly intended to do so.
Clearly, she was just a harmless little girl, yet she seemed like a veteran survivor in the apocalypse…
Without a doubt, as long as she felt threatened by him, she would definitely kill him without hesitation!
Li Ying did not expect to feel such an eerie chill from a girl who looked so adorable.
If he had known this little girl was so extraordinary, he would never have acted rashly.
This girl's abilities were even more terrifying than he had imagined!
Not only could she control zombies, but there was also someone capable of freezing him in place with a peculiar ability!
Up till now, Li Ying had not figured out how he was captured…
Seeing Li Ying's panic-stricken face, Ji Ruxue smiled faintly in her heart.
Such people, who cherish their lives and fear death, were exactly what she needed.
The more people fear death, the more they cherish their lives, the more they obey orders, and treasure the chance to live.
The next moment, Ji Ruxue's mind stirred, and she activated the Soul Contract.
"Ah!!!"
Suddenly, Li Ying's face twisted, his eyes widened, and his pupils bulged.
He felt as though his brain was about to explode!!
In that moment, Li Ying felt as if thousands of silver needles pierced into his brain!
The terrifying pain deep within his soul nearly caused him to faint, and the most crucial thing was that he was being controlled by Ji Ruxue.
He lay on the ground immobile, with excruciating pain filling his mind yet unable to utter even a scream.
This kind of torment made Li Ying feel as if he were living a fate worse than death.
"This is my method, if you want to live, from now on you must follow my orders, or I will make you suffer endlessly."
"However, I can also give you a quick end, let you completely die right now, your life and death to me are nothing more than a thought."
Upon hearing these words from Ji Ruxue, Li Ying felt like crying but had no tears.
If only she had told me earlier!
She could have just told me directly!
I never said I wouldn't agree?!
Li Ying felt a sharp pain in his head, his clothes soaked with cold sweat.
Unable to speak, Li Ying desperately blinked at Ji Ruxue.
Ji Ruxue then unblocked Li Ying's acupoints.
Li Ying could finally move; he immediately jumped up from where he was.
However, although he regained his mobility, he did not dare to choose to run away immediately.
The agony he just suffered was unforgettable to Li Ying; he had no doubts about the truth of Ji Ruxue's words.
"Please, don't take my life! I am willing to submit to you, I will henceforth look to you as my guide!"
Fearing death, Li Ying didn't hesitate at all to choose submission.
After such pain, Li Ying now dared not question Ji Ruxue the slightest.
Seeing Li Ying submit so easily without the slightest struggle, Ji Ruxue helplessly shook her head.
Ultimately, there were still more people afraid of dying in this world.
It would be really troublesome if she met someone like Zhao Lin.
Although that woman was a trusting airhead, she had her own persistence.
Forcing Zhao Lin to submit through coercion wasn't a simple task; with her personality, she might even resort to suicide; she wouldn't be easily threatened even by death.
Ji Ruxue helplessly shook her head; Zhao Lin was someone she couldn't kill and had no way to handle at all.
Looking at Li Yong, who was in horror, Ji Ruxue said sternly, "I command you to infiltrate Jianghai City's human survivor camps to gather information for me and report back every half month!"
"Otherwise, I will make you understand what it means to be better off dead!"
"To be honest, your life and death are now just a thought of mine."
Hearing this, Li Ying nodded repeatedly, "I agree! I agree to everything! As long as you spare my life!"
His tone was extremely urgent as if he feared Ji Ruxue would go back on her word.
"Rest assured, I am fair with rewards and punishments, if you truly work for me, I will not treat you poorly in the future."
"For the Genetic Evolution Potions that are hard to obtain within the survivor base, I can also concoct them."
"Don't worry, I am much more generous than the human survivor base."
Ji Ruxue understood well the principle of giving a stick and a sweet date.
Since Li Ying was now afraid of her, the next step was to keep him fearful yet feel reliant on her.
People act for profit; as long as there is enough benefit, Li Ying would do his utmost for her without the necessity of death threats.
Sure enough, upon hearing Ji Ruxue's words, Li Ying's eyes instantly lit up.
While the Survivor Base also allowed for exchanging Genetic Evolution Potions, the bulk was taken by the higher-ups.
Even if he handed over a large number of Crystal Cores, the Genetic Evolution Potions he could obtain were few and far between.
"Since it has come to this, getting some Genetic Potion while being able to stay alive is already a good thing..."
Li Ying glanced at Ji Ruxue hesitantly, and with her signal, he activated his invisibility ability and silently left Qingshui Farm.
But when Li Ying stood afar and looked toward Qingshui Farm, he couldn't help but shiver.
He was filled with regret at this moment.
Indeed, curiosity killed the cat.
If he hadn't been so curious, he wouldn't have ended up like this.
Although he could leave Qingshui Farm alive, his mind was already marked by someone else, and his life and death were no longer under his control.
At this moment, Li Ying felt utterly regretful, but there was nothing he could do; he could only follow Ji Wuxue's orders.
Inside the farm.
In her bedroom, Ji Ruxue quietly gazed out of the window, her eyes black and white, exuding a maturity that was beyond her years.
"With Li Ying as a chess piece now, I will be able to learn of any movements from the human survivor base at an early stage, preventing being caught off guard and ensuring neither I nor my father fall into a passive situation."
"Although this Li Ying is extremely cowardly, he is very useful for gathering information."
A curve formed on Ji Ruxue's lips.
If the humans over there ever wanted to take action against my father.
I can obtain the information in advance from Li Ying, allowing us to prepare ahead of time.
PS: Many readers are puzzled as to why the protagonist couldn't detect Li Ying, the Invisible. The protagonist's spiritual power is mainly expressed in controlling zombies, with nearly all her energy dispersed, which is very different from Telekinesis Control.

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 141: A Fire-Breathing Zombie?
