chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 141: A Fire-Breathing Zombie?
Inside Qingshui Farm.
A burst of laughter echoes through the tranquil farm at this moment.
In the small amusement park built by Lu Chuan, Ji Ruxue is having a blast.
She goes from riding the carousel to the roller coaster, and every now and then heads over to the trampoline for some fun.
Originally, Ji Ruxue didn’t care much for these amusement facilities, after all, she feels she’s already lived a new life and is past the age of enjoying amusement parks.
She always believed her mind was very mature, and she couldn’t possibly enjoy facilities meant for children.
She initially tried them out just to make her father happy, but unexpectedly, once she started trying, she found herself addicted to it!
Ji Ruxue never imagined that she, once an empress in a past life, would find herself having so much fun with these amusement rides.
Perhaps it’s because she lacked a carefree childhood in her past life, or maybe it’s her biological hormones as a child that have affected her emotions, awakening the childlike heart of Ji Ruxue.
She thought she wouldn’t be interested, but now she can only say, "It’s delightful!"
As an orphan in her past life, she didn’t have the conditions to play in amusement parks when young, and when she grew up and earned money, she felt her age was a bit inappropriate to let herself go.
So until now, Ji Ruxue never experienced the joy of playing so freely and happily.
She threw all worries and troubles behind, only wanting to enjoy the current happiness.
Ji Ruxue seems intent on making up for all regrets she had in her past life, here and now.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan is controlling the Corpse Puppet, continuing to search for traces of Evolved Zombies in the Jiangnan City District.
Though life currently seems very peaceful and stable, Lu Chuan knows that without strong power, this peace is merely fleeting.
Lu Chuan commands ordinary Corpse Puppet squads to constantly search for traces of Evolved Zombies, as ordinary Corpse Puppets aren’t Evolved Zombies, they won’t alert those Evolved Zombies.
The tier-two ’Tyrant One’ is like a Grim Reaper wielding a scythe, leaving no Evolved Zombie able to escape his slaughter.
The horrifying claws are a nightmare for Evolved Zombies in the Jiangnan City District.
Even Lu Chuan has lost count of the number of low-tier zombies he has killed during this period to collect Crystal Cores using the Tyrant Zombie.
This tier-two Tyrant Zombie, due to excessive killing, is covered with dark red blood, exuding a lethal aura.
Many survivors in the Jiangnan City District heard the wails of Evolved Zombies and the sound of them collapsing, drawing considerable survivor attention.
These survivors in the district have no idea what happened, they only know that many Evolved Zombies have been hunted.
This is a hugely positive development for the struggling survivors.
The fewer zombies there are, the less of a threat they pose to everyone.
Especially Evolved Zombies, which are a complete catastrophe for most survivors.
Yet survivors were also terrified to find resources fading away, becoming extremely hard to find.
Over several days, Lu Chuan’s harvest was quite good, collecting a sizable amount of tier-one zombie Crystal Cores through searching.
By feeding these tier-one zombie Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets have achieved significant improvements in their capabilities compared to before.
Among Lu Chuan’s current Evolved Corpse Puppets, aside from ’Er Pang’ the tier-three zombie, all other Corpse Puppets have broken through to tier-two, substantially enhancing the combat effectiveness compared to before!
Through experiments during this period, Lu Chuan found this method of feeding Crystal Cores to Corpse Puppets very effective, far quicker than searching for high-tier zombies to enhance their strength.
Moreover, Lu Chuan not only acquired a lot of tier-one Evolved Zombie Crystal Cores but also found a tier-two Tyrant Zombie, which he successfully brought under control.
With the addition of the ’Tyrant Two’, the strength of the Corpse Puppet army has further increased.
Watching the increasingly powerful troops, Lu Chuan himself is growing more confident.
Concurrently, Lu Chuan has gathered a large amount of resources during this time, especially gasoline and diesel.
Regardless of whether it’s the farm’s generator or his transport truck, all rely heavily on these energy resources.
Fortunately, lots of vehicles have stalled in the streets post-apocalypse, perfect for Lu Chuan to collect plenty of gasoline.
After collecting various resources, Lu Chuan controls ’Lightning One’ to drive the truck and prepare to return to Qingshui Farm.
Boom!
Suddenly, a massive fireball slams violently into the truck.
Before Lu Chuan can respond, another fireball follows.
This series of attacks truly catches Lu Chuan off guard, particularly the manner of these attacks completely exceeds his expectations.
Lu Chuan never imagined that while driving peacefully down the street, a huge fireball would suddenly emerge!
During this time, Lu Chuan, wielding Lightning One, has wandered in Jiangnan City District and faced assaults from human survivors or zombies.
However, he’s never encountered this kind of attack before.
Amid these continuous attacks, Lu Chuan can only command ’Lightning One’ to swiftly push open the truck door and leap out to dodge these strong attacks.
Bang!
The massive fireball blasts into the truck, causing it to roar, burning fiercely now, and the surrounding intense heat makes Lu Chuan furrow his brow.
Such sudden flaming attacks really caught him off guard.
By manipulating ’Lightning One’, with its high speed and agility as a tier-two Agile Zombie, he remains unharmed amidst this assault.
Extremely vigilant, scanning his surroundings, Lu Chuan quickly spots a strange figure not far in Lightning One’s sight.
Upon seeing this figure’s appearance, Lu Chuan is stunned.
It turns out to be a zombie with entirely red skin, its bizarre appearance rather striking!
It’s Lu Chuan’s first time seeing such an unusually malformed zombie, uglier than common zombies.
The creature is staring intently this way, and remarkably, spewing flames from its mouth.
Clearly, the large fireball that suddenly attacked the truck earlier was the work of this red-skinned zombie.
Zombies that breathe fire?
For a moment, Lu Chuan finds himself completely bewildered.
With time passing, he never expected zombies to evolve into such strange species!

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 142: Forming a "Mage" Zombie Squad!
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 142: Forming a "Mage" Zombie Squad!
"I didn’t expect there would be a zombie that can breathe fire!"
Looking at the fiery red zombie in front of him, spewing flames from its mouth.
Lu Chuan not only remained calm, but instead became extremely excited.
Undoubtedly, this was a new type of evolved zombie, one that he had never encountered before.
After the initial shock of this evolved zombie’s appearance, Lu Chuan quickly became intrigued by it.
This was completely different from the evolved zombies he’s seen before; this guy had evolved not only physically but also awakened the ability to breathe fire!
A metamorphosis from close combat to long-range attack!
The fireball that just smashed over, although it didn’t hit Lightning One.
It demonstrated considerable power nonetheless!
"Up till now, my Corpse Puppet squad has collected various Corpse Puppets, but this is the first time I’ve encountered such a peculiar zombie."
Lu Chuan had already decided that he would definitely capture this completely red Fire-breathing Zombie successfully.
However, the strength of this fire-breathing evolved zombie seemed quite formidable; the intense flames carried extremely high temperatures.
Ordinary zombies caught off guard by the road were instantly charred black like coke under this evolved zombie’s attack.
Even if an evolved zombie got hit, it would likely be severely injured.
Lu Chuan felt it was somewhat tricky, but fortunately, he had many evolved Corpse Puppets in the vicinity.
Before long, Lu Chuan’s ’Lightning Two’ and ’Lightning Three’ arrived on the battlefield.
At this time on the battlefield, all three of Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets were Agile Zombies and had successfully advanced to the second tier, each moving at a frightening speed.
With legs like springs, all three zombies leapt continuously on the street, their figures ghostly.
This fiery red zombie sensed a threat too, roaring from its mouth, continuously forming fireballs between its hands and throwing them. However, its attacks were always slightly slower than Lu Chuan’s evolved Corpse Puppets, easily evaded.
Facing this unique zombie, Lu Chuan didn’t rush to attack but leveraged the Agile Zombies’ outstanding speed to find cover as much as possible while dodging.
Although flames shot across the battlefield, occasionally causing loud explosions, Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets remained mostly unscathed.
Lu Chuan noticed that the red-colored Corpse Puppet, whenever it was about to attack, its hands would come together.
Then terrifying heat would gather between its palms, as accompanied by waves of red light, the zombie would rub out a huge fireball!
That scorching fireball emitted considerable heat, not even Lu Chuan dared let his Corpse Puppets directly take such an attack.
Lu Chuan’s gaze shifted; the zombie’s attacks were fast and fearsome, but fortunately, what he controlled were Agile Zombies.
Moreover, surrounded by modern steel and concrete buildings, Agile Zombies could perform exceptionally well in this environment.
However, this street wasn’t so lucky. Under this fiery red zombie’s attack, the whole street was full of pitted grooves, blasted into a state of disarray.
After observing for a moment, Lu Chuan basically understood this zombie’s attack pattern.
Subsequently, Lu Chuan multitasked, simultaneously controlling three evolved zombies to confront the enemy.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, ’Lightning One’ rushed swiftly towards the front of this zombie.
Utilizing its outstanding form and flexible maneuvering, again and again dodging the zombie’s attacks, attracting the attention of this fire-breathing, peculiar zombie, locking its gaze entirely on ’Lightning One’.
Missing with each attack, it made this fire-breathing zombie incredibly furious.
The difference between having a brain and not having one was starkly apparent at this moment.
Lu Chuan simultaneously manipulated three second-tier Agile Zombies, with their outstanding speed continually altering their forms, approaching the zombie in front of them.
One could see the fire-breathing zombie becoming exceedingly enraged, murderous intent in its eyes almost becoming solid.
Yet, the actions of the Lu Chuan-controlled ’Lightning One’ were extremely swift; the fire-breathing zombie could only rage helplessly.
Meanwhile, ’Lightning Two’ and ’Lightning Three’ quietly circled behind the fire-breathing zombie.
These two zombies even had in their hands two thick iron chains.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Two swishing sounds rang out as ’Lightning Two’ and ’Lightning Three’ rapidly approached the zombie in front of them, simultaneously throwing the chains at it, the links forming a snare in mid-air.
With exertion, they ensnared the fire-breathing zombie, a trace of panic finally flashing in its eyes.
The two heavy chains instantly restricted its arm movements, making it unable to form fireballs again for the moment.
Boom!
Just then, the fire-breathing zombie opened its massive mouth, spewing fiery red flames, the searing heat rapidly spreading all around.
The chains themselves were quickly heated under the flames’ scorching, ’Lightning Two’ and ’Lightning Three’s hands holding the chains started emitting wisps of white smoke.
Thankfully, Lu Chuan controlled zombies, who lacked the sense of pain; otherwise, they might have indeed broken free.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
In rage, the fire-breathing zombie emitted angry howls.
However, Lu Chuan didn’t give it a chance to fight back, ’Lightning One’ also wielding a chain as it swiftly advanced.
The figures of the three Agile Zombies constantly changed, within just a few seconds wrapping the fire-breathing zombie in front of them with iron chains like a parcel.
Lu Chuan noticed that the chains had been heated until emitting a red glow, but the chains were thick as a wrist, making escaping the bind not easy at all for the time being.
After confining this fire-breathing zombie, Lu Chuan then discovered that the compartment of his truck had caught fire due to being hit by a fireball.
Fortunately, the supplies transported today didn’t contain much combustible material, so the fire was still manageable.
The three Agile Zombies rushed to pick up fire extinguishers to mitigate the damage, finally extinguishing the blaze.
Fixing the fire-breathing zombie with chains at the back of the truck, ’Lightning One’ soon drove towards Qingshui Farm.
This fire-breathing zombie was thus taken all the way back to Qingshui Farm.
Returning to Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan immediately exited, easily taking control of this zombie.
During control, Lu Chuan discovered that this flaming zombie, capable of crafting fireballs and spitting flames, had reached a second-tier level.
He commanded the zombie to an empty site, opening its mouth to release a streak of fire instantaneously.
Then Lu Chuan further manipulated the Corpse Puppet, extending its hands, within which suddenly flared vibrant flames, akin to those of ordinary zombies.
With Lu Chuan’s forceful throw, a massive fireball immediately flew out, even causing a violent explosion!
"Hiss~ What a terrifying power! Since your flame strength is so powerful, from now on you’ll be called ’Flame One’!"
Feeling the formidable combat prowess of ’Flame One’ before him, the corners of Lu Chuan’s mouth slowly curled into a smile.
It was unexpected that in the apocalypse, zombies had developed along such unique evolutionary paths. If he could control more of them in the future, wouldn’t he be able to directly form a mage Corpse Puppet squad?!

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 143: Mage in Heavy Armor—Who Could Possibly Stop That?
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 143: Mage in Heavy Armor—Who Could Possibly Stop That?
"I really didn’t expect Dad to control an Elemental Evolved Zombie so quickly!"
Lu Chuan’s control of ’Flame One’ naturally caught Ji Ruxue’s attention, and she recognized this crimson zombie at a glance.
This type of Elemental Zombie evolves differently from zombies like ’Da Pang’ and ’Lightning One’, which are physical evolution types.
There are many kinds of Elemental Zombies, and ’Flame One’, which can attack with fire, is one of them.
Moreover, like ’Flame One’, Elemental Zombies generally have higher attack power and a wider attack range.
However, Elemental Zombies also have a downside, which is that their physical endurance is weaker than other Evolved Zombies.
After all, when Elemental Evolved Zombies break through, their energy is mostly used to enhance their powerful attack capabilities rather than physical evolution.
Seeing the Flame Zombie controlled by her dad, Ji Ruxue slightly furrowed her eyebrows, recalling memories of her previous life.
She remembered facing Corpse Tides in her past life, where these Elemental Zombies were key firepower in the hordes.
After all, the areas attacked by the Corpse Tides were mostly major human Survivor Bases, where heavy firepower was plentiful.
Most zombies are of the physical evolution type, which are typically close combatants. Though perhaps stronger physically, their combat range is limited.
If relying only on such zombies, attacking a human Survivor Base would, without doubt, incur heavy losses from human firepower.
Thus, the threat posed by the Corpse Tides to humans would be relatively lower.
However, Ji Ruxue clearly remembered that in the post-apocalyptic Corpse Tides, Elemental Zombies were akin to human heavy weaponry.
Even though the Flame Zombie currently only fires single shots, later on, its attack range could broaden, releasing dozens of large Fireballs at once!
More frightening was that the Fireballs had explosive effects, greatly enhancing their destructive power!
And in most Corpse Tides, there wouldn’t be just one or two of these Elemental Zombies.
Ji Ruxue also remembered once fighting against a massive Corpse Tide at a large Survivor Base in her previous life.
The scale of that Corpse Tide was terrifying, with dozens of Elemental Zombies alone!
These Elemental Zombies were often shielded by other Evolved Zombies, compensating for their inability to fight at range.
The overwhelming Elemental attacks flying out from the Corpse Tide constantly bombarded the Survivor Base from afar.
This was humans’ first realization of the terrifying power of Elemental Zombies gathering together, catching the Survivor Base off guard. It was unexpected that zombies could have so many ranged attack methods.
And it was precisely because of the Elemental Zombies that the modern heat weaponry advantage humans had in Ji Ruxue’s Survivor Base was negated.
"Controlling an Elemental Zombie so quickly, it seems Dad won’t take long to build a truly powerful zombie army." Ji Ruxue murmured, gazing at the distant ’Flame One’ displaying its might.
On the other side, Lu Chuan was delighted with the attack unleashed by Flame One.
"The evolutionary path of zombies in this world is indeed peculiar, with zombies of all types."
"But if I could have more zombies capable of releasing flames, then my Corpse Puppet unit’s combat power would change dramatically!"
Lu Chuan was very excited, having recruited another powerful ally.
Ever since learning of the human Survivor Base on the outskirts of Jianghai City, Lu Chuan had been quite apprehensive.
After all, even though his Corpse Puppet team was strong enough to face ordinary human survivor groups,
a Survivor Base established near a major city must have human military stationed there.
In Lu Chuan’s eyes, the modern human military’s long-range firepower posed the greatest threat. No matter how fast ’Lightning One’ ran, it would still be shot to pieces under modern firepower suppression.
But the Flame Zombie was different. Its ability for ranged attacks gave Lu Chuan great confidence. With a dozen Flame Zombies, Lu Chuan was confident in facing human troops head-on!
However, after some manipulation, Lu Chuan also understood the Flame Zombie’s shortcoming: ’Flame One’s’ physical durability was too poor compared to other Evolved Zombies.
Even a leaner agility zombie had far superior physical endurance than the Flame Zombie.
But in Lu Chuan’s view, this was normal. After all, being capable of long-range attacks with strong firepower, a zombie with both powerful attacks and robust physique would be an invincible existence!
Being a Mage, it’s naturally supposed to be a glass cannon.
But this isn’t much of a problem. Since ’Flame One’s’ body isn’t great, I’ll just equip it with gear.
Lu Chuan remembered the scales he had saved from the slaughtered Mutated Golden Python, knowing how tough they were.
The body of that Tier-2 Mutated Golden Python reached a terrifying 20 meters. When processing the meat of the Mutated Giant Python, Lu Chuan had kept all those scales.
It now seemed that these scales could play a role, equipping ’Flame One’ with what was essentially heavy armor.
Though not comparable to ’Da Pang’, they would be far superior to the Flame Zombie’s own defense.
Who can handle a Mage in heavy armor?
As long as it doesn’t die, it can keep dealing damage!
Then, Lu Chuan noticed Little Qiqi watching him intently, thinking the little one was curious about the commotion he had caused.
Lu Chuan waved to summon Little Qiqi over, then took out paper and pen to write: "Little Qiqi, do you want to see some fireworks?"
Ji Ruxue was momentarily confused, but quickly caught on upon seeing the Flame Zombie nearby.
"Hehe, sure Dad, I’ve read about fireworks on the learning machine, but I’ve never seen such things!"
Lu Chuan lifted Ji Ruxue up onto his shoulders, "Little Qiqi, just point in any direction, and I’ll open your eyes!"
"Hahaha! Dad! Fire away!"
Ji Ruxue casually pointed toward an open space nearby, and Lu Chuan immediately had ’Flame One’ unleash a line of fire.
"Wow! Dad, this uncle is amazing! Is this some kind of superpower?!"
Ji Ruxue exclaimed with wide-eyed innocence.
Hearing the melodious sound of the little one’s voice, Lu Chuan was elated, directing ’Flame One’ to fire wherever she pointed, hosting a grand display of artillery near Qingshui Farm!

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 144: Damn It! Why Did This Woman Come Here Too?
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 144: Damn It! Why Did This Woman Come Here Too?
After witnessing the incredible power of the Flame Zombie, Lu Chuan was in a good mood.
In the post-apocalyptic world, if I can have more of these Flame Zombies, they would be of great use either for defending Qingshui Farm or fighting against any enemies I might encounter in the future.
In the following days, Lu Chuan dispatched numerous Corpse Puppet squads into Chengjiangnan City, hoping to find more of these zombies that are crimson red and can release flames.
Unfortunately, these Flame Zombies are evidently rare even among evolved zombies.
Over these few days, Lu Chuan has only found a few first-tier evolved zombies.
Forget about these unique Flame Zombies; even regular second-tier evolved zombies haven’t been seen...
But Lu Chuan no longer hopes to directly control second-tier zombies, as his Corpse Puppets can also evolve after devouring Crystal Cores.
Instead of spending a lot of time and effort to find and control a second-tier zombie, it’s better to slaughter more first-tier evolved zombies and use their Crystal Cores to feed his Corpse Puppets.
During this period, Lu Chuan has successfully cultivated two second-tier evolved zombies using the Crystal Cores from first-tier zombies, namely ’Si Pang’ and ’Lightning Five’.
Though these two are common Tank Type and Agile Type zombies, their combat power has greatly improved after breaking through to the second tier.
At least for now, second-tier evolved zombies possess considerable strength.
...
Meanwhile, in the Jiangnan City District, on the top floor of a residential building.
A young woman with a pretty face, but pale complexion, awoke on the rooftop.
Currently, Zhao Lin appeared very disheveled; her clothes had not been changed or washed in days, accumulating many stains due to continuous travel.
Additionally, since resources became extremely scarce following the apocalypse, Zhao Lin hadn’t had a proper meal for many days, looking very thin.
The reason she specifically chose the rooftop to rest was to avoid a vengeful Earth Escape Zombie.
Over these days, every time Zhao Lin fell asleep, that Earth Escape Zombie would emerge from the ground and attack her.
These zombies feel no pain and never tire.
But Zhao Lin is different; even as an Evolver, she cannot withstand such prolonged sleeplessness.
The most crucial issue is being continually disturbed by the zombie during sleep, almost driving Zhao Lin to nervous exhaustion.
Helpless, Zhao Lin could only go to the top floor, where the zombie couldn’t suddenly appear next to her using its Earth Escape Technique, allowing her to finally sleep well.
The cold rooftop wind blew through her slightly dry black hair, making her look a little lost.
After a while, Zhao Lin shook her head, stood up, and began collecting resources in the nearby area.
Pfft!
To enter a shop, Zhao Lin relied on her powerful combat ability as an Evolver, slashing her tactical knife through the air, leaving cold glints as she swiftly resolved all ordinary zombies along the way.
Having faced death multiple times, Zhao Lin’s combat skills had become extremely terrifying; these ordinary wandering zombies, which were not even evolved zombies, posed no threat to her.
Seeing the shop within reach, Zhao Lin’s pale and exhausted face finally showed a smile.
"It’s quite a distance to Qingshui Farm; I hope I can fill my belly."
This shop had no signs of extensive fighting nearby, suggesting that human survivors probably didn’t battle here.
Even if scavenged, there should still be quite a bit left. Now, since there are no other survivors requiring food, she only needs a little to meet her own needs.
Squeak~
Zhao Lin happily pushed open the shop door.
Yet, the greater the hope, the greater the disappointment...
"Damn it! This damned apocalypse! Where have all the resources gone?!"
Seeing the empty shop, Zhao Lin stomped her foot angrily.
This seemingly sizeable chain supermarket should typically have plenty of resources.
But now, the shelves were completely empty, with only rotten vegetables and foul-smelling frozen meats remaining, while all the food that could be vacuum-sealed and preserved long-term had vanished.
After opening the door, the overwhelming rotten stench almost knocked out the already hungry and nervously exhausted Zhao Lin.
"So many people turned into zombies after the apocalypse; how come there isn’t any food in such a large city?!"
Zhao Lin thought she’d be able to find some food after killing so many zombies and entering the shop, only to find nothing at all.
After searching for a whole morning, scouring the residential buildings and shops in the nearby streets, she ended up with only a bottle of mineral water and a piece of bread.
Looking at the pitiful food in her hand, Zhao Lin could almost cry.
"Could it be that because Jiangnan City District doesn’t have many evolved zombies, the survivors boldly emptied all the resources? But this is too much..."
Zhao Lin shook her head helplessly, hastily stuffing the hard-earned bread into her mouth.
After swallowing a few mouthfuls of mineral water, she continued her resource search, fearing she wouldn’t have the strength to reach Qingshui Farm if she didn’t find food soon...
Zhao Lin sighed helplessly and remembered her earlier life in Sunshine District,
"I really didn’t expect the few days I could eat my fill were spent in the zombies’ stronghold..."
"Huh? Wait a minute? Is that a survivor team?!"
Zhao Lin suddenly spotted several figures on a street, each carrying large bags.
"This attire... No, aren’t these the Corpse King’s minions?!"
All these figures wore motorcycle helmets, identical to those the Corpse King controlled!
Crucially, the Corpse King also used zombies to gather and transport huge amounts of resources back to its lair.
Zhao Lin now recalled the massive stockpile of resources in Building 5 at Sunshine District.
Only now did she realize why she hadn’t found many resources; this familiar situation was indeed the Corpse King’s doing!
Qingshui Farm.
Through the perspective of the Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan also noticed the female cop he had released, a shadow fell over his heart.
"Damn it! Why doesn’t this stupid woman stay near the police station? Why did she also come to Jiangnan City District?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 145: Since You’re Here, Don’t Ever Leave Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 145: Since You’re Here, Don’t Ever Leave Again!
Lu Chuan still remembered that when he initially drove his convoy of trucks, it took a whole day to travel from Sunshine District to Qingshui Farm.
From Jianghai City District to Jiangnan City District, the distance between the two major areas was quite far.
Especially for other survivors in the apocalypse, wanting to come here without any means of transport.
There was only one possibility, which was that Zhao Lin came here on her own.
Lu Chuan was a bit bewildered; he couldn’t understand if he had some unresolved issue with this Zhao Lin from a past life, to run into her again upon arriving in Jiangnan City District...
"Damn it! This woman is just too persistent, isn’t she? How come she’s everywhere I go?!"
Lu Chuan was utterly speechless; at this moment, he could only hope that Zhao Lin just happened to pass by.
This woman was practically like a jinx; previously, she inexplicably barged into his Sunshine District and caused havoc.
Back then, when he let her go, he thought it would be almost impossible to run into her again in this chaotic apocalypse and such a vast world.
Unexpectedly, plans couldn’t keep up with changes, and in just a few days, he had encountered her again...
At this moment, Lu Chuan could only hope that Zhao Lin wouldn’t inexplicably come to Qingshui Farm.
He had finally managed to stabilize his new home and didn’t want this woman to disturb it once more.
If it were other human survivors, Lu Chuan would certainly have eliminated the threat in its infancy without hesitation.
But Zhao Lin’s ability to come back from the dead and grow stronger was something that left Lu Chuan feeling quite helpless.
He couldn’t kill her, but keeping her around wasn’t a solution either.
This woman was really troublesome beyond belief.
Lu Chuan really didn’t want to get involved with her again...
...
In Jiangnan City District, upon seeing the Corpse King’s subordinates, Zhao Lin was so angry her teeth were grinding.
"Damn it! No wonder I’ve been starving for so long; you took the supplies again?!"
"Is this Corpse King brain-dead or what? You’re a bloodthirsty zombie, what do you need so many human supplies for?!"
Grrr~
Soon, Zhao Lin’s stomach rumbled uncontrollably.
With the constant traveling during this period and continuous zombie battles without proper rest, that small piece of bread just now had no effect at all.
Looking at the large amount of food these zombies were carrying, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but swallow her saliva. She then pretended nothing was amiss and left the area.
However, she secretly followed behind the resource-collecting Corpse Puppet squad.
Zhao Lin was sure that these zombies in front of her were definitely listening to the Corpse King.
As long as she followed these zombies, she could definitely find Little Qiqi’s current location.
"Little Qiqi, don’t worry. I will definitely find you and let you live a normal human life!"
Zhao Lin clenched her fist in secret.
She didn’t consider how she could take care of an infant when even she couldn’t have enough food...
Zhao Lin, who had been following the Corpse Puppet squad all this time, thought she was hiding well, unaware she had long been discovered by Lu Chuan.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Just as Zhao Lin walked past a street corner, she suddenly heard two whooshing sounds behind her.
Caught off guard, Zhao Lin’s legs, like springs, tightened their muscles and propelled her forward in a quick roll, rolling several meters away.
As she raised her head, Zhao Lin immediately noticed ’Lightning One’ and ’Lightning Two’, wielding steel knives, standing in front of her.
Their terrifying speed startled Zhao Lin; the cold, sharp glint of the blades cutting through the air with whooshing sounds made it clear that being struck by them would mean certain death!
Upon discovering Zhao Lin, Lu Chuan urgently directed ’Lightning One’ and ’Lightning Two’ to intercept her.
Now that he’d finally settled down at Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan didn’t want this bad luck charm to interfere with his life again.
Now having advanced to the second tier, both ’Lightning One’ and ’Lightning Two’ surpassed in speed and strength compared to before, their combat ability not even in the same league as before.
Especially when the two Agile Type zombies joined forces, their dual blades swung in the air, causing a silver and white cold gleam to permeate the area!
Although Zhao Lin’s strength grew stronger after resurrection, she was still forced to retreat continuously in the face of two-tier two Agile Type zombies.
"How is this possible?! Isn’t this the Agile Type zombie who was guarding me before? How did it break through to the second tier in such a short time?!"
At this moment, Zhao Lin recognized the guise of ’Lightning One,’ and she was very surprised.
In just a few short days, ’Lightning One’s combat power had multiplied several times!
In haste, Zhao Lin only had time to draw two tactical daggers from her waist in defense.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The knives and machetes clashed repeatedly in midair, sparks flying, and the immense strength of the knife left Zhao Lin’s arms a bit numb.
Although both ’Lightning One’ and ’Lightning Two’ were Agile Type zombies and significantly weaker compared to Tank Type zombies like ’Da Pang’ in terms of strength.
But after all, they were body-evolution-type zombies; their overwhelming power still far exceeded what Zhao Lin could compare to now.
What surprised Zhao Lin the most was ’Lightning One’ and ’Lightning Two’s combat techniques, clearly having advanced more than a level from their previous encounter.
As a police officer who had undergone systematic training, Zhao Lin now found herself somewhat lagging behind the two zombies in terms of combat experience!
She was immediately troubled, for every encounter with the Corpse King brought nothing good.
She couldn’t understand how these mindless, bloodthirsty zombies suddenly turned into martial arts experts?
Whoosh!
’Lightning One,’ relying on its excellent combat skills, flicked its machete upwards after slashing, directly knocking Zhao Lin’s dagger out of her hand.
Deprived of her defensive weapon, Zhao Lin instantly fell into a disadvantage; ’Lightning Two’s machete landed directly on her back, leaving a gruesome scar.
In pain, Zhao Lin furrowed her brows; yet even before she could catch her breath, ’Lightning One’ threw down its dual blades and rushed over with fists swinging.
Those huge fists, full of force and fierceness, left Zhao Lin unable to dodge under the joint assault of the two zombies. She took a punch to the abdomen from ’Lightning One,’ flying backward four or five meters, landing on her knees.
Her already pale complexion was now covered in cold sweat.
At this moment, Zhao Lin’s hair stuck to her cheeks with cold sweat, making her appear rather pitiful.
However, Lu Chuan had no intention of showing mercy. ’Lightning Two’ also rushed to Zhao Lin’s front, landing a heavy kick that sent her flying six or seven meters.
Zhao Lin, like a sandbag, slammed into the wall of a building, even causing cracks in the concrete wall.
Under the force of the counter-impact, Zhao Lin coughed up a mouthful of blood, severely injured in just a few exchanges.
Lu Chuan looked at Zhao Lin before him, a cold gleam flashing in his eyes.
"Since you insist on coming, then don’t ever leave this time!"

chapters.title: Chapter 145 146: Zhao Lin's Shock—This Corpse King Is Just Too Clever!
chapters.content:
Zhao Lin felt as if her organs had all taken a huge hit, as if she had been struck by a giant hammer!
The terrifying impact caused blood to spill uncontrollably from her mouth.
Her face was ashen, and Zhao Lin couldn't believe she was being battered by two second-tier Agile Zombies.
Watching the two zombies approaching, Zhao Lin forced herself to stand despite the pain.
But before she could react, 'Lightning One' was already in front of her.
In Zhao Lin's wide-open eyes, 'Lightning One's' fist, as big as a sandbag, came crashing down.
"Damn Corpse King! I will never forgive you!"
Filled with unwillingness and anger, Zhao Lin was knocked out by one punch from 'Lightning One'.
...
The truck shook continuously, causing the knocked-out Zhao Lin to slowly come to.
Zhao Lin tried to move, but found that her hands and feet were bound by iron chains, and she couldn't move. The surroundings seemed to be the inside of a moving truck.
"Zombies... can actually drive?!"
When Zhao Lin woke up and saw 'Lightning One' driving, she was instantly dumbfounded.
The Evolved Zombie that had just knocked her out was now driving a truck?
Moreover, with its ability to skillfully dodge obstacles, use the gas pedal, brake, and shift gears, it was clearly an experienced driver.
Zhao Lin couldn't help but shake her head, feeling she must be hallucinating.
Since when could zombies drive?!
Before reaching Sunshine District, Zhao Lin didn't realize there even was a Corpse King in the world, but she thought even if the Corpse King was formidable, it was still just a zombie.
However, now it seemed these Evolved Zombies were even more terrifying than she imagined...
"Where are these guys taking me after tying me up?"
"Could it be that this Corpse King wants to keep me by his side like at Sunshine District?"
With her hands and feet tied, Zhao Lin couldn't help but think of her previous experience in Building No. 5 of Sunshine District.
Back then, she was also tied up by the Corpse King, and that Corpse King was smart enough to figure out that she had the ability to grow stronger each time she revived.
So the Corpse King wouldn't kill her, but instead tied her up and threatened her with people from the police station. Now, it seemed that was also the plan.
But that's quite convenient, as Little Qiqi must be living with this Corpse King.
If Zhao Lin gets taken to the lair of this Corpse King, she believes she'll certainly see Little Qiqi.
She remembered the note Little Qiqi left her earlier, with the words "Qingshui Farm" written on it, so that must be their next destination.
Right now, the journey from Jiangnan City District to Qingshui Farm isn't short, and walking there would take quite a bit of time.
Hitching a ride would save Zhao Lin a lot of trouble.
"Corpse King, don't misunderstand, I harbor no malice. I just want to see Little Qiqi again,"
After her prior encounters in Sunshine District, Zhao Lin knew the Corpse King was extremely intelligent and could understand human speech, so she directly spoke to 'Lightning One'.
However, it was evident she wouldn't receive any response here.
Lu Chuan, who was operating 'Lightning One', just glanced at Zhao Lin and continued driving.
Lu Chuan didn't expect Zhao Lin to come all this way for Little Qiqi.
He really didn't know how the relationship between these two women had advanced so quickly, even after such a short conversation.
But in his heart, Lu Chuan sneered.
Setting aside Zhao Lin's true intentions this time, since she'd entered his territory again, she shouldn't think of leaving so easily.
Soon, the truck approached Qingshui Farm, and watching the scenery outside the window, Zhao Lin was momentarily stunned.
As a police officer in Jianghai City, she had some knowledge about the outskirts' farms.
The large farms often had wooden posts and wire fences for cost reduction, but now those fences had undergone major changes!
The wire fences had been reinforced with stones, enclosing the vast Qingshui Farm with stone walls, greatly enhancing its defenses!
What was most shocking was the giant figure standing at the gate of Qingshui Farm, which left Zhao Lin completely astounded.
Er Pang's massive body and the powerful aura it emitted had completely exceeded Zhao Lin's understanding of Evolved Zombies after the apocalypse.
Without a doubt, this figure guarding the entrance of Qingshui Farm was at least a three-tier Tank Type zombie!
Zhao Lin couldn't help but swallow.
"It seems that during this time, the Corpse King's power has increased significantly. Just the farm's gatekeeping setup is much stronger than Sunshine District's..."
However, what Zhao Lin didn't expect was that Er Pang, the three-tier Tank Type zombie at the gate, was just an appetizer for her.
As the truck continued moving, the farm's landscape began to change too.
Seeing the zombies tirelessly working in the fields left Zhao Lin speechless with shock.
"Did I get hit so hard by this zombie that I've become stupid?!"
"What is this? A bunch of zombies farming? How is this possible?!"
Zhao Lin, who had been lost in thought, was now rendered speechless by the scene outside.
In the farm, aside from zombies working in the vegetable patches and fields, many zombies were patrolling in formation, maintaining order across the farm.
If it wasn't for their hideous, frightening appearances, yellow dry hair, red eyes, and occasional roars,
Zhao Lin might really have thought this was a newly established human survivor base...
Zhao Lin couldn't have imagined zombies gathering together and doing something like this, it was even more outrageous than what she saw at Sunshine District!
After driving a bit further, Zhao Lin saw the Little Bear Amusement Park newly established by Lu Chuan in a vacant lot near the residential area.
Zhao Lin was utterly dumbfounded. She remembered clearly that there was no such amusement park facility in Qingshui Farm.
There could only be one possibility, the Corpse King had transported it back...
The Corpse King, who could command zombies to gather resources, would naturally have no trouble bringing back these amusement facilities.
As Zhao Lin gazed out the car window at these incredible scenes, she was rendered speechless with shock.
"Training these zombies to be almost indistinguishable from humans, could this Corpse King really possess only a bit of intelligence?"
"This is overly smart, isn't it?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 147: Daddy Brought Your Pet Back Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 147: Daddy Brought Your Pet Back Again
Zhao Lin was still in shock when Lu Chuan manipulated Lightning One to pull her directly off the car with a chain.
Lu Chuan couldn’t care less about Zhao Lin’s current distress and injuries.
Even though this woman was now covered in blood, Lu Chuan’s eyes still exuded endless coldness.
If it weren’t for this woman’s troublesome talent ability, Lu Chuan would have killed her countless times already.
This woman was like a sticky plaster that couldn’t be shaken off; even after moving from Sunshine District to Qingshui Farm, she still followed him all the way, leaving Lu Chuan speechless.
Faced with the uninvited Zhao Lin, Lu Chuan directly took the chain and locked Zhao Lin to the railing of the slide.
Like tying a dog, he fastened her there, and Lu Chuan didn’t feel there was anything wrong with it.
Treated like this by Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin was also furious, "Hey? After all, we are old acquaintances, aren’t we? Is this really necessary?!"
"No matter what, I’m still Little Qiqi’s friend. Can’t you use a different approach? Rest assured, I won’t run away!"
Inwardly, Zhao Lin’s teeth itched with anger towards Lu Chuan, continuously cursing in her heart, "Damn bastard! You actually tied me up like a dog?!"
Of course, Zhao Lin only dared to curse in her heart; she knew the methods of the Zombie King all too well.
Though he probably wouldn’t dare kill her, coming up with ways to torture her was no problem, and Zhao Lin didn’t want her legs inexplicably broken again...
Lu Chuan glanced at Zhao Lin, ignored her discontent, and dispatched ’Tyrant Two’ to guard Zhao Lin.
Although Zhao Lin looked utterly miserable now, Lu Chuan knew her talent ability was somewhat formidable.
If this woman committed suicide and came back stronger to seek revenge, that would be troublesome.
Seeing the second-degree tyrant zombie beside her, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but swallow her saliva.
The tyrant zombie appeared much wilder than ’Lightning One’.
And Zhao Lin remembered how she was nearly driven to despair by one of these tyrant zombies, and even the explosion at the gas station failed to kill that tyrant...
The intangible pressure from this second-degree tyrant made Zhao Lin feel apprehensive, so she shouted loudly, "Zombie King! What do you want?!"
"I already said I don’t mean anything else; I just want to meet Little Qiqi!" Zhao Lin shouted anxiously.
She traveled from Sunshine District to Jiangnan City District just to save Little Qiqi from danger and lead the innocent little girl away from zombie control.
Ignoring the zombie threat around her, she continued calling Ji Ruxue’s name loudly.
"Little Qiqi, where are you?!"
"Little Qiqi! It’s me, Zhao Lin! I’ve come to find you!"
Watching Zhao Lin shouting loudly, Lu Chuan helplessly shook his head.
"This woman, although she has some issues, surprisingly values Little Qiqi quite a lot..."
Her willingness to travel such a long way for Little Qiqi showed that Zhao Lin had a sincere heart in this matter.
Meanwhile, by the fish pond at Qingshui Farm.
The mutated golden python, reaching a length of twenty-six meters, had quite some flesh missing from its body, each time Ji Ruxue took a bit to feed the turtle she contracted with.
Over time, as the old turtle absorbed the energy from the air, it grew even larger than when first seen.
It seemed more imposing overall, and the aura it emitted became even stronger.
Not only did Ji Ruxue continuously feed it mutated giant python flesh, but she also provided a cultivation technique.
The Ancient Beast Taming Technique not only recorded Ji Ruxue’s beast taming methods but also many ways to enhance the power of contracted beasts.
Although its aura grew much stronger, the mutated old turtle remained very affectionate toward Ji Ruxue.
The harmonious relationship between Little Qiqi and the mutated old turtle puzzled Lu Chuan.
He was initially cautious and forbade Little Qiqi from getting close.
But after a few attempts and finding no malice from the old turtle, he gradually allowed Little Qiqi to get closer.
"Hmm? That voice sounds familiar?"
Hearing Zhao Lin’s shouting, Ji Ruxue was surprised, never expecting to hear her voice from inside Qingshui Farm.
"The sound seems to be coming from the playground!"
"She really followed from Sunshine District?!"
Realizing Zhao Lin was captured by her father again, Ji Ruxue hurried toward the playground.
Soon enough, she spotted the figure chained like a dog beside the slide, the same Zhao Lin her father had recently released.
"Little Qiqi, I knew you were here!"
Spotting Ji Ruxue, Zhao Lin excitedly greeted her.
"Great, you’re alive, this is wonderful!"
Seeing Little Qiqi safe and sound, looking even healthier than before, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but feel relieved.
After the police station incident, Zhao Lin had completely lost hope in other humans.
She believed only pure-hearted girls like Little Qiqi were worth protecting at all costs.
Zhao Lin remembered the promise she made with Little Qiqi, sealing it with a pinky swear.
A promise was made, and Zhao Lin intended to keep it!
Ji Ruxue approached and saw Zhao Lin chained there like a dog.
Zhao Lin’s body was covered in blood and dirt, looking extremely disheveled.
Her face was pale and weak, and her hair seemed dry, evidence of the hardships Zhao Lin endured on her journey.
In her past life in the apocalypse, Ji Ruxue knew how difficult it was for a regular human evolver to travel between districts.
Zhao Lin’s joy at seeing her was apparent, and Ji Ruxue was touched but also felt helpless.
Why was this woman so foolish, finding her way to Qingshui Farm just from a piece of paper?
Seeing Zhao Lin in such a pitiful state, she must have been severely taught a lesson by her dad on her way here.
Ji Ruxue knew her father’s personality well; he only showed his gentle side to her.
Not breaking Zhao Lin’s legs this time could be considered merciful...
Lu Chuan stood aside and nodded to himself.
Despite hating the foolish woman, he had to admit having someone who could communicate with Little Qiqi in a normal way was good.
Lu Chuan took out his paper and pen.
"Little Qiqi, Dad has captured your pet again for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 148: You Can’t Even Protect Yourself? And You Still Want to Protect Qiqi?
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 148: You Can’t Even Protect Yourself? And You Still Want to Protect Qiqi?
Seeing the words on the piece of paper in Ji Ruxue’s hand, Zhao Lin was instantly furious.
Upon realizing that this Zombie King really considered her a pet, Zhao Lin was immediately inflamed!
So the other party tethered her here not unintentionally, but truly regarded her as a dog?!
Although she was very angry in her heart, Zhao Lin could do nothing about the surrounding zombies at the moment.
She could only sulk.
...
A moment later, inside the amusement park, Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin, the two women, one big and one small, chatted idly like long-lost friends.
"Little Qiqi, have you been doing well recently?" Zhao Lin asked softly, her voice very gentle.
Hearing this, Ji Ruxue helplessly raised an eyebrow and then pointed around with her hand.
"Do I look like I’m not doing well?"
Zhao Lin was taken aback by these words, then looked in the direction Ji Ruxue was pointing.
Around them were amusement facilities that the Corpse King had specially moved back for Little Qiqi from the city, providing enough entertainment for the little one in the apocalypse.
With so many entertainment projects, let alone in this post-apocalyptic world, even before the end of the world, not many kids of the same age could have such an experience.
Even Zhao Lin herself hadn’t had the chance to properly enjoy playing in an amusement park...
Besides, there were large vegetable fields. Although no crops had grown yet, it was evident that new sprouts had emerged thanks to the zombies cultivating them.
Beneath that soil, there was plenty of vitality brewing, and it wouldn’t be long before there would be a harvest of vegetables.
The whole Qingshui Farm was in an orderly state.
Although these zombies looked terrifying and hideous, within this Qingshui Farm, they were managed orderly by the Corpse King, appearing strangely normal beyond their ghastly appearances.
The key point is, this is the apocalypse.
In such a world, human life is as worthless as grass; countless humans would betray their companions for a path to survival and turn into terrifying devils for a morsel of food.
Even as an Evolver herself, Zhao Lin was in dire straits, having not eaten decent food for days, finding it hard to get proper rest.
As for the ordinary survivors, their living conditions need no elaboration; staying alive is already their greatest luxury...
At this moment, Ji Ruxue was neat and tidy, her clothes spotless.
Her white face was as adorable and charming as a porcelain doll, her skin smooth and her complexion rosy.
Zhao Lin looked at her own extremely dismal state in comparison to Little Qiqi’s god-like living conditions, an enviable situation for many human survivors.
Reflecting on the earlier experience in the Sunshine District and the current orderliness of Qingshui Farm, Zhao Lin saw that this Corpse King truly cherished Little Qiqi.
After all, zombies don’t need to collect human supplies, much less plant crops.
Yet this zombie even considered Little Qiqi’s emotional needs and brought back playground facilities...
Seeing all the beauty surrounding her, Zhao Lin found herself doubting her decisions.
The reason she chased from the Sunshine District to Qingshui Farm was not to let Little Qiqi live with the Corpse King anymore.
In Zhao Lin’s view, these zombies were mindless, bloodthirsty creatures, and humans who followed them would meet no good end.
The original plan was to lead Little Qiqi away from the Corpse King’s side, to give her a new life and let her live an authentically human life.
But now everything was completely the opposite of what Zhao Lin had imagined.
Compared to Little Qiqi’s life, it seemed that her own environment was the real hell...
If not for her ability to revive, she didn’t know how many times she would have died.
If she really took Little Qiqi away, could she still provide her with a life like this?
Did she really have the ability to take care of this little one?
Until now, Zhao Lin couldn’t remember the last time she had a full meal. How was she supposed to take care of Little Qiqi like this?
Through ’Tyrant No. 2’s’ perspective, Lu Chuan watched Ji Ruxue chatting happily with Zhao Lin.
He sighed inwardly.
Little Qiqi is still human; she needs human companionship, to communicate and interact with actual humans.
It’s a pity that while he retained human consciousness, in his zombie form, he couldn’t even speak and had to communicate with Little Qiqi through writing.
Lu Chuan felt quite helpless about this, as normal communication with humans couldn’t be compensated just by learning from a machine.
It was only because Little Qiqi was exceptionally talented that she managed to teach herself to read and write...
Inside the amusement park, Zhao Lin looked seriously at Ji Ruxue and said in a very earnest tone.
"Little Qiqi, the reason I came here is to fulfill our original agreement!"
Zhao Lin looked at Ji Ruxue with firm eyes.
She initially believed that as a police officer, even in a society where order and morality had completely collapsed, she should fulfill her duties as a cop.
After the apocalypse, Zhao Lin indeed helped many survivors, but the people in the police station had taught her a harsh lesson.
They made Zhao Lin realize that people in this world were no longer like those she previously knew.
The world had become extremely frightening, and people became grotesque.
Zhao Lin now had no intention to protect these beasts anymore.
She only wanted to protect this little one who recently entered the world, allowing her to grow up healthy and happy.
"Little Qiqi, from now on I will be your personal bodyguard!"
"As long as I’m here, no one can harm you; I will not let you fall into danger!"
Looking into Little Qiqi’s pure and innocent eyes, Zhao Lin made up her mind to protect Little Qiqi at all costs, even if she had to risk her own life!
After all, she had many lives and could resurrect and become stronger...
Nearby, Lu Chuan heard all Zhao Lin’s words and found it utterly amusing.
Disheveled with her body stained with blood, Zhao Lin stood in stark contrast to the clean and well-attired Ji Ruxue beside her.
Zhao Lin’s tone was solemn, and her words profound, yet her current state of being chained to a slide made them sound somewhat absurd...
"This woman is so foolishly endearing, worrying about protecting Little Qiqi when she can’t even ensure her own safety?"

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 149: Earth Escape Zombie? Perfect Timing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 149: Earth Escape Zombie? Perfect Timing!
Lu Chuan was concerned that Zhao Lin might have ulterior motives for coming to Qingshui Farm, so he constantly had ’Tyrant No. 2’ closely monitor her every move.
However, what surprised Lu Chuan was that upon meeting Zhao Lin this time, she seemed inexplicably honest.
Lu Chuan remembered that back in Sunshine District, Zhao Lin was filled with bizarre thoughts about upholding justice and rescuing survivors.
In Lu Chuan’s view, Zhao Lin was like an outright saint in the apocalypse, oblivious to the pitfalls awaiting her.
She even tried to lure away his Little Qiqi, an irredeemable fool through and through.
Yet, this time Zhao Lin didn’t stir up any trouble, she behaved very honestly these past few days, almost like a different person.
Zhao Lin seemed to have adapted to her current life quite well, even when Lu Chuan had her chained to the slide, she never considered escaping.
Such a dramatic change in Zhao Lin’s behavior left Lu Chuan rather astonished.
He couldn’t understand what experiences she had gone through recently to cause such a drastic personality transformation in such a short time.
Previously, after being captured, Zhao Lin would negotiate terms and even attempt to get food for other survivors, but now she seemed solely focused on Little Qiqi.
In the past, she would threaten him with suicide because she could revive, yet this time Zhao Lin showed no intention of doing so.
Lu Chuan scratched his head, unsure what had happened to this woman to cause such a major personality shift, but undeniably, it’s a good thing.
Now, Zhao Lin’s demeanor relieved Lu Chuan significantly; he no longer needed to surveil her 24 hours a day, allowing him to focus on other matters.
In the following days, Zhao Lin either chatted with Little Qiqi or watched her play in the playground.
She now seemed more like a neighborly big sister than an apocalypse Evolver.
Though Zhao Lin hadn’t relaxed properly for ages, now chained by Lu Chuan to the slide, she undoubtedly didn’t need to stay ever vigilant as she did outside.
The best part about being on Lu Chuan’s turf? Zhao Lin was finally able to eat her fill!
Having traveled nonstop without finding supplies, Zhao Lin survived these past days on just a bottle of water and two pieces of bread, without any other food intake.
Starving to the point her chest stuck to her back, Zhao Lin suddenly found that staying at the Corpse King’s lair wasn’t bad; at least she wouldn’t go hungry...
Having food and drink, without fear and without worrying about being backstabbed by companions, it seemed the zombie king’s lair was more comfortable than with the human survivors.
With Zhao Lin’s arrival, Ji Ruxue noticeably became more talkative than before.
After all, as a zombie, Lu Chuan couldn’t speak and could only communicate with Ji Ruxue through writing, which was very inconvenient.
Zhao Lin, being human and a grown woman, had many topics she could discuss with Ji Ruxue.
Through the perspective of ’Tyrant No. 2,’ Lu Chuan witnessed the interactions between the two for those days, and seeing Little Qiqi so happy, Lu Chuan felt very satisfied.
"Even though I don’t know why this dumb woman changed her personality, Little Qiqi obviously enjoys spending time with her."
"As long as Zhao Lin doesn’t cause any trouble, she could be kept like a pet at Qingshui Farm, which would surely make Little Qiqi very happy."
...
It was mealtime again, and Zhao Lin looked eagerly towards the residential area.
Every mealtime, Little Qiqi would bring her food.
During her time at Qingshui Farm, Zhao Lin lost all anxiety about food, her face looked much healthier after eating her fill.
Zhao Lin gazed at the residential area, smelling a delightful fragrance before Ji Ruxue even walked over.
After a while, she saw Ji Ruxue carrying a large bowl of meat porridge, swiftly heading her way.
The aroma made Zhao Lin’s stomach growl in protest, and her mouth began to water.
The cooked rice mixed with mutated beast meat, the fragrance of rice and meat was a delicacy in the apocalypse.
Famished and impatient, Zhao Lin gulped the meat porridge down as soon as she received it.
Greedily, she finished the bowl clean, even licking it spotless.
Though she’d finished eating, Zhao Lin still displayed a longing expression; she couldn’t remember the last time she had such food.
"How’s the taste of the porridge?" Ji Ruxue asked softly, stifling laughter at Zhao Lin’s delighted expression.
"Woo woo woo~ So delicious! It’s really delicious!"
"Little Qiqi, you know? I’ve never had such tasty porridge before!"
Zhao Lin felt an urge to cry; she couldn’t recall when she last enjoyed such a flavor.
Ji Ruxue nodded contently, confident in her father’s cooking skills, and said with a light laugh, "Of course, this porridge is made by my dad himself!"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin was stunned, her mind momentarily overwhelmed.
The delicious porridge she just drank was made by a zombie?!
Zhao Lin felt dumbfounded; when did zombies, who thrive on blood, learn to cook porridge?!
Though from the current situation, the Corpse King’s intelligence was evidently high, cooking porridge could be a challenge even for humans, let alone being so delicious!
Zhao Lin felt warm in her stomach yet dizzy in her head.
She ate a bowl of porridge cooked by a zombie, something she’d struggle to convince anyone of...
Late night.
Despite Zhao Lin being chained by Lu Chuan to the slide, thoughtful Ji Ruxue provided a quilt for her.
For Zhao Lin, who’d traveled a long way, having a quilt at night was already very fortunate.
Moreover, surrounded by the Corpse King’s patrolling zombies, Zhao Lin didn’t worry about attacks, so she slept soundly at Qingshui Farm.
Bang bang bang!
But suddenly, the ground near Zhao Lin cracked open.
As she watched, a yellowish zombie crawled out from underground—it was the "grudge-bearing" Earth Escape zombie.
Lu Chuan, observing through ’Tyrant No. 2’s perspective, immediately spotted the new type of zombie.
He was first startled, then delighted.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 150: Leave Here? When Did I Say I Wanted to Leave Dad?
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 150: Leave Here? When Did I Say I Wanted to Leave Dad?
"Not long ago, we encountered a fire-breathing zombie, and now we come across one that can burrow into the ground. The evolutionary types of these zombies are truly peculiar!"
This earth-burrowing zombie’s appearance did not alarm Lu Chuan; instead, it filled him with immense joy.
"It seems I need to take back my previous words; it doesn’t seem accurate to call Zhao Lin a jinx at the moment."
During this period, Lu Chuan sent many Corpse Puppet squads into the Jiangnan City District, but apart from finding some regular first-level evolved zombies, he never found any possessing unique abilities.
But unexpectedly, not long after Zhao Lin’s arrival, this earth-burrowing zombie willingly presented itself.
Moreover, Lu Chuan noticed that this peculiar earth-burrowing zombie seemed to hold a grudge against Zhao Lin; its presence at Qingshui Farm was clearly aimed at her.
This earth-toned zombie had barely sprung from the ground before it eagerly launched an attack on Zhao Lin.
"It’s you again, this haunting fellow!"
Woken by the commotion, Zhao Lin was astounded to see the onrushing earth-burrowing zombie.
She couldn’t believe she had come all the way to Qingshui Farm, yet this zombie persistently followed her.
It truly holds grudges!
Even though a second-level Tyrant zombie was not far from her side, this earth-burrowing zombie had a clear target, charging at her as if no one else was around.
For a moment, rage bubbled within Zhao Lin.
These days, this earth-burrowing zombie nearly drove her to a nervous breakdown, and she finally found peace for two days at Qingshui Farm.
Having eaten and drank her fill, she hoped for a good sleep, but unexpectedly, the commotion woke her again, filling Zhao Lin with anger.
Even though tethered by Lu Chuan’s chains, she unleashed a formidable fighting force.
Facing the charging earth-burrowing zombie, Zhao Lin powered through with her thigh, using the adjacent slide to leap over its head.
Dodging the earth-burrowing zombie’s attack, Zhao Lin, using her evolved robust physique, launched a triple kick mid-air, driving the zombie back repeatedly.
With her continuous evolution, Zhao Lin gained a remarkable physique; while she struggled against Lightning One and Lightning Two under Lu Chuan’s control, she had no trouble handling the non-combative earth-burrowing zombie.
Momentarily pausing after being repelled, the earth-burrowing zombie detected the aura of strong evolved zombies surrounding Zhao Lin.
Realizing its inferiority, this earth-burrowing zombie transformed its hands into claws, tearing apart the ground.
Having faced this earth-burrowing zombie many times, Zhao Lin immediately knew it intended to escape.
She shouted loudly to her surroundings, "Corpse King! I know you’re watching here!"
"Don’t say I didn’t warn you; this guy is about to escape!"
Hearing this, Lu Chuan, who was secretly observing, unleashed his own telekinesis, effortlessly subduing the earth-burrowing zombie under his terrifying telekinetic force without any struggle.
Seeing the earth-burrowing zombie that intended to escape suddenly freeze in place, Zhao Lin was momentarily stunned.
"Is it this easy to be perfectly controlled by a zombie?"
Seeing the zombie, which seemingly lost all hostility towards her, even experiencing a complete shift in its aura, Zhao Lin felt a chill in her heart.
Is this the Corpse King’s power? To control an evolved zombie so quickly is truly terrifying!
Zhao Lin couldn’t help recalling the invisible assailant’s words to her in the Sunshine District.
The Corpse King is indeed the most terrifying zombie, no wonder the invisible wanted to destroy it so desperately.
If allowed to develop, this Corpse King would become a severe threat to humanity!
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan manipulated the earth-burrowing zombie to a distance, inspecting the abilities of this new-type zombie out of Zhao Lin’s view.
This earth-toned burrowing zombie could freely traverse underground and could carry objects, albeit not living creatures.
Lu Chuan raised his eyebrows slightly and muttered, "Zombies probably aren’t considered living creatures, right?"
After experimenting, Lu Chuan discovered that this earth-burrowing zombie could indeed carry other zombies underground!
Possibly due to its current rank, it could only carry one at a time.
Understanding this unique ability, Lu Chuan was overjoyed.
"With this zombie capable of underground travel, operations would be much more convenient in the future. Even if Evolvers have peculiar abilities, I doubt anyone could detect underground movements."
To most people, the movement of this earth-burrowing zombie beneath the ground could be described as vanishing into thin air.
If I need to gather information in the future, this burrowing zombie will prove invaluable.
It’s like a natural scout, capable of bypassing enemy defenses and, if discovered, could avoid pursuit by burrowing.
No matter how strong the adversary, they couldn’t possibly tear apart the entire ground.
This burrowing zombie could also carry other zombies underground, ensuring my survival against unbeatable foes, serving as a lifesaving tactic at critical moments.
...
By noon the next day.
Ji Ruxue approached Zhao Lin with a large tray.
The tray bore a delicious congee, a few pieces of whole wheat bread, and even an egg added into the congee.
Ji Ruxue valued this Nine Deaths Demon Police highly, hoping that with careful guidance, Zhao Lin might successfully step into the Emperor Realm in the future.
The crucial point was that despite such formidable battle prowess, Zhao Lin seemed not particularly sharp, pushing Ji Ruxue to gradually win her over through kindness.
As expected, Zhao Lin was immensely touched seeing the sumptuous food Ji Ruxue brought.
In this extremely indifferent post-apocalyptic world, she never imagined she’d ever eat such lavish food.
Seeing Little Qiqi’s innocent gaze, Zhao Lin felt profoundly moved.
The girl before her, like a little angel, starkly contrasted with the demons at the police station.
Gazing at Ji Ruxue, Zhao Lin resolutely declared, "Little Qiqi, don’t worry, I’ll surely get you out of here!"
Ji Ruxue: "???"
Leave here?
Seriously?
Are you crazy?!
When did I ever say I wanted to leave?
Could we not be so presumptuous?!
Ji Ruxue was utterly speechless.
She planned to ally with Zhao Lin, but didn’t expect Zhao Lin wanted to take her along...

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 151: Does This Corpse King Still Retain Human Consciousness?
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 151: Does This Corpse King Still Retain Human Consciousness?
Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly, the thought process of this Zhao Lin was just too bizarre.
Leave her father?
That’s impossible!
She immediately voiced her stance clearly: "Sorry, you better give up that idea early, I will never leave my dad!"
Are you kidding, wander with you, a woman who can’t even feed herself properly and is always in a sorry state?
Do you really think I’m as big a fool as you are?!
Here in Qingshui Farm, I eat well, and dress well.
Not only do I have my dad’s thoughtful care and love, but also so many Evolved Zombies at my disposal.
Every day I can have hot meat porridge and fresh fruits.
There’s even a contract-bound Mutated Giant Turtle in the pond.
The whole farm is thriving under dad’s management, maybe soon there will be plenty of vegetables to eat.
Here, I have a comfortable, warm, and safe place to live, without worrying about being attacked by zombies in my sleep.
Nor do I have to worry about what to eat tomorrow, or about going hungry.
Unless my brain has been kicked by a donkey, why would I leave this princess-like life to wander with this fool?
Ji Ruxue looked at Zhao Lin like she was an idiot. Had this woman’s brain been knocked silly?
If it weren’t for her ability to come back to life, Zhao Lin would probably have been reincarnated several times by now.
If I really were to leave with this woman, who knows who would be taking care of whom by then...
Whether it was Zhao Lin fleeing to Sunshine District before or being dragged back to Qingshui Farm by dad this time, every time we’ve met she’s been gaunt and disheveled.
She still wants me to leave with her in this state, I really don’t know where her confidence comes from...
Hearing this, Zhao Lin was momentarily dumbfounded.
Ji Ruxue’s words indeed caught her off guard.
She never expected the other party to not want to leave here with her.
Frowning, Zhao Lin hurriedly continued to persuade, "Little Qiqi, listen to me, you really shouldn’t think like that."
"After all, you are human, you can’t possibly live with a group of zombies for long."
"As the saying goes, those who are not of our kind must have different intentions. Moreover, these blood-thirsty zombies could turn their backs at any moment, and by then, it might be too late to regret."
"You are still so young, you should have an extremely beautiful future, only the human world can truly be suitable for you, only there can you have a truly beautiful life!"
Zhao Lin pleaded earnestly.
But Ji Ruxue just sneered at these words.
She even felt like laughing.
Who says the human world is definitely suited for humans?
As a human empire’s empress in her previous life, Ji Ruxue didn’t know how long she struggled through the apocalypse, experiencing countless trials in such harsh survival conditions.
She was long accustomed to the deceitfulness of the human world, especially after the apocalypse when the evil in human nature was greatly magnified in the struggle for survival.
People would do anything for their own survival.
In the post-apocalyptic world, all sorts of extremely ugly situations could happen, many people, though wearing human skins, acted in ways worse than beasts.
Compared to those filthy beings, her zombie father was incomparably better.
Though father is a zombie, Ji Ruxue was certain.
His love for her was real and fervent, a thousand times more genuine than those human hypocrites.
Looking at Zhao Lin’s naive appearance in front of her, Ji Ruxue shook her head.
"Is that so?"
"Then may I ask, have you adapted to the current human life?"
"If the human world is really that wonderful, you wouldn’t have come looking for me, would you?"
If Ji Ruxue remembered correctly, the reason Nine Deaths Demon Police turned dark in their previous life was precisely because they experienced too much deceit in the apocalypse.
So much so that they became completely disillusioned with humanity, transforming from a simple and kind-hearted officer into a ruthless executioner with countless kills.
Upon hearing Ji Ruxue’s words, Zhao Lin was momentarily speechless.
She recalled her past encounters within the police station.
All those demons she killed with her own hands were the very survivors she had risked her life to save.
Even the food she painstakingly collected, she couldn’t bear to eat, choosing instead to share with these survivors.
She was even willing to sacrifice her own life for them.
But all she got in return was betrayal.
Those demons wearing human skins were even more detestable and deserving of death than zombies!
For a moment, Zhao Lin didn’t know how to persuade the other, plunging into deep thought.
Seeing Zhao Lin’s silent demeanor, Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly in her heart.
It seemed Zhao Lin had indeed encountered some changes recently.
But this woman was too pure and kind-hearted, still holding a sliver of fantasy about the human world, despite the changes she faced.
Not wanting to say more, Ji Ruxue took out a workbook from her backpack.
"Oh, by the way, my dad said that you should tutor me in my homework from now on..."
"He said resources are extremely precious now, and you can’t eat and drink for free at our place, you have to work in return."
Ji Ruxue felt helpless about her dad’s decision, it seemed she had disguised herself too well, Dad hadn’t noticed a thing.
In her previous life, after all, she was a graduate from a prestigious university, why would she need this foolish woman to tutor her in elementary school subjects?
"Huh? Tutor you in homework?"
Ji Ruxue’s words left Zhao Lin completely surprised, this development was entirely unexpected for her.
Are you kidding me?
It’s already the apocalypse, and the Corpse King still cares about Little Qiqi’s education?
No hardship should befall children, and nothing should hinder education, right?
Doing homework even in times like these?
But then Zhao Lin felt a chill in her heart.
This Corpse King had such thorough considerations, thinking so meticulously?
Not only did he take care of Little Qiqi in every aspect, but he also didn’t want to neglect her education?
Even if the Corpse King was Little Qiqi’s biological father during his human life, his care for the child after becoming a zombie was notable.
But how could he, as a zombie, know about these things?
Could it be that...
Suddenly, an astonishing thought struck Zhao Lin’s mind!
This Corpse King’s way of doing things was not at all like those blood-thirsty zombies.
He managed the entire abandoned farm so orderly and rejuvenated; more like a human with wisdom...
Could it be that...
This zombie still retained his human memories?
Had not completely turned into a blood-thirsty monster?!

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 152: Human Nightmare or Savior?
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 152: Human Nightmare or Savior?
Impossible!
Absolutely impossible!
As soon as this thought surfaced in her mind, Zhao Lin quickly shook her head.
This idea is just too absurd, it doesn’t conform to normal logic at all.
Zombies are just zombies, merely a group of monsters that died after being infected by a virus.
How could they possibly retain human consciousness?!
As a police officer, Zhao Lin was among the first batch of humans to have direct contact with zombies after the apocalypse.
Whether it’s those humans who have already turned into zombies...
Or those who gradually mutate after being bitten by zombies, Zhao Lin has had contact with them.
Once these guys mutate, they lose their sanity and turn into mindless bloodthirsty monsters.
Be it their own relatives or friends, zombies seem to have no other thoughts apart from devouring flesh and blood.
Initially, the police station wanted to suppress this kind of crazy mutation state, back then, nobody knew it was a zombie crisis that would sweep the world.
But soon Zhao Lin and others found that this couldn’t be compared to ordinary rabies, those who had mutated didn’t have any thoughts at all.
No way to awaken even the slightest bit of human memory within their bodies through any method.
After attempting various methods, the police station then decided not to rescue those who had turned into zombies but instead chose humane destruction, meaning direct extermination.
Having contacted so many zombies, not a single one had human consciousness.
Zhao Lin couldn’t believe that the Corpse King in front of her could retain human consciousness, the idea was utterly absurd.
If a zombie retained human consciousness...
Then is it considered dead or alive?
Though the idea is somewhat ridiculous, the scenes she’s witnessing right now are too overwhelming for her.
If the Corpse King doesn’t have human consciousness, why can it cultivate farmland?
And consciously strengthen the walls?
How could these be actions taken by a group of bloodthirsty zombies?
Zombies with a mind full of slaughter, how could they raise a human infant?
Even take care of her mental and physical health? Create a vast array of play facilities?
How could a zombie that bites humans and chases creatures on the streets do something so humane?!
Zhao Lin couldn’t help but recall her time in the Sunshine District.
Learning from that mysterious Invisible that the Corpse King was different from other zombies.
This type of existence has a certain level of intelligence, able to manipulate zombie actions from behind the scenes.
But now it seems that’s far more than just simple intelligence!
If it weren’t a being with human consciousness, what she’s seeing wouldn’t have happened!
But if the Corpse King truly retains human consciousness...
These chaotic thoughts spun in her mind without stop, leaving Zhao Lin’s thoughts in disarray.
...
"Here, this is my homework, could you check it for me?"
Having completed her homework, Ji Ruxue reluctantly handed the notebook to Zhao Lin.
She earned a graduate degree from a prestigious university in her past life, now even elementary school homework has to be checked by others...
Ji Ruxue’s words interrupted Zhao Lin’s thoughts, and she returned to her senses, taking the notebook and inspecting it.
Then she found Little Qiqi had answered every question correctly, which made her eyes light up.
She couldn’t help but marvel at how intelligent Little Qiqi was.
Completing these assignments through self-study without guidance.
If Little Qiqi were living in the normal human world, Zhao Lin couldn’t imagine how outstanding her future could be.
"Little Qiqi, you’re amazing! You got all the questions right!"
Zhao Lin smiled and praised Ji Ruxue, "You’re the smartest child I’ve ever met!"
Looking at Little Qiqi in front of her, Zhao Lin hesitated to speak.
These thoughts in her mind kept spinning without stopping.
Zhao Lin wanted to get some clues from Little Qiqi to confirm her hypothesis.
But looking into Little Qiqi’s clear eyes, Zhao Lin sighed helplessly and could only abandon the idea.
If the Corpse King indeed possesses human intelligence, that alone is a groundbreaking secret.
And Zhao Lin knows fully well that even if she asked such questions...
With Little Qiqi’s cleverness, she’d surely notice something odd and wouldn’t reveal anything.
Though the little one is very young, she discerns what should be said and what should not clearly.
Back in Sunshine District, Zhao Lin experienced this firsthand.
Every time she asked crucial questions, Little Qiqi always avoided answering.
The little one is not as simple as she seems on the surface.
Moreover, Zhao Lin knows that although the Corpse King hasn’t done anything yet...
She can guarantee that the Corpse King is definitely watching her.
Once she decides to probe deeper or do something out of line, it’ll definitely alert the Corpse King.
Having interacted with the Corpse King several times, Zhao Lin considers herself somewhat familiar with its personality.
This guy is not just typically cautious.
If the Corpse King has any secrets, it would definitely not allow her to take such secrets away.
Once Zhao Lin inadvertently lets something slip, the Corpse King definitely won’t let her go.
Even though she can reincarnate, Zhao Lin realizes.
Her ability has limits, and there’s no guarantee she’ll wake up next time she dies.
She frowned tightly, feeling troubled by the multitude of thoughts in her mind.
If the Corpse King truly retains human consciousness and can think and act like a normal human...
Then should we consider it human or zombie?
Or perhaps, what defines the boundary between zombies and humans?
Every zombie originates from a transformed human, and zombies are a group of mindless and bloodthirsty monsters.
But if a zombie possesses human-like consciousness, how should these two races be categorized?
People infected with rabies also go mad and attack nearby humans, yet they are still regarded as humans by society.
But what about zombies?
Most crucial is if this Corpse King truly has human consciousness, is he treating himself like a human, or as one of the bloodthirsty zombies?
If it’s the former, the Corpse King could unify all zombies with its abilities and human consciousness, perhaps ending this dystopian apocalypse alone.
