But if it’s the latter, then this human-conscious Corpse King will be a nightmare for everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 153: The Rescue Team from Jianghai Base City!
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 153: The Rescue Team from Jianghai Base City!
Just like that, ten days had passed in a flash.
During this time of relentless day and night struggle, Lu Chuan, controlling numerous Corpse Puppets, had been working diligently to reinforce the perimeter of Qingshui Farm with stones.
The original makeshift walls made of fences and wire mesh were suitable for the peaceful society before the zombie crisis, not for now.
Through his efforts, Lu Chuan had built a towering, solid stone wall around Qingshui Farm’s perimeter to ensure better security and stronger defenses within the farm.
The stone wall on the perimeter reached a height of four meters and had a thickness of two meters!
Moreover, Lu Chuan did not waste the existing wire mesh on the wall but directly grafted it onto the top of the stone city wall.
The wall, which already had increased defensive power, was further strengthened by these wire meshes.
This stone wall was enough to withstand most zombies or survivors, shielding Qingshui Farm airtight from outside threats.
Additionally, Lu Chuan controlled a large number of Corpse Puppets, having them patrol ceaselessly around the farm’s wall day and night.
After Lu Chuan’s improvements during this period, the previously abandoned farm at the outskirts now looked like a military fortress from the outside!
Of course, Lu Chuan didn’t just focus on improving the perimeter defenses; the internal farms also saw significant gains under the diligent labor of the Corpse Puppets.
The once-abandoned vegetable gardens had been revitalized by the incessant work of the Corpse Puppets during this time.
Soon, the seeds planted in the farms successfully sprouted, and after this period of growth, green seedlings had emerged from the earth.
It seemed as though the presence of blood and flesh in the farmland greatly increased the nutrients in the soil.
These plants thrived vigorously, and during this time, Lu Chuan often looked after these growing green seedlings, and their overall condition was better than imagined.
Next to the amusement park, there was also a small change: a bed appeared among the pile of amusement facilities...
Lu Chuan observed all of Zhao Lin’s actions during this time through Tyrant Two’s surveillance.
This foolish woman seemed like a completely different person from when she was in Sunshine District, behaving very quietly and honestly during this period.
Seeing that she brought comfort to Little Qiqi and wholeheartedly tutored her, Lu Chuan did not treat her too harshly this time.
He generously arranged for two Corpse Puppets to move a bed near the slide.
The bed was placed right under the slide, which acted as a shield against the wind and rain. Lu Chuan thought he was being very kind to Zhao Lin.
Even Zhao Lin herself was quite satisfied...
Earlier in Sunshine District, she was first surrounded and beaten badly by a group of zombies, causing severe pain and bleeding, and later had her legs broken.
This time, apart from being beaten once when they met, the Corpse King never laid hands on her again, and now she even had her own bed.
Constantly fleeing during the apocalypse had previously left Zhao Lin thin and pale, with a weak and tired overall state, even walking appeared listless.
After recuperating at Qingshui Farm during this period, Zhao Lin’s complexion significantly improved.
She might not have the dazzling look she had before the apocalypse, but at least her face regained a healthy flush, and she appeared energetic.
Although still chained by Lu Chuan, her overall condition improved greatly.
The key was that being at Qingshui Farm, surrounded by numerous zombies providing defense, allowed Zhao Lin to rest assured and not fear zombie attacks.
Looking at the sky above, Zhao Lin chuckled bitterly in her heart.
The most peaceful time after the apocalypse was undoubtedly when she stayed with the Corpse King under the same roof.
Even though her legs were broken in Sunshine District, she had enough food and didn’t have to risk her life for a morsel as other survivors did.
This time, the life at Qingshui Farm was even more wonderful; not only were her legs unbroken, but the environment was also more spacious than Sunshine District.
The integration with nature was more pleasing, and the meals were better than before.
Zhao Lin never imagined she would fall in love with the meat porridge cooked by a Corpse King.
The meat porridge was incredibly delicious, and every time Zhao Lin drank it, she felt warm all over, as if filled with boundless energy.
"I never thought that as a human, and an Evolver at that, I would be living comfortably among zombies."
"The most absurd thing is living here at Qingshui Farm with the Corpse King is even more comfortable than when I was at the police station..."
This current life sparked a bold idea in Zhao Lin’s mind; perhaps one day, humans and zombies could coexist as peacefully as now...
If it were another Corpse King, it might not be possible, but if it were the Corpse King like Little Qiqi’s dad, who retained human consciousness, maybe it could be achieved...
...
During these ten days, Lu Chuan also made great gains within the city district.
The entire southern area of the city had almost been brought under Lu Chuan’s control.
Thanks to the continued search efforts of the Corpse Puppet squads, the Evolved Zombies and resources in the southern area of the city were under his grasp, and Lu Chuan didn’t particularly concern himself with the remaining survivors.
As for the development of the Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan had always been working on it.
He cultivated his Tier Two Corpse Puppets by hunting ordinary Tier One Evolved Zombies.
After much effort, Lu Chuan now had no less than twenty Tier Two Evolved Zombies under his command!
Though most were Agile and Tank Type Zombies.
The zombies in the Lightning Group had reached ’Lightning Eight.’
And the Tank Type Zombies had successfully become six brothers, with the newest ’Liu Pang’ also breaking into Tier Two.
There were also three Tier Two Tyrant Zombies now.
In addition, Lu Chuan encountered a totally red Tier Two Flame Zombie during this period.
However, there was only one Earth Escape Zombie as before.
With so many Tier Two Evolved Zombies, Lu Chuan’s strength became extremely formidable.
The farm flourished, his strength continued to grow, and Little Qiqi studied diligently, progressing rapidly every day.
Even though this was a desolate end-times, Lu Chuan felt secure.
He hoped this peaceful life could last forever.
...
Buzz, buzz, buzz!
On this day, a helicopter suddenly flew over Jiangnan City District, disrupting the sky’s calm.
Some survivors saw several parachutes drop from the aircraft, along with a large number of leaflets scattered.
Lu Chuan naturally saw this scene through the Corpse Puppets.
He then controlled a Corpse Puppet to pick up a leaflet and look at it.
"Hmm? A rescue team sent from Jianghai Survivor Base?"

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 154: Strange, There’s Not a Single Evolved Zombie Here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 154: Strange, There’s Not a Single Evolved Zombie Here!
After reading the information on the flyer, Lu Chuan frowned deeply.
The data on the flyer was actually very straightforward.
According to the records, the official survivor base in Jianghai City had now completely stabilized.
They could now dispatch their resources to rescue other survivors scattered outside.
According to the information on the flyer, the survivor base had sent out several powerful Evolutionary Squads to rescue survivors around Jianghai City.
This flyer was used to remind survivors in various places to leave distress signals and wait for rescue teams to save them one by one.
The information revealed on this flyer suggested that the Jianghai City’s survivor base seemed to have gained confidence in dealing with this apocalyptic change.
Seeing this flyer, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but fall into deep thought.
"Humans are indeed the strongest species on this planet, already beginning to adapt after a short time of facing the apocalypse."
"Not only can they maintain the stability within the base, but they can also send out Evolvers to rescue others. It seems Jianghai City’s survivor base has developed significantly and possesses commendable strength."
Lu Chuan still remembered how chaotic the world was when the doomsday crisis first erupted.
At that time, everyone was in danger, let alone rescuing others.
Just surviving was a problem itself.
Lu Chuan had previously learned about the survivor base when he was living in the Sunshine District.
He even had a confrontation with those Evolvers from the survivor base.
Although he didn’t know why those guys were targeting Sunshine District.
They were all killed by him.
Based on previous information, the purpose of that Evolver team was to enter the city to search for supplies.
And now, the survivor base had developed to the point of organizing Evolutionary Squads to go out and rescue survivors.
This transformation further demonstrates that humans are slowly adapting to this apocalypse change.
However, since the purpose of these Evolver rescue teams is to save survivors.
Then Lu Chuan thought there was no need to go hard against these guys.
Although he became a zombie after the crisis erupted,
Lu Chuan, who still retained human consciousness, didn’t think he needed to be at odds with humans like other zombies.
After all, there is no fundamental conflict of interest between the two sides.
As long as these human survivors don’t disturb him and Little Qiqi’s peaceful life, Lu Chuan couldn’t be bothered with them.
It’s best that everyone minds their own business and keeps a mutual peace.
Thinking of the parachutes jumping down from the helicopter just now, Lu Chuan’s heart moved, and he immediately manipulated all the active Evolved Corpse Puppets near Jiangnan City District to disappear.
Keeping Evolved Corpse Puppets in the city will sooner or later lead to a conflict with these Evolvers.
Anyway, the Corpse Puppets’ strength had increased a lot during this period, so a few days wouldn’t matter.
And as for other supplies, Lu Chuan’s Qingshui Farm warehouse was already almost full.
In that case, they might as well give the Corpse Puppets a few days off.
...
A moment later, in Jiangnan City District,
five men in black special operations uniforms were surrounded by a large group of corpses on a street.
"Lin Yan, you’re responsible for taking out those groups of zombies that keep gathering here!"
"Liu Yang, you and Yang Xiu are to cut down the zombies approaching us and protect Lin Yan."
"Zhang Hao, hide next to me and use your abilities to help everyone recover and increase their stamina!"
"Everyone, be extra careful, the city is different from other places, who knows when an Evolved Zombie will jump out!"
A middle-aged man in a black combat uniform commanded his teammates with a calm expression.
This five-man Evolution Team was one of the teams sent by the survivor base to rescue survivors this time.
The leader, named Wang Lei, was a captain in the military before the apocalypse, exuding a tough iron-blooded air.
After the zombie crisis erupted, the unit Wang Lei was stationed in also experienced a zombie crisis, with many comrades turning into zombies, forcing him to find ways to escape the barracks.
Fortunately, as an officer, he quickly joined the survivor base.
After the Blood Moon, he awakened a robust Talent Ability called ’Steel Hardening,’ allowing him to make his body as tough as steel.
As he progressed, his body’s strength continued to enhance.
With his military combat skills, Wang Lei, although his Talent Ability was defensive in nature, successfully became a powerful warrior capable of both offense and defense.
In this rescue action initiated by the Jianghai City’s survivor base, he took on the role of the team’s captain.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Loud bangs echoed on the street as fireballs streaked overhead, igniting fierce flames among the zombie horde.
The Evolver named Lin Yan had blazing flames in his hands, similar to Lu Chuan’s control of Flame One, releasing fireballs with every wave of his hands.
Watching the zombies engulfed in flames, Lin Yan smirked coldly.
Unlike the steady Wang Lei, Lin Yan appeared to be only about twenty years old, full of youthful arrogance.
Before the apocalypse, Lin Yan was just a regular college junior, happening to be in an off-campus rented house when the crisis hit.
After the Blood Moon, he awakened a flame talent, allowing him to continuously unleash fire to attack zombies, with considerable combat power.
Zhang Hao, beside Wang Lei, was a classmate of Lin Yan from the same university, though in a different major. After the Blood Moon, he awakened an augmentative Talent.
He could boost the speed and strength of his teammates based on his Spiritual Power, acting as a sort of team buff aura, making it significantly easier for the team.
Due to his relatively weak combat ability, Zhang Hao usually stood next to Wang Lei.
At the very front of the team were two melee Evolvers, a man named Yang Xiu wielding a three-foot-long sword, about thirty years old, and a burly man with a beard named Liu Yang wielding two machetes.
Yang Xiu, from a martial arts family, had trained since young and, after awakening a swift Talent, his combat power skyrocketed.
The Three-foot Cyan Blade slashed through the air, cutting down zombies like autumn leaves.
Liu Yang, a butcher, awakened a Giant Strength Talent, swinging his machetes vigorously, reducing any approaching zombies to pieces.
In just a short time, the street was piled with a dense mass of corpses.
All the zombies they attracted were killed, and the Evolvers ended the fight with a flick of their hands, walking over to Wang Lei.
All five were Evolvers above the second tier, with formidable power, yet all wore puzzled expressions at the moment.
"Captain, something feels off."
"We’ve been here quite a while, but haven’t encountered a single Evolved Zombie."

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 155: The Zombies Here Not Only Drive? They Also Transport Supplies?
chapters.content:
Upon hearing the reports from the team members, Wang Lei also felt a bit puzzled.
Because the city was densely populated before the apocalypse, the number of Evolved Zombies inside is usually more than outside the city.
The commotion from the battle they just had on this street wasn’t small, even the ordinary zombies from several nearby streets were attracted.
Yet among so many ordinary zombies, there wasn’t even a single Evolved Zombie.
This situation really defied common sense.
"Perhaps we’re in an area that just so happens to avoid the Evolved Zombies. Everyone needs to be careful. It’s very dangerous in the city, and we could be attacked by various Evolved Zombies at any moment."
As a captain in the military, Wang Lei had personally witnessed the power of these zombies.
Even though they had killed plenty of zombies on this street, he still cautiously reminded his teammates.
Lin Yan, however, didn’t care at all. Looking at the charred zombies all over the ground, he showed a confident smile at the corner of his mouth: "Captain, I think you’re being too cautious. No Evolved Zombies have appeared for so long, it seems they’re afraid of us!"
"Just a group of brainless Bloodthirsty Monsters. Even if they evolve, it’s nothing special. It’s not like we haven’t seen Evolved Zombies before."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei frowned but said nothing more.
The team members under his command were all uniquely talented and powerful.
Lin Yan, especially, had awakened the Elemental Flame Control ability.
His mastery over flames was superb, allowing him to unleash immense power in group battles.
Perhaps because of the strength of his Flame Ability, or perhaps due to being too young,
Lin Yan always gave off too arrogant a temperament, which Wang Lei found quite displeasing.
"Everyone still needs to be careful. Next, we’ll spread out to search for hidden survivors."
Wang Lei, as the Evolution Team captain, quickly began to form a new plan.
"Try to rescue as many survivors as possible. By evening, bring them back to regroup. If you encounter danger, be sure to send a signal to alert your companions!"
The five of them set up their communication equipment and then began going in different directions to find survivors.
Now that the southern city area was under Lu Chuan’s control, the Evolved Corpse Puppets were all hidden under his command.
Ordinary zombies wandering the streets were not a match for the Evolvers, and many survivors hiding in the dark were rescued one after another.
The five Evolvers spread out to rescue survivors, and when they gathered at night, all five were unscathed and appeared relaxed.
Even Zhang Hao, who had awakened an augmentation talent, could easily kill many ordinary zombies with his evolved physical enhancements.
Gathering all the survivors they brought along, they found that only about twenty to thirty people had been rescued from this large city area.
Although this was just a portion of the survivors, it showed how horrifically high human casualties were after the apocalypse!
Wang Lei led the survivors into a store, but this chain store had long been emptied, not even hairs left on the shelves.
They moved all the shelves aside, leaving a large empty space in the middle, with the survivors sitting in a circle.
These survivors had been hiding in the dark all this time, and each one was already emaciated from hunger.
Besides essential equipment, Wang Lei and the others carried a lot of supplies meant to replenish the survivors from the Survivor Base.
"Everyone line up by head count to receive bottled water and compressed biscuits. Regardless of age or gender, the share is the same. Come and line up orderly to receive your portion."
Under Wang Lei’s organization, these twenty to thirty survivors lined up in an orderly fashion.
"Thank you, thank you so much!"
"I knew the Survivor Base would send people to rescue us, thank you so much!"
Even though they only received some compressed biscuits, to the survivors who were already starving, this was precious and could at least provide essential calories for their bodies.
However, some survivors were still not satisfied.
A rather beefy man, after receiving the compressed biscuits and bottled water, threw it to the ground with a look of discontent.
"How long has it been since the apocalypse? It’s been three months, and you’re only now thinking of rescuing people? What were you doing before?"
"And you’re just giving us these compressed biscuits? Are these even edible?!"
Hearing this, a few other survivors nodded their heads.
But just as they were about to agree, Lin Yan let out a cold laugh.
Smack!
A quick step, and Lin Yan appeared in front of the survivor, slapping him to the ground. The man’s face swelled up instantly, losing several teeth.
"With trash like you, you should be grateful we came to the city to save you, and you dare to complain here?"
"If you ramble another word, believe me or not, I’ll directly throw you out to feed the zombies?!"
Lin Yan’s sudden outburst startled all the survivors present.
Each one became silent and dared not utter any more complaints.
Those who hadn’t spoken were secretly relieved, thinking they were lucky to have been slow or they’d have been the ones getting beaten.
As for Wang Lei and the others, they were long accustomed and didn’t find anything improper.
Finishing up, Lin Yan crushed the compressed biscuit under his foot, pressing the survivor’s head firmly to the ground.
"Damn useless waste. Lick it clean, or I’ll feed you to the zombies!"
Gazing at the survivor he had trampled, Lin Yan wore a sinister grin.
Wang Lei frowned slightly at this scene, then gestured to Lin Yan: "Alright, don’t waste time with these people, come over and discuss today’s situation."
The five of them gathered and shared their respective encounters, finishing with puzzled expressions on all their faces.
"None of you encountered an Evolved Zombie? That’s quite unlikely, isn’t it?"
Wang Lei frowned, believing that not encountering a single Evolved Zombie all day wasn’t just good luck for the team.
"Hey, you’re an Evolver, right? Come over, I have a few questions for you."
Wang Lei glanced at one of the more agile survivors, clearly also an Evolver.
"Has anything strange happened recently in Jiangnan City District? Where did all the Evolved Zombies go?"
This Evolver obviously sensed that Wang Lei and the others had auras far superior to his, and quickly replied truthfully: "To be honest, there indeed are Evolved Zombies in Jiangnan City District."
"But you may not believe it, I’ve even seen zombies driving cars. The supplies in Jiangnan City District were taken away by those zombies!"
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei and the others were instantly stunned on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 156: Jiangnan City District Is Truly Full of Mysteries Everywhere!
chapters.content:
Can zombies drive cars?
Where the heck did this ludicrous idea come from?!
And they even make zombies transport human supplies.
Since when do these bloodthirsty monsters like eating bread and cookies?!
Upon hearing this survivor’s words, Wang Lei and his team all had an expression of stunned disbelief.
They had speculated on various situations in the Jiangnan City District.
But what this survivor said left them completely dumbfounded.
The Jianghai City Survivor Base has now reached quite a规模, its development through various battles with zombies during the apocalypse.
And as the rescue team going out, each member of Wang Lei’s group naturally had extraordinary strength.
Each of them had slain Evolved Zombies in the apocalypse and were considered well-informed.
They understand all kinds of zombies, but had never heard of any zombies driving cars.
Nor had they heard of zombies having a habit of collecting human supplies.
Even if the five had rich combat experience, they were also horrified.
What this survivor said was beyond their imagination, utterly devoid of any authenticity.
"Kid, are you freaking kidding me?!"
Hot-tempered Lin Yan burst into laughter in fury upon hearing this survivor’s words. He stepped forward and lifted him by his collar.
"You think we’re fools? Since when can zombies freaking drive? And you’re lying without even finding a good reason?!"
Lin Yan simply didn’t believe this survivor’s nonsense.
After the apocalypse broke out, Lin Yan had been hiding in his rental unit until after the Blood Moon when he awakened his Flame Talent, discovering he possessed impressive combat abilities.
With his Flame Talent, Lin Yan fought numerous zombies.
As far as he was concerned, these zombies were just a bunch of brainless bloodthirsty monsters, impossible to have any human thoughts or behavior.
Lin Yan’s anger led him to grip tighter, as if wanting to crush the survivor to death.
Wang Lei and the others did not stop him because they thought the statement was too absurd; they believed the survivor was playing them.
When the survivor’s face turned red from Lin Yan’s grip, his companions couldn’t sit still and collectively vouched for him.
"Please, great sirs, my friend is not lying, the zombies in Jiangnan City District truly are peculiar!"
"Yes, many survivors in Jiangnan City District have seen zombies driving cars."
"The reason we can’t gather supplies is that a large number of zombies are raiding each store, looting all the supplies."
More and more survivors stood to vouch.
Clearly, what Lu Chuan sent Corpse Puppets to do in the Jiangnan City District had been noticed by many survivors secretly hiding.
Lu Chuan’s actions simply caused too much noise, dealing with Evolved Zombies either by subduing or directly killing them.
As for the other supplies, a large number of Corpse Puppets were dispatched to transport them directly without any rationale.
"Those zombies are simply crazy, everything that can be taken is taken away, not leaving a single hair for us."
"And we’ve seen with our own eyes, those zombies even extract gasoline, take it from abandoned cars, fill large containers and carry it away!"
"..."
The survivor’s numerous statements about the situation were generally the same.
This made the squad momentarily glance at each other in disbelief.
If it were only one or two people, they might intentionally lie, but if everyone was so sure, then there was some reality to it.
Wang Lei and his team sat staring at each other, their eyes full of surprise.
Tonight, the news from those survivors was somewhat beyond their comprehension, utterly unexpected.
Not only from their own experience, but also from the information provided by the Survivor Base to date, there is no mention of the Jiangnan City District issues.
"Brothers should be cautious, abnormal phenomena indicate something strange, and Jiangnan City District may not be that simple."
"With zombies here so peculiar, we must be very careful, report situations timely, and definitely not fall for the zombies’ tricks!"
Born a soldier, Wang Lei instinctively sensed Jiangnan City District wasn’t as simple as it seemed.
Yang Xiu, holding his long sword, nodded slightly: "I think the captain is right, the zombies here are indeed peculiar."
"But if it’s true as what these survivors say, that zombies can transport supplies and drive cars, we must properly investigate!"
The few exchanged glances and smiled slightly.
The Survivor Base sent many Evolvers into the city not only for rescue but because population is a resource after the apocalypse, the base needs manpower for basic construction.
Additionally, it wants to send many Evolvers to the city to gather information.
In the Survivor Base, besides providing Zombie Crystal Cores, new intelligence can be exchanged for a large amount of Contribution Points.
In the Survivor Base, exchanging Evolutionary Gene Potions or other items requires Contribution Points.
So, many Evolvers choose to join exploration teams, aiming to take Contribution Points to strengthen themselves.
If they can really investigate the zombie-driving situation, they would be able to acquire a large amount of Contribution Points!
Yang Xiu, holding his long sword, let a smirk play on his lips.
"Jiangnan City District is really interesting, even zombies can drive, I’d like to see whose driving skills are better."
Yang Xiu’s face showed a teasing grin.
As someone from a martial arts family, Yang Xiu grew up in a well-to-do environment, living carefreely before the apocalypse.
Before the apocalypse, he was a racing driver.
With excellent driving skills, he couldn’t help but consider competing when hearing even zombies could drive.
Wang Lei heard this and frowned, his companions apart from the steady Zhang Hao with增益天赋were all casual in attitude.
"Everyone should still be careful, avoid letting your guard down, my intuition tells me this place isn’t easy."
As the leader, Wang Lei sighed helplessly. Although today’s message was somewhat absurd, he had to prepare his team for any sudden combat.
Currently, Jiangnan City District is full of mysteries, and beneath this mystery, huge potential dangers may be hidden.

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 157: Curiosity Killed the Cat!
chapters.content:
As the rescue team arrived in the Jiangnan City District for two days, because there was no obstruction from Evolved Zombies, the rescue operation led by Wang Lei’s Evolution Team went very smoothly.
One by one, they rescued many hidden survivors.
During the rescue process, the Evolutionary Squad was also constantly compiling information.
Wang Lei and others also learned via radio that Evolution Teams in other areas had started to engage with Evolved Zombies in other city districts.
Some teams had even suffered considerable casualties.
However, in the Jiangnan City District where Wang Lei and others were, they had yet to discover any trace of Evolved Zombies.
This made their rescue mission proceed very smoothly.
It was almost too smooth, completely without the anticipated danger that Wang Lei and others had predicted before coming.
As more and more survivors were rescued, Wang Lei and the others learned more information from these people.
Many of these survivors claimed to have personally witnessed zombies driving cars.
There were even more people who had seen zombies transporting supplies.
In the eyes of Wang Lei and his team, these bizarre phenomena seemed incredibly absurd.
And after more inquiries, Wang Lei and his team had even heard that the Jiangnan City District had frequently witnessed battles between Evolved Zombies not long ago.
Those Evolved Zombies kept fighting fiercely, occasionally letting out earth-shattering roars, scaring many survivors into not daring to search for food.
The commotion from the battles of Evolved Zombies was so great that many survivors had witnessed it with their own eyes.
After continuous inquiries, Wang Lei compiled the information from these survivors.
Indeed, there had been battles between Evolved Zombies, zombies driving cars, and zombies transporting supplies in Jiangnan City District before.
But in the past few days, no one had seen any of these phenomena.
The disappearance of these Evolved Zombies coincided with the arrival of the rescue team.
It seemed that the Evolved Zombies simply vanished without a trace after the rescue team arrived in Jiangnan City District.
Although Wang Lei and others found it hard to believe, such a coincidence inadvertently gave rise to some thoughts.
Could it be that these Evolved Zombies were truly afraid of them?
Upon learning that an Evolutionary Squad had come to save survivors, did they all hide away?
Although this speculation seemed a bit ridiculous, at the moment it appeared to be the only possibility.
Otherwise, there was no reason for everything to be normal before they arrived, and then change once the five of them came.
The absence of Evolved Zombies made Wang Lei’s team even more relaxed.
More and more survivors received rescue, yet they still hadn’t encountered Evolved Zombies, as if these Evolved Zombies were truly afraid of them.
...
Due to the extreme safety of the Jiangnan City District, the rescue missions were conducted separately.
When Lin Yan was conducting a rescue in the Jiangnan City District, he passed through a small road leading to the suburbs.
Lin Yan didn’t pay much attention initially, but he found that the ground was very uneven, and there were large truck tracks.
"Hmm? Are these... marks from a large truck?"
Lin Yan looked at the tracks and squatted down to measure the depth of the tire imprints with his hand.
"It seems these aren’t just marks left by a large truck, but a fully loaded one!"
With the apocalypse having lasted for over half a year, the zombie crisis erupted so swiftly that humans quickly had to hide.
No one dared to drive on the streets, which would basically serve as a beacon for zombies.
Yet Lin Yan was surprised to find that the tracks on this road were clearly very recent.
And the same tire tracks appeared repeatedly on this road, indicating that the vehicle had frequently traveled back and forth recently.
This behavior was not typical of a human survivor.
After all, if human survivors could leave the city district alive, no one would likely want to return here.
Lin Yan furrowed his brows slightly, recalling what he had heard from the survivors about zombies driving vehicles.
"Could those useless fools be telling the truth? Are there truly zombies capable of driving trucks in the Jiangnan City District?"
"Are these tire tracks left by a zombie driving a truck?!"
At this thought, Lin Yan’s eyes went wide.
He previously didn’t believe a word the survivors said, but now it seemed the evidence was right in front of his eyes.
"Haha, quite interesting indeed."
"Mindless and bloodthirsty creatures that can drive? If I can take this news back to base, it may earn a substantial amount of Contribution Points!"
Lin Yan’s eyes lit up; news of zombies driving would likely be met with disbelief.
If he could confirm this news and bring it back to the Survivor Base, it would indeed be a major achievement.
He would surely earn a lot of Contribution Points and might even achieve a breakthrough in his own evolution.
Previously, Lin Yan wouldn’t have dared to act alone; no one knew what dangers the apocalypse might present.
But with no Evolved Zombies appearing recently in Jiangnan City District, Lin Yan felt that these zombies must be afraid, boosting his confidence significantly.
After some thought, Lin Yan decided not to inform Wang Lei and the others, and independently followed the tracks towards the suburbs.
Relying on his great combat power as an Evolver, Lin Yan easily dispatched the ordinary zombies he encountered along the way.
His hands glowed with flames, and under the terrifying blaze, these zombies were no match for him.
As numerous zombies fell under his feet, Lin Yan grew increasingly confident.
However, caught up in the slaughter, Lin Yan failed to notice a zombie silently trailing him.
Once Lin Yan was far from the urban area, ’Lightning One’ suddenly charged out from the shadows.
The sudden movement startled Lin Yan; he quickly waved his hands, instantly erecting a wall of fire to block ahead.
But after observing for so long, Lu Chuan had understood Lin Yan’s combat style thoroughly.
This wall of fire was completely within Lu Chuan’s expectations; he immediately maneuvered Lightning One to dodge and swiftly closed in on Lin Yan.
’Lightning One’s’ burst of speed turned Lin Yan’s face deathly pale.
As an Evolver capable of conducting rescue missions in the city district, Lin Yan’s combat abilities were indeed very powerful.
But his overconfidence led him to overestimate his own strength.
While his flame attacks were formidable, he was merely a "Mage," facing an agile Evolved Zombie like ’Lightning One.’
...
Half an hour later.
At the entrance of Qingshui Farm, ’Lightning One’ returned to the farm, dragging a lifeless corpse.
The corpse was none other than Lin Yan from the five-person team.
Gazing at the Evolver before him, a cold glint flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
"The path to heaven you bypassed, yet you barged into hell’s gate."
"Didn’t your mother ever tell you curiosity killed the cat?"

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 158: Warning!
chapters.content:
Looking at the corpse of the Evolver in front of him, the killing intent in Lu Chuan’s eyes almost became tangible, his blood-colored pupils filled with cold light.
Although he’s now transformed into a zombie, he has no intention of completely breaking away from humanity.
In this chaotic post-apocalyptic world, Lu Chuan’s demands are simple; he just wants a place where he and Little Qiqi can live peacefully.
After becoming a zombie, he never actively attacked the human survivor team.
Unless humans provoked him.
Lu Chuan questioned himself if he had retreated enough.
After all, if it were other zombies, they would have already slaughtered any humans they encountered.
Especially after the human rescue team entered Jiangnan City District.
To avoid provoking the Human Base City, Lu Chuan even controlled all his Evolved Corpse Puppets, making all Evolved Zombies in the Jiangnan City District disappear.
Lu Chuan had made his greatest effort to avoid conflict with humans.
But he didn’t expect these humans to be shamelessly ambitious, attempting to seize Qingshui Farm.
Their fate can only be death!
Lu Chuan’s eyes became eerily sinister at this moment.
The reason he moved from Sunshine District to Qingshui Farm was because he didn’t want to clash with humans.
He hoped he and Little Qiqi could have a peaceful and stable living environment.
Nowadays, Qingshui Farm is his bottom line.
To ensure the safety of Qingshui Farm, he had already arranged for a large number of Evolved Corpse Puppets to ambush on various roads leading to Qingshui Farm.
But even after retreating to such an extent, he didn’t expect these humans to still shamelessly covet his home.
Then don’t blame him for being ruthless.
Through the confrontation between Lightning One and this Flame Evolver, Lu Chuan could tell that the opponents he faced this time were much stronger than those Evolvers from before.
Their Evolution Realm was higher, and they had richer combat experience.
"According to Corpse Puppet’s surveillance, the Survivor Base just dropped supplies once, and all the resources inside Jiangnan City District have already been moved by me. Without supplies to settle so many survivors, these humans likely can’t stay long."
Having lived in the post-apocalyptic world for so long, Lu Chuan knew very well what food meant to these survivors.
Without food, even the human survivor base couldn’t appease the survivors’ emotions unless using direct violence.
Besides, Evolvers aren’t mythical cultivators; they still need food to replenish the energy they consume.
Even if the survivors could endure hunger, these Evolvers absolutely couldn’t stay in a state of starvation.
Glancing at the Evolver’s corpse at his feet, Lu Chuan’s lips curled into a cold smile.
Since they take an inch, it does no harm to give them another warning.
"I hope you can behave accordingly, don’t be shameless."
"I’ve already given you whole Jiangnan City District, and yet you still covet my territory. I hope after seeing this warning, you can have some self-awareness."
Moments later, the Earth Escape zombie arrived next to Lu Chuan, took Lin Yan’s corpse, and immediately burrowed underground, silently infiltrating into Jiangnan City District.
The Earth Escape zombie moves silently, making it perfect for such tasks.
...
"What’s going on? Why hasn’t Lin Yan come back yet? There’s no movement on the radio either!"
In the night.
The five members of the rescue team gathered again in the shop, only to find Lin Yan missing.
Moreover, Wang Lei and others repeatedly called Lin Yan via radio but received no response.
He seemed to have vanished into thin air in Jiangnan City District, making the team’s atmosphere instantly heavy.
Although they hadn’t encountered any Evolved Zombies in recent days, Wang Lei always felt that Jiangnan City District seemed shrouded in shadows.
Especially learning from the survivors about the eerie happenings with zombies in Jiangnan City District, he felt even more uneasy.
Thus, Wang Lei set a rule for everyone to return to the team before nightfall, regardless of the results.
The Evolvers sent out by the Survivor Base are all experienced and powerful, each with their own temperament and character, but they wouldn’t make such basic mistakes like being late or disappearing without cause.
Bear in mind, this is the City District, and no one knows how many zombies are hidden in the concrete jungle.
In the dark, human combat effectiveness might decline, but the zombies wouldn’t be affected.
Moreover, the five men separated to improve efficiency, making it extremely dangerous for a lone Evolver if surrounded by zombies in the night.
Now, it’s already deep into the night, and since Lin Yan still hasn’t returned, most likely something has happened.
"Could it be Lin Yan got lost? Why hasn’t he returned so late?" Zhang Hao frowned and asked with some confusion.
"Nonsense, we all have navigation systems; how could he get lost?" Butcher Liu Yang immediately retorted.
"Lin Yan is young and impulsive. I reckon he might have gone back to some city center again, leading to being stranded too late, or perhaps he met some beautiful survivors..."
Liu Yang spoke with disdain, as he had some opinions about Lin Yan’s arrogance.
Noticing Wang Lei’s displeased look, Liu Yang then kept his mouth shut.
Holding a long sword, Yang Xiu looked out the window with a furrowed brow, puzzled: "We’ve been in Jiangnan City District for so long, yet haven’t found any trace of Evolved Zombies. With Lin Yan’s strength, these corpses shouldn’t pose a problem for him, right?"
Upon hearing this, Liu Yang nodded. Despite disliking Lin Yan’s personality, he had to admit that Lin Yan was a master at manipulating flames.
"Could it be... Lin Yan encountered Evolved Zombies hiding in the city?!"
Upon hearing Yang Xiu’s words, everyone was startled, each brow instantly furrowing.
Now that the five-person team had already lost one member, and to make matters worse, it was the combat-powerful Lin Yan, it wasn’t good news for everyone.
As the team leader, Wang Lei noticed the increasingly heavy atmosphere and immediately spoke: "Alright, everyone stop speculating, anything can happen in the city."
"The city at night is extremely dangerous, we’ll wait until dawn to talk again, tomorrow we’ll look for him together."
"Even Lin Yan can disappear without a trace, it seems Jiangnan City District isn’t as safe as we imagined. From now on, everyone absolutely cannot act separately."

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 159: Since You Want to Die So Much, I’ll Grant Your Wish!
chapters.content:
After receiving Wang Lei’s order, everyone stopped discussing, but the atmosphere around became increasingly heavy, and each person’s face was extremely grim.
Even the survivors noticed something was wrong because they also saw that among the five people from the Human Survivor Base, one person was missing...
Not a word was spoken all night.
Early the next morning, Yang Xiu was awakened by certain noises.
Born into a martial arts family, his sensory perception was naturally stronger than ordinary people.
After becoming an Evolver, Yang Xiu’s five senses became even more acute.
Following the sound, Yang Xiu drowsily approached the window, but the scene outside instantly shocked him.
"Captain! Something’s wrong!"
Yang Xiu’s cry instantly woke Wang Lei and others who were still asleep, and they quickly adopted battle poses, vigilantly looking around.
But they only found Yang Xiu standing by the window, his face pale.
The others who woke up also heard faint roars, and they all came to the window to look down along Yang Xiu’s gaze, freezing on the spot one by one.
Just outside the store where they were camped, a long-dead human corpse was hanging—Lin Yan, who hadn’t returned all night and was missing.
The apocalypse had already passed for three months, and human flesh was already very scarce. This fresh piece of meat hanging in the street attracted countless zombies.
Each of these zombies waved their arms, wanting to devour Lin Yan’s corpse; Yang Xiu was awakened by the sound of these zombies.
"Damn it! Isn’t that Lin Yan?! What’s going on?!"
Liu Yang’s pupils contracted sharply, unable to help but curse under his breath.
Although he was dissatisfied with Lin Yan’s personality, the man was still a companion, and now Lin Yan had died right in front of him, chilling Liu Yang to the core.
"Captain, we can’t let Lin Yan hang here like this!"
Zhang Hao, who came from the same university as Lin Yan, said angrily at this moment.
Wang Lei nodded at these words.
Lin Yan’s body must be retrieved, not just because he was their companion, but also because the corpse had been hanging there for an unknown length of time, and the smell of blood had already attracted many zombies.
If more Evolved Zombies were to gather, it would be very dangerous, and their main task this time was to rescue survivors. Unlike them, those survivors could not just fight their way out of a horde of zombies with ease.
The four of them immediately moved to seize the corpse; these regular zombies couldn’t stop their slaughter, and they quickly killed all the zombies gathered around, then carried Lin Yan’s body back to the base.
Looking at Lin Yan’s body lying on the ground, everyone’s face became extremely somber.
Wang Lei squatted down to examine it, discovering Lin Yan’s fatal wound was on his neck, a mark clearly made by a forceful blade swing.
Aside from the fatal wound, Lin Yan’s body bore multiple knife wounds, each strike vicious enough to sever Lin Yan’s tendons.
"An Evolver is in this city too? Why are they attacking us?!"
Yang Xiu’s face was extremely grim. They knew zombies don’t use knives, and these bloodthirsty creatures, if they killed Lin Yan, would just eat him clean.
These zombies wouldn’t return a corpse after killing someone, nor would they hang it outside the base with a rope.
"Damn it, what the hell do these bastards want?! Are they trying to provoke us?!"
Liu Yang punched the ground heavily, his anger boiling over.
"Damn it! Zombies are already everywhere, and these guys are still fighting among themselves? We’re here to rescue people; do they think we’re here to snatch territory?!"
In Liu Yang’s opinion, those who could do this were surely Human Evolvers, and probably not ones to be underestimated.
Thinking about how they risked their lives to come to help, only to be harmed by these humans, and even having a corpse hung out as a display, their eyes burned with rage, almost turning into substance.
"Captain! We can’t just let this go, I must avenge Lin Yan and kill those bastards!"
A furious Zhang Hao couldn’t believe his friend had died right in front of his eyes, in such a tragic way!
Even as an Evolver with awakened enhancement talents, he wanted to personally avenge Lin Yan.
"No! We can’t act rashly!"
Seeing their emotions intensify, Wang Lei quickly spoke to stop them.
He pointed at the knife wounds on Lin Yan, his face serious, and said, "We mustn’t underestimate, you all know Lin Yan’s strength, yet even with his combat power, he was easily killed with a few strikes, showing that the perpetrator’s strength is formidable."
"It’s very likely that the Evolver lurking in the shadows possesses the power to kill any member of our team."
"This person hung the corpse outside our base silently; none of us noticed..."
These words shocked everyone; that Evolver could approach the base without a sound, probably also having the ability to quietly eliminate them.
"He hung Lin Yan’s corpse outside to give us a warning; we’re here to rescue survivors, so try not to complicate things, finish the mission quickly, and leave!"
"With Lin Yan gone, our team’s combat power is affected. I noticed there are some Evolvers among the survivors; let’s temporarily have them join our team."
Yang Xiu and Liu Yang nodded at these words, only Zhang Hao looked at Lin Yan’s corpse with eyes full of resentment.
...
Zhang Hao, seeing Wang Lei and others unwilling to intervene, went alone to find the survivors saved by Lin Yan yesterday to inquire about Lin Yan’s whereabouts.
"After Lin Yan saved these survivors, he went to the outskirts of the city; could it be he met with misfortune there?"
Finding his friend’s death so mysterious, even being hung out as a corpse for display, filled Zhang Hao with boundless rage.
Unable to swallow this anger, he disregarded Wang Lei’s orders and went alone to the city outskirts.
"Hm? So many repeated tire tracks? And all of them left recently?"
"It seems Lin Yan must have noticed something suspicious here, which is why he was murdered. Hmph! Zombies driving cars? I think it’s just these Evolvers messing around!"
Zhang Hao sneered, then followed the direction of the tire tracks.
...
At Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan, who was cooking porridge for Little Qiqi and Zhao Lin, suddenly felt a shift.
Through the perspective of the Corpse Puppet, he saw another Human Evolver approaching Qingshui Farm from the small road on the city outskirts.
Lu Chuan’s gentle gaze suddenly emitted a chilling killing intent.
"I’ve already warned you, yet you still don’t know your limits."
"Since you’re determined to die, I’ll grant your wish!"

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 160: If We Don’t Leave Now, We’ll All Be Wiped Out!
chapters.content:
Zhang Hao cautiously continued along the road, his mind occasionally flashing back to his college days with Lin Yan.
Originally, both were just ordinary third-year students, but after the apocalypse erupted, they both awakened as Evolvers and entered Jianghai City’s Survivor Base together.
In this apocalypse, Zhang Hao didn’t have many friends, and Lin Yan was one of them.
But now, Lin Yan had tragically died in Jiangnan City District.
If he had died at the hands of zombies, Zhang Hao would feel somewhat better.
But Lin Yan died at the hands of other Evolvers.
This made it hard for Zhang Hao to accept.
"Ha, Survivor Base my ass, comrades my ass! Lin Yan has just died here, yet instead of finding the murderer and avenging him, they immediately replaced him with someone else!"
The more Zhang Hao thought about it, the angrier he became, and the intent to kill in his eyes grew stronger.
Encountering a few wandering zombies along the way, Zhang Hao dispatched them swiftly and decisively.
Although Zhang Hao awakened a boosting talent, the physical enhancements from evolving still gave him considerable combat power.
As he walked forward, Zhang Hao carefully observed the tracks on the road.
Among the tire marks, he found a familiar imprint — Lin Yan’s shoe print from earlier.
This was a shoe print unique to the combat boots of Base City.
"Damn it! Lin Yan indeed traveled this road!"
The footprints before him solidified Zhang Hao’s conviction, and he immediately called upon Wang Lei and the others.
"Captain, I found where Lin Yan went earlier. There’s a good chance we can find the Evolvers’ hideout. Hurry and support me!"
Hearing Zhang Hao’s words, Wang Lei and the others were startled, realizing Zhang Hao had acted alone again.
Moreover, he sought Lin Yan’s trail, which made Wang Lei furious.
"Damn it! Zhang Hao, do you know what you’re doing? I order you to return immediately!"
"Those hidden Evolvers are extremely powerful, far beyond what you can handle. Return immediately!"
Wang Lei was furious.
Lin Yan’s body still lay inside the base, its gruesome condition clearly showing the opponent’s strength.
There’s no way they could match them with just those who had entered Jiangnan City District.
As for the Evolvers temporarily recruited from the survivors, their combat power was pathetic.
The mystery of those Evolved Zombies in Jiangnan City District was still unsolved, and another trusted member had been killed by Evolvers. Wang Lei didn’t want to complicate matters.
In this chaotic post-apocalyptic world, things were extremely harsh, and any decision could lead the whole team to their deaths.
According to the constant information from the radio, nearly every team leaving the base had faced casualties.
Some teams had even reported complete annihilation.
This made Wang Lei even more cautious, but they didn’t expect Zhang Hao to act alone at this critical time.
Even the usually silent Yang Xiu quietly admonished, "Zhang Hao, don’t be impulsive — return to the team!"
"From the knife wounds on Lin Yan, we can tell their strength is extremely terrifying, far beyond what we can handle!"
But the admonitions only fueled Zhang Hao’s anger, so he directly turned off the radio.
A bunch of cold-blooded animals!
They spoke nicely about comrades living and dying together, sharing hardships.
But now, they’re all so heartless!
He absolutely couldn’t let Lin Yan die unjustly.
But Zhang Hao didn’t walk much farther before he suddenly noticed a figure ahead.
The sudden appearance startled him, but soon Zhang Hao’s face sank.
"Was it you who killed my companion yesterday?"
However, the figure didn’t respond to Zhang Hao’s question, simply continued walking towards him.
Seeing the figure ignore him, Zhang Hao grew even angrier.
"Bastard! Why did you attack my friend? We came here only to rescue survivors."
"Dare to kill someone from our Base City? Today, I’m going to make you pay!"
Yet Zhang Hao was puzzled despite his furious tirades.
The person before him showed no reaction, and even their walking pace remained unchanged.
"Damn beast!"
With these words, Zhang Hao clenched his fist tightly, and a strange energy enveloped him.
In an instant, his aura surged, with strength, speed, and reflexes all enhanced across the board.
This was Zhang Hao’s hidden trump card!
He could provide boosts to other teammates.
But he could apply the enhancements to himself as well.
Moreover, the effect on himself was doubled.
Except for Lin Yan, he hadn’t told anyone about this secret.
In terms of single combat capability, he wasn’t inferior to anyone else on the team.
"Today, I will make you pay!"
Swoosh!
In the next second, Zhang Hao shot out like a leopard, with a loud swoosh, appearing right before the shadow.
Looking at the helmeted figure before him, Zhang Hao’s lips curled into a cold smile.
His right fist smashed onto the helmet, shattering the visor with its powerful force.
But the next second, Zhang Hao’s sinister smile froze on his face.
"How, how is this possible?!"
"No! Impossible?! You’re... you’re not human?!"
Zhang Hao pointed at the figure in front of him in terror, his face pale, with cold sweat trickling down his forehead.
Originally aggressive, his stance became unsteady.
His eyes were full of fear, and standing in front of him was a terrifying creature with a pair of blood-red pupils.
This wasn’t a Human Evolver but a zombie!
This couldn’t be!
Could the legends about Jiangnan City District be true?!
Was there truly a group of zombies bizarrely resembling humans?!
Recalling the words of the survivors, Zhang Hao’s pupils contracted sharply.
Bang!
In shock, Zhang Hao didn’t react, and the zombie that hadn’t moved suddenly approached him and punched him away.
The terrifying force broke several of Zhang Hao’s ribs, and the pain made him panic.
He no longer had any will to fight and only wanted to run back to the city.
Yet in the next moment, Zhang Hao saw a headless body slowly falling, its black combat suit so familiar.
And the zombie just now stood there holding a long knife...
...
The next morning, Yang Xiu was once again awakened by the zombies’ roar.
Recalling Zhang Hao’s absence throughout the night, Yang Xiu was alarmed and apprehensively approached the bedside.
As expected, Zhang Hao’s corpse was hanging outside, and this time it was even in a decapitated state.
Wang Lei and the others arrived upon hearing, and seeing Zhang Hao’s fearful eyes, each person felt a chill run down their backs.
"Go! Withdraw! We can’t stay here any longer!"
The successive deaths of two comrades instilled fear in Wang Lei’s heart, and he no longer wanted to stay.
The base’s quota was for each team to rescue fifty survivors.
Since Lu Chuan withdrew the Evolved Zombies, they had already achieved the goal.
In the apocalypse, every man for himself; there was no need to stay here and risk a senseless death for those already gone.
Wang Lei had a hunch that if his team didn’t pull back soon, they might not escape at all...

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 161: Complete Control Over the Entire Jiangnan City District!
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 161: Complete Control Over the Entire Jiangnan City District!
The next morning.
"Get up! Everyone get the hell up, no more sleeping!"
Liu Yang quickly ran downstairs to wake all the survivors staying inside the shop.
At this moment, Liu Yang didn’t care if his voice would attract other zombies; he just wanted to leave this place as soon as possible.
Zhang Hao’s death was just too tragic, and the remaining few no longer dared to linger in Jiangnan City District.
"Sir, are we getting food this early?"
The many survivors were bleary-eyed, looking at the rather irritable Liu Yang, utterly confused.
"Food my ass! I don’t even have food for myself to share with you!"
In his anger, Liu Yang kicked the still half-asleep survivor to the side.
After arriving in Jiangnan City District, they found out that all the supplies in each shop had been cleared out, not even a speck of dust left. Liu Yang himself hadn’t had enough to eat.
"Hurry up, pack your things and leave here. If you want to stay and feed the zombies, keep sleeping!"
Upon hearing Liu Yang’s words, the survivors downstairs became incredibly excited. They were already fed up with living in constant fear and uncertainty in this city.
Turning around, Liu Yang’s expression darkened instantly. His lips, usually coarse and brash, with a full beard, were now trembling slightly.
Damn it!
This cursed Jiangnan City District, I’ll never come back!
Liu Yang returned to the second floor to find Wang Lei and the others already packed, each with a gloomy face.
"Zhang Hao and Lin Yan’s bodies... forget it, just leave them here," Wang Lei said, frowning deeply.
No one objected; in this apocalyptic world, even the living are struggling to survive, who has the energy to care for the dead?
"According to the original plan, escort these survivors to the helipad. No changes in formation, let the evolvers among the survivors fill the gaps!"
"Brothers, this next stretch won’t be easy. It’s tens of kilometers to the rendezvous point, and from here on, it’s up to you all..."
The survivor base had a small outpost set up dozens of kilometers away for transferring survivors, and there were other evolvers providing mutual support there.
Soon, the personnel inside the stronghold gathered, all the survivors were filled with excitement.
"Finally, we can leave. Finally, we can get out of here!"
"These damned zombies, one day we’ll kill them all!"
"Do you think there’s food at the survivor base? Can we eat our fill?"
Unlike the somber Wang Lei and others, these survivors ready to evacuate were exceedingly excited, chattering nonstop inside the stronghold.
"All of you, shut up!"
A low growl from Wang Lei instantly silenced the previously noisy stronghold.
"Shortly, we will protect you all the way to the designated location. During this time, if any of you dare to say a word, don’t blame me for being rude!"
Wang Lei’s face was exceedingly grim, glaring harshly at the survivors in front of him.
They had to understand that retreating with his squad and covering the main force’s move are two completely different concepts. A slight mistake could lead to total collapse with unimaginable consequences.
Yang Xiu and Liu Yang exchanged a glance, then left the stronghold first.
The two of them slashed their swords, easily killing the dozen zombies gathered at the entrance like cutting through vegetables.
"Move, move, move! If you fall behind, it’s your own responsibility!" Wang Lei urged the survivors, gesturing for them to follow, speaking in a low voice.
The mission target only required fifty individuals, and the team already had over seventy people. Even if some died, it didn’t matter.
After passing through several streets, Wang Lei took a deep look back, with a sense of frustration pent up inside.
Damn it!
What the hell is this Jiangnan City District?!
We didn’t encounter a single evolved zombie the whole time. I brought four people here and only took two back!
One day I’ll come back; I want to see what kind of secrets Jiangnan City District holds?!
After a few days of investigation, Wang Lei found Jiangnan City District to be incredibly strange, undoubtedly hiding a big secret, but his current strength was far from enough to uncover it.
Although he felt reluctant, Wang Lei also knew it was too dangerous to stay and decided to retreat until he was stronger.
Yang Xiu and Liu Yang, in their eagerness to leave Jiangnan City District, fought desperately in the front.
...
Not far from the retreating main force, a figure stood proudly on a high building, staring intently at the team.
"Hmph, good that you know your place."
Through the perspective of ’Lightning One’, Lu Chuan watched Wang Lei and the others retreat, finally feeling a weight lifted from his heart.
This area has now been searched by humans, and most survivors have been moved, meaning Jiangnan City District now belongs to him!
At Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan stretched lazily.
It wasn’t for nothing that he hadn’t slept these past few days monitoring this team, and now Qingshui Farm is somewhat temporarily secure.
With a thought, Lu Chuan released massive amounts of Corpse Puppets into Jiangnan City District, and one Evolved Zombie after another exuded powerful auras.
Apart from the forces defending Qingshui Farm, over a dozen Evolved Corpse Puppets entered the city district.
Meanwhile, trucks began moving back and forth between Qingshui Farm and Jiangnan City District, and the once silent Qingshui Farm returned to its former liveliness.
Looking at the vast cityscape, Lu Chuan’s eyes shone brightly.
"With most humans gone, this area is now my kingdom."
Looking at his fist, Lu Chuan’s corner of the mouth formed a stiff smile.
As expected, in any world, power is the ultimate truth.
Last time, Lu Chuan felt frustrated evacuating from Sunshine District.
This time, he chased away others.
Seeing his currently powerful grasp over his forces, a sense of mighty ambition surged within him.
Only three months into the apocalypse, his Corpse Puppets had grown to this magnitude.
Given some more time to continue evolving, he would one day command an invincible Corpse Puppet army!
Rest assured, Little Qiqi.
Your father already has enough strength to protect you, no longer living in fear within Sunshine District!
"These human survivors have developed too quickly. I guess their scale will continue to grow; it seems I must strike first!"
A cold glint appeared in Lu Chuan’s eyes. With such a massive and formidable Corpse Puppet army, if he didn’t establish his own Zombie Kingdom, wouldn’t that be a waste?
Who says zombies can’t rule the world? I’ll see whether you human evolvers grow faster or my zombie army develops faster.
From now on, Jiangnan City District is a forbidden zone for humans.
This territory belongs to me, Lu Chuan!

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 162: Could Little Qiqi Also Become an Evolver?
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 162: Could Little Qiqi Also Become an Evolver?
After the rescue team evacuated a large number of survivors from the Jiangnan City District, Lu Chuan was finally able to relax and not have to keep an eye on the district every day. Life returned to its usual state.
He left his physical body at the well-defended Qingshui Farm, practicing the Blood Evil Blade Technique daily.
After this period of cultivation, his combat skills had improved considerably. Although he hadn’t reached the level described in the cultivation technique, his combat power had significantly increased compared to before.
It was precisely by controlling Lightning One in the Jiangnan City District and using the power of the Blood Evil Blade Technique that he effortlessly killed two formidable Evolvers.
Lu Chuan was confident that if he continued to cultivate in this way, he might indeed achieve the miraculous state described in the cultivation technique.
Outside of this, Lu Chuan’s life was like that of a diligent farm owner, inspecting the vegetable fields daily, strolling in the orchard...
Although Zhao Lin could chat with Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan wasn’t comfortable letting Little Qiqi spend too much time with this woman.
So every day, he still personally accompanied the little one for a period of time.
Thanks to the Corpse Puppets’ constant clearing, the mountains and forests near Qingshui Farm had been mostly cleared of dangers.
After taking the little one on a walk around the farm each day, Lu Chuan would then take him for a couple of rounds around the outskirts of Qingshui Farm.
In his free time, Lu Chuan also needed to tend to the growth of the farm’s plants, and fortunately, these plants grew normally according to his memory.
With the rescue team and a large number of survivors relocated, Lu Chuan no longer had to handle the Corpse Puppets in the Jiangnan City District as cautiously as before.
He began to massively transport various supplies, while a large number of Corpse Puppets flooded into the district, searching for those leftover Evolved Zombies.
Without interference from human Evolvers, Lu Chuan’s life returned to normal, and seven days passed in the blink of an eye.
...
Swish, swish, swish!
The figures of Lu Chuan, ’Lightning Two,’ and ’Lightning Three’ flickered continuously on the farm’s open ground.
Sparks flew as long blades clashed, and after a few moves, Lu Chuan knocked the long blades out of the hands of both ’Lightning Two’ and ’Lightning Three,’ causing them to retreat repeatedly.
"Not bad, not bad, this Blood Evil Blade Technique is indeed powerful!"
Seeing the fruits of his recent training, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
After this period of training, Lu Chuan’s blade technique had improved further, allowing him to repel the attacks of two second-tier agile zombies head-on.
"Hmm? Oh..."
Just as he was putting away his steel blade, Lu Chuan suddenly felt a change in one of the Corpse Puppets he controlled.
He quickly ran to the vegetable field and approached a Corpse Puppet that was hoeing the ground.
After examining the Corpse Puppet in front of him for a long time, Lu Chuan couldn’t figure out what was happening.
"What’s going on? These ordinary zombies can actually evolve?!"
Just a moment ago, while Lu Chuan was honing his blade technique against second-tier zombies, he suddenly felt that he had gained a new first-tier Evolved Zombie.
This surprise prompted Lu Chuan to quickly come and check.
"Weren’t these zombies only able to evolve during the Blood Moon? How is it that new Evolved Zombies are appearing after the Blood Moon has ended long ago?"
At this time, Lu Chuan was stunned by the unexpected situation unfolding before him.
Could it be that zombie evolution wasn’t caused by exposure to the Blood Moon that night?
He had thought that zombies that didn’t evolve that night would never have the chance to evolve.
Was his assumption wrong?
Scratching his head, Lu Chuan carefully recalled his own memories of evolution.
It seemed that he felt something entering his body, like a strange energy, after which he blacked out and began his evolution journey.
Could it be that the Blood Moon brought not just its peculiar moonlight, but a special energy dispersed in the air?
Lu Chuan recalled the Crystal Cores in the brains of the Evolved Zombies and the Mutated Giant Beasts, which seemed to be the products of energy accumulation.
"So it seems... the evolution of zombies is actually caused by the accumulation of energy leading to a breakthrough."
"And after the night of the Blood Moon, a lot of special energy remained in the air, and it’s very possible that this energy did not disappear with the Blood Moon!"
A glimmer of brilliance flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes, his bold hypothesis filling him with joy.
If it were indeed as he speculated, wouldn’t that mean that even after the Blood Moon disappeared, these ordinary zombies could still successfully evolve?!
"Hahaha! This is great, now there’s no need to worry about the dwindling number of Evolved Zombies."
Currently, the number of Evolved Zombies being found by the Corpse Puppets in the Jiangnan City District is decreasing, which worried Lu Chuan since his evolution depended on Crystal Cores.
But now there was no need to worry; over time, the number of Evolved Zombies would only increase.
"Dad, I’m hungry!"
Just as Lu Chuan was inspecting the first-tier Corpse Puppet in front of him, Ji Ruxue came running over from a distance.
The little one now reached up to Lu Chuan’s knee.
Since arriving at Qingshui Farm, the little one could drink meat porridge every day and eat fresh fruit, her face becoming ever rounder.
Subtly, she was showing signs of becoming a chubby little girl.
Seeing Little Qiqi before him, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but recall the survivors evacuated days before, all of whom had lost considerable weight and were starving to the point of becoming skin and bones.
If it weren’t for assistance from the Survivor Base, those survivors would likely starve to death, even if they weren’t eaten by zombies.
Lu Chuan smiled and nodded, then quickly walked towards the kitchen.
As he prepared a meal, he looked out the window, watching the little princess running freely in the fields.
Over this period, the little one had grown; she was no longer the baby who could only lie in bed, and she could even run freely in the rustic countryside.
"If ordinary zombies can evolve, doesn’t that mean Little Qiqi could become an Evolver?"
If the air truly was filled with special energy, as he speculated, then there was no reason why only zombies could evolve while humans couldn’t.
Lu Chuan was constantly concerned about the little one’s safety.
If anything happened to him in the future, it would be almost impossible for the little one to survive healthily in the apocalypse.
He tried to provide Little Qiqi with a stable and healthy environment for growth, which was also one of the reasons Lu Chuan sought to continuously evolve.
After all, only with sufficient strength could one survive in this chaotic apocalypse.
As the saying goes, give a man a fish, and you feed him for a day; teach a man to fish, and you feed him for a lifetime. Even if he tried his best to protect Little Qiqi, unforeseen events could still happen.
But if Little Qiqi could become a powerful Evolver herself, then even if Lu Chuan wasn’t around in the future, the little one could still have the ability to protect herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 165: Tactics of the Zombie Horde Beatdown!
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 165: Tactics of the Zombie Horde Beatdown!
Crunch! Crunch!
The crisp sound of chewing resounded through the mountains, as a two-meter-tall wild boar had been devoured, leaving only half its body behind. The blood that flowed out stained the surrounding ground red.
Standing atop the wild boar was a black giant wolf, shoulder height of two meters, and body length exceeding four meters.
This was originally just an ordinary wild wolf whose body size had skyrocketed after mutating during the Blood Moon.
Its black fur looked like countless spikes, and its terrifying bite force had crushed the wild boar’s bones to pieces.
Even while gnawing at its prey, the mutated giant wolf’s yellow pupils remained vigilant, surveying the surroundings.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
At this moment, Lu Chuan, controlling a large number of Corpse Puppets, began flooding Yellow Dragon Mountain.
The massive zombie horde was like a swarm of tourists, instantly making the empty Yellow Dragon Mountain crowded again.
The first-tier mutated wolf, busy eating its prey, suddenly felt a tremor from beneath its feet.
A strange aura had invaded its territory, and the mutated giant wolf became furious, quickly charging toward the source of the sound.
The speed of the first-tier mutated giant wolf, running through the forest, was like a swift lightning bolt.
In a moment, the mutated giant wolf rushed to the mountain path, where it was met with a sea of zombies.
Suddenly encountering such a large horde made the mutated giant wolf freeze on the spot.
Seeing so many zombies, the giant wolf’s yellow pupils instantly grew apprehensive. It began to slowly back away, then immediately turned to flee.
"Hehe, prey I’ve set my sights on never escapes!"
Boom! Boom!
Along with two swishing sounds, two large fireballs were hurled from the hands of Flame One and Flame Two.
Watching the fireballs soar through the air, fear instinctively flashed through the mutated giant wolf’s mind.
Bang!
A massive explosion sounded, before it could react, the giant wolf was hit by a fireball.
In an instant, its body was nearly blown away, with much of its fur burned off by the scorching flames, black smoke billowing from its body.
Awooo!
Mortally wounded, the mutated giant wolf let out a pathetic wail.
It then attempted to escape further into the distance, but Lu Chuan had already commanded Lightning One to approach its side.
The mutated giant wolf hesitated for a moment, then instinctively lunged at Lightning One to bite it.
But Lightning One was even swifter, and with a flash of a cold blade, it slashed at the giant wolf’s waist.
Copper head, iron brain, tofu waist!
With a single slice at a vital spot, the mutated giant wolf was instantly half a breath from death.
Lightning One didn’t relent, continuing to swing its steel blade.
Bam!
The lifeless mutated giant wolf soon fell heavily to the ground, blood flowing ceaselessly.
Just having entered the mountain and already gained a harvest, Lu Chuan was very satisfied with this efficiency.
As a wild tourist attraction, Yellow Dragon Mountain already had large undeveloped protected areas, teeming with countless wild animals.
"Tsk tsk tsk, I just love these undeveloped mountainous areas — hunting to my heart’s content!"
Lu Chuan had a Tank Zombie deal with the mutated giant wolf’s body, and then led his army further up the mountain.
Rustling, rustling, rustling!
Before long, a series of intense sounds came from the forest beside him, as if something was rushing toward his direction from the mountains.
Then Lu Chuan heard a chorus of squeaking sounds.
The next second, a gray mutated giant monkey leaped out from the forest, standing three meters tall, with an incredibly sturdy build.
The most crucial detail was that Lu Chuan noticed this mutated giant monkey was holding a tree trunk pulled from the ground!
As it swung the tree, about thirty centimeters in diameter, a series of whooshing sounds echoed. Several normal Corpse Puppets at the front were directly flung away!
Lu Chuan scrutinized them, and judging by its powerful aura, he recognized that this gray monkey had reached the second tier!
With a thought, Lu Chuan immediately commanded the Corpse Puppet army to reshuffle their formation, putting San Pang and Si Pang, the two-tier Tank Zombies, at the forefront.
This monkey’s intelligence was clearly superior to the mutated giant wolf’s, and sensing the formidable aura of the two Tank Zombies, its muscles instantly swelled.
The tree trunk spun with great force, slamming toward the Corpse Puppets on the mountain path.
However, San Pang and Si Pang were now both second-tier Tank Zombies, not any less powerful than this monkey.
Bam!
The two Tank Zombies at the front directly caught the tree head-on.
The mutated giant monkey’s pupils contracted, clearly not expecting its attack to be blocked outright.
It was at this moment that Tyrant One sprang into action, its baleful aura causing even a second-tier mutated giant monkey’s hair to stand on end.
Realizing the power of the second-tier Tyrant Zombie, the mutated giant monkey instantly dropped its tree trunk and leaped backward.
Yet it evidently underestimated the might of the Corpse Puppet army.
Just as the monkey landed, two fireballs struck it directly, the intense heat causing the second-tier mutant beast to let out a series of screams.
Under Lu Chuan’s command, the Evolved Corpse Puppets coordinated perfectly with each other.
Even though this mutated giant monkey had reached the second tier, with formidable physical strength and some combat skills, it had no means to deal with Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet army.
Realizing these ’monsters’ before it were unlike anything it had encountered, the mutated giant monkey prepared to flee into the forest.
But at that moment, several silver streaks flashed through the air as some second-tier Agile Zombies, who had taken advantage of the earlier confrontation, had already circled behind the mutated giant monkey.
The second-tier mutated giant monkey, already shaken from the fight, blindly ran and failed to notice the ambush in the forest.
As silver streaks flashed in mid-air, several ferocious wounds appeared on its body, especially at the ankle, where the arteries were severed by Lightning Three and Lightning Four.
The massive body, nearly four meters tall, fell to one knee.
In agony, the mutated giant monkey roared in anger, its eyes filled with fury.
As Tyrant One leaped high, its terrifying claws pierced the chest of the second-tier mutated giant ape.
The ground reaper swiftly returned the body to the base of the mountain.
The Tank Zombies were responsible for clearing the way and defending, while the Tyrant Zombies provided front-line offense. Agile Zombies handled side attacks, and the comparatively fragile Flame Zombies, clad in the scales of the Mutated Golden Python, stayed in the middle for ranged assaults.
After the battle, the duty of cleaning the battlefield fell to the ground reaper, who transported the Zombie remains to the convoy at the foot of the mountain.
Thanks to group assault tactics, every first- and second-tier Mutated Fierce Beast encountered became Lu Chuan’s prey.

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 166: A Bountiful Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 166: A Bountiful Harvest
Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Amidst the dense forest, a series of chilling beast howls echoed from time to time.
The terrifying fierce beasts that once hunted with impunity on Yellow Dragon Mountain seemed to have met their doom today.
Each of them had lost their former arrogance and was solely focused on fleeing endlessly through the mountain forest.
Since the apocalyptic outbreak, Yellow Dragon Mountain had remained quiet for a long time, but today it seemed vibrant with life.
With a Corpse Puppet army that was functionally diverse and nearly flawless, Lu Chuan was invincible in the mountain forest, and the mutated fierce beasts he encountered fell one after another under the siege.
This undeveloped Yellow Dragon Mountain also gave Lu Chuan a sense of what biodiversity truly meant.
Awhoo!
A thunderous roar echoed through the mountain forest.
The sound was akin to thunder, and if anyone else were here, it would frighten them out of their wits.
A terrifying giant beast, nearly four meters at the shoulder and six meters in length, let out a roar that shook the skies.
The tiger, originally the king of the mountains before its mutation, was already an unparalleled hunter with no significant weaknesses.
After evolving, the muscles of this striped tiger exploded in growth, with a golden ratio muscle distribution that sent shivers down one’s spine at first glance.
Each swipe of its massive paws caused a terrifying sound as if cutting through the air, capable of snapping large trees that would require a person to wrap their arms around.
The speed of this second-tier Mutated Giant Tiger was terrifying, running through the mountain forest like a streak of golden lightning!
However, this mountain overlord looked rather miserable at this moment...
Over twenty wounds of varied sizes had appeared on its body, with blood dyeing its yellow and black striped hide red long ago.
There were also several scorched marks on its body, from which wisps of black smoke continuously emanated, with the wounds scorched into something grotesque.
The second-tier Mutated Giant Tiger panted heavily, with eyes once full of majesty now brimming with shock and panic.
Lu Chuan also felt heavy-hearted, as the mutated tiger before him was indeed powerful.
Compared to the same tier, mutated beasts were undoubtedly stronger than Evolved Zombies.
After all, zombies originated from humans.
Before the apocalypse, human combat capabilities were already far inferior to beasts.
If not for bringing enough Evolved Zombies this time, the Corpse Puppet squad might have been completely wiped out by this mutant giant tiger.
This mutant giant tiger’s strength was simply too formidable. Even though it was also second-tier, it took two second-tier Tank Type zombies to barely withstand its frontal assault.
Apart from the Tank Type zombies, the frontal attack of this giant tiger was invincible, with no one in the Corpse Puppet army able to withstand it.
Even a simple tail sweep gave Tyrant One and Three a tough time.
Fortunately, he had brought out both Flame One and Flame Two, with the two Flame Zombies continuously launching fireballs from a distance, severely wounding the second-tier tiger.
