The Earth Escape zombie meant for transport was also pulled into battle by Lu Chuan, constantly disrupting the tiger’s judgment from underground to create conditions for the Agile Type zombies’ assault.
Several Agile Type zombies swung machetes, continuously bleeding the tiger, with the surrounding soil soaked in blood.
With sustained damage and massive blood loss, the second-tier tiger’s speed finally slowed down.
Seeing the increasingly weary second-tier Mutated Giant Tiger, Lu Chuan’s heart flashed a cold smile.
Strike when the iron is hot!
Then, three Tank Type zombies rushed forward, directly blocking the tiger’s charge head-on.
The tiger’s strength had significantly waned, allowing the three Tank Type zombies to barely engage it in a stalemate.
Then two Tyrant zombies suddenly sprung from the sides, their deadly claws piercing through the tiger’s belly.
Immediately, several Agile Type zombies charged with machetes once more, and finally, under the gang beating by numerous zombies, the second-tier Mutated Giant Tiger unwillingly collapsed to the ground.
Lu Chuan sighed in relief, feeling tense after controlling a large number of Evolved Corpse Puppets for a prolonged battle.
This particularly strong second-tier Mutated Giant Tiger consumed a lot of energy.
"No wonder ancient nobility loved hunting and watching gladiator fights; the process does indeed stimulate excitement."
"It’s almost dark, time to head back."
In this battle on Yellow Dragon Mountain, Lu Chuan’s control over the Corpse Puppet army resulted in the elimination of six first-tier Mutated Fierce Beasts and three second-tier Mutated Giant Beasts.
The bodies of the Mutated Giant Beasts were transported to the foot of the mountain by Earth Escape One, with several large trucks now piled high with giant beast carcasses.
Seeing these spoils, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction, as this mission was a success, yielding more than he’d imagined.
Not only did he acquire plenty of game, but he also practiced combat cooperation among the various Corpse Puppets.
The convoy was loaded with copious amounts of flesh and blood, with the heavy scent of blood permeating the town, drawing zombies from all directions towards the convoy.
The number of zombies even formed a Corpse Tide in front of the convoy!
However, this Corpse Tide comprised of ordinary zombies posed no threat whatsoever to Lu Chuan.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
In the face of the merciless charge of these heavy-duty trucks, the Corpse Tide directly broke a bloody path forward as Lu Chuan powered through.
Lu Chuan manipulated the Corpse Puppets to step hard on the accelerator, sending all the zombies encountered flying.
Crunch! Crunch!
The zombies drawn under the vehicles were ground into mincemeat under the heavy wheels, with even their bones crushed.
The howling of zombies, the roaring of engines, the dreadful sound of Corpse Tide being crushed made Yellow Dragon Town exceptionally noisy this night.
Those survivors hiding in the darkness continuously prayed, as they had no choice but to shiver in the face of such a crisis.
...
Inside Qingshui Farm, Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin, one large and one small, were energetically chatting.
Suddenly, they heard the roar of cars and instinctively looked toward the gate of Qingshui Farm.
Ji Ruxue lightly raised an eyebrow, smelling a rich scent of blood as the trucks drove in, and the scent was very fresh.
Just as Ji Ruxue felt curious, she saw a giant mutated beast carcass being unloaded from a truck by numerous zombies.
Ji Ruxue was stunned, not expecting that her father went to slay mutated fierce beasts today.
"Meat! So much meat!"
She knew that these mutated fierce beasts contained substantial energy, with this flesh serving as potent nourishment, and she nearly drooled.
Beside her, Zhao Lin stood frozen in place, as having never seen a mutated fierce beast, she was left gape-mouthed with shock at the giant corpses before her.
"What... what are these?!"
"Are there such enormous beasts in this world? Are we not shooting a sci-fi film?"
"Wait... these huge beasts, could it be that the Corpse King was the one who killed them all?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 167: Now Little Qiqi Will Never Worry About Having Meat Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 167: Now Little Qiqi Will Never Worry About Having Meat Again!
Has the Zombie King become this powerful now?
He managed to slay so many beasts with such massive sizes!
Zhao Lin looked at the corpses of mutant beasts loaded in truck after truck, utterly shocked.
"Little Qiqi, do you know why the Zombie King is killing so many animals?"
"Does this guy have some weird penchant for animal cruelty?!"
As soon as Zhao Lin asked this, she wanted to slap herself. Zombies are bloodthirsty monsters, of course, they would torture animals...
Ji Ruxue heard Zhao Lin’s words and immediately showed a proud and naive smile: "It’s obviously so I can eat meat every day!"
"If Dad doesn’t hunt these beasts, how do you think we’re getting meat porridge daily?"
On hearing this, Zhao Lin suddenly realized and then showed a bit of sadness.
The survivors she worked hard to save would go as far as to kill her for a bite of food.
Yet, this Zombie King, who should be bloodthirsty and heartless, fights these giant beasts just to let Little Qiqi eat better...
Glancing at Zhao Lin who believed her without doubt, Ji Ruxue smiled helplessly in her heart.
This woman is indeed all chest and no brains, believing whatever people say.
The meat from the last Mutated Golden Python Dad killed is still piled up in a warehouse. If it’s just for eating meat, why would we need this much?
Moreover, the corpses of these mutant beasts taking up several trucks pose a big storage problem.
It’s likely Dad has his eye on the Crystal Cores of these mutant beasts, right?
Dad actively hunting these mutant beasts probably means he can’t get third-tier Crystal Cores from zombies anymore...
Ji Ruxue sighed helplessly; the cultivation technique she practiced in the past is powerful, but sadly it only suits beings with flesh and blood.
In her memories, there was no cultivation technique suitable for Dad, such an oddity, or else he wouldn’t be stuck unable to progress beyond the third-tier.
...
The Corpse Puppets at Qingshui Farm worked in numbers, quickly unloading all the goods from these trucks.
These mutant beast corpses need to be cut and stored quickly, or else in this weather they’ll quickly mutate.
Lu Chuan looked up to see Little Qiqi and Zhao Lin staring curiously at him, and after a moment’s thought, he ordered the Corpse Puppets to move these mutant beast corpses near the orchard.
The orchard has lush fruit trees, which can block the little one’s view and prevent overly bloody scenes from leaving a childhood trauma for Little Qiqi.
A child’s physical health is one aspect, psychological health is equally important.
After evolution, the corpses of these mutant giant beasts boast a considerable size, so Lu Chuan manipulated more than thirty Corpse Puppets wielding knives to the orchard to cut them.
The once vast orchard has now become a slaughterhouse for giant beasts.
Lu Chuan controlled Lightning Two, deftly plunging the machete into these mutant beasts, extracting the bloodstained Crystal Cores from within.
Once cleaned, the Crystal Cores were then brought to Lu Chuan by Lightning One.
Looking at these first-tier and second-tier mutant Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan nodded with satisfaction.
To gain this much in just one day, battling tirelessly with the Corpse Puppets wasn’t in vain.
And this was only the outskirts of Yellow Dragon Mountain; if it weren’t for nightfall, he could have led the Corpse Puppet army further in.
This undeveloped Yellow Dragon Mountain is indeed a treasure trove.
If the entire Yellow Dragon Mountain could be swept through, who knows how many Crystal Cores he could obtain!
He wondered if there were any tier-three mutant beasts within Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Now that he’s at tier-three, he needs to consume tier-three Crystal Cores to continue progressing.
If he could slay a few tier-three mutant beasts, he could successfully evolve to tier-four.
The farm orchard at this moment was piled with several mutant beast corpses, each looking quite ferocious.
These giant beasts were slain today, including a wholly black giant wolf, a robust striped tiger, and a large ape with gray fur, among others.
Many of these giant beast species were rare before the apocalypse, eating them would land you in jail.
But now, in the apocalypse, even eating rare animals doesn’t matter.
The Crystal Cores had been taken by Lightning Two, leaving only the simple task of cutting.
With the concerted effort of many Corpse Puppets, the enormous beasts were cut into evenly-sized meat chunks.
The dense smell of blood spread throughout the orchard, with the blood from many fierce beasts soaking the ground beneath the Corpse Puppets’ slicing.
The orchard’s soil turned red from the fresh blood of these giant beasts in a short time.
The blood of these mutant beasts contained rich energy, perfect for nourishing the land and providing abundant nutrients for the fruit trees’ growth.
Lu Chuan manipulated the Corpse Puppets to differ a small piece from the bodies of several mutant beasts, placing them before him.
Hmm~
This deer meat is very good, more tender than I imagined, and the monkey meat is smooth and toothsome with great texture...
Lu Chuan sampled the flavor of these mutant beast meats first, to ensure the little one’s meals were better.
"This Mutated Giant Tiger is the king of all beasts, surely its meat is nourishing!"
Among today’s slaughtered beasts, the second-tier tiger’s meat was the firmest.
After eating a large piece, Lu Chuan immediately felt a bit hot inside.
It truly lives up to a second-tier beast, indeed containing tremendous energy.
Little Qiqi needn’t worry about having meat now, this giant tiger’s bones are top quality even for soup!
Kids are at the stage of growing bodies, they definitely need to eat well.
Lu Chuan manipulated the Corpse Puppets to carve the most tender portions from these giant beasts and place them in the fridge for future use.
The rest of the meat was strung up and hung high, making jerky for long-term preservation.
As for the black wolf meat and Mutated Pangolin’s corpse, since their taste is just too terrible, Lu Chuan simply fed them to the ordinary Corpse Puppets.
These two mutant beasts’ bodies may lack flavor but not energy.
Such meat, unfit for Little Qiqi’s consumption, could be experimented with to see if mutant beast meat could accelerate ordinary zombies’ evolution into Evolved Zombies.
If it worked, he wouldn’t need to worry about the number of Evolved Zombies in the future.
Plus, if zombies could evolve by consuming these mutant beast bodies, then humans should too.
Little Qiqi eats these mutant animals’ meat every day; who knows if there’s a chance she might become an Evolver.

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 168: The Second Tier 3 Corpse Puppet!
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 168: The Second Tier 3 Corpse Puppet!
Crunch! Crunch!
The sound of chewing continuously echoed within the orchard.
A group of ordinary Corpse Puppets was gnawing on the bodies of a Mutated Giant Wolf and a pangolin. The scene appeared exceedingly gory.
The appearance of zombies devouring flesh was extremely frightening, and the sound of chewing was even more unsettling, making one’s scalp tingle.
Though the flesh of the Giant Wolf and pangolin was extremely poor in taste, these zombies did not care about this.
Fresh flesh was an irresistible temptation for zombies.
After the flesh of various giant beasts was entirely carved up, Lu Chuan then controlled a large number of Corpse Puppets to begin handling the surrounding bloody environment.
The original orchard had been temporarily transformed into a slaughtering ground by him, and now this area was filled with a dense smell of blood, enveloping the entire orchard in a bloody haze.
Due to the dismembering of these giant beast corpses, the orchard’s environment seemed extremely unpleasant.
The fruit trees all over were splattered with fresh blood, and the dense smell of blood made people feel nauseous.
Lu Chuan immediately controlled a group of Corpse Puppets armed with mops and towels, starting to scrub the blood-stained trees nearby.
Along with the knives used for dismembering the mutant beast corpses, they were all cleaned thoroughly.
Though he himself had already turned into a zombie, capable of surviving in any environment.
Even lying atop a mountain of corpses and sea of blood, Lu Chuan would not be affected at all.
However, there was still Little Qiqi on this farm, and the little one was still young, needing a clean and healthy environment to grow up in.
If the dense scent of blood in the orchard was not promptly dealt with, it could also affect the little one’s appetite and mood upon smelling it.
Lu Chuan naturally wanted to maintain a healthy environment for the little one.
Luckily, there were enough Corpse Puppets, and soon those bloody conditions around the orchard were restored to their original state, with only a trace of fresh blood stained in the soil, seeping slowly underground.
After completing all this, Lu Chuan then looked at the numerous Crystal Cores he had just acquired, feeling an uncontrollable surge of excitement in his heart.
Although many Mutated Giant Beasts were killed this time, unfortunately, there were no Tier-three Crystal Cores.
Therefore, his strength couldn’t break through for now.
But fortunately, with these many mutant beast Crystal Cores, they could indeed enhance the power of his Corpse Puppets significantly.
With a thought, Lu Chuan directly controlled that Corpse Puppet, which after the Blood Moon night had seen no change and had only accidentally evolved to Tier-one a few days ago, bringing it in front of him.
Looking at this Tier-one Corpse Puppet that had just accidentally evolved, Lu Chuan directly took out three Tier-one Crystal Cores for it to consume.
He saw this Corpse Puppet swallow the Crystal Cores from the mutant beasts one by one.
Moments later, a peculiar power fluctuation rapidly emerged.
Under the enormous energy of these mutant beast Crystal Cores, the Corpse Puppet, which had just recently reached Tier-one, immediately evolved again, becoming a Tier-two Evolved Zombie.
Watching the successfully evolved Tier-two Corpse Puppet before him, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
Adding to the newly advanced Tier-two Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan now controlled as many as twenty-five Tier-two Corpse Puppets.
Such a formidable force of Tier-two Evolved Zombies definitely constituted an exceptionally strong combat power in this apocalyptic world.
Then, Lu Chuan lowered his head once more to look at the remaining Crystal Cores in his arms.
Today, a total of three Tier-two mutant beasts were encountered, yielding three Tier-two Crystal Cores.
If these Crystal Cores were given to other zombies to devour, their power might drastically increase.
It might even allow a Tier-two Evolved Zombie to evolve directly to Tier-three!
Though Lu Chuan now had several dozen Tier-two Evolved Zombies, those genuinely reaching Tier-three only included the Tank Type zombie "Er Pang".
According to Lu Chuan’s experience, three mutant beast Crystal Cores were enough for a Tier-two Corpse Puppet to breakthrough to Tier-three.
But this rare chance for evolution, which Corpse Puppet to leave it to, left Lu Chuan somewhat undecided.
The Tank Type Corpse Puppet already had the immensely powerful Er Pang, but he could choose to let other types of zombies try first.
Currently, Lu Chuan was in greater need of Corpse Puppets with strong attack power.
Clearly in this aspect, the Agile Type zombies were somewhat lacking.
Ultimately, Lu Chuan focused his attention on Tyrant One and Flame One.
One was a powerful melee zombie for direct confrontation.
The other was an elemental zombie capable of releasing flames from a distance.
Lu Chuan was momentarily indecisive, and he recalled today’s combat.
Moments later, Lu Chuan decided to leave this opportunity for evolution to Flame One.
During today’s battle, facing the powerful Tier-two Mutated Giant Tiger, the direct confrontation role of the Tyrant zombie was relatively quite small.
It mainly relied on the two Flame Zombies, continually releasing ranged attacks, causing sustained exhaustion and injuries to this fierce tiger.
If Flame One could reach Tier-three, then today’s kill of the Tier-two Mutated Giant Tiger might have been much easier.
Having made up his mind, Lu Chuan did not hesitate anymore, directly calling Flame One to his front, and letting it devour these three Tier-two Crystal Cores.
Boom!
Upon consecutively consuming the Crystal Cores of three Tier-two mutant fierce beasts, the aura of this Corpse Puppet instantly surged!
Flame One’s aura continued to ascend and ultimately successfully reached the Tier-three level.
As an Elemental Zombie, Flame One did not undergo any major changes upon breaking through to Tier-three.
Just the originally crimson body began to ignite a layer of flames.
That blazing flame lit up the surrounding area, and Lu Chuan could feel waves of heat rushing towards him.
Watching the aura surging before him from Flame One, Lu Chuan couldn’t wait to control it and head to a vacant lot to test its strength.
Boom!
After evolving to Tier-three, Flame One’s speed in releasing fireballs was faster than before.
Most critically, it could simultaneously release multiple fireballs!
Changing from a single-target long-distance attack to an area-wide long-range coverage.
Furthermore, the fireballs had expanded to twice the original size, with even more fearsome power.
Even this time the fireballs not only had high-temperature burning effects but also contained some explosive effects, akin to a terrifying incendiary bomb!
Lu Chuan believed that if these fireballs hit, even the mighty Tier-three fierce beasts would fall dead on the spot.
Besides the fireballs, Flame One could also form a wall of fire with a wave of its hand, with heights and lengths reaching several meters.
This wall of flame was useful for defense or preventing opponents from fleeing.
Watching Flame One showcase its terrifying combat strength, Lu Chuan was thoroughly amazed.
This breakthrough to Tier-three made Flame One an especially formidable weapon in group battles!
If several more Tier-three Flame Corpse Puppets came along, they might toughly confront a human hot weapon army.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 169: If This Keeps Up, I’ll Be Spoiled Rotten
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 169: If This Keeps Up, I’ll Be Spoiled Rotten
Late night descended.
Inside Qingshui Farm, bright flames flickered next to the amusement park.
Lu Chuan directly controlled Flame One to light a bonfire in the center of the yard.
With the protection of a large army of Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan didn’t have to worry about the firelight attracting other zombies and mutated fierce beasts.
Then he rummaged through the farm’s warehouse to find a barbecue grill and placed it next to the playground.
Two Corpse Puppets, wearing gloves, had already skewered a large amount of meat, all from previously hunted mutated fierce beasts.
Lu Chuan had brought plenty of barbecue seasonings while scavenging for supplies, and now they came in handy.
After dealing with the beast carcasses earlier, Little Qiqi suddenly had the idea of eating barbecue.
For Little Qiqi’s requests, Lu Chuan always did his best to fulfill them.
Besides, with today’s bounty, Lu Chuan planned to celebrate well and let Little Qiqi enjoy.
With Flame One around, Lu Chuan could even skip the fire-starting step.
At this moment, he was also wearing gloves, holding handfuls of skewers over the flames, turning them continuously. The sizzling heat cooked the fat out of the skewers.
The sizzling sound as the fat dripped into the flames was the most beautiful sound in the world to Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue standing nearby!
As the skewers gradually cooked, the mouth-watering aroma spread, enticing their taste buds.
Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but salivate as she gazed at the barbecue before her.
"Daddy, add more chili. I want it spicy!"
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan shook his head and refused.
How could the little one eat spicy food at such a young age?
Adding some pepper and salt would already be good enough.
Seeing her request refused, Ji Ruxue pouted, walked to Lu Chuan’s side, and hugged his leg, refusing to let go.
Lu Chuan looked down at the little one with her pitiful expression, and his heart softened.
But since both his hands were occupied with grilling, Lu Chuan simply controlled the nearby Tyrant to take out pen and paper, writing: "Little Qiqi, listen. You’re too young for chili, just a little bit."
Seeing this, Ji Ruxue was overjoyed. After all, her current body was still that of a child, and slightly spicy was already very good.
Having meat porridge every day, Ji Ruxue was a bit tired of it now.
Although the porridge was also delicious, eating the same thing daily could be too much.
Looking at the oil-coated skewers, Ji Ruxue suddenly wanted some beer.
Enjoying barbecue and chilled beer by the bonfire in the cool evening breeze was simply a great earthly delight.
Yet Ji Ruxue knew her daddy would never agree to such an unreasonable request.
After all, how could anyone agree to a one-year-old asking for beer?
Even if her dad agreed, Zhao Lin, being a policewoman, would likely snatch the beer from her hands...
Meanwhile, Zhao Lin, hugging her fair legs, was carefully watching Lu Chuan grilling the meat.
The zombie in front of her looked almost indistinguishable from a human from a distance, except for those striking blood-red eyes.
She remembered how he had nearly risked everything to stop her from entering Building 5 in the Sunshine District.
If it weren’t for the Invisible helping her from the shadows, she might have been killed by this guy long ago.
No, to be precise, if not for her talent of getting stronger upon revival, this guy might have really killed her...
The way he approached her with reckless abandon still sent chills down her spine when she thought about it.
Little Qiqi actually called this guy daddy?
So, he must be the Corpse King controlling the entire Qingshui Farm?
At this thought, Zhao Lin frowned slightly.
She remembered the Invisible once told her.
The Corpse Kings were extremely sneaky creatures, hiding in the shadows for their own safety.
But the guy in front of her was completely different from the description given by the Invisible.
In the Sunshine District, this guy seemed completely unaware of the concept of hiding, focused solely on risking his life against her.
Was it all for Little Qiqi’s safety back then?
Is that why the Corpse King, who should have been hiding in the dark, came to confront her?
Thinking about it, Zhao Lin felt a complex mix of emotions. She never imagined the Corpse King would go to such lengths to protect Little Qiqi.
Right, wasn’t this guy related to the Invisible?
Initially, when she wanted to make a move, the Invisible stopped her several times.
At this thought, a hint of depression flashed in Zhao Lin’s eyes. Had the Invisible been reliable, she wouldn’t have been crippled and imprisoned in Building 5...
Yet Zhao Lin felt puzzled. Over these days chatting with Little Qiqi, she never mentioned having any family...
With Lu Chuan continually sprinkling barbecue seasoning on the skewers, the aroma became even more rich.
The cravings of Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin, big and small, were both tantalized by the barbecue.
"Daddy, your skills are amazing, this smells incredible!"
Standing by the grill, Ji Ruxue stared at the barbecue with her bright eyes, momentarily forgetting to wipe the drool from the corners of her mouth.
Beside her, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but swallow, watching Lu Chuan meticulously grilling meat for Little Qiqi; her emotions became incredibly complex at this moment.
She had never imagined living so closely with a Corpse King.
Zhao Lin wanted to open up and have a heartfelt conversation with the zombie king, who possessed human consciousness, sharing her true thoughts.
But she was almost one hundred percent sure that if she said something wrong, this seemingly thrifty and homey Corpse King might turn hostile.
Though Zhao Lin was somewhat reluctant to admit...
It seemed she was a bit unwilling to leave this place.
Enjoying good food and drink without worrying about safety issues.
Looking across the entire post-apocalyptic world, it might be impossible to find a place as comfortable as being by the side of this Corpse King.
At this moment, the barbecue finally cooked, and Lu Chuan handed a few skewers to the little one.
Ji Ruxue received them, blew on them to cool, and put them in her mouth.
Fat mixed with meat juice burst in her mouth, adorned with barbeque seasoning, making it almost the most exquisite taste in the world.
Ji Ruxue had lost track of how long it had been since she last ate barbecue. As she devoured it, her eyes closed unconsciously, wearing a look of sheer enjoyment.
After slaying numerous mutated fierce beasts, Lu Chuan didn’t skimp on the skewers and passed a few to Zhao Lin as well.
Smelling the rich barbecue aroma, Zhao Lin eagerly took a bite.
The taste awakened her taste buds and simultaneously brought back memories of pre-apocalypse, momentarily causing her eyes to redden slightly.
Watching Little Qiqi eat so leisurely, Lu Chuan felt a bit of joy and continued playing the role of an impassive barbecue tool man.
Moments later, they both had a large pile of skewers beside them.
Both were eating with faces full of greasy satisfaction.
Zhao Lin instinctively touched her belly, her elegant brows slightly knitting.
Dear heavens, this is the apocalypse, so why does it feel like I’ve gained quite a bit of weight recently?
Oh no, if this keeps up, the Corpse King will spoil me useless...

chapters.title: Chapter 169 170: Encounter with the Bloodthirsty Wolf Pack, Unleash Direct Firepower!
chapters.content:
Yellow Dragon Town, already abandoned, now looked even more desolate after the previous bloody purification.
Gulu-lu～
Chen Tao's stomach kept growling, as the food in the warehouse has now been completely consumed.
The small piece of chocolate he had five hours ago was already his last ration.
Since the outbreak of the zombie crisis, he had managed to survive for half a year with the remaining food in the inn, but now there was absolutely no food left.
Chen Tao wheezed heavily as he looked at himself in the mirror, his face now sallow and emaciated, dark circles around his eyes, lips chapped and pale.
He glanced at the paper calendar on the wall; it had been almost six months since the outbreak began.
During the first month, he could still eat some filling meals with the warehouse's leftover food, originally thinking the crisis would end soon, or at least the government would send rescue.
But things got worse; the water and electricity stopped, the entire network collapsed, and every day he lived in darkness at home with no hope; the food dwindled as did the number of living people in the town.
From the second month of the apocalypse, he was barely eating anything, far from filling his stomach.
This food barely kept him from starvation. He originally thought that reducing his consumption would last until rescue arrived, but now Chen Tao realized he was too naive.
This post-apocalyptic world has lost all hope, and it's already the sixth month without a hint of rescue.
"Back when the inn was open, I hated those rats the most, hated them for stealing food, but now if one appeared in front of me, I'd be grateful..."
He stood up while supporting himself against the wall, looking at the empty warehouse with a bitter smile.
With not having eaten for so long, his stomach felt like it was tightly clenched, this intense pain made him feel nauseated, even feeling the acid surge up.
"No more, I can't keep forcing myself!"
"If I don't eat something soon, I'll starve to death even if the zombies don't bite me to death!"
"Damn it! An innkeeper starving to death in his own shop, that's damn embarrassing to say out loud!"
Looking at the blood-soaked streets outside, Chen Tao swallowed to moisten his dry throat.
Taking a deep breath, he picked up his backpack and prepared to go out to scavenge for supplies.
Rumble rumble rumble!
Just at that moment, another burst of engine noise came, and Chen Tao's hand paused in mid-air, ready to open the door.
Was that a car sound?
Could it possibly be those zombies from yesterday again?
Thinking of this, Chen Tao felt despair, but the unwillingness and desire to survive made him shake his head.
No!
Impossible!
This time it must be the human rescue team!
Struggling with the hunger in his abdomen, Chen Tao supported himself against the wall to return to the second floor, looking out from the window towards the distance.
However, reality was always so cruel, once again what he saw was not the rescue team.
Still the familiar convoy, still zombies driving those familiar trucks.
Plop!
The backpack dropped from his hand onto the floor, and Chen Tao sank powerlessly into the corner, his eyes turning utterly vacant.
The last flicker of survival instincts in his heart extinguished completely upon seeing those zombies.
Zombies could damn well drive now; does this world even have a place for humans to survive?!
In this crappy world, what's the damn point of being alive?!
Chen Tao staggered over to the bedside, where a box of rat poison was in the drawer of the nightstand. This was originally prepared for the rats that stole food from the warehouse, unexpectedly to be used on himself.
After swallowing the rat poison, Chen Tao quietly lay on the bed.
After months of the torment of a dark and hopeless apocalypse, a hint of relaxation finally appeared on his face.
"Screw the zombies! Screw the apocalypse!"
...
Similar situations to Chen Tao's were still playing out endlessly in the rest of Yellow Dragon Town.
Witnessing zombies driving caused many survivors to lose their will to survive completely.
Lu Chuan had no idea his actions brought such despair to these survivors.
He still parked the convoy at the foot of Yellow Dragon Mountain as before, while the Corpse Puppet army marched into the mountain under his control.
However, because yesterday he had slaughtered mutated fierce beasts on the outskirts of Yellow Dragon Mountain all day, there were essentially no mutated fierce beasts blocking him at the outskirts now.
As the Corpse Puppet troops advanced deeper, they soon arrived at a mountain valley.
This valley differed from the surrounding green forests, composed entirely of massive yellow rocks.
The shape formed by the piled yellow rocks at the entrance to the valley was like a giant serpent lying in the mountains; hence, Yellow Dragon Mountain got its name.
Corpse Puppet troops had just started walking into the valley when the sound of dense footsteps could be heard not far ahead, followed by the appearance of massive mutated giant wolves.
Awoo～Awoo～
Lu Chuan roughly glanced around, there seemed to be about ten wolves in front of him.
Since they were all mutated, it was difficult to discern what breed this wolf pack was before the apocalypse.
These mutated giant wolves were similar in size to the black giant wolf from yesterday, with a shoulder height of over three meters and body length reaching five meters.
Their fur was all blood-red, as if dyed in a layer of fresh blood.
Their pupils were also blood-red, each wolf's eyes filled with ferocity and bloodlust.
What most caught Lu Chuan's eye was a mutated giant wolf standing on a rock among the wolf pack.
This wolf was larger than the others, with a shoulder height nearly three meters and a body length nearly five meters.
Obviously, this second-tier giant wolf standing on the rock was the leader of the pack; its blood-red eyes exuded a chilling murderous intent.
Apparently, the sudden arrival of the Corpse Puppet army had invaded these mutated blood wolves' territory.
Seeing the zombies, the mutated blood wolves' fur bristled along their backs, their mouths gaping to reveal sharp teeth.
Roar! Roar!
Facing the mutated blood wolves' howls, the Corpse Puppet troops controlled by Lu Chuan countered with defiantly roaring sounds of their own.
In an instant, Corpse Puppets and mutated wolves faced off, the atmosphere growing increasingly tense.
But Lu Chuan was not the least bit fazed by this situation, his skill in controlling various Corpse Puppets to coordinate had improved after yesterday's fight.
The most crucial part was that Flame One successfully advanced to the third tier, with attack power skyrocketing post-advancement.
With the evolved Flame One, handling a situation like this was too easy.
The wolf pack seemed to have sensed the presence of a good number of second-tier evolved zombies, hesitating out of fear.
But Lu Chuan couldn't care less; when meeting on a narrow path, strike first!
Flame One suddenly ignited in blazing flames, his hands waving as enormous fireballs were hurled towards the wolf pack, like a sudden downpour of fiery rain.
Melee combat?
I'm directly going for remote firepower coverage!

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 171: Tempering the Blood Evil Blade Technique with Mutant Beast Blood!
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 171: Tempering the Blood Evil Blade Technique with Mutant Beast Blood!
After evolving to the third tier, Flame One’s fireball strength and the speed of its casting both improved significantly.
These massive fireballs fell into the wolf pack, instantly triggering their explosive attribute once again.
In an instant, countless flames spread out, almost forming a sea of fire within the wolf pack.
The wolf pack obviously didn’t understand the principle of striking first. Originally, both sides were tensely confronting each other, but then Lu Chuan suddenly caught them by surprise.
Flame One’s attack frequency and speed were so fast that even the second-tier Wolf King didn’t have time to react.
However, although the place where the wolf pack was became a sea of fire, these bloodthirsty giant wolves did not scatter and flee like pre-apocalypse wolf packs.
After being injured, the ferocity of these Mutated Blood Wolves was fully aroused, and they instead became more brutal.
Howl! Howl!
Under the roars of the second-tier Wolf King, numerous Mutated Blood Wolves charged towards the direction of the Corpse Puppet army, with the flames on their bodies blazing, advancing instead of retreating.
The entire wolf pack, already terrifying and hideous after mutation, now charged through the flames released by Flame One, resembling demon wolves emerging from purgatory.
In the Yellow Stone Valley, eerie wolf howls echoed through the air!
Seeing the ferocious wolf pack in front of him, Lu Chuan was slightly taken aback, but soon a strong fighting spirit surged within him.
Since you like to gamble your lives, I’ll play along with you to the end!
This is my Undead Legion. Let’s see which living being can play for their life with my Corpse Puppets!
With a thought, Lu Chuan sent a large number of Evolved Corpse Puppets into battle with the wolf pack ahead.
Even though the melee had begun, Lu Chuan still remained composed.
Flame One raised a massive wall of fire at the front of the team, utilizing the terrain of the valley on both sides. These giant wolves had to pass through this wall of fire to attack the Corpse Puppet forces.
The Tank Zombies, as always, took on the defensive duties for the entire team, acting like humanoid main battle tanks at the front.
The charging Mutated Giant Wolves were scorched by the fire wall and were all firmly suppressed by the Tank Zombies on the periphery.
Da Pang, wielding twin hammers, was exceptionally brave, taking on not only defensive tasks but also swinging the massive hammers madly to repel the Mutated Giant Wolves in front of him.
Each impact of the giant hammers would draw heartrending howls from the Mutated Giant Wolves.
Even if some Mutated Giant Wolves used the yellow stone terrain on both sides of the valley to attack the middle and rear of the team, they would be successfully intercepted mid-air by the second-tier Tyrant Zombie.
The third-tier Flame One, clad in the scale armor of a Mutated Golden Python, continued to launch massive fireballs under cover from the Tank Zombies and Tyrant Zombies.
This terrifying attack sent Mutated Giant Wolves flying away one by one,
and the valley soon filled with thick, dark smoke emanating from the injured Giant Wolves.
Flame One’s attack power increased significantly, causing the bodies of these Mutated Blood Wolves to stiffen upon being struck.
Agile Zombies of the second tier followed up with steel knives right after the fireballs, exploiting the stiffening phase of the injured Mutated Giant Wolves to further expand the wounds on the Mutated Blood Wolves.
Moreover, many Corpse Puppets would move with the pack’s movements, ensuring that only the Tank Zombies and Tyrant Zombies faced the direct assault from the Giant Wolves.
The mutated wolf pack was incredibly violent, trying to launch attacks continuously. However, against Lu Chuan’s steady and precise formation, each injury they suffered was their own.
Holding a steel knife, Lightning One danced like a bee among the Bloodthirsty Wolf Pack under Lu Chuan’s control.
These Mutated Giant Wolves increased in power after mutation, each moving much faster than before, but due to size differences, they could do nothing against Lightning One.
Lu Chuan maneuvered Lightning One, utilizing the Blood Evil Blade Technique he had previously practiced. Each slash unleashed the most powerful attack with minimal force.
The sharp blade beams streaked through the air, accompanied by a whistling sound.
After long practice, Lu Chuan had reached a beginner’s level mastery of the Blood Evil Blade Technique.
Each time Lightning One swung the steel knife, the blade’s menacing arc seemed to explode with terrifying force.
He seemed the most fearsome executioner on earth, each lateral slash of the steel knife took the life of a Giant Wolf!
And as the blood on him thickened, Lu Chuan felt increasingly skilled in the Blood Evil Blade Technique.
After slaughtering each Giant Wolf, a thin wisp of blood aura subtly encircled the steel knife.
Lu Chuan nodded secretly. The name "Blood Evil Blade Technique" was fitting; real combat was indeed the ultimate test for everything.
Only true combat could accelerate his blade technique’s progress.
The Blood Evil Blade Technique could only grow stronger when honed in a bloodbath.
The more blood on the blade, the deeper Lu Chuan’s understanding of this cultivation technique became.
Hahaha!
Good timing!
Today, I shall use the blood of the wolf pack to hone my Blood Evil Blade Technique!
After slaying several Mutated Blood Wolves consecutively, Lightning One’s steel knife became coated with a layer of fresh blood.
Even after shedding the blood, wisps of blood aura still hovered over the steel knife.
The Bloodthirsty Wolf King, originally standing high above, was enraged upon seeing its pack heavily damaged, immediately leaping down from the boulders to join the fight.
The speed of the second-tier Lightning One was equally astonishing, moving ghost-like, leaving the Mutated Wolf King helpless.
Exploiting its size advantage, Lightning One swung the long blade in his hand to slay yet another first-tier Mutated Giant Wolf.
Howl!
Witnessing Lightning One’s persistent slaughter, the second-tier Wolf King was utterly enraged.
After unleashing an angry roar, the second-tier Wolf King’s already terrifying speed surged even more!
Instantly, it was standing before Lightning One!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
This second-tier Wolf King boasted formidable combat ability, its strength and speed far exceeding ordinary first-tier Giant Wolves.
Lightning One wielded the blood-red long blade with impenetrable precision, barely managing to parry the Wolf King’s assaults.
"Hahaha! Nice timing!"
Facing the extremely violent second-tier Wolf King, Lu Chuan showed no fear at all.
With the Blood Evil Blade Technique continuously in motion, Lu Chuan felt something affecting his mood, releasing an unstoppable momentum with each swing of the blade.
Incessantly wielding the long blade, Lightning One gathered strands of blood-colored divine light within the blade aura.
Along with the ceaseless execution of the Blood Evil Blade Technique, Lightning One’s assault grew increasingly fierce.
Pssh!
As the ongoing battles continued, the second-tier Wolf King bore more and more injuries, and its speed began to decline.
Though unaffected by the fatigue of battle, Lightning One’s overall offensive became fiercer.
Finally, a blood-red blade beam slashed through the air, decapitating the second-tier Mutated Wolf King!

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 172: Old Turtle Levels Up!
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 172: Old Turtle Levels Up!
Crack! Crack!
The originally quiet outskirts of Qingshui Farm were now filled with nerve-wracking sounds of chewing.
A few massive blood-colored giant wolves were being torn to pieces by a horde of ordinary zombies, the ground around them dyed red with blood.
These zombies, already hideous in appearance, were now half-buried in the bodies of these giant wolves as they fed.
After tearing off large chunks of flesh, they held them in their hands and chewed continuously, their faces covered in blood, looking utterly terrifying.
Not only the flesh of the Mutated Giant Wolves, but even the intestines in the abdomen were not spared by the zombies.
Several zombies, like participating in a tug-of-war, pulled at the intestines of the Mutated Giant Wolves, their bodies stained red with flowing blood.
The once massive and ferocious mutated wolf pack was now reduced to nothing but thick bones, gnawed by a group of zombies.
Wolf meat is sour and of extremely poor texture, rendering it inedible for Little Qiqi, so Lu Chuan could only use it to feed these Corpse Puppets.
These zombies are not picky; any meat that can be swallowed is stuffed into their mouths without hesitation.
In Lu Chuan’s opinion, these zombies are the best candidates for a mukbang show, as they feast fervently on the crimson flesh...
Feeding zombies with Fierce Beast meat isn’t a waste.
It’s also an opportunity to experiment, observing whether consuming the flesh of Mutated Fierce Beasts can accelerate the evolution of ordinary Corpse Puppets.
As for the Crystal Cores within the Mutated Giant Wolves, Lightning One had already extracted them.
Seeing Lightning One carry a large pile of Crystal Cores toward him, Lu Chuan felt incredibly delighted.
The Bloodthirsty Wolf Pack from Yellow Stone Valley provided him with ten first-tier Crystal Cores and one second-tier Crystal Core!
Though today’s harvest was not as bountiful as yesterday’s, compared to his meager gains in the Jiangnan City District, this was already quite satisfying.
Lu Chuan felt very content, as one cannot become a fat person with one bite.
The consecutive two days of success greatly bolstered Lu Chuan’s confidence in Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Merely two days into Yellow Stone Valley, encountering such a massive mutated wolf pack indicates a large number of mutated fierce beasts still waiting for him to hunt in Yellow Dragon Mountain.
If he could conquer the entire Yellow Dragon Mountain, the Crystal Cores of these mutated fierce beasts would undoubtedly greatly enhance his Corpse Puppet army’s strength.
It might even be possible to elevate his troops of Evolved Zombies to the third tier, thus exponentially increasing his power!
Lu Chuan dared not imagine his troop’s combat power if all his Evolved Zombies evolved to the third tier!
Subsequently, Lu Chuan headed to the outskirts of the farm.
The ordinary zombies, although not strong in combat, feasted at an astonishing pace.
Before long, the Mutated Giant Wolves’ corpses outside Qingshui Farm were reduced to mere skeletons by the feasting zombies.
The scene before him was somewhat gory, as zombies devour without regard for their appearance.
A large group of blood-stained zombies stood outside Qingshui Farm, creating an eerily chilling picture.
Fortunately, with foresight, he had these zombies devour the corpses outside the farm; otherwise, such a bloody scene would be disastrous if witnessed by Little Qiqi.
Seeing the chaotic and gory scene before him, Lu Chuan immediately ordered the Corpse Puppets to clear the area using tools.
The blood-soaked soil from the Mutated Fierce Beasts wasn’t wasted by Lu Chuan; it was transported back to the farm for tilling.
Thus, an exceptionally peculiar sight emerged outside Qingshui Farm: a queue of blood-soaked zombies lined up to wash at the water bucket...
At that moment, a thought jolted Lu Chuan, prompting him to sprint toward the fish pond.
The Mutated Old Turtle, dwelling in the fish pond, was unexpectedly about to come ashore!
...
At the fish pond’s edge.
Seeing the Mutated Turtle opting to come ashore, Lu Chuan, to prevent any danger, immediately ordered the shoreline Corpse Puppets to prepare for action.
Turtle soup is nourishing, and such a large Mutated Turtle would certainly make the broth even more replenishing.
Lu Chuan had long wanted to stew the turtle to nourish Little Qiqi.
"Don’t harm the little turtle, it means no harm!"
But just as the Corpse Puppets were about to act, Little Qiqi suddenly darted out to block them.
Seizing the opportunity, the Old Turtle ascended onto the shore.
Yet, even after coming ashore, it remained quietly by the bank.
Though a Mutated Fierce Beast, this Old Turtle indeed didn’t exhibit any outrageous behavior, exuding a slightly honest demeanor as it lay by the shore.
Arriving at the scene, Lu Chuan was astonished to find Little Qiqi riding on the Old Turtle’s back.
Despite this, the Large Turtle remained very calm.
"Hehe, Dad, look, the little turtle is letting me ride it."
Ji Ruxue flashed a naive smile, appearing very adorable.
Actually, Ji Ruxue had her reasons for bringing the Old Turtle ashore this time.
Observing her father hunting numerous Mutated Fierce Beasts over the days, she realized he must have accumulated quite a few Crystal Cores.
Though the little turtle has her cultivated technique, possessing Crystal Cores would undeniably speed up its power enhancement.
At this moment, Lu Chuan was amazed by the sight before him.
Never did he expect this turtle that once bit the ankles of his Corpse Puppets upon first meeting, to now be so gentle with Little Qiqi.
The little one was sitting on its back, and yet the Old Turtle remained calm.
Could this be the outcome of Little Qiqi’s daily feeding, similar to a dog recognizing its master, making this Old Turtle acknowledge her?
Are these Mutated Fierce Beasts indeed tamable?
Initially intending to seize the opportunity of the turtle’s landfall to stew this Mutated Giant Turtle.
However, witnessing the harmony between the little one and the Old Turtle, Lu Chuan hesitated to proceed with his plan.
Little Qiqi, following him daily, only had Zhao Lin as companionship within the vast Qingshui Farm apart from himself.
Now, having an additional presence to bring joy to the little one was rare.
But the size of this Mutated Old Turtle makes it seem inapplicable for the name "little turtle"...
Gazing at the Mutated Giant Turtle before him, Lu Chuan pondered silently.
This Giant Turtle had always lived within his farm, seemingly getting along nicely with Little Qiqi.
If its power could also be enhanced, the little one’s safety would have an additional layer of assurance.
After some thought, Lu Chuan pulled out two first-tier Crystal Cores from his pocket, tossing them directly to the Old Turtle.
This Mutated Giant Turtle, always inclined by the shore, immediately widened its eyes upon sensing the aura of the Fierce Beast Crystal Cores.
Moments later, after swallowing several first-tier Crystal Cores, the aura emitted from the Giant Turtle continued to rise.

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 173: Newly Emerged Evolved Zombies!
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 173: Newly Emerged Evolved Zombies!
By the fish pond.
An aura belonging to a second-tier Fierce Beast continually emanated from the body of the giant turtle, and its massive size was still expanding further.
The original size of the Mutated Giant Turtle was already close to over three meters in length.
After devouring the Crystal Core now, its size has surged to approximately four meters!
The pitch-black shell of the Mutated Giant Turtle appeared even more robust, and upon closer inspection, strange patterns could faintly be seen.
Clearly, with the breakthrough in its realm, the defense capabilities of this giant turtle received a substantial boost.
The limbs outside the shell also became more muscular, and the turtle claws carved several trenches on the earth.
The original Mutated Turtle was at the first-tier level, and during this period, Ji Ruxue often fed it the blood and flesh of Mutated Fierce Beasts.
After signing a contract, Ji Ruxue passed on the Cultivation Technique she acquired in her past life to this turtle, enabling it to continuously absorb the Energy Factors in the air to grow stronger.
After accumulating over such a long period, this giant turtle has stored a certain amount of energy inside.
Now, with the addition of the two first-tier Crystal Cores that Lu Chuan just fed it, the Mutated Turtle has fully evolved to the second tier.
After breaking through to the second tier, this over five-meter long turtle, lying by the shore, appeared even more majestic.
"Wow, Dad, look! The little turtle has grown bigger!"
"Dad, what did you just feed it? Could you give it some more? I want the little turtle to grow even bigger."
Ji Ruxue yelled innocently at the moment, though she knew well.
Watching the little turtle successfully breakthrough, she was genuinely delighted inside.
With Dad’s current strength, hunting ordinary Mutated Fierce Beasts was not a problem, and the speed at which he acquired Crystal Cores could certainly accelerate the evolution of this Mutated Giant Turtle.
Additionally, with the Cultivation Technique I taught this Mutated Turtle, the combined effects will rapidly enhance the little turtle’s strength.
Based on my experiences and memories from my past life, Dad is undoubtedly standing in the first echelon of evolution in the apocalypse now.
After all, a Corpse King capable of human consciousness is just exceedingly exceptional in this apocalyptic world.
During this period, neither human Evolvers nor Mutated Fierce Beasts could be compared to Dad.
If I could obtain a large number of Mutated Crystal Cores from Dad, perhaps the little Turtle truly could become a horrifying existence like the Emperor Rank Fierce Beast, Black Tortoise, in my past life!
By that time, I could also venture into training within the East Sea properly.
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue felt a burst of joy inside.
Standing aside, Lu Chuan nodded secretly while observing the evolved Mutated Giant Turtle.
It’s rare for the little one to like this Mutated Turtle so much.
This Mutated Turtle also seems to have a special attachment to Little Qiqi.
Since I have decided to cultivate this Fierce Beast, there’s no need to be stingy with the Crystal Cores.
However, just having promoted, Lu Chuan doesn’t intend to immediately let it consume another second-tier Crystal Core — at least, it should first adjust to its strengthened body.
Lu Chuan takes out paper and pen and writes: "Little Qiqi, what Dad just fed this turtle was very precious, and it’s just eaten — it can’t continuously consume more."
"But rest assured; since you like this guy so much, Dad surely will make it grow bigger and bigger!"
Ji Ruxue read it and quickly nodded with a smile, "Mm-hmm, I knew Dad was the best!"
"Don’t worry, Dad. Little Turtle listens to me; even if it were to grow big, it would never harm us."
After speaking, Ji Ruxue directly flipped over and mounted on this Mutated Giant Turtle.
The giant turtle bore no complaint, turning into a mount for Ji Ruxue, moving freely around the farm.
Although being a turtle, its speed was not slow after coming ashore, running in the farm, slightly slower than second-tier zombies but kicking up clouds of dust as it went.
Since having a mount, Ji Ruxue started wandering around the farm on the Mutated Turtle.
Hearing Little Qiqi’s joyful laughter, Lu Chuan felt deeply gratified.
The little one growing up healthily and happily day by day is his largest current wish.
Thud, thud, thud!
The limbs of the Mutated Turtle were very robust, making rumbling noises while running on the ground, its stout turtle paws leaving massive prints upon the earth.
Zhao Lin, originally resting on the bed, sat up straight upon hearing the commotion.
Soon, she saw Little Qiqi sitting atop a gigantic turtle, swiftly passing before her eyes.
Zhao Lin was dumbfounded; her beautiful eyes widened hugely, even wondering whether she hadn’t woken up from her sleep yet...
What just dashed by?!
What was Little Qiqi sitting atop a big, round, black thing?
How does it seem like a turtle?!
But... what family’s turtle grows like this?!
Moreover, how is it running so fast?!
Isn’t it always said that the tortoise only beat the hare because the hare napped halfway through the race? But this turtle doesn’t run slow at all?!
Wait...
Little Qiqi mentioned before that she was raising a little turtle, bringing all sorts of meat to feed it punctuality every day.
Zhao Lin froze.
All along, she assumed that the turtle Ji Ruxue mentioned was merely a palm-sized pet.
But now, she reckoned she undervalued the size of the little one’s pet.
Only now did she realize — no wonder every time she saw Little Qiqi going to feed the turtle, she had a pile of meat.
She hadn’t paid much heed before, yet now she understood: how could a small turtle eat so much meat?!
But this turtle is as big as a car; you call this thing a little turtle?
How is it small?!
Zhao Lin genuinely hadn’t expected such a cute name.
Then what approaching her was a robust giant turtle five meters long...
Massaging her temples, Zhao Lin felt somewhat disconnected from the world, where the post-apocalyptic world had changed dramatically.
Having zombies was acceptable; nevertheless, there’s now a Corpse King with human consciousness.
Even the beasts in her memory underwent an overwhelming change in size.
Is this still the world she once knew?
...
The next morning.
Lu Chuan, as usual, was preparing breakfast for Little Qiqi.
With a large quantity of Mutated Fierce Beasts slain over this period, it sufficiently met Little Qiqi’s various meat-consuming needs.
Besides the obligatory meat porridge daily, Lu Chuan also sliced some Mutated Deer Meat, simply marinated it in starch, then cooked it with barbecue seasonings.
As Lu Chuan was plating the dishes, he suddenly had a sense of intuition.
Among the numerous ordinary Corpse Puppets he controlled, two suddenly transformed into Evolved Corpse Puppets this time!

chapters.title: Chapter 173: 174: Directly Rearing Zombies! Fatten Them Up Before the Slaughter!
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 174: Directly Rearing Zombies! Fatten Them Up Before the Slaughter!
Early in the morning came good news, making Lu Chuan naturally overjoyed.
After careful observation, Lu Chuan discovered that the two zombies that successfully evolved into first-order Corpse Puppets were ordinary Corpse Puppets that had participated in his experiment of devouring Mutated Fierce Beast Meat in the past two days.
"It seems my hypothesis is probably correct, the flesh and blood of these Mutated Fierce Beasts indeed carry energy, which can truly promote the evolution of ordinary zombies!"
Feeding these zombies with the flesh and blood of Mutated Fierce Beasts.
On one hand, because the meat of those mutated wolves was too sour, astringent, and dry for Little Qiqi to consume.
On the other hand, I wanted to experiment to see if the flesh and blood of these Mutated Fierce Beasts could accelerate the evolution of zombies.
I need to manage the entire farm now, and control the Evolved Corpse Puppets to fight against the Mutated Fierce Beasts.
Even though my Spiritual Power has increased greatly after evolving to the third-order, it’s still somewhat challenging to keep track of so many ordinary Corpse Puppets at once.
So, Lu Chuan preemptively made marks on these zombies that were part of the experiment for easy future differentiation.
On the shoulders of these zombies that devoured the flesh and blood of Mutated Fierce Beasts, Lu Chuan tied a piece of cloth.
This way, if any changes occur, I can immediately distinguish between the group that devoured the flesh of mutant beasts and those that didn’t.
Unexpectedly, the marked signs came in handy after just two days.
The appearance of these two Evolved Zombies further supports my previous hypothesis.
If it truly is as I thought, then there’s no need to worry about the dwindling numbers of Evolved Zombies anymore.
However, for the sake of experimental rigor, Lu Chuan didn’t immediately conclude.
After all, the appearance of one or two Evolved Zombies might just be a coincidence.
Not long ago, an ordinary Corpse Puppet underwent evolution, so a further test is necessary.
"I hope it turns out as I guessed, so we won’t have to worry about the issue of Evolved Corpse Puppets anymore."
"If further evolutions occur among this batch of ordinary zombies that devoured the Mutated Fierce Beast’s flesh, it would fully prove my hypothesis correct!"
After calming the joy in his heart, Lu Chuan continued with the farm work.
The next day, while Lu Chuan was inspecting the vegetable garden on the farm, he had new sensory feedback.
Sure enough, among his ordinary Corpse Puppets, two more Evolved Zombies were born!
And according to the markings, these two evolved Corpse Puppets, like the previous day, were part of the group that had devoured the flesh and blood of Mutated Fierce Beasts!
"Great, it seems there’s nothing wrong with my guess!"
Lu Chuan was excited at this moment; the appearance of these two Evolved Zombies allowed him to fully confirm his previous hypothesis.
The Crystal Core of these Mutated Fierce Beasts can advance Evolved Zombies, and their flesh and blood can also continuously accelerate the evolution of ordinary Corpse Puppets!
The success of this experiment gave Lu Chuan new ideas.
In Jiangnan City District, he had virtually cleaned out all the Evolved Zombies, and a search by Corpse Puppets hadn’t yielded new findings.
Now, the result of this experiment rekindled his hope for growing stronger.
Since the flesh and blood of Mutated Fierce Beasts can facilitate the evolution of ordinary zombies, it means that with enough Mutated Fierce Beast Meat, he could continuously produce a large number of first-order Evolved Zombies!
Judging from the continuous emergence of Evolved Zombies over the past two days, the efficiency of cultivating Evolved Zombies using Mutated Fierce Beasts is quite impressive!
At least, this efficiency is far faster than sending Corpse Puppets to find them in the city.
Taking a glance at the warehouse where he stored the Mutated Fierce Beast Meat, Lu Chuan’s eyes gleamed.
Producing first-order Evolved Zombies is just the beginning.
The key is to manage it independently; using these first-order Evolved Zombies to cultivate second-order Evolved Zombies.
Zombies evolve by consuming Crystal Cores of the same level, and with enough Crystal Cores, powerful zombies can be cultivated.
Even with sufficient numbers, it’s possible to nurture third-order Corpse Puppets!
He could fully establish an Evolved Zombie production factory, as long as there are ordinary zombies and the flesh and blood of Mutated Fierce Beasts, they can enter an assembly line process, generating Evolved Zombies continuously through mutual devouring and evolution.
Finding Evolved Zombies in the city is extremely difficult, but ordinary zombies can be grabbed by the handful on the streets.
Because his breakthrough speed has been rapid, it’s become challenging to encounter third-order Evolved Zombies for breakthroughs.
If this plan to mass-produce Evolved Zombies succeeds, it would equate to discovering a new path of evolution!
Lu Chuan understands the principle of survival of the fittest.
In this chaotic apocalypse, only those with sufficient power can lead a stable life.
Now, human survivors have regained composure amidst the doomsday crisis, and the Survivor Base has become increasingly strong, with more and more Human Evolvers appearing.
Powerful Mutated Fierce Beasts in the mountains are also multiplying, steadily eroding the advantage he had previously built.
To continue living safely, he must find a way to rapidly evolve before other species grow stronger.
Clenching his fist, Lu Chuan immediately started preparing for a new round of planning.
...
Jiangnan City District.
A large stadium echoed with the roars of numerous zombies.
The stadium was completely sealed off except for one exit.
However, the internal space was quite spacious, enough to accommodate a thousand people.
Lu Chuan controlled the Evolved Corpse Puppets, using overwhelming power to subdue the ordinary zombies on the street into shivering intimidation, then grabbed them one by one and tossed them directly into the stadium.
These ordinary zombies had no resistance against Lu Chuan’s Evolved Corpse Puppets and could only passively accept the fate Lu Chuan arranged.
Having captured and thrown in a massive number of ordinary Corpse Puppets, the stadium area was large enough to contain them all without issue.
After confining these ordinary zombies in the stadium, he closed the single door completely, ensuring none could escape.
Looking at the sealed-off stadium, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
This stadium was the designated breeding ground for the Evolved Zombie factory, spacious inside with few exits.
By keeping all these ordinary zombies within, feeding them with Mutated Blood Beasts, let numerous Evolved Zombies emerge amongst them.
These Evolved Zombies, driven by primal instincts, would massacre each other inside the stadium.
Thereby constantly devouring and growing stronger, and when the zombies finished their battles, he would come to reap the fattened results.
This fully automated, advancing Evolved Zombie cultivation required no further effort on his part thereafter.

chapters.title: Chapter 174: 175: Have the Plants Mutated Too?
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 175: Have the Plants Mutated Too?
Inside the gymnasium.
A large number of ordinary zombies crowded together, densely packed, and roars continuously echoed.
These ordinary zombies looked extremely hideous and terrifying.
However, without undergoing evolution, their bodies had gradually become more haggard and miserable over time.
Perhaps due to the long time without eating, their bodies became extremely thin, now baring their teeth at their surroundings.
Because of the large gathering of zombies, the gymnasium was filled with a heavy stench of rot.
These ordinary zombies, devoid of thought and consciousness, had no idea what fate awaited them.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, a circle of evolved zombies was standing outside the gymnasium, their immense pressure making the ordinary zombies shiver, not daring to run outside.
If human survivors came to the stadium and saw the massive number of zombies there, they would probably faint from fright.
After the apocalypse outbreak, even these ordinary zombies caused humanity countless troubles.
Except for the Evolvers, ordinary humans hardly had any courage to fight back against these bloodthirsty zombies.
Yet at this moment, these zombies, considered a great calamity to humans, appeared unusually quiet, even their bodies were trembling.
With evolved zombies surrounding the gymnasium, these zombies did not dare to run outside at all.
Of course.
Even if they wanted to escape, it would be useless as the gymnasium only had one exit, while the rest were completely sealed off.
Crack!
Lightning One opened the only door, and then Da Pang forcefully threw chunks of cut mutant fierce beast flesh into the gymnasium.
The fresh smell of blood instantly attracted these zombies.
Since the apocalypse, these bloodthirsty zombies wandering the streets hadn’t smelled fresh human flesh in a long time.
Fresh fierce beast flesh had a deadly attraction for them.
In an instant, these zombies’ vicious nature was triggered.
Zombies that could coexist peacefully suddenly started fierce fights.
They began frantically scrambling for the flesh, as if goldfish fighting for bait in a fish tank.
"Not bad, not bad, from now on this will be my zombie breeding base."
Watching the ongoing battle inside the gymnasium, Lu Chuan felt very satisfied.
He was eagerly anticipating how many evolved zombies would appear after some time.
Now that the zombie breeding base had been set up, his next task was to hunt more mutant fierce beasts.
Now he needed not only to support Little Qiqi, who was a foodie, but also to feed this large group of zombies.
The path to becoming stronger truly was a long and arduous journey...
...
Yellow Dragon Town, inside a rather old five-story residential building.
"Quan, look quickly! That zombie horde is moving again!"
"Really don’t know what the deal is with this zombie convoy, coming and going in Yellow Dragon Town several times."
The man referred to as Quan was a middle-aged man around thirty or forty years old, also an Evolver and the leader of the survivor team.
Yellow Dragon Town was a tourist town, and before the apocalypse outbreak, it was summer and also the peak tourist season.
Zhang Quan just happened to be with a tour group visiting this area when the zombie crisis struck upon reaching Yellow Dragon Town.
The tour guide within the group suddenly mutated right on the bus, crazily biting those sitting in the front row; fortunately, Zhang Quan was seated in the back and avoided being attacked.
But he quickly chose to charge forward, using the fire extinguisher on the bus to smash the zombie guide’s head into a pulp.
Before the rest of the tourists could transform, he opened the door and led everyone out.
However, when the tour group descended from the bus, they found the world in chaos, with accidents and explosions happening everywhere.
Many, like the guide before them, started crazily biting the pedestrians on the streets.
The streets filled with screams and wails, and the originally peaceful tourist town suddenly became a living nightmare.
Zhang Quan kept a clear head, leading everyone through the crowds and fled to a quieter old residential area nearby.
But by the time the group of originally around fifty tourists reached here, only twenty or so remained.
The rest had all been killed by zombies en route, and the remaining tourists were all in shock.
Even in this old residential area, zombies also appeared.
Fortunately, the tour group had many physically strong adult males, who grabbed whatever tools they could as weapons, and under Zhang Quan’s leadership, they fought their way into an old residential building.
After they completely locked the gates downstairs, it was only then they realized that the large tour group had been reduced to merely a dozen people.
However, some people within the building had already transformed into zombies, and while clearing the building, a few others were bitten.
There were also several local survivors within the building, and everyone immediately formed a survivor team, electing Zhang Quan, who led them here, as the leader.
With the supplies available in the residential building, Zhang Quan and the others held their ground, enduring until now.
Watching the convoy pass through town, Zhang Quan and several adult males had already packed their bags.
Each of them wielding baseball bats and homemade spears and such simple gear, they prepared to go out searching for supplies.
Their stance clearly indicating it wasn’t their first time doing it.
Zhang Quan glanced at the receding convoy and said in a deep voice, "This zombie horde has really helped us a lot. Everyone, get ready and charge out with me."
Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppet convoy, every time it passed through the town, attracted large numbers of zombies, which they killed along the way.
Unintentionally, they reduced quite a bit of survival pressure for the town’s survivors.
Zhang Quan’s survivor team would take advantage of this moment to venture out for supplies.
Seeing the convoy gradually disappear from view, the survivors inside the building were still amazed, and curious about what this zombie convoy was doing in Yellow Dragon Town.
...
After previous battles with various mutated fierce beasts, Lu Chuan now led the Corpse Puppet army directly into the interior of Yellow Dragon Mountain.
But surprisingly, there were no fierce beasts around; instead, there were spreading blood-colored vines.
Glancing around, Lu Chuan noticed a large number of fierce beast carcasses near these blood-colored vines.
Among them were several massive carcasses, which evidently were not weak in power.
This scene immediately made Lu Chuan alert.
This large number of mutated beasts dying here.
Evidently, the blood-colored vine forest was not a safe place.
Just as he realized something was amiss, these blood-colored vines suddenly began moving.
They then swept directly towards the direction of the evolved Corpse Puppets.
"Damn! Are you kidding me?!"
"Mutated animals are one thing, but even plants are freaking mutating?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 176: Bloodthirsty Vine
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 176: Bloodthirsty Vine
These blood-colored vines were numerous and moved quickly.
Lu Chuan hurriedly controlled the Corpse Puppets to dodge.
But soon he found that these blood-colored vines bypassed the other zombies and headed straight for Lightning Two.
"What did Lightning Two do to provoke you? Why are you only chasing it?"
Lu Chuan was puzzled. The attack method of these mutant plants was really perplexing.
Luckily, these vines posed no threat to the other zombies.
Lu Chuan quickly maneuvered the other Corpse Puppets away from the blood-colored vines.
He focused on controlling Lightning Two to constantly dodge the vines.
However, there were so many blood-colored vines, emerging wildly from behind rocks.
The overwhelming blood-colored vines surged toward Lightning Two, turning the area into a sea of blood.
These vines sped like arrows released from a bowstring, far faster than normal biological growth.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
The thighs of the second-tier Lightning Two were thick and strong, its feet pushed hard, propelling the whole body like a bullet.
Yet no matter how fast Lightning Two was, the vines formed an encirclement in the air.
Bang, bang, bang!
The steel blade wielded by Lightning Two sliced through the air, leaving silver arcs and a chilling sharpness where it passed.
Unexpectedly, Lu Chuan noticed that Lightning Two’s strike, enough to injure a second-tier Mutated Fierce Beast, had no effect on the vines.
The vines were far tougher than expected, not at all like typical vegetation. The machete chopping them emitted sounds of metal clashing against stone.
Lu Chuan’s pupils contracted. He didn’t expect these blood-colored plants to be so troublesome.
Damn it!
The remains of fierce beasts everywhere, could they all be the work of these blood-colored vines?!
How could these mutant plants be even harder to deal with than mutant beasts?!
Surrounded heavily by the blood-colored vines, Lightning Two’s space for movement shrank, leaving it to desperately swing the steel blade to resist the vines.
Yet all this seemed futile, the machete slashing the blood-colored vines felt like punching cotton, ineffective.
Damn it!
What the hell are these things?
Lu Chuan grew increasingly anxious. This was his first time encountering such a helpless situation.
The mutation extent of these plants exceeded imagination, unlike mutant beasts of flesh and blood.
Before encountering these blood-colored vines, Lu Chuan had never dealt with such mutant plants, and for a moment, couldn’t think of a solution.
Most importantly, he didn’t even know what they were.
The number of blood-colored vines was overwhelming, blocking Lightning Two’s retreat in all directions.
Although Lightning Two struggled desperately, the vines, both soft and resilient, quickly entangled its legs.
Movement was further restricted, and Lightning Two was completely engulfed by the blood-colored ocean.
The numerous vines furiously enveloped Lightning Two, forming a giant cocoon on the spot.
No matter how Lu Chuan controlled Lightning Two to struggle, it couldn’t move.
From Lightning Two’s perspective, there was only the sight of blood, oblivious to the nature of the blood-colored vines.
Lu Chuan, for the moment, could only control the other Corpse Puppets to retreat from the blood-colored vine forest.
...
Lu Chuan controlled Flame One from a distance, getting ready. The vines were extremely tough, even Lightning Two’s blade couldn’t cut through.
Currently, he could only rely on the third-tier Flame One, hoping the released Fireball could scorch them.
Only then did Lu Chuan suddenly realize that Lightning Two was still tightly bound by the vines.
The blood-colored vines only wrapped around it but made no further moves.
This eerie scene puzzled Lu Chuan, but since the vines were inactive, he remained hesitant to act rashly.
Thus, Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppet unit from afar, confronting the blood-colored vine forest.
Lightning Two had been with him for so long, and this agilely controlled Corpse Puppet was hard to give up until necessary.
Half an hour passed, and to Lu Chuan’s surprise, the vines enveloping Lightning Two inexplicably loosened.
The vines that crazily wrapped Lightning Two now actively released it.
Such bizarre behavior left Lu Chuan baffled.
A careful check revealed that Lightning Two sustained no injuries.
"So strange, do these mutant plants have issues?"
"Just now they desperately wrapped my puppet, and now they let it go without reason, what’s this about?"
Thud, thud, thud!
As Lu Chuan pondered, there was a sudden sound of hasty footsteps not far away.
He saw a massive mutated wild boar charging from the woods.
Before Lu Chuan could lead the Corpse Puppets to hunt the boar,
The vines that had just released Lightning Two dashed out quickly.
Then in front of Lu Chuan, the blood-colored vines reenacted the previous scene.
However, the boar’s power was inferior to Lightning Two, its dodging technique poor and speed slow.
It was soon entangled by a mass of blood-colored vines.
Lu Chuan noticed the blood-colored vines treated the wild boar differently from how they treated his puppet.
Roar, roar, roar!
The blood-colored vines had just wrapped the boar when Lu Chuan heard its miserable squeals from the vine cocoon.
The heartrending boar screams echoed through the valley, making one’s scalp tingle.
Lu Chuan noticed the vines kept tightening, some piercing into the boar’s body directly,
Then it seemed a devouring force was released, continuously draining the boar’s blood.
The robust boar shrank rapidly before Lu Chuan’s eyes.
Witnessing this, Lu Chuan shivered with fear.
Wait, could the blood-colored vines be drawn to flesh and blood, hence launching attacks?
If so, their inactivity after capturing Lightning Two made sense.
The blood-colored vines only attack creatures with flesh and blood.
Perhaps earlier, when Lightning Two fought other beasts, some beast blood stained it, attracting these blood-colored vines.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 177: Tenacious Vitality!
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 177: Tenacious Vitality!
However, this is merely his own speculation.
After pondering for a moment, to verify his guess, Lu Chuan dispatched another Corpse Puppet into the blood-colored vine forest for testing.
Sure enough, even though this time the Corpse Puppet was very close to the blood-colored vines.
But these blood-colored vines seemed unable to perceive the presence of the Corpse Puppet and didn’t react at all.
Seeing this, Lu Chuan nodded silently to himself, it indeed seemed to be as he suspected.
The blood-colored vines will only attack living creatures with flesh and blood.
For entities like zombies that are already dead, the blood-colored vines directly ignore them.
Then Lu Chuan focused his attention on the carcasses within the vine forest.
Upon entering the Yellow Dragon Mountain, he hadn’t encountered many mutated fierce beasts yet.
Now it seemed that the reason for this was likely because a large number of mutated fierce beasts had already been killed by the blood-colored vines.
The beast carcasses strewn about were the best evidence.
These blood-colored vines are incredibly tough; cutting them is not an easy task.
With their overwhelming numbers, it’s almost impossible for ordinary creatures to confront such mutant plants directly.
Seeing the beast carcasses tangled in the vines, Lu Chuan felt a stir in his mind.
The blood-colored vines drained all the flesh and blood from these beasts, but he noticed that their heads were intact.
This implies that the beast carcasses likely still contain Crystal Cores.
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan immediately manipulated a Corpse Puppet to enter the blood-colored vines.
Upon breaking open the skull of a large beast carcass, he found a Crystal Core in the back of its brain.
As the Corpse Puppet held the Crystal Core, not attracting any attention from the surrounding vines, Lu Chuan finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He then couldn’t help but chuckle inwardly.
Who would’ve thought that these vines are uninterested in Crystal Cores?
Could it be that they only devour the flesh and blood of living things?
Well, this certainly benefits him; initially, without encountering any mutated fierce beasts, he thought this trip would yield little, but now he could easily collect them.
Since Corpse Puppets are not attacked by the blood-colored vines, Lu Chuan continued to gather Crystal Cores from the carcasses.
This expedition proved fruitful for Lu Chuan, collecting a sizable quantity of Crystal Cores effortlessly.
Although some carcasses were not mutated fierce beasts but ordinary animals without Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan was still pleased.
After searching through the carcasses in the area, Lu Chuan acquired over a dozen first-tier Crystal Cores and even discovered two second-tier ones.
His earlier frustration at not encountering mutated fierce beasts dissipated completely.
Taking advantage of the zombie’s unique traits, Lu Chuan profited greatly, and he felt elated.
Once he finished gathering the Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan began to observe the vine forest before him seriously.
These blood-colored vines are extraordinarily thick, far beyond any vines he had seen before the apocalypse, resembling blood-colored tentacles.
Close inspection reveals the vines’ surface is covered with thick blood vessels, resembling those of organisms.
A careful observation even feels like fresh blood is flowing along the surface of the vines.
Despite witnessing various strange phenomena since the apocalypse, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but marvel at the blood-colored vines before him.
This world is getting more bizarre, even plants that once seemed ordinary could turn into terrifying bloodsucking monsters.
If not for him manipulating the already dead zombies, today might have resulted in significant losses.
Looking at the blood-colored vines before him, Lu Chuan felt an overwhelming shock akin to survivors seeing zombies driving cars.
