Simultaneously, Lu Chuan was filled with curiosity, wondering what else the blood-colored vines could transform into after consuming blood and flesh.
In the apocalypse, even plants mutate, making this world increasingly lively.
A moment later, Lu Chuan manipulated Lightning Two, carrying a large pile of Crystal Cores, quickly leaving the blood-colored vine area.
Watching the peculiar vegetation before him, Lu Chuan couldn’t resist his curiosity and manipulated Lightning One towards the nearest vines.
Keeping a safe distance from the vines, Lightning One began slicing through them.
Normally, with the power of a second-tier zombie, there’s little that could withstand the horizontal slash of the knife.
But the blood-colored vines before him were entirely different, not anything like normal plants that could be easily severed.
Though appearing to be made of concentrated blood vessels, they had immensely strong defenses.
It felt like cutting through tightly wound nylon ropes, incredibly resilient; even with significant force, only small slices could be achieved.
Lu Chuan carefully continued cutting while remaining vigilant of the blood-colored vines.
Though certain that the vines wouldn’t attack dead entities.
No one could be sure if the vines would suddenly go berserk if attacked during cutting.
Fortunately, the situation Lu Chuan feared did not occur; after persistent cutting by Lightning Two, he finally acquired a sample.
This Bloodthirsty Vine is truly mysterious, extremely tough and capable of bloodletting attacks; Lu Chuan planned to study it closely later.
He wanted to see the modifications these plants underwent in this world.
Although no intense battles with mutated beasts occurred today, this experience left a deep impression on Lu Chuan.
It seems that after the Blood Moon Mutation, the world underwent significant changes.
Much stranger than he ever imagined.
He realized that he couldn’t rely on common sense in this world anymore.
...
In the evening, Lu Chuan’s convoy returned fully loaded.
However, as the Lightning One in the front held a small piece of blood-colored vine, it seemed to sense the mutated beast’s carcass in the truck and began writhing.
Lu Chuan was shocked, as this Bloodthirsty Vine had been severed for quite some time.
There hadn’t been any change before, but now it was suddenly writhing wildly.
Watching the vine writhing constantly in his hand, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but exclaim in amazement.
"This mutated Bloodthirsty Vine surely has formidable vitality!"

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 178: Blood Crystal! Ji Ruxue’s Excitement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 178: Blood Crystal! Ji Ruxue’s Excitement!
Inside Qingshui Farm.
After coming ashore, the Mutated Giant Turtle was constantly used as a mount by Ji Ruxue, leisurely wandering around the farm.
This big guy might be large, but when it runs, it’s not slow at all.
Perhaps it was too boring.
Ji Ruxue seemed to really enjoy the feeling of riding a mount around everywhere.
She had a great time playing with this Mutated Giant Turtle on the farm.
"Little Qiqi, how on earth did you manage to do it? To make this Mutated Giant Turtle so obedient?!"
Watching Ji Ruxue riding on the giant turtle, Zhao Lin was full of curiosity.
At this moment, she had already accepted that the so-called Little Turtle was such a colossal creature.
It’s just that seeing such a huge turtle with Little Qiqi seems somewhat incongruous.
It was indeed unbelievable for her to see such a small creature taming a Mutated Giant Beast so submissively.
So far, Zhao Lin had not yet fought with such a Mutant Beast.
But she also knew that this world was no longer dominated by humans.
First, the Corpse King hunted so many giant beasts, and now seeing Little Qiqi riding this Mutated Giant Turtle.
It was enough to show that many massive beasts had emerged in this post-apocalyptic world.
These giant beasts were completely different from the beasts she used to know.
Frowning deeply, Zhao Lin felt a trace of deep worry in her heart.
Apparently, after that Blood Moon, not only did humans and zombies mutate, awakening Talent Abilities or evolving physically.
Even these originally ordinary animals did so, growing so large that it profoundly defied normal biological categories.
With the massive change in the world environment, human survival had also become more difficult.
In this post-apocalyptic world, humans would have to face not only a large number of zombies but also now be wary of these colossal Mutated Fierce Beasts.
Survival itself in the post-apocalyptic world had already been extremely harsh.
But now, with time passing, the space for human survival was likely to shrink further.
The cost of survival would also become higher.
Hearing Zhao Lin’s doubts, Ji Ruxue shrugged, casually saying, "It’s very simple, just feed it meat, just like humans feed dogs."
Zhao Lin’s mouth twitched slightly at this plain answer.
But in this post-apocalyptic world, humans were grateful just to have something to eat.
As for meat, that was something they didn’t dare to hope for.
To this day, Zhao Lin still remembered the survivors at the police station who wouldn’t hesitate to harm their companions for a bit of food.
Only Little Qiqi could afford such luxury.
Having more meat than she could eat herself, she could afford to feed it to the turtle.
Vroom vroom vroom!
Along with the rumbling of a truck engine, the convoy Lu Chuan sent to Yellow Dragon Town finally returned to the farm.
"Little Turtle, I’m going to take you to eat meat."
Hearing the commotion of the convoy, Ji Ruxue rode the Mutated Old Turtle towards its direction.
The Mutated Turtle was quite intelligent too, seeming to know there was meat to eat, running faster than before this time.
At this moment, Lu Chuan also arrived beside the convoy, taking the Bloodthirsty Vine from Lightning One’s hands.
Looking at this small piece of plant sample, Lu Chuan was still in disbelief and amazement.
He couldn’t believe such a peculiar plant could grow in this world.
If he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, it would be hard to believe this was a product from the same planet as humans.
Observing this small section of Blood-colored Vines up close, it really did look like a tendril with veins.
Even though it had been separated from its body for a long time, this Bloodthirsty Vine was still trembling slightly, seemingly not completely dead, eager to continue devouring the blood and flesh of fierce beasts.
This astonishing vitality greatly surprised Lu Chuan.
Riding her turtle over, Ji Ruxue was also captivated by the Bloodthirsty Vine in Lu Chuan’s hand.
The next moment, as if recognizing this plant, her eyes widened, filled with shock.
This... Could it be the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine?!
How did Dad manage to get such a thing?!
In Ji Ruxue’s memory.
The Bloodthirsty Demon Vine was known post-apocalypse as a fierce, blood and flesh-devouring sinister plant among mutated plants.
Any creature with flesh and blood appearing near these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines.
The demon vine would instantly launch an attack, absorbing all the flesh and blood cleanly.
But that’s not the crucial part.
What Ji Ruxue cared about the most was that once this plant matured, it would start forming ’Blood Crystals’!
’Blood Crystals’ were a rare treasure in the past life, having tremendously beneficial effects on refining a martial artist’s body.
Although the name ’Bloodthirsty Demon Vine’ sounds terrifying, it was a mutant plant that can be subdued by humans.
Ji Ruxue naturally knew how to subdue it.
By feeding it her Essence Blood and utilizing the Blood Refining Technique, she could control it effortlessly.
Once subdued, it could be manipulated for attack or defense.
Or to perform other useful actions according to one’s will.
The body of the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine was extremely tough, making it a rare mutant plant, both offensive and defensive.
Additionally, it was a colony plant that did not live alone.
After all, this plant relied on its numbers advantage in its early stages.
Now that Dad had such a small piece of the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine, it meant there was a Bloodthirsty Demon Vine Forest near the Qingshui Farm!
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue was extremely excited.
This was indeed a monumental piece of good news.
In her past life, so many strong individuals sought this Bloodthirsty Demon Vine, but it was a rarity.
It seemed when she became stronger in the future, she could look for the whereabouts of that Bloodthirsty Demon Vine.
By refining it with Essence Blood, she could gain a mighty ally for both attacking and defending, as well as restraining opponents’ movements!
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but curl up in a smile.
She realized that since her rebirth, her luck seemed to have improved significantly.
The opportunities she encountered were indeed much better than in her past life.
As long as she stayed by her father’s side, it seemed that good fortune would continually come her way.
Seeing Little Qiqi coming over, Lu Chuan hurriedly handed over the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine to Lightning One.
Even though this Bloodthirsty Demon Vine had been cut off, the blood-colored tendril was still incessantly writhing.
Clearly, the strong vitality hadn’t completely faded.
Being a zombie himself, it didn’t matter to him, as he was immune to the vines.
But the little one was different; she was a living human, exactly the target this blood-colored vine wanted to devour.
Coming forward with a smile, Ji Ruxue said, "Dad, do you have something delicious to feed Little Turtle? I want it to grow bigger as quickly as possible."
During this period, Lu Chuan carefully observed and found that this old turtle truly obeyed Ji Ruxue’s words without complaint.
Thus, he no longer hesitated.
He directly controlled Corpse Puppets to unload a Fierce Beast carcass from the truck for the Mutated Turtle to feast on.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 179: Truly Achieving Mass Production of Evolved Zombies!
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 179: Truly Achieving Mass Production of Evolved Zombies!
Inside the farm, Lu Chuan manipulated the Corpse Puppets to dissect and process the collected bodies of the Mutated Giant Beasts as usual.
Numerous Corpse Puppets followed Lu Chuan’s commands and carried out their tasks.
Lu Chuan, however, was intrigued by the constantly writhing Blood-colored Vines.
He carefully placed this small section of Blood-colored Vine that had been cut down in front of him to observe.
The veins on this Blood-colored Vine, upon close inspection, resembled the blood vessels in the human body.
If he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes at Yellow Dragon Mountain, Lu Chuan would have suspected it was an organ that fell off an animal.
He had cut down this small section earlier at Yellow Dragon Mountain.
A considerable amount of time had passed since then.
Yet to his surprise, this small section of vine was still able to maintain a certain level of activity.
Although it twisted significantly less than before, it clearly still possessed some vitality.
"Isn’t this vitality just too exuberant?"
Looking at the endlessly writhing Blood-colored Vine, Lu Chuan had new ideas brewing in his mind.
Holding the Blood-colored Vine, Lu Chuan headed to the open space on the farm’s outskirts.
Instead of burning the vine, he decided to plant it directly along the farm’s perimeter.
Concerned that he might have already killed the vine’s viability.
Lu Chuan had a Corpse Puppet fetch a bucket of fresh Mutated Fierce Beast blood to pour onto the soil.
Having seen first-hand at Yellow Dragon Mountain how these vines went nearly berserk at the sight of flesh and blood.
The wild boar’s body was devoured in no time.
Presumably, fresh flesh and blood held significant attraction for these vines.
The beast blood poured on the ground could both nourish the land and allow the small section of Blood-colored Vine to absorb it.
Lu Chuan was merely trying his luck, unsure if it would actually grow.
If he could successfully grow it, he might consider transplanting some Blood-colored Vines from Yellow Dragon Mountain.
A solitary Blood-colored Vine might not be powerful enough.
However, if they grew extensively, the resulting force could be extremely astonishing.
Lu Chuan had witnessed the formidable power of the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest at Yellow Dragon Mountain with his own eyes.
Thankfully, in the depths of Yellow Dragon Mountain, he led a team of lifeless Corpse Puppets.
If it had been any other species, escaping the Blood-colored Vine Forest’s attack might have been questionable.
Once this vegetation began to multiply, the overwhelming expanse of Blood-colored Vines would fill anyone with despair.
However, Lu Chuan believed that if he managed to cultivate these Blood-colored Vines, the farm would gain a powerful defensive wall!
It would basically add an extra layer of insurance for the farm.
If any enemies wished to attack his farm, they would first have to get through these Bloodthirsty Vines.
Based on the previous encounter with Blood-colored Vines, ordinary creatures probably wouldn’t last long.
Since the ones he controlled were already deceased Corpse Puppets, they were not within the attack range of these Blood-colored Vines.
If he could form a Blood-colored wall outside the farm, Qingshui Farm’s defense would reach another level.
...
The sports stadium in Jiangnan City District.
Despite being a relatively spacious venue, the stadium was still crowded with a vast number of zombies.
Roar... Roar... Roar!
The continuous roars of zombies echoed inside the stadium. Anyone passing by would get goosebumps hearing the chaotic noises within.
Peering through the stadium’s windows, one could see that the vast stadium space was entirely filled with zombies.
Creak～
The only door that could be opened in the stadium slowly started to open.
As the sound of the door opening rang out, countless zombies immediately swarmed towards it, desperately trying to escape through the exit.
The zombies inside the stadium were too crowded, and even after extensive fighting, a large number of zombies remained inside.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
However, just as these zombies rushed to the entrance, they were instantly sent flying back, as if hit by a cannonball.
A gigantic figure stood at the door, it was Lu Chuan’s Tyrant One.
Its powerful aura made the zombies at the entrance tremble, as Tyrant One, with its violent temper and intense aggressive nature, had no compassion.
With a casual kick, it sent any zombies trying to flee out flying, throwing them all back into the stadium.
To ensure the continuous emergence of Evolved Zombies inside the stadium, Lu Chuan had thrown in a large number of zombies earlier.
Now that all these zombies squeezed towards the entrance, Tyrant Zombie’s immense strength sent the ordinary zombies beside it sprawling back into the stadium.
In the next moment, the powerful aura of Tyrant Zombie was unleashed.
As a second-tier Evolved Zombie, its overwhelming pressure instantly froze the ordinary zombies, making them shiver uncontrollably.
Under this potent hierarchy suppression, the horde of zombies at the entrance shuddered one by one and moved deeper into the stadium.
Once they were all driven away from the entrance, only then did Lu Chuan manipulate other Corpse Puppets to push carts loaded with Mutated Fierce Beast meat to this location.
Tyrant One continued to throw this meat into the stadium, where the ravenous zombies immediately scrambled for it.
The fresh meat had a deadly allure to the zombies.
Moreover, the meat of the Mutated Fierce Beast could somewhat accelerate the zombies’ evolution, implementing the zombie cultivation plan more successfully.
Through Tyrant One’s perspective, Lu Chuan could clearly observe.
Amid the tide of zombies, several larger and noticeably much stronger zombies emerged.
These stronger zombies seized more meat, evidently having undergone evolution.
A brief sweep of his gaze revealed several Evolved Zombies within the horde.
"Apparently, this method really works! In just two short days, a few more Evolved Zombies have emerged!"
Lu Chuan was filled with joy, as the zombie cultivation was advancing more successfully than he had anticipated.
At this rate of efficiency, in half a month, the stadium might cultivate over a hundred Evolved Zombies!
Producing so many Evolved Zombies at once could practically qualify as an Evolved Zombie factory!
PS: The Mutated Beast Meat simply acts as a catalyst for evolution; these ordinary zombies have been continuously absorbing energy factors after the night of the Blood Moon, not solely relying on the Mutated Beast Meat to evolve.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 180: Tyrant No. 1 Advances! Terrifying Destructive Power!
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 180: Tyrant No. 1 Advances! Terrifying Destructive Power!
In a flash, three days had passed.
During these three days, Lu Chuan repeated the same tasks every day.
He hunted mutated fierce beasts and then controlled his Corpse Puppet to process and carve up the flesh of these beasts.
Due to the high number of beasts he hunted, Lu Chuan collected a substantial amount of their blood.
Currently, the fruit orchards and vegetable patches at the farm are enriched with the blood of these mutated beasts, resulting in thriving crops growing on them.
Seeing the situation on the farm, Lu Chuan felt very satisfied.
The blood of these mutated beasts is more effective than fertilizers, working quickly without any side effects.
The key point is that fertilizers would need to be collected manually, whereas the blood of these mutated beasts can be obtained in large quantities by hunting them.
At the same time, Lu Chuan also dispatched a convoy of Corpse Puppets to deliver a portion of the flesh to the city.
Now, Lu Chuan was not only feeding Little Qiqi but also a massive number of zombies waiting for food in the stadium.
The evolved zombie cultivation plan in the stadium was going perfectly, as the flesh and blood of these mutated beasts could accelerate zombie evolution to a certain extent.
Meanwhile, for food competition, these evolved zombies inside would further kill each other, engaging in devouring evolution.
This kind of positive cycle was exactly what Lu Chuan wanted to see.
However, in this process, the consumption of mutated fierce beasts was quite rapid.
Fortunately, with Lu Chuan’s current strength, hunting ordinary mutated fierce beasts was still manageable.
After dealing with other matters, Lu Chuan, as usual, came to inspect the farm.
In the area where he had previously planted Blood-colored Vines, Lu Chuan found that these vines had already sprouted.
"I originally just wanted to try, but surprisingly it succeeded. This thing’s vitality is too tenacious!"
Looking at the Bloodthirsty Vines that were continuously sprouting and starting further growth.
Lu Chuan was quite amazed; he hadn’t expected the vitality of this thing to be stronger than he imagined.
Initially, he planted them outside the farm just with a trial attitude.
Unexpectedly, it succeeded with such ease.
But Lu Chuan got the results he wanted.
Since this thing is so tenacious that it survived even when brought back from Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Then he could rest assured to continually transplant these Bloodthirsty Vines around the farm.
As the post-apocalyptic timeline progressed, Lu Chuan also wanted to constantly enhance the defenses of Qingshui Farm.
However, given the current situation at the farm, raising the defenses further within a short time would be quite difficult.
Nevertheless, the appearance of these Blood-colored Vines gave Lu Chuan new ideas.
He recollected scenes in movies and games from his previous life about city fortress defenses.
Constructing a moat around the city, leaving just one road leading to the city, and raising the bridge over the moat during an attack to intercept opponents to some extent.
This was also a strategy to enhance the defenses of Qingshui Farm, but digging a trench and channeling large amounts of river water with his own strength was unrealistic.
However, although he couldn’t create a real moat, he could use these Blood-colored Vines to form a red moat.
And these vines, with their strong offensive and defensive capabilities, were much more useful than an ordinary moat.
Although he and the Corpse Puppets were not concerned with the Blood-colored Vines, considering Little Qiqi’s safety, Lu Chuan decided to place these Bloodthirsty Vines kilometers away from the farm.
The scene of the vast landscape of vines devouring wild boars entirely was something Lu Chuan couldn’t forget.
Although they wouldn’t attack him or the Corpse Puppets, the Blood-colored Vines showed no mercy when devouring living creatures.
This plant had a keen sense of biological flesh, and critically, it could continually extend its attack range.
Planting the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines was to reinforce Qingshui Farm’s defenses, but letting them harm Little Qiqi would be counterproductive.
Having made the decision, Lu Chuan immediately set about implementing it.
He dispatched a squad of Corpse Puppets to transplant the Blood-colored Vines while going to Yellow Dragon Mountain to hunt mutated fierce beasts.
Since the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine’s vitality is robust enough, Lu Chuan didn’t have to worry about the plants dying along the way.
At the same time, Lu Chuan took a look at the Crystal Cores he accumulated during this time and discovered he now had four second-grade Crystal Cores!
It was enough to evolve another second-grade Corpse Puppet to third-grade.
The combat power increase from a zombie evolving from second-grade to third-grade was significant.
However, looking at his numerous Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan hesitated for a moment, unsure of whom to promote first.
Based on the current situation, both Tank type and Flame Zombie already had third-grade ones, so they could be directly excluded this time.
This left only the Agile type, Tyrant, and the single Earth Escape Zombie.
After some contemplation, Lu Chuan decided to elevate the Tyrant to third-grade first.
Among the evolved zombies under his control, the Tyrant excelled in both offense and defense.
In battles between the Corpse Puppet squad and mutated fierce beasts, the Tyrant usually assumed the role of front-line combatant.
Lu Chuan still recalled the overwhelming pressure the Tyrant exerted the first time he encountered it, stronger than ordinary evolved zombies.
He called the Tyrant One to his side and let it swallow the second-grade Crystal Cores sequentially.
As soon as those Crystal Cores went down, terrifying energy erupted inside Tyrant One.
Lu Chuan could clearly feel that after devouring the Crystal Cores, Tyrant One seemed to radiate a more violent aura!
This massive creature, with hands like sharp claws, grew even larger after breaking through to third-grade.
Its muscles became extraordinarily terrifying, with bulges suggesting endless power.
Moreover, Lu Chuan noted, with the breakthrough, Tyrant One’s claws now bore a metallic sheen, casting a chilling gleam under the sunlight!
Looking at the colossal, formidable Tyrant One before him, Lu Chuan was dumbfounded.
He immediately controlled Tyrant One to the farm’s waste material pile site.
Bang!
The monstrous muscles of the third-grade Tyrant One propelled its entire body like a missile upon forcefully stepping forward, leaving cracks on the ground underneath.
This immense physical strength and speed were incredibly astonishing.
At the same time, the claw with metal shine swung, slicing through the piled metallic debris nearby in an instant.
Seeing those neat cuts, Lu Chuan’s pupils involuntarily contracted.
This third-grade Tyrant One was like a humanoid combat weapon!

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 181: Jianghai Survivor Base
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 181: Jianghai Survivor Base
After Tyrant One advanced to the third tier, its formidable combat strength left Lu Chuan pleasantly surprised.
Among the zombies I currently control, in terms of sheer close-quarters combat ability, Tyrant One is probably the strongest.
Of course, Er Pang happened to find a metal staff weighing over a ton due to a stroke of luck.
With the enhancement of this powerful weapon, Er Pang’s combat effectiveness also surpasses that of a normal third-tier zombie.
The most critical factor is that due to Er Pang’s huge size and having a weapon in hand, it has been stationed at the gate of Qingshui Farm, taking on both offense and defense.
Looking at the third-tier Tyrant One’s claws, gleaming with a cold glint, Lu Chuan nodded his head in satisfaction.
Coincidentally, I am planning to transplant those blood-red vines from Yellow Dragon Mountain to the outskirts of the farm. Last time, Lightning Two spent half a day trying to cut those vines with a steel knife.
Now, this Tyrant One can be put to good use; Lu Chuan doesn’t believe those powerful claws won’t be able to slice through the vines.
Lu Chuan immediately commanded Tyrant One to lead the Corpse Puppet team. While hunting Fierce Beasts on Yellow Dragon Mountain, they also cut a large number of Bloodthirsty Demon Vines to bring back to the farm.
A large number of Corpse Puppets arrived a kilometer outside the farm’s perimeter, continually planting the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines brought back from Yellow Dragon Mountain.
In order for these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines to grow quickly, Lu Chuan even took care to water them with a large quantity of fresh blood from Fierce Beasts, which both nourished the soil and allowed the vines to absorb the blood to accelerate their growth.
In this way, through Lu Chuan’s continuous efforts, a scarlet defensive line started slowly forming a kilometer away from Qingshui Farm.
...
Li Yang Lake, originally a reservoir at the upstream of the river in Jianghai City.
Before the apocalypse, this was a key nature reserve in Jianghai City, and after simple treatment, the lake water could meet drinking needs.
Before the apocalypse, the area around Li Yang Lake was primarily within the focus protection area of Jianghai City’s forestry bureau.
But now, with the outbreak of the apocalypse, what was once a quiet and peaceful Li Yang Lake is now bustling with noise.
Not only have many humans appeared around it, but quite a few temporary structures have also been built here.
Because while Li Yang Lake is far from Jianghai City’s urban area, several highways nearby make access very convenient.
Most crucially, Li Yang Lake is flanked by mountains and water, with vast areas of green hills surrounding it, which can serve as a barrier against zombies.
Moreover, for the post-apocalyptic era, the large lake is also an extremely important resource.
Additionally, the area around the original Li Yang Lake was a reserve with few people, so there was no zombie presence after the apocalypse.
Due to these geographical advantages, after the apocalypse broke out, Jianghai City’s leadership immediately chose Li Yang Lake as the base location for survivors.
After more than half a year of development, this survivor base has begun to take shape.
The perimeter of the survivor base has, over this period, been reinforced with a simple modern city wall.
They are mostly pieced together with metal containers and reinforced concrete, mainly used to defend against zombies and set up sentry posts.
And for survivors in the apocalypse, only these towering walls can provide them with some psychological comfort.
The benefit of being far from the urban area is a reduced risk of zombie harassment, yet the downside is also apparent, which is a severe scarcity of resources in the survivor base.
Currently, the Jianghai Survivor Base can only dispatch Evolution Teams to various places to rescue survivors as much as possible.
As for the idea of taking back the city, that is practically a fantasy.
Moreover, due to resource shortages, the entire survivor base is basically divided into two areas.
Even in such a resource-scarce situation, the survivor base still expended a large number of building materials to construct another high wall in the middle of the city.
The high wall’s exterior is the area where ordinary survivors reside, whereas the interior is where Evolvers and their families, and the survivor base’s high-ranking officials, live.
The condition in the base’s outer city is extremely dire.
Ordinary survivors live on the outer periphery of the survivor base, where it’s relatively more dangerous, and the living conditions are even worse.
Survivors either stay in simple tents or hastily built temporary shacks made of wood or scrap metal.
It’s just a simple shelter, barely holding up against heavy wind and rain.
And since the survivor base was temporarily constructed outdoors, gathering a large number of survivors, there was no so-called urban planning at all.
The outer streets are muddy, with various excrements mixed within the mud, making the smell at the base’s perimeter very unpleasant.
Due to the lack of resources, many survivors cling onto their moldy and spoiled food, unwilling to discard it.
As a result, the outer area of the base is filled with the smell of urine and rotting food.
This place reeks and is filthy, resembling more of a landfill than a survivor base.
The ordinary residents living here are all disheveled, and their clothes hadn’t been washed for a long time.
Water is an extremely precious resource in the apocalypse — having a sip to drink sometimes is good enough, leaving no opportunity to wash up.
Because of food shortages, the ordinary people in the survivor base’s outer fringes are all emaciated, their hair dry and yellowed.
As for obtaining food, the method is quite simple, which is to work for the survivor base.
These ordinary survivors can strengthen the outer defenses, build structures, or plant food, among other assorted tasks, to earn Contribution Points.
However, the Contribution Points that ordinary survivors can exchange are very limited, barely meeting daily food needs.
Still, even so, the so-called food is just some rice porridge, which only suffices to keep a person from starvation.
Outside the high wall are the shanties where these ordinary people reside, while inside the inner city are independent prefabricated houses.
Compared to the filth of the outer city, the streets of the inner city are relatively cleaner.
But what’s more ironic is that the task of tidying up the inner city is handled by the common people living outside.
In this run-down apocalypse, prefabricated houses are considered decent living conditions, at least providing shelter against the elements.
Only Evolvers and their families are allowed to live here, while ordinary people have no right to enter the inner city unless working there.
At the core of the survivor base’s inner city is a temporary office building.
Currently, the leadership of the Jianghai Survivor Base has gathered in a conference room, and the atmosphere is somewhat serious.
"Gentlemen, today Imperial Capital issued a warning; the situation is very severe, and everyone needs to take it seriously."
"The Imperial Capital has experienced a small-scale Corpse Tide. Survival bases in various provinces must be alert and preemptive against Corpse Tide assaults."
PS: Four Chapters have been released today, asking for some monthly tickets, asking for support!

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 182: Corpse Tide in the Imperial Capital! The Corpse King Emerges!
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 182: Corpse Tide in the Imperial Capital! The Corpse King Emerges!
At this moment in the conference room, a video was being played.
The scene in the video made all the high-ranking officials present feel chills down their spines.
On the large screen, an endless mass of zombies was seen moving in one direction, as if they had a target.
From time to time, these zombies let out roars, looking like a black mass of ants from the sky.
The abandoned vehicles along the way were all overturned by these zombies.
Within this massive horde, there were many Evolved Zombies with enhanced physiques.
In everyone’s understanding, zombies were a bunch of mindless bloodthirsty monsters.
There was no contact among zombies, and it was impossible for them to initiate large-scale migrations like humans or other creatures.
Most of the zombies survivors encountered were just wandering the streets.
They would only suddenly charge madly towards a region when they discovered prey.
Usually, zombie movements were aimless, without any crowd-following traits.
But the scene presented in the video playing in the conference hall was completely different from what everyone understood before.
"Everyone must have seen it, this is what the Imperial Capital captured through drone footage."
"For some unknown reason, those bloodthirsty zombies have all gathered together."
"At first, no one paid attention to it, but unknowingly this small group of zombies grew larger and larger, forming the massive Corpse Tide we see now!"
A middle-aged man in military uniform, sitting beside the screen, spoke with a gloomy expression.
"What on earth is going on? How can a group of brainless zombies display such strong cohesion?"
Currently, humanity had survived the early days of doomsday and was slowly adapting to the zombie crisis, starting to establish Survivor Bases in various places.
Everywhere was gradually developing its own strength, preparing to rebuild life after the apocalypse.
But this huge Corpse Tide before them was beyond everyone’s imagination.
The faces of the high-ranking officials from the Jianghai City Survivor Base were exceedingly grim.
There was no doubt that in the face of this horrific Corpse Tide, the existing Jianghai City Survivor Base was no match.
"Has the Imperial Capital found out what’s going on? Is there any way to deal with it?"
Everyone looked hopefully towards the middle-aged man; the atmosphere in the conference hall was extremely heavy due to the massive Corpse Tide.
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man took a deep breath and then said heavily, "The Imperial Capital has revealed that it’s very likely there’s a high-level zombie commanding the Corpse Tide..."
As soon as the words fell, the conference hall became deathly silent, no one could believe their ears.
"What did you say?! There’s a zombie commanding these Corpse Tides?!"
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible! They’re just a bunch of brainless monsters, aren’t they?!"
"This Corpse Tide is a black mass, stretching endlessly with unknown numbers, how could they be intentionally gathered together?!"
Facing the news from the Imperial Capital, the high-ranking officials of the Jianghai City Survivor Base were in utter shock, unwilling to believe such statements, or perhaps they simply dared not believe the news.
Since the outbreak of the doomsday crisis, humanity on the entire planet had dwindled to less than ten percent of its original number.
Factories halted, politics collapsed, society was chaotically disordered with surviving as a primary concern.
Yet humans still hadn’t given up hope.
Survivor Bases were constantly being established in different places, working together to survive the crisis and restore order and life as it once was.
And this was on the premise that humans knew these zombies were nothing more than mindless entities.
Even though zombies were tremendously powerful and posed a deadly threat, the gap in intelligence gave humans confidence that they could reclaim the world over time.
However, the news disclosed by the Imperial Capital now was undoubtedly a heavy blow that shattered everyone’s confidence. If zombies were intelligent, where would humanity head to?!
The many high-ranking officials in the conference room fell silent, some puzzled, others shocked, and some with self-mockery on their faces.
One elderly man took off his glasses, rubbed his brow, and sneered, "In my opinion, if what the Imperial Capital said is true, there’s no need for us to establish Survivor Bases."
"The reason we are alive today is because these zombies are mindless and lack any discipline, allowing us to barely survive in a world full of zombies."
"Now that the Imperial Capital says there’s a high-level zombie commanding the Corpse Tide, does that mean these zombies already have intelligence?"
The person next to him also voiced doubts, "I still can’t understand how these zombies, just a bunch of dead bodies, could possibly evolve intelligence?"
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man shook his head with a cold smile, "Haven’t we encountered enough bizarre things in the apocalypse?"
"The corpses you call long dead can stand up and attack humans, so why couldn’t they evolve intelligence?"
For a moment, everyone in the conference room fell silent, a heavy gloom shrouded over everyone’s heart.
If zombies awaken intelligence, the current human advantage will no longer exist.
"I know this result is hard to accept, and everyone feels helpless, but we have no choice but to accept this fact."
The middle-aged man stood up, a look of authority flashed in his eyes as he surveyed the people before him.
"All of you here are the top leaders of the base, we must accept the fact that these bloodthirsty zombies are constantly evolving, otherwise there’s only the path to death!"
Hearing this, everyone present sighed helplessly and then nodded one after another.
"Since the Imperial Capital has investigated these Corpse Tides, have they given any instructions? Have they clearly identified the type of zombie capable of commanding zombies and organizing a Corpse Tide?"
The middle-aged man nodded, "According to information from the Imperial Capital, this is a type of Evolved Zombie that has never appeared before."
"It possesses intelligence not found in other zombies and has the ability to control lower-level zombies.
"So far, this type of zombie is extremely cautious and uses the Corpse Tide to protect itself; it will not appear in frontal battles."
"The Imperial Capital has named this type of zombie... the Corpse King!"
Hiss~
Everyone drew a sharp breath upon hearing it, sensing the terror merely from the name.
"The name ’Corpse King’ is indeed imposing, it seems the Imperial Capital attaches great importance to this type of zombie."
"Everyone listen, the threat posed by this type of zombie far exceeds other zombies."
"We must disseminate information about the Corpse King as soon as possible; if any Evolutionary Squad encounters an Evolved Zombie suspected to be the Corpse King, it must be reported immediately!"

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 183: First Encounter with Tier 3 Mutated Fierce Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 183: First Encounter with Tier 3 Mutated Fierce Beast
The entire Yellow Dragon Mountain looked extremely oppressive on this rainy day, the sky shrouded by dense black clouds that cast an ominous shadow.
The post-apocalyptic environment seemed to have been affected to some extent, as the torrential rain turned the mountain paths extremely rugged and muddy.
Fortunately, all those controlled by Lu Chuan were Evolved Zombies, whose strong physical qualities allowed them to traverse the rugged mountain paths with ease.
This time, Lu Chuan wasted no time, skillfully guiding the Corpse Puppet army through the pouring rain to reach the back mountain.
After bypassing the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine Forest, the Corpse Puppets continued their march deep into Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Perhaps due to the heavy rain, these Mutated Fierce Beasts were reluctant to come out to hunt, and the Corpse Puppet army did not encounter any particularly strong beastly auras for a while.
Roar!
At that moment, through the perspective of the Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan sensed an angry roar coming from the forest not far away.
The sound carried a strong, violent aura, and soon the surrounding ground began to tremble constantly, with ripples spreading across the puddles on the ground.
Clearly, a giant beast was rapidly approaching.
Sensing the powerful aura of a Mutated Fierce Beast, Lu Chuan was not the least bit afraid, but instead brimming with excitement.
"Great, I thought the rain would make today’s trip fruitless, but it seems a Fierce Beast can’t hold back anymore."
"I’ve even brought Er Pang, who guards the farm gates, this time. Even if it’s a third-tier beast, it’s going to meet its end!"
This time, Lu Chuan was well-prepared: Er Pang, the third-tier Tyrant One, and Flame One were all part of the group.
Even though the beastly aura from the forest was strong, snapping trees along its path, Lu Chuan felt no fear before the giant beast.
Er Pang stood at the front, holding a metal staff weighing over a ton, his massive body resembling a Gate God, with all other Corpse Puppets shielded behind him.
Roar!
Finally, the terrifying giant beast burst out from the woods—it was a second-tier Mutated Black Bear.
Seeing this black bear, Lu Chuan was astonished.
The enormous beast stood nearly five meters tall, even larger than the third-tier Er Pang by a significant margin.
Its entire muscular frame was incredibly robust, and its massive paws seemed as intimidating as car doors.
Trees over a meter thick could be snapped with a single swipe of its paw.
"Wow, it seems the strength of these Mutated Fierce Beasts is related to their original form. Those already at the top of the food chain have become unbelievably powerful after mutation!"
Nevertheless, Lu Chuan was not the least bit afraid.
The blood-red eyes of this Mutated Giant Bear were filled with viciousness, showing no fear even when sensing the aura of numerous Evolved Zombies, and swung its massive paws directly at the Corpse Puppets.
Its terrifying speed was completely unhindered by its size, closing the dozens of meters distance to the Corpse Puppets in just a blink of an eye.
Bang!
Er Pang lifted his long staff to directly block the attack of the Mutated Giant Bear; as a third-tier Tank Type zombie, his evolved strength faced the massive bear without flinching.
The Tyrant Zombie, possessed of a strong desire for combat, exuded a powerful aura, charging at the Mutated Giant Bear like a humanoid weapon, akin to a cannonball.
Although smaller compared to the nearly six-meter-tall bear, its terrifying claws shimmered with a cold, sharp light.
The razor-sharp claws with a metallic sheen instantly tore through the fur of the Mutated Giant Bear, leaving two giant gashes on its abdomen.
The bear’s blood gushed out like a fountain, staining the surrounding ground red.
In pain, the Mutated Giant Bear retreated several steps, its gaze filled with doubt and shock at the zombies before it.
Having never fought a third-tier zombie before, it never expected these smaller beings could unleash such formidable combat power!
Roar, roar, roar!
Enraged, the bear pounded its chest, emitting a powerful force as it charged at the Corpse Puppets like a speeding heavy truck.
Bang!
The third-tier Er Pang held his ground against the charging Mutated Giant Bear, directly halting its massive body.
The Tyrant Zombie leapt from the ground like a missile, descending from the sky.
Its terrifying claws were about to end the bear’s life, but the Mutated Giant Beast, showing immense resilience, rolled away a few meters to avoid the Tyrant Zombie’s fatal blow.
Boom!
After gathering energy, Flame One launched a huge fireball at that moment.
The massive fireballs hammered onto the Mutated Giant Bear with relentless force.
The scorching flames made the bear let out painful howls, and the raging fire threw it into chaos.
The Tyrant Zombie seized the opportunity, its deadly claws piercing through the bear’s skull before tearing its brain to shreds.
An Earth Escape Zombie emerged to move the bear’s corpse back to the mountain’s base.
However, Lu Chuan noticed at this point—because Flame One had fought so fervently earlier—that the surrounding forest had caught on massive fires.
Fortunately, the heavy rain today was relentless, quickly extinguishing the flames.
Seeing this, Lu Chuan breathed a sigh of relief.
In the apocalypse, it’s not a problem to start a mountain fire; the real concern is the blaze scaring other beasts away, causing significant loss.
But in the next moment, Lu Chuan’s pupils suddenly contracted.
Even though the rain had put out the flames, the earlier blaze had attracted an unwelcome guest.
This was an even larger giant beast than the second-tier bear earlier, radiating an intense pressure that greatly burdened his third-tier zombies.
Roar!
A tremendous roar of a tiger echoed through the mountains, likely louder than the thunder above.
Lu Chuan was utterly shocked, as before him stood a Mutated Giant Tiger, its shoulder height about five meters and body length reaching seven meters.
This tiger was even more robust than the previous black bear, potentially standing taller than the giant bear.
In the eyes of this Mutated Giant Tiger, Lu Chuan clearly saw a trace of disdain.
To this third-tier Mutated Giant Tiger, it seemed the Corpse Puppets were merely an appetizer.
Even with three third-tier zombies present, this Mutated Giant Tiger showed no fear.
"Wait, what kind of power is this?!"
Through the perspective of a Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan was shocked to see a chilling aura emanating from the mouth and nose of the Mutated Giant Tiger, seemingly freezing the surrounding ground.
"Could it be that Mutated Fierce Beasts have awakened special abilities?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 183 184: Luring the Tiger Into the Trap
chapters.content:
Staring at the giant tiger that emitted a chilling cold, Lu Chuan was utterly shocked.
Never had he imagined that these mutated fierce beasts after evolving would have such terrifying physical power.
They had even awakened unique energy like human Evolvers and Evolved Zombies!
Just as Lu Chuan was in shock, a chilling gleam darted toward Lightning One.
Fortunately, Lu Chuan maneuvered Lightning One to swiftly evade the attack.
The spot where Lightning One had just stood turned into a patch of ice.
With its mouth open, this tiger unleashed a terrifying frost, and the chilling cold seemed even more terrifying in the gloomy rain.
At this moment, Lu Chuan felt his scalp tingling, the first time since the apocalypse began that he faced a mutated fierce beast with such an awakened Talent Ability.
Previous encounters with mutated beasts had, at best, further developed their robust physiques.
But never did he expect this tiger, having broken through to the third tier, could release elemental energy like Flame One.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Accompanied by the sound of air being sliced, the tiger's mouth repeatedly launched frosty attacks.
For the moment, the Corpse Puppet could only flee in panic, while trees struck by the frost instantly turned into ice sculptures.
The attack's terrifying power left Lu Chuan in a cold sweat.
Perhaps this tiger needed to exhaust a lot of energy to unleash its frost power, so after a few ineffective attempts, it closed its mouth again.
Only then did Lu Chuan breathe a sigh of relief, hastily controlling his Corpse Puppet to engage in close combat.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The battle roared like thunder, and Lu Chuan watched in amazement and dread.
This third-tier tiger's strength was terrifyingly overwhelming, making even the second-in-command Tank Type Evolved Zombie, Er Pang, struggle against its might.
The enormous body was swatted away by the tiger's claws, almost toppling to the ground.
It was the first time that Lu Chuan's third-tier Tank Type Evolved Zombie had been at such a disadvantage in a direct battle of strength.
Roar!
With a roar, the tiger, in a gust of wind, landed in front of the yet-to-rise Er Pang.
The fearsome claws came down again, but Er Pang managed to block with a metal rod, preventing what could have been a decisive blow.
Lu Chuan was startled, not expecting his painstakingly nurtured third-tier zombie to nearly become scrap in a flash.
Anger blazed within him, and he immediately controlled Tyrant One to engage the tiger with claws glowing coldly.
Tyrant One's claws were indeed sharp, soon breaking the tiger's defense.
As the terrifying wounds left the tiger enraged, it struck repeatedly, forcing Tyrant One to retreat.
"Damn! This third-tier mutated tiger is far stronger than that previous second-tier one!"
"We can't keep this up…"
Lu Chuan felt an intense dread, this battle undoubtedly being the hardest since commanding the Corpse Puppet army.
His numerous second-tier Corpse Puppets couldn't even get close, as the tiger's speed far surpassed Lightning One.
Even Agile Type zombies like Lightning One couldn't get close to sneak attack, only managing to toss throwing knives from afar, leaving slight wounds at best.
He initially thought to have Da Pang and other second-tier Tank Type zombies resist the tiger together, but underestimated its strength.
The tiger's formidable claws sent his second-tier Tank Type zombies flying.
This terrified Lu Chuan enough to no longer allow direct encounters, fearing they might all get destroyed here.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
In the heavy rain, large Fireballs streaked across the sky, lighting up the darkened forest.
Flame One continuously unleashed ranged attacks, but with little effect.
The stormy weather weakened Flame One's power to some extent.
Moreover, the tiger seemed capable of exhaling icy power post-evolution.
The spotted tiger opened its massive mouth, summoning a wall of ice to block the incoming Fireballs.
Seeing his strongest long-range attack neutralized, Lu Chuan's heart sank.
"Damn it! How careless I was!"
"I never thought a third-tier mutated beast would be this formidable!"
To deal with a third-tier mutated beast, Lu Chuan had brought all his third-tier zombies, hoping to win through hard-fought battle.
But he hadn't expected the mutated beast to gain Talent Ability.
Watching his Corpse Puppets getting pushed back, Lu Chuan grew increasingly heavy-hearted. If they continued fighting to the death, even if they won, the damage would be severe.
These were carefully accumulated assets, not worth sacrificing for a third-tier Crystal Core.
Wait!
He almost forgot, the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest wasn't far away.
A plan formed, and Lu Chuan immediately controlled his third-tier Evolved Zombies to gradually retreat, luring the mutated tiger toward the vine forest.
The Corpse Puppets began to falter, and the tiger's bloodlust grew, quickly bringing them into the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest's range.
As soon as the tiger stepped into the forest, the blood-colored vines reacted immediately.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
With a slicing sound, the blood-red vines charged at the tiger.
However, the third-tier mutated tiger fought fiercely, swiftly slicing through the vines with its claws.
Lu Chuan noticed his third-tier Corpse Puppets, stained with blood, also became targets, instantaneously enveloped by the vines.
"Underestimated them…"
Though the Corpse Puppets were ensnared, Lu Chuan wasn't worried, knowing the vines weren't interested in the zombies.
Instead, he ceased their struggle, allowing the vines to fully exert themselves against the third-tier tiger.
The tiger fought with formidable might, struggling amidst the sea of vines.
Through Lightning One's view, Lu Chuan watched the tiger with astonishment.
Vines that took effort for second-tier zombies to sever fell quickly beneath the tiger's claws.
Yet the overwhelming number of Bloodthirsty Demon Vines turned the area into a crimson ocean.
No matter how agile the tiger was, it couldn't escape the encirclement.
As more vines surrounded, the tiger's limbs gradually became ensnared.
Even the frost it breathed out had little effect against the resilient Demon Vines.
Its strength could not be fully exerted, ultimately succumbing to the mass of vines, bound and roaring helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 185: Results from One Week at the Zombie Breeding Base!
chapters.content:
As time slowly passed, the third-level Mutated Giant Tiger trapped in the blood-colored sea roared incessantly, trying to break free from its bonds.
But no matter how it struggled, it was all in vain.
Eventually, the Mutated Giant Tiger showed a look of despair, and its roars turned into a piercing wail, like the wails of ghosts from hell, sending a shiver down anyone's spine.
The body of the Mutated Giant Tiger was covered with Blood-colored Vines.
Those sharp Bloodthirsty Vines crazily burrowed into the wounds and mouth and nose of the Mutated Giant Tiger, penetrating deeper into its body.
They continuously sucked the blood of the third-order Fierce Beast, just like pumps placed in a pool to draw water.
In no time, the once majestic and robust Mutated Giant Tiger shriveled under Lu Chuan's watchful eyes, its gaze dimming.
The screams of the Mutated Giant Tiger grew fainter and finally disappeared.
The dense Bloodthirsty Vine Forest quickly retracted, revealing a large blood-colored vine ball which unraveled to show a bleak white skeleton in the center, with tattered tiger skin draped over it.
After devouring the Mutated Giant Tiger, the ferocity of the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest greatly diminished, and it released Er Pang, Tyrant One, and other Evolved Zombies, as if disdainful of them.
The freed Er Pang and several others, including Tyrant One, slowly walked out of the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest.
The rain continued to fall, washing away the remaining blood of the Mutated Giant Tiger in the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest.
"Sigh, it's strong alright, just not too smart."
Lu Chuan chuckled and fixed his gaze on the skeleton of the Mutated Giant Tiger.
This Mutated Giant Tiger was truly fierce; even Er Pang and the three of them together couldn't withstand it.
Next, Lu Chuan slowly walked towards the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest, approaching the skeleton of the Mutated Giant Tiger to retrieve the hidden Crystal Core from within the bones.
Then, Lu Chuan held the third-level Crystal Core before his eyes, examining it with blood-colored pupils.
The third-level Crystal Core had an overall yellow hue.
However, this Mutated Giant Tiger was extremely powerful among the third-level, so its Crystal Core had a faint touch of green, the glow appearing like green mist hovering on the Crystal Core's surface.
Feeling pleased, Lu Chuan subconsciously glanced at the skeleton of the Mutated Giant Tiger.
"Such a massive body, what a waste!"
It's a pity because the flesh of this third-level Mutated Beast contains enormous energy, which, if used to feed zombies, could expedite their evolution into Evolved Zombies significantly.
Much better than the first and second-level flesh he's been using for feeding.
Nevertheless, Lu Chuan was content to have acquired a third-level Crystal Core so easily today.
After all, if not for the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest, he might not have gotten the third-level Crystal Core and could even suffer heavy losses under the attack of the Mutated Giant Tiger, with Er Pang and Tyrant One possibly lost.
Lu Chuan knew it was because he wasn't strong enough yet.
Facing the Mutated Giant Tiger, apart from Er Pang and the trio barely able to contend with it, the remaining second-level Evolved Zombies could be dealt with in one swipe by it.
If he had seven or eight third-level Evolved Zombies under his command, that Mutated Giant Tiger would definitely flee at the sight of him.
"Luckily, there's this Bloodthirsty Vine Forest."
Lu Chuan looked at the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest, feeling extremely satisfied in his heart.
This success also gave him a taste of sweetness...
In the future, if he encounters troublesome third-level Mutated Beasts, he can still use this method.
Looking at the third-level Crystal Core in his hand, thoughts swirling, Lu Chuan's blood-red eyes slightly shifted.
If a few more appeared, he might directly evolve again.
After a moment, Lu Chuan put the third-level Crystal Core away and, with his Corpse Puppets, embarked on another hunt. After killing a few more Mutant Beasts, he returned to Qingshui Farm with the Corpse Puppets.
Lu Chuan had the Corpse Puppets cut up the blood-reeking Mutated Beast corpses, storing some in the warehouse while others were taken by him to the stadium to feed the zombies.
Unconsciously, another week passed.
These days, Lu Chuan often led his Corpse Puppet army to Yellow Dragon Mountain for hunting, collecting Crystal Cores, and gathering Mutated Beast flesh for the zombies.
Unfortunately, during the week, Lu Chuan didn't encounter any more third-level Fierce Beasts, so his plan to use the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest to evolve was thwarted.
However, there were plenty of first and second-level Mutated Fierce Beasts, and the collected Crystal Cores led to a substantial increase in his second-level Corpse Puppets.
Now, the count of second-level Corpse Puppets had reached 32.
Additionally, Lightning One, Earth Escape One, and Da Pang successfully upgraded to third-level Evolved Zombies after Lu Chuan supplied them with enough second-level Crystal Cores.
Lightning One's body didn't change much, but its limbs elongated considerably, becoming more robust and possessing incredible jumping ability, with speed more than double its previous level.
The steel blade in its hand, when swung, emitted numerous gleams of cold light in the air, causing a stabbing pain in one's body, as the blade itself moved too fast to be seen with the naked eye.
Da Pang, on the other hand, moved towards Er Pang, becoming bigger and bulkier, covered in black Scale Armor, instantly becoming another Gate God to guard Qingshui Farm.
He paired well with Er Pang.
Finally, there was Earth Escape One, which didn't change much in size after evolving, but its entire body appeared earth-yellow, as if composed of soil dust, though its Earth Escape distance increased significantly.
Of course, Lu Chuan's gains during this week were not only these...
Jiangnan City District, the stadium.
The noisy stadium interior buzzed with zombies, emitting ear-piercing howls and chaotic footsteps echoing constantly.
Some zombies stood alone against the walls, scratching at the concrete walls with their claws, seemingly attempting to escape from there.
Some zombies fought and bit each other, devouring each other after killing, while most zombies wandered aimlessly in the center of the stadium.
Rumbling~
The third-level Tyrant One pushed open the door, unleashing a violent aura, immediately quieting the interior, as these zombies feared Tyrant One like a plague.
Using Tyrant One's perspective, Lu Chuan began a meticulous inventory, assessing his harvest during this period.
Unbeknownst to him, far away at Qingshui Farm, a slight smile appeared on Lu Chuan's lips.
The stadium now boasted as many as fifty first-level Evolved Zombies.
Clearly, the effect of Fierce Beast flesh on zombie evolution far exceeded Lu Chuan's estimates.
Naturally, Lu Chuan's joy was not solely due to these fifty first-level Evolved Zombies; there were also a few second-level zombies prominently present in the corner.
"The relentless hunt for Mutated Fierce Beasts every day has finally paid off!"
Gazing at this substantial yield, Lu Chuan couldn't help but exclaim.
It's important to note that Lu Chuan raised these zombies precisely for these Crystal Cores.
The current number of Crystal Cores is sufficient for a considerable upgrade of his Corpse Puppets.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 186: Finally Able to Evolve to Tier 4!
chapters.content:
"It's time to harvest!"
Looking at the zombie horde, Lu Chuan made up his mind.
Without high-level zombies to suppress them, these zombies would instinctively fight each other, devour each other, until they themselves ascended.
The few second-level evolved zombies in the stadium came about this way.
And the stadium, though it looks solid, made of reinforced concrete, cannot be easily breached by ordinary attacks.
However, over time, under the continuous wear of the evolved zombies, it became riddled with holes.
Especially the second-level evolved zombies, with their stronger destructive powers, could punch holes in the walls with a single blow, and over time, it would get worse.
If there were more second-level zombies, Lu Chuan suspected that the entire stadium would be torn down by these guys.
Therefore, Lu Chuan decided to deal with these cultivated evolved zombies first.
These Crystal Cores, in fact, are of great use to him. It's time to use the pigs he has raised.
Having eaten so much mutated fierce beast flesh, it's time for these evolved zombies to repay.
Half an hour later, Lu Chuan prepared a meal for Little Qiqi, instructed her to do her homework properly, and then drove himself to the stadium.
After getting out of the car, Lu Chuan walked to the front door.
With a single thought, Lu Chuan directly manipulated some of the evolved zombies inside, converting them into Corpse Puppets.
Immediately, these previously lively evolved zombies quieted down, as if receiving a command, orderly making their way through the zombie horde and slowly walking out of the stadium.
Arriving outside the stadium, Lu Chuan had these Corpse Puppets line up in several rows, distinctly separated.
As for the remaining first-level evolved zombies inside the stadium, naturally, they would become Crystal Core providers, giving Lu Chuan the necessary Crystal Cores.
The next moment, Lu Chuan manipulated Tyrant One and Lightning One to charge in.
Rumble~
With every step Tyrant One took, the ground would shake violently, emitting a deafening noise.
Seen was Tyrant One exuding an aura of violence, bulging muscles crashing through the zombie horde, using its strong physique to fling away any blocking its path.
Those zombies that were sent flying smashed into the horde, knocking over a swath, causing greater chaos.
Meanwhile, Tyrant One swung its metallic glowing claws, leaving cold gleams in the air, each swing producing sharp explosive sounds.
The first-level evolved zombies, seeing the charging Tyrant One, let out instinctual screams of terror, scattering in all directions.
But the speed of these evolved zombies was no match for the third-level Tyrant One, and before they could run far, Tyrant One caught up, swinging its sharp claws.
Cold gleams flashed, and those fleeing first-level evolved zombies were instantly torn apart, with dark red flesh flying.
As for Lightning One's speed, it was truly lightning-fast, its slender body transforming into streaks of light, weaving between the chaotic zombie horde, the steel blade in its hand creating dazzling blade lights.
Those first-level evolved zombies, who escaped Tyrant One's slaughter amidst the chaos, had a flash of blade light across their necks, and the next moment, heads rolled to the ground.
The entire stadium reverberated with the fearful howls of zombies and the muffled sound of sharp blades slicing through flesh.
A few minutes later, Tyrant One and Lightning One walked out of the stadium, their bodies covered in torn flesh and dark red blood.
What followed was a pungent stench.
The zombie horde, having suffered a massacre, was now utterly terrified, crowding together in one large mass.
The oppressive aura of authority made their bodies tremble instinctively, no longer daring to make any howling sounds.
Lin Chuan, standing outside the gate observing all this, finally received thirty first-level Crystal Cores from Tyrant One and Lightning One.
"Next, it's time to digest these Crystal Cores."
Gazing at the thirty Crystal Cores in Tyrant One's palm, Lu Chuan's eyes shifted to the first-level Corpse Puppets nearby.
These Corpse Puppets were freshly converted from the stadium.
Then, Lu Chuan selected a nearby Agile Zombie, controlling it to step forward and began feeding it Crystal Cores.
As the three red Crystal Cores were swallowed, the surging energy coursed through its body, transforming every part of it.
Roar!
The Agile Zombie in front uttered a roar, its body started to tremble, its form elongating, and the muscles slowly swelled.
It was evolving!
Seeing this scene, Lu Chuan felt a surge of joy.
Sure enough, it wasn't long before this zombie evolved into a second-level Agile Zombie.
Afterward, Lu Chuan paid it no mind, letting it stand there, then controlled another first-level evolved zombie to step out.
Lu Chuan fed it Crystal Cores once again.
Each time a second-level zombie evolved, Lu Chuan would control another first-level zombie to step out, continuously feeding it Crystal Cores.
By the time all thirty Crystal Cores in Lu Chuan's possession were exhausted, he successfully obtained ten second-level Corpse Puppets.
Seven Tank Type second-level Corpse Puppets, and three Agile Type second-level Corpse Puppets.
Lu Chuan gathered the ten second-level Corpse Puppets together.
With a thought from Lu Chuan.
Tyrant One and Lightning One, standing behind him, instantly charged into the zombie horde, using their claws and steel blade to quickly tear apart the ten defenseless second-level Corpse Puppets, slashing and crushing their heads to retrieve the second-level Crystal Cores from their minds.
Lu Chuan watched this slaughter quietly.
What he lacked most to advance to the fourth level were third-level Crystal Cores.
And to acquire third-level Crystal Cores, besides obtaining them from third-level evolved zombies and mutated fierce beasts, there was another method: to obtain them from his own third-level Corpse Puppets.
To create third-level Corpse Puppets, naturally, second-level Corpse Puppets needed to ascend, which required second-level Crystal Cores.
So these ten second-level Corpse Puppets had to serve as Crystal Core providers to supply him with second-level Crystal Cores.
Moments later, Lu Chuan received ten second-level Crystal Cores from Tyrant One, his eyes filled with joy.
This should be enough.
Typically, three second-level Crystal Cores could evolve a second-level Corpse Puppet to the third level, which Lu Chuan had already verified before.
Thus, if everything went well, Lu Chuan would temporarily have three third-level Corpse Puppets under his command.
This was the ultimate result of over a week's effort for Lu Chuan.
And three third-level Corpse Puppets meant three third-level Crystal Cores, plus the Crystal Core from the mutated giant tiger, enough to advance Lu Chuan to the fourth level.
The thought of advancing to the fourth level, with his Talent Ability greatly increasing, filled Lu Chuan with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 187: Advancement to Tier 4!
chapters.content:
Having Tyrant One continue guarding the gymnasium, Lu Chuan drove back to Qingshui Farm with ten second-tier Crystal Cores.
Arriving at the farm gate, Er Pang was holding a giant iron rod, guarding the entrance.
Then, Lu Chuan directly summoned three second-tier Corpse Puppets under his command.
Immediately, Lu Chuan let the three Tank Type Corpse Puppets before him consume the second-tier Crystal Cores in his hand.
After ingesting the Crystal Cores, the mountain-like bodies of the three Tank Type Corpse Puppets began to tremble uncontrollably.
The immense energy from the Crystal Cores continuously nourished the Corpse Puppets' bodies, promoting their transformation towards the third-tier.
Roar!
The seemingly endless energy inside collided wildly, causing the three Tank Type Corpse Puppets to roar at the sky, emitting a terrifying aura as a third-tier pressure gradually formed.
As their aura visibly intensified, the forms of the three Corpse Puppets quickly approached Da Pang and Er Pang.
Their arms seemed forged from steel, like giant door panels, incredibly thick, and covered with layers of hard black scales that glowed darkly.
At this moment, Da Pang, Er Pang, and Flame One beside Lu Chuan instantly attacked the three newly promoted Tank Type Corpse Puppets.
Er Pang swung his iron rod with great force, striking down on the head of the central Tank Type Corpse Puppet.
Boom!
Instantly, the head of the Tank Type Corpse Puppet exploded, its skull shattered, flesh scattered, the head resembling a broken candied hawthorn before the Tank Type Corpse Puppet collapsed helplessly to the ground.
Da Pang used the iron rod to pry at the Tank Type zombie's head, extracting a yellow Crystal Core.
Er Pang punched out again, creating an ear-splitting sound in the air, smashing the face of the left Tank Type Corpse Puppet into a bloody mess, even faintly cracking its skull, causing the Tank Type Corpse Puppet to fall.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Relentlessly, Er Pang repeatedly smashed the opponent's head with punch after punch, making blood mixed with brain matter continuously spill out until the head shattered, exposing the Crystal Core inside.
Meanwhile, Flame One's long-charged Fireball finally blasted towards the head of the right Tank Type Corpse Puppet.
Boom!
The moment the Fireball touched the head, it exploded instantly, the blaze dazzling, completely disfiguring the Tank Type Corpse Puppet, the dried flesh on its face gradually melting under the intense heat.
With successive Fireballs launched by Flame One, the Tank Type Corpse Puppet's head was left with only a char-red skull.
As yet another Fireball hit, the long-brittle skull exploded, the Crystal Core inside spewing out along with some charred brain matter and bone fragments.
Moments later, gazing at the three third-tier Crystal Cores in hand, Lu Chuan couldn't contain his excitement.
Consuming these three Crystal Cores would allow him to ascend to the fourth-tier, something he had never seen since the apocalypse began, even after so many days had passed.
Who knows, he might be the first in this world, Lu Chuan wondered to himself.
Ordering Da Pang and others to guard the farm closely, preventing anyone from approaching, Lu Chuan took the three third-tier Crystal Cores and Earth Escape One back to his room.
The reason for keeping Earth Escape One nearby was to prevent accidents during his evolution; if necessary, Earth Escape One could rapidly escape underground with him.
Then Lu Chuan swallowed the three third-tier Crystal Cores and the third-tier Mutated Giant Tiger Crystal Core from before all at once.
Boom!
Instantly, four Crystal Cores melted inside Lu Chuan, their energy becoming a torrent, surging and raging within his body as if trying to tear it apart.
Lu Chuan couldn't stop shaking, his muscles writhing in agony, while his mouth emitted painful groans, feeling his body being gnawed by uncountable ants, his head ready to explode, pierced as though by a constantly drilling electric tool.
However, beneath these symptoms lay the nourishment and refinement bestowed upon Lu Chuan's body by the Crystal Cores.
With time passing, the energy transformed into streams, flowing continuously in his mind and body, causing his body to begin transforming.
His aura visibly strengthened, but Lu Chuan's physique remained unchanged.
Nonetheless, his muscles gradually swelled, each fiber becoming steel-like, tough and flexible, his bones changing from pale yellow to jade-like white, emitting a faint glow, with tendon lines exceptionally elastic and tough.
Of course, these changes were internal.
Such changes weren't as easily visible as external appearance.
The outward change in Lu Chuan could be summed up as becoming more human-like.
His skin gradually turned white and smooth, though without circulating blood, it wasn't flushed.
A head of dense, jet-black hair covered his scalp; viewed from behind, he resembled a fair-skinned living human.
The most recognizable face looked almost identical to his pre-apocalypse appearance, the strange eyes had shifted from blood-red to dark red, the eye whites from red to light red.
Time slowly passed.
Boom!
Suddenly, Lu Chuan's aura soared, a powerful pressure sweeping all around.
Fourth-tier!!!
Feeling the unusual sensation dissipate instantly, the near-numb Lu Chuan finally breathed a sigh of relief, joy spreading across his face.
Breaking through, this ascension process had tortured him nearly to death.
"The changes after reaching the fourth-tier are truly remarkable!"
Slumping to the ground, once calming down, Lu Chuan began sensing the changes brought by this ascension.
Post-fourth-tier, his Spiritual Power surged multiple times, his thinking sharper than before, and his five senses greatly enhanced.
Just sitting here, a torrent of scents from the entire farm flowed into his nostrils; in the complex and chaotic mix, he could distinguish each scent's source.
Simultaneously, his ears became incredibly sharp, able to hear the sounds of insects and earthworms crawling beneath the ground…
Due to the surge in Spiritual Power, Lu Chuan's control over the range of Corpse Puppets also strengthened.
Originally controlling Corpse Puppets over ten kilometers, this time, it might surpass fifty kilometers.
Besides the boosts from the Spiritual Power increase, Lu Chuan clearly sensed his body had undergone a comprehensive enhancement.
His skin, caressed lightly with his nails, gave Lu Chuan a jade-like sensation, dramatically boosting his defense.
Beyond defense, Lu Chuan felt a significant increase in strength, as if an endless reserve filled his body.
Next moment, clenching his right fist, he punched the concrete floor fiercely.
Boom!
A loud bang followed, with cracks radiating from the fist center towards the surrounding area.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 188: Wang Lei's Shock!
chapters.content:
Jiangnan City District.
Rumble~
A convoy of vehicles slowly moved along the road. If someone were to look at the drivers, they would realize that all the drivers were mindless zombies.
These zombies were naturally Lu Chuan's Corpse Puppets.
At this moment, Lu Chuan himself sat in the driver's seat of the truck in front, eyes closed, and as the convoy passed, his immense Spiritual Power swept across all directions, instantly controlling all zombies along the way.
Immediately, the zombies wandering outside on the streets seemed to receive an order, stumbling forward with a series of howls, heading in a common direction.
Zombies trapped inside buildings smashed windows and doors to join, following the other zombies from behind.
In no time, as the number of zombies increased, they naturally formed a flowing stream of corpses along each street, vast and mighty.
Soon, these zombie tides converged like rivers into the sea, gathering behind Lu Chuan's convoy, eventually forming a dense sea of zombies behind him, unending as far as the eye could see.
At this moment, the terrifying howls sounded like ten thousand thunderstorms, making one's hair stand on end, bloodlust and ferocity filling the air, as if the entire sky had suddenly darkened.
On the truck's roof, Lu Chuan stood firmly with his feet planted, staring at the terrifying Zombie Army behind him with a smile, a sense of pride welling up in his heart.
With this endless Zombie Army at his disposal, who could threaten him in the future?
Even if the official base sent troops to encircle, they would equally be drowned in the boundless Zombie Army.
Of course, this was only part of Lu Chuan's excitement.
The rest of it was that with so many zombies in his hands, his reserve troops were now assured.
The Corpse Puppets under him all evolved step by step from ordinary zombies, and if he wished to expand his forces in the future, this Zombie Army would be the foundation.
A nation is made up of people, and a power is the same. Without people, neither the nation nor the power has a future.
"Good, good, good, establishing a Zombie Kingdom is just around the corner!!!"
Lu Chuan's heart surged with ambition, watching the Zombie Army, laughing ceaselessly inside.
This was just the beginning; when he expanded his territory to encompass the entire Jiangnan City District and even the surrounding cities, more zombies would inevitably fall under his control.
At that time, the Zombie Kingdom he anticipated would take shape, followed by continuous expansion and strengthening until reaching the limit.
Moments later, Lu Chuan also commanded the Zombie Army to disperse, distributing them evenly throughout the Jiangnan City District, serving as his monitors. In the future, any human force passing through the Jiangnan City District would find it difficult to escape his gaze.
Next, Lu Chuan led the convoy back to the stadium to begin feeding the "pigs" inside.
...
Jianghai Survivor Base.
Wang Lei's squad finally returned after completing their mission.
Wang Lei, with a gloomy face, looked at the surrounding dilapidated tents and the heaps of garbage, breathing in the foul stench of the streets, which dampened his mood further.
Unable to bear the sight, Wang Lei, followed by a squad member, walked quickly along the street toward the Inner City.
Soon, Liu Yang, who had gone ahead to gather information, returned with a grave expression.
"Captain, the situation isn't great. All other Elite Evolution Teams completed their missions smoothly without any incidents."
Liu Yang stepped forward to report to Wang Lei, whose face was clouded with gloom.
There are quite a few Evolutionary Squads in Jianghai Base City.
But elite squads, there are only ten.
That means, out of all the elite Evolutionary squads sent out by the Jianghai Survivor Base, only their elite squad experienced casualty losses.
"Damn bastard, don't let me find out who you are!"
Hearing this, Wang Lei's face darkened further.
After all that trouble, only their squad suffered losses—five people went out, and two were lost. This result was unbearable.
And everything was normal elsewhere; only Jiangnan City District failed, as if haunted!
Recalling the brutal deaths of his teammates, followed by being strung up by an unknown enemy for provocation, Wang Lei couldn't let it go.
He vowed to avenge his fallen comrades by torturing the enemy to death once his strength grew.
"Let's go! Head back to the Inner City and report this matter!"
Shaking his head helplessly, Wang Lei spoke to his teammates behind him.
This mission was a significant loss for their squad—two teammates dead, and aside from rescuing a few survivors, they didn't even obtain a single Crystal Core.
Moreover, Wang Lei felt a chill thinking about how not a single Evolved Zombie was discovered in Jiangnan City District.
This kind of eerie phenomenon was something he had never seen before.
There were quite a few zombies in Jiangnan City District, so an absence of Evolved Zombies was impossible. Their failure to discover any meant there were only two possible explanations.
One was that a concealed Evolutionary power existed in Jiangnan City District that had eradicated all the Evolved Zombies for their Crystal Cores.
Wang Lei leaned more toward this explanation, believing his two teammates were most likely killed by them and that their corpses were strung up at the door as a taunt to their squad.
The second possibility was the existence of an unknown terrifying creature in Jiangnan City District, perhaps a Mutant Beast or an Evolved Zombie, which had killed all of the Evolved Zombies and devoured their Crystal Cores.
The three had not walked far when they saw some base staff posting notices around the streets.
On almost every street, people were putting up notices, plastering them everywhere.
"What's happening? Such a huge fuss?"
Yang Xiu beside Wang Lei said in surprise.
The base occasionally posted notices, but mobilizing so much manpower for such a large effort was unprecedented.
As Wang Lei and the others paid attention, many survivors from the outer city rushed to the notices, thinking recruitment was underway in the Inner City.
However, moments later, these survivors dispersed in disappointment.
"Sigh, thought it was recruitment, wasted my effort!"
"What the hell does Corpse Tide have to do with me? Let me fill my belly first!"
"What a waste of emotion, I think this is all about starving us to death..."
"..."
