Listening to the survivors' complaints, Wang Lei became interested and quickly approached one of the notices with his two companions.
The survivors standing in front saw Wang Lei and the others approaching and tactfully stepped aside.
Wang Lei looked at the notice, his face showing a surprised expression.
"A Corpse Tide appeared in the Imperial Capital?"
"And a new type of Evolved Zombie—Corpse King? This name... What, it can control other zombies?"
The more the three read, the more shocked they became. While this notice meant nothing to powerless survivors, it was crucial for Evolvers like them.
A Corpse King capable of controlling other zombies made the area outside the city even more dangerous!

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 189: Could There Be a Corpse King in Jiangnan City District Too?
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 189: Could There Be a Corpse King in Jiangnan City District Too?
After reading the notice, the three of them looked at each other and could feel deep shock from each other’s eyes.
Next, Wang Lei led the two of them and quickly entered the inner city.
Wang Lei arranged for the other two to go back and rest, while he went to the office area of the base city.
Not long after.
Inside a meeting room.
Wang Lei met with the high-ranking officials of the base city.
A middle-aged man in a suit, with an imposing presence, stood up when he saw Wang Lei come in, walked up to him, shook his hand, and said with a smile, "Captain Wang, welcome back."
"Chief, I failed the base’s trust..."
Wang Lei was a little speechless; their team’s performance was indeed very poor this time.
How could he have the face to accept the chief’s welcome?
This is in the apocalyptic world. Before the apocalypse, if two members of a five-person squad died, even if he was not dismissed, he would have faced severe punishment.
"Captain Wang, I already know about your team’s situation. I know it’s hard for you, and I too feel the pain for the sacrifice of those warriors, but both you and I must get used to it.
Because when we go out of the city on missions, some casualties are inevitable, and all our base city can do is to provide solace and take good care of the families of the fallen soldiers, so they can rest in peace!"
The high-ranking official of the base also adopted a stern expression and comforted him.
The apocalypse has come, and death has already become commonplace. These high-ranking officials of the base city can only do their utmost to maintain the stability of the base city, provide necessary support to the evolution teams, and reduce the frequency of evolvers’ casualties.
But to completely prevent casualties during missions outside, it’s almost impossible.
"Chief, I understand."
Wang Lei nodded. He wasn’t someone who hadn’t experienced people dying in front of him, and he could definitely endure this.
It’s just that this time, the death of his two teammates felt too stifling because they didn’t even know who the enemy was.
So he secretly vowed that in the future, he must avenge his two teammates and uncover the disgusting guy behind it.
"It’s good that you can think it through. The base city cannot do without a great general like you!"
Hearing this, the high-ranking official of the base nodded and said with a smile.
Every powerful evolver is a treasure for the base city.
Then, Wang Lei remembered the notice he had just seen in the outer city and hurriedly asked, "By the way, Chief, I just saw the notice outside. When did this corpse tide happen? How are things in the Imperial Capital now?"
The notice was written unclearly, and Wang Lei knew the high-ranking officials must have more detailed information.
"I was about to tell you! Come, sit down quickly!"
The high-ranking official led Wang Lei to sit at the conference table, then started playing the video footage transmitted from the Imperial Capital.
Wang Lei looked at the image of the endless corpse tide rushing toward the Imperial Capital, feeling utterly shocked.
This corpse tide was like a flood, devouring everything in its path, with many evolved zombies among them, exuding a terrifying aura that ordinary zombies nearby didn’t even dare to approach.
The roaring sound coming from the corpse tide was like ten thousand ghosts howling in hell, extremely terrifying.
Seeing this scene, Wang Lei couldn’t help but think, if the corpse tide were attacking not the Imperial Capital but Jianghai Base City, could they withstand it?
After weighing it in his mind, Wang Lei immediately had a bad premonition. The strength of Jianghai Base City is not weak, but to resist such a level of corpse tide would probably be very difficult.
Because in this corpse tide, it’s not just ordinary zombies, there are also many evolved zombies, and these evolved zombies are the tough ones, incredibly hard to deal with.
"Is this what a corpse tide is? It’s indeed terrifying!"
After a moment of silence, Wang Lei looked at the chief and said with a bitter smile.
Faced with such a terrifying corpse tide, even a powerful evolver like him, who kills ordinary zombies like cutting grass, would be overwhelmed in an instant.
"Don’t worry, only a Corpse King can stir up a corpse tide.
Such zombies are very rare, and until now, our Jianghai Base City has not discovered the trace of such a zombie."
Seeing that Wang Lei seemed frightened, the high-ranking official spoke slowly.
These high-ranking officials of the base, when they just saw this footage, didn’t react much better than Wang Lei either.
"A Corpse King?"
Wang Lei thought of the introduction on the notice, which described the Corpse King’s ability to control other zombies in battle.
This kind of zombie uses swarm tactics, which is extremely deadly to evolution teams like them. Once targeted, a large group of zombies would swarm in for a siege, draining their stamina.
At that time, even if their individual strength is strong enough to kill second-tier or third-tier evolved zombies, they would be worn out to death by the endless ordinary zombies.
"Oh right, Captain Wang. The Corpse King has significant intelligence, can control other zombies, and is extremely afraid of death. It normally directs zombies to battle while hiding in the dark.
I wonder, Captain Wang, have you encountered any similar situations during your missions?"
"A lot of zombies cooperating in battle?"
The high-ranking official asked.
Since receiving the intelligence about the corpse tide from the Imperial capital, the high-level officials in the base have been quite worried, fearing such terrifying zombies might appear nearby.
They in Jianghai are not like the Imperial Capital, capable of withstanding a corpse tide’s attack.
"Chief, no."
Wang Lei shook his head.
He then smiled bitterly and said, "Chief, you’re really joking. If I had encountered one, I probably wouldn’t be back now."
Hearing Wang Lei’s words, the high-ranking official wasn’t surprised either. Smiling, he patted Wang Lei on the shoulder and said warmly, "Alright, you’ve worked hard, go back and have a good rest first!"
"Yes!"
Wang Lei stood up, saluted, and turned to leave.
As he exited the meeting room, Wang Lei paused, his complexion changed as he suddenly remembered the strange occurrences he had seen in the Jiangnan City District before.
Zombies without intelligence suddenly driving cars and transporting supplies...
Wang Lei had slaughtered countless zombies, but he had never seen zombies doing such things, and zombies don’t need supplies either.
So doesn’t this mean that something behind the scenes is manipulating these zombies?
The reason they behaved like normal humans is because some presence was giving them orders?
And his two teammates, killed mysteriously and silently, with the attacker nowhere to be found.
He had previously suspected it was the work of evolvers because such a provocative act of hanging corpses could only be done by humans.
But things were different now...
The more Wang Lei thought, the more wrong it felt. Coupled with the evolved zombies that should have existed but mysteriously disappeared, his pupils suddenly contracted.
Could it be... that there is a Corpse King lurking in the Jiangnan City District?

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 190: Is This Corpse King Going to Evolve into a Living Person?
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 190: Is This Corpse King Going to Evolve into a Living Person?
Lu Chuan, controlling the Corpse Puppets, drove the convoy to the stadium.
The stadium still echoed with constant roars, with a large number of zombies being kept inside.
Upon the convoy’s arrival, the "supervisor" and "security" of the zombie breeding base—Tyrant One, slowly opened the doors.
A new feeding round had begun.
The Corpse Puppets pushed carts loaded with Mutated Beast flesh into the stadium, and afterwards, Tyrant One threw all the flesh into the zombie crowd.
Instantly, the zombies began a feast of flesh and blood.
Roar!
Each zombie, stimulated by the blood scent, let out excited roars and pounced crazily onto the flesh of the Mutated Beasts.
"Eat, eat! If you don’t hurry up and evolve, where am I going to get Crystal Cores?"
Watching the zombies devour the feast, Lu Chuan thought to himself.
The Evolved Zombies within the stadium had already been harvested by Lu Chuan previously. To maintain their numbers, Lu Chuan had caught another batch to raise inside.
His next target was simple.
Since he had already reached the fourth level, his few third-level Corpse Puppets should also be promoted to the fourth level.
Figures like Da Pang and Er Pang, with their terrifyingly large sizes, could literally crush cities. If they evolved to the fourth level, Lu Chuan couldn’t imagine how terrifying they’d become.
When Er Pang struck with a club, at the very least, it could flatten a two-story building.
There’s also Flame One, Earth Escape One, these Mage-type Corpse Puppets, who knows what new abilities they’d awaken upon leveling up.
Day in and day out, it’s either Fireballs or Earth Escapes. Lu Chuan was tired of it.
A meteor shower or meteor strike would be far more thrilling!
Yet, this was just something Lu Chuan was thinking about.
To sustain his third-level Corpse Puppets to the fourth level in a short period required a massive number of first-level Evolved Zombies. Who knows if Yellow Dragon Mountain could provide that much Fierce Beast meat.
...
After breaking through to the fourth level, Lu Chuan was in a very good mood.
Nighttime.
Lu Chuan turned on the porch light, then brought out an iron barbecue grill from the room, planning to celebrate properly.
First, he placed the grill three zhang (around 10 meters) away from the house, then brought out tables, chairs, and various ingredients.
Under the white light, Lu Chuan began putting the collected coal into the box under the grill, then added a few blocks of alcohol to ignite it. Before long, the coals were lit.
Next, Lu Chuan placed the skewers that were already prepared on the grill, occasionally rotating them.
"Daddy, let me help you!"
Ji Ruxue, wearing a princess dress, saw her father was a bit overwhelmed and slowly climbed down from the chair, stepping towards Lu Chuan steadily.
Seeing Ji Ruxue really about to run over, Lu Chuan was startled. The grill was dirty and dangerous, not something a delicate child like Little Qiqi should be near.
Putting down his work, Lu Chuan wiped his hands, inserted his hands under Little Qiqi’s arms, and lifted her back onto the chair.
After giving the little one a gentle pinch on her round cheek as a warning with his eyes not to come closer, Lu Chuan walked back to the grill.
However, just as he reached the grill, Lu Chuan suddenly remembered that he had hunted a Mutated Rabbit earlier that day, which would be perfect to grill for the little one.
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan immediately commanded the Corpse Puppets to retrieve the rabbit from the warehouse.
The Mutated Rabbit was originally kept for eating, so it had already been prepared with the fur, guts, and head removed.
However, due to its mutation, even skinned, the Mutated Rabbit was still comparable in size to a typical large golden retriever.
For convenience, Lu Chuan could only divide it into many pieces for grilling. Before long, the rabbit legs and ribs began to turn yellow, becoming glossy and emitting a tempting aroma, sizzling with specks of oil.
The vegetables were done cooking first. Jiang Che placed the grilled vegetable skewers on a plate and brought them to the table.
Golden brown potato slices sprinkled with pepper salt; silky roasted eggplants filled with garlic fragrance; white and tender golden needle mushrooms soaked with oil...
Finally, Lu Chuan specially prepared a bowl of vegetable salad for Little Qiqi, knowing children need supplements of vitamins during growth.
As the vegetable salad was placed in front of her, Ji Ruxue wrinkled her little nose, her expression full of refusal.
Unfortunately, Lu Chuan had already turned his back, completely unaware.
Once all the dishes were laid out, Lu Chuan prepared to serve the grilled rabbit meat, pork trotters, and lamb kidneys.
Sitting across from Little Qiqi, Zhao Lin, who had been secretly observing Lu Chuan since she came out, was astounded by his current appearance.
How had this Corpse King changed so much?
If not looked at closely, one might think he was a living person.
Now this Corpse King, besides having overly white skin and some flaws in his eyes, was almost indistinguishable from a living person.
Properly dressed and with sunglasses, he could probably blend into a crowd unnoticed.
Zhao Lin slightly frowned, wondering if he had evolved again?
Would he finally evolve into a living person?
Zhao Lin couldn’t help feeling a chilling suspicion.
However, reflecting on her current predicament, Zhao Lin found her concerns somewhat laughable. Forget it, forget it, better to enjoy the meal!
Since the apocalypse, she hadn’t had a single barbecue meal.
Moments later, Lu Chuan brought up all kinds of grilled meat.
Looking at the fragrant barbecue before her, Zhao Lin mustered up the courage to say to Lu Chuan, "This barbecue smells so good, how can it be without beer? Bring some beer!"
Lu Chuan looked at this foolish woman in surprise.
Adapting so quickly?
How impolite!
However, Lu Chuan was in a good mood and, given Zhao Lin’s decent behavior lately in keeping Little Qiqi company, decided to fulfill her small request.
Immediately, Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppets to retrieve a can of beer from the warehouse and placed it on the table.
Zhao Lin directly fetched a can of beer, opened it, and with a lamb skewer from the table, started devouring it, oil dripping from her mouth.
"Qiqi, your zombie dad’s cooking is pretty good."
While eating, Zhao Lin chatted with Ji Ruxue, who was nibbling on a rabbit leg.
"Then you should eat more. My dad doesn’t make barbecues often."
Watching Zhao Lin who seemed to forget her bearings from joy, Lu Chuan sighed inwardly.
Although this was indeed the future Nine Deaths Demon Police, watching her silly demeanor, Lu Chuan wasn’t sure if capturing her was right or wrong.
Lest in the end this Nine Deaths Demon Police gets spoiled by daddy, just knowing how to eat and drink on the farm.
All this meat was hunted down by daddy at great risk, and can’t be eaten in vain!

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 191: Base City’s Reaction! Investigating Jiangnan City District!
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 191: Base City’s Reaction! Investigating Jiangnan City District!
Jianghai Survivor Base.
After harboring doubts about the Jiangnan City District, Wang Lei immediately reported the information he knew.
Due to his position as the Elite Squad captain, it wasn’t long before the highest commander of the Jiangnan Survivor Base heard of the matter.
Surprised by the report, the highest commander quickly summoned Wang Lei.
In the office.
"Captain Wang, is what you said true?"
The highest commander, dressed in military attire and appearing middle-aged, looked at Wang Lei.
Although the news had been received some time ago, upon bringing up the matter again, the commander still found it hard to believe.
Zombies driving cars?
Even transporting supplies?
If all this truly exists, it means these zombies must have awoken to intelligence.
But ordinary zombies can’t evolve intelligence.
So it’s highly likely that a Corpse King is secretly commanding these zombies.
"Yes, Commander."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei nodded, responding without hesitation.
"Could you describe the situation in detail again?"
The commander furrowed his brow, feeling puzzled.
If Wang Lei and his team had personally witnessed these manipulated zombies, how could the Corpse King have let them go?
The Corpse King’s intelligence isn’t low. Would he expose his situation to Wang Lei and the others?
"At that time, when our squad arrived in Jiangnan City District by helicopter... we killed a lot of zombies but didn’t encounter a single Evolved Zombie..."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei began to recall the series of events his squad experienced after arriving in Jiangnan City District and started to recount them to the commander.
Aside from concealing any rough treatment towards survivors, he revealed everything else.
After Wang Lei finished speaking, the commander furrowed his brow deeper, filled with confusion and puzzlement.
There were so many points in Wang Lei’s story worth investigating!
Seeing the commander silent after his explanation, Wang Lei quietly stood there waiting, the office atmosphere somewhat oppressive.
After a brief silence, the commander looked at Wang Lei again and said in a deep voice, "Captain Wang, are you saying that after your squad entered Jiangnan City District, you found that all the Evolved Zombies that should have been there had mysteriously vanished?"
"Moreover, the scene of zombies transporting supplies and driving cars, you didn’t actually see it with your own eyes, correct?"
Evolved Zombies evolve from ordinary zombies and can’t just disappear without reason.
In the commander’s view, these Evolved Zombies were either all hunted down or gathered by something, hidden in the dark.
And such an existence really aligns well with the identity of a Corpse King.
However, Wang Lei couldn’t witness any unusual scenes of those zombies; all were recounted by survivors, making it difficult to determine the truth in a short time.
Of course, the commander already inclined to believe this matter was true.
After all, this matter and the complete disappearance of Evolved Zombies corroborate each other, strongly proving the existence of a Corpse King.
"Commander, many survivors have seen it. Now these people should have been transferred to the Base City, and the Base City can send someone to verify with them."
Wang Lei hurriedly said, although he hadn’t seen it personally, he believed the survivors in that situation weren’t lying.
And such an abnormal phenomenon, if it’s not a Corpse King, then what is it?
Wang Lei even deeply suspected that his two teammates were killed by this Corpse King.
The motive was likely to warn them not to linger in his territory, wanting them to leave quickly.
This is also the reason why he and his teammates withdrew without facing the fatal danger the other two teammates faced.
Of course, if things were really as he speculated, then the Corpse King hiding in Jiangnan City District, the intelligence... is truly terrifying.
Wang Lei wouldn’t be so arrogant to think that this Corpse King feared his squad’s strength and didn’t wipe them out entirely.
With the ability to manipulate Corpse Tides, if wanting to strike, Wang Lei’s squad wouldn’t be able to escape.
He believed the real reason is likely that the Corpse King considered their backing at Jianghai Base City.
Not wanting to attract Jianghai Base City’s attention to Jiangnan City District due to annihilating a super squad.
After all, this Corpse King is still in a dormant state and certainly didn’t want to be exposed to human sight. This is the key to why they were able to retreat.
"This isn’t what you saw yourself, so we can’t rush to conclusions. However, your mention of the disappearance of all Evolved Zombies is very suspicious, with a good chance of a Corpse King being behind it."
"The Base City will send an Invisible Squad, entirely composed of Invisibles, to investigate further."
"If traces of a Corpse King are really found, Captain Wang, you will have made a significant contribution to the Base City and will surely receive a grand reward!"
The commander’s expression was serious as he spoke.
This matter cannot be ignored by the Base City.
If this is false, it’s manageable. But if it’s true, it truly means a Corpse King is lurking near Jianghai Base City, eyeing humans menacingly.
In such a situation, Jianghai Base City is no different than living in a den of wolves.
Threatened daily by the Corpse King.
The opponent could anytime unleash a massive Corpse Tide and annihilate Jiangnan Base City District.
Therefore, once the existence of a Corpse King is detected, Jianghai Base City must quickly find the location of the Corpse King and eliminate it before a Corpse Tide is unleashed.
"Thank you, Commander. I reported this mainly out of concern for the safety of the Base City, and never thought about any reward before."
Wang Lei said modestly.
Subsequently, Wang Lei suggested: "Commander, I have a proposal, which is that the helicopter transporting the Invisible Squad should not land over Jiangnan City District; otherwise, it might easily alarm the Corpse King."
In Wang Lei’s view, his squad was likely alarmed by the helicopter last time, resulting in his two teammates being brutally killed.
And the Corpse King must be hiding somewhere in Jiangnan City District. Hearing the helicopter’s noise would surely attract him.
With the previous squad as an example, the Invisible Squad should not repeat the same mistake.
"Alright, I’ll inform them!"
Upon hearing Wang Lei’s suggestion, the commander clearly understood Wang Lei’s suspicion as well. After a brief thought, he agreed immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 192: Ji Ruxue Breaks Through to Tier 4!
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 192: Ji Ruxue Breaks Through to Tier 4!
Yellow Dragon Town.
The convoy drove past as usual.
At this time, Yellow Dragon Town was incredibly silent; not even a passing zombie could be seen on the streets, which were completely deserted.
This is because, earlier, Lu Chuan had personally visited Yellow Dragon Town and directly transformed the zombies here into Corpse Puppets.
Currently, these Corpse Puppets have become piglets and have been sent by Lu Chuan to be raised in the gym.
"Quan, how about we secretly follow them to see what these zombies are actually up to?"
By the window on the first floor of an apartment building, a survivor, full of curiosity, softly suggested to Quan beside him.
These zombies have been coming and going from Yellow Dragon Town unknown times, and they have no idea what they are actually doing.
Hearing this, Zhang Quan’s face fell, glaring at the other person, "If you want to die, don’t drag me along!"
He wasn’t stupid; zombies being able to drive obviously indicate a considerable level of intelligence.
If this group of zombies discovered them trailing behind, wouldn’t they rush in and tear them apart!
Moreover, now the entire Yellow Dragon Town’s zombies seem to have been drawn away by the zombie convoy, making it very safe to go outside and search for food.
No longer needing to worry about an unnoticed zombie rushing out from a corner to bite and chew them.
Being able to survive safely, Zhang Quan naturally wouldn’t take any risks.
Who cares what they’re up to, as long as it doesn’t affect him, he pretends he doesn’t see it.
"Go, call the others; let’s go down to gather supplies!"
Watching the convoy move farther away, gradually disappearing from view, Zhang Quan instructed the survivor beside him.
"Okay!"
Being reprimanded by Zhang Quan, the survivor got sensible. Hearing Zhang Quan’s words, he nodded, turned around, and ran off to call people.
Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Lu Chuan commanded his army of Corpse Puppets, once again entering Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Today’s weather was great; the sky was clear with no clouds, everything in view was distinctly visible.
Perhaps recently, he had been killing too ruthlessly.
When Lu Chuan passed through the outermost region, he only encountered two first-tier Mutant Beasts, one a giant greenish goat with two robust sharp horns on its head, and the other a massive black-scaled giant snake exuding a fierce aura.
Both Mutant Beasts, just before dying, couldn’t even utter a sound; their heads were severed instantly by the steel knife wielded by Lightning One.
After controlling second-tier Corpse Puppets to extract the Crystal Cores, the team proceeded.
As they ventured deeper, they began encountering more and more Mutated Fierce Beasts. In a short moment, Lu Chuan had already amassed quite a few first-tier Crystal Cores.
As the team stormed through a pine forest.
Roar~
Several deafening roars suddenly came, and immediately, with the aid of Lightning One’s body, Lu Chuan could distinctly feel the ground constantly trembling, as if Fierce Beasts were about to rush out from the pine forest.
Alert!
Lu Chuan’s heart immediately became vigilant, commanding the Corpse Puppets to quickly form a kind of fan-shaped formation, with Er Pang at the forefront, Lightning One on the side, Flame One in the center for ranged attacks, and other second-tier Corpse Puppets stationed on the outer edges, ready to act.
Rumble~
The heavy footsteps came from afar, as if a thousand armies were charging.
Roar~
The next moment, dozens of giant figures leaped out of the pine forest, charging toward the Corpse Puppet team, like dozens of cars pushed to their maximum speed, crashing head-on.
They were dozens of Mutated Giant Pigs, the largest with a shoulder height of three meters, and the smallest with a shoulder height of two meters, exuding a fierce presence, formidable in momentum.
These Mutated Giant Pigs were well-fed and robust, covered in a thick layer of Mud Armor, with bristles like steel needles, hard and sharp, tusks aiming toward the sky, gleaming with a cold light, with blood-red eyes full of ferocity.
Ten first-tier, five second-tier!
Lu Chuan had already seen through the complete strength of the Mutated Pig Group.
Boom!
As the Mutated Pig Group charged close, Flame One, having already charged up, immediately acted, unleashing several scorching Fireballs, exploding directly in the midst of the Mutated Pig Group.
Instantly, two first-tier Mutated Giant Pigs that didn’t dodge in time were killed, their flesh flying.
Additionally, three first-tier Mutated Giant Pigs and one second-tier Mutated Giant Pig were injured, their bodies ablaze, emitting cries of pain from their mouths.
However, Flame One’s attack didn’t rout the Mutated Pig Group; instead, it incited the ferocity of these Mutated Giant Pigs.
Subsequently, these Mutated Giant Pigs started crazily accelerating, their long tusks aimed forward, charging toward Er Pang and the other Corpse Puppets.
Roar!
Er Pang looked like the Demon Lord of Chaos, standing at the forefront, with a roar, the iron rod in his hand swung in the air, emitting a whistling sound.
Boom!
Er Pang directly faced the second-tier Mutated Giant Pig at the forefront, the strongest in build, wielding the iron rod like a celestial pillar, fiercely striking down on the giant pig’s forehead.
Boom!
Supreme Giant Power unleashed, the Mutated Giant Pig’s head exploded, blood and brain matter splattering, its massive body lifelessly falling to the ground.
Second-tier Mutant Beasts stood no chance against Er Pang, a third-tier.
The other Corpse Puppets also began engaging the Mutated Giant Pigs continuously, and with Lightning One and Flame One present, the remaining Mutated Giant Pigs were soon slaughtered completely.
Instructing the Corpse Puppets to transport the bodies of the Mutated Giant Pigs down the mountain, Lu Chuan looked at the dozen or so Crystal Cores in Er Pang’s hands, feeling very pleased.
"I wonder if this time, we can encounter a third-tier Mutated Fierce Beast!"
Looking at the vast forest in front, Lu Chuan secretly anticipated.
...
Farm.
Inside the room, Ji Ruxue, who should have been obediently resting in bed due to lunchtime, had already sneaked up.
She knew her father was commanding zombies to hunt Fierce Beasts again and wouldn’t be distracted enough to notice her.
So, she prepared to sprint for the fourth-tier realm.
Sitting cross-legged on the bed, closing her eyes and focusing her mind, Ji Ruxue began practicing the Glazed Breathing Technique.
Surrounding Energy Factors, following Ji Ruxue’s special breathing, transformed into a trickling stream, flowing into Ji Ruxue’s petite body.
As time passed, the energy flowing into Ji Ruxue’s body increased, and the aura she radiated gradually rose.
Boom!
It was as if a thunderclap sounded in her ear, Ji Ruxue’s aura surged upwards, then swept through the entire room like a tidal wave!
From this point, Ji Ruxue successfully ascended to the fourth-tier, becoming a fourth-tier Evolver.
The energy within her body, like an unending river, continually transformed Ji Ruxue’s physique, her skin as white as jade, making her look like a porcelain doll.
The nourishment from energy caused Ji Ruxue’s figure to grow slightly larger, her aura strong and vigorous, containing terrifying power within her delicate body.
Apart from greatly enhancing her body, Ji Ruxue’s Telekinesis also surged again, with significant improvement in her Spiritual Power.
With a thought, Ji Ruxue’s body instantly floated up.
The next moment, Ji Ruxue transformed into streaks of light, flying swiftly around the room.
After a few breaths, Ji Ruxue returned to the bed, her eyes filled with joy. With her current Telekinesis strength, she could already sustain prolonged aerial flight.
And her speed was incredibly fast, with greatly enhanced offensive and defensive capabilities.
Additionally, after reaching the fourth-tier, in increased Evolver power, she could already employ Cultivation Techniques to manipulate Energy Factors of the universe, finally able to perform some of her past life’s Secret Techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 193: Spirit Communication Technique! Dad Actually Planted the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine Outside the Farm?
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 193: Spirit Communication Technique! Dad Actually Planted the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine Outside the Farm?
In her past life, as an empress, Ji Ruxue knew an enormous amount of Divine Power Secret Techniques, many of which she was incredibly skilled at.
However, these Secret Techniques basically all required Energy Factors as the energy source for casting.
Now, having smoothly broken through the fourth tier, she could already use Cultivation Techniques to guide external Energy Factors, casting some simple Secret Techniques.
Ji Ruxue’s expression became serious as she extended her small hand, maneuvering the surrounding Energy Factors to gather in her palm.
The next moment, a bright red Spiritual Light ignited in Ji Ruxue’s tender little hand, a flame of extreme liveliness hovering above her palm, emitting an endless fiery glow, causing the room’s temperature to continuously rise, with waves of heat surging.
With a thought, the flame above her palm transformed into a crimson serpent, flying into the air, constantly weaving around. Moments later, the crimson serpent morphed into a fiery red bird, soaring up and down.
A fiery horse galloping, a red fish swimming, a red eagle spreading its wings... In the room, under Ji Ruxue’s gaze, the cluster of flames kept changing forms.
Fire Spirit Technique!
A relatively simple Elemental Secret Technique that can condense emotionally endowed flames, taking the form of various animals, making it a practical Secret Technique.
Next, Ji Ruxue curved her palm.
Poof!
The flames that were constantly changing in mid-air went out instantly.
In addition to the Fire Spirit Technique, Ji Ruxue then tried various Elemental Spells like the Thunder Strike Technique, Earth Spike Technique, and Earth Escape Technique, causing the entire room to be dazzling and ever-changing.
However, as the place was really not suitable, Ji Ruxue was in a state of holding back when attempting these Secret Techniques.
After trying, she quickly disconnected, causing the Secret Technique to dissipate swiftly.
After eagerly trying all sorts of Secret Techniques, Ji Ruxue finally calmed down.
Even so, there was still a hint of a smile in Ji Ruxue’s eyes, lingering for a long time.
With the support of Secret Techniques, her power compared to before was worlds apart; now with the greater strength, she could finally protect her father’s safety.
In the future, anyone who dares to invade my farm, Ji Ruxue will let them know the consequences.
Afterwards, Ji Ruxue saw her father still focused on controlling the zombies, so she climbed off the bed herself, put on her princess shoes, and slowly walked to the orchard.
In the orchard, many fruits were ripe, emitting an intoxicating fragrance.
Ji Ruxue stood under a pear tree, ready to experiment and see how powerful her Secret Technique could be.
Buzz~
Just then, a bee buzzed around, flying back and forth.
Seeing the bee, Ji Ruxue’s eyes brightened.
Immediately, Ji Ruxue’s gaze sharpened, a flash of white light appeared, and a very noticeable Energy Wave emerged around her.
The next moment, the bee that was flying around paused in mid-air, then quickly flew to Ji Ruxue’s side, hovering there, motionless, as if it were a soldier waiting for the order from its commander.
Secret Technique — Spirit Communication Technique!
Capable of Spirit Communication with various animals and using their perspective to view the outside world.
Of course, this Spirit Communication Technique is not omnipotent and can only control some small animals.
Staring at the small body of the bee, Ji Ruxue’s eyes rolled, and she immediately willed it to move.
The little bee instantly flew in the direction behind Ji Ruxue.
Soon after, through the bee’s vision, Ji Ruxue successfully saw Zhao Lin.
This foolish woman, at the moment, was lying on a chair outside, lazily basking in the sun?
The bee under Ji Ruxue’s control quickly flew over, landing on Zhao Lin’s face, with several legs crawling around on her face.
"Hmm..."
Half-awake Zhao Lin only felt an itch on her face, instinctively reaching out to scratch, swiping a few times before stopping.
And just as Zhao Lin reached out, the bee flew up, landing on the other side of her face after she finished scratching, crawling around again.
Feeling the itch, Zhao Lin scratched her face once more.
The bee narrowly escaped in the nick of time.
"Hmph, really treating this place as if it’s your own home? No vigilance at all!"
Seeing Zhao Lin fail to notice even after two times, not even intending to open her eyes, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but sneer.
However, she also felt a bit helpless at heart, as this fellow now performed even worse than before in the Jianghai City District.
It seems like she’s gotten lax!
The main reason being that her father protected the farm too well, too safely, without giving this fellow any sense of crisis.
Over time...
This Nine Deaths Demon Police unknowingly believed they still lived in the peaceful times from before.
"Today, I’ll teach you a lesson!"
A mischievous smile appeared on Ji Ruxue’s tender little face.
The next moment, the bee hovering above Zhao Lin’s head went into action again, starting to repeatedly tease Zhao Lin.
Every time Zhao Lin felt an itch on her face and wanted to grab at it, the bee would swiftly fly away, landing on the other side of her face.
Once or twice might be okay, but as this happened multiple times, Zhao Lin started to notice something was wrong.
"What’s going on!"
Zhao Lin irritably opened her eyes, suddenly realizing that something was on her nose, giving her a fright and instinctively wanting to swat it away.
But just before that, the bee smugly flew off Zhao Lin’s nose, provocatively circling several times in front of her before swiftly flying higher.
"Damn it, you filthy bee, get back here!!!"
It was at this point that Zhao Lin finally understood that the unusual feeling on her face earlier was all caused by this bee.
Disrupting her sleep and indirectly teasing her, Zhao Lin was furious, grabbing the square pillow in her hand and throwing it towards the bee.
Unfortunately, the bee had already flown high, the pillow not able to reach.
"Filthy bee, if you dare to come again, I won’t let you off..."
Below her came bursts of Zhao Lin’s impotent rage, making Ji Ruxue chuckle, deciding not to bother her anymore and instead controlled the bee to fly out of the farm.
"This place is so clean, thanks to father’s tidying up!"
Ji Ruxue noted how neat the surroundings were; once overgrown with weeds, it had transformed entirely.
It seems that father had put in considerable effort.
However, Ji Ruxue wasn’t too surprised since she realized that her father could command zombies to assist with the chores.
"Are these... Bloodthirsty Vines!!!"
But when the bee flew near the Bloodthirsty Vine, Ji Ruxue was shocked to see that her father had planted the Bloodthirsty Vine outside the farm.
Controlling the bee to circle around the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest, Ji Ruxue finally understood the intention.
Presently, her eyes were filled with a smile, touched deeply.
Father planted this Bloodthirsty Vine Forest outside, surely with her safety in mind.
With the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest present, many Mutated Fierce Beasts and Evolved Zombies wouldn’t dare slip into the farm unnoticed.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 194: Invisibility Squad! Li Ying’s Dilemma!
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 194: Invisibility Squad! Li Ying’s Dilemma!
Buzzing~
Outside Jiangnan City District, a helicopter swiftly approached. Soon, it hovered over a relatively flat piece of grassland.
The strong wind from the blades above continuously stirred the dry grass and trees below.
The next moment, five long ropes were thrown down from the helicopter, landing on the ground.
Soon after, five fully armed Evolvers stepped out of the helicopter, quickly sliding down to the ground using the ropes.
Thud, thud, thud~
After landing.
The five quickly unbuckled their waists, releasing the restraints, then took out their carried weapons, stepped forward a few paces, and watched their surroundings with vigilance.
This five-member team was the invisibility team sent by Jianghai Base City to scout Jiangnan City District this time.
All five were Invisibility Ability Users.
This team’s mission was to use the advantage of invisibility to infiltrate Jiangnan City District, investigate situations, and gather intelligence.
Especially this time in Jiangnan City District, regarding the disappearance of Evolved Zombies and the intelligence of zombies, was the focus of their scouting.
And one of them was Li Ying, who had once entered Qingshui Farm and luckily survived in Ji Ruxue’s hands.
Actually, when he first received this mission, Li Ying was very resistant. He was living well in the Base City.
With his status as an Evolver, his treatment was much better than other survivors. He could live in the Inner City, and though it wasn’t comparable to the pre-apocalyptic world, he was already satisfied.
So he never wanted to return to this place, Jiangnan City District, ever again.
A place that gave him a significant psychological shadow!!!
Unfortunately, this time, it was a mandatory order from the Base City, something an ordinary Evolver like him couldn’t refuse.
Not going?
The consequence of not going was the loss of all treatment, and he would be expelled from the Base City.
Eventually, Li Ying had no choice but to agree to this mission.
And once back here, Li Ying naturally thought of that eerie little girl in the farm, whose grasp still held his life.
The other side wanted him to infiltrate the Base City to obtain some intelligence...
"That little girl..."
Glancing clandestinely in the direction of Qingshui Farm, Li Ying’s heart was filled with struggle, but because of his comrades on the side, he didn’t show it.
Should he deliver a message, this time’s affairs would definitely involve the other side.
Li Ying was conflicted.
As a human enjoying a stable life in the Base City, he naturally stood with the Base City’s side innately, but he hadn’t forgotten that his life was in the other’s hands.
This time, if something happened on the other side, he would surely not fare well either.
Seeing no apparent danger around, the team of five finally felt somewhat relieved.
Among them, a stout middle-aged man with a scar on his face surveyed the others with a serious expression, "Everyone, gather around!"
Li Ying came to his senses, pushed down his inner turmoil, and with a few steps, walked to the middle-aged man’s side with a normal expression.
This speaking middle-aged man was the leader of this invisibility team. The team’s actions had to follow the leader’s arrangements.
The other three also quickly walked over.
"We are now about ten kilometers from Jiangnan City District! Before coming, everyone should have seen the Base City’s information; this mission carries significant risks, so everyone must be cautious when infiltrating!"
The leader looked at the four, speaking sternly.
The four nodded, their sense of crisis rising.
The data recorded the mysterious deaths of two members of Wang Lei’s team. Their strength wasn’t weaker, yet they died silently, already corpses when found, hung up.
"Also, our task this time is intelligence gathering. The mission is paramount; do not go off on a tangent, understood?"
The leader’s tone grew heavier in the second half, filled with a warning.
"Don’t worry, Captain, we will remember!"
The four nodded again.
"Alright, let’s move out!"
Hearing this, the captain’s eyes showed satisfaction.
He was worried these few were too naive, that after entering Jiangnan City District, sympathizing with any desperate survivors might distract them from their mission.
It must be understood, although invisibility was useful, like any ability, it couldn’t be maintained continuously, consuming one’s energy continuously.
They had to use their abilities entirely for the mission, not waste resources on saving those ordinary people who were of no use.
At least, these four seemed sober enough. After all, having been tempered in the apocalyptic world, they generally wouldn’t make mistakes in this matter.
He added his words just in case.
This mission came from the top command; if they messed up, the consequences were conceivable.
Afterward, checking their carried items, the five quickly pressed towards Jiangnan City District.
...
Jiangnan City District, Stadium.
Roar, roar, roar~
A series of hair-raising roars came from the stadium, exuding a thick, foul stench.
At this moment, Lu Chuan was controlling Corpse Puppets, feeding the newly formed zombie horde.
Rumble~
The main entrance was slowly opened by Tyrant No. 1.
Carts loaded with mutated flesh were pushed in by Corpse Puppets. Under the menace of Tyrant No. 1, the zombies inside retreated tactfully.
Then, Lu Chuan directed Tyrant No. 1 to start throwing flesh into the zombie horde.
The zombies, smelling the scent of flesh, madly pounced, incessantly gnawing and devouring.
"Eat, eat! It seems the next harvest isn’t far away!"
Lu Chuan glanced at the chaotic zombie horde, thinking silently.
These zombies were his Crystal Core providers, so he had to serve them well.
Qingshui Farm.
As peaceful as usual.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue was sitting cross-legged in the room, meditating, manipulating her Cultivation Technique, and stabilizing her realm.
Energy Factors around her, under an invisible pull, quickly surged into Ji Ruxue’s body. Soon, her previously restless aura stabilized at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Suddenly, Ji Ruxue opened her eyes, a sharp glint fleeting swiftly.
She seemed to sense something approaching Jiangnan City District continuously, with a connection to herself.
The next moment, Ji Ruxue understood, a cold glint flashed in her eyes.
She knew what it was.
It was that Invisibility Ability User, Li Ying...
He finally knew to come back!
After she controlled him, she dispatched him into Jianghai Base City, and now quite some time had passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 195: Warning! Li Ying Meets Ji Ruxue!
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 195: Warning! Li Ying Meets Ji Ruxue!
It was something that could make Ji Ruxue have such a sensation.
In this lifetime, besides Li Ying with whom she signed a Soul Contract, Ji Ruxue couldn’t think of anyone else.
Li Ying had been silent for so long that Ji Ruxue almost forgot about him.
"This guy has been gone for so long, finally knowing to return!"
Ji Ruxue’s gaze was icy, and she let out a cold hum.
After detecting the opponent’s direction of advancement, Ji Ruxue became even more displeased.
The other party wasn’t heading toward Qingshui Farm at all, meaning this time his return likely wasn’t with the purpose of delivering intelligence to her.
"Looks like he has forgotten about me! Well, don’t blame me then..."
In the next moment, Ji Ruxue directly invoked the power of the Soul Contract to pull the distant Li Ying.
Three kilometers outside Jiangnan City District, the five members of Shadow Squad were rapidly advancing in a formation that balanced attack and defense, quickly approaching Jiangnan City District.
At the moment Ji Ruxue launched her offensive.
"Ah!"
Li Ying, who was just behind the captain, suddenly let out a cry of pain, feeling his mind convulse, dizzy and as if a needle was incessantly stabbing his brain.
Li Ying swayed and nearly lost his balance.
This soul-wrenching pain, if not for the strength of his Evolver body, might have overwhelmed Li Ying, causing him to faint.
"Li Ying, what’s wrong? Are you not feeling well?"
The captain walking in front noticed Li Ying’s abnormality immediately, surprised, stopped, and turned to look at him.
The mission hasn’t even started yet!
"Please, don’t let anything unexpected happen!"
Because of the pain, Li Ying understood immediately why he was experiencing sudden headaches.
It was the girl who acted.
Instantly, a feeling of fear surged in his heart, cold sweat broke out on Li Ying’s back, his body trembling slightly.
Damn it, is this a warning?
"Li Ying! Li Ying? Are you okay?"
"Li Ying, do you want to rest for a while?"
Li Ying’s abnormality caught the attention of his teammates, who all came over after ensuring there was no danger around, looking at Li Ying with concern.
Regaining his senses, seeing everyone watching him, Li Ying hurriedly waved his hand and said, "It’s nothing, nothing, no need to worry!"
His true identity was a spy and must not be revealed to these people.
"Captain, shall we keep moving?"
Li Ying looked at the captain.
"You’re really okay?"
"I’m fine, Captain! The mission is urgent, let’s get going!"
Li Ying said with a smile.
"Alright, if something doesn’t feel right, remember to speak up. Let’s keep moving! Everyone maintain the previous formation, aim to get into Jiangnan City District before dark, and find a place to settle!"
Seeing Li Ying looking normal and seemingly untroubled, the captain nodded at him and turned to instruct the others.
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
Next, with a heavy heart, Li Ying followed behind the squad and continued advancing toward Jiangnan City District.
...
Qingshui Farm
"Hmph!"
Ji Ruxue let out a cold snort, considering it as punishment.
If Li Ying still doesn’t come to see her tonight, she won’t be soft-hearted.
When he snuck into Qingshui Farm and saw secrets he shouldn’t have, he should have been killed.
However, at the time Ji Ruxue thought she could use his identity to infiltrate Jiangnan Base City to gather intelligence.
That was the only reason she mercifully gave him a chance to live.
But if Li Ying doesn’t appreciate it...
A disobedient pawn is useless to keep.
Might as well send him off directly.
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue’s face turned stern, with a glint of murderous intent in her large round eyes, mismatched with her age.
Knock knock knock!
Just then, the sound of knocking was heard.
Hearing the sound, Ji Ruxue immediately snapped back to reality, realizing it was her father calling her to dinner.
"Coming, Dad!"
Ji Ruxue’s face quickly lit up with a smile, emitting a sweet voice, she got off the bed, wore her little white shoes, and hurriedly walked out with her short steps.
......
Nighttime in Jiangnan City District was not quiet.
Dark streets were teeming with roaming zombies.
The zombies wandered aimlessly, walking back and forth again and again, from the darkness, there were occasional chilling roars of zombies.
Inside the old residential building on the outskirts of the city, five figures quietly hid in the corner of a room resting.
They were the already invisibly infiltrated Shadow Squad in Jiangnan City District.
"I observed when we came over, this Jiangnan City District is consistent with the information, indeed very abnormal without a single Evolved Zombie in sight!"
"Everyone, rest well tonight, early tomorrow we will go out to investigate and see if we can find any relevant clues."
The captain instructed the four beside him in a low voice.
"Captain, we haven’t clarified the dangers of Jiangnan City District yet, plus the zombies outside, we must have someone on night watch to prevent unexpected situations during sleep!"
At this time, a nearby Invisible suggested solemnly.
"Naturally, someone has to keep watch!"
Hearing him, the captain nodded unsurprisingly, he already had this idea.
After all, if no one is guarding, and at night they all fall into a deep sleep, surrounded by zombies, it would be disastrous.
Although the five of them were Invisible, facing a mass of zombies, they could only wait for death.
Just as the captain was about to volunteer for night watch, Li Ying’s eyes flashed and he volunteered, "Captain, I’ll keep watch!"
The captain was slightly stunned, then looked at Li Ying with a bit of appreciation, nodded and said, "Alright, Li Ying, it’s up to you tonight."
Over the following days, we’ll take turns keeping watch, tonight it’s you, tomorrow night will be the next person, this way we can ensure rest."
After confirming the night watch among them, seeing the night deepen, the five members each ate some dry food and then went to sleep.
Seeing the four asleep, Li Ying’s eyes flickered, feeling uneasy.
However, it was still early, so he didn’t act recklessly. Like a normal night watch, he leaned against the door alone, alert to any changes around him.
Standing there quietly, Li Ying stared at the street filled with wandering zombies, recalling earlier times meeting that little girl; her methods were ruthless and she was surely not one to show mercy.
The agony in his head during the day, both a warning and a reminder, if he didn’t meet her tonight, he reckoned his life would be over.
Time passed slowly, reaching deep into the night, and after confirming the four were asleep, Li Ying slowed his steps and quietly slipped out.
Then, he activated his Shadow status to avoid the roaming zombies in the street, heading toward Qingshui Farm.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 196: Ji Ruxue’s Killing Intent! Anyone Dares Target My Dad Is Asking for Death!
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 196: Ji Ruxue’s Killing Intent! Anyone Dares Target My Dad Is Asking for Death!
"Dad, I’m going to bed first."
Finishing off the last bite from her small bowl, Ji Ruxue grabbed a tissue with her little hand to wipe her mouth, looking at Lu Chuan with her big, watery eyes.
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan nodded.
Ji Ruxue jumped off the chair and hurried back to her room, closing the door carefully before continuing to stabilize her cultivation.
The night deepened.
The farm gradually fell silent, with only the footsteps from patrolling Corpse Puppets echoing distinctively through the night.
In the amusement park, Zhao Lin lay sound asleep on a bed beneath the slide.
Ji Ruxue, sitting cross-legged on her bed, suddenly opened her eyes, her gaze flickering.
She sensed Li Ying’s location; he was approaching the farm.
"Consider yourself lucky, I’ll spare your life."
Ji Ruxue thought to herself.
It seemed he understood her intentions; otherwise, he wouldn’t have come so late.
However, thinking about the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine planted outside and not wanting him to disturb her father, Ji Ruxue decided to go out and meet him.
Quietly, Ji Ruxue got off the bed, secretly opened the window facing the orchard, and, taking advantage of the gap during the Corpse Puppet patrol, wrapped her body in telekinesis and flew out.
Once out of the room, Ji Ruxue quickly increased her flying altitude, swiftly soaring over the walls and Bloodthirsty Vine Forest, using the cover of night to leave the farm.
A mile away from the farm, Li Ying was moving invisibly along a road.
At that moment, the closer he got to the farm, the more uneasy he felt, unsure of how the little girl would treat him upon seeing him.
She had tasked him with infiltrating Jianghai Base City, and so far, he hadn’t brought back any useful information for her.
Suddenly, Li Ying was startled, his eyes wide open, and he came to an abrupt halt.
A small figure was flying towards him at high speed.
"It’s that guy..."
Li Ying immediately realized who it was and stood in place, waiting for her approach.
Knowing the other was ruthless, Li Ying wore a respectful look, not daring to show any disrespect.
Moments later, Ji Ruxue flew over, her gaze oppressively fixing on Li Ying as she coldly said, "You finally came. Did you forget about the intelligence you were supposed to send back, or do you really want to die?"
Li Ying’s heart tightened, sensing the murderous intent in her tone; it wasn’t false. She had truly considered killing him.
Faced with a life-and-death situation, Li Ying dared not hesitate and immediately knelt down, apologizing with a face full of regret, "My lord, I haven’t forgotten the task you assigned. It’s just that, after joining Jiangnan Base City, I’ve been swamped with many matters and couldn’t find time. Please forgive me!"
"From now on, I will surely provide you with more intelligence. Please, spare my life!"
Li Ying’s body trembled with fear. The other’s power was too terrifying, and he had no thought of resistance, only the humiliating plea for a dog’s life.
He understood that resisting would only result in death.
"Hmph, tonight was your last chance, consider yourself lucky. If you hadn’t come to meet me tonight, I would’ve popped your head with a thought!"
Ji Ruxue snorted coldly. This guy was afraid of death, and it was only the threat to his life that motivated him to act.
Ji Ruxue was extremely angry at him for not delivering intelligence. If he wasn’t the only candidate at the moment, she would’ve already gotten rid of him.
Hearing Ji Ruxue’s words, Li Ying, already sweating profusely with fear, felt a sense of relief, knowing that his life was temporarily spared.
The other valued the intelligence about Jiangnan Base City more; it seemed if he wanted to survive under her, he must relay the relevant information.
Thinking of this, Li Ying felt a twinge of guilt towards the Base City.
However, this feeling of guilt quickly vanished,
Man serves himself first, or the heavens will destroy him; he was in a life-and-death situation and had no time to worry about anything else. Surviving was the priority.
"So tell me, what news have you brought from Jiangnan Base City? You should understand that your survival hinges on your ability to supply me with intelligence. If what you share is trivial, imagine the consequences..."
Ji Ruxue said coldly.
Though curious about the intelligence Li Ying delivered this time, Ji Ruxue was particularly interested. After all, Jianghai Base City was the largest official survivor camp in the area, and any major event that happened there piqued her interest.
Upon hearing this, Li Ying realized the other might have misunderstood his visit; she thought he came solely to deliver intelligence, rather than completing a mission.
Even so, Li Ying didn’t intend to hide. From the moment he secretly left the team for the farm, his choice was clear without needing more words.
"My lord, this time, coming to Jiangnan City District was due to a mission. I was dispatched by the Base to investigate an issue that involves you."
Li Ying quickly said.
"Involves me? Explain in detail, tell the story from start to finish."
Ji Ruxue was a bit puzzled, wondering what issue could involve her. Could the Jiangnan Base City have discovered the farm?
"Here’s how it is, my lord. Previously, after Wang Lei’s team returned to the base from Jiangnan City District, they reported the information they gathered to the higher-ups.
Information such as not seeing any Evolved Zombies and even witnessing zombies driving vehicles to transport supplies, which led the higher-ups to conclude that a Corpse King had appeared in Jiangnan City District."
"So to further confirm this, the Base dispatch the Shadow Squad to investigate and search for clues. Our squad consists of five members, including myself."
Li Ying explained everything to Ji Ruxue.
"Shadow Squad? Corpse King?"
"What is the ultimate goal of your Base City? What if you find the Corpse King?"
Ji Ruxue was shocked, not expecting Jianghai Base City had already sent people to investigate. Although surprised, she remained calm on the surface and asked.
"I hold a low position and don’t know the upper management’s exact plans. But the captain mentioned that usually, a Corpse King, being highly dangerous, would be eliminated immediately upon discovery to prevent further growth."
Li Ying thought and said hesitantly.
After hearing Li Ying’s words, Ji Ruxue was immediately filled with murderous intent, eyes cold as ice.
"Hmph! Dare to make a move against my father, courting death!"

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 197: Crushing! Subjugation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 197: Crushing! Subjugation!
Gradually calming down, Ji Ruxue looked at Li Ying and asked coldly, "You came alone, right? Did you expose the farm in any way?"
"Reporting to you, I indeed came quietly alone, and I had no intention of exposing the farm!"
Li Ying, panicking in his heart, hurriedly began to explain.
"There are five people in your Invisibility unit. Where are the other four now?" Ji Ruxue asked.
"Master, the other four are still asleep in a building on the outskirts of Jiangnan City District."
Li Ying, though puzzled, replied truthfully.
"Alright, now take me there!"
Ji Ruxue’s eyes were icy, and an ominous aura surrounded her, obviously intent on killing these people.
She wouldn’t allow anyone who poses a threat to zombie dad to remain alive.
The invisibility unit sent by Jiangnan Base City could trace the clues back to the farm, and once they exposed the location to Jiangnan Base City, it could become a big problem.
Hearing Ji Ruxue’s demand, Li Ying hesitated.
Ah~
The next second, he experienced a sharp headache, as if hit by a heavy hammer, feeling as though his head might explode, with pain piercing deep.
At the same time, the intense pain caused his whole body to convulse, and shake uncontrollably.
Bang!
Li Ying crashed powerlessly to the ground, face contorted, clutching his head and crying out in agony.
"Humph, dare to disobey my orders, this is the consequence. The taste of the Soul Contract isn’t pleasant, right!"
Ji Ruxue suspended in the air, eyes contemptuous, sneered.
This guy needed to be taught a lesson, as his intentions were unstable; only constant harsh measures could keep him in line.
"Ah~ Master, I realize my mistake..."
Li Ying, pale with pain, begged for mercy, voice trembling uncontrollably.
The pain, too intense, made Li Ying feel he might faint from it at any moment.
Seeing Li Ying comply, Ji Ruxue finally stopped, ceasing to activate the Soul Contract.
Phew~
Li Ying’s pain vanished instantly, feeling relieved, he lay on the ground, exhaling deeply.
Boom!
Ji Ruxue’s expression was indifferent, as she extended her hand, a blaze shot into the sky; it was a ferocious three-yard-long Fire Serpent, energetically flying in the air, streaking past Li Ying, emitting a terrifying hiss, while the surrounding temperature rapidly rose, scorching the cool night.
"What is this?"
Li Ying, lying on the ground, was stunned, eyes wide open.
"Li Ying, you’re merely an Invisibility Evolver; although you excel in stealth, in combat, the gap between you and other Evolvers, you should be well aware."
"However, as long as you complete the tasks I assign, I can teach you cultivation techniques and secret techniques to enhance your strength; allowing an Invisibility Evolver like you to possess formidable power."
Ji Ruxue adhered to the principle of giving a stick and a sweet date, promising great benefits to Li Ying.
Upon hearing this, Li Ying was moved. If he could obtain such cultivation techniques and secret techniques, his teammates mattered little, let them be sacrifices on his path to power!
Laboriously rising, Li Ying wiped his sweaty forehead, looking at Ji Ruxue with some fear, respectfully bowing, "Master, please follow me. I’ll take you there right away."
With that said, Li Ying turned back and retraced his steps.
Ji Ruxue revealed a satisfied look, immediately concealing her aura, followed behind the invisible Li Ying.
Half an hour later, Ji Ruxue finally arrived with Li Ying at the residential building where they previously camped.
"Li Ying, where did you run off to? Not guarding properly, why are you roaming?"
The captain had already awakened, faced Li Ying with a scowl, and angrily rebuked when he returned.
Before finishing speaking, he saw a figure behind Li Ying, seemingly a child.
"Who are you?"
As soon as the captain saw Ji Ruxue, he sensed something was wrong. Although she had a child’s body, her demeanor and aura were completely unlike one.
Li Ying found such a clean girl in the zombie-ridden Jiangnan City District, something was certainly off, extremely off.
Upon the captain’s questioning, Li Ying showed a momentary flicker of guilt and silently moved aside, no longer speaking.
The other team members thereafter also reacted, holding guns, warily staring at Ji Ruxue.
"Speak, who are you? Li Ying, say something!"
The captain pointed a gun at Ji Ruxue, questioning Li Ying who was shrinking aside.
"You don’t need to know who I am, just know that you are about to die..."
Ji Ruxue’s eyes were chilling, her tone full of murderous intent. Compared to her at the fourth evolution stage, these Invisibility Evolvers were like ants, hardly a match.
Bang!
Unexpectedly, before Ji Ruxue finished speaking, a gunshot sounded suddenly from the corner.
It turned out that a nervous member of the Invisibility unit had pulled the trigger.
This sudden change startled everyone.
At this moment, an invisible force surged from Ji Ruxue.
Whoosh!
The incoming bullet magically stopped in front of Ji Ruxue, as if caught by something, unable to advance.
"What!!!"
Seeing this, the invisibility unit’s four members were shocked, bewildered by what sort of monstrous being this little girl was, so terrifying.
Bang bang bang!
Realizing the situation was wrong, the captain’s eyes turned fierce, quickly firing several shots.
Yet, none of the bullets fulfilled their purpose, they all stopped before Ji Ruxue.
Then, Ji Ruxue unleashed her Telekinesis to engulf the entire room.
The next moment, a powerful force acted on the invisibility unit’s captain, his neck cracked sharply, instantly turning his head 180 degrees, blood trickling from his mouth, body falling limp.
!!!
Witnessing Ji Ruxue’s methods, the two remaining members were terrified, bodies trembling constantly, even their gun-holding hands shook.
Under Ji Ruxue’s sharp gaze, they finally caved, perhaps seeing Li Ying’s obedience, they simultaneously knelt, begging for their lives.
"Mercy, mercy, I don’t want to die..."
"Master, don’t kill me, I’ll obey you!"
The two continuously bowed their heads, pounding the floor with a "bang bang" echo.
In the corner, the team member who fired also came to his senses from the shock, learning from the two, knelt down, and begged for mercy incessantly.
"..."
This made Ji Ruxue, who originally intended to kill them, entertain another idea.
Perhaps they could be tamed like Li Ying.
Coldly gazing at the three: "Submit or die!"
...
Meanwhile
Lu Chuan at the farm suddenly opened his eyes, showing a hint of surprise.
"If I heard correctly just now, was that... gunfire?"

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 198: Lu Chuan’s Shock—Is This a Tier 4 Evolver?
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 198: Lu Chuan’s Shock—Is This a Tier 4 Evolver?
Looking at the three people in front of her, Ji Ruxue’s eyes carried contempt; just like Li Ying, they were people who feared death and clung to life.
But it’s understandable, as these people were ordinary before the apocalypse.
Although they had become Evolvers, possessing Extraordinary Abilities and enhanced bodies, their minds hadn’t transformed along with their capabilities.
You can’t expect an ordinary person to face death calmly.
"You three, come here!"
Looking at the three, Ji Ruxue said indifferently.
Hearing Ji Ruxue’s words, the three people were relieved, faces showing joy, and without hesitation, hurried over.
The three stood in a line, respectfully, looking at Ji Ruxue with eyes full of anxiety and fear.
"Next, you three must not resist! Whoever resists will end up like him!"
Ji Ruxue pointed to the captain’s corpse, warning coldly.
"Yes, yes, sir, please do as you will, we won’t resist at all."
Confused about what Ji Ruxue intended to do but seeing the captain’s cold body, the fear in their hearts compelled them to nod nonstop.
Standing by the door, Li Ying naturally knew what Ji Ruxue was about to do. Thinking that three more people would receive the same treatment as himself, he couldn’t help but gloat.
Being enslaved is not a pleasant experience.
Next, energy from Ji Ruxue circulated continuously within her body, emitting a powerful aura as her hands formed seals, and three drops of crimson blood flew out, hovering before the three individuals.
In the next moment, Ji Ruxue’s black-and-white eyes brimmed with endless frost, chilling any onlookers to the core. The three drops of blood transformed rapidly in the air, turning into three mysterious ancient blood-colored talismans.
Whiz!
The three ancient talismans, emitting a blood glow and rotating slowly, flashed and entered the foreheads of the three people.
Immediately, the three felt a great sense of danger descending upon them, instinctively wanting to resist. But recalling Ji Ruxue’s earlier warning and the captain’s cold corpse, they could only endure it, their bodies trembling uncontrollably, and sweat beaded on their foreheads.
Moments later, the three blood-colored talismans successfully imprinted in their minds.
"It’s done!"
Ji Ruxue’s voice, like a heavenly melody, brought a collective sigh of relief from the highly tense trio.
Seemingly without any change, after checking their bodies, the three thought secretly to themselves.
"You are now enslaved by me. From today onwards, your lives and deaths are in my hands. If I want you to live, you shall live; if I want you to die, you shall only die! Do you understand?"
Ji Ruxue said indifferently.
"What?"
The three were startled, finally realizing the talismans were meant to control them, and their hearts grew heavy with this understanding.
"Your only value in living is to complete the tasks I assign. If anyone takes it lightly, I’ll make it such that living will be worse than dying. You can ask Li Ying for specifics, as he knows well!"
With a cold laugh, Ji Ruxue turned to glance at Li Ying.
Hearing himself mentioned, Li Ying’s face turned bitter, recalling previous suffering, his hands couldn’t stop trembling.
Upon hearing this, the other three looked towards Li Ying, eyes harboring a hidden wrath.
The three weren’t keen on asking how living could be worse than dying; rather, they had figured out that Li Ying too was enslaved by the opponent.
Had it not been for Li Ying leading this person to them, they wouldn’t have ended up in such a state.
"You all better not start a conflict; if I discover it, face the consequences yourselves.
Once back at Jianghai Base City, just say there was no sign of the Corpse King.
As for this person’s death, whether you claim it was due to a Mutant Beast attack or an encounter with an Evolved Zombie... just find an excuse to brush it off, ensuring Jianghai Base City doesn’t suspect anything."
Seeing the expressions on the three’s faces, Ji Ruxue knew what they were thinking, issuing a warning before instructing them.
"Yes, ma’am!"
The three composed themselves and answered in unison.
Ji Ruxue nodded.
Just then, a series of faint footsteps echoed from the darkness in the distance.
Upon hearing the distant commotion, Ji Ruxue’s expression changed, and her Spiritual Power instantly spread out, sensing several powerful zombies approaching.
Are these dad’s zombies?
Ji Ruxue frowned and immediately understood what was happening.
It must have been the gunfire that startled dad.
She knew that the entire Jiangnan City District was under dad’s control, and gunfire suddenly erupting, creating an unexpected situation, meant that dad would definitely come to check it out.
"You all leave first, Evolved Zombies are coming, I’ll hold them off!"
Therefore, Ji Ruxue instructed Li Ying and the other three to leave.
She prepared to confront dad’s zombies.
"Yes!"
Hearing about the Evolved Zombies, the four felt a chill, nodded, quickly gathered their belongings, and then, under Ji Ruxue’s guidance, retreated in the opposite direction.
Watching the four use their Invisibility Ability to vanish into the night, Ji Ruxue quickly found a long coat in the residential building.
Then, she covered her body with the coat, hiding her face, and floated in mid-air.
Soon, Ji Ruxue saw several familiar figures appear, precisely dad’s controlled Evolved Zombies, including Agile Type and Tank Type Evolved Zombies holding iron rods, and quite a few third-level zombies.
She now had to hold off these zombies controlled by dad, to prevent dad from noticing any changes here and catching up to the Invisibility Squad, or else she would be exposed.
Thump thump thump~
Er Pang, Lightning One, Flame One, and other third-level Corpse Puppets, led a group of second-level Corpse Puppets along the street, rushing toward the residential building, each step echoing loudly.
Using Er Pang’s perspective, Lu Chuan looked at the residential building ahead, frowning slightly; the gunfire had just come from this direction.
In the next instant, under Lu Chuan’s command, a large number of Corpse Puppets began searching the area, while Er Pang and others, under Lu Chuan’s control, charged toward the residential building.
Just at that moment, Ji Ruxue unleashed Time Control, an invisible force swept over the Corpse Puppets like Er Pang.
Instantly, the Corpse Puppets that were charging upward, like Er Pang, froze in place.
Then Ji Ruxue released the Time Control, an endless torrent of Telekinesis swept out like ocean waves.
This Telekinesis seemed extremely viscous, clinging to the feet of third-level Corpse Puppets including Er Pang, Lightning One, and Flame One, imprisoning them in place.
Roar!
Under Lu Chuan’s manipulation, Er Pang and others let out a furious roar and struggled mightily, but no matter how hard they tried, they couldn’t break free from the grip of the Telekinesis.
Lu Chuan was utterly shocked!
The one acting in secret, could it be a fourth-level Evolver?

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 199: Pressure! Dad Was Really Frightened!
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 199: Pressure! Dad Was Really Frightened!
Lu Chuan refused to believe in evil. Once again, he controlled Lightning One and other Corpse Puppets, unleashing all their inner potential, trying to break free from the restraints.
Boom!
The ground shook violently, erupting with a burst of roar. Under the terrifying strength of the Corpse Puppets and Ji Ruxue’s telekinesis, the cement ground underfoot couldn’t withstand the immense force. It cracked directly, extending out into a web-like pattern.
At this moment, no matter how much effort Lightning One and other Corpse Puppets exerted, their bodies remained motionless.
And Er Pang, capitalizing on his strength advantage, managed to briefly lift his foot, but in the next second, an invisible pull yanked him back once again.
Seeing this, a look of shock flashed across Lu Chuan’s eyes.
After multiple attempts, still unable to break free, Lu Chuan had already drawn a conclusion in his mind.
The one intervening from the shadows had definitely reached the fourth tier.
Otherwise, it would be absolutely impossible to immobilize so many of his third-tier Corpse Puppets at once.
Just when Lu Chuan was at a loss, the restraint binding Lightning One and other Corpse Puppets suddenly disappeared.
The Corpse Puppets, who were struggling desperately, barely reacted, their bodies swayed, nearly tumbling to the ground.
"What’s going on? Why did the restraints disappear? Could it be that the fourth-tier Evolver hidden in the dark has already left?"
Lu Chuan was extremely surprised.
The reason the restraints disappeared was naturally because Ji Ruxue had stopped.
Just now, sensing that the Invisibility Squad had gone far away, Ji Ruxue no longer needed to hold back her father’s Evolved Zombies.
Subsequently, Ji Ruxue accelerated with her telekinesis, rising quickly, flying away from Jiangnan City District, and returned to the farm.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan, after freeing himself from the restraint, deployed the Corpse Tide Army to search the entire Jiangnan City District, hoping to find the person in the shadows.
Lu Chuan suspected that the person who made a move in the dark and the one who fired the gun were two different groups because the person who acted secretly was a fourth-tier Evolver. Noticing his Corpse Puppets approaching, they would have the capability to retreat swiftly.
The reason the other party didn’t leave but instead obstructed his Corpse Puppets was obviously to cover others’ escape.
After realizing this, Lu Chuan naturally wouldn’t miss this opportunity. He immediately mobilized all the zombies in Jiangnan City District to conduct a search.
Regrettably, under Lu Chuan’s command, the vast and mighty Corpse Tide Army, distributed throughout the city, practically turned Jiangnan City District upside down, yet yielded absolutely no results.
In the end, finding no option, Lu Chuan could only temporarily give up.
The reason Lu Chuan couldn’t find Li Ying and the others is because all four had Invisibility Ability and quickly left Jiangnan City District.
The Corpse Tide Army only searched within the city; naturally, they found nothing.
Inside the farm, a look of seriousness appeared in Lu Chuan’s eyes.
He originally just wanted to investigate who fired the shot in Jiangnan City District, thinking it was a survivor or an ordinary Evolver who wandered in.
But unexpectedly, he uncovered such a shocking piece of information.
Among humans, a fourth-tier Evolver had appeared, infiltrated Jiangnan City District, and even engaged with him.
What was the other party’s purpose? Was it related to him?
What was the relationship between this person and the Evolver who previously stopped him from acting against Zhao Lin? Was it the same person or just similar abilities?
And since this person could ascend to the fourth tier, were there other fourth-tier Evolvers?
Did the other party come from a human Survivor Base?
For a moment, various questions and speculations emerged in Lu Chuan’s mind. The sudden appearance of a fourth-tier Evolver made him feel a great sense of crisis.
Today, he had finally witnessed the true power of a fourth-tier Evolver.
Without a fourth-tier Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan had no confidence to deal with such Evolvers.
If a fourth-tier Evolver were to find him...
Lu Chuan had a clear self-awareness.
He was no longer human but a zombie, a zombie with intelligence. Once discovered by a fourth-tier Evolver, even if he could withstand the opponent’s attack, things wouldn’t end well for him.
Because revealing his existence meant that even if the fourth-tier Evolver couldn’t deal with him, the forces behind them, those mighty Survivor Bases, would come for him after receiving the Evolver’s report.
By then, even if he didn’t die, he’d have to go on the run.
He, a zombie, could survive anywhere, but what would happen to Little Qiqi? She was still so young. Without a farm full of supplies, how would she live with him, in a state of wandering?
"Sigh, have I become somewhat complacent recently?"
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan sighed inwardly.
Originally, after breaking through to the fourth tier, he was full of confidence, believing that in the Jiangnan City District region, no one could do anything to him, and that he was safe and sound.
But facing a fourth-tier Extraordinary who could immobilize his Corpse Puppets, he realized that his powers were far from sufficient.
Some third-tier Corpse Puppets had no power to resist when facing a fourth-tier Evolver.
The immobilization of Lightning One and other Corpse Puppets tonight was the best testimony.
Thankfully, he was remotely controlling the Corpse Puppets.
Once, at some future moment, if his true self were present, and the opponent immobilized the third-tier Corpse Puppets, wouldn’t he become a lamb to be slaughtered?
Lu Chuan did not fear a human army’s siege; he had the Corpse Tide Army. What he feared most was humans executing a decapitation strike against him.
Without the protection of powerful Corpse Puppets, he had no safety whatsoever in facing high-tier Evolvers.
"Indeed, humans cannot be underestimated. Previously, I saw too many of those useless Evolvers and wretched survivors, without realizing they were only part of humanity!"
Lu Chuan shook his head, bitterly smiling. Some humans evolved as quickly as he did. To ensure his own safety, perhaps he still needed to enhance his strength and continuously evolve.
As long as his Corpse Puppets could advance to the fourth tier, even those fourth-tier Evolvers wouldn’t be something he’d dread.
Inside the bedroom, Ji Ruxue sensed her father pacing back and forth in the living room, appearing anxious and restless. She wrinkled her little nose, a hint of worry in her eyes.
It seems that tonight’s incident really shocked her father.
But perhaps this was a good thing.
Now the Human Base City had already set its sights on the Jiangnan City District, yet her father was utterly unaware of it.
Tonight’s incident served as a wake-up call to keep her father vigilant, ensuring he stayed watchful over Jiangnan City District and guarded against potential intruders.
Ji Ruxue furrowed her brows, recalling Li Ying and the others who had left.
She wasn’t sure whether these few could deceive Jianghai Base City.
If they passed smoothly, then she and her father might still enjoy a period of peace.
It would be an excellent opportunity to develop further and swiftly enhance their powers.
By the time Jianghai Base City discovered something was amiss, they would be out of reach.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 200: Blood Refining Technique! Controlling the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine!
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 200: Blood Refining Technique! Controlling the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine!
The next morning.
