Early in the morning, the convoy set off from the farm with Lu Chuan’s eager anticipation, heading towards Yellow Dragon Mountain.
The appearance of a fourth-tier Human Evolver last night brought immense pressure to Lu Chuan.
To deal with and resolve this, naturally, the pace of becoming stronger must be accelerated.
Last night, Lu Chuan made up his mind that he must quickly raise all his third-tier Evolved Corpse Puppets to the fourth tier.
Only then would he have the confidence to face fourth-tier Human Evolvers.
In the upcoming period, he planned to battle day and night in Yellow Dragon Mountain, engaging in endless fights with the Mutated Fierce Beasts, to hunt more Crystal Cores.
Aiming to quickly raise Tyrant One and the others to the fourth tier.
...
At night, the sky had completely darkened.
As the farm’s gates opened, the convoy exuding a thick bloody scent slowly drove in.
The vehicles were loaded with numerous Fierce Beast corpses, blood-drenched, with blood continuously dripping down from the crevices of the cars.
Zhao Lin was lying on the bed beneath the playground slide, awakened by the noise, looking displeased and curiously peeking over.
Seeing the still-bleeding Mutated Fierce Beast corpses in the vehicles, Zhao Lin was shocked, her eyes wide open.
"Has this Corpse King gone mad? Slaughtering Mutated Fierce Beasts so late at night? Are these Mutated Fierce Beasts his enemies or what? Does he have to be so desperate?"
Zhao Lin’s eyes were full of confusion.
With long-term interaction, she could naturally see that apart from not being able to speak, the Corpse King was not much different from a normal human.
The other party must have a reason for such crazy behavior, but she didn’t know the details.
"Is Dad’s pressure a bit too much?"
Watching her father still focused on controlling the corpses to slaughter Fierce Beasts late at night, Ji Ruxue felt a bit distressed.
It seems like her intervention this time greatly frightened Dad.
Otherwise, Dad wouldn’t be fighting so hard.
"No way, I can’t let Dad be the only one working hard. I should do something for Dad too!"
Thinking that the Survivor Base had its eyes on them, Ji Ruxue also felt some pressure.
Although this time, the crisis was temporarily averted.
Ji Ruxue knew it was just a matter of buying more time, and eventually, there would be a battle between the two sides.
When that day comes, she and Dad must win!
"Right, the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine!"
"It’s a good thing. If I can control these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines to attack, it will definitely enhance the farm’s defense!"
Suddenly, Ji Ruxue’s eyes lit up as she thought of the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine her father had brought back.
Those Bloodthirsty Monsters are extremely useful.
If the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines are left to attack by instinct, their danger level may be one.
But if someone is controlling them from behind, their danger level could even increase to ten!
Subsequently, Ji Ruxue did not wait any longer, taking advantage of her father controlling the corpses to deal with the Fierce Beast corpses.
She wrapped herself in Telekinesis, taking advantage of the night, and flew outside the farm.
It didn’t take long for Ji Ruxue to arrive at the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall formed by the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines.
With copious amounts of beast blood nourishing them, these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines grew densely and vigorously.
Each Blood-colored Vine intertwined like blood-colored demon snakes, sealing off the surrounding space, emitting a strong bloody odor.
When they sensed a living being approaching, the originally still Blood-colored Vines seemed to awaken like blood-colored demon snakes, starting to wriggle constantly.
Soon, a section of the vine wall several zhang* long in front of Ji Ruxue, numerous Bloodthirsty Vines stretched towards her with all their might.
Unfortunately, due to their length, even if these Bloodthirsty Vines stretched to their fullest extent, their extremely sharp tips still couldn’t touch even a bit of Ji Ruxue.
Gazing at the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines before her, Ji Ruxue’s eyes flickered. To control these mindless Bloodthirsty Demon Vines, there’s only one good method, which is to use the Blood Refining Technique.
With a thought, Ji Ruxue extended her palm, and a bright and lustrous crimson Essence Blood emerged from her palm, suspended in front of her.
Then, Ji Ruxue activated her Cultivation Technique to guide the Energy Factors in the air.
Under the effect of the Energy Factors, this drop of Essence Blood kept rotating.
Ji Ruxue’s hands changed forming a seal, causing that drop of Essence Blood to rapidly change, with a flash of crimson light, transforming into a dozen smaller blood droplets.
A few breaths later, these blood droplets rotated under Ji Ruxue’s gaze, quickly turning into a dozen oddly shaped blood-colored marks.
Ji Ruxue looked to the bottom of the vine wall composed of Bloodthirsty Vines, searching for the main stems of the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines.
Each main stem was as thick as a drinking cup, growing exceptionally well under the constant baptism of beast blood from Lu Chuan.
Choosing one main stem, Ji Ruxue directed a blood-colored mark to fly towards it.
As long as the Blood Refining Seal successfully penetrated into the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine, the blood refining would be considered a success.
Whoosh!
The blood-colored mark shot out like a stream of light at high speed.
However, at this moment, those Bloodthirsty Demon Vines seemed to sense the blood-colored mark, with countless Bloodthirsty Vines thrashing wildly, shattering the incoming blood-colored mark.
Ji Ruxue’s expression stiffened, and she frowned.
"Troublesome!"
Fortunately, this kind of trouble is easy for her to solve.
In the next moment, Ji Ruxue’s hands changed, dispersing the dozen blood-colored marks, which transformed into streams of blood-colored light, flying towards the corresponding Bloodthirsty Demon Vine main stems.
And those Bloodthirsty Vines, as the blood-colored marks approached, thrashed wildly again like blood-colored iron whips, producing a continuous whooshing sound.
Just then, Ji Ruxue used Time Control to envelop a section of the area in front, immediately freezing the frantically waving Bloodthirsty Vines, rendering them immobile.
In an instant, the flying blood-colored marks successfully penetrated into the main stems of the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines.
A moment later, Ji Ruxue felt a certain connection established between herself and the dozen Bloodthirsty Demon Vines in front of her.
This connection not only allowed her to control the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines at will, but also enabled her to observe the external situation through the perspective of these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines.
With a thought, immediately the vines on the dozen Bloodthirsty Demon Vines seemed to receive a command.
Multiple Bloodthirsty Vines intertwined, forming bloodthirsty spears, and fiercely stabbed toward their targets, producing a series of piercing sounds.
Feeling the Bloodthirsty Vines move with ease like her limbs, Ji Ruxue nodded in satisfaction.
As long as she can blood refine all these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines, then this vine wall composed of Bloodthirsty Demon Vines can become a controllable and deadly defense line.
However, the number of Bloodthirsty Demon Vines is too great, and Ji Ruxue can only complete a small portion of blood refining at one time.
To complete all of them, Ji Ruxue estimated that it would take quite a bit of time.
After all, blood refining consumes Essence Blood, which is not limitless, so she can only refine a portion at a time after intervals.
```
(Note: "zhan" is a traditional Chinese unit of length, roughly equal to 3.3 meters.)

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 201: Wang Lei’s Suspicion! Things Are Definitely Not That Simple!
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 201: Wang Lei’s Suspicion! Things Are Definitely Not That Simple!
Jianghai Survivor Base.
Inner city, inside the meeting room.
Upon receiving the notice, Wang Lei, under the guard’s guidance, walked in.
"Commander!"
Upon seeing the highest commander, Wang Lei’s expression turned serious as he saluted.
"Captain Wang, please come and sit down!"
The highest commander showed no change in expression, nodding to Wang Lei and gesturing to the seat beside him.
"Commander! I’m not sure why I’ve been called here this time? Is there any news from the Invisibility Squad?"
Wang Lei sat down respectfully, looking toward the highest commander and urgently inquiring.
The reason he rushed over as soon as he received the notice was his guess that the Invisibility Squad might have returned with news.
"Yes, the Invisibility Squad has returned from investigating the Jiangnan City District."
The highest commander nodded.
"Is there news about the Corpse King?"
Wang Lei’s face showed a peculiar look as he pursued the question, his tone faintly urgent.
It was him who had reported the possible Corpse King news in the Jiangnan city district to the base city.
Upon confirmation of the Corpse King’s existence, he would have contributed to the base city.
Upon hearing this, the highest commander shook his head and stated calmly, "Captain Wang, you’re mistaken. According to the Invisibility Squad’s verification, there were no signs of the Corpse King throughout the Jiangnan City District!"
"What!!!"
"Impossible, how could there be none, clearly..."
Wang Lei was utterly shocked, his eyes wide open, filled with disbelief.
No, the Jiangnan City District doesn’t have any evolved zombies, yet ordinary zombies have demonstrated the intelligence to drive cars. Only a Corpse King could explain these two phenomena.
How could the Invisibility Squad not have detected anything unusual!
"The members of the Invisibility Squad are specially trained, highly professional in intelligence gathering and tracking. If they say it’s not there, it’s basically certain."
"Wang Lei, it seems you guessed wrong."
Seeing Wang Lei’s reaction, the highest commander spoke in a gentle tone.
Truth be told, the news from the Invisibility Squad that no Corpse King was found indeed provided a relief for the highest commander.
Because the absence of a Corpse King was the best possible news for the Jianghai base city.
If a Corpse King was truly found in Jiangnan city district, that would have been a headache for the highest commander. That overwhelming corpse tide would be something the Jianghai base city could not withstand.
After a moment of silence, Wang Lei finally calmed down. Despite finding it a bit unbelievable, he still accepted this as a fact. Actually, the absence of a Corpse King was also a good thing.
"Commander, it’s best if there’s none."
Wang Lei looked up at the highest commander, a smile appearing on his face.
"Of course, Captain Wang, to be honest, when you first reported that there might be a Corpse King hidden in the Jiangnan City District, it worried me for quite a while! Now, I finally feel at ease!"
The highest commander, wearing a faint smile, sighed.
"Commander, it was my misjudgment..."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei, full of apology, was about to admit his error when he was suddenly interrupted by the highest commander.
"Captain Wang, there’s no need for such words. Reporting the existence of a Corpse King was also considering the safety of the base city, so don’t blame yourself. Even though this time the Corpse King was not found, you have not made any substantial mistakes."
The highest commander raised a hand to stop Wang Lei, who was about to stand up.
"Thank you, Commander!"
Reassured by the highest commander’s comforting words, Wang Lei sat back down with ease.
"By the way, Commander, during the Invisibility Squad’s time in the Jiangnan City District, did they encounter anything special?"
Although he had come to terms with the fact that there was no Corpse King, Wang Lei still asked, recalling the mysterious deaths of his teammates in the city.
Upon hearing this, the highest commander’s demeanor became solemn, and the atmosphere in the meeting room grew tense.
The highest commander looked at Wang Lei and said gravely, "They encountered evolved zombies, and unfortunately, Captain Liu sacrificed himself, not even the body could be brought back!"
The highest commander felt deeply grieved over Captain Liu’s death. A rare talent like an Invisibility Evolver, able to become a captain, was not common in the entire base city.
Now, due to this investigation task, losing such a precious Invisibility Evolver was quite unexpected for him.
"Encountered evolved zombies?"
Wang Lei was shocked, a hint of suspicion arising in his heart.
The last time their squad went through, they hadn’t encountered a single evolved zombie.
Yet when the Invisibility Squad went over, they just happened to run into evolved zombies?
It’s known that those with invisibility are the best at staying alive. Once they activate invisibility, unless someone possesses special abilities, it’s extremely difficult to capture them.
Moreover, he had dealt with Captain Liu from the Invisibility Squad quite a bit before.
On the surface, Captain Liu appeared rough, but in reality, he was extremely meticulous and cautious, planning everything before taking action.
Given his way of handling things, even if they did encounter evolved zombies, the squad should have been able to activate their invisibility ability and escape immediately. How could they have been killed by evolved zombies?
Especially since, this time, only the most experienced Captain Liu died during the mission, while the remaining ordinary members all survived.
It was too abnormal.
"Things definitely aren’t that simple!"
Wang Lei felt that this matter was shrouded in a layer of mist, far from as straightforward as the highest commander suggested.
Did Captain Liu really die at the hands of evolved zombies?
Recalling the tragic deaths of his two teammates last time, Wang Lei furrowed his brows tightly.
He wasn’t quite convinced by this explanation!
A moment later, Wang Lei bid farewell to the highest commander and exited the meeting room.
As he walked out onto the street, amidst the flow of people, a sharp gleam appeared in Wang Lei’s eyes.
Earlier, in the meeting room, a hypothesis had formed in Wang Lei’s mind, though it wasn’t something he could easily tell the highest commander.
That was, the Invisibility Squad sent to investigate Jiangnan City District might have a problem.
But without any evidence, if he said it out loud, the highest commander would not only disbelieve him but might also consider him crazy.
For now, the most critical task was to find proof of the Invisibility Squad’s issues, otherwise, it would be tough convincing anyone with just his words.
After some thought, suddenly a bright idea struck Wang Lei.
"Perhaps... Captain Chen with the hypnosis ability could lend a hand!"
If he could hypnotize the Invisibility Squad’s members, surely the truth could be learned from them.
Of course, undertaking such an action could lead to severe punishment from the base city.
But by now, Wang Lei couldn’t afford to care that much.
The threat of the Corpse King was not something Wang Lei dared to take lightly.
Otherwise, it would be a nightmare for the Jianghai base city!
One must know, if there’s an issue with the Invisibility Squad, the information they retrieved is certainly false.
Thus, it could mean that the Corpse King indeed exists in Jiangnan City District.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - 202: Encountering a Tier 3 Fierce Beast Again! Beaten to Death!
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 202: Encountering a Tier 3 Fierce Beast Again! Beaten to Death!
Yellow Dragon Mountain.
Crack~
The ground trembled slightly, and the branches of the surrounding trees snapped under the enormous pressure, producing a sharp, unsettling sound.
At this moment, ten large zombies roamed the mountain forest without restraint, stomping on the ground, creating thunderous booms, their bodies covered in still-wet blood, exuding a thick aura of Blood Evil Qi.
Their massive bodies, like unstoppable moving hills, shattered the obstructing trees along their path.
They forcefully carved out several unimpeded paths in the densely wooded mountain forest.
Lu Chuan was controlling his corpse puppets, searching for traces of mutated fierce beasts in the vast and dense mountains.
To Lu Chuan, mutated fierce beasts were treasures. His actions could even be considered treasure hunting.
The crystal cores inside mutated fierce beasts could be used to enhance his corpse puppets, evolving them to the third tier.
The flesh, rich in energy, was a necessity for the zombie piglets in the zombie breeding grounds and gymnasium.
"This Yellow Dragon Mountain is truly my treasure trove! I hope the resources of mutant beasts here never run dry!"
Using Lightning One’s perspective, Lu Chuan gazed at the forest ahead, obscured by tree branches, and couldn’t help but sigh.
He unrealistically hoped that Yellow Dragon Mountain could be like a perpetual motion machine, with an inexhaustible supply of mutated fierce beast resources.
It wasn’t that he lost his mind—it’s just that, over the past two days, Lu Chuan had reaped so many benefits from Yellow Dragon Mountain; naturally, he didn’t want this kind of harvest to be a one-time affair.
In just two days, through Lu Chuan’s relentless hunting, the entire army of corpse puppets had slain a large number of first and second-tier mutated fierce beasts, quickly yielding over ten second-tier crystal cores and dozens of first-tier crystal cores for Lu Chuan.
After rapidly digesting these crystal cores, the number of third-tier corpse puppets under Lu Chuan’s command had impressively reached ten.
Tier-three zombies like San Pang, Lightning Two, and Flame Two had all increased in number.
Such a powerful lineup was enough for Lu Chuan to dominate the forest.
With ten tier-three corpse puppets, even a massive group of mutated fierce beasts could be annihilated in a short time.
Lu Chuan believed that even if they encountered a third-tier mutated fierce beast, like last time, the ten tier-three corpse puppets could easily gang up on it and kill it.
A single third-tier mutated fierce beast might have strength far exceeding a third-tier zombie individually.
But how could it possibly stand against ten corpse puppets of the same tier, capable of coordinating their efforts?
Unfortunately, two days had passed, and despite his hopes, Lu Chuan still hadn’t encountered that damn third-tier fierce beast.
"Hopefully, I’ll encounter a third-tier mutated fierce beast next! Killing one third-tier mutated fierce beast would be way more rewarding than those first and second-tier ones."
Staring into the eerily silent forest ahead, Lu Chuan silently prayed.
Then, he continued to control the ten corpse puppets, moving further into Yellow Dragon Mountain.
This area was already very remote, with almost no traces of human activity even before the apocalypse.
The deeper he went, the more Lu Chuan noticed the surrounding trees grew thicker and taller, with dense foliage blocking out the sunlight, making the forest grow increasingly darker.
Suddenly, two ghostly green flames appeared silently in the forest ahead, emerging abruptly in the twilight.
"What the hell is that..."
Lu Chuan’s pupils constricted in shock, and his entire troop of corpse puppets came to an instant halt.
In an instant, the ten tier-three corpse puppets prepared for battle, facing the direction of the flames with vigilance.
The two green flames suddenly vanished from top to bottom, only to reappear in the next second.
Staring at the eerie green flames that were steadily approaching, Lu Chuan sensed a subtle tremor in the ground, indicating that a colossal entity was heading their way.
At that moment, Lu Chuan also finally saw what those two ghostly green flames in the air were.
They were a pair of enormous serpent eyes, deep and cold, glowing with a ghostly green light in the darkness.
A gigantic mutated giant python was charging towards Lu Chuan.
This mutated giant python measured at least fifteen meters long, its thickest part larger than a water barrel, and its entire body was tightly covered in hard, smooth black scale armor, exuding a ferocious aura.
Roar!
As the distance between them rapidly decreased, the serpent’s eyes, filled with indifference, brimmed with endless killing intent; it let out a long howl to the sky.
The roar shattered the surroundings, the sound wave surging like ocean waves, rippling throughout the area, causing the nearby trees and flowers to tremble ceaselessly.
In the next moment, the giant python suddenly accelerated, spewing a foul, toxic mist from its mouth. The black toxic mist spread extremely fast, like surging ocean waves, engulfing the ten corpse puppets.
"Well, well, well, talk about a stroke of luck! I was just musing about a third-tier fierce beast, and here it is. My luck is unreal!"
Seeing that this giant python was a third-tier mutated fierce beast, Lu Chuan’s shock quickly turned into delight.
This time, Lu Chuan did not plan to retreat nor lure it into the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest.
He was ready for a real, hand-to-hand battle with this third-tier mutated fierce beast.
Things were different now.
Last time, he was so embarrassed by a third-tier mutated giant tiger because he had too few third-tier corpse puppets. Lu Chuan treasured his forces, fearing losses, so he relied on the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest to kill the giant tiger.
But now, his forces were robust, and a mere third-tier mutated fierce beast would be a piece of cake for Lu Chuan.
Whereas previously, if that third-tier giant tiger attacked Lu Chuan, Lu Chuan would definitely make it regret the day it was born.
Moreover, the flesh of a third-tier fierce beast certainly held immense energy, and Lu Chuan didn’t want to let the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest benefit this time.
Boom!
In the next moment, all ten tier-three corpse puppets charged at the mutated giant python.
Rumble~
The ground continued to quake.
The encroaching black toxic mist had no effect on the zombie corpse puppets; it was as if they were unscathed as they traversed through the black mist.
Da Pang, Er Pang, and other tank-type zombies directly used their massive bodies to halt the giant python’s onslaught. Their fists, brimming with tremendous strength, smashed down like giant hammers on the python’s head, causing its black scales to shatter and cave inward, drawing a roar of pain from the python.
Meanwhile, Lightning One and Lightning Two, wielding steel blades, flitted around the python, slashing its black scales open and tearing huge wounds.
Flame One and other corpse puppets also acted in unison, launching Fireballs and using claws to attack the python.
Not long after, the python, which had been thrashing noisily in the forest, suddenly stumbled and fell limp on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 203: Interrogation! Something’s Not Right After All!
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 203: Interrogation! Something’s Not Right After All!
Looking at the mutated giant python lying in a pool of blood, Lu Chuan felt immense joy, another Level 3 Crystal Core added to his collection.
It was strange how this Level 3 mutated python was unfortunate.
Of all the abilities to evolve, it chose the poison mist ability.
The Corpse Puppets under his command were completely unafraid of poison mist.
If this Level 3 python could evolve like the previous Level 3 tiger, developing abilities like frost that could affect Corpse Puppets.
It wouldn’t have been killed by the Corpse Puppets in mere moments, at least it could have lasted for a dozen minutes.
Maneuvering ten Corpse Puppets, he walked to the python’s side, observing the python lying in the pool of blood; Lu Chuan carefully scrutinized for a few moments, noticing the python died tragically.
The black scales meant to protect the flesh were almost entirely sliced open by Lightning One and the other Corpse Puppets, leaving no intact spots on its body.
Wounds blossoming with blood flowers, deep enough to show bone, tender flesh cut open by steel knives, smooth on both sides like a mirror, with threads of fresh blood seeping from the white flesh.
The python’s head was battered beyond recognition by Da Pang and the others, the flesh and scales covering the skull turned into a mess of disordered flesh under the immense force of the impact.
The python’s two eye sockets were shattered, the serpent pupils blasted open, leaving only two bloody holes.
"Good heavens, I wonder if this python was beaten to death by Da Pang and the others or sliced with too many cuts by Lightning One and the others, dying from excessive blood loss!"
Lu Chuan smacked his lips, no longer dwelling on it, directly maneuvering Lightning One and the others to cleave open the python’s head and extract the essential Level 3 Crystal Core.
Next was processing the Level 3 mutated python’s carcass.
Ordering Da Pang and Er Pang to carry the mutated python, Lu Chuan manipulated the Corpse Puppets to walk out of the mountain.
After packing all the hunted Fierce Beasts into vehicles, the convoy started its return to Qingshui Farm.
At Qingshui Farm, Lu Chuan began processing the mutated python’s carcass.
Though the flesh of a Level 3 Mutant Beast is excellent, the python could spew poison mist, so its flesh likely contains mild toxicity, Lu Chuan dared not feed it to Little Qiqi.
Lu Chuan only extracted the venom sac larger than a barrel, perhaps useful later.
The rest of the python’s body was cut into many pieces and placed in the vehicle.
He planned to use this flesh entirely to feed zombies.
The flesh of Level 3 mutated Fierce Beasts is highly effective in promoting zombie evolution.
Lu Chuan estimated this truckload of Level 3 flesh would likely cause a surge in the number of evolved zombies within the stadium.
After processing all brought-back Fierce Beasts, the transport convoy set off again towards the Jiangnan City District stadium to feed the zombies inside.
At the stadium, Tyrant One opened the door, scattering the Level 3 flesh onto the zombie horde from the small vehicle.
Instantly, the zombies pounced madly towards the Level 3 flesh like cats smelling fish, instinctively drawn to consume the flesh to enhance and evolve themselves.
The entire stadium erupted into chaos, with Level 3 flesh fiercely contested among zombies; for a piece of flesh, three or four zombies started biting each other, fighting relentlessly.
A full half-hour passed before the chaos in the stadium finally settled, with the Level 3 flesh entirely devoured.
Using Tyrant One’s perspective, observing the stadium now beginning to house many more evolved zombies brought Lu Chuan satisfaction.
Level 3 flesh works wonders indeed!
"Seems like I can harvest again in a few days!"
...
In a private room of a makeshift restaurant in Jianghai Base City.
Wang Lei successfully invited the remaining members of the Invisibility Squad for a drink.
To learn the truth from their mouths, he deliberately spiked the wine bottles with special sedatives.
This sedative comes from a mutant plant known as Illusory Flower Vine, whose flowers can induce temporary unconsciousness, placing one in a half-awake, half-asleep state, which Base City researchers discovered accidentally.
To make it convincing, Wang Lei preemptively took the antidote made from Illusory Flower Vine seeds.
"Ladies and gentlemen, Liu Captain’s death is partly my fault. If I hadn’t misjudged and reported false information, Base City wouldn’t have sent Liu Captain and you all to the Jiangnan City District, and he wouldn’t have died at the hands of evolved zombies."
With a face full of remorse, Wang Lei made a self-punishment toast and gulped down.
Listening to Wang Lei’s words, the four members of the Invisibility Squad felt guilty.
Liu Captain wasn’t killed by evolved zombies; that was merely their excuse to conceal the truth.
"What’s Captain Wang’s intent by inviting us for drinks? Is he suspicious?"
Li Ying raised his wine glass slowly, speculating internally.
"It’s probably straightforward drinking... Liu Captain wasn’t killed by us, so we said that just to survive!"
Another squad member covertly glanced at Wang Lei’s face, noticing no oddities, and felt significant relief.
The other two, seeing Wang Lei seemingly not suspicious, simultaneously relaxed too.
"Come, let’s all have a toast to Captain Liu!"
Wang Lei raised another glass, inviting the four to drink together.
The four naturally couldn’t let Wang Lei spot anything unusual, thus hesitantly drinking along with him.
After just a while, three glasses in, the four fell unconscious.
Wang Lei, previously smiling with his glass raised, suddenly became silent, his smile fading as he set down the glass, gazing coldly at the four.
Their behavior during the drinking seemed odd, especially when he mentioned Liu Captain, their expressions appeared unnatural.
At this point, though he hadn’t yet extracted the truth from them, Wang Lei was now convinced there was definitely a problem.
"Captain Chen, I’ll trouble you now."
Wang Lei politely spoke.
As the words fell, a figure walked inside from outside the door.
This was a middle-aged man with a plump appearance and a beer belly.
Captain Chen awakened with the ability of hypnosis, dedicated to interrogating criminals and evolvers who committed major crimes.
Wang Lei managed to invite Captain Chen due to their private acquaintance; early in the apocalypse, Wang Lei saved Captain Chen from evolved zombies.
"Haha, Wang, you’re too kind!"
Captain Chen chuckled.
He didn’t waste words and started working promptly.
Subsequently, Captain Chen propped up an Invisibility member onto the chair, began wielding his ability.
An invisible force flowed into the individual’s mind.
"Tell me, how did your Liu Captain die?"
This Invisibility member, eyes closed and seemingly asleep, spoke like sleep-talking, mouthing silently: "Little girl... a little girl..."
On hearing, Wang Lei’s eyes widened!
"A little girl?"
Definitely problematic!

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 204: The Mysterious Little Girl? Capture Plan!
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 204: The Mysterious Little Girl? Capture Plan!
Captain Chen, standing nearby, changed his expression upon hearing the Invisible’s answer.
The matter was indeed not simple.
Since Captain Chen was involved in the interrogation, he naturally learned everything from Wang Lei.
Initially, he didn’t quite believe what the other side was saying, but he agreed to help because of their past relationship.
But now, this Invisible was showing flaws, which meant Wang Lei’s suspicions were entirely correct.
These Invisibles likely had some real issues.
At this moment, Wang Lei’s expression was so grim it seemed as if it could drip water.
After the Invisibility Squad returned this time, they explained Captain Liu’s cause of death as being killed by an Evolved Zombie.
Yet now, the result from hypnosis was that he died at the hands of a little girl.
A little girl?
What kind of little girl could possibly kill Captain Liu?
"Captain Chen, please continue."
Taking a deep breath, Wang Lei tried to calm himself down, then looked seriously at Captain Chen and slowly said.
He was eager to learn more truth. Why did these Invisibles lie?
What was the girl’s identity?
Captain Chen nodded, once again shifting his gaze to the Invisible beside him, and calmly said, "Tell me, what is this little girl’s identity? Is she an Evolver?"
The Invisible was already in a half-asleep state, and under the influence of Captain Chen’s hypnosis ability, his slightly squinting eyes were dull and lifeless, mechanically saying, "Yes! The girl is an Evolver!"
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei, who was listening on the side, furrowed his brow.
A little girl, yet she’s an Evolver, and even killed Captain Liu; it seemed strange no matter how you looked at it.
At this point, Captain Chen asked again, "Then is she very powerful?"
"Yes, very powerful, very terrifying..."
As if recalling a frightening scene, when answering this question, the previously motionless Invisible started trembling slightly.
"Where did you guys..."
Just as Captain Chen was about to continue questioning.
Sitting in the chair, the Invisible’s face suddenly twisted, his eyes shot open, bloodshot and bulging, his body trembled violently, all the while letting out a series of heartrending screams.
The Invisible struggled violently in the chair, his limbs convulsing, but in the next moment, everything came to an abrupt end, and the Invisible died suddenly.
His stiffened body slouched in the chair, with eyes like dead fish about to pop out, and fresh blood flowed from the corners of his mouth, nose, and ears.
This sudden change startled Wang Lei and Captain Chen.
Before the two could react, the other Invisibles, including Li Ying, exhibited the same condition as the previous Invisible and died suddenly after several blood-curdling screams.
In an instant, the small room was filled with the stench of blood and a thick atmosphere of death.
Wang Lei and Captain Chen’s expressions were utterly grim.
This eerie scene made them break out in cold sweat. It was just a hypnosis interrogation, so how did it lead to death?
"Captain Chen, do you think this is..."
After a moment of silence, Wang Lei looked toward Captain Chen and asked in confusion.
"I only know hypnosis, so how could I know why this happened? But I suspect it has something to do with that girl."
Unfortunately, before Wang Lei could finish speaking, he was interrupted by Captain Chen’s shake of the head.
"I also have a similar thought, that they likely didn’t escape from the girl, and possibly have a special relationship with her, even their life and death were under her control.
Otherwise, why didn’t they die sooner or later, but precisely when we’re probing for the girl’s information?"
Wang Lei nodded, speaking in a cold voice.
"I think we should report this matter to the commanding officer immediately!"
Captain Chen glanced at the chaotic room, and solemnly spoke to Wang Lei.
This time, although their actions were somewhat unauthorized, they uncovered vital truths for the Base City.
They confirmed that something was wrong with these Invisibles, and found out that Captain Liu died at the hands of a little girl, all of which must be reported to the top for handling.
"Okay! I will report this immediately. Captain Chen, I’ll leave this place to you. Until the matter is resolved, please keep this place as it is."
Wang Lei nodded, quickly stood up, and instructed Captain Cheng.
"Alright, leave it to me."
Captain Chen responded, as this place couldn’t be disturbed because the Base City would need to ascertain the truth of what Wang Lei had said next.
Only by presenting the state of the Invisibles’ sudden deaths to the Base City high command can it be proven that the deaths had nothing to do with the two of them.
After all, these were four Invisibility Evolvers, and if they just died without explanation after a round of drinks, even if they were captain-level Evolvers, the Base City would impose severe punishment.
...
Soon, Wang Lei reported the matter up.
In the conference room, the commanding officer was furious.
"Such audacity, to dare kill an Evolver of our Jianghai Base City, must be captured and severely punished!!!"
The commanding officer banged on the table, shouting in anger.
The conference table was surrounded by people, and the faces of all the top officials were extremely grim.
Originally, with Captain Liu’s death, they felt some regret, lamenting his bad luck encountering a powerful Evolved Zombie, but they never expected that he wasn’t killed by an Evolved Zombie.
Discovering this truth was enough to enrage them.
But now, it wasn’t just Captain Liu who died, but the entire Invisibility Squad was wiped out!
An entire Invisibility Squad!
Just like that, gone!
"Captain Wang, thanks to you for this matter; otherwise, the Base City would have been fooled by those four bastards. Rest assured, the Base City won’t pursue your actions against them."
After calming down a bit, the commanding officer looked at Wang Lei, who sat to the side, and reassured him.
"Thank you, sir. These are all duties I should perform."
Wang Lei straightened his face, stood up, and saluted.
"Alright, sit down!"
The commanding officer nodded in satisfaction, then swept his gaze over everyone, speaking in a deep voice, "Regarding this matter, does anyone have any thoughts? Feel free to speak."
"Commander, I think Li Ying and the others’ deaths must be related to that girl; they were likely controlled by the mysterious girl, which is why they managed to escape back."
"That’s right, this girl shouldn’t be an ordinary Evolver. By letting Li Ying and the others come back, she must have some undisclosed objective."
"To have our Base City’s five Evolvers die tragically, it cannot be let go like this..."
After some discussion, the commanding officer decided to dispatch three elite squads to the Jiangnan City District to capture the ’mysterious girl.’"

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 205: Target: Tier 5!
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 205: Target: Tier 5!
Qingshui Farm.
In the room, Ji Ruxue was sitting cross-legged on the bed, eyes closed and concentrating, practicing cultivation techniques, absorbing the energy from the outside world, and continuously refining it, exuding a powerful aura all over her body.
The energy factors drifting in the room transformed into streams, flowing towards Ji Ruxue’s body, like hundreds of rivers converging into the sea.
After continuously refining this energy, Ji Ruxue’s aura was slowly rising at a speed visible to the naked eye, and soon she took a small step in the fourth stage.
Suddenly, Ji Ruxue’s face changed, and she let out a painful muffled groan.
Her somewhat pale face suddenly had her eyes open wide, revealing a look of shock and anger.
The next moment, realizing what happened, Ji Ruxue’s expression turned gloomy.
"It seems Li Ying and the others have been discovered."
Ji Ruxue already understood what had happened.
Although the Soul Contract Technique was useful for enslaving others and perfectly controlling their life and death,
it also had its drawbacks.
If someone bound by the soul contract were to die suddenly, the caster would also be affected.
For example, the deaths of Li Ying and the others were linked to her soul, causing violent tremors in it.
Right now, her head felt as if it were about to split open, aching intolerably.
Even now, a faint pain persisted in the depths of her mind.
However, Ji Ruxue was grateful that she had set a restriction in advance while using the Soul Contract Technique.
As long as the person bound by the soul contract showed signs of betrayal, the contract would activate automatically, killing the bound person to prevent future troubles.
So Ji Ruxue wasn’t too worried about Li Ying and the others divulging too much information about her.
"It seems this time I can’t hide it anymore; a storm is coming..."
Thinking that Li Ying and the others were exposed to the Survivor Base, a look of seriousness flashed in Ji Ruxue’s eyes.
In reality, she never thought she could keep this matter hidden forever, thinking that concealing it for a month or two would be enough.
After a month or two, given her and her father’s rate of development, their strength would surely be beyond fear of Jianghai Base City.
But she didn’t expect the matter to be exposed so quickly.
"I really can’t expect too much from those useless Li Ying and the others; they can’t handle even the smallest things."
Ji Ruxue shook her head helplessly.
However, she was no longer interested in pondering how these few people had exposed themselves to the Human Base City.
Now, the most important matter was to consider how to handle the imminent crisis.
Since the Human Survivor Base had already noticed something, they would certainly send people to investigate and trace related clues.
Moreover, next time, it wouldn’t just be a few weakly-powered invisibility evolvers.
By then, she would be facing a powerful evolutionary squad.
"Hmph, however many come, I’ll kill however many!"
With that in mind, a murderous intent flashed in Ji Ruxue’s eyes, and a deadly aura surged around her.
She held a deep disdain for the human evolutionary squads at this stage.
Despite her previous apprehension toward humanity, specifically instructing Li Ying and the others to cover up anomalies in the Jiangnan City District,
it was merely due to humanity’s overall strength and size, which she couldn’t contend with at the time.
But now both her father and she had advanced to the fourth stage, while humanity at this stage probably had very few even at the third evolutionary stage.
Relying on a small number of evolvers to act against her and her father was surely a pointless endeavor.
Thus, as long as the matter didn’t spiral out of control, leading humanity to dispatch large forces to eliminate them, Ji Ruxue had absolute confidence.
Even if humanity did deploy large forces, she wouldn’t be overly concerned.
Because, in this apocalypse, roads and railways were completely destroyed and blocked, greatly hampering large troop movements.
With precautions, their opponents wouldn’t stand a chance against her and her father.
By the time they reached Jiangnan City District, her father and she would have already received the news and retreated quickly.
Thinking of this, a slight smile played on Ji Ruxue’s lips.
Next, she planned to devote all her time and energy into enhancing her cultivation level.
Only by ensuring powerful strength could she protect her father’s safety, preventing humanity from coveting him.
If she could reach the fifth stage before humanity’s dispatched personnel arrived,
then she and her father could rest easy.
With fifth-stage cultivation, even facing the siege of human military forces, she would have confidence in handling it.
Thinking this, Ji Ruxue’s eyes showed determination, and she sat firmly once more, beginning to practice cultivation techniques and absorb external energy again.
She had to seize every moment, not allowing any bit of slackness.
...
In the amusement park, by the slide.
Whoosh!
At this moment, Zhao Lin, covered in sweat, was hanging upside down from the slide, her feet hooked tightly, repeatedly doing sit-up exercises, curling her body upwards.
Each time she sat up, her body trembled uncontrollably, seemingly using all her strength, and when finished, she exhaled a long breath.
Time passed bit by bit.
Her face was flushed, tears streaming as Zhao Lin persevered, exerting great strength through her legs onto the slide, which creaked as if it might fall apart.
During this period, she was in the farm, not having to worry about her safety, living comfortably, eating and sleeping to her heart’s content.
But because she was locked up here, she didn’t have much activity daily, feeling like she might become useless.
However, she hadn’t forgotten that it was still the apocalypse, and the farm was a completely different world from the outside.
She didn’t know if one day she would be thrown out by the Corpse King, or if suddenly, the Corpse King might be merciful enough to release her.
If that happened, if she were all fat, how could she compete against those evolved zombies, when she couldn’t even outrun others?
Thus, lying on the bed and looking at the slide overhead, she had a sudden inspiration and came up with an idea.
She immediately started using the slide in various ways to exercise her body, trying to maintain her condition this way.
"Whew! I’m exhausted..."
Using up the last of her energy, Zhao Lin’s upper body bent upwards with difficulty, and upon completing the move, she breathed a long sigh of relief, feeling completely relaxed.
Afterwards, Zhao Lin reached out her hands to grip the iron pole by her feet, lowered her legs to the ground.
Wiping her face with her hand, Zhao Lin sat on the bed, her chest heaving as she panted heavily.
After a while, Zhao Lin’s breathing finally steadied.
Watching in the direction of Little Qiqi’s room, Zhao Lin frowned slightly, "Why does Little Qiqi always seem to stay in the room lately?"
"Also, that Corpse King fellow seems to be showing up less frequently."
Did something happen?

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 206: The Second Harvest!
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 206: The Second Harvest!
During this period, the Corpse King’s doting on Little Qiqi is something Zhao Lin sees with her own eyes.
On regular days, the Corpse King would take quite some time to play with Little Qiqi and amuse her.
Although he cannot speak, he is definitely a very responsible zombie "dad," taking good care of Little Qiqi, ensuring she lacks nothing in terms of food and clothing, and providing a high level of safety.
No wonder Little Qiqi is so dependent on the Corpse King, reluctant to leave his side.
But in recent days, Zhao Lin has clearly noticed a change because she cannot see the Corpse King’s shadow at all.
The Corpse King stays in the room and never comes out, and no one knows what on earth he’s up to.
Even Little Qiqi seldom appears, staying in the room like the Corpse King and acting much less lively than before.
They seem to have turned into homebodies!
This is very strange...
Zhao Lin knows there’s definitely a problem here, something she is unaware of has undoubtedly happened.
This is precisely why the Corpse King and Little Qiqi are behaving so unusually.
In the last couple of days, Zhao Lin has been racking her brain, almost busting her head, yet she couldn’t come up with a suitable answer.
In truth, the best way, of course, is to simply ask directly.
However, Zhao Lin knows she is a prisoner, still alive by the grace of Little Qiqi, so she doesn’t have the courage to call out the Corpse King and inquire into his secrets.
"Perhaps I could ask Little Qiqi. Little Qiqi might know!"
Zhao Lin had a sudden insight, thinking a little hesitantly.
"Sigh!"
Letting out a long sigh, Zhao Lin lay back down on the bed, staring blankly at the slide above her.
Being locked up like this, she really couldn’t go anywhere, it was truly painful.
Who knows when this Corpse King will finally let her go.
Noontime.
Creak~
The door that had been shut for a long time opened.
Dressed like a flower fairy, Ji Ruxue brought the meal to Zhao Lin.
"Eat up! Today’s dish is stir-fried pork with green peppers over rice, it’s really tasty!"
Zhao Lin, who was already starving, received it with a big smile, picked up the chopsticks, and started devouring it ravenously.
After scarfing down half of the rice in the bowl in a few quick bites.
Catching her breath, Zhao Lin remembered her morning decision and immediately paused her action, looking at Ji Ruxue, curiously asking, "Little Qiqi, did something happen at the farm? Why do I feel that you and your dad hardly come out these days?"
"Don’t worry about that; it’s no use even if I tell you."
Hearing this, thinking about the impending crisis at the farm, Ji Ruxue furrowed her brows, saying impatiently.
This Nine Deaths Demon Police has decent potential, but their current strength is far from adequate, unable to even hold a candle to the third-tier evolved zombies under Dad’s command; how could they possibly contend with the evolvers sent by humans?
Moreover, her savior complex hasn’t changed, naïve to a fault, if she finds out the ones fighting against her and her dad are from the official human side, she might even switch sides when the time comes.
"Little Qiqi, maybe I can help, don’t you think? Just tell me; I can also try to come up with a solution for you."
Thinking about freeloading for so long, Zhao Lin was preparing to take this opportunity to reciprocate Little Qiqi and the Corpse King.
Although she was locked up by the Corpse King, to be honest, this period was the most stable time she has had since the apocalypse.
No need to worry about zombies suddenly breaking in and devouring her, no need to venture out foraging for supplies to fill her stomach.
As long as it’s mealtime, there’s food to eat; she can sleep whenever she wants, get up when she wishes, it’s practically a paradise.
"There’s no need; you can’t solve our problem now, just hurry and eat!"
Seeing Zhao Lin’s earnest desire to help, Ji Ruxue smiled bitterly in her heart, shook her head, and urged Zhao Lin.
"Little Qiqi, believe me, I do have some strength, even if I can’t solve it, having me as an extra force is still good."
Zhao Lin didn’t want to give up, quickly persuading once more.
"You..."
"Little Qiqi, just say it! What if I can help?"
Zhao Lin interrupted Ji Ruxue.
Ji Ruxue became somewhat annoyed by Zhao Lin, knowing that if she didn’t make things clear to this guy, he might not let it go, so she said with a slight temper, "Fine, you want to help, right? What if there are humans coming after my dad? Will you still help?"
"Aren’t you the one who values the police status the most, willing to risk your life to save those human survivors? Let me ask you, which side would you help when the time comes?"
Snap!
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin was taken aback as if struck by lightning, her chopsticks slipping from her hands powerlessly.
The atmosphere in the room instantly froze.
Looking at Little Qiqi with a complicated gaze, Zhao Lin remained speechless.
Though she knew this would likely happen, but... it finally came to this point.
With humans and the Corpse King Little Qiqi battling, where should she, a human, go...
Ji Ruxue squatted down to pick up the chopsticks, took out a piece of paper from her small pocket, wiped them, and handed them back to Zhao Lin.
"See, just like I said. Even if I tell you, it’s no use, just stay here obediently, and don’t think about helping."
Glancing at the bewildered Zhao Lin, Little Qiqi turned around and walked away with short strides.
Zhao Lin sat powerlessly on the bed, looking at Little Qiqi’s back, showing a look of struggle.
Jiangnan City District.
Lu Chuan, using the perspective of Tyrant No. 1, observed the evolution of zombies inside the stadium.
Roar~
A series of roars emerged from the zombie horde, sending chills down the spine of anyone listening.
The dense horde almost filled the entire space of the stadium, with many evolved zombies now among them, including Tank Types and Agile Types.
These evolved zombies often create a wide circle of space around them, as the ordinary zombies, feeling the suppression of rank, stay far away, not daring to get close at all.
"The blood and flesh of this third-tier mutated fierce beast are truly useful!"
Looking at the evolved zombies amidst the horde, Lu Chuan was overjoyed.
After devouring the blood and flesh of the third-tier fierce beast, these zombies’ evolution sped up remarkably.
Besides the previous advancements, in just two days, dozens more evolved zombies emerged.
This proves how abundant the energy contained within the blood and flesh of the third-tier fierce beast is.
"The number of evolved zombies is already considerable, if it increases further, I fear the stadium won’t hold them anymore!"
"Tomorrow, they can be harvested!"
Crystal Cores, a large number of Crystal Cores...
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan couldn’t contain his excitement, eager to harvest all these evolved zombies now.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 207: Four Tier-4 Corpse Puppets!
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 207: Four Tier-4 Corpse Puppets!
Early morning, Qingshui Farm.
Lu Chuan prepared breakfast for Ji Ruxue.
A small bowl of steaming shredded meat and egg noodles, with a cup of milk made from milk powder placed on the table in front of Ji Ruxue.
"Thank you, Dad!"
Ji Ruxue’s eyes brightened as she looked at the breakfast, and she thanked Lu Chuan in her sweet, childish voice.
Lu Chuan smiled, wrote a note, and handed it to Little Qiqi.
Looking at Little Qiqi’s smiling face, it seemed as though all the fatigue accumulated from his busyness over the past few days instantly vanished.
"Little Qiqi, Dad has something to do recently and can’t be with you for long. Be good, and next time, Daddy will roast a little rabbit for you, okay?"
Looking at the note, Ji Ruxue nodded obediently, "Don’t worry, Dad, I’ll be good."
She understood that Dad had been busy hunting fierce beasts to improve his strength.
Previously, her disguise as a stranger and fourth-level Evolver had put a lot of pressure on Dad.
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue felt a bit guilty towards her father.
Although what she did indeed heightened Dad’s vigilance and accelerated his strength improvement, after all, the stronger one is, the safer the future will be.
But during this period, Dad was truly too busy, and she was a little afraid that Dad might not be able to handle it all, or even be crushed by the immense pressure.
Seeing Little Qiqi’s obedient look, Lu Chuan felt very comforted in his heart.
He is now treating Little Qiqi as his real daughter, who wouldn’t want to have an obedient and lovely daughter?
Little Qiqi, Daddy will surely let you grow up safely and happily, and will never let anyone hurt you, no matter who!
He signaled Little Qiqi to have breakfast, then Lu Chuan’s gaze flickered slightly, pondering something.
"Next, it’s time to harvest the second batch of Evolved Zombies!"
A moment later, Lu Chuan, accompanied by a convoy, drove out of Qingshui Farm toward Jiangnan City District.
At the foot of the slide, Zhao Lin, who had just woken up, was surprised to see Lu Chuan walk out of the room.
"This Zombie King finally decided to come out?"
Lu Chuan, who had already left Qingshui Farm, naturally didn’t notice Zhao Lin’s attention.
Now he had only one request for Zhao Lin, which was to keep her as a pet to accompany Little Qiqi and not let Little Qiqi feel lonely.
Soon, Lu Chuan’s convoy stopped in front of the stadium.
Getting out of the car, the first thing heard was the noisy yet continuous roaring of zombies.
Rumble~
Under Lu Chuan’s control, Tyrant One quickly opened the big door, revealing the horde of zombies inside.
The zombie horde walked back and forth on the dirty ground, issuing bursts of roars. Some zombies tore and bit each other, trying to devour the other, while others just wandered aimlessly.
And at the moment Tyrant One appeared, these zombies seemed to have encountered a natural enemy, shivering and stopping any extra actions, only retreating instinctively, trying to distance themselves from Tyrant One.
Lu Chuan watched the chaotic zombie horde, counting the zombies inside, satisfaction showing in his eyes.
Just now, he roughly estimated that with the large supply of meat from the Black-Scaled Giant Snake, there were now over one hundred and thirty first-tier Evolved Zombies in the stadium!
Even more than the first batch of first-tier Evolved Zombies before, which was naturally credited to the third-tier mutant flesh.
Seeing firsthand how significant the effects of third-tier mutant beast flesh are, Lu Chuan yearned even more for third-tier Mutated Fierce Beasts.
Third-tier Mutated Fierce Beasts are all treasures!
Hunting one not only yields a precious third-tier Crystal Core but its entire body of flesh also represents a huge pile of first-tier Crystal Cores.
Now in Lu Chuan’s eyes, those third-tier Fierce Beasts in Yellow Dragon Mountain are just heaps of Crystal Cores.
Going up the mountain isn’t really hunting fierce beasts; it’s clearly hunting "Crystal Core Monsters." As long as one is killed, a huge pile of Crystal Cores will explode.
"Hopefully, Yellow Dragon Mountain yields a good amount, must produce more third-tier Fierce Beasts!"
With a sigh in his heart, the corners of Lu Chuan’s mouth slightly lifted.
Returning to his senses, Lu Chuan looked at the zombies in the stadium and began to act.
With a thought, forty first-tier Evolved Zombies slowly walked out of the zombie crowd under his control, finally reaching outside the stadium.
In no time, forty first-tier zombies were arranged in four rows, neatly aligned.
Next, it’s time for the slaughter.
In the next moment, under Lu Chuan’s command, Tyrant One and Lightning One stepped out from the ranks of Corpse Puppets.
Boom!
The two Corpse Puppets charged into the group like arrows, waving their Sharp Blade Claw Knives in their hands, drawing cold flashes in the air, so fast they were almost invisible.
In no time, over a dozen first-tier zombies were shredded to pieces under the attack of the two Corpse Puppets, with dark red flesh splashing all over.
Roar roar roar~
The zombies in the horde issued roars of terror, instinctively fearing Tyrant One and Lightning One, running amok in the stadium, especially those first-tier Evolved Zombies targeted, fleeing madly for their lives.
Tyrant One and Lightning One continued to chase these first-tier zombies, like grim reapers harvesting lives.
The ordinary zombies in the way were directly knocked flying by the two Corpse Puppets, crashing heavily against the stadium walls and struggling to get up for a long time.
Many first-tier Evolved Zombies, not yet killed by luck, in horror started to flee towards the wide-open door to escape Tyrant One and Lightning One, the two slayers.
But before they could escape through the wide-open door, a huge figure stood in their way, blocking the door completely.
Boom!
Er Pang, like the Demon Lord of Chaos, swung an iron rod in his hand, directly smashing several first-tier Evolved Zombies into pieces, scattering them everywhere.
Half an hour passed, the noise inside the stadium gradually quieted down, with no more sounds of terrified screams.
Thud thud thud~
Tyrant One and Lightning One walked out of the blood-filled stadium.
Looking at the small pile of first-tier Crystal Cores in Tyrant One’s palm, Lu Chuan nodded in satisfaction.
Next, Lu Chuan fed these first-tier Evolved Zombies one by one to the first-tier zombies standing outside.
Ultimately, he successfully evolved thirty-six second-tier zombies.
Afterward, Lu Chuan staged another bout of slaughter, controlling the Corpse Puppets like Tyrant One to kill all thirty-six second-tier zombies and take out the second-tier Crystal Cores.
Having acquired thirty-six second-tier Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan controlled the Corpse Puppet team behind him to bring out a lineup of second-tier Corpse Puppets.
He then fed the accumulated second-tier Crystal Cores to the second-tier Corpse Puppets one by one.
Finally, Lu Chuan gained a total of eleven third-tier zombies.
Plus the one third-tier Mutated Beast Crystal Core previously contributed by the Black-Scaled Python.
This was enough for Lu Chuan to evolve four fourth-tier Corpse Puppets!

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 208: Power Surge! Upgrading from Birdshot to Cannons!
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 208: Power Surge! Upgrading from Birdshot to Cannons!
Forcibly taking control of the bodies of eleven Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan held them in place.
Next, Tyrant One extended its powerful claw blades, fiercely piercing the back of these Corpse Puppets’ heads, extracting the Tier 3 Crystal Cores one by one.
After acquiring eleven Tier 3 Crystal Cores, Lu Chuan naturally needed to consider which four Tier 3 Corpse Puppets to upgrade.
He currently commands quite a number of Tier 3 Corpse Puppets, a total of ten, including Da Pang, Tyrant One, Flame One, among others.
After thinking it over, Lu Chuan ultimately decided to allocate the first batch of Tier 4 promotion spots to Tyrant One, Er Pang, Flame One, and Earth Escape One.
There are reasons for such a choice, of course.
The Corpse Puppets under his command can roughly be categorized into four types: those like Da Pang and Er Pang, which are Tank Type Corpse Puppets. These are not only qualified as meat shields but also possess incredible strength with destructive power.
Another type is Tyrant One, which boasts balanced attributes like speed, power, and attack capability; it’s an all-rounder that can both endure and fight.
The third type is Agile Type like Lightning One, which relies on extreme speed and sharp blades to kill enemies swiftly.
The last type, of course, is Magic Type like Flame One and Earth Escape One.
Among them, Lu Chuan initially ruled out Agile Types like Lightning One for the available spots.
Agile Types like Lightning One, despite their incredible speed and lethal sharp blades, resemble assassins with a single deadly strike, followed by quick retreats.
That’s Lightning One’s advantage, but its weaknesses include poor strength and low defensive capability.
Especially when confronted with Tier 4 Evolvers possessing binding abilities, their speed advantage becomes useless, and their weak physical strength can’t break free from restraints.
Additionally, due to the issue of insufficient defense, it’s likely they will quickly lose their combat effectiveness when the defense is breached by enemies.
Corpse Puppets like Tyrant One and Er Pang possess far superior defensive abilities compared to Lightning One, and their strength is vastly different.
Even if they encounter previous Tier 4 Evolvers, they can forcibly break free from the restraints with their strength, while their robust defense allows them to engage in prolonged combat.
As for Flame One and Earth Escape One, which are Magic Types, there’s no need to mention them; they must rank above Lightning One!
How could a mere assassin like Lightning One ever compare with us Mages?
Of course, Lu Chuan chose Flame One and Earth Escape One also to see if their abilities will evolve after promotion.
Flame One might transform into a true Mage instead of relying on a single Fireball, effortlessly wielding various Fire Skills.
And for Earth Escape One, he wanted to see if it could evolve from Earth Escape to a real Earth Mage.
Besides Earth Escape, it might also use other Earth Magic.
After confirming the promotion candidates, Lu Chuan wasn’t in a hurry to promote the four Corpse Puppets here; he decided to wait until returning to the farm for promotion.
Lu Chuan, accompanied by his Corpse Puppets, got into the vehicle.
A moment later, the convoy drove past the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall, stopping outside the stone courtyard wall of the farm.
Controlling the four Corpse Puppets, Tyrant One, Er Pang, Flame One, Earth Escape One, they lined up on the vacant land.
In a few breaths, the four Corpse Puppets had devoured the Tier 3 Crystal Cores.
Instantly, the enormous energy from the Crystal Cores rampaged within their bodies, continuously crashing and clashing, washing over their organs, blood, and bones, all subjected to the wild baptism of energy.
This energy resembled massive sea waves in a storm, while the four Corpse Puppets seemed like a lone leaf in the ocean, swaying intensely amidst the energy surges.
Under the nourishment and refinement of abundant energy, the evolution of the four Corpse Puppets formally commenced.
Roar Roar Roar~
Tyrant One and Er Pang, the physically strong and robust Corpse Puppets, stood in place, their bodies unable to stop trembling, fierce pain making them emit piercing screams.
Flame One and Earth Escape One exhibited even poorer conditions than Tyrant One, their legs kneeling on the ground, bodies shaking violently, issuing trembling roars.
Flame One’s body ignited with fierce flames, appearing like a giant Fireball, radiating endless heat and light.
Earth Escape One, however, emitted earthy-colored light, the dust on the ground inexplicably attracted, transforming into a fluid state, spreading upwards from its feet, gradually covering Earth Escape One entirely.
In a few breaths, Earth Escape One appeared completely as a zombie composed of dirt, resembling a clay figure.
As time passed, the transformation of the four Corpse Puppets finally reached its endpoint.
Roar~
Four deafening roars reverberated across the skies of Qingshui Farm.
Tyrant One’s size had seen a considerable increase compared to Tier 3, reaching nearly five meters tall, towering over a single story.
Its physique was well-built, enveloped in bulging muscles, like forged from steel, and its pair of claw blades became thicker and longer, emitting a cold gleam.
The key areas like its brain, neck, joints, and chest grew a layer of hard black armor, making Tyrant One appear extremely terrifying and ferocious.
Er Pang’s form also evolved, becoming taller and more robust, akin to a small hill, standing at about two zhangs high, comparable to a two-story building, stomping the ground with booming sounds as it walked.
Most crucially, the black scales covering Er Pang’s body now exhibited a metallic sheen, appearing extremely hard.
Flame One and Earth Escape One’s physiques didn’t undergo substantial changes, but they didn’t appear composed of flesh anymore.
Flame One glowed with fire, appearing as if made of endless flames, while Earth Escape One looked more like a clay figure, radiating a heavy earth essence.
"Finally Tier 4!"
Looking at the four Tier 4 Corpse Puppets in front of him, Lu Chuan’s face radiated joy.
Subsequently, Lu Chuan tested the abilities of the four Corpse Puppets individually.
The transformation of Tyrant One’s body didn’t require much explanation; its most surprising aspect was the acquisition of long-range attack capabilities, with its sharp claw blades now able to detach and shoot out like arrows.
Er Pang’s black scale armor offered explosive defense, as Lu Chuan’s full-strength sword swing only left a shallow groove, and even bullets bounced off leaving dents.
Flame One and Earth Escape One, as expected by Lu Chuan, had evolved into genuine Mages.
Capable of using multiple spells, no longer limited like before.
"Great, great, great, this is like trading birdguns for cannons!"
Understanding the significant power enhancement of the four Tier 4 Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan felt immense joy, knowing these Corpse Puppets significantly boosted his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 209: Wang Lei: Blood Debts Must Be Paid in Blood!
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 209: Wang Lei: Blood Debts Must Be Paid in Blood!
The blissfully unaware Lu Chuan had no idea that a gaze was fixed upon everything below from above.
"Four heads of fourth-tier evolved zombies, it seems the hard work has paid off!"
Ji Ruxue, sitting cross-legged in the room, allowed a slight smile to emerge.
At this moment, she was using the Spirit Communication Technique to manipulate a little bee, watching the scene unfold.
She saw the four fourth-tier zombies standing outside the farm’s wall.
Even Ji Ruxue felt a profound sense of security in her heart.
Now, like Lu Chuan, she was also filled with joy inside.
Because with the addition of these four fourth-tier zombies, Qingshui Farm’s strength was greatly increased.
It’s worth noting, before adding her father, the Corpse King, the entire farm only had two fourth-tier combatants.
But in a blink of an eye, the farm’s fourth-tier strength had increased to six!
This made Ji Ruxue even more confident in her fight against the human side.
In her opinion, as long as the human Survivor Base didn’t deploy large-scale armed forces, with just the Evolutionary Squads, they couldn’t possibly be opponents for her and her father.
With just fourth-tier strengths, the surrounding Survivor Base Cities might not stand a chance, so how could they compete with their farm?
...
Jianghai Survivor Base.
Inside a massive conference room.
At the center of the large conference table, fifteen Evolvers, with every five sitting together, were discussing something.
At this moment, Wang Lei also sat with his team members inside, exactly five people.
After returning to the Base City, not long after, his team’s vacancies were filled by the base city, and now he had four teammates again.
The reason Wang Lei was in this conference room was that the highest command had selected three elite squads to carry out a mission in the Jiangnan City District.
This time, they were called together to be given formal orders, after which they could depart.
Originally, Wang Lei’s squad wasn’t initially selected to undertake this task, mainly because his team had just been replenished, and there were two newcomers, so it wasn’t suitable for them to take on a mission immediately.
However, Wang Lei volunteered and expressed a strong desire, coupled with the fact that his team had previously carried out related missions, and was more familiar with the Jiangnan City District’s situation, so in the end, the highest command agreed.
After all, it was thanks to Wang Lei that the Invisibility Squad’s matter was exposed so quickly, something the highest command acknowledged.
"Captain Wang, I’ve looked at the mission data this time, it’s quite complex!
But this time, Captain Wang, you really stood out, being able to identify issues with the Invisibility Squad. Your sharpness is truly impressive!"
At this time, a bald middle-aged man sitting opposite Wang Lei, expressed admiration.
"Haha, Captain Zhang, you flatter me. It was sheer coincidence, I had been to Jiangnan City District before.
So I was somewhat familiar with that side’s situation, and coupled with various inconsistencies in the Invisibility Squad members’ words, I chose to take a gamble, and luckily, it paid off."
Wang Lei shook his head humbly and said.
Previously, he only had suspicions with no real evidence, and his decision to hypnotize the Invisibility Squad was rather risky in hindsight.
Because if there had been no issue on the other side, not only would Wang Lei create four more enemies, but he would also face severe punishment from the Base City.
After all, both the Invisibility Squad and Wang Lei belonged under the Base City’s official forces, making them de facto comrades.
Wang Lei’s unprovoked actions against comrades was absolutely prohibited by the Base City.
It was only due to the highest command personally absolving Wang Lei of blame, otherwise, despite his great contribution, he’d certainly face some consequences.
"Captain Wang, you’re too modest. If it were someone else, they likely wouldn’t dare to take such a risk regardless of their suspicions."
Captain Zhang unconsciously stroked his own smooth head, full of admiration for Wang Lei’s actions.
"Indeed, not just anyone possesses such courage as Captain Wang does. That the Base City was able to quickly locate Liu Captain’s murderer owes much to Captain Wang.
Such decisiveness is something I also admire a lot!"
Just as Wang Lei was preparing to respond, suddenly, a voice came from beside him.
It was someone from the squad sitting next to Wang Lei’s team speaking.
The speaker was a young man, not old but with a head full of white hair. A scar on his face gave his smile a somewhat grim appearance.
"Captain Li, why are you joining in the fun too?"
Wang Lei saw the speaker and shook his head helplessly.
"Haha, I’m just speaking the truth, Captain Wang, being overly modest could be seen as arrogance."
Captain Li chuckled and said.
Immediately, Captain Li looked at Wang Lei, continuing, "Among our three squads, only your team, Captain Wang, has carried out missions in the Jiangnan City District before; we’ll probably need your team’s guidance later on."
"Indeed, Jiangnan City District is quite eerie. Captain Wang, this time, we two squads will be following your lead."
The opposite Captain Zhang also nodded, smiling.
"You two..."
Listening to their words, Wang Lei understood they intended for his team to take the lead; he couldn’t agree and immediately waved his hand to refuse.
At this moment.
Thud, thud, thud~
The sound of firm footsteps approached from the side.
When the newcomer was seen, everyone’s expressions stiffened, all rising in unison, and the conference room fell into instant silence.
It was the highest command walking towards them.
"Everyone, please sit."
The highest commander sat at the head and pressed his hands down towards everyone.
"Yes!"
Everyone took their seats.
"The reason for gathering you all today is regarding the mission."
"The mission data has already been sent to you, so you should all be aware.
This mission is extremely important, and I hope that you three captains can give it your all to capture that ’mysterious girl’ in the Jiangnan City District for me!"
The highest command spoke with a serious expression and a deep voice.
"Rest assured, sir. We guarantee to complete the mission!"
Wang Lei and the others stood up again, responding loudly.
"Good, Captain Wang, you are the most familiar with this mission, so once you arrive, you’ll be in charge of the operations. Make sure that the mysterious girl does not escape!"
The highest command nodded and then looked at Wang Lei, instructing him.
"Yes!"
Wang Lei responded solemnly, with a hint of anger in his eyes.
He remembered the last trip to the Jiangnan City District, where two of his teammates met with tragic deaths, connecting it to this mysterious girl mission.
He suspected, highly likely, that this person was the one who killed his two teammates.
Blood debt... must be repaid with blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 210: Falcon! Visual Sharing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 210: Falcon! Visual Sharing!
Outside Jiangnan City District.
Buzz buzz buzz~
With a roar, three helicopters flew in from the distance.
Above a smooth piece of ground, the three helicopters hovered for a few moments before a dozen figures quickly descended from the sky.
The people who descended were the three Elite Squads dispatched by Jianghai Base City for this mission.
A moment later, the helicopters flew away.
On the ground, the three squads gathered together under the leadership of their respective captains.
"Captain Wang, you are more familiar with Jiangnan City District than us. I think from now on, we should follow your arrangement! What’s the plan for the next step?"
Captain Li, with a head full of white hair, looked at Wang Lei and suggested.
The hidden enemies are undoubtedly strong. If the three squads fight separately, they may easily be picked off one by one. Only by acting together are they safest.
"Yes, Captain Wang, we don’t know this place well. The little information we have can’t compare to your firsthand exploration. Don’t be modest, let’s follow your command for this operation."
Beside him, Captain Zhang, with a shining bald head, smiled as he removed the cigarette from his mouth.
They are not afraid of taking responsibility but truly unfamiliar with the situation in Jiangnan City District.
The two squads were responsible for other directions within Jianghai Base City and had never dealt with Jiangnan City District.
"Since both captains have said so, then I will shamelessly assume command of this operation. If there are any shortcomings, please feel free to supplement."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei hesitated for a moment, then nodded in agreement.
After all, before coming, the top command had already named him to arrange the next action, and he couldn’t refuse.
Seeing Wang Lei agree, Captain Zhang and Captain Li both smiled, the former asked cheerily, "So Captain Wang, how should our teams proceed next? Do we go directly into Jiangnan City District, or do we send one or two people as the vanguard to scout the situation inside the district first?"
Recalling when his squad entered Jiangnan City District last time and found all Evolved Zombies had disappeared, Wang Lei could almost ascertain that the entire Jiangnan City District was filled with the enemy’s eyes and ears.
Those Evolved Zombies likely died at the hands of Evolvers inside the district.
In such circumstances, the three squads with fifteen people are too large to move in undetected.
Then their advantage of enemy in the open and us in the dark will be lost.
So, recklessly sending personnel into the district, in Wang Lei’s opinion, is inappropriate.
"Gentlemen, we don’t know how many Evolvers are hidden inside Jiangnan City District.
But I estimate it’s not a small number. To prevent being discovered early, I think we should let someone with reconnaissance ability scout inside first."
Wang Lei pondered for a moment and proposed to the two captains.
Upon finishing his words, Wang Lei looked at Captain Li.
Captain Zhang, beside him, mirrored Wang Lei’s action, also shifting his gaze to Captain Li.
Regarding the situation of the three squads, the captains were actually very familiar.
The recon specialist Wang Lei suggested was most suitable from Captain Li’s squad.
This Evolver’s codename was — Falcon.
Before the apocalypse, he was a professional hunter who specialized in raising hawks to assist in hunting.
After the apocalypse, the hawk he raised became a Mutated Fierce Beast but remained loyal to him. The Evolver also awakened an ability to sign contracts with certain creatures, enabling vision sharing and mutual understanding with the pet.
By contracting his hawk, Falcon naturally gained outstanding reconnaissance abilities, valued by the Base City, and was recruited into the official unit.
It’s not that the other two squads didn’t have Evolutionary recon specialists, but they needed close reconnaissance, risking discovery by enemies in the district.
Falcon, however, wouldn’t have such concerns. If a hawk flew into the district, even if discovered, suspicion would be minimal.
"Captain Li, we might have to trouble your squad for this scouting task," Wang Lei said solemnly.
Captain Zhang nodded in agreement.
Captain Li understood their meaning and didn’t refuse. He also agreed with Wang Lei’s scouting proposal.
Then Captain Li nodded and immediately ordered his team behind him, "Falcon, let your treasure scout ahead! Stay safe and don’t fly too low!"
"Yes, Captain!"
Among the four people behind Captain Li, a middle-aged man with weathered features hurriedly stepped forward after hearing the order.
He had a lean build, carried a massive alloy bow, and wore a quiver at his waist.
He nodded to the three captains.
Next, Falcon closed his eyes and began communicating with his treasured pet.
Shriek!
An ear-piercing cry came from above everyone’s heads.
In the sky, a giant Black Hawk with a wingspan of three zhang, eyes sharp, received the order and suddenly shook its wings, stirring strong winds as it dived towards Jiangnan City District.
Everyone looked up, watching the hawk fly into the district.
"Captain Li, honestly, I envy you! How come you got such a useful recon specialist from the Base City for your squad? It would be great to have one in my squad."
Glancing at Falcon, who was in sync with the Black Hawk, Captain Zhang touched his head and commented enviously to Captain Li.
Falcon’s reconnaissance ability is truly handy, allowing for pet scouting without Evolvers taking risks, both safe and stealthy.
In every Base City mission, the most dangerous role was the squad’s scout.
Often needing to explore unknown hazardous areas, once exposed, retreat is impossible, resulting in direct sacrifice.
So far, Captain Zhang’s squad has already sacrificed two recon specialists.
Fortunately, Base City timely replenished the team when there was a vacancy.
"There’s nothing I can do! Falcon was supplied by Base City, I didn’t contribute at all."
Hearing this, Captain Li smiled, ever since having Falcon as a recon specialist in the squad, mission safety had greatly increased.
They could always thoroughly investigate enemy situations without alerting them.
While the two were chatting.
Among the crowd, Wang Lei gazed at Jiangnan City District not far away, his eyes flickering with a hint of fierceness.
Returning here again, images of his two teammates’ tragic deaths kept flooding his mind.
The enemy not only killed them but also hung their bodies to shame them.
This time, he must uncover the secrets of this district!

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 211: Oh My God! It’s Really a Zombie Driving!
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 211: Oh My God! It’s Really a Zombie Driving!
