A giant Black Hawk, with a robust build and astonishing wingspan, swept across the skies of the Jiangnan City District, its sharp eyes surveying everything below.
The once-towering buildings, now riddled with countless holes, stood in ruin. Glass curtain walls shattered like spiderwebs, while the outer walls of residential buildings crumbled away like clothing, with one corner clinging to the wall, fluttering in the wind.
The city streets were littered with vehicles that had collided or were stuck in traffic jams, their bodies covered in dust and various claw marks.
For reasons unknown, the windows of many vehicles were broken, revealing chaotic interiors stained with blood. Occasionally, the reeking corpses lay in the driver’s seat, with mosquitoes and flies buzzing around, filling the air with stench.
The shops along the streets had their doors violently broken open, and their glass windows shattered, with goods scattered like the aftermath of a robbery.
Meanwhile, across the streets, scattered and fragmented corpses lay in every direction, with dried black marks left from pools of blood beneath them. Zombies wandered aimlessly along the roads.
From the hawk’s-eye view, the entire Jiangnan City District appeared dead silent, with only the occasional zombie’s roar echoing through the city.
"Everything seems normal, fitting the true appearance of a city in the apocalypse."
After a moment of observation, the Falcon thought to himself.
But suddenly, a rumbling sound reached his ears.
On the distant street, a speeding truck roared into sight within the hawk’s-eye view.
The truck moved quickly, its exterior filthy, marked with dark red stains left from dried blood.
Moreover, the truck’s movements appeared deliberate, as if it was heading towards a specific destination, quickly darting through the city, avoiding the streets blocked by vehicles.
"This truck..."
The appearance of the truck made the Falcon’s expression change slightly and startled him.
How could a truck suddenly appear in this dead city?
And brazenly drive through the city, unafraid of zombie attacks?
Was it an enemy lurking in the city, or the surviving survivors?
Falcon’s heart was filled with doubt.
With such a significant discovery, it naturally required timely reporting.
Immediately, Falcon withdrew his focus from the Black Hawk, opened his eyes, and looked at Captain Li, shouting, "Captain, there’s a discovery!"
A discovery?!!
The three chatting members, Wang Lei, immediately grew joyful and quickly gathered around.
The other team members also curiously approached.
"Falcon, what’s going on, tell us quick!"
Captain Li nodded at Falcon, urging impatiently.
"Captain, within the city, a truck has been spotted driving, seemingly fearless of zombie attacks, moving extremely fast and causing quite a commotion!"
Falcon promptly reported the discovery of the truck.
This phenomenon was too strange.
"A truck?"
Everyone expressed surprise.
"Could it be a survivor driving the truck, trying to escape from the city?"
Captain Li frowned, expressing some doubt.
"No way, by now, those who should have left have long since left.
Those remaining are exceedingly timid, even if barely surviving, they wouldn’t have the courage to drive a truck madly in the city!"
Captain Zhang beside him shook his head, speaking with disdain.
"Then it must be hidden enemies, Evolvers lurking in the city, don’t forget that mysterious little girl!"
Captain Li’s expression instantly became solemn, and he spoke in a deep voice.
This possibility was the greatest; only Evolvers would have the guts to drive a noise-inducing truck in a city full of zombies.
After all, ordinary zombies couldn’t do anything to Evolvers.
"There’s a high possibility; only Evolvers would have this nerve.
But why are they driving a truck? Logically speaking, isn’t walking safer? It wouldn’t cause so much commotion either!"
Captain Zhang nodded, frowning slightly.
Compared to the two, Wang Lei thought much further; upon hearing Falcon mention the truck, he suddenly recalled the rumors about zombies driving cars within the Jiangnan City District.
The more he thought about it, the more uneasy he felt. Wang Lei’s expression changed, and he hurriedly instructed Falcon, "Whether it’s an Evolver in hiding or not, this truck is extremely suspicious.
Falcon, please keep your eyes on this truck; don’t let it leave your sight. See where it’s going!"
"That’s right, keep a close watch and see what its destination is!"
Both Captain Li and Captain Zhang nodded.
This time, their target was the mysterious little girl. As long as they could follow the clues and capture her, their mission would be considered complete.
"Understood!"
Falcon dared not slack off; he hurriedly reconnected his consciousness with the Black Hawk, preparing to follow the captains’ orders and closely track the truck.
In Jiangnan City District, the Black Hawk hovering at high altitude began to rapidly descend under Falcon’s control.
It vibrated its wings, weaving between the high-rises, its sharp gaze tightly following the quickly moving truck, not missing a single detail.
In the truck, Lu Chuan was directing a second-tier Corpse Puppet, heading for the stadium.
The truck was filled with blood and flesh of Mutated Fierce Beasts, all meant to feed the zombies in the stadium.
Since the second harvest, the zombies in the stadium were soon replenished by Lu Chuan.
The pig farming was to begin anew!
Next, as long as there was enough mutated blood and flesh, it shouldn’t be long before Lu Chuan could proceed with the third harvest.
Scree~ Scree~
The truck braked sharply, coming to a stop right in front of the stadium entrance.
Opening the door, the second-tier Corpse Puppet exited the truck.
Jiang Che began feeding the zombies.
All of this was captured by the Black Hawk as it flew closely with the truck, observing the zombie descending from the truck, Falcon’s expression instantly changed, shock filling his heart.
In an instant, Falcon disconnected from the Black Hawk, quickly opened his eyes, his gaze full of horror.
Those constantly monitoring Falcon noticed his expression, their hearts tightened.
"Falcon, what’s going on?"
Captain Li asked worriedly.
"Falcon, did you discover something?"
Wang Lei gazed at Falcon with some excitement, hoping to discern something from his expression.
Falcon stared wide-eyed at everyone, shouting incredulously, "My god, there really are zombies driving in Jiangnan City District!"
He had only previously seen related statements in the captain’s documents.
But actually, everyone hadn’t taken it seriously, as the document stated it was suspected, meaning it was uncertain, so he glanced at it and then disregarded it.
But unexpectedly, this matter was indeed true; there really were zombies driving in Jiangnan City District, truly...

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 212: The Farm Exposed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 212: The Farm Exposed!
Zombies driving cars!!!
The moment Wang Lei heard this news from the Falcon’s mouth, his eyes widened, and his mind was greatly shocked.
This matter is actually true!
Although he had previously learned of this news from the mouths of those survivors, and the information provided by the Base City regarding zombies driving cars also came from him.
But the idea of zombies driving cars is so unbelievable, beyond the scope of normal comprehension...
He still harbored some doubts in his heart.
After all, he had not seen this matter with his own eyes; it was all heard from the survivors.
Even though instinct told him that those survivors weren’t lying, seeing is believing.
But now, since Falcon claimed to have seen it with his own eyes, and since he was his comrade, there was no room for error, so he had to believe it.
Then Wang Lei seemed to think of something, his complexion changed again, and a look of shock appeared in his eyes.
According to the survivors’ statements, the zombies in Jiangnan City District are not only able to drive cars, but they can also transport resources.
This stirred more speculation in his heart, could it be... there is truly a Corpse King lurking in Jiangnan City District?
Is the Corpse King commanding these zombies, whether it’s driving trucks or transporting resources, all of it?
All previous speculations were true, there really is a Corpse King existing in Jiangnan City District!
Captain Zhang, standing nearby, almost dropped his jaw upon hearing Falcon’s words.
Is it true? A zombie driving a truck?
Could it be that what was said in the documents is real?
But how is it possible for a zombie to drive a truck?
Standing next to Falcon was Captain Li, frowning. He naturally believed his team member’s account.
After all, they are currently completing an important mission for the Base, which carries great weight. Falcon would not dare lie at such a crucial time.
It’s just that these zombies driving cars... are indeed too surprising.
He had also seen the previous relevant documents and thought it was a rumor!
Now it seems that this intelligence is true!
Aside from the three captains, the remaining crowd of team members was also shocked, looking at each other in disbelief upon hearing about zombies driving cars.
Zombies driving cars?
It’s simply unbelievable, but Falcon doesn’t show any signs of lying.
"What do you two think? The mission entrusted to us by the Base is the mysterious little girl!"
At this moment, Captain Zhang looked at Wang Lei and the others, asking in some confusion.
Their original mission was to capture the mysterious little girl, but now there’s a zombie driving a car, one is an Evolver, the other is a zombie, and they are entirely unrelated!
"I think this situation must be taken seriously, I have a bad feeling, Corpse King!"
Wang Lei’s face was serious, and after finishing, he continued: "The Corpse King can control zombies, causing a Corpse Tide, now controlling a zombie to drive a car, I also think there’s no problem in that!"
"Corpse King?"
Captain Zhang’s complexion drastically changed, pondering over it, indeed this zombie driving a car could be linked to the Corpse King.
"Very possibly, cannot be 100% certain, but we have to take it seriously; after all, it’s a Corpse King! The threat of the Corpse King, no need for me to expand further, you should understand as well!"
"As for the issue of the mysterious little girl, I think we can set it aside for now and address it after confirming the situation with the Corpse King."
"If there is no Corpse King, we will proceed to capture the mysterious little girl, but if there is..."
Wang Lei’s face turned ugly, looking at Captain Li and Captain Zhang.
"I agree, if there really is a Corpse King, going in to capture the mysterious little girl would definitely alarm it; there might even be a total wipeout!"
Captain Li’s expression was grave, nodding seriously as he spoke.
"Alright, let’s first see what this business of zombies driving cars is about, hopefully it’s not the Corpse King..."
Captain Zhang also slightly nodded, speaking with concern.
With the knowledge that there might be a Corpse King in Jiangnan City District, all the team members grew tense, making the atmosphere on the scene very somber.
"Falcon, did you see what the truck was loaded with?"
Subsequently, Wang Lei turned around to look at Falcon, inquiring.
Zombies couldn’t possibly be driving empty trucks around, as there would be no point.
Upon hearing this, Falcon closed his eyes, using Black Hawk’s vision to observe, speaking while doing so: "It’s... seems like the carcasses of Fierce Beasts, but they’re specially divided into pieces.
By the way, zombies are transporting these Fierce Beast carcasses using carts into the sports stadium in Jiangnan City District! Not sure what for!"
"Fierce Beast carcasses? Trucks transporting carcasses to the sports stadium... could it be delivered for the Corpse King’s enjoyment?"
Highly possible!
Wang Lei was greatly astounded, judging the sports stadium to be the Corpse King’s lair.
These Fierce Beast carcasses are very likely commanded by the Corpse King’s zombies, hunted from outside Jiangnan City District.
Now, zombies are surely driving trucks to transport the mutated fierce beast meat back to the sports stadium for the Corpse King’s feast.
No mistake!
Absolutely it’s this!
Wang Lei’s eyes gleamed as he inquired Falcon again: "Falcon, did you notice any signs of other Evolved Zombies? Especially around the sports stadium?"
"None, seems like there’s only this one!"
Falcon observed carefully and shook his head in response.
No?
Wang Lei frowned, it’s impossible for a Corpse King to have only one Evolved Zombie under its command.
Knowing that the entire Jiangnan City District’s Evolved Zombies were missing, it’s highly likely they were summoned by the Corpse King.
There absolutely should not be none.
"Falcon, keep a close eye on this driving zombie, I want to see where it drives the truck to."
Wang Lei’s gaze turned cold, instructing.
This Evolved Zombie is most likely under the Corpse King’s control, as long as they can keep a close watch on this Evolved Zombie, Wang Lei feels certain they can locate where other Evolved Zombies are hidden.
Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated!
Because this is the Corpse King, a terrifyingly extreme entity, if it successfully causes a Corpse Tide, even the entire Jianghai Base City could be overturned in an instant.
Wang Lei must find out how many Evolved Zombies the Corpse King has under its command to better direct this operation.
"Yes! I will definitely keep a close watch on the opponent!"
Falcon responded, immediately focusing on monitoring the Evolved Corpse Puppet’s every movement.
The two captains beside him watched as Wang Lei issued orders and remained silent.
After all, it had been agreed just now that this operation would be commanded by Wang Lei, and they just needed to follow orders.
Within Jiangnan City District.
Lu Chuan manipulated the Evolved Corpse Puppet, using a small cart to transport the mutated meat into the sports stadium, feeding the zombie swarm.
Moments later, after finishing feeding, Lu Chuan directly drove the truck, quickly returning to the farm.
Unaware there was a black shadow tightly following above the truck.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 213: Target Sighted: The Mysterious Little Girl!
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 213: Target Sighted: The Mysterious Little Girl!
Qingshui Farm, playground.
Ji Ruxue is swinging, her small figure seated on the swing, swaying back and forth, with her white dress fluttering in the wind.
At this moment, the smile on Ji Ruxue’s rosy little face is bright and radiant.
"Little Qiqi, does it seem like the problem has been solved?"
Leaning against the slide, Zhao Lin watches Little Qiqi, who hadn’t played in the amusement park for days, come out today, sparking a speculation in her mind, and she quickly asks with a smile.
Upon hearing Zhao Lin speak to her, Ji Ruxue slows down, causing the swing to decelerate.
Then she nods to Zhao Lin, her voice crisp, "It’s temporarily solved."
Dad broke through to Tier 4 and has four Tier 4 Evolved Zombies, plus her own Tier 4 cultivation; such strength finally allows Ji Ruxue to temporarily breathe a sigh of relief.
With six Tier 4 fighters, in Ji Ruxue’s view, she can basically rest easy for a short period.
After all, even several Tier 3 Evolvers couldn’t possibly be a match for a Tier 4.
The human Survivor Base, especially the nearby Jianghai Base City, even if they found the farm, how many Evolvers could they send out?
Coming would only mean death!
"That’s good. So, Little Qiqi, will you be coming out every day from now on?"
Zhao Lin felt happy for Little Qiqi, and then quickly asked again.
These past few days, being alone in the amusement park without seeing a soul felt indeed suffocating for Zhao Lin.
Previously, at least she could see Little Qiqi, and they could still talk and exchange, keep each other company; but ever since the Corpse King encountered a crisis, it was hard even to see Little Qiqi.
"Of course, I’ll be coming out every day to play and can chat with you!"
Ji Ruxue nodded her head earnestly.
Since intending to tame this Nine Deaths Demon Police, Ji Ruxue naturally needs to cultivate feelings with her, not make it estranged.
Even though the other party is still somewhat unreliable, her powerful Evolutionary Ability means she will eventually be an Emperor Realm powerhouse, regardless.
At this time, Zhao Lin suddenly said seriously, "Little Qiqi... I will help you and your dad, you don’t need to worry!"
It seemed she made a big decision, and after finishing the words, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but take several deep breaths.
Ji Ruxue was stunned, then quickly realized it was Zhao Lin’s response to her counter-question that day.
Honestly, Ji Ruxue was quite surprised by Zhao Lin’s affirming reply.
Zhao Lin was the Nine Deaths Demon Police, and still the early stages of Nine Deaths Demon Police.
To her knowledge, Zhao Lin was particularly dedicated to her police duties, loyal to the official, and valued protecting survivors’ safety more than her life.
In the previous life, post-apocalypse, the other party died countless times due to this personality.
But now, the other party actually offered to help her and dad!
Knowing dad’s enemies are humans, who Zhao Lin vows to protect, is the other party going to side with them against humans now?
"Why?"
Ji Ruxue felt confused, completely unable to comprehend why the other party would undergo such a big change.
Actually, Ji Ruxue didn’t really expect Zhao Lin to give an answer to her previous counter-question at all.
Because she knew Zhao Lin would inevitably fall into conflict, unable to make a choice, and very likely to still side with humans eventually.
But never expected that today, the other party gave her a surprising answer.
Indeed, fate is unpredictable!
"Because I promised to protect you!"
Facing Ji Ruxue’s question, Zhao Lin’s expression turned solemn as she spoke earnestly.
Actually, deciding to help Little Qiqi and the Corpse King came after multiple considerations.
Because if the Corpse King really lost to humans, then Little Qiqi, the child mingling with the Corpse King, might also get hurt.
And definitely wouldn’t be as happy, laughing every day like now, which she didn’t want to see.
Moreover, the Corpse King possesses human consciousness, which is a crucial point for Zhao Lin.
Though this period, the Corpse King has been constantly hunting Fierce Beasts, displaying extreme bloodthirst, Zhao Lin never saw him slaughter humans, not even killing herself despite repeated offenses.
Plus, through this period of contact, Zhao Lin could basically determine that the Corpse King isn’t slaughter-happy by nature.
Such a Corpse King, Zhao Lin felt it was better not to let him be defeated by humans.
Because now, there’s still Little Qiqi as the tie, dragging the Corpse King, making him appear non-aggressive.
But once human attacks affect Little Qiqi or push the Corpse King away from her, nobody knows if the Corpse King will go crazy.
Especially considering the other party has Corpse King intelligence comparable to humans, if he goes berserk, the consequences would be unimaginable.
...
Black Hawk followed the truck, flying out of Jiangnan City District all along.
Watching the truck continuously heading towards the outskirts, Falcon felt extremely excited.
The other party’s departure from the city must have a purpose, if followed all the way, something will surely be uncovered.
Until Falcon saw the truck drive into a farm.
The moment he saw the farm, Falcon was stunned.
The farm’s perimeter was a layer of blood-red walls, seemingly woven from special red vines.
What’s most important is this blood-red wall extended as far as the eye could see, appearing extremely awe-inspiring.
Then, Falcon’s gaze shifted to the tall stone wall inside.
That stone wall was entirely built from boulders, appearing extremely solid like an impregnable fortress.
"Is this the zombie’s lair? Why does it feel like a place for humans?"
Falcon wondered looking at the two layers of walls clearly constructed by humans, speculating silently in his heart.
Next, Black Hawk continued flying towards the farm’s depths, hovering over the entire farm, scanning everything below with sharp eagle eyes.
In the next moment, Falcon saw many zombies inside the stone wall, with many being Evolved Zombies, tall and fierce-looking, only these zombies seemed odd.
Because these zombies were holding some tools as if working.
Some zombies holding hoes seemed to be weeding, some carrying shovels were digging trenches, even some zombies were holding baskets picking something from trees...
Such a scene made Falcon feel dazzled and baffled.
What situation is this, driving trucks wasn’t enough, now they’re plowing fields and doing farm work?
While Falcon considered this increasingly absurd, a silhouette below captured his sight.
It was Ji Ruxue swinging on the swing!
Upon seeing Ji Ruxue, Falcon’s face changed dramatically.
A girl?
Could this be the mission target, the mysterious little girl?

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 214: Could This Little Girl Be the Corpse King?
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 214: Could This Little Girl Be the Corpse King?
Seeing this scene, the Falcon didn’t dare hesitate and immediately informed Wang Lei and the others of the news.
Excitedly, he said, "Captains, I followed the truck driven by the zombies and tracked it all the way to an outlying farm. I think I’ve found the traces of that mysterious little girl!"
"That little girl is now in the farm!"
What?
Upon hearing this, Wang Lei’s heart trembled, and his eyes widened. The mysterious little girl had appeared?
However, Wang Lei was immediately puzzled. The Falcon was clearly tracking an Evolved Zombie, and even if it found something, it would be the Evolved Zombie. How did it find traces of a little girl?
Could it be that this Corpse King has some unknown connection with the little girl?
Wang Lei was baffled.
Upon hearing this, Captain Zhang and Captain Li were also a bit surprised. Just a moment ago, the three of them decided to temporarily put aside the issue of the little girl and handle the matter of the Corpse King first, since the Corpse King was more important.
But now, ironically, the little girl appeared first.
Wang Lei hurriedly asked, "Falcon, what else did you see? Any traces of the Corpse King or other Evolved Zombies?"
"Not sure about the Corpse King, but I did see zombies, a lot of zombies, all inside the farm!"
The Falcon quickly responded.
At the same time, the Falcon’s heart was filled with confusion. He could understand why these zombies appeared here, but how could a little girl appear amidst the zombies?
And how is she surviving among the zombies? Why aren’t these zombies attacking her?
We know that zombies are very sensitive to the scent of flesh. A little girl appearing so openly among zombies should have been torn apart long ago.
Right, this little girl seems to be an Evolver, after all, she killed Captain Liu of the Invisibility Squad, showing considerable strength.
But this still makes no sense! Even if she’s an Evolver, it doesn’t stop the zombies from attacking her!
Puzzled, the Falcon was about to lower the Black Hawk for a closer inspection of the little girl, but suddenly, his pupils shrank, and his face changed drastically.
"Wait... is that a woman?"
How is there still a woman?
Through the Hawkeye’s view, he saw a human woman leaning against a slide not far from the swing where the little girl was, her mouth moving as if speaking to the girl.
After careful discernment, the Falcon was sure he wasn’t wrong, that is indeed a living human woman.
At this moment, the Falcon was in shock, feeling like his worldview was collapsing.
A little girl staying with zombies was already surprising, and now there was a human woman. What was going on?
Could it be that the zombies of Jiangnan City District have changed their nature and no longer attack humans?
Then the Falcon thought of a new hypothesis.
Could it be that these two are a team?
Both are Evolvers!
But it still doesn’t make sense why they can safely stay at a zombie-filled farm.
Then the Falcon reported what he observed to Wang Lei and the others.
"Captains, I’ve found a human woman who seems to know the little girl. They might be on the same team.
But these two are in a farm full of zombies, and those zombies aren’t attacking. It’s strange!"
Everyone present changed expressions upon hearing this, utterly amazed.
The situation was too bizarre. Since when could zombies and humans coexist peacefully?
"Falcon, are you sure you didn’t see it wrong? Are they really a human woman and a little girl, not just clean-looking zombies?"
Captain Li asked skeptically with a frown.
The scenario was too ridiculous. If they were truly human, why wouldn’t the zombies attack? It doesn’t make sense.
"Confirmed, Captain. The two of them are chatting happily without any tension of being in a zombie pack, as if they’re aware the zombies won’t attack them."
The Falcon nodded emphatically, his words filled with disbelief.
"..."
Upon hearing this, Captain Li was momentarily speechless, but his frown deepened.
He was familiar with the Falcon and trusted he wouldn’t speak nonsense, but the peaceful coexistence of Evolvers and zombies didn’t seem plausible!
At this moment, Wang Lei, standing beside him, suddenly affirmed, "That’s right, this little girl should be the one who killed Captain Liu of the Invisibility Squad."
Witnessing this bizarre situation, Wang Lei determined that the little girl in the farm was their target this trip.
He even speculated that the previous strange behavior in Jiangnan City District, like zombies driving cars and moving supplies, was related to this little girl.
The fact she was peacefully amongst zombies was the best proof.
"It’s very likely, but why can these two safely stay in the zombie group?
Falcon’s words just now should have been heard by everyone. It seems they aren’t afraid of the zombies, so what’s their relationship with these zombies?"
Captain Zhang lit a cigarette and inhaled deeply.
It’s too bizarre, just thinking about it makes one’s scalp tingle. Humans and zombies peacefully coexisting?
Are the zombies as intelligent as humans, or can these humans control the zombies?
Either hypothesis is terrifying.
"Guys, is it possible that this mysterious little girl is the Corpse King?"
At this point, Wang Lei hesitantly suggested.
It was his conjecture, as all information about the Corpse King at Jianghai Base City came from the Imperial Capital.
The Imperial Capital knew of the Corpse King’s existence, but no one had actually seen it.
That is to say, no one knows what the Corpse King looks like, though it is confirmed to be a zombie, it doesn’t necessarily look like the others!
Wang Lei speculated if it’s possible this Corpse King’s evolutionary path is to resemble humans more and more?
If not, the farm’s eerie phenomenon is even harder to explain.
"This little girl, the Corpse King?"
Captain Zhang and Captain Li’s expressions changed.
"Captain Wang, if your guess is true, it would be an earth-shattering discovery, the Corpse King looking like a human, this is simply..."
Captain Zhang exclaimed, shocked.
Indeed, thinking about it, Captain Wang’s hypothesis might be viable, which would explain how it peacefully exists with zombies.
"If the little girl is the Corpse King and she can control the zombies, it would explain the peaceful coexistence!"
Beside him, Captain Li nodded, somewhat approving.

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 215: Ji Ruxue’s Counter-Surveillance
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 215: Ji Ruxue’s Counter-Surveillance
In order to better verify his conjecture, Wang Lei looked at the Falcon and instructed, "Falcon, please descend a bit, get closer, and see if you can gather more information!
But be careful, if you sense anything wrong, retreat immediately!"
"Understood!"
The Falcon nodded slightly, then maneuvered the Black Hawk in the air to quickly approach the farm.
However, in order not to be discovered, the Black Hawk moved silently, making the sound of wing flapping barely audible.
As the Black Hawk got closer, the situation inside the farm became fully visible.
Vegetable gardens, orchards, ponds, and that amusement park...
Vegetable plots were neatly distributed on the ground, growing familiar vegetables like tomatoes, eggplants, and cucumbers.
In the orchard, peach trees and pear trees were densely packed, with red fruits hanging on some of them.
As for the amusement park, the Falcon took a quick glance; the facilities were quite complete, who knows if these Evolved Zombies brought them over.
However, this amusement park paired perfectly with that little girl.
Looking at these scenes, the Falcon couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
Such an environment, in the post-apocalypse world, is simply a paradise!
After the apocalypse, you can’t find such a good environment anymore.
Even in Jianghai Base City, there’s only some assurance of safety.
The usual vegetables found in those days couldn’t be eaten every day by evolvers in Jianghai Base City.
Since all the land reclaimed in Jianghai Base City was used for planting grain.
After all, the survivors in the outer city couldn’t even get enough to eat. How could they use that precious land to grow vegetables!
But just as the Falcon was lost in thought, the altitude of the Black Hawk kept dropping.
Below, in the amusement park, Ji Ruxue, who was chatting with Zhao Lin, suddenly frowned.
For some reason, she suddenly had the feeling of being watched by something, making her uncomfortable.
That’s right, something must be spying!
Ji Ruxue trusted her intuition.
In the past life, whenever she had this feeling, it meant an enemy was watching her from the shadows.
Her expression changed slightly, then returned to normal.
Ji Ruxue continued to chat with Zhao Lin as if nothing had happened, while secretly, her telekinesis spread out like a tide, searching for the unknown lurking in the shadows.
Zhao Lin, oblivious, noticed nothing unusual and kept chatting with Ji Ruxue cheerfully.
Ji Ruxue responded to her absentmindedly.
Moments later, a gleam flashed in Ji Ruxue’s eyes as she finally noticed something amiss.
She was almost certain that something kept spying on her from the shadows.
A Black Hawk.
This creature was circling over her head.
Like a black cloud drifting there, it didn’t make a single sound, and unless one looked up on purpose, it was impossible to notice.
This Black Hawk was the prime suspect!
Because Ji Ruxue had specifically observed it. The Black Hawk had been circling above the farm, almost as if it had a special interest in the place, which was quite strange.
This Black Hawk must be a Mutant Beast, but what does it want?
Does it want to eat me and Zhao Lin?
Ji Ruxue was puzzled by the Black Hawk’s behavior. Its circling overhead seemed only to suggest an intent to eat her and Zhao Lin, as there wouldn’t be any other possible reason.
Unfortunately, this farm isn’t a forest, once you come here, don’t expect to...
Wait a minute!
Suddenly, Ji Ruxue’s heart shuddered.
Black Hawks typically thrive in forests where food is abundant, so why would it hover over the farm just for her and Zhao Lin?
Together, she and Zhao Lin might not even weigh two hundred pounds!
Moreover, the Black Hawk was so close, yet it didn’t attack, almost as if it was investigating all aspects of the farm...
With her past experiences, the seasoned Ji Ruxue quickly realized something was off.
This Black Hawk is suspicious!
Ji Ruxue suddenly thought of some evolvers who could contract mutant beasts, and everything became clear.
The opponent is definitely not a normal wild mutant beast, but most likely an evolver’s contracted pet.
Is someone spying on the farm?
How did they discover this place?
Qingshui Farm is in the suburbs, with nothing nearby. Unless someone came with a purpose, no one would pass by.
Then, Ji Ruxue slightly frowned as if something had dawned upon her.
She understood.
The truck!
Her dad controlled a truck every day, transporting mutant flesh to the Jiangnan City District. The opponent most likely followed the truck back.
After all, the Black Hawk was very fast and flew in the sky, making it hard to be noticed.
In other words, it’s highly possible that the evolver controlling the Black Hawk appeared in the Jiangnan City District.
Upon thinking of the Jiangnan City District, Ji Ruxue inevitably associated it with the Invisibility Squad.
She had them sneak back there, but they turned out to be fully exposed.
Through association, Ji Ruxue almost guessed the situation.
It must be that someone from Jianghai Base City was sent again, and they sensed something was off from the Invisibility Squad, so someone was sent to the Jiangnan City District. They followed the truck driven by her dad and found this place.
Just now, the Black Hawk circling above was definitely surveying the farm’s strength.
Ji Ruxue coldly sneered in her heart, since the current farm couldn’t be shaken by just a few evolvers.
With a turn of thought, Ji Ruxue directly launched a telekinetic attack; the invisible telekinesis transformed into arrow-like spears and shot towards the Black Hawk.
Silently and without a sound, the telekinetic attack invaded the Black Hawk’s brain in the blink of an eye.
The next moment, the Black Hawk, which was initially flying smoothly, suddenly trembled and started to wobble.
As Falcon sensed the shaking vision, his face changed, believing the Black Hawk was out of stamina, and quickly recalled it.
After all, the Black Hawk had flown all the way here and circled cautiously over the farm, so it was normal for it to be exhausted.
Then the Black Hawk steadied its body, extended its wings, and fluttered back to its route.
Noticing the Black Hawk leaving, Ji Ruxue smiled knowingly; indeed, it was an evolver’s pet beast.
If it were a wild mutant beast, suffering an attack and feeling pain, it would most likely go haywire, letting out angry roars and attacking indiscriminately.
Instead, after being attacked, it endured without making a sound, struggling to leave the area.
Then, Ji Ruxue looked at a few sparrows on the ground, pecking at bugs nearby.
Soon, Ji Ruxue used the Spirit Communication Technique to control a sparrow and quickly follow.
She needed to know where the opponent was located.
Thinking of leaving after spying on the farm, it’s not that easy!

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 216: Night Raid on the Farm? However Many Come, I’ll Kill Them All!
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 216: Night Raid on the Farm? However Many Come, I’ll Kill Them All!
Due to Ji Ruxue’s telekinesis impact, Black Hawk’s spirit suffered considerable trauma.
Although not fatal, it slowed its flight speed compared to before.
Over at Falcon’s side, they also assumed Black Hawk was fatigued, making the slower speed reasonable.
The sparrow controlled by Ji Ruxue followed behind Black Hawk, flying all the way towards Jiangnan City District.
Time slowly passed, and Ji Ruxue maneuvered the sparrow all the way to the outskirts of Jiangnan City District.
Squawk!
Black Hawk let out a weak cry, diving towards the wilderness below.
"Finally arrived!"
Following behind, Ji Ruxue’s eyes brightened as she watched Black Hawk descend, controlling the sparrow to approach that position slowly.
Soon, Ji Ruxue saw a dry, grass-filled ravine with three squads gathered inside.
"Sure enough, the Base City is up to something behind the scenes. Their tactical uniforms are exactly like Li Ying’s team!"
Ji Ruxue’s gaze landed on Wang Lei and his team’s tactical uniforms, identical to those worn by the Invisibility Squad during their last visit to Jiangnan City District.
These people are likely the evolutionary squad sent by Jianghai Base City.
"I want to see what plots you’re planning!"
Noticing the people seemed to be discussing something, Ji Ruxue moved the sparrow slowly downward, finally landing silently on a nearby tree branch.
Wang Lei and his crew were focused on the falcon, thus paying no attention to the sparrow.
In the ravine, Falcon looked at the disheartened Black Hawk in front of him, affectionately stroking it, then turned to Wang Lei, saying awkwardly, "Captain Wang, sorry, my precious seems a bit tired and can’t scout for now."
"No worries, let it rest more! This time, your precious has made a significant contribution!"
Hearing this, Wang Lei nodded. The specific situation of the farm was mostly understood.
Even further scouting may not uncover anything significant, so Black Hawk would not be needed after this.
Falcon smiled and, with the cooperation of his teammates, took out food and water from his backpack and began to feed his precious, it needed to eat more due to fatigue.
Sitting in place, Wang Lei appeared to be in deep thought.
The scouting was basically complete; the girl on the farm was undoubtedly crucial.
Not only did she connect with the Invisibility Squad, but she also had significant ties with the Zombie King, possibly even being the Zombie King.
Their mission was to capture the girl.
"Guys, you’ve already heard what Falcon said.
The key now is to catch this girl.
If we manage to capture her, we’ll not only complete the mission but also get information about the Zombie King from her, possibly even confirming if she’s actually the Zombie King!"
Wang Lei looked at Captain Zhang and Captain Li beside him, serious and solemn.
The success of this mission depended on the upcoming actions. Any mistake could threaten the survival of the three squads.
Thus, Wang Lei intended to discuss with the other two captains before acting, to unify their thoughts and prevent unexpected situations during the mission.
"Captain Wang, I agree with your viewpoint. Based on Falcon’s description, it’s highly likely she’s the Zombie King or related to it. Capturing her would unravel everything!"
Captain Zhang, who was drinking water, put down the bottle and nodded.
This mission is centered on capturing the girl.
Now that the girl possibly shares an identity with the Zombie King, we naturally need to strike directly and capture her.
"Captain Wang, I also agree with your proposal, but if the girl is indeed an evolver, then we have the strength across three squads to capture her without difficulty.
Should the girl not be an evolver, but genuinely the Zombie King, the situation becomes tricky. Don’t forget, the Zombie King can manipulate zombies.
Falcon just mentioned the farm is swarming with zombies, attacking the Zombie King might cause us to be overwhelmed by a zombie horde."
Captain Li frowned, hesitating.
He had watched videos sent from the Imperial Capital of the zombie tide raised by the Zombie King — vast, fearless, terrifying to even think about!
"Captain Li, your concerns are valid. Indeed, if the girl is the Zombie King, brazenly heading to the farm might mean no return for us.
Even if the farm’s zombies can’t stop us, should the Zombie King delay us while stirring up a zombie tide from Jiangnan City District, our squads would undoubtedly face annihilation!"
Wang Lei smiled, nodding in agreement with Captain Li.
"Looks like, Captain Wang, you have a plan already? Come on, spill it; stop keeping us in suspense!"
Captain Zhang lit a cigarette and, seeing Wang Lei’s confident demeanor, urged him promptly.
Captain Li looked at Wang Lei, awaiting his explanation.
"I do have a plan, but whether it’s suitable, we need to discuss it amongst us!
We can’t be certain if the girl is the Zombie King, but treating her as such ensures we fight prepared."
"The Zombie King, with its power to control zombies, is indeed troublesome. If discovered, it quickly gathers zombies to attack us.
So to capture the Zombie King, we must conceal our traces. My suggestion is, our squads unite for a night raid on the farm, using the darkness as cover for a swift operation.
Before the Zombie King senses us, we launch directly at her when her zombie horde hasn’t surrounded us yet, controlling her then!"
Wang Lei’s expression turned grave as he spoke decisively.
If they could catch the girl off guard, the mission would likely succeed.
Speed is the crucial factor!
"Night raid the farm? Indeed it’s a good tactic; with the darkness as cover, it’s nearly impossible to spot us right away, allowing for quick passage through the zombie horde to capture her!"
Captain Zhang’s eyes lit up, finding Wang Lei’s plan promising, even if it’s merely a simple night raid, it addresses the toughest part — capturing the girl.
Beside him, Captain Li smiled slightly, nodding to Wang Lei, "Captain Wang, I agree."
"Alright, let’s discuss the specific timing for the operation..."
On the nearby tree branch, hearing their plan, Ji Ruxue snickered coldly in her heart.
Night raid the farm?
No matter how many come, I will kill them all!

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 217: Ji Ruxue’s Warning! Lu Chuan on Alert!
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 217: Ji Ruxue’s Warning! Lu Chuan on Alert!
From their earlier conversation, Ji Ruxue easily inferred that the little girl they were talking about was likely herself.
And the most ridiculous part was, these people even mistook her for the Zombie King and planned to raid the farm at night to capture her.
Ji Ruxue felt a speechless moment in her heart, this was really a grave misunderstanding!
With her current childlike form, she was cute and fair-skinned, how could she possibly resemble a Zombie King?
Like fools, they were practically blind!
However, Ji Ruxue thought to herself, she couldn’t really blame them for being foolish.
After all, her dad had been hiding in the room like a shut-in, never coming out.
The Evolver with the Black Hawk couldn’t see her dad, mistaking her for the Zombie King had some justification.
But why didn’t they mistake Zhao Lin for the Zombie King? That was something Ji Ruxue couldn’t quite understand.
Logically, compared to a little girl, Zhao Lin as an adult had a higher likelihood of being the Zombie King. Could it be that the chains on Zhao Lin were spotted?
So they deduced Zhao Lin wasn’t the Zombie King?
Unable to figure it out, Ji Ruxue simply stopped contemplating the matter, and turned her gaze towards Wang Lei and the other two, who were eagerly discussing the exact timing and details of the night raid.
Seeing the confidence on their faces and the determined tone in their words, a trace of disdain appeared in Ji Ruxue’s eyes.
Did they think the farm only had the strength that Black Hawk saw just now?
So naïve!
Then, Ji Ruxue did a quick count, finding that there were just fifteen people in the ravine, equivalent to three complete Evolutionary Squads by human standards.
With only these fifteen people, they wanted to raid the farm at night?
This was like an egg smashing against a rock.
One should know, from what Black Hawk saw earlier, among the zombies at the farm, there were only some first and second-tier Evolved Zombies, and their numbers were relatively few.
But this was merely a corner of the farm’s strength.
Dad’s Zombie Army was still at Yellow Dragon Mountain!
That’s where the farm’s main force was, with four fourth-tier zombies, terrifying in their might!
One can only imagine the reaction of these people when they arrive at the farm and see Dad’s four fourth-tier zombies.
They would likely collapse right away!
Ji Ruxue found the idea amusing, snorted and thought, "Dare to target me, I’ll let you feel my dad’s Zombie Iron Fist."
Then, after completing the discussion of the specific time and details of the night raid, Captain Li suddenly remembered something and said to Wang Lei beside him: "By the way, Captain Wang, I remember you mentioned before that the stadium in Jiangnan City District could also be hiding the Zombie King. Should we sneak into the stadium for reconnaissance before our night raid?"
"No need. Whether there’s a Zombie King there or not, we cannot enter the city district.
Because the district must be filled with the Zombie King’s informants, once discovered, given the number of zombies in the district, we would be completely wiped out!
Besides, if we go through the district and that little girl really is the Zombie King, it will certainly alert the opponent, so the district is absolutely off-limits."
Wang Lei shook his head, directly refusing, then added: "Actually, we can already confirm that the Zombie King is present in the Jiangnan City District. We should first capture the little girl to complete our mission.
If she’s the Zombie King, then everyone is happy. If she’s not, then the Zombie King must be hiding in the stadium, which is within the city district, densely filled with zombies, already beyond our ability to handle.
We should immediately take the little girl and swiftly retreat, return to the Base City, then report the Zombie King situation and let the highest command deal with it!"
After hearing this, both nodded solemnly.
Indeed, capturing the little girl was already a big risk, considering there’s a high chance she could be the Zombie King.
Their best choice should be to retreat immediately and report it, allowing Base City to dispatch greater forces for handling.
But unfortunately, the little girl was their mission target this time, without being able to confirm 100% that she’s the Zombie King, they had to complete the task.
Of course, they could also not complete it and report directly saying there’s a possibility the little girl was the Zombie King, that the three teams dared not move, but the result...
"Hm, they thought it out quite thoroughly, but alas..."
Ji Ruxue snorted coldly from her perch on the tree branch, then stopped listening to the three discussing, as her consciousness started returning.
Since their plan was already to raid the farm at night, she must warn dad and let him prepare.
...
At this time, Lu Chuan was busily controlling the Corpse Puppet army, slaughtering and harvesting lives in Yellow Dragon Mountain.
In the forest, a group of over twenty mutant wild boars was directly scattered by the Corpse Puppet army.
Roar!
A second-tier mutant wild boar let out a frightened roar and blindly rushed to Er Pang’s front.
Boom!
Suddenly, accompanied by a terrifying whistle, an indistinct shadow fell, a thick iron rod grazed the boar’s body, slamming the ground with a deafening bang.
And the part grazed by the iron rod, its half-body flesh directly peeled away from the skeleton, flying blood and gore everywhere, extremely bloody.
The second-tier mutant wild boar didn’t even get a chance to let out a miserable cry before lying on the ground with its flesh and bone separated, lifeless.
It wasn’t that Er Pang missed the attack, but rather Lu Chuan deliberately controlled it.
After advancing to the fourth tier, Er Pang’s strength had far exceeded expectations, whether it was a first-tier or second-tier mutant beast, as long as Er Pang hit it solidly, it would immediately turn into minced meat.
Lu Chuan cherished the flesh, so he let Er Pang do this, with the force of the graze, it just killed the fierce beast without turning the flesh into mash.
Now, with four fourth-tier Corpse Puppets by his side, Lu Chuan could practically walk unhindered in Yellow Dragon Mountain, any fierce beast in their presence was only there to be slaughtered.
While Lu Chuan was commanding the Corpse Puppets to encircle and wipe out the remaining mutant wild boars, Ji Ruxue suddenly came running over in haste.
Her face full of childlike curiosity and excitement, she pointed to the sky outside and shouted: "Dad, I just saw a flying person!"
Lu Chuan regathered his focus, turned to look at Little Qiqi, furrowing his brows.
A flying person? What kind of flying person?
Lu Chuan was puzzled.
Then Lu Chuan took out pen and paper, scribbling on the blank paper, "What kind of flying person? Little Qiqi, can you explain more clearly?"
Ji Ruxue took a look.
"It was someone flying over the farm, but didn’t stay long, then flew away.
It’s such a pity that dad didn’t get to see it."
Ji Ruxue explained to Lu Chuan while making a disappointed expression.
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan was suddenly taken aback.
What flying person, could it be a Human Evolver discovering the farm?

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 218: Zhao Lin’s Request: I Want to Help Too!
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 218: Zhao Lin’s Request: I Want to Help Too!
Flying humans, flying humans...
They can’t possibly be bird people with wings, right?
Could it be some human evolver who has awakened the ability to fly and discovered the farm?
Just to be safe, Lu Chuan used handwritten notes to repeatedly confirm with Little Qiqi, and asked some detailed questions.
He finally confirmed that the flying person Little Qiqi saw was indeed a real human.
And not some other humanoid creature.
Subsequently, Lu Chuan immediately concluded that the farm had been discovered by a human evolver.
After all, Little Qiqi is so young and says what she sees, she wouldn’t lie to him.
Faced with the sudden appearance of an evolver, Lu Chuan’s mood was a little heavy.
Just one evolver doesn’t scare him.
He’s just worried that the matter will be spread, and if it reaches the human survivor base, that would be bad.
Additionally, he reflected on himself; he’s been too careless lately.
Thinking that moving to the farm would bring peace of mind, he didn’t expect that a human evolver would find the farm without being detected.
If anything happened to Little Qiqi because of this, he would regret it too late.
Now that the farm has been discovered and exposed to the eyes of the evolvers, it is no longer safe.
Just to be safe, Lu Chuan immediately summoned back the undead army that was slaughtering fierce beasts at Yellow Dragon Mountain. He wanted to use all his strength to guard the farm.
There are priorities, hunting fierce beasts and gathering flesh and Crystal Cores is important, but it doesn’t compare to the farm’s safety.
Without the undead army and only having fourth-stage Corps Puppets, Lu Chuan is not at ease at all.
Snapping back to reality, seeing Little Qiqi still looking at him with those big round eyes, Lu Chuan affectionately pinched Little Qiqi’s soft cheek, causing the little guy to wrinkle her nose in discontent.
Afterward, Lu Chuan withdrew his hand and wrote again on the paper: "Little Qiqi, you made a great contribution this time, Daddy will definitely reward you well!"
"Great contribution... What will Daddy reward Little Qiqi with?"
Looking at the writing on the paper, Ji Ruxue blinked her watery eyes and asked expectantly.
Hearing Ji Ruxue’s question, Lu Chuan smiled and wrote again on the paper: "Daddy will make you a barbecue feast, how about that? We’ll make our Little Qiqi a chubby little girl!"
If it weren’t for Little Qiqi this time, he wouldn’t have noticed that the farm had already been discovered.
If so, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Not to mention, whether the opposite party would sneak into the farm while he commands the army to hunt at Yellow Dragon Mountain.
If the other party leaks the information of humans and corpses coexisting at the farm to the nearby human survivor base city.
The base city side will definitely be suspicious and send a large force to investigate the farm.
At that time, based on his strength, Lu Chuan probably won’t be in danger, but the farm would become uninhabitable, and the large amount of supplies he relocated from the city would have to be abandoned.
"Well, Little Qiqi wants to eat! But Little Qiqi won’t become a chubby little girl!"
Ji Ruxue first nodded, then glared at Lu Chuan and ran away, pouting.
Lu Chuan was greatly amused.
Time passed little by little.
Woo woo woo~
The speeding convoy finally returned from Yellow Dragon Mountain, and before unloading the beast corpses from the vehicles, one after another the evolved zombies began surrounding the entire farm, patrolling incessantly, making the defense extremely tight.
In an instant, the atmosphere at the farm became heavy.
Meanwhile, the four most powerful fourth-stage Corpse Puppets were gathered by Lu Chuan near the farm’s rooms to protect Little Qiqi’s safety.
Anyone plotting against Little Qiqi would face the thunderous strikes of the four fourth-stage Corpse Puppets.
Especially Flame One and Earth Escape One, the two remote mage-type Corpse Puppets; anyone hit by a spell would either die or be severely injured.
If that flying evolver dares to return, he will surely meet his end.
Such a big commotion immediately caught the attention of Zhao Lin outside.
Lying on the slide, as the defenses became incredibly strict, Zhao Lin’s expression shifted and she quickly stood up.
Her gaze instinctively scanned the surroundings to see what was going on.
For the evolved zombies to make such moves, they must have received instructions from the Corpse King?
Seeing the state of alert, there must be a powerful enemy emerging.
Suddenly, Zhao Lin’s gaze changed, as if she had thought of something, and directly looked towards the house not far away.
Could it be that another human evolver has set sights on the Corpse King and Little Qiqi?
Zhao Lin furrowed her brow, constantly speculating in her heart.
However, since there was not much information, she couldn’t be sure what exactly the Corpse King was facing.
It wasn’t until Ji Ruxue brought over their meal that Zhao Lin, full of questions, could finally release her thoughts, quickly asking Ji Ruxue: "Little Qiqi, what’s happening? Why has your dad ordered so many zombies to guard the farm? Has a human evolver come to trouble you guys?"
Handing a large bowl of rice topped with braised eggplant to Zhao Lin, Ji Ruxue frankly said: "Apart from this, what else could pose a threat to my dad?"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin’s complexion changed significantly, not expecting that she really guessed it, that a human evolver would indeed come to the farm to cause trouble.
Given the Corpse King’s strength, she wondered if he could handle it...
After hesitating for a moment, Zhao Lin looked towards Little Qiqi who had reached the swing and quietly asked: "Little Qiqi, could you talk to your dad about letting me go?"
The Corpse King usually adores Little Qiqi, so she thought there might be a chance of success if Little Qiqi made the request.
Hearing this, Ji Ruxue was puzzled, looking at Zhao Lin with a frown.
Seeing Little Qiqi’s expression, Zhao Lin didn’t hesitate and directly said: "At the very least, I’m also an evolver, not weak, and if I could be freed, I could lend you all a hand."
Help us?
Sitting on the swing, Ji Ruxue looked at Zhao Lin in surprise, was she being serious?
It looks like taking care of her during this period wasn’t in vain after all.
Ji Ruxue was a bit pleased in her heart; although she intended to tame Zhao Lin and kept her carefree with daily food and drink, it would be a loss if she turned out to be ungrateful.
Zhao Lin didn’t disappoint her, at least.
Then, Ji Ruxue smiled and said: "Thank you, but we don’t need your help for now; my dad can handle them."
With just those fifteen evolvers, it’s not that Ji Ruxue looks down on them, but their farm only needs to send one fourth-stage evolved zombie to defeat them, and soon after, they would all be torn to pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 219: Night Falls, the Dead Men Arrive!
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 219: Night Falls, the Dead Men Arrive!
With Zhao Lin’s current strength, she can’t be of any help and would only add to the chaos if she goes up.
But her attitude pleases Ji Ruxue.
This indicates that Zhao Lin now considers herself part of the farm and even regards herself as a member of it.
Strictly speaking, in this farm, the only ones with intelligence besides her and her dad are Zhao Lin.
Her dad and she are naturally on one side, but Zhao Lin is not.
If the other party cannot align herself with the farm for a long time and become one of them, then neither her dad nor herself can keep Zhao Lin around.
After all, Zhao Lin lives on the farm every day, knows and has learned a lot, and if she escapes, entering the Human Base City, it would bring tremendous trouble to the farm.
However, seeing how Zhao Lin is behaving now, which is relatively good, Ji Ruxue is pleased.
Ji Ruxue plans to test Zhao Lin once or twice more.
If Zhao Lin passes, it signifies that she has become a member of the farm.
When the time comes, Ji Ruxue will teach Zhao Lin relevant cultivation techniques, cultivate her, and accelerate Zhao Lin’s power growth.
The potential is considerable, and as long as she can grow, it will also be helpful for the farm.
In the past life, Zhao Lin stopped at the Emperor Realm not because her potential was exhausted, but because she acted foolishly early on and was overly compassionate, wasting many precious resurrection opportunities.
But now it’s different. With Ji Ruxue’s meticulous guidance and training, Zhao Lin’s future is bound to exceed the Emperor Realm.
At the slide, hearing Ji Ruxue say this, Zhao Lin was somewhat disappointed.
It seems that freeing herself from the chains in a short time is impossible.
However, she just saw the Corpse King looking as if the farm was going to face a significant human invasion.
But now seeing Little Qiqi calm and unhurried, it doesn’t seem to be the case.
"Little Qiqi, can your dad really handle it? Are there not many humans coming this time?"
With some doubts in her heart and only herself and Little Qiqi here, Zhao Lin boldly probed for information.
Since being locked here by the Corpse King, she could only get external information from Little Qiqi.
The channel for obtaining information is extremely scarce; she doesn’t know anything about what’s happening outside.
"Don’t worry about it, just believe in my dad; my dad is the greatest!"
Ji Ruxue shook her head confidently while swinging on the swing.
This time, the night raid by the Human Evolutionary Squad is completely a delivery of food.
"Hurry up and eat! Otherwise, the food will get cold and not taste good."
Just as Zhao Lin wanted to ask something, Ji Ruxue suddenly interrupted her, pointing to the bowl of food in Zhao Lin’s hands.
Before Zhao Lin passes all the tests, Ji Ruxue won’t discuss anything related to the farm with her.
Their casual chat is limited to trivial matters, avoiding topics about the farm and her dad.
Zhao Lin paused, realizing Little Qiqi didn’t want to talk about human-related matters, and helplessly looked at the food in her hands and started eating.
Honestly, the Corpse King’s cooking skills are really not bad; if she didn’t maintain high-intensity exercise every day, she might’ve gained weight.
...
As night fell, the sky darkened.
After dinner, Ji Ruxue quickly went to the bedroom, told her dad, and then lay down pretending to sleep.
Later, Ji Ruxue used Spirit Communication on the bee she caught during the day.
In the next moment, the bee flapped its wings, flying around the room, and under Ji Ruxue’s mental command, it flew out the window, into the darkness, and headed outside the farm.
In the living room, Lu Chuan sat on a chair, eyes closed in concentration, extremely vigilant.
At this moment, he monitored the inside and outside of the farm through the perspective of Corpse Puppets, examining any suspicious areas.
On the circular clearing between the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall and the stone wall inside, a team of second-class Corpse Puppets patrolled back and forth, not missing any corner.
Around the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall, numerous first-class Corpse Puppets dispersed as observation points.
If anyone touched the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall, Lu Chuan could discover it through these Corpse Puppets instantly.
Besides these arrangements, surrounding the houses inside the farm were San Pang, other fourth-class Corpse Puppets, and Da Pang, third-class Corpse Puppets.
The strongest Corpse Puppets surrounded it on all sides to prevent any villain from using flying abilities to directly break into the houses.
In Lu Chuan’s view, nothing in the farm is more important than Little Qiqi’s safety; she cannot be harmed by human evolvers invading.
In the quiet and silent night, only a series of rhythmic footsteps from Corpse Puppets patrolling could be heard.
Enemies often prefer to attack a farm guarded by tall walls at night, with the cover of darkness greatly increasing their safety.
Therefore, the night is the most dangerous and requires the utmost vigilance.
Lu Chuan decided to remain alert throughout the night, preventing malicious intruders from sneaking in.
Little Qiqi’s mention of the flying ability evolver, who knows if they will return tonight?
......
As time reached deep into the night, outside the farm was shrouded in darkness.
In the forest two kilometers from the farm, a group of shadows slowly emerged with the sound of trampling on dried leaves.
They were the three Evolutionary Squads that bypassed Jiangnan City District.
"Everyone stop!"
Walking at the forefront, Wang Lei suddenly halted, raised his right hand, and said softly.
Hearing this, the cautious group behind him immediately paused, lowered their bodies, and fixed their gaze on Wang Lei ahead.
"Up ahead is the destination, everyone be careful."
Wang Lei pointed to the farm ahead, its blurred outline visible, and gave a stern warning.
This isn’t a joke; the little girl in the farm might very well be the Corpse King.
The zombies surrounding the farm almost all act as her scouts; if they make too much noise, the Corpse King will detect them.
By then, not only would the plan fail, but the fifteen of them being able to return intact is uncertain.
Before setting off, the three teams had agreed that tonight’s action would be fully commanded by Wang Lei, so upon hearing Wang Lei’s advice, everyone seriously nodded.
"Let’s go!"
Swiftly, Wang Lei led the group, crouching, toward the farm.
And unbeknownst to the group, a tiny bee leisurely watching them was perched atop a leaf over their heads.
"Here come the fools!"
Seeing these people approaching the farm, a trace of disdain flashed in Ji Ruxue’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 220: Since You Seek Death, Don’t Blame Me for Being Ruthless!
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 220: Since You Seek Death, Don’t Blame Me for Being Ruthless!
Under the leadership of Wang Lei, the three teams quickly left the relatively concealed forest and arrived at a flat area.
Not far in front was a blood-red wall constructed of countless Bloodthirsty Vines.
Through the holes in the vine wall, the silhouettes of some zombies could be faintly seen moving back and forth.
"Everyone, if anyone captures that little girl first, try to leave her alive!"
"This Corpse King has significant research value. Despite being a zombie, it possesses considerable intelligence... If we can bring it back for the top to study, discovering its weaknesses would make it much easier for us to deal with such Corpse Kings in the future."
Wang Lei turned around and softly instructed the people behind him.
No one had ever captured this Corpse King before, so they might be the first.
Then, Wang Lei paused and added, "Of course, there’s no need to force the issue. If the situation doesn’t allow it, just kill it directly.
A dead one may not be as valuable as a live one, but it’s enough for our Base City to uncover some secrets from this Corpse King."
After all, despite this being a Corpse King, breaking in and killing it was already quite challenging, let alone bringing it back alive, which would be even harder.
Even though all of these people were second-tier Evolvers, accomplishing such a task was still immensely difficult.
Not far behind the three teams, a little bee flew about in the dark. Through its perspective, Ji Ruxue heard all of Wang Lei’s words, and a chilling sensation filled her heart.
Though she was human, a little girl with a human body and intelligence.
It was a zombie father who raised and saved her.
Yet, these fellow humans only thought of taking her life, which was laughable.
Of course, in Ji Ruxue’s heart, her father’s status had long surpassed racial distinctions.
Without her zombie father, she would have surely starved to death in that powerless state back then...
At this time, the three teams had already reached the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall. Looking at the wall made of red vines, the crowd paid no attention, merely assuming it was an ordinary vine arts wall.
Subsequently, at the signal of the three captains, one member from each of the three teams stepped forward, holding military combat knives, ready to cut the vines and open three passages.
Unexpectedly, just as the three approached and slowly crouched down, extending their knife-wielding hands.
Whizz, whizz, whizz!
Countless piercing sounds abruptly emerged in the darkness.
Under Ji Ruxue’s direct control, the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall appeared to come alive, with Bloodthirsty Demon Vines dancing like serpents, sharp and blood-red, resembling long scarlet spears.
Suddenly, from the vine wall, Bloodthirsty Demon Vines started moving, their tips raising, a blood red glow, emanating a chilling sharpness.
In an instant, the three at the front, too close, couldn’t dodge in time, directly pierced through by several Bloodthirsty Demon Vines, penetrating their chests and splattering blood onto the faces of those behind.
Ah~
The three let out cries of pain, hoisted into the air by the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines, their blood and energy ravenously consumed by the vines, leaving them pale, unable even to use their talent abilities, their cries growing weaker.
"Not good! There’s something wrong with this vine wall, what in the world is this red vine?!"
"Damn Demon Vine!"
"Quickly, save them..."
"..."
The sudden turn of events startled everyone behind them.
No one expected that the vines forming this wall were actually a living entity.
"Quickly, save them!"
Staring at the three being impaled, Wang Lei and the others snapped back, preparing to rescue them.
Just then, numerous Bloodthirsty Demon Vines rushed towards the crowd from the side, giving them no chance to rescue.
Boom, boom, boom~
The group had no choice but to first block the attacking Bloodthirsty Demon Vines. In no time, various abilities were unleashed.
"Kill!"
Yang Xiu, Liu Yang, and other close combat gifted ones stood at the front, swinging their Three-foot Cyan Blades, Heavy Horse-Cutting Blades, and other weapons, clashing with the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines incessantly.
Each confrontation between the sides erupted with thunderous sounds.
At this moment, Wang Lei, with his entire body hardened like steel, his skin gleaming metallically, stood at the forefront of the battle, taking the bulk of the attacks.
But he showed no fear, his punches thunderous, endlessly countering the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines that looked like scarlet lances.
Each collision between Wang Lei’s physique and the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines produced crisp metallic clashing sounds, deafening.
Meanwhile, the three previously pierced by the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines were quickly dragged back to the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall, firmly secured.
"Ah~ Save—me!"
The three only had time to emit a shrill cry for help.
The next moment, more Bloodthirsty Demon Vines surged in from all directions, engulfing them in mere breaths, their sounds vanished completely.
"Damn it! What the hell is this thing?!"
Witnessing this scene, Wang Lei and the others were furious, charging forward with full force, trying to retrieve the three.
"Ah~"
Yet, this caused chaos in their formation, allowing two weaker Evolvers to be seized by the Bloodthirsty Demon Vines, their bodies pierced and lifted high.
Then, the two were also drawn back towards the vine wall by the vines.
Facing this situation, the group, under heavy attack by the Bloodthirsty Vines, was helpless, forced to watch as their companions were dragged into the vine wall, then engulfed by the lethal vines.
In the farm.
Sleeping under the slide, Zhao Lin awoke immediately upon hearing the screams.
Gazing outside the farm, at the area flickering with various lights, her expression was somewhat grave.
So it’s begun?
It was faster than expected, and it seemed humanity had suffered a significant loss.
It seems Little Qiqi was right; this time, the Corpse King should be able to handle it.
In the room, observing this through the viewpoint of a Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan also reacted swiftly.
Subsequently, Lu Chuan immediately directed a Corpse Puppet to move outside the farm.
Seeing the Evolutionary Squad entangled with the Bloodthirsty Vine Forest, Lu Chuan’s expression turned icy cold, filled with a chilling intent.
Indeed, human Evolvers had set their sights on the farm, sneaking in under cover of darkness with ill intentions, but unfortunately, these fools failed to detect the abnormal nature of the Bloodthirsty Vines.
Luckily, thanks to Little Qiqi’s warning, he was prepared, or it truly could have resulted in disaster.
Thinking of this, the killing intent in Lu Chuan’s heart surged dramatically, his eyes reflecting a bloodthirsty hue.
Very well, very well, since you seek death, I shall grant it to you!

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 221: Damn Falcon, He Lied About the Enemy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 221: Damn Falcon, He Lied About the Enemy!
The little bee flying in the sky naturally saw Lu Chuan’s evolved zombies in action.
Instantly, Ji Ruxue inside the room let a smile appear at the corner of her mouth.
Humph, daring a night raid on the farm?
Next, you better be ready to face my father’s wrath!
At this moment, scenarios of these people’s unbearable deaths already filled Ji Ruxue’s mind.
With these Evolvers only at a mere second stage, they are absolutely no match for dad’s fourth-stage evolved zombies.
Especially the big guy holding an iron stick, one swing might be enough to smash these Evolvers into pulp, beyond human recognition.
On the farm, fueled by anger towards these Evolvers, Lu Chuan’s thoughts stirred, and several huge figures outside the house received the command and quickly started moving.
Tyrant One and Er Pang immediately took steps towards the battlefield, their massive and heavy bodies causing slight tremors with each step while producing heart-thumping, muffled booming sounds.
In the dark, Flame One and Earth Escape One, glowing like human torches, also rushed towards the battlefield simultaneously.
As mages, they naturally didn’t need to huff and puff, relying on their legs to run like Tyrant One and Er Pang.
Earth Escape One emitted a dazzling light across its body, momentarily enveloping Flame One, and instantly, Earth Escape One carried Flame One as they escaped towards the battlefield.
On the battlefield, three Evolutionary Squads were desperately dealing with the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine, suffering heavy casualties.
Besides the five team members lost before, three more were injured by the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine during this period, their combat suits soaked in blood.
The Bloodthirsty Demon Vine had savored Evolver blood, far more delicious than Mutant Beast Blood, and immediately went berserk.
Under Ji Ruxue’s control, it flew like tens of thousands of snakes, densely attacking the Evolutionary Squad.
The blood-red light on the Bloodthirsty Vine instantly intensified, making the dark sky glow crimson.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh~
In an instant, the piercing sound of countless breaking through the air constantly resounded.
Facing such ferocious attacks, the members of the Evolutionary Squad, all turned pale, dared not hold back, exerting all their strength.
Wang Lei turned into a steel body, constantly clashing with the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine, his special combat suit now in tatters, exposing skin radiating a metallic sheen.
Though Wang Lei could harden, his flesh wasn’t truly made of steel after all.
After prolonged attacks from the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine, bright red spots appeared on what seemed to be indestructible skin, surrounded by a dull blue hue.
Not far from Wang Lei, Captain Zhang had already transformed into a giant over ten feet tall, muscular and covered in a gray shell for good defense.
Razor-sharp bone blades over half a meter long, emitting icy glimmers grew from his large hands.
He roared repeatedly, his claws waving out continuously, slashing out shadowy trails.
The attacking Bloodthirsty Demon Vines were chopped and sent flying, with some being directly severed and juice splattering everywhere.
However, Captain Zhang’s reckless and fearless assault soon came at a great cost.
Just as he swung his claw again to fend off the incoming Bloodthirsty Demon Vine.
Under Ji Ruxue’s manipulation, several Bloodthirsty Vines shot out from the side, piercing Captain Zhang’s right arm, leaving several fist-sized bloody gashes!
"Ah~"
The intense pain caused Captain Zhang to shriek, his form staggering.
He retreated several steps in a row, until his massive body finally stopped.
"Captain, this vine is too troublesome, we should retreat!"
Witnessing five teammates die miserably, Yang Xiu who was slaughtering with the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine nearby, was exhausted, filled with fear as he shouted.
Others also felt the urge to retreat, having lost five in just nearing the wall, not daring to imagine how many lethal dangers lie within.
This bizarre vine is indeed too hazardous, fighting further may lead to everyone’s demise here.
"That’s right, retreat quickly! Such commotion will surely alert the Corpse King, the plan has failed, retreat now while we still can!"
Captain Li, encased in purple lightning, unleashed serpent-like lightning to fend off incoming Bloodthirsty Demon Vines, spoke calmly.
Upon hearing, Wang Lei’s eyes filled with reluctance.
At this moment, rhythmic footsteps arrived from afar.
Wang Lei instinctively looked in that direction, suddenly, his pupils contracted.
Two immense zombies were seen, running towards them.
Oh my god?
What level of zombies are these?
Third-stage?
Or fourth-stage?
The aura emanating from those two zombies made Wang Lei tremble uncontrollably, they were terrifying.
Wang Lei felt himself as weaker than even an ant before these two zombies, utterly insignificant.
Not a chance of victory!
What the hell, didn’t Falcon say there were no powerful evolved zombies in the farm? What on earth are these terrifying creatures?
"Everyone, run!"
Regaining his senses without any hesitation, Wang Lei bellowed with all his might.
Upon hearing the voice, relief swept through everyone as they prepared for retreat.
But the next instant, the ground not far from them flashed with earthy yellow light, Earth Escape One and Flame One leaped from the ground.
Flame One’s magma-like hand gently lifted, a crimson glow brilliantly shone.
Within moments, over ten massive fireballs, each spanning a meter in diameter, descended from the sky like meteorites, exploding among the Evolvers, fire erupting toward the heavens, the earth trembled fiercely.
Ah~~!
Four slower Evolvers were directly engulfed by the flames, blown into pieces.
Among the remaining six, including the three captains, they too were affected by the fireball explosions.
The tremendous heat wave flung them upwards, hurling them hard onto the ground.
At this moment, the surviving Evolvers were pale as ghosts, scorched black, agony painted across their faces.
Despair now lingered around every one of them.
At this point, Earth Escape One, who had been inactive, now shone brightly with earthy-yellow light extending from its body to the ground, spreading like ocean waves in all directions.
In no time, the earth trembled, amid thunderous rumbles, towering and hefty earthen walls rose up, enclosing the remaining Evolvers in a square barrier.
Within these walls, Wang Lei, who was less injured, now stood up from the ground.
Facing the scene around, his expression turned extremely grim.
Damn Falcon, reporting false information!

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 222: Total Annihilation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 222: Total Annihilation!
After a few breaths, the others also climbed up from the ground, enduring the immense pain on their bodies as they moved toward Wang Lei.
Boom~
At this moment, the originally motionless four high walls suddenly shook, and a dirt-yellow spiritual light instantly covered every part of the walls.
In the next moment, bulges began to appear on the inner walls.
These bulges grew longer and longer, gradually transforming into sturdy and sharp rock spikes.
Rumble~
Immediately, the front and back walls started to slowly move inward, pushing the densely packed, cold-glowing rock spikes.
The ground trembled continuously with the movement of the high walls.
The six people standing in the center watched this scene with extremely grave expressions.
"What are you waiting for! Let’s rush out quickly, or we’ll all die once these stone walls close!"
Panicked, Yang Xiu shouted to the remaining few, his eyes filled with fear.
These walls, over three meters high, were actually not an insurmountable barrier in the eyes of the Evolver. If they wanted to, they still had a chance to rush out.
"Don’t be impulsive, outside..."
Wang Lei frowned, just about to say that there were several powerful zombies outside, and they shouldn’t act recklessly.
"If you don’t go, I will! I don’t want to die here!"
"Yang Xiu, don’t be impulsive!"
Wang Lei was startled, just about to stop Yang Xiu.
But Yang Xiu shouted and directly used his Super Speed ability, holding the Three-foot Cyan Blade, moving like lightning.
In just a few breaths, he jumped to the high air with the help of the rock spikes on the wall.
Just as Yang Xiu was about to leap over the high wall, suddenly, a crimson flame surged from outside the wall.
"No!"
Only Yang Xiu’s desperate cry was heard as a giant Fireball shot up from below, smashing directly onto Yang Xiu, exploding instantly.
Boom!
The sky was filled with flames, engulfing Yang Xiu’s body, the terrifying sound incredibly loud in the silent night.
"Yang Xiu!"
Watching Yang Xiu disappear into the flames, Wang Lei’s eyes almost split, wishing to rush out and fight the Flame Zombie to the death.
The others watched Yang Xiu’s death, their expressions somber. With the threat of rock spikes inside and the terrifying Flame Zombie blocking outside, they were almost in a desperate situation.
Boom boom boom~
Standing next to Wang Lei, Liu Yang watched the approaching rock spikes with a sharp gaze, rushed forward, and continuously swung his machetes at the stone spikes.
Instantly, pieces of rock splattered, and under Liu Yang’s continuous attacks, the hard stone spikes broke apart.
"Liu Yang, come back! It’s not much use!"
Wang Lei shook his head helplessly. They could handle these stone spikes and climb the high walls; the most lethal threats were the Evolved Zombies standing outside.
These zombies were at least Tier 3, terrifying beyond words, something they could not fight against.
As soon as Wang Lei’s words fell, a series of massive footsteps could be heard from outside the high walls.
"What sound is that?"
Captain Zhang, half of his face burnt by flames, asked with some confusion.
In the next moment, the footsteps grew closer and more rapid, as if rushing toward the high walls!
"Get out of the way!"
Wang Lei’s expression changed drastically, exclaiming in alarm as he quickly retreated.
Boom!!!
The front high wall exploded, the huge sound causing dizziness, dust filling the sky, and debris flying everywhere.
In an instant, an Evolver who couldn’t dodge in time was hit heavily in the chest by several pieces of stone like cannonballs.
The chest caved in, blood spewed from the mouth, and the body collapsed onto the ground, half-buried in rubble and dust.
At this moment, the remaining five people were split into three groups by the sudden change.
