Liu Yang, holding two machetes, hid in the corner with Captain Wang Lei.
Captain Li with white hair retreated backward alongside Captain Zhang, all the way to the position of the rock spikes.
The remaining team member who failed to dodge was buried in the center, their life and death unknown.
Boom~
At the same time, a massive figure slowly walked in through the breach in the high wall, causing the ground to tremble continuously.
"Ah~"
Er Pang stepped on the Evolver in the center. Already gravely injured, the Evolver could only let out a scream before his body was ground into pulp.
"Damn it, what is this monster? How many tiers is this Evolved Zombie!"
Captain Li, with his head full of white hair, cursed angrily as he looked at the unbelievably massive Er Pang.
Following Er Pang, Earth Escape One and Flame One also walked in, glaring at the four of them, exuding an extremely terrifying aura.
"Not good?"
Then, Captain Li and Captain Zhang’s faces changed dramatically as they heard the terrifying sound of wind from above, a shadow of a staff sweeping towards them, parting the air.
"Run!"
Wang Lei in the corner shouted in shock, his eyes wide open.
"Let’s attack together! Otherwise, we’ll all die!"
Captain Zhang shouted to Captain Li, using all his strength, his body like a small giant, charging toward Er Pang.
Unexpectedly, just as Captain Zhang rushed out, after Captain Li unleashed several thunder snakes forward, his figure flashed and he escaped in the opposite direction.
Lightning flickering around him, he quickly leaped onto the high wall.
"Captain Zhang, thank you, your death will be valuable. Once I return to the Base City, I will report this incident and avenge you all!"
At the moment of disappearing over the high wall, Captain Li left a message.
"Li Xun, you bastard!"
Stunned by Captain Li’s actions, Captain Zhang was immediately enraged.
Boom!
At this moment, Er Pang’s iron staff came down, smashing the distracted Captain Zhang into paste.
"How could this happen!"
With Captain Li’s betrayal and Captain Zhang’s tragic death, Wang Lei was left utterly hopeless as the three terrifying zombies turned to face him and the other person.
"Captain, go quickly, I’ll hold them off!"
Liu Yang shouted resolutely to Wang Lei behind him, then charged forward, wielding his machete.
Facing Er Pang, Flame One, and the other Tier 4 Corpse Puppets, Liu Yang’s attack was futile; he was directly killed by a Fireball from Flame One, failing to delay them at all.
"Today, even if I die, I’ll bite off a piece of flesh!"
Wang Lei’s eyes turned red as he angrily faced Er Pang and the Corpse Puppets, roaring, charging with his Steel Hardened body, determined to fight to the end.
Boom!
Instantly, Wang Lei was knocked away, his body smashing heavily into the high wall, half his body shattered by Er Pang’s staff, barely alive.
With his face covered in blood, Wang Lei could feel his life rapidly slipping away, his heart filled with unwillingness. He hadn’t even avenged his teammates before dying...
In the next moment, a shadow of a staff fiercely struck down again!
Boom!
Wang Lei’s body exploded on the spot.
Subsequently, the three Corpse Puppets walked out of the high walls and joined Tyrant One, who held a white-haired charred corpse in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 223: Slipped Through the Net
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 223: Slipped Through the Net
The white-haired corpse in Tyrant No. 1’s hands was naturally none other than Captain Li, who had tried to use his teammates to buy time to escape.
Saying grandiose words while betraying his teammates.
In a life or death crisis, his true nature was revealed.
He thought all the zombies were drawn by his teammates, allowing him to scale the high wall to escape.
But alas, he was too proud too soon.
Lu Chuan’s initial goal was to catch them all in one sweep, so how could he let them escape under his watch?
After Er Pang charged in, Lu Chuan specifically arranged for Tyrant No. 1 to guard outside the high wall, to capture anyone trying to escape over it.
Just as the white-haired man jumped off the high wall, he was punched into the ground by the charging Tyrant No. 1.
Before he could even scream, the claws in Tyrant No. 1’s hands shot out, pinning him to the ground, dead beyond any doubt.
Tyrant No. 1 lightly flicked his hand, and the white-haired corpse rolled to the ground.
At this point, the human evolvers who plotted against the farm were completely annihilated under the dual assault of the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall and Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets.
"If there’s anyone to blame, blame yourselves for courting death! Dare to provoke me, and this is what you get!"
Lu Chuan sneered coldly at the evolver bodies on the ground.
He never had any intention to provoke humans; ideally, both sides would stay out of each other’s business peacefully.
However, if humans planned to go after him, he wouldn’t hold back and would eliminate any threat.
After all, if they’re coming for him, how could he afford leniency?
It’s known that with his ability to control other zombies, if captured by humans, the outcome would either be death or eternal imprisonment in a cage, subjected to endless research.
So since these humans dared to raid the farm at night, they should be prepared to leave their lives behind.
Inside the farm, Ji Ruxue suddenly snapped back to consciousness and climbed out of bed, quickly heading outside after seeing her father take down the remaining evolvers.
At that moment, Zhao Lin, sensing the quiet outside and guessing that the battle was over, immediately asked Ji Ruxue, "Little Qiqi, I noticed there’s no sound outside. Did your father win?"
Previously, Zhao Lin had been closely following the battle outside, and hearing the repeated screams of humans, she guessed that the Zombie King had won.
"Of course my father won. My father is the best."
Ji Ruxue smiled with pride in her voice.
Hearing this, Zhao Lin subconsciously sighed in relief. Indeed, the Zombie King won, and that’s good, that’s good...
But then Zhao Lin felt something strange inside — her attitude seemed... a bit wrong!
The Zombie King won, which meant the humans outside were all dead, killed by the evolved zombies under the zombie king.
Why was she happy for the Zombie King? Was she sick?
Why is this happening?
She’s human!
No, no, it’s not like that... She wasn’t happy because the Zombie King won.
It was because she feared that if the Zombie King was killed by evolvers, there would be no one left to take care of Little Qiqi.
That must be it!
Little Qiqi is so young; without the Zombie King to rely on, how would she live?
Once she convinced herself, Zhao Lin felt much better.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue looked at Zhao Lin with a slightly peculiar gaze.
This woman, what was she just thinking for her facial expressions to change so quickly!
"Little Qiqi, you better tell your father to be careful lately.
This time, the eradication of the human evolvers won’t go unnoticed; they’ll likely send even stronger forces here, so we must remain vigilant."
Zhao Lin, coming to her senses, felt that Little Qiqi’s gaze was strange, but she didn’t mind.
She quickly expressed her concerns, considering it a warning for the Zombie King.
"Okay, I’ll tell Dad."
Ji Ruxue nodded, and actually, even without Zhao Lin’s reminder, she and her dad understood the gravity of the situation.
This total annihilation of the human evolvers would surely attract serious attention from the Human Base City.
With recurring issues with the evolvers sent to the Jiangnan City District, even a fool could guess there’s something unusual there.
Outside the farm, gazing at the ruined landscape and the scattered corpses, Lu Chuan began directing Corpses Puppets to clean up the area.
The high wall generated by Earth Escape No. 1 would naturally be dismantled by it as well. With a wave of its hand, the wall glowing with earthen spiritual light crumbled, turning into dust that flowed into the ground and vanished.
On the ground, only mangled corpses and broken remains were left, staining it red with a nauseating bloody stench.
Soon, the corpse puppets carrying tools gathered, picking up the scattered remains and putting them in bamboo baskets.
Then, they shoveled the bloody mud and nearly unrecognizable bodies into the Bloodthirsty Vine wall.
These were evolver flesh and blood, not to be wasted.
As soon as these remains touched the Bloodthirsty Vine, it sprang into action.
Countless blood-like vines on the vine wall rushed towards the bloody flesh, wrapping them up.
The sharp vine tips violently speared into the flesh, devouring the nutrients needed for their growth and evolution.
The vine wall now looked like a nest of feeding serpents, a mass of blood-thirsty vines, a sight that made one’s skin crawl.
The abundant energy in the evolver’s flesh was incredibly desirable to the vines.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue, who had been watching through the perspective of the Bloodthirsty Vine, discovered a peculiarity—a corpse with a collapsed chest that nearly lost human shape was untouched by the vines.
As if... it wasn’t flesh but something else entirely.
"What’s going on? Why aren’t they consuming this body?"
Ji Ruxue was full of doubt, scrutinizing the body closely.
The Bloodthirsty Vine’s desire for flesh was insatiable, and as long as there was a scent of flesh, it would attack and devour it.
But she could clearly sense that the vines had no desire to devour this corpse.
"Could it be... this body isn’t made of flesh..."
Suddenly, Ji Ruxue thought of something, her pupils shrank, and her face turned grim.
Her gaze suddenly sharp as a sword, she stared at the body.
Could there still be an escapee?

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 224: Identity About to Be Exposed! Ji Ruxue’s Sense of Urgency!
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 224: Identity About to Be Exposed! Ji Ruxue’s Sense of Urgency!
"Whether it’s real or not, we’ll find out soon enough!"
Ji Ruxue’s gaze was cold, and she immediately controlled the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine to launch an attack on the corpse.
Swish, swish, swish!
In an instant, the Bloodthirsty Vine, which was originally like long blood-colored serpents, became incomparably straight, resembling blood-red spears, transforming into bolts of lightning and plunging into the corpse.
Puff, puff, puff~
The corpse was perforated by the Bloodthirsty Vines, but no blood flowed from the wounds, only red flesh was visible, which seemed very unnatural.
"As expected!"
Sensing the condition of the corpse, Ji Ruxue furrowed her brows, feeling that something was amiss.
Even if it had just died in battle, there should still be some blood left.
Yet there was no blood at all between the flesh.
Moments later, under Ji Ruxue’s perception,
the corpse seemed to be made of countless blood-red sand grains, disintegrating layer by layer, until it completely vanished into the wind.
Ji Ruxue’s eyes widened.
"This is... a fake body?"
With her vast experience, Ji Ruxue immediately realized.
It seems that this was an Evolver who had awakened a Split Body Talent Ability.
The opponent must have used this ability to escape unnoticed a long time ago.
Realizing this, Ji Ruxue’s brows knit into a tight crease.
This is going to be problematic.
She chided herself for being too careless.
She hadn’t noticed someone with such a unique ability among them.
This oversight allowed the person to escape.
With one slipping through the net, her plan to conceal the stronghold’s exposure and delay the Human Base City’s discovery of events was mostly dashed.
The person would definitely report back the situation at the farm to the official base city, exposing the farm to human scrutiny.
Although humans aren’t aware that the Zombie King is the father,
the fact that the farm harbors the Zombie King and several terrifying Evolved Zombies can’t be concealed.
Especially since the farm displayed formidable strength this time, nearly wiping out three Evolutionary Squads without full force.
If not for the one that got away, those three squads would have been annihilated entirely.
Having witnessed such overwhelming power, if the base city decides to attack again, they will come prepared.
The force they send could be much stronger than the three Evolutionary Squads this time around.
Achieving an almost complete annihilation of the enemy as today did will likely be much harder for the farm.
Unless father and she can make another breakthrough in the near future...
The only solace for Ji Ruxue was that her true strength had not been revealed.
Though the opponent recognized her, they couldn’t have guessed she was a fourth-rank Evolver.
Moreover, the Evolutionary Squads seemed to mistake her for the Zombie King.
This means even if the Survivor Base received intelligence from that Evolver,
they’d likely mistakenly calculate her as the father when assessing Qingshui Farm’s overall combat capability.
Thus, as an undercover fourth-rank Evolver, she might surprise them significantly.
However, the situation this time left a sense of urgency in Ji Ruxue’s heart.
If they had wiped out all of them, they might have gained some time.
But now that one escaped, the time for the Human Base City to send reinforcements will be much shorter.
There’s probably not much time left, and she must hasten in advancing her strength to ensure father’s safety.
Resolute, Ji Ruxue stopped her intermittent conversation with Zhao Lin.
She got up from the swing, severed the connection with the Bloodthirsty Vine, and returned her consciousness to her body, leaving the aftermath to her father.
Ji Ruxue bid farewell to Zhao Lin, returned to her room, sat cross-legged on her bed, closed her eyes, focused her mind, and began cultivating, absorbing Energy Factors from all directions.
From now on, she must seize every moment to train.
...
Meanwhile, several kilometers from Qingshui Farm, within a dense forest.
The thick foliage blocked the moonlight; the mountain forest was extremely dark, and only some small animals moving nearby made slight noises.
Amid gentle footsteps approaching from afar, a staggering figure slowly emerged from the darkness.
"Cough, cough, cough..."
This was a pale-faced, panicked-looking man.
He stooped, as if his feet were shackled with millstones, panting heavily with each step.
The man’s name was Qian Yun, an Evolver under Captain Zhang’s squad.
At this moment, Qian Yun couldn’t help but glance back continuously, eyes filled with fear of an Evolved Zombie suddenly appearing behind him.
However, after walking for a few minutes and not seeing any Zombies chasing, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Recalling the recent events, Qian Yun was filled with dread.
If it weren’t for his special ability, he would have surely been stomped to death by that terrifying giant.
His awakened ability is a Substitute Ability, allowing him to create a fake body to take the hit during a life-threatening situation, while his real self escapes several kilometers away in an instant.
After the dummy is attacked, it doesn’t vanish immediately but disintegrates only after a certain time.
In such conditions, when he uses this ability, it’s hard for an opponent to notice the ruse.
By the time the truth is discovered, he’s already safely escaped.
However, using this particular ability isn’t without its costs.
Each use leaves his body extremely weakened, requiring a long recovery period.
During this time, he can no longer use this ability and becomes weaker than an average person.
"I wonder how the captain and the others are doing, but those screams we heard earlier..."
Qian Yun’s expression flickered as he recalled the faint screams from the farm earlier, feeling an immense weight in his heart.
He had used his ability to escape the moment the giant Evolved Zombie tried to stomp him.
At the time, among the three Evolutionary Squads, only four, including himself, were still alive: the three captains and Liu Yang.
Therefore, he knew nothing about subsequent events.
But he had a premonition that the outcome wouldn’t be favorable.
After all, a bizarre blood-colored vine wall had already caused significant casualties among them, eliminating five Evolvers.
And the Evolved Zombies exuding terrifying auras were incredibly powerful, far beyond what the three Evolutionary Squads could handle.
A single Fireball from the opponent could kill many!
Combining the differences in strength, Qian Yun had already surmised the likely outcome...

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 225: Zhao Lin’s Vision: Achieving Coexistence Between Humans and Zombies!
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 225: Zhao Lin’s Vision: Achieving Coexistence Between Humans and Zombies!
Lu Chuan, sitting in the room, took a long breath as consciousness returned.
"Finally solved this trouble."
After hearing from Little Qiqi about the presence of Flying Evolvers, he was worried that news of the farm would leak out, attracting big trouble.
Unexpectedly, these humans acted so quickly, launching an attack that very night.
Now that these invading humans have been completely wiped out, Lu Chuan felt a bit more relieved.
There should not be a second attack in the short term.
As for any loose ends, Lu Chuan was naturally unaware.
From his perspective, these are all undoubtedly dead, so revival seems impossible.
However, this sudden attack by the human Evolvers served as a wake-up call for him.
This time, the human Evolvers came in large numbers, and from the battle situation, it was clear they were organized and their backgrounds were not simple.
He understood that it’s likely he has been noticed by the human official Base City.
It’s unknown how much of his information has been exposed.
How much do humans understand about him?
Soon, Lu Chuan’s gaze flickered, carrying a hint of worry.
It’s easy to imagine that the human Base City would not let this go easily.
It can be foreseen that the next human attack will be even more intense.
Regarding this, Lu Chuan didn’t have any good solution.
If he doesn’t want to give up the farm as a perfect foothold, then he can only defend against the humans’ attacks.
After two or three times, humans should find it too difficult and retreat.
Now, under his command, there are already four fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, and with continued hunting and raising ordinary zombies, the number of fourth-tier Corpse Puppets will increase.
As long as he has enough time, even if humans dispatch more Evolvers, he has confidence in being able to resist them.
However, thinking of this, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but reflect on himself.
During this period, he was wholeheartedly devoted to hunting Fierce Beasts to evolve his Corpse Puppets. The results were gratifying, successfully evolving four fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, strengthening considerably.
But this also led him to be somewhat distracted and neglectful in other areas, especially in the security of the farm, allowing humans to exploit vulnerabilities.
Next, he decided to pay close attention to the farm’s protective measures.
Thinking of protective measures, Lu Chuan immediately thought of the Bloodthirsty Vine, whose performance tonight was perfect, meeting Lu Chuan’s expectations well.
This time, the Bloodthirsty Vine not only served as a warning but also blocked the opponent’s infiltration, killing five members during the battle, greatly contributing.
Choosing the Bloodthirsty Vine as the farm’s perimeter defense was indeed a wise decision.
"Daddy, what happened outside? Is there a fight going on? It’s so noisy!"
At this moment, Ji Ruxue came out of the bedroom with a frown, pretending to ask unknowingly.
Seeing Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan’s previously expressionless face suddenly blossomed with a smile, and he took the paper on the table, wrote: "There were bad people outside, but don’t be afraid, Daddy will protect you."
"Bad people, were they all driven away by Daddy?"
Ji Ruxue’s eyes widened in surprise, then her expression changed as she asked with concern.
Lu Chuan smiled warmly and nodded.
He hadn’t exactly driven away the bad people but rather killed them.
However, facing Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan naturally wouldn’t mention such bloody matters to the little one, which was inappropriate.
Since the little one said they were driven away, then let it be considered so!
"Daddy, you’re amazing! When I grow up, I will help Daddy fight the bad guys too."
Ji Ruxue raised her little hand and said sweetly.
This little one, at such a young age, is already thinking of sharing my burdens?
Seeing Little Qiqi so well-behaved and sensible, Lu Chuan felt extremely gratified.
It felt like his own child was growing up, even though Little Qiqi was still so young.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan swore in his heart that he would never let the little one suffer even the slightest harm.
Since the night was already deep, seeing Little Qiqi still full of energy, Lu Chuan quickly wrote: "Little Qiqi, it’s very late, go back to sleep like a good girl!"
He then handed the note to Little Qiqi.
"Okay, Daddy!"
Ji Ruxue nodded obediently and returned to the room.
...
At night.
The temperature kept dropping, with a thin fog rising over the ground, permeating the amusement park.
Wisps of white mist drifted to Zhao Lin’s cheeks, causing her eyelids to twitch.
Feeling the chill on her face, Zhao Lin lay still on the bed, her eyes fixed blankly on the dark sky, unable to sleep.
Recalling the numerous human Evolvers who recently died miserably a kilometer away, she couldn’t help but feel lost.
Where should she go from here?
If she protected Little Qiqi and prevented humans from invading the farm, it meant standing by the Corpse King.
But she was ultimately human!
It’s foreseeable that conflicts between humans and the Corpse King won’t be few.
Standing with the Corpse King would pit her against all humanity, which she was unwilling to do.
As a "human," she naturally felt a sense of belonging to humans.
Witnessing the Corpse King slaughter humans made her uncomfortable.
Yet, if the Corpse King were defeated by humans, killed, or captured, what would happen to Little Qiqi?
Being a human child close to the Corpse King and even calling the Corpse King ’Daddy,’ humans would surely be very wary of Little Qiqi, and her fate could be tragic.
"Fortunately, the Corpse King is a zombie with human consciousness!"
Zhao Lin then sighed and thought with some comfort.
Precisely because the Corpse King possessed human consciousness, Little Qiqi regarded him as a father, which was why she stood by Little Qiqi.
Truthfully, besides physical changes, this Corpse King was hardly different from humans; he wasn’t bloodthirsty like other zombies, and facing fresh flesh, he showed no abnormality.
He could raise Little Qiqi and tolerate her... which also implies that, given proper conditions, he could tolerate other humans!
Thinking of this, Zhao Lin’s eyes brightened, and her originally confused gaze gradually became determined.
The Corpse King seems quite reclusive; as long as humans don’t provoke him, he probably won’t attack humans.
If she could prevent humans from provoking the Corpse King and make them understand that as long as they don’t, the Corpse King won’t attack, might it be possible to achieve coexistence between zombies and humans peacefully?
Though difficult, for Little Qiqi and humanity, Zhao Lin must give it a try to see if it can succeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 226: Base City’s Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 226: Base City’s Shock
Several days later, on the main road in front of the Base City gates, a man, disheveled and pale, staggered forward, each step requiring immense effort.
"Help—"
Qian Yun struggled to lift his head, gazing at the Base City so near, a glimmer of hope igniting in his vacant eyes. His dry, cracked lips parted slightly, attempting to utter a hoarse sound.
"Halt! Stay back!"
Seeing a filthy human, resembling a zombie, approach, the sentry at the gate immediately grew alert.
In an instant, many soldiers raised their rifles, aiming at Qian Yun, their expressions tense.
Unexpectedly, just as the soldier’s warning ended, Qian Yun, who was about to plead for rescue, could no longer hold on and collapsed powerlessly to the ground, fainting.
The sentry soldiers, witnessing this, were startled but dared not make any rash moves.
After all, no one could tell if the person was truly human or an Evolved Zombie in disguise.
After some deliberation, two soldiers bearing shields stepped out from the crowd, cautiously approaching Qian Yun.
The soldiers behind them firmly gripped their rifles, keeping them aimed at Qian Yun on the ground, ready to fire at the slightest sign of anomaly.
A moment later, as the two soldiers neared Qian Yun, prepared to examine him, their expressions changed.
"This attire, combat suit... he’s from the Evolutionary Squad, quick, get him inside!"
The next day.
Qian Yun, who had been in a deep sleep for a day, struggled to open his eyes. Seeing the clean ceiling above, he immediately realized he had been rescued.
He remembered losing consciousness near the Base City gates, likely brought in by those soldiers.
"He’s awake! Qian Yun is awake!"
Suddenly, a voice of surprise came from beside the bed.
Upon hearing this, Qian Yun turned his gaze towards the sound, surprised to find himself surrounded by the Base City’s top officials, everyone watching him with joy on their faces.
"Supreme Commander..."
Upon seeing the Supreme Commander standing in the middle, Qian Yun’s pupils contracted, instinctively attempting to stand and salute, ready to report the incident.
However, the pain and weakness in his body made it impossible to complete his movements; even speaking too quickly would cause his throat to ache.
"Qian Yun, don’t get excited, take it slow, we’re in no rush... Tell me, what happened to the others?"
The Supreme Commander hastily stopped Qian Yun, offering a few words of comfort before asking with concern.
This time, three Evolutionary Squads were dispatched, and so far, only Qian Yun had returned, and even he was in poor shape, clearly having endured many hardships.
Clearly, something major happened when the three Evolutionary Squads entered the Jiangnan City District.
Upon hearing the Supreme Commander’s question about the others, Qian Yun felt as if struck by lightning, his heart sinking to the depths.
What happened to the others?
Obviously, it seemed he was the only one who had returned to the Base City.
Realizing his fears were true, Qian Yun felt a pang as if stabbed in the heart, unable to believe that the captain and others hadn’t escaped.
After a brief silence, Qian Yun, with a face full of sorrow, trembled as he spoke each word: "The others... have all perished."
"What?"
Everyone present was shocked, their expressions changing drastically.
"How could this be? Captain Wang and the others are quite capable, even measured against the entire Base City. Moreover, with three Evolutionary Squads together, the risk should have been low."
"There must have been an unforeseen incident. Ordinarily, neither Evolvers nor zombies could possibly overwhelm three squads, let alone wipe them out, leaving just one survivor!"
"Anyone who dares to harm the people of Base City cannot be forgiven!"
"Is this mysterious girl so powerful? Or does she have some unknown force behind her? Otherwise, how could only one person make it back?"
"Indeed, in this matter..."
"..."
People were shocked, unable to suppress a flurry of discussions.
Though seeing Qian Yun’s condition led them to speculate that the three Evolutionary Squads had encountered trouble, and perhaps suffered considerable losses prompting Qian Yun’s desperate return, they never imagined that nearly all fifteen of the squad’s powerful Evolvers were wiped out.
These were not just disorganized individuals but three fully armed Evolutionary Squads capable of coordinated combat. What sort of enemy could reduce them to this state?
The Supreme Commander wore a grim expression. The mission for the three Evolutionary Squads was to capture that mysterious girl in the Jiangnan City District.
How formidable must she be to inflict such significant losses on the Evolutionary Squads?
Third-tier, fourth-tier?
Or does she perhaps have vast forces behind her?
"Qian Yun, what exactly happened? Wasn’t your mission to capture that Evolver girl? Is she really powerful enough to do this to you?"
Beside the Supreme Commander stood a middle-aged man with a receding hairline, who frowned as he pressed for answers.
This slightly overweight middle-aged man was the Deputy Commander, named Zheng Yu, responsible for the city defense of the Base City, a high-ranking military officer, and the Supreme Commander’s right-hand man in military affairs.
Upon hearing Deputy Commander Zheng’s inquiry, everyone present turned their gaze simultaneously towards Qian Yun, also feeling this was a point of confusion.
Could the girl truly have the capability to destroy three powerful Evolutionary Squads?
If so, the Base City must heighten its vigilance.
A force hidden around the Base City like this poses a definite threat to its safety and should be eliminated swiftly.
"Leaders, there is indeed a Corpse King in the Jiangnan City District... along with fourth-tier zombies... That mysterious girl is very likely the Corpse King... and Demon Vine attacks humans!"
Upon hearing this, Qian Yun shook his head lightly, each sentence followed by a gasp, eyes filled with a mix of hatred and fear when he mentioned the Corpse King.
With fifteen people embarking and only one returning, the rest brutally slaughtered by the Corpse King, no wonder hatred filled his heart.
However, the Corpse King was terrifyingly strong, especially with the evolved zombies under his command. Whether erecting towering walls, launching enormous fireballs, or even the one that nearly crushed him, their strength was overwhelmingly terrifying.
In Qian Yun’s view, a third-tier evolved zombie couldn’t possibly be so dreadful, undoubtedly making them fourth-tier zombies.
After learning this, the Supreme Commander’s face showed a look of shock.
Corpse King?
They hadn’t expected there truly to be a Corpse King in the Jiangnan City District?
This discovery was undoubtedly a disaster for the Base City.
With fourth-tier evolved zombies, no wonder Wang Lei and the others met their doom.
Against such terrifying beings, even three Evolutionary Squads couldn’t hope to stand a chance...

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 227: Requesting Aid from the Imperial Capital! The Corpse King Must Be Eliminated Quickly!
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 227: Requesting Aid from the Imperial Capital! The Corpse King Must Be Eliminated Quickly!
There truly is a Corpse King in Jianghai City!
A wave of panic and fear lingered in the hearts of the high-ranking officers from the Base City present.
Everyone in the room had a grave expression.
The room fell into silence.
They couldn’t help but recall the video sent over from the Imperial Capital earlier.
The video depicted the overwhelming Corpse Tide Army.
Wherever it went, not a single blade of grass survived, it was no different from a natural disaster.
This terrifying Corpse Tide was something Jianghai Base City could not possibly resist.
If the Corpse King were allowed to grow, Jianghai Base City would face nothing but annihilation.
"Ladies and gentlemen, the terror of the Corpse King needs no further explanation. With the strength of Jianghai Base City, it’s extremely hard to contend with. We absolutely must relay this message to the Imperial Capital immediately, seeking military support!"
The top commander, looking solemn, surveyed everyone present and spoke gravely.
The Imperial Capital Base City, as the nation’s political and military center, is far stronger than any other Base City and embodies the nation’s foundation.
Now, the Corpse King must be eradicated as soon as possible, or else Jianghai is in grave danger.
"I have no objections. Only with support forces from the Imperial Capital, can Jianghai Base City have greater assurance in resolving the Corpse King!"
Deputy Commander Zheng nodded.
Others also understood the seriousness of this matter, so no one raised any objections.
"Qian Yun, to help the Imperial Capital clearly realize the serious situation Jianghai Base City is currently facing, we might need you to recall some detailed issues."
Seeing no objections, the top commander looked at Qian Yun and asked.
"Top commander, go ahead and ask!"
Qian Yun said seriously.
Upon hearing that the top commander was going to report the issue, Qian Yun felt very excited.
As long as the Imperial Capital dispatches support, that damned Corpse King would surely have no burial place.
The captain and others’ grievances would be avenged.
"Could you tell us how you discovered the Corpse King?"
"The three teams initially arrived outside the Jiangnan City District. Captain Wang suggested letting Falcon send its pet Black Hawk to scout the district, to check for any anomalies.
Soon, Falcon discovered a truck driven by a zombie. It followed the truck all the way to a farm outside the city, where we found that mysterious little girl, who was the Corpse King!"
Qian Yun recalled slowly.
"A zombie driving a car?"
The top commander was astonished; Wang Lei had reported this to him before.
But it had never been verified; he didn’t expect them to encounter it this time.
And according to Qian Yun, this zombie driving must be orchestrated by the Corpse King.
The counterpart controlled the zombies.
Yet, the top commander was very puzzled.
No matter how intelligent the Corpse King was, it was merely an intelligent beast. How could its controlled zombies drive a car?
The related information on the Corpse Tide Army from the Imperial Capital didn’t describe the Corpse King being able to manipulate zombies to drive!
Could it be undiscovered?
"I thought this matter in the data was fake, but it turns out..."
Deputy Commander Zheng, beside him, shook his head and said regretfully.
If they had linked this zombie driving with the Corpse King earlier, perhaps their Base City could have confirmed the existence of the Corpse King sooner.
Regrettably, it did seem rather far-fetched, and he didn’t take it seriously at the time.
Then, Qian Yun continued: "After sending Black Hawk to the farm, Falcon soon discovered many Evolved Zombies inside, and the little girl was among them, peacefully coexisting with those Evolved Zombies.
Oh right, those Evolved Zombies were indeed strange, they appeared to be under the Corpse King’s control, farming.
Captain Wang, upon hearing this news, analyzed and confirmed that the little girl was indeed the Corpse King.
And because the little girl looked exactly like a human, Captain Wang speculated that the Corpse King’s evolution path would appear increasingly similar to humans!"
"A zombie that can farm? And the Corpse King looks exactly like a human! This..."
Deputy Commander Zheng was shocked by this news.
Not only does it farm, but it drives a car, resembling humans completely. If the Corpse King truly possesses such intelligence, it wouldn’t be much different from humans.
Others present were also a bit shocked, then frowning like the top commander.
This Corpse King was nothing like what they imagined!
The Corpse King as they imagined should have been a ghastly-looking, ferocious and cunning weak zombie, hiding fearfully among the Zombie Army, always thinking of stirring up a beast tide to obliterate human cities.
Yet now, driving cars, farming, enjoying a rural life.
"And then? How did you get discovered? What about the Four-Tier Zombies and Demon Vine?"
After a moment of silence, the top commander looked at Qian Yun and continued to ask.
Regarding zombies driving and farming, he also found it somewhat absurd. Could the Corpse King be this clever?
However, at this point, Qian Yun had no reason to lie, so it is highly likely this is true.
"Next, Captain Wang proposed capturing the Corpse King.
But there were so many zombies in the farm. To prevent being discovered too soon by the Corpse King, we chose a night raid.
At midnight, as we prepared to infiltrate the farm, we ran into a vine wall formed by the blood-colored Demon Vine. Upon nearing it, the Demon Vine launched an attack on us.
The Demon Vine was extremely powerful, its blood-colored strands seemed to possess a blood-sucking ability. If stabbed, one would be drawn in and have their blood drained rapidly.
In moments, five members from the three squads were lost, and then we wanted to retreat.
At this time, due to the noise, we startled the Corpse King, and they sent out four...four-tier Evolved Zombies...
The strength of these four Evolved Zombies was terrifying. Even a third-tier Evolved Zombie could never be this strong, so it’s without a doubt they were four-tier Evolved Zombies."
When mentioning the four-tier Evolved Zombies, Qian Yun’s eyes carried fear, it’s a force he simply could not contend with.
"Afterwards, because my Talent Ability is quite special, I was lucky to escape with my life, while others perished at the hands of those four-tier Evolved Zombies...and in the end...it was just me, struggling back to Base City."
"Top commander, I’ve finished, this is all I know!"
Qian Yun looked towards the top commander.
The top commander nodded and said to the person recording beside him: "Have you recorded everything Qian Yun said?"
"It’s recorded, sir!"
The recorder nodded and handed over the document.
Zombies driving...
Also farming...
The suspected Corpse King girl almost identical to humans.
Captain Wang speculated that the Corpse King continually evolving would resemble humans more and more.
The Corpse King commands multiple four-tier Evolved Zombies and cultivates mutant plants capable of bloodthirsty killing.
Gazing at the strange information documented, the top commander’s expression turned peculiar, feeling somewhat uncertain.
Not knowing if the Imperial Capital would consider them insane...

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 228: Little Qiqi, I Want to Talk to Your Dad!
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 228: Little Qiqi, I Want to Talk to Your Dad!
This time, discovering the traces of the Human Evolver in time, Little Qiqi made great contributions.
The promised barbecue feast for Little Qiqi before, Lu Chuan immediately arranged it after the crisis was resolved.
Outside the house, waves of heat rolled in, and pieces of glowing red charcoal emitted scorching flames.
On the grill, skewers of lamb and other meats, under Lu Chuan’s control, continuously spun, sizzling with oil and releasing a tempting aroma.
Not far from the barbecue stand, Ji Ruxue obediently sat at the table, holding a bottle of milk, sipping while watching her father’s busy figure.
After a short while, seeing that the meat skewers on the grill were almost cooked, Lu Chuan sprinkled cumin and other seasonings, spun them around twice, then picked up all the skewers and placed them on the prepared plate.
Next, putting the vegetable skewers on the grill, Lu Chuan carried the plate and walked towards Little Qiqi, placing the skewers on the table.
Gesturing for Little Qiqi to eat first, Lu Chuan was about to turn around to tend to the vegetable skewers.
At this time, Ji Ruxue’s voice came through.
"Dad, why not unlock Zhao Lin’s chains? She’s miserable being chained all the time, and she even wanted to help you fight the bad guys yesterday!"
Ji Ruxue gazed expectantly at Lu Chuan.
Not far away, Zhao Lin, who was sitting on the slide, was overjoyed upon hearing Little Qiqi’s words, hurriedly glanced at Lu Chuan, her eyes uncertain.
Lu Chuan’s movements paused, surprised, he glanced at Zhao Lin.
This foolish woman was so kind-hearted, even wanted to help me fight humans?
He naturally found this hard to believe.
After all, given her character, she values the lives of human survivors more than her own life, always talking about the protection of civilian safety... how could she possibly help a zombie like him?
"It’s true, she really said that to me."
Seeing her father’s hesitant demeanor, Ji Ruxue nodded her little head energetically, speaking with certainty.
The reason she wanted her dad to unlock Zhao Lin’s chains was naturally purposeful.
She wanted to continue testing Zhao Lin. If after unlocking the chains, Zhao Lin remained honest without any attempt to escape, it would indicate no ulterior motives.
But if Zhao Lin was not honest, then there would be no need to keep her, and they might as well eliminate her.
After all, Zhao Lin knows more about the farm than people outside know about the Human Base City.
For instance, knowing that Dad is actually the Zombie King and has human consciousness, so if she escapes, the consequences would be very serious.
And Lu Chuan, naturally looked down upon Zhao Lin, this foolish woman, not wanting to unlock her, since she always stirs up trouble.
However, now that Little Qiqi has spoken, as her dad, he couldn’t let the little one lose face.
Fine, considering that this woman has recently been honestly tutoring Little Qiqi and bringing a lot of joy to the little one.
Today, I will be magnanimous.
Having made up his mind, Lu Chuan first nodded towards Little Qiqi, then took out paper and pen, wrote on the paper: "Since Little Qiqi wants Zhao Lin’s chains unlocked, Dad agrees with you.
However, this is only a temporary unlock, lest she creates trouble in the future, Dad will still need to lock her up."
Lu Chuan was actually not worried about Zhao Lin at all, with the fourth-level Corpse Puppet around, given her current strength, she definitely could not escape his grasp.
"Thank you, Dad! Rest assured, Zhao Lin will surely behave!"
Upon hearing, Ji Ruxue was very happy, jumped down from the chair, bouncing to Lu Chuan’s side, pulling his clothes corner, and said with a giggle.
Zhao Lin, who was anxiously waiting, seeing this scene, naturally knew the Zombie King agreed.
Immediately, she excitedly stood up from the slide, feeling a bit impatient.
"This Zombie King, is actually reasonable, finally free..."
Locked here, although having no worries about food and drink, there was entirely no freedom, even going to a relatively distant place was impossible, lying on the slide every day, staring at the unchanged surroundings, Zhao Lin had long been sick of it.
However, she also knew she was a prisoner, captive, her value to the Zombie King probably only remained in accompanying Little Qiqi.
So naturally, she did not dare to wish she could be unlocked with a single word.
Only Little Qiqi, doted on by the Zombie King, her words were more effective.
Next, Lu Chuan carried Little Qiqi back to the chair and then walked to the slide.
Clatter~
Lu Chuan unlocked Zhao Lin’s chains, releasing her.
Whew!
Breaking free, Zhao Lin let out a long breath, feeling the surrounding air much fresher, freedom indeed!
"Thank you, Zombie King!"
After loosening her hands and feet, stretching her muscles, the joyful Zhao Lin did not forget to give Lu Chuan a word of thanks.
Lu Chuan glanced at her with his faint red eyes, ignored her, and turned back to the grill.
If dragged on, the vegetable skewers would probably be burnt.
"Zhao Lin, come quickly, Dad’s barbecued skewers are delicious!"
Ji Ruxue held a half-eaten skewer with her little hand, her mouth full of oil, and called out to Zhao Lin.
"Little Qiqi, thank you! Otherwise, I wouldn’t know when I could escape."
Upon hearing, Zhao Lin, with a big smile, walked to the table in a few steps, sat down, and sincerely thanked Little Qiqi.
This time, Little Qiqi indeed helped her a great deal.
"It’s okay, didn’t you say you wanted to help Dad fight the bad guys before? From now on, you and I are on the same team, naturally, we won’t lock you up anymore."
Ji Ruxue shook her head meaningfully.
Next, let’s see if you truly intend to join Dad and me in this little group, if there are ulterior motives... then don’t blame me.
Hearing Little Qiqi’s words, Zhao Lin’s expression became slightly complex, yet she still nodded earnestly.
"Eat! Barbecue is delicious!"
Ji Ruxue smiled, grabbed a bunch of skewers, and handed them to Zhao Lin.
"Thank you."
Zhao Lin smiled and accepted, and the two started eating.
Moments later, Zhao Lin, who had eaten heartily, felt something was missing, then promptly called out to Lu Chuan, who was busy at the barbecue stand: "Zombie King, could I have a beer?"
Upon hearing, Lu Chuan felt a bit speechless, yet still controlled the Corpse Puppet to fetch a bottle of beer from the warehouse and deliver it to her.
Half an hour later, on the table lay two piles of bare wooden skewers, Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin both rubbed their round bellies, reclining on the chairs, both utterly stuffed.
Especially on Zhao Lin’s side, there were also three empty beer cans on the table.
After resting for a while, Zhao Lin suddenly recalled her previous idea, humans and zombies coexisting peacefully... mustering her courage, she said to Little Qiqi beside her: "Little Qiqi, can I talk to your dad?"

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 229: You Don’t Want Little 77 to Spend Her Whole Life in a World of Zombies, Do You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 229: You Don’t Want Little 77 to Spend Her Whole Life in a World of Zombies, Do You?
"Talk to my dad?"
Ji Ruxue, who was rubbing her belly and regretting eating too much, was stunned upon hearing this.
Then confusion surged in her heart. What does this woman want?
What can she talk to my dad about?
It’s not surprising Ji Ruxue thought this way, after all, her dad is a zombie, and a Zombie King at that.
Zhao Lin is just a captive who has regained a little freedom. What can the two of them possibly talk about?
Could this woman have gotten cocky right after being released, wanting to make some unreasonable demands?
Seeing Little Qiqi not respond, Zhao Lin was a bit anxious. She also knew her request seemed abrupt and odd.
But for the sake of her ideology, she could only ask again, "Little Qiqi, can you? Just mention it to your dad, just a short chat is fine."
Zhao Lin knew that if she approached the Zombie King directly, he wouldn’t pay attention to her, and might even lock her up again.
Only Little Qiqi can help her achieve her aim.
"Alright! But make sure not to say anything that might upset my dad?"
Ji Ruxue nodded; she also wanted to see what the other party’s purpose was.
However, in the end, Ji Ruxue still warned Zhao Lin.
After all, because of what happened before in the Jiangnan City District, her dad had a very bad impression of Zhao Lin. If Zhao Lin angered him, her pleading might not be of any use.
Then, Ji Ruxue jumped off the chair, found Lu Chuan who was packing up the barbecue grill, tugged at his sleeve, and gently said, "Dad, Zhao Lin seems to have something to say to you, could you talk to her?"
Zhao Lin wants to talk to me?
Upon hearing Little Qiqi’s words, Lu Chuan was a bit puzzled.
He couldn’t help but look at Zhao Lin, and Zhao Lin, noticing Lu Chuan’s gaze, immediately smiled.
This silly woman, wonder what sneaky plan she’s up to.
Lu Chuan shifted his gaze and saw Little Qiqi still looking at him expectantly. Despite feeling helpless inside, he nodded.
Actually, he was also curious about what Zhao Lin wanted to say to him.
A moment later, Zhao Lin followed Lu Chuan inside, and the two sat facing each other.
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue considerately brought paper and pen, placing them in front of Lu Chuan.
Lu Chuan gazed indifferently at Zhao Lin, silently waiting for her to speak.
Opposite him, Zhao Lin naturally felt nervous in front of the Zombie King.
But she forced herself to calm down, and for her plan, she couldn’t lose nerve.
After taking a deep breath, Zhao Lin looked at Lu Chuan and straightforwardly said, "Zombie King, I know... you still possess human consciousness, don’t you?"
Hearing this, Lu Chuan’s heart trembled, his pupils slightly narrowed.
Immediately, his gaze turned cold and chilling, emitting a thick aura of menace.
In an instant, the whole room was enveloped in a fierce killing intent.
This was the biggest secret he held in his heart, and he didn’t expect Zhao Lin to discover it...
Had he known, he wouldn’t have left her at the farm back then...
Beside him, Ji Ruxue was also shocked and glanced at Zhao Lin.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Lin, who usually appeared foolish and reckless, had such keen insight to notice this.
"Zombie King, don’t be angry, I mean no harm!"
Seeing the situation turning bad, Zhao Lin quickly explained.
With the Zombie King’s current demeanor, Zhao Lin feared any delay in explaining might lead to her being killed.
Across from her, Lu Chuan also gradually calmed down.
Thinking about it carefully, it wasn’t surprising for her to notice something was off and even guess he had human consciousness.
After all, Zhao Lin had always been at the farm, observing his every move. She could deduce from many aspects that his intelligence was unusual.
He was just caught off guard by Zhao Lin; now that he’s calm, he’s not very angry.
However, he grew more interested in what Zhao Lin wanted to discuss with him, and then wrote on the paper, "I won’t kill you, keep talking!"
Lu Chuan’s attitude basically confirmed Zhao Lin’s guess.
This Zombie King indeed has human consciousness.
This relieved Zhao Lin, who had been observing him all along.
After all, only with the Zombie King possessing human consciousness could she have the chance to realize her ideals.
Because although the Zombie King physically differs from humans, his thoughts and ideas are no different, sharing the same thought patterns, allowing for smooth communication.
In the next moment, Zhao Lin cautiously asked, "Zombie King, may I know your name?"
Lu Chuan looked at Zhao Lin, thought for a moment, then wrote down, "Lu Chuan."
"Lu Chuan, is this dad’s name?"
Ji Ruxue looked at the name and thought to herself.
Dad’s name is Lu Chuan, and my name is Lu Qiqi...
Seeing that the Zombie King indeed had a name, Zhao Lin felt delighted, as it meant his human consciousness was quite complete. She then said, "Lu Chuan, how do you view the current world’s chaotic situation?"
Instantly, Lu Chuan fell silent, casting a puzzled glance at Zhao Lin.
What exactly does this woman want to say?
Did she drink herself stupid?
What an outrageous comment?
Discussing the world’s situation with a Zombie King?
What does the state of the world have to do with me, a mere zombie?
Feeling a fleeting chill emanating from the Zombie King, Zhao Lin continued, "You know the current world, zombies are bloodthirsty and need flesh, while humans, to reclaim their homeland and resources, are continually fighting.
However, peace between zombies and humans is not impossible!"
Lu Chuan was extremely speechless, coldly staring at Zhao Lin, and wrote on the paper, "Are you joking with me? Are you looking to die?"
Peaceful coexistence between zombies and humans? What a colossal joke.
Zombies and humans aren’t even the same species anymore; there’s no way to coexist peacefully with those who aren’t of our kind.
"Zombie King, I’m not joking. Everything I’m saying is genuinely what I think!"
Zhao Lin shook her head, looking serious and earnest.
She was prepared for Lu Chuan’s attitude; after all, what she was proposing was indeed unbelievable.
"I don’t know if zombies and humans can peacefully coexist, but in the short term, it seems impossible, and it doesn’t concern me much either!
Do you have anything more to say? If not, our conversation can end here."
Lu Chuan’s expression was grim as he frowned and wrote on the paper.
"Little Qiqi is human, after all, and will eventually grow up. Surely you don’t want Little Qiqi to live with zombies forever, do you?"
Zhao Lin quickly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 230: If I Became the Leader of Humanity, Would You Be Willing to Coexist Peacefully with Us?
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 230: If I Became the Leader of Humanity, Would You Be Willing to Coexist Peacefully with Us?
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan paused his movement to stand up and sat back down.
He glanced at the innocent and carefree Little Qiqi beside him and immediately fell silent.
Yeah!
After all, Little Qiqi is a human. Could he really let her live with zombies for the rest of her life?
No peers, no friends, no social life...
Can this really work?
Is it really fair to Little Qiqi?
Right now, while Little Qiqi is still young, they rely on each other, and naturally, she’s quite dependent on him.
But if Little Qiqi grows up and wants to return to the human world...
Could she, a girl raised among zombies, even reintegrate into it?
It would be very difficult...
Noticing Lu Chuan’s silence, seemingly deep in thought.
Zhao Lin’s heart stirred, knowing her words just now had taken effect.
The Corpse King might not care about peaceful coexistence between humans and zombies, but considering his doting on Little Qiqi, he would certainly consider her well-being.
He would definitely care about Little Qiqi’s growth issue.
Additionally, with the Corpse King having human consciousness, he likely wouldn’t want Little Qiqi to grow up among zombies.
After all, zombies are basically cruel, bloodthirsty, and lack intelligence.
Living among them provides no benefit for Little Qiqi, and she might even be influenced by them.
"Daddy, I don’t want to be separated from you. I want to stay with you forever."
With a face full of urgency, Ji Ruxue grabbed Lu Chuan’s arm, shook it, and said.
Zhao Lin’s words made sense, but that was for a child. Yet she wasn’t truly a human child.
She had a mature mind, so even living among zombies wouldn’t affect her.
Besides, she felt that staying with her daddy was far better than going to the human world.
She needn’t worry about food or clothing, and she had her daddy’s doting, while back in the human world, who would care for an orphaned child?
Most importantly, in the human world, where words were many, keeping her secret was much harder than it was here at the farm.
So, even if she were foolish, she wouldn’t leave her daddy to go to the human world.
Lu Chuan came back to his senses, gently ruffled Little Qiqi’s hair, and smiled.
Little Qiqi’s attitude comforted Lu Chuan greatly, but he couldn’t deny that Zhao Lin’s concerns were indeed valid.
It’s a realistic issue that he would have to face sooner or later.
No matter what, Little Qiqi was human, not a thoughtless zombie. She would have to return to the human world.
If she stayed in the zombie world forever, it would not benefit the little one’s growth.
Watching Zhao Lin, who sat waiting patiently, Lu Chuan’s gaze shifted, and he wrote again on the paper: "Continue! What else do you have to say?"
What she said was indeed reasonable, but if she couldn’t provide a solution, wouldn’t it just be nonsense?
"Lu Chuan, as I just said, if humans and zombies achieve peaceful coexistence, this issue can naturally be resolved.
By then, Little Qiqi could freely travel between the human and zombie worlds, contact humans, and you wouldn’t have to be separated."
Zhao Lin looked at Little Qiqi with a solemn expression and spoke earnestly.
If the relationship between humans and zombies became harmonious, Little Qiqi wouldn’t be seen as an outcast by humans; she could even become a bridge of communication between the two.
Having someone with a human identity but deep trust with zombies could make future interactions between the two sides smoother.
However, there were two challenges: getting this special Corpse King to agree and having the human side willing as well.
Although difficult, she was willing to try, no matter the obstacles ahead...
Today, her task was to persuade the Corpse King first.
Thinking of this, Zhao Lin’s eyes were filled with determination.
Hearing Zhao Lin’s words, Lu Chuan felt a bit helpless.
This woman was too naive.
Coexistence?
Is it really that simple?
The conflicts between the two sides are fundamentally irreconcilable.
Just as Zhao Lin said, humans want to reclaim their former homes, and many who lost loved ones to zombies harbor deep hatred.
Additionally, the Crystal Core in the evolved zombies’ brains is a precious resource. How could greedy humans give it up?
Without a top-down, complete ban, it’s impossible!
It’s like hunting wild boars: not only is it legal, but there’s a huge reward for killing one. Guess how many people would join the hunt?
His patience for Zhao Lin was gradually waning.
However, Lu Chuan also wanted to know if she might have an effective solution.
He then wrote on the paper: "Zhao Lin, your idea is good, but how could zombies and humans possibly achieve peaceful coexistence? Even if I don’t provoke humans, they won’t spare me.
As a human yourself, you should understand human nature."
"Lu Chuan, I know it’s difficult, but please believe me. I’ll do everything in my power, even if it costs me my life."
Zhao Lin’s face was serious, and her eyes showed resolve.
Making humans stop hunting zombies is tough because she knew the allure of the Crystal Core to humans.
But she also understood the terror of Lu Chuan, who not only had the power of a Corpse King but also possessed human wisdom. If he grew, he’d become a disaster for mankind, causing countless deaths.
She wanted human-zombie coexistence for Little Qiqi’s sake as well as humanity’s. She didn’t want numerous humans to die at the hands of Lu Chuan, the Corpse King.
Because of her firsthand experience of Lu Chuan’s uniqueness, Zhao Lin realized his dreadful potential.
The evolved zombies under his control were growing too powerful, too fast.
Especially those terrifying zombies suspected to be at the fourth stage, which, even from a distance, exuded an overwhelming and suffocating presence.
"Anyone can make grand statements. Do you have any real solutions for peaceful coexistence between zombies and humans? If you can’t give a reasonable answer, you know the consequences."
Lu Chuan sneered, quickly writing on the paper.
Looking at Lu Chuan’s words, Zhao Lin took a deep breath, seeming to make a significant decision, her demeanor suddenly becoming decisive and resolute, and she slowly said, "If one day, I become the human leader, deciding people’s fate, and extend an invitation, would you be willing to coexist peacefully with humans?"
Zhao Lin’s voice was stable and soft, but to Lu Chuan and Ji Ruxue, it sounded like an explosive thunder, startling them both.
What a joke!

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 231: I Must Become the Leader of Humanity!
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 231: I Must Become the Leader of Humanity!
Human leader?
At this moment, Lu Chuan looked at Zhao Lin with an expression full of disbelief.
His heart was suddenly filled with disdain.
This woman Zhao Lin, she wants to become the leader of humanity?
What a beautiful thought.
Human leader, Zhao Lin, how do these two fit together at all...
However, after a moment, Lu Chuan saw Zhao Lin’s face still serious and her eyes determined, and he couldn’t help but retract his contempt.
Could this woman really mean it?
Lu Chuan hesitated in his heart.
Although he admired her ambition, daring to claim she could become the human leader.
But as for Zhao Lin’s future, he actually did not see it very positively.
After all, what is Zhao Lin’s current status?
To put it nicely, she’s an Evolver with decent potential, who might become a powerful figure one day.
To put it bluntly, she’s just a prisoner on a farm, unable to return to the human world without his permission.
With such a status, she is a long, long way from being a human leader.
Even if you give Zhao Lin a hundred or eighty years, she might still not reach the position of human leader.
Meanwhile, Ji Ruxue, sitting beside, now looked at Ji Ruxue with wide eyes, showing surprise.
The fact that Zhao Lin could say something like that truly made Ji Ruxue see her in a new light.
She never thought that Zhao Lin, who usually seemed content and naïve, would have such an ambition?
Human leader!
Is it really that easy to become one?
Unless your strength can overwhelm the world, sweeping everything aside, otherwise, wanting to sit in that position is too difficult.
However, Ji Ruxue’s view of Zhao Lin’s future differed somewhat from Lu Chuan’s.
Although Zhao Lin’s ambition was rather grand and seemed somewhat unrealistic.
Ji Ruxue still believed that as long as Zhao Lin remained determined, keeping her ambition unchanged and working towards it tirelessly.
With Zhao Lin’s talent ability, it might not be impossible.
After all, her abilities are truly out of class, with her power surging every time she dies.
As long as she follows a well-planned route, she will certainly soar to unimaginable heights in the future.
As long as her power is strong enough, not only could she aim to be the human leader, but even becoming an emperor isn’t out of the question!
So Ji Ruxue is quite looking forward to Zhao Lin becoming the human leader.
"Haha, Dad probably never thought that Zhao Lin could really fulfill her ambition to become the human leader..."
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue glanced at her father with an incredulous look, speaking silently to herself.
In the future, if Zhao Lin really became the human leader, and her dad unified the world’s zombies.
The two might become the rulers of the two dominant powers in this world, and perhaps human-zombie coexistence could finally be achieved.
Removing her gaze from her father’s face, Ji Ruxue looked at Zhao Lin again.
At this moment, the look Ji Ruxue gave Zhao Lin was slightly different from before, with a hint of appreciation.
She did underestimate this woman previously.
Completely never thought she could come up with such an idea.
Ji Ruxue narrowed her eyes slightly, regardless of whether it could succeed in the end, just looking at Zhao Lin’s current thought.
In Ji Ruxue’s view, it actually has feasibility.
In the future, Dad and Zhao Lin, one as the human leader of humans and the other as the Corpse King governing countless zombies.
If they truly intended to let the two races coexist, then it would be hard for anyone to stop them...
At that time, it could really bring world peace.
On the human side, regulations and administrative orders could force humans to stop hunting zombies.
And on the zombie side, her dad is the king of the entire zombie world, controlling the life and death of zombies. Who would dare disobey his command?
At the same time, Ji Ruxue also thought of the Star Sky Insect Race.
In the past life, humanity experienced hardships and was nearly wiped out by the Star Sky Insect Race.
Ji Ruxue herself died at the hands of the Star Sky Insect Emperor.
Against the formidable Star Sky Insect Race, the power of humanity alone was not enough to resist.
In this lifetime, if zombies and humans united to resist the Star Sky Insect Race, maybe the world wouldn’t face the brink of extinction.
Even if together they still can’t match the Star Sky Insect Race, at least their strength would help withstand attacks longer.
Zhao Lin naturally felt the two gazes directed at her.
She also knew they must have dismissed her idea inwardly.
But she just wanted to try.
The future is uncertain, and anything is possible, who can say for certain she would fail.
Even if she ultimately doesn’t succeed, she wouldn’t regret the path she chose.
Lu Chuan came back to himself, giving Zhao Lin a deep look but did not directly answer; instead, he wrote on paper: "About zombies and humans living in peace, we’ll talk about it when you truly become the human leader."
Lu Chuan was not overly hopeful about Zhao Lin, but since her ambition and choices benefited him, he wouldn’t refuse directly.
Considering Zhao Lin’s status, becoming the human leader might take a long time, Lu Chuan thought he could wait and see how she does.
The human population is vast, with many having grand aspirations, yet most fantasize without taking action. A few who do act often retreat at the first hurdle.
Of the remnants, some may achieve modest success, but most fall by the wayside, becoming failures.
It’s usually only a handful who reach the end and become recognized as great successes.
Regarding Zhao Lin’s future, Lu Chuan thought the likelihood of her failing is quite high, perhaps even retreating when facing the first step.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin’s eyes widened.
Although Lu Chuan didn’t directly agree, yet Zhao Lin felt a bit pleased.
At least faced with her seemingly "outrageous" idea, he didn’t outright reject.
This means there is still a lot of hope.
"Okay!"
Zhao Lin nodded firmly, her voice resolute.
At this moment, Zhao Lin held one thought, a grand aspiration.
That is to quickly become the human leader!
After the conversation, Zhao Lin’s tense face relaxed, breaking into a smile.
She was quite satisfied with her performance in this conversation with Lu Chuan.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, I believe you can succeed!"
Ji Ruxue gave a little fist in encouragement to Zhao Lin.
"Thank you, Little Qiqi, I will certainly work hard."
Looking at Ji Ruxue’s bright smile, Zhao Lin felt a renewed sense of vigor.
She vowed in her heart to end this chaotic apocalypse!

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 232: Has Little Qiqi Finally Become an Evolver?
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 232: Has Little Qiqi Finally Become an Evolver?
After chatting with Lu Chuan, Zhao Lin didn’t stay long. She nodded at Lu Chuan and Little Qiqi, then turned around and left, returning to the amusement park.
Lu Chuan sat in the living room, his eyes flickering as he pondered Zhao Lin’s words earlier.
From time to time, he would glance at Little Qiqi, as if he thought of something.
Perhaps... Zhao Lin is right.
Although zombies are transformed from humans, both sides are now two different species.
Even if he spoils Little Qiqi and lets her grow up safely, she is still a human...
Ji Ruxue sat obediently in her seat, holding milk in her small hand, drinking through a straw while observing her father’s actions.
Seeing her father constantly looking at her, Ji Ruxue suddenly realized that her father might be contemplating the question Zhao Lin just raised.
Her father treats her well and is extremely attentive to her growth, not wanting her to grow up among zombies.
She knows that being among zombies won’t affect her, but her father doesn’t know that!
Her father definitely worries.
As for returning to human society, Ji Ruxue naturally wasn’t pleased about it, and she immediately decided to interrupt her father’s thoughts.
"Dad, why don’t we stop keeping Aunt Zhao Lin locked up? She seems like she wouldn’t hurt us."
Ji Ruxue supported herself on the table, leaned her little face towards Lu Chuan, blinked her eyes, and made a request.
Although she admired Zhao Lin’s ambition, she didn’t fully believe what Zhao Lin said, becoming the leader of humans was quite exaggerated...
After all, everyone can make grand statements, but whether they’re true or false, it’s hard for others to discern.
Regarding Zhao Lin, Ji Ruxue felt it was still necessary to continue probing her attitude.
To see if she would have any unusual actions after being completely unbound.
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan was startled, realizing that this was Little Qiqi’s favorable impression of Zhao Lin—wanting to plead for her because she saw Zhao Lin always locked up.
But how could Lu Chuan agree to this? He immediately shook his head.
Although what Zhao Lin said today made a lot of sense, and her ambition was terrifyingly grand, it didn’t mean Lu Chuan fully trusted her.
No matter what, she is still an Evolver and once was an enemy to him.
Facing his methods of torture, in addition to the period of imprisonment, surely she harbors resentment, right?
No one knows.
Even though he is confident that she can’t escape the farm even if unchained, the farm is constantly under the surveillance of Corpse Puppets.
But what if Zhao Lin holds a grudge, finds herself desperate, and decides to risk it all, targeting Little Qiqi?
If she harms Little Qiqi or uses her to threaten him, that would be unacceptable.
No matter what, he absolutely cannot place Little Qiqi in danger.
People can look innocent, but who knows their hearts? Although Zhao Lin usually behaves as if she likes Little Qiqi.
Who knows if it’s all an act to deceive him?
Lu Chuan dared not gamble on that...
Seeing her father’s refusal, Ji Ruxue felt disappointed, scrunching her nose dejectedly.
It seems that getting her father to agree to liberate Zhao Lin is still challenging, but she understands his concerns.
Zhao Lin attacked her father before in Jiangnan City District and even managed to put him in a difficult position...
Of course, there was also her help...
Previously, her father always reminded her not to get too close to Zhao Lin.
Simply out of fear that Zhao Lin might suddenly harm her.
Clearly, her father is wary of Zhao Lin.
Seeing Little Qiqi’s disappointed expression, Lu Chuan could only offer an apologetic glance and ruffled her hair.
Little Qiqi, it’s not that Dad doesn’t want to agree with you.
Dad is also thinking about your safety!
If Zhao Lin were to harm Little Qiqi, he would regret it too late.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue’s eyes sparkled as she came up with a good idea.
The reason her father refused her was fear of her being hurt by Zhao Lin.
If she could reveal some strength in front of her father, letting him know she can protect herself, discussing Zhao Lin might become much simpler.
Then, if she softened him a little and pressed him hard, he might consent.
Thinking about this, Ji Ruxue felt smug, her face beaming with a smile.
Seeing Little Qiqi’s sudden smile, Lu Chuan knowingly smiled and suddenly pinched Little Qiqi’s cheeks, pulling them to the sides.
Instantly, Little Qiqi’s chubby face resembled a round pancake.
"Dad!"
Ji Ruxue complained in annoyance, quickly breaking free from Lu Chuan’s hands and pulling her head back, her face flushed with anger.
Lu Chuan’s smile became even brighter.
"Hmph, Dad is too bad. I’m not playing with you anymore, I’m going to find Aunt Zhao Lin!"
Picking up the milk on the table, Ji Ruxue glared at Lu Chuan and jumped off the chair, quickly running towards the door.
Lu Chuan watched Little Qiqi’s back, his smile gradually faded.
For Little Qiqi’s sake, he became more eager for what Zhao Lin planned to do, and hoped she would succeed, even if the chances were slim.
He actually wished that in the future Little Qiqi would be able to attend school, surrounded by peers, growing up happily like a normal human child.
Next morning.
At the dining table, Lu Chuan prepared a sumptuous breakfast for Little Qiqi.
Yawning, Ji Ruxue rubbed her eyes and slowly walked over, skillfully climbed onto her chair, and sat down.
Seeing the delicious breakfast on the table, Ji Ruxue smiled and picked up a small spoon, ready to start.
Remembering yesterday’s decision, Ji Ruxue put the spoon down again, looked at Lu Chuan with a smile and excitement, "Dad, I think I’ve awakened superpowers, I can finally help Dad fight bad guys in the future!"
After speaking, Ji Ruxue clenched her small pink fists and pretended to punch forward.
"..."
Lu Chuan was stunned.
Superpower?
Regaining his senses, Lu Chuan looked at Little Qiqi with surprise.
At that moment, Ji Ruxue pointed towards the tableware on the table. The tableware suddenly rose from the table and moved back and forth in front of Lu Chuan.
Next, under Ji Ruxue’s control, the tableware quickly separated and danced in the air, its speed increasing.
Half a minute later, the porcelain bowl filled with meat porridge was securely placed back onto the table, and the pair of chopsticks swiftly returned, resting on the porcelain bowl.
Ji Ruxue looked proudly at Lu Chuan, saying, "Dad, look, isn’t my superpower amazing?"
Witnessing this firsthand, Lu Chuan naturally understood. Little Qiqi has become an evolver?
Lu Chuan had always seen adult evolvers, not knowing if children could become evolvers as well.
Presumably, if it works for adults, it should work for children too, since they are both humans without any difference.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 233: Training Little Qiqi! The Female Wine Sword Immortal!
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 233: Training Little Qiqi! The Female Wine Sword Immortal!
In order to further determine whether Little Qiqi has really become an Evolver, Lu Chuan quickly grabbed pen and paper to write: "Little Qiqi’s superpower is truly amazing.
However, you moved so fast just now; Dad would like to see it again. Can you show it to Dad once more?"
"Sure, Dad."
Seeing the words on the paper, Ji Ruxue nodded.
She knew that Dad probably wanted to confirm whether she had become an Evolver.
Ji Ruxue immediately decided to show Dad a skill, letting him know she already possesses the power of self-defense.
Instantly, Ji Ruxue moved her thoughts, disseminating her telekinesis like a tidal wave, quickly enveloping the dining table in front of her and then lifting it upward.
In an instant, the heavy table slowly parted from the ground and rose towards the ceiling.
In the air, the table remained steady, and the items placed on it did not sway.
This showed exactly how mature Ji Ruxue’s control over her telekinesis had become.
Then, under Lu Chuan’s thrilled gaze, Ji Ruxue returned the table to the floor, and surprisingly, it didn’t make a sound upon landing.
Even the chopsticks leaning on the bowls didn’t budge, showing no sign of falling.
Just then, Ji Ruxue seemed to not have had enough, opening her arms wide to Lu Chuan like a bird spreading its wings, chuckling as she said: "Dad, look, I can fly like a little bird now!"
As soon as she finished speaking, Ji Ruxue started flying in front of Lu Chuan; her petite figure, enveloped by telekinesis, moved ignoring the force of gravity, flying around the room.
She would fly to the ceiling, touch it with her small hand, and then fly behind Lu Chuan, circling him several times joyfully.
A moment later, at Lu Chuan’s beckoning gesture, Ji Ruxue flew back and returned to her seat.
Through careful observation, Lu Chuan had already understood the type of ability Little Qiqi had awakened.
If he was not mistaken, it should be the Telekinesis Control type.
This kind of ability is indeed powerful.
At this moment, looking at the "praise me" expression on Little Qiqi’s face, Lu Chuan felt incredibly excited.
Great, great, now that Little Qiqi has become an Evolver, he can finally relax.
From now on, even if he is not by her side, Little Qiqi will have her own power to protect herself.
If they encounter enemies in the future and can’t match them, Little Qiqi can use her telekinesis to help herself quickly escape.
Meanwhile, with Little Qiqi becoming an Evolver, Lu Chuan’s last shortcoming has been compensated.
Even if humanity’s army comes to besiege them, Lu Chuan can take Little Qiqi and leave quickly if they can’t defeat them.
Little Qiqi, as an Evolver, won’t be as fragile as ordinary people once were, and some hardships won’t cause her harm.
"Little Qiqi is very impressive; this superpower can raise a table and even make you fly!
However, your current strength isn’t strong enough. If you want to protect Dad, you must work hard in the future!"
Taking a deep breath to calm himself down, Lu Chuan continued writing on the paper.
Since Little Qiqi could become an Evolver and her talent and potential are significant, then naturally she ought to be carefully nurtured, ensuring her talent is not wasted.
Lu Chuan’s eyes shifted slightly, pondering how to help Little Qiqi improve her strength.
Evolution Potion?
Lu Chuan’s eyes brightened; if the opportunity arises, he could try to obtain some human Evolution Potion to boost Little Qiqi’s strength.
Additionally, the Blood Evil Blade Technique can also be arranged for Little Qiqi.
Little Qiqi’s talent ability is of the Telekinesis Control type, not skilled in close combat, just perfect for mending the shortcoming with the Blood Evil Blade Technique, which will surely come in handy.
...
The next day, to increase Little Qiqi’s proficiency in Telekinesis Control and develop the ability to combat enemies, Lu Chuan began training with Little Qiqi.
In the orchard.
Lu Chuan stood before the table, while Ji Ruxue stood on the nearby chair.
At this moment, the table was adorned with several fruit knives of varying sizes, rocks the size of fists, and a pile of embroidery needles.
"Dad, are these things used to hit the circles on the fruit trees?"
Ji Ruxue looked up at Lu Chuan and asked.
Both observed numerous wooden boards hanging on the trunks of fruit trees hundreds of meters ahead.
These were all hung by Lu Chuan, who controlled Corpse Puppets in advance.
Lu Chuan nodded and smiled at Little Qiqi, writing on paper: "Exactly, Little Qiqi! Use your superpower to control these and attack those wooden boards..."
"Got it! Dad, watch me!"
Ji Ruxue enthusiastically nodded, and immediately powerful telekinesis surged, rushing towards the several fruit knives on the table.
Swish~
Three fruit knives of varying lengths rose from the table, and in a flash, shot out rapidly as streaks of light flying towards the wooden boards hung on the tree trunks hundreds of meters away.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh~
Under Ji Ruxue’s control, the three fruit knives traversed through the orchard, swiftly avoiding the fruit trees ahead, quick as lightning.
Bam, bam, bam~
Almost simultaneously, the three fruit knives were embedded into the same wooden board.
The sharp blades, under immense impact, pierced right through it, causing the whole fruit tree to shudder violently, the canopy shaking and rustling.
"Dad, did you see how awesome I am!"
Ji Ruxue exclaimed excitedly.
As soon as the words fell, the stones on the table and the pile of embroidery needles flew up simultaneously under Ji Ruxue’s control, shooting out.
They danced incessantly in the orchard, skirting around tree after tree, accurately hitting the designated wooden boards.
The array of embroidery needles swam like fish in water within the orchard, finally all sinking into the wooden boards, penetrating the entire length.
And the two fist-sized rocks heavily struck the wooden board, shattering it instantly under the Giant Strength, erupting with a deafening noise.
The surface of the tree trunks behind was damaged with two deep dents, bark and wooden fragments scattering everywhere.
"Little Qiqi’s talent is truly mighty!"
Seeing Ji Ruxue effortlessly performing tasks he set, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but sigh with admiration.
A genius—Little Qiqi is definitely a genius. This feels like she was adept at Telekinesis Control in a past life—recently mastered, yet already proficient; simply unbelievable.
Nowadays, under Little Qiqi’s manipulation, these fruit knives, embroidery needles, and other items are like her extending limbs, capable of easily taking life.
Lu Chuan then recalled that previously, Little Qiqi could utilize telekinesis for flying.
In his mind, a vivid image emerged.
Little Qiqi standing on a flying sword, clad in white, steering the sword’s light across the sky, surrounded by thousands of suspended swords, gleaming sword beams covering heaven and earth, showcasing a world-shattering aura, suppressing everything.
This is simply the female version of the Wine Sword Immortal!
Absolutely awe-inspiring!

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 234: Little Qiqi Is the Real Trump Card!
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 234: Little Qiqi Is the Real Trump Card!
After unleashing everything on the table, Ji Ruxue slowly withdrew the telekinesis she had released.
Then, Ji Ruxue looked up at her dad.
Seeing Dad, with that excited and thrilled look, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but smile knowingly.
To make Dad happy, she doesn’t mind cooperating in a performance...
Actually, the skills that seem powerful and take a long time to master in Dad’s eyes are mere child’s play to her.
