In her past life, after numerous battles, she eventually became the Empress of Dragon Country, and many combat skills had become instinctual to her.
So that even now, after reincarnation and rebirth, these skills haven’t been lost; the familiar feeling just welled up the moment she started using them.
Actually, Ji Ruxue was holding back in her performance just now.
If she were to use the full power of a Level Four Evolver, those fruit knives and embroidery needles that were just shot out would not merely cause some damage to the wood board.
A fruit knife flying out would be like a fired missile; even fruit trees as thick as a bowl would be snapped in half.
However, she naturally couldn’t reveal her full strength in front of Dad since, on the surface, she’s just become an Evolver, which couldn’t be explained.
After all, it’s one thing to become an Evolver at such a young age by coincidence, but being so strong immediately after evolving, beyond common sense, really wouldn’t make any sense.
"Dad! These are easy for me!"
Seeing her entranced Dad, Ji Ruxue proudly said.
Waking from the fantasy of Little Qiqi becoming the Wine Sword Immortal, Lu Chuan’s excitement gradually subsided.
Just from Little Qiqi’s performance, the future will undoubtedly be limitless.
Then, Lu Chuan lowered his head, looked seriously at Little Qiqi, and wrote on paper: "Little Qiqi, you are now a Human Evolver and possess a powerful talent ability; I know you’re very happy, and of course, Dad is also very happy for you.
In the future, my Little Qiqi can also protect Dad.
However, Little Qiqi, remember to keep it a secret that you’ve become an Evolver and possess talent ability, and don’t easily tell anyone except Dad.
Not even Mrs. Zhao Lin; also, don’t easily show your abilities in front of her, understand?"
"Understood, Dad, I’ll definitely keep it a secret."
Upon hearing, Ji Ruxue naturally wouldn’t question why Mrs. Zhao Lin must be kept unaware, just nodded obediently and patted her chest, agreeing.
She knew that deep down, Dad certainly didn’t fully trust Zhao Lin, otherwise, he wouldn’t stress this personally.
It’s not really surprising, actually Ji Ruxue herself, up to now, hasn’t completely trusted Zhao Lin.
Otherwise, she wouldn’t repeatedly want to test Zhao Lin.
Mainly Zhao Lin’s previous actions in Jiangnan City District left her and Dad quite unsettled.
Seeing Little Qiqi nod, Lu Chuan showed a satisfied smile.
"My Little Qiqi is so good!"
Lu Chuan reached out and affectionately rubbed Little Qiqi’s head.
This little one is so much more obedient and well-behaved compared to other brats before the apocalypse.
Lu Chuan cautioned Little Qiqi not to show her abilities in front of others easily, not just to conceal them from Zhao Lin.
Normally, with him by her side, Little Qiqi would definitely not encounter danger.
After all, his army of Corpse Puppets isn’t just around to look pretty.
Therefore, usually, Little Qiqi’s abilities aren’t really necessary, so under such circumstances, Lu Chuan feels it’s best for her to stay hidden.
Who knows, maybe at a crucial moment, she might prove surprisingly effective!
Thinking back to when Little Qiqi shouted about wanting to help him fight bad guys and protect Dad...
Lu Chuan couldn’t help but smile.
At that time, Lu Chuan treated it as mere banter and didn’t take it seriously.
After all, Little Qiqi was just a child, how could she have the strength to help him?
His enemies are not only powerful Mutated Fierce Beasts but also opportunistic Human Evolvers, all formidable foes, not something Little Qiqi, a child, could confront.
But now, everything is different; with Little Qiqi becoming an Evolver, she really may have the ability to help Lu Chuan.
Telekinesis Control ability is such a powerful talent ability!
Of course, while it is possible, Lu Chuan doesn’t plan to directly send Little Qiqi into battle, having her fight enemies to help him.
After all, right now, Little Qiqi is still an innocent child, even if she has awakened a powerful talent ability.
Initially, her strength isn’t quite high.
Letting such a child risk her life, go head-to-head with powerful enemies, and experience those bloody scenes, Lu Chuan’s nature simply wouldn’t allow it.
Unless it’s a last resort, when all seems lost and in imminent peril, Lu Chuan wouldn’t let Little Qiqi take risks.
Lu Chuan’s plan is to secretly train Little Qiqi to become strong.
If all goes well, in the foreseeable future, Little Qiqi will stay by his side.
Although he is the Corpse King, capable of commanding a Zombie Army, with a multitude of Evolved Corpse Puppets under his command, who would overwhelm and crush any enemy.
However, Lu Chuan is not a combat-type Evolved Zombie; while his physical strength is indeed strong, compared to Evolved Zombies and other Evolvers of the same level, his strength is still inferior.
Like Tyrant One, it’s challenging for Lu Chuan to face them alone.
This is his flaw and also a common weakness among the Corpse Kings.
And as time progresses, the occurrence of Corpse Kings in the world increases, and this weakness will inevitably be discovered by those with intent.
At that point, humans may very well attack him specifically based on this weakness.
Lu Chuan couldn’t possibly remain vigilant at all times, preventing such incidents, so it’s imaginable that someday, he might be caught off guard by someone with intent.
Therefore, to resolve this "innate problem," Lu Chuan must leave himself with an ace that can help him at crucial moments.
And in Lu Chuan’s selection, the awakening of telekinesis control in Little Qiqi makes her the best choice as his trump card.
Next, Lu Chuan’s task is to find ways to improve Little Qiqi’s strength, striving to make her strong as soon as possible.
Imagine when the enemy passes through layers of Corpse Puppets, overcoming the tremendous cost to evade pursuit by Tyrant One and other strong Corpse Puppets, going through great difficulties, and finally facing Lu Chuan directly.
Being extremely prideful, thinking they have victory in their grasp, capable of killing the Corpse King.
Yet they would never expect.
That the seemingly harmless little girl beside the Corpse King is Lu Chuan’s true trump card!

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 235: Zhao Lin Gains Her Freedom! Try to Escape and You’ll Be Zombie Food!
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 235: Zhao Lin Gains Her Freedom! Try to Escape and You’ll Be Zombie Food!
Moments later, under Lu Chuan’s command, the Corpse Puppet brought over several boxes of iron nails from the warehouse.
These iron nails were quite large, about the length of an index finger, as thick as chopsticks, with extremely sharp tips.
If used well, they would serve as excellent hidden weapons.
Lu Chuan grabbed a handful of iron nails, placed them on the table, and wrote on paper: "Little Qiqi, practice your abilities more with these nails, Daddy will go prepare some snacks for you."
"Okay, Daddy!"
Ji Ruxue glanced at the iron nails, her eyes brightened, and she nodded towards Lu Chuan.
Afterwards, Lu Chuan turned around, preparing to wash some fruits, while the remaining Ji Ruxue, on a thought, drew several iron nails into her hand.
She touched the sharp tip of the nail, her eyes reflecting shifting emotions.
These iron nails were extremely suitable for her telekinesis control.
They were common, lightweight, and most importantly, sharp and sturdy. As soon as Ji Ruxue’s telekinesis moved, in an instant, they could be launched like a barrage of arrows, riddling the enemy.
And under telekinesis control, each iron nail was like a sniper rifle, hitting its target precisely.
Whether it was a Human Evolver or an Evolved Zombie, as long as they were hit on the head by the nails, they would essentially meet their end.
Moreover, the small size of these nails made it convenient for Ji Ruxue to carry, much better than using materials on hand.
In the future, if they encountered a horde of zombies or besiegement by Human Evolvers, having these nails would definitely catch the opponent off guard.
Next, following her daddy’s instructions, Ji Ruxue began to use these iron nails, flying them around the entire orchard.
Gradually, as more nails flew out, they started to resemble an attacking swarm of bees, producing a menacing buzzing sound in the orchard.
Under Ji Ruxue’s control, a nail would occasionally break away from the group, shooting out forcefully and fiercely hitting a distant fruit tree.
The strong force made the nail pierce through, splintering the wood, with a deafening bang.
Moments later, Lu Chuan returned, carrying a fruit platter.
At this time, Ji Ruxue had already gathered the nails back, like birds returning to their nests, each one falling back into the box.
Seeing her father approaching, Ji Ruxue joyfully jumped down and, with her little short legs, rushed over.
"Daddy, I want an apple!"
Rushing to the front, Ji Ruxue reached out her hand, jumping to grab an apple from Lu Chuan’s platter.
Lu Chuan smiled and raised the fruit platter high, keeping it out of Little Qiqi’s reach.
"Daddy!!"
Ji Ruxue exclaimed exasperatedly, her big round eyes staring at Lu Chuan.
Lu Chuan, no longer teasing her, handed the apple over.
"Thank you, Daddy!"
Ji Ruxue beamed, immediately taking the apple and biting into the rosy fruit.
Watching the beaming little Qiqi, Lu Chuan smiled.
"Daddy, Mrs. Zhao Lin is very nice, please free her! I’m begging you!"
After swallowing the apple in her mouth, Ji Ruxue scampered over, shaking Lu Chuan’s hand, looking at him expectantly.
Having shown some of her strength, Ji Ruxue believed her father shouldn’t have any more worries and immediately made the request again.
Hearing this, Lu Chuan’s smile faded, and he frowned slightly, falling into thought.
He didn’t expect Little Qiqi to ask him for Zhao Lin’s sake again so soon.
However, considering that Little Qiqi now had some self-preservation abilities, freeing Zhao Lin became feasible, and with Little Qiqi insisting a second time, he couldn’t bear to refuse.
Not taking long to decide, Lu Chuan nodded at Little Qiqi.
He wrote on the paper: "Since Little Qiqi wants to free Mrs. Zhao Lin, then Daddy agrees. Come with me."
"Thank you, Daddy!"
Ji Ruxue was overjoyed; indeed, she had gambled right. Daddy just worried about her safety, and as long as he was assured, freeing Zhao Lin wasn’t an issue.
Afterwards, Lu Chuan led Ji Ruxue towards the amusement park.
Amusement Park
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, Daddy has agreed, you won’t be locked up anymore! We’re here to free you!"
Ji Ruxue ran ahead of Lu Chuan, cheerfully yelling to Zhao Lin, who was sunbathing on the slide.
Hearing this, Zhao Lin was stunned and looked up towards the Corpse King and Little Qiqi.
Really, did the Corpse King agree just like that?
Moments later.
Zhao Lin, full of disbelief, just watched as the Corpse King undid the chains on her.
Stunned for a long time, Zhao Lin finally snapped back to reality, the feeling of regaining freedom thrilling her immensely.
"Little Qiqi, I don’t have to be locked here anymore!"
Overwhelmed with excitement, Zhao Lin couldn’t resist rushing to Little Qiqi, lifting her and spinning in circles, expressing her joy with a few excited cries.
After spinning Ji Ruxue ten or more times, Zhao Lin finally stopped and put Little Qiqi down.
Calming herself slightly, Zhao Lin turned her gaze to Lu Chuan, her eyes hiding excitement, and said: "Lu Chuan, thank you!"
Thinking of a possibility in her heart, Zhao Lin felt a renewed excitement.
Why would the Corpse King suddenly release her?
Could it be that what I said earlier had an effect?
Does it mean the other party agreed to my request?
Ignoring Zhao Lin, Lu Chuan walked away.
Seeing Zhao Lin’s silly smiling face, Ji Ruxue shook her head helplessly.
"This silly woman..."
"Little Qiqi, come, Auntie will play on the slide with you!"
Regaining her freedom, Zhao Lin was in an incredibly good mood and directly picked up the unresponsive Ji Ruxue, happily heading towards the slide.
"..."
Ji Ruxue was utterly speechless, planning to break free, but upon thinking, decided not to.
...
Though Lu Chuan had freed Zhao Lin, it didn’t mean he fully trusted her.
He still monitored her with the Corpse Puppet.
Fortunately, Zhao Lin’s subsequent behavior was satisfactory, as she didn’t wander around or try to investigate anything...
She stayed near the amusement park, accompanying Little Qiqi, and the two chatted and laughed.
Observing from the Corpse Puppet’s perspective, Lu Chuan nodded.
It seemed Zhao Lin understood the rules.
However, it was unclear when her personality changed so much.
No longer probing endlessly, nor recklessly impulsive, viewing zombies as enemies.
Hopefully, it’s not an act...
Lu Chuan thought silently, then his gaze sharpened.
If Zhao Lin has any intentions of escaping, he wouldn’t hesitate to act ruthlessly.
Continuously resurrecting?
Indestructible?
Might as well feed her to the zombies directly.
Revive her only to be eaten again.
After all, a zombie’s stomach is never full.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 236: Response from the Imperial Capital!
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 236: Response from the Imperial Capital!
"Little Qiqi, come play on the swing!"
Zhao Lin, having regained her freedom, felt light all over and was having a great time at the amusement park, sitting on the swing with a big smile on her face.
She waved excitedly at Little Qiqi, who was sliding down the slide.
Ji Ruxue paused her steps, looking at Zhao Lin, feeling speechless.
Has this woman gone mad?
She didn’t know where the energy came from; once freed, she dragged her to play around in this amusement park.
It’s as if she never gets tired, definitely like she’s born in the Year of the Ox.
At first, it was okay, Ji Ruxue understood and thought to indulge Zhao Lin for a bit, as a way to pass the time.
But as time went on, it became a bit troublesome.
She didn’t have much time to waste hanging around here with Zhao Lin.
"You play by yourself, I have homework to do."
Ji Ruxue shook her head and quickly walked towards the house.
Seeing Little Qiqi decline, Zhao Lin didn’t mind.
She swung by herself, enjoying the breeze that greeted her, looking content.
After returning to her room, Ji Ruxue didn’t actually get to her homework as she had said.
Instead, she used the Spirit Communication Technique to control a small bee, silently spying on Zhao Lin’s every move.
Her persuasion of her father to release Zhao Lin this time was merely a test for the latter.
If Zhao Lin showed any signs of misdeed, it would imply ill intent.
In that case, there would be no need to keep Zhao Lin alive.
Although Ji Ruxue saw potential in Zhao Lin, believing that her growth could be an asset.
But if Zhao Lin had harmful intentions towards her father or the farm, then she was better off without her.
In her previous life, she became the Supreme Empress.
This life, too, she will be the Empress; no one can stop her.
To her, Zhao Lin was merely an embellishment.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan was also following Little Qiqi, doing the same thing.
With a large number of Corpse Puppets as spies, he would not stop monitoring Zhao Lin.
However, apart from monitoring Zhao Lin’s actions, Lu Chuan had other things to do, keeping himself busy.
After resolving the crisis brought by the Human Evolvers, Lu Chuan’s attention returned to hunting Mutated Fierce Beasts.
After all, the zombie breeding ground in Jiangnan City District was waiting eagerly for their return.
In order to produce a large number of Evolved Zombies, a supply of energy-rich Mutated Beast blood is essential.
At this time, Lu Chuan was already controlling his Evolved Corpse Puppets, forming a convoy heading towards Yellow Dragon Mountain.
However, considering the ongoing threat from the Human Evolvers, which wouldn’t disappear anytime soon.
Lu Chuan didn’t send out all his Fourth-Tier Corpse Puppets.
Instead, he left two Fourth-Tier Corpse Puppets behind to guard the farm.
With Fourth-Tier Evolved Zombies as protectors, no matter how many ordinary Human Evolvers come, they would only meet their demise.
In addition to monitoring Zhao Lin and commanding the Corpse Puppet army to hunt beasts.
Lu Chuan spent his remaining time nurturing Little Qiqi.
First, he brought out various tools for Little Qiqi to continuously practice her Telekinesis Control ability.
Afterward, he selected suitable First-Tier Corpse Puppets to spar with Little Qiqi, honing her combat skills.
It started with one-on-one battles, progressed to two-on-one, and finally turned into group fights to enhance Little Qiqi’s fighting prowess.
After all, Lu Chuan intended to make Little Qiqi his trump card.
However, if Little Qiqi had only potential but lacked combat experience, that wouldn’t do.
...
Jianghai Base City.
In the Inner City’s vast conference room.
After the highest command reported the encounter of three Evolutionary Squads in Jiangnan City District to the Imperial Capital.
Today, they finally received a response from the Imperial Capital.
At this moment, all the senior officials of the Base City were present, having a video conference with the Imperial Capital.
The conference room was extremely quiet, everyone was sitting straight, looking solemn, eyes fixed on the screen ahead.
In the video screen appeared a dignified middle-aged man, calmly observing everyone present.
"The report from your Jianghai Base City has been understood by the Imperial Capital, as for the content...
Since you dared to report it, it means you’ve considered it carefully, so I won’t say more.
Next, I’ll inform you of the Imperial Capital’s decision.
Regarding the issue of your Jianghai Base City, the Imperial Capital decided to send a very strong ace squad to verify the situation.
Once verified to be true, they will assist your Jianghai Base City in operations to eliminate the Corpse King."
The middle-aged man spoke slowly with piercing eyes.
Upon hearing this, the people present were inwardly delighted; with the elite squad from the Imperial Capital sent, they finally felt relief.
By then, they could leverage the strength of the elite squad to strike directly at Yellow Dragon, swiftly eliminating the Corpse King at the farm before it had the chance to incite a Corpse Tide.
Just then, the middle-aged man in the video changed his tone, speaking coldly: "However, don’t rejoice too soon.
Let me be blunt, if upon verification, the intelligence you sent is false, and there’s no Corpse King in Jiangnan City District...
Then the Imperial Capital will severely punish your Jianghai Base City, and each of you will be held accountable!
The Corpse King is a major threat to humanity, not a joking matter! Do you all understand?"
Upon these words, the highest command and other high officials glanced at each other, feeling somewhat guilty.
Logically, the presence in the farm should be the Corpse King, right?
However, obtaining support from the Imperial Capital was still gratifying to the highest command, who promptly responded formally: "Understood, sir! If the intelligence is incorrect, Jianghai Base City willingly accepts punishment!"
Regardless of whether the intelligence on the Corpse King holds true, resolving this deadly threat is beneficial for Jianghai Base City.
Once the elite squad arrives, if the Corpse King is truly absent in Jiangnan City District, they would simply face punishment.
Yet, from that point on, Jianghai Base City wouldn’t have to worry about the Corpse King again.
If they indeed find evidence of the Corpse King, Jianghai Base City must exert full effort to aid the elite squad in exterminating the menace.
A few minutes later, the video screen went blank.
The conference room immediately buzzed with discussions.
The highest command frowned slightly and said loudly: "Alright, everyone quiet down."
Everyone instantly fell silent, focusing on the highest command.
"Now, the elite squad dispatched by the Imperial Capital will soon arrive, everyone return and prepare, each department ready to welcome them."
"Yes!"

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 237: Zhao Lin Passes the Assessment! Ji Ruxue’s Scheme!
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 237: Zhao Lin Passes the Assessment! Ji Ruxue’s Scheme!
Time passed again, and a few more days went by.
Zhao Lin, who had gained freedom, no longer had to be confined to that small area by the slide, and she seemed much more spirited.
However, her daily physical training did not stop; she was as unshakable as ever, completing her daily training regime to maintain her condition and prevent decline.
After all, it had been a long time since she had been in combat.
Perhaps feeling a bit embarrassed about simply eating and drinking for free every day, Zhao Lin found something to do for herself.
She thought of contributing in this way to the farm, even if her efforts seemed insignificant to Ji Ruxue and Lu Chuan.
In the early morning, with the sun just rising, the warm orange-red sunlight spread over the farm, gradually dissipating the thin cool mist lingering in the air.
The once-sleeping farm had come alive, with each Evolved Corpse Puppet starting its respective duties for the day.
After washing up early and having breakfast, Zhao Lin, as she had in past days, slowly walked into a warehouse with more than a dozen Evolved Corpse Puppets.
A moment later, Zhao Lin followed these Evolved Zombies out, each holding a farming tool in hand.
Following the group into the vibrant vegetable field, Zhao Lin imitated their actions, starting to weed and till the eggplant plots.
After finishing her own plot, Zhao Lin hurried to another empty vegetable field, assisting an Evolved Corpse Puppet in planting some vegetable seeds.
At this point, Zhao Lin seemed to have become completely integrated into farm life, becoming one of its members.
Even though she was surrounded by speechless Corpse Puppets, mindlessly shuffling about.
Not far away, a small bee perched on a tomato leaf gently flapped its wings and flew away.
Inside the room, Ji Ruxue watched Zhao Lin through the surveillance of the little bee, with a slight curl at the corner of her mouth.
She was quite satisfied with Zhao Lin’s behavior during this period.
Repeated secret observations hadn’t revealed any abnormal behavior on Zhao Lin’s part.
During this time, Zhao Lin’s life was extremely regular. Apart from eating, sleeping, and training, she spent her remaining time helping with farm work.
Weeding the vegetable fields, assisting Evolved Zombies in picking ripe fruit from the orchard, and cleaning the living room...
Through the little bee flying in the sky, Ji Ruxue watched Zhao Lin busily working in the vegetable field, her eyes slightly flickering.
Now, Zhao Lin had preliminarily passed her assessment.
She thought it might be time to begin cultivating Zhao Lin.
Meanwhile, like Ji Ruxue, after intensively monitoring Zhao Lin for a period, Lu Chuan had also slightly lowered his guard.
At least for now, he hadn’t found anything amiss with Zhao Lin.
Moreover, now that Little Qiqi had self-preservation capabilities, most Evolvers might not be able to match Little Qiqi.
Even if Little Qiqi were to lose, it could escape through Telekinesis Control.
Therefore, with Zhao Lin’s current abilities, she couldn’t cause much trouble on the farm.
If she wanted to escape, facing layer upon layer of Corpse Puppets, the only way was to take Little Qiqi hostage to threaten Lu Chuan.
But now that Little Qiqi could protect itself, Zhao Lin had no chance of escaping.
After observing Zhao Lin in the vegetable field for a moment, Lu Chuan shifted his attention away.
At this moment, he sat in the living room, mentally controlling the army of Corpse Puppets at Yellow Dragon Mountain, continuing to hunt Fierce Beasts.
One by one, the Fierce Beasts were being slain by the Corpse Puppet army, their Crystal Cores removed, while their flesh was loaded onto vehicles.
Lu Chuan calculated that, before long, the Zombie Breeding Base would be ready for its third harvest.
...
Meanwhile, in the room, Ji Ruxue sat cross-legged on the bed, eyes filled with thought.
Zhao Lin had great potential, and cultivating her could greatly benefit her future efforts.
However, how to cultivate her...
Actually, Ji Ruxue had previously planned to teach Zhao Lin a cultivation technique.
After all, for an Evolver seeking to quickly gain strength, apart from Evolution Potions, using a cultivation technique to accelerate the absorption of external energy was the best and most stable method.
With a cultivation technique, Zhao Lin could quickly grow stronger, and with her unique Resurrection Ability, she could possibly soar to new heights in a short time.
If things developed this way, it would naturally be a good thing for Ji Ruxue.
But human hearts are unpredictable, and though Zhao Lin seemed to have integrated into farm life, who could say with certainty that she wouldn’t turn against them in the future?
One must remember, despite everything, Zhao Lin was a human, fundamentally different from Zombies.
She might stand with Zombies now, but in the future, when she’s powerful, it might not be the case.
If one day Zhao Lin were to suddenly betray the farm, it would inevitably lead to disastrous consequences.
Ultimately, Ji Ruxue did not wish to cultivate an enemy against herself.
"Human nature is so unpredictable!"
Recalling various unpleasant experiences from her past life, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but sigh, shaking her head in resignation.
Even though she worried about creating an enemy,
Ji Ruxue truly saw Zhao Lin’s potential.
So even though she had concerns, she wouldn’t entirely give up on cultivating Zhao Lin.
Now she needed to find a win-win strategy, one that could achieve the goal of cultivating Zhao Lin while ensuring she remained under her control, ever usable, without worrying about betrayal.
She had to be able to manipulate Zhao Lin, controlling her future, so that even with divergent intentions, she wouldn’t dare act on them...
After deliberating for a while, Ji Ruxue’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Got it!
She thought of a solution.
Since she needed to cultivate Zhao Lin anyway, she could just offer her a cultivation technique she had acquired in her past life.
This technique was of such high quality it would serve the purpose of cultivating Zhao Lin well, and due to its particular characteristics, it would also allow Ji Ruxue to exercise control over Zhao Lin.
A cultivation technique appeared in Ji Ruxue’s mind.
Nine Elements Pulse Refining Technique!
This technique had a very strong remodeling capability for human meridians, capable of transforming and widening the meridians within, greatly enhancing the capabilities of Evolvers of the same level.
However, the technique wasn’t without its drawbacks; once practiced, switching to another cultivation technique would become very difficult.
And if one were to force a switch, there existed risks of ruptured meridians and sudden death.
Even if Zhao Lin could resurrect again, the marks of the cultivation technique would remain.
Hence, Ji Ruxue only planned to teach the first half of this technique to Zhao Lin.
Once Zhao Lin practiced this technique, to achieve higher realms in the future, she would have to rely on Ji Ruxue to impart the second half of the technique.
In this way, Zhao Lin would undeniably remain under her control!
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue’s lips curled up. The trouble of cultivating Zhao Lin seemed to be resolved.
In a matter of time, she would certainly have a powerful ally at her disposal, making her more confident in the face of threats from Human Base Cities.

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 238: The Corpse King’s Ancestral Cultivation Technique? Real or Fake?
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 238: The Corpse King’s Ancestral Cultivation Technique? Real or Fake?
In the vegetable field.
Zhao Lin followed the two evolved Corpse Puppets and planted vegetable seeds in all three nearby plots.
Standing up, Zhao Lin looked at the neatly arranged vegetable plots in front of her, a smile on her face, and an overwhelming sense of accomplishment in her heart.
This feeling could only be compared to the times before the apocalypse when she solved problems for the nearby residents and received their gratitude.
"If I could live like this all the time, it wouldn’t be too bad!"
Staring at the pastoral beauty before her, Zhao Lin was deeply moved.
Under the protection of the Corpse King, the farm had no security issues at all.
With ample resources and food, there was no need to worry about sustenance.
Such conditions, perhaps, seemed ordinary before the apocalypse, and many young people might not want to live like this, preferring the dazzling city life.
But now, in this post-apocalyptic world, this kind of safe and well-fed environment was like heaven to Zhao Lin and many survivors.
It’s fortunate that Zhao Lin didn’t know about the pig-like lives of the survivors in the Jianghai Base City Outer District; otherwise, her feelings would be even more profound now.
However, only for a moment, Zhao Lin snapped back to reality, her eyes filled with determination.
The goal she had set for herself flashed through her mind.
For Little Qiqi, and for her fellow humans still struggling in this apocalypse.
She had to strive to become stronger and fulfill the promise she made before the Corpse King.
In an instant, Zhao Lin straightened her back, her posture resembling a tall, snow-covered pine, her face filled with resolute determination.
She was determined to become a leader of the human race!
Moments later, after finishing her weeding task, Zhao Lin returned to the warehouse with the evolved Corpse Puppets and put away her hoe.
Then, Zhao Lin walked out of the warehouse to the pond, intending to wash the dirt off her hands.
Swish~
Just as Zhao Lin was washing her hands, a crisp voice called out from behind the house.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin! Come here, I have something to tell you!"
Ji Ruxue, hiding behind the house, poked her head out and called out to Zhao Lin sneakily.
"Hmm? Little Qiqi."
Zhao Lin was initially taken aback, but when she turned and saw her, a smile appeared on her face.
Ever since Little Qiqi persuaded the Corpse King to release her, Zhao Lin had grown increasingly fond of the child.
But what’s Little Qiqi wanting to talk to me about?
Especially with such a mysterious demeanor?
Filled with curiosity and intrigue, Zhao Lin walked over with a smile.
"Little Qiqi, what do you need from me?"
Approaching, Zhao Lin reached out to Ji Ruxue’s surprised gaze, playfully pinching her soft cheeks.
Realizing what was happening, Ji Ruxue, a bit speechless, quickly broke free, retreating several steps.
Seeing Little Qiqi’s adorable demeanor, even in defiance, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but chuckle.
"Little Qiqi, tell me, what did you want? Is it something about your homework?"
Zhao Lin continued to ask.
Secretly keeping Zhao Lin’s teasing in mind to get back at her someday, Ji Ruxue quickly returned to the main topic.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, you need to come with me. This is something secret; come to my room."
Then, Ji Ruxue grabbed Zhao Lin’s sleeve and led her toward the house.
Secret?
What in this farm is worth keeping a secret?
Hearing Ji Ruxue’s words, Zhao Lin felt even more puzzled, but to find out what Little Qiqi needed, she did not resist being pulled along.
In a short while, they entered Little Qiqi’s room.
Under Zhao Lin’s curious gaze, Ji Ruxue locked the door, went to the bed, and pulled a box from underneath it.
Carefully, she took out a book filled with writing from inside.
The next moment, Little Qiqi handed the booklet to Zhao Lin, quietly instructing, "Mrs. Zhao Lin, this is the ’Nine Elements Pulse Refining Technique,’ my family’s ancestral cultivation technique.
After cultivating it, you can become stronger faster. Take it and cultivate, but don’t tell anyone."
Ji Ruxue wanted to pass the cultivation technique to Zhao Lin but couldn’t be straightforward about it; otherwise, it would be hard to explain its origin. So she framed the ’Nine Elements Pulse Refining Technique’ as an ancestral method, so it wouldn’t arouse Zhao Lin’s suspicion.
"Your family’s ancestral technique? Did your father give it to me?"
Zhao Lin was startled; she initially thought Little Qiqi had some request, but she didn’t expect her to present a cultivation technique.
Looking at the ancestral technique, she inferred that it must belong to the Corpse King.
"No, I copied it secretly. Papa doesn’t know yet."
Ji Ruxue shook her head.
She had just copied the technique, and perhaps the ink hadn’t even dried yet.
"No, this is your family’s ancestral technique. If I cultivate it, your father might get angry."
Upon hearing, Zhao Lin’s expression changed drastically; she shook her head vigorously.
She thought it was given by the Corpse King...
If the Corpse King had given it to her, she would have cultivated it, ready to repay the favor someday.
But now, since Little Qiqi decided on her own to give her the technique, she naturally couldn’t accept it. If discovered, not only would she be punished, but Little Qiqi might also bear the consequences.
She couldn’t involve Little Qiqi, who was still innocent, over a cultivation technique.
"Just cultivate it secretly so that he won’t find out."
Ji Ruxue forcibly placed the booklet into Zhao Lin’s arms, speaking nonchalantly.
"Little Qiqi, this..."
Zhao Lin still felt uneasy and tried to return the booklet.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, just keep it! Although it’s an ancestral technique, Papa doesn’t care about it.
He left it in the pile of old books and forgot about it. I found it, so even if you cultivate it, Papa won’t say anything..."
Seeing Zhao Lin’s guilty face, Ji Ruxue nodded inwardly, then with a smile, pushed Zhao Lin’s extended hand back, comfortingly said.
Hearing this, Zhao Lin was moved. Such a good Little Qiqi; she must protect her in the future, ensuring she comes to no harm.
Little Qiqi’s actions were, after all, at the risk of being reprimanded by the Corpse King.
Even though the Corpse King didn’t value the technique much, what if he suddenly remembered it one day?
Moments later, guided by Ji Ruxue, Zhao Lin sat down cross-legged.
Having felt overwhelmed by the joy and dilemma that came with the cultivation technique, Zhao Lin now cooled down and sensed that something might be amiss.
Looking down at the cultivation manual in her hand, she hesitated.
Could the Corpse King actually have an ancestral technique? Is it actually cultivatable?

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 239: Zhao Lin’s Power Soars! The Grand Enterprise Within Reach!
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 239: Zhao Lin’s Power Soars! The Grand Enterprise Within Reach!
Seeing Little Qiqi staring at her, Zhao Lin hurriedly hid the doubt in her eyes.
No matter what, this cultivation technique was passed to her by Little Qiqi at the risk of danger. It was a gesture of goodwill, purely for her own benefit.
So even if the cultivation technique is fake, out of respect for Little Qiqi, she must try it once and not let Little Qiqi’s good intentions go to waste.
"Little Qiqi, can you understand this cultivation technique?"
Upon hearing Little Qiqi just say she would guide her, Zhao Lin opened the cultivation technique manual in her hand, planning to go through it.
Instantly, it felt like reading a book of heaven.
She recognized every word in it, but when these little ones were put together, she completely couldn’t understand them.
Thus, she was somewhat surprised. Such a complex thing, can Little Qiqi understand it?
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, of course, I didn’t understand before, but I asked my dad, and it seems like he had studied it before.
Back then, my dad looked indifferent, clearly not taking it seriously, that’s why I brought it out."
Sitting opposite Zhao Lin, Ji Ruxue spoke confidently.
Hearing Little Qiqi’s words, Zhao Lin’s heart sank, thinking this cultivation technique must be fake.
Since the Corpse King had studied it before but then casually tossed it into a pile of books, what does this mean?
It means he couldn’t cultivate anything from it at all!
The Corpse King, who could understand it, couldn’t make headway in cultivating it, it’s unlikely for her, who is completely in the dark, to gain anything.
Thinking of this, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but feel a bit disappointed.
However, since it is also Little Qiqi’s goodwill, Zhao Lin decided not to give up so easily and chose to first try practicing it with Little Qiqi’s explanation.
As time ticked away, half an hour passed in the blink of an eye.
Because there wasn’t much content in the booklet, with Little Qiqi’s explanation and guidance, Zhao Lin basically grasped the cultivation method outlined in the booklet.
An hour later, under Ji Ruxue’s watchful gaze, Zhao Lin closed her eyes, meditated, and entered her first session of cultivation.
The moment Zhao Lin started operating the cultivation technique, energy factors from all directions began to converge towards her, merging into her body.
Gradually, Zhao Lin’s body started to tremble slightly, and she radiated an aura of renewed vitality, as if she had undergone a baptism from inside out.
"It can really be cultivated!"
Instantly, Zhao Lin opened her eyes, filled with astonishment.
She had just clearly felt a mysterious power from the air entering her body, spreading a tingling sensation throughout her body as if thousands of ants were crawling inside her.
Is this really the ancestral cultivation technique of the Corpse King?
How could there be such a miraculous cultivation technique in the world?
Why had she never heard any information about it before?
At this moment, Zhao Lin’s heart surged with wonder intertwined with curiosity; what exactly is Lu Chuan’s background?
Little Qiqi mentioned that the "Nine Elements Pulse Refining Technique" is the Corpse King’s family inheritance. A family possessing such a cultivation technique must have an unusual background.
If this cultivation technique is real, why did the other party fail to cultivate it? Is there some limitation?
Opposite her, Ji Ruxue, who had been observing Zhao Lin, was also somewhat surprised to see her making progress so quickly.
Looking Zhao Lin up and down, Ji Ruxue’s eyes showed satisfaction.
Unexpectedly, this woman is also a genius.
Having a remarkable Talent Ability as an Evolver doesn’t mean the person has talent in cultivating cultivation techniques.
Now, Zhao Lin not only has outstanding Talent Ability, but she is also a genius in cultivation, the combination of the two making Zhao Lin’s potential even greater than Ji Ruxue expected.
"Little Qiqi, I did it!"
Coming back from her shock, Zhao Lin looked at Little Qiqi, smiling broadly, and announced happily.
"Congratulations, Mrs. Zhao Lin. You are truly amazing to have cultivated successfully so quickly."
Hearing this, Ji Ruxue was also delighted and complimented her.
"I owe it to you, Little Qiqi. If it wasn’t for your excellent guidance, I couldn’t have done it so quickly."
With a smile on her face, Zhao Lin reached out to ruffle Little Qiqi’s head, speaking warmly.
The two chatted for a while more. Little Qiqi once again requested Zhao Lin keep it secret, to which Zhao Lin nodded affirmatively, then bid farewell to Little Qiqi and left the room.
In the room, watching Zhao Lin’s back, Ji Ruxue’s eyes flickered: "I hope you won’t disappoint me."
With her cultivation technique passed on, Zhao Lin is considered her disciple. If she disloyal, the sect would have to be purged, retrieving everything given out, one by one.
Leaving the house, Zhao Lin cheerfully went to the amusement park, sitting on the bed under the slide, eagerly starting the cultivation of the "Nine Elements Pulse Refining Technique."
And through the Corpse Puppet, Lu Chuan noticed Zhao Lin’s bizarre behavior. Though puzzled, he didn’t think much of it.
With Little Qiqi now having self-preservation capabilities and the farm’s defenses enhanced, the security aspect was considerably assured.
Currently, he focused his efforts on Yellow Dragon Mountain, aiming to promote several fourth-tier Corpse Puppets before the human invasion came again.
Three days later.
During these three days, Zhao Lin dedicated most of her time to cultivation, equipped with the cultivation technique.
Under a large tree on the edge of the amusement park, Zhao Lin was meditating on a stone, eyes closed, operating the cultivation technique. At this moment, energy factors from all around rushed towards her like a surging torrent.
Zhao Lin’s body shivered slightly under the impact of the energy factors, and as time passed, her aura visibly rose at a rapid rate.
Boom!
Finally, as if reaching a critical point, Zhao Lin’s body shook, her aura surged upwards, an overwhelming blast sweeping across the area.
"Good, good, good, finally broke through to the third tier!"
Zhao Lin opened her eyes; feeling the changes within her, delight filled her eyes.
This "Nine Elements Pulse Refining Technique" was truly a treasure. During cultivation, it continuously remodels and refines the body’s meridians, making them broader and more pliable, able to withstand stronger energy impacts.
Not only is it beneficial for daily cultivation but also for breaking through levels.
Of course, her swift breakthrough to the third tier isn’t solely due to the cultivation technique. Half of it is credited to her long-term consumption of beast meat, especially high-grade mutated fierce beast meat, which had already accumulated considerable energy factors within her.
Frankly, she benefited from Little Qiqi’s advantage.
Otherwise, how could she have feasted on such precious mutated beast meat regularly?
Standing up slowly, feeling the strength of the third tier, Zhao Lin was very content, the smile on her face never wavering.
At the same time, her eyes sparkled with confident brilliance.
With such a divine technique, why worry about not accomplishing great feats?

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 240: The Ace Team from the Imperial Capital!
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 240: The Ace Team from the Imperial Capital!
With both hands gripping, the crackling sound of bones echoed, and feeling the power contained within her body, Zhao Lin felt eager to test it out, contemplating finding someone to spar with.
"There’s only me and Little Qiqi on this farm, who can I spar with? Surely not the Corpse King..."
Zhao Lin shook her head.
However, in the next moment, her eyes lit up, focusing on the Corpse Puppets wandering around the farm.
Right, there are still Evolved Zombies here!
These Evolved Zombies are completely under the Corpse King’s control, mindless creatures, perfect as her sparring partners.
After sorting this out, Zhao Lin stepped forward, preparing to discuss with the Corpse King, but after a few steps, she paused, furrowing her brows, somewhat troubled.
The Corpse King doesn’t quite take kindly to me. Even if I ask, it might not work!
"Better to find Little Qiqi first, let this little guy help me talk."
After some thought, Zhao Lin decided to enlist Little Qiqi, figuring that if Little Qiqi steps in, there’s a good chance it could work.
Truth be told, as an adult, continually seeking help from Little Qiqi, a child, made Zhao Lin feel a bit uncomfortable, despite her thick skin.
Next, Zhao Lin walked over to Ji Ruxue, who was swinging on the swing.
"Little Qiqi!"
Zhao Lin approached the swing, her expression hesitant.
"Aunt Zhao Lin, is there something you need from me?"
Ji Ruxue stopped the swing, looked at Zhao Lin, and asked with a face full of curiosity.
Seeing Zhao Lin coming over, Ji Ruxue already guessed she had something to ask of her, so she didn’t beat around the bush.
"Little Qiqi, could you tell your dad, let me have a fight with that big guy?"
Resolutely, Zhao Lin smiled and pointed to an Evolved Corpse Puppet nearby, speaking warmly.
"Huh? Aunt Zhao Lin, you want to fight these zombies? They’re quite strong, you might get hurt."
Feeling her cultivation breakthrough, a desire to test her strength?
Although Ji Ruxue understood, she feigned worry and shook her head.
"Don’t worry, Little Qiqi, this zombie won’t beat me."
Zhao Lin chuckled and said.
"Alright then! Aunt Zhao Lin, wait here, I’ll go talk to dad."
Ji Ruxue nodded, jumped off the swing, and ran to find Lu Chuan.
Meanwhile, Zhao Lin stood in place, anxiously waiting.
Who knows what the Corpse King would think upon realizing her breakthrough, whether he would perceive her as a threat, growing wary?
...
Jianghai Base City.
Bzz bzz bzz~
In the distant sky, a helicopter rapidly approached.
"Something’s up, everyone stay alert!"
The guard at the gate, seeing the helicopter of unknown origin, immediately grew wary, loudly warning.
Instantly, the soldiers responsible for gate defense aimed their weapons at the approaching helicopter, their alertness heightened to the extreme.
The helicopter hovered hundreds of meters away from the gate in mid-air, the cabin door slid open, and seven figures flew out, landing quickly.
Under the guards’ astonished gaze, the seven-member squad dressed in combat gear quickly began walking towards the gate.
"Gentlemen, we are the Imperial Capital’s Sky Squad, ordered by senior officials to support Jianghai Base City, please notify your superiors."
The leading captain, a resolute middle-aged man, saluted a group of guard soldiers and reported his identity.
The Sky Squad of the Imperial Capital!
The guard soldiers were all startled upon hearing, afterwards, the guard captain among them stepped out with a serious expression, returned the salute, and politely said, "Please wait a moment, I’ll report to the top."
The Sky Squad captain nodded and, along with his team members, waited in place.
After the guards had reported the news upstairs, shortly thereafter, the highest commander brought a group of senior officials outside to personally greet them.
"Haha, our base city has been eagerly awaiting the aid from the Imperial Capital, welcome to the Sky Squad."
The highest commander extended his hand politely and said with a smile.
"Chief, under orders from the Imperial Capital, Sky Squad Captain Lin Liming, along with six teammates, reporting for duty."
Seeing the highest commander leading the high-rank officials to welcome them, Sky Squad’s six members immediately put on a serious demeanor. Captain Lin Liming saluted again and said with measured respect.
"Captain Lin, with your help this time, our base city will feel less pressured. Come, come, let’s head inside first."
"Chief, you are gracious..."
"After a long journey, please come in and rest first. We’ll discuss further matters later..."
"..."
After exchanging handshakes and pleasantries, the highest commander led the Sky Squad inside.
Following this, after settling the Sky Squad, the highest commander and seniors returned to the meeting room for discussions.
Inside the meeting room.
"This time, the Sky Squad has come to Jianghai Base City with a significant mission and is also here to help solve our city’s problems.
The stakes are high, and the outcome could affect the rise and fall of our entire base city!
So here I caution everyone beforehand, please do not cause any trouble that might influence the Sky Squad or affect the base city’s upcoming actions, understood?"
At the start of the meeting, the highest commander issued a warning to all present senior officials.
Facing the highest commander’s ultimatum, all senior officials certainly wouldn’t defy him, nodding earnestly.
Once the tone was set, the meeting entered a relatively relaxed discussion phase.
"Chief, I didn’t expect the Imperial Capital to be so generous, sending the Sky Squad here."
A senior official at the end of the meeting table exclaimed with surprise.
"Indeed, the Sky Squad is said to be one of the five ace squads of the Imperial Capital; their dispatch here shows the importance they attach to our Jianghai Base City’s incident."
Someone chimed in agreement.
"I didn’t expect the Imperial Capital to choose the Sky Squad either, but I suppose it’s because the Corpse King has caught their attention.
After all, everyone knows how terrifying the Corpse King is. The Imperial Capital must be trying to ensure everything goes flawlessly."
The highest commander smiled broadly, expressing his surprise.
The Sky Squad consists entirely of Evolvers with flying abilities, their strength has reached tier-three.
This squad is entirely unmatched by those in Jianghai Base City, which consists of squads formed by tier-two Evolvers.
In the highest commander’s view, this time, with the assistance of the Sky Squad, perhaps they can completely eliminate the Corpse King.
When that moment comes, Jianghai Base City will break free from its shackles, no longer having to be on edge like now.

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 241: The Third Harvest!
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 241: The Third Harvest!
Farm, a piece of land beside the vegetable field, an open area.
"Are you really sure you want to try?"
Lu Chuan looked at Zhao Lin in front of him and wrote on the paper.
Just now, after learning about Zhao Lin’s idea from Little Qiqi, Lu Chuan was quite surprised and wondered what kind of madness this woman was up to.
After all, she had just been released for a few days and was already thinking about battle. Is it because she’s itchy from being inactive for so long, wanting to find a fight?
"Yes, Lu Chuan. I’ve recently improved my strength, so I want to find an opponent to practice with. Your Evolved Zombie is just right."
Facing the inquiry of the Corpse King, Zhao Lin responded honestly.
"Yes, Dad, Mrs. Zhao Lin has improved her strength and just needs an opponent. Dad, please help her!"
Ji Ruxue tugged at Lu Chuan’s hand, shaking it, and chimed in.
Ji Ruxue naturally agreed with Zhao Lin’s idea. It’s not enough to just improve one’s realm; practical combat skills need to keep up too!
If one only has the realm without practical combat experience, it’s like being crippled, making it difficult to go far on the path of evolution.
"Okay, but my Evolved Zombie won’t hold back during combat. If you get hurt in the end, don’t blame me."
Upon hearing, Lu Chuan’s lips slightly curled up and agreed on paper.
This woman wants to fight, which is perfect; I can also use it as a tool to hone my skills in swordsmanship and combat techniques.
"Thank you very much."
Seeing Lu Chuan agree, Zhao Lin felt a surge of joy and quickly expressed her gratitude.
Lu Chuan nodded, then moved his mind, swish, a figure swiftly rushed over from the distance.
In the blink of an eye, Lightning One appeared before them.
Looking at the dangerously exuding Lightning One, Zhao Lin’s face turned solemn, body tense, hands grasping tactical knives, entering a battle-ready state.
Afterward, Lu Chuan led Little Qiqi aside, leaving the battlefield open.
In the next moment, Lu Chuan took control of Lightning One, roared, and shot out explosively; the steel knife in his hand tore through the air, slashing towards Zhao Lin.
The piercing knife light flashed overhead, making Zhao Lin’s skin sting.
Zhao Lin’s gaze sharpened, tightly gripping her tactical knife, charged forward against the blade light, fearless and indomitable.
Instantly, the two figures collided.
Clang!
With an ear-piercing sound of metallic collision, Zhao Lin forcefully blocked Lightning One’s steel knife with her knife, her body shivered, but she managed to stabilize herself.
Subsequently, Zhao Lin swiftly veered to the side; the knife in her left hand, quicker than lightning, fiercely swung towards Lightning One, cold light sprang forth.
Bang!
At the critical moment, the steel knife in Lightning One’s hand returned in defense, effortlessly blocking the strike.
Then, the agile body fiercely rammed Zhao Lin, directly sending her flying backward with no time to react, mouth letting out a muffled groan of pain.
Next, seizing the momentum, Lightning One advanced, body like a bolt, in the blink of a leap only a shadow could be seen.
Stabilizing her footing, Zhao Lin’s face was pale, yet displayed a fierce glow; fearing not Lightning One, with tactical knife and nimble movements, she collided with Lightning One continuously.
Clang clang clang~
The two clashed intensely, a series of ear-piercing collision sounds echoed.
Nevertheless, despite reaching Tier 3, Zhao Lin, with her current combat power, still wasn’t a match for Lightning One; as the fight dragged on, she was suppressed by Lightning One’s impenetrable steel blade.
Bang!
A moment later, Zhao Lin, with several scratches on her, mistakenly allowed Lightning One’s fast-as-lightning body to slam directly into her chest.
Ah~
Zhao Lin managed only a cry of pain before her body was violently sent flying backward under immense force, crashing heavily to the ground, rolling several times before finally stopping.
Though Lightning One’s evolution wasn’t power-focused, in terms of physical attributes, it was still beyond what Zhao Lin, having just entered Tier 3 as an Evolver, could rival.
After defeating Zhao Lin, Lightning One was stopped under Lu Chuan’s control.
At this time, looking at Zhao Lin lying on the ground, Lu Chuan was somewhat surprised by her strength; compared to her time in Jiangnan City District, it had increased significantly!
Hundreds of meters away, Zhao Lin struggled to get up, complexion pale, blood seeping at the corner of her mouth, disheveled hair making her look rather ragged.
Zhao Lin wiped the blood from her mouth, her gaze directed at Lightning One standing there, her eyes still filled with battle intent.
Clearly, the recent defeat hadn’t affected her.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, are you alright? You’re already injured, I think you should stop fighting."
Seeing Zhao Lin still eager to fight, Ji Ruxue quickly persuaded.
Training in combat skills is a good thing, but don’t overstrain yourself beyond recovery!
"Kill!"
Unexpectedly, Zhao Lin roared and charged again, like a battle maniac, her tactical knife aiming at Lightning One.
Since she still wants to fight, I’ll accompany her to the end.
Seeing this, Lu Chuan smiled and didn’t hold back, directly controlling Lightning One to meet her charge.
In an instant, the two were locked in another battle; although Zhao Lin repeatedly retreated under Lightning One’s elusive figure and Unrivaled knife techniques, she persisted in resisting fiercely.
Both at this moment viewed each other as training tools.
A few minutes later, the dense sounds of collision in the air finally ceased.
The furiously battling Zhao Lin lay powerlessly on the ground, chest heaving heavily, breathing roughly, body marked with numerous wounds, albeit not deep, already staining her clothes red.
While Lightning One remained like a pine, standing on the battlefield, only some barely noticeable bloody marks on its body.
"This woman really is crazy!"
The high-intensity battle left Lu Chuan mentally exhausted; he shook his head helplessly, looking at Zhao Lin lying on the ground.
In the afternoon.
The farm gates opened wide, a convoy drove out from within, speeding towards Jiangnan City District.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, Tyrant One opened the gates.
Looking at the hundreds of zombies in the stadium, Lu Chuan’s eyes revealed satisfaction.
Finally ready to start harvesting the third batch of Evolved Zombies.
As usual, first controlling some Tier 1 Evolved Zombies to walk out of the stadium, then Tyrant One and several Corpse Puppets rushed in for slaughter, extracting all the Tier 1 Crystal Cores.
Afterward, through the Tier 1 Crystal Cores, evolve Tier 2 zombies, retrieve the Tier 2 Crystal Cores, and give them to accompanying Tier 2 Corpse Puppets to consume...
Finally, Lu Chuan obtained a total of ten Tier 3 Crystal Cores.
No hesitation, an excited Lu Chuan immediately controlled the convoy to bring the Tier 3 Crystal Cores back to the farm.
On the farm, after consecutively giving the Tier 3 Crystal Cores to Lightning One, Flame Two, and Da Pang to consume, Lu Chuan successfully obtained three Tier 4 Evolved Corpse Puppets again.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 242: Sky Squad’s Confidence
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 242: Sky Squad’s Confidence
Jianghai Base City.
Inner City, inside the conference room.
At this moment, the central large conference table was already filled with people.
The surroundings were very quiet.
This meeting was discussing the topic concerning the Zombie King.
Due to the seriousness of the matter, the top officials of the Base City were all present, and all seven members of the Sky Squad, the main actors of the operation, were invited to attend.
"Captain Lin, here is all the information about the Zombie King in the Jiangnan City District, including several failed cases by our Base City against the Zombie King, which are much more detailed compared to what was previously submitted.
You can look at it, get an overview of the situation, it will help with the upcoming action."
The highest commander handed a thick pile of documents to Captain Lin on his right, speaking politely.
Whether this extermination of the Zombie King would succeed or not, the Base City still had to rely on the Sky Squad.
Therefore, the intelligence collected by the Base City was very detailed, documenting all sorts of anomalies that had occurred in the Jiangnan City District over this period.
"Alright, sir, please give me a little time."
Captain Lin nodded, then pulled the documents in front of him and quickly reviewed them.
The conference room was now silent, everyone was quietly waiting for Captain Lin to finish reading.
After a few moments of looking through the documents in his hand, Captain Lin’s expression changed slightly, as if he had seen something surprising.
Then, unexpectedly, his brow furrowed, and his expression grew serious.
Ten minutes later, after finishing reviewing the documents, Captain Lin raised his head and looked around at everyone.
At this moment, the others were also watching Captain Lin, puzzled by his recent emotional change.
"Sir, I have gone over this information, and I think... the entity inside Jiangnan City District might not be the Zombie King, you may have misjudged."
Captain Lin frowned, looking towards the highest commander, expressing his doubt.
"Not the Zombie King? How can that be?"
Astonishment swept over the room, and all the top officials looked at Captain Lin in disbelief.
How could it not be the Zombie King? That girl’s behavior was no different from the legendary Zombie King that could control zombies!
Even the highest commander had a slight change of expression upon hearing this, his eyebrows furrowing.
However, he quickly found his composure, looking at Captain Lin, asking slowly, "Captain Lin, you’re from the Imperial Capital, so you should be more familiar with the Zombie King. Since you have doubts, we are all ears, please elaborate."
With the command from the highest commander, the previously noisy top officials instantly fell silent, frowning, and focusing on Captain Lin, waiting for his explanation.
"Sir, the reason I say this is naturally because I have reasons, for example, the Zombie King in the Imperial Capital seems very much afraid of dying, never showing up, always hiding in the shadows.
And even though the Zombie King possesses significant intelligence, it would never engage in such ’driving, transporting supplies, farming’—a series of human activities... Therefore, what’s in the Jiangnan City District shouldn’t be the Zombie King.
Moreover, as for that little girl who is suspected to be the Zombie King, I suspect she may have awakened an extraordinary Corpse Control ability, and like the Zombie King, she can control other zombies.
The girl’s true identity should be an Evolver, so under her control, the zombies displayed some behaviors unique to humans."
Captain Lin nodded at the highest commander, then explained the reason behind his judgment based on his understanding, also speculating on the girl’s possible identity.
An Evolver? The ability to control zombies?
Hearing Captain Lin’s analysis, the highest commander’s expression moved slightly, considering the high possibility.
After all, as Captain Lin just said, the Zombie King in the Imperial Capital did not demonstrate human behaviors, which indicates that the unusual behaviors of the zombies in the Jiangnan City District could not have been controlled by the Zombie King.
Since it is not the Zombie King, then the only one capable of controlling zombies would be an Evolver who has awakened relevant powers.
The other top officials, after hearing Captain Lin’s analysis, were also taken aback, and upon careful consideration, found it to be quite accurate.
At this point, Captain Lin’s eyes gleamed as he suggested to the highest commander, "Sir, as for this operation against the little girl, I believe we should strive to capture her alive, her abilities are simply too unique.
If we could subdue her, not only could we use her to research the secrets of the Zombie King’s ability to control zombies, but perhaps, when dealing with other Zombie Kings in the future, she would also provide incredible advantages."
Captain Lin was obviously very interested in the little girl, who could control zombies, essentially a Zombie King with human intellect!
If they could subdue her, humans might even incite a Corpse Tide in the future, launching assaults on other Zombie Kings, continuously weakening the zombies.
Upon hearing this, the highest commander quickly reminded, "Captain Lin, this little girl is quite formidable, your squad must not underestimate her, capturing her alive will be extremely challenging."
Having suffered repeated setbacks from the little girl, the highest commander dared not underestimate her at all; her apparent strength was already beyond what Jianghai Base City could handle, and in the shadows, who knew what other tricks she might have.
"Rest assured, sir! With Sky Squad on the job, this little girl will definitely not escape the grasp of Base City."
Captain Lin patted his chest and smiled as he spoke.
In his view, given the Sky Squad’s makeup, capturing an Evolver of ordinary status should be a breeze.
"Exactly, sir, our Sky Squad consists entirely of Flying-type Evolvers, there won’t be any problems."
"That’s right, although that little girl has Corpse Control abilities and various other means, she can’t do anything to us."
"That Fire-breathing Zombie might be a bit troublesome, but the Imperial Capital has long developed special Fireproof Battle Suits capable of resisting the Fire-breathing Zombie’s damage. With the threat of the Fire-breathing Zombie eliminated, that little girl is just a lamb waiting to be slaughtered."
"Heh heh, this time, we’re sure to succeed with ease."
"..."
Members of the Sky Squad also voiced one by one, all brimming with confidence.
Since they were all Flying-type Evolvers, they naturally had the upper hand. Whether it was the Evolved Zombies under the girl’s control or the mysterious Bloodthirsty Demon Vine, they couldn’t do anything against them.
Having such an innate advantage, what was there to worry about?
Seeing the Sky Squad so confident, the highest commander decided not to say anything discouraging.
"In that case, let us wish for the success of our operation to eliminate this significant threat to Jianghai Base City!"
The highest commander nodded, smiled, and motivated the Sky Squad.
"Rest assured, sir, the Sky Squad guarantees to complete the mission!"
The entire Sky Squad stood up, saluting confidently, responding in unison.

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 243: The Highest Commander’s Concern
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 243: The Highest Commander’s Concern
Jianghai Base City, located in the Inner City’s military airport.
At this moment, a large number of people have gathered on the wide concrete ground, creating an extremely lively scene.
Several armed helicopters are parked not far away, with quite a few personnel below loading munitions into the missile pods.
Today is the day when the Sky Squad heads to Jiangnan City District to carry out their mission.
This time, in order to ensure complete eradication of the threat in Jiangnan City District.
Besides the Sky Squad, which is the mainstay of this operation, the Supreme Commander has also deployed three fully armed Elite Squads to assist in the operation.
At the same time, to guard against the more troublesome Corpse Tide, the three Elite Squads have brought a large amount of hot weapons.
At this moment, the Supreme Commander is engaging in brief pleasantries with Captain Lin and others, repeatedly giving instructions.
Although it’s been almost confirmed that this Zombie King incident is a misunderstanding, an Evolver who can control zombies is not to be taken lightly, even the Imperial Capital has to pay attention.
The opponent appears to be a harmless little girl, but the danger is actually significant.
Even though the Supreme Commander has confidence in the Sky Squad, he couldn’t help but give a few pointers, advising them to be cautious and not underestimate the enemy.
Buzz buzz buzz~
At this time, the other three Elite Squads have already boarded the armed helicopters, which are slowly ascending to the sky, hovering at a height of ten zhang, waiting for the Sky Squad and others below.
"Commander, then I will head out first!"
Captain Lin, with a serious expression, saluted the Supreme Commander, followed closely by his six team members.
"Captain Lin, make sure to return safely! I’m here at the Base City waiting for your triumphant news!"
The Supreme Commander nodded and said solemnly.
As long as the Sky Squad can deal with the little girl who can control zombies this time, they will no longer need to worry in Jianghai Base City.
The ability to control zombies poses a huge threat to Jianghai Base City, and in the Supreme Commander’s view, if the opponent harbors hostility, the threat could be greater than a Zombie King.
After all, a Zombie King lacks human intelligence, whereas the opponent does not.
"Rest assured, Commander, just wait for our good news!"
Captain Lin said earnestly.
This time, if they can capture the little girl and bring her back to the Imperial Capital, their Sky Squad will certainly achieve great merit, so he will not allow the operation to fail.
"Head out!"
Subsequently, Captain Lin turned around and gave orders to the six team members behind him.
"Yes!"
As soon as the words fell, one brawny team member with a beard transformed into a giant eagle, rapidly soaring into the sky, letting out a cry, flapping its wings, and heading toward the helicopters in the sky.
At the moment of impact with the helicopter, the giant eagle suddenly transformed to the size of a normal hawk and flew into the helicopter.
Following closely, two team members who looked similar and likely brothers exchanged a glance, emanated blue light all over, and instantly elementalized, turning into two dazzling flame streams, quickly gliding across the sky and entering the helicopter.
Then, they returned to their human forms and sat down inside the helicopter.
The remaining three team members, each displayed their abilities, with one being surrounded by a green stream of wind, instantly flying into the high sky, and another flashed and flew directly into the helicopter...
Below, Captain Lin saluted the Supreme Commander and others once again.
The next moment, a ripping sound of fabric came from his back, and a pair of wings covered with dense black scales stretched out, flapping strongly, creating a sonic boom, and Captain Lin shot into the helicopter like Lightning.
"The abilities of Evolvers are truly bizarre and varied, even among these seven people in the Sky Squad, their flying capabilities are all so diverse!"
Watching this scene, the Supreme Commander couldn’t help but make a remark.
Buzz buzz buzz~
After everyone boarded, several helicopters swiftly flew towards the distance.
Watching the helicopters gradually fade away, for some reason, the Supreme Commander felt a sense of foreboding.
I hope everything goes smoothly...
The flight formation consisting of five armed helicopters soon flew out of the area where Jianghai Base City is located and entered the wilderness.
Looking around, outside there were only barren fields and ruins, abandoned vehicles, desolate villages, collapsed houses...
Gazing at everything below, Captain Lin turned his head, instructing the six team members on the helicopter, "Everyone, take a rest; there will be another battle waiting for you next."
"Okay, Captain!"
Upon hearing this, the team members nodded, and a few of them, after drinking water, leaned back in their seats and closed their eyes to rest.
However, the two seated next to Captain Lin did not rest; upon seeing their captain reading the information provided by Jianghai Base City, they also leaned over and looked at it with interest.
This mission’s target is an Evolver capable of controlling zombies, and the members of the Sky Squad were quite curious about this little girl, as the ability to control zombies had never been heard of, even in the Imperial Capital.
"Captain, do you think the intelligence from Jianghai Base City is true?"
The short-haired young man with transformative abilities asked somewhat dubiously.
In his view, zombies driving, farming, and such things really sounded too far-fetched and unreliable.
If this intelligence hadn’t come from Jianghai Base City, no one would believe it, and it would even be thought of as a prank.
"...I don’t know, but Jianghai Base City shouldn’t be joking about this."
Carefully reviewing the intelligence in hand, Captain Lin frowned slightly and, upon hearing the short-haired young man’s question, paused and replied.
He previously deduced that the little girl was an Evolver with the ability to control zombies based on the intelligence provided by Jianghai Base City.
And if the intelligence from Jianghai Base City was incorrect, all previous analyses and speculations would have to be overturned and everything would suddenly become complex.
However, in Captain Lin’s view, the possibility of Jianghai Base City openly falsifying information is slim; they probably don’t have the nerve nor the necessity.
Because if such a thing were discovered, Jianghai Base City from top to bottom would undoubtedly be completely overhauled.
Captain Lin really couldn’t figure out what benefit there would be for them in doing such a thing.
After a moment of silence, Captain Lin continued, "Of course, if the intelligence is true, then we must capture this little girl alive this time.
Such an unprecedented ability, our squad must ensure her safe delivery to the Imperial Capital."

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 244: Another Night Raid!
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 244: Another Night Raid!
The helicopter fleet dispatched from the Jianghai Base City is swiftly heading towards the Jiangnan City District.
Meanwhile, inside the farm.
Ji Ruxue is sitting at the table, having lunch.
Potatoes stewed with beef, the beef from a second-stage mutated Giant Bull, contains rich energy, which is very beneficial for Ji Ruxue’s daily cultivation.
At this moment, Lu Chuan, who had finished cooking, walked over, extended his hand, and carefully placed a box of dark green embroidery needles on the table and slowly pushed them towards Ji Ruxue.
"Dad, what is this?"
Ji Ruxue was stunned, glanced at the somewhat peculiar embroidery needles in the box, and asked, puzzled.
For training her telekinesis control, hadn’t Dad already specially collected a large number of embroidery needles and iron nails for her?
They were enough for her to use for a long time.
Now, why is he giving another box, and these embroidery needles in the box seem a bit off, giving her an extremely dangerous feeling.
Lu Chuan’s face turned serious; hearing Little Qiqi’s inquiry, he quickly wrote on paper: "Little Qiqi, these are poison needles Dad prepared for you, containing very dangerous toxins extracted from third-stage mutated fierce beasts.
After you take them, make sure to be extremely careful, don’t end up hurting yourself. You can only take them out in crucial moments, understand?"
This box of embroidery needles was repeatedly soaked using the venom sac of the previous third-stage mutated Giant Python until the deadly toxin fully permeated the needle’s interior.
So even though this box of embroidery needles may seem insignificant, once Little Qiqi uses telekinesis control to shoot them all out.
At that time, these needle tips can be considered deadly, extremely dangerous.
Poison needles?
And toxins of third-stage mutated fierce beasts?
Upon hearing Dad’s words, Ji Ruxue felt a surge of joy in her heart.
This is a great thing; ordinary embroidery needles and iron nails, while useful, can only deal with some ordinary enemies.
Once faced with those large-sized and robust enemies, Ji Ruxue might find it challenging to deal with them.
But with these poison-soaked embroidery needles, everything would be different; if the poison is strong enough, it can affect the enemy’s state the moment their defense is broken.
With the poison-soaked embroidery needles taken from third-stage mutated fierce beasts, there’s a good chance of a one-hit kill against third-stage entities.
If it’s a fourth-stage, though not lethal, it would certainly disrupt its state.
"Thank you, Dad, I’ll be careful!"
Ji Ruxue smiled, thanked him, then carefully closed the box of embroidery needles and held it.
Lu Chuan nodded.
Although Little Qiqi possesses telekinesis control, the time is too short; she hasn’t matured yet, and her strength is still weak.
Especially in attack power; if encountering strong enemies, Little Qiqi’s means would struggle to pose a threat.
But with the poison needles, Little Qiqi could exploit telekinesis control to possibly defeat the strong while being weak.
Next, Lu Chuan, fearing that Little Qiqi wouldn’t take it seriously, repeatedly cautioned her to be extremely careful not to hurt herself.
Ji Ruxue could only obediently nod continuously.
Time ticked by, and night fell.
In the amusement park, under the slide, Zhao Lin sat cross-legged on the bed, eyes closed, focusing her mind, operating the "Nine Elements Pulse Refining Technique" to absorb energy factors from all directions into her meridians.
These surging energies, under the guidance of the cultivation technique, constantly flowed within the meridians, refining and nourishing them, making the meridians broader and tougher.
Feeling a tingling sensation from inside to outside her body, Zhao Lin frowned slightly, but she didn’t open her eyes and continued to maintain the technique’s operation.
As time progressed, the aura emanating from Zhao Lin started to rise at a visibly slow pace.
Energy factors from all directions continuously flowed in, enabling Zhao Lin to persistently operate her cultivation technique.
At the same moment, Ji Ruxue was also cultivating in her room; when the night was quiet, without disturbance, it was the best time for focusing on cultivation.
Just like usual, she continuously absorbed energy factors from the outside world into her body.
At this moment, Ji Ruxue was sitting cross-legged, motionless, evidently immersed in cultivation.
Suddenly, a faint noise drifted into the room from the black cover of night, catching Ji Ruxue’s attention.
Her eyes snapped open; her expression instantly turned solemn, and she furrowed her brow.
Such a familiar sound!
"Uh-oh!"
She instantly spotted a series of red dots in the distant sky, flying towards the farm.
Buzzzzz~
Upon hearing the familiar sound, Ji Ruxue knew, of course, what it was — human helicopters, and not just one; with a rough glance, there were at least three.
There’s no need to guess; this is the human Base City coming for revenge.
The last time, the farm destroyed three elite squads from the human Base City; they hadn’t given up, evidently.
High in the sky, five armed helicopters swiftly approached, and their speed was astonishing.
Such a commotion naturally also alerted Zhao Lin, who was cultivating in the amusement park.
Stunned by the sight of the five armed helicopters not far away, Zhao Lin hurriedly shouted towards the house behind her: "Lu Chuan, Little Qiqi, we have trouble, come out quickly!"
"Five helicopters, enemy attack, hurry and get prepared!"
With so many helicopters arriving at once, Zhao Lin immediately understood the severity; the evolvers dispatched by humans this time are certainly more than last time.
The most important thing now is to quickly alert Little Qiqi and the Corpse King, ensuring they’re prepared, preventing them from being caught off guard by these human evolvers.
"Got it, Mrs. Zhao Lin, stop shouting, hurry and hide, don’t just stand there!"
Ji Ruxue looked at Zhao Lin, who was shouting loudly in the amusement park, feeling speechless and immediately issued a loud reminder.
This woman just stands there with such a loud noise, basically acting like a target, isn’t she? Or are you afraid the humans won’t shoot at you?
Ji Ruxue already observed that those approaching helicopters were armed, with pods underneath.
And now it’s not the latter days of apocalypse; given Zhao Lin’s current condition, a few rockets would probably blast her to pieces.
Upon hearing Little Qiqi’s shout, Zhao Lin realized, cursed herself for being foolish, and quickly started moving to find a hiding spot.
And when Lu Chuan heard the commotion and came out of the house, five armed helicopters had already approached the farm above.
The deafening buzzing echoed across the farm’s sky, as gusts of wind rushed in from the front, producing a continuous howling.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 245: The Farm Gets Bombed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 245: The Farm Gets Bombed!
"It’s a helicopter!"
"Humans again! It seems the human Base City hasn’t given up on destroying us!"
Watching the five helicopters flying in, Lu Chuan’s expression changed, feeling a heaviness in his heart while also a surge of uncontrollable anger.
These human Evolvers truly fear nothing!
I had only slain over a dozen of them, and now they’re rushing in again to die.
But, seeing the unclear situation, Lu Chuan didn’t go on the offensive recklessly.
After all, this time they’ve come with five helicopters, and he didn’t know the strength and number of Evolvers inside.
There’s a chance some might be fourth-rank Evolvers.
Quickly, Lu Chuan decided, maneuvering Lightning One to rush to Little Qiqi’s side, standing by and ready to whisk her away at any moment.
At Lightning One’s current speed, it could easily dodge bullets.
No matter what danger Little Qiqi encounters next, Lightning One can take her away instantly without a scratch.
Earth Escape One also arrived beside him, staying close by to ensure everything goes without a hitch.
If the battle seems unwinnable, he wouldn’t be foolish and would prepare for a temporary retreat.
Then, Lu Chuan saw Zhao Lin running towards the house.
However, he didn’t plan to intervene.
Let her look after herself!
If Lu Chuan’s side wins this battle, and Zhao Lin isn’t caught in the crossfire, she’ll naturally survive.
But if the human side proves strong, Lu Chuan can only abandon Zhao Lin and make a quick escape with Little Qiqi.
However, since Zhao Lin is human, if captured by the human side, as long as she insists she was taken by the Corpse King, she might not be in mortal danger.
Anyway, this one can keep reviving, so dying isn’t much of an issue.
Buzz buzz buzz~
In the sky, the helicopter squad was advancing, with the Sky Squad at the forefront of the armed helicopters.
Captain Lin, wearing night vision goggles, observed the farm below.
The first thing that caught his eye was the vast number of Evolved Zombies, primarily first and second rank, patrolling back and forth through the farm.
