"So many Evolved Zombies! No wonder the materials stated all the Evolved Zombies from Jiangnan Base City mysteriously disappeared. Seems they’ve all been gathered by this Evolver!"
Seeing so many Evolved Zombies, Captain Lin was a bit astonished.
Gathering all these Evolved Zombies here without causing chaos clearly indicates there’s an entity capable of controlling them.
If the information from Jianghai Base City is true, and the zombies are driving cars and transporting supplies, it shows the entity behind, that little girl, is likely an Evolver.
Of course, it’s even more likely there are other Evolvers here.
After all, a little girl wouldn’t be driving.
Thinking deeply, the situation here seemed more complex.
But if the data from Jianghai Base City was wrong, Captain Lin still thought the likelihood of a Corpse King was greater.
And then, what Lin saw next made him immediately reach a conclusion in his heart.
The vegetable garden!
He couldn’t quite believe his eyes; patches of lush green vegetable gardens appeared before him.
These gardens were neatly arranged, the vegetables growing well, and no trace of weeds, clearly tended to regularly and certainly not abandoned.
The entity behind must be a human Evolver indeed!
Unexpectedly, there truly exists a special talent ability to control zombies!
A flash of insight passed through Captain Lin’s eyes.
Confirming the little girl as an Evolver, the team’s next mission was to capture her alive.
Such uniquely talented Evolvers are only useful when alive.
Once dead, they’re just useless corpses.
Thinking about this, Captain Lin’s lips curled slightly, already imagining the successful capture of the little girl.
"Captain, look at that zombie!"
"That Evolved Zombie, definitely reached fourth rank, the bulk..."
Just then, a young man with a crew-cut beside him pointed to a position on the farm below, exclaiming.
What he saw was Er Pang holding a metal club, in the dark appearing like an ancient beast lurking in the night, instilling fear.
Lin Captain snapped out of it, looking in the pointed direction, and upon seeing the zombie, his expression grew tense.
Fourth rank, definitely fourth rank!
Against fourth rank Evolved Zombies, any common third-rank Evolver would just be fodder.
Luckily, they had the Sky Squad this time; without flying capabilities, dealing with fourth-rank zombies is extremely difficult.
Previously, he had doubted the reports about fourth-rank Evolved Zombies, but now it turned out to be true.
This Evolver has developed well, able to control fourth-rank Evolved Zombies.
Squinting slightly, Captain Lin harbored some concern about the upcoming capture operation.
He couldn’t help but recall the highest command’s warnings before departure...
Capturing this guy alive next might not be so simple.
Then, Captain Lin saw Zhao Lin running towards the house, but felt no surprise.
The reports mentioned a woman in the farm; since the farm was under human Evolvers’ control, extra human women weren’t strange.
Perhaps this person is a relative of the little girl or maybe taken in by the compassionate little girl as a human survivor.
"Captain, what’s next? Should we rush down and have a good fight?"
Having crossed over the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine’s walls, the crew-cut youth eagerly asked, looking impatient.
"The little girl hasn’t appeared yet. First, handle the surrounding Evolved Zombies!"
Captain Lin looked at the dense cluster of Evolved Zombies below, frowning, and gave the order.
Though most of these Evolved Zombies are first and second rank, their sheer numbers could interfere with the capture mission.
Though unable to harm the squad, they can delay and disrupt attacks.
"Okay!"
In the next moment, five armed helicopters opened fire simultaneously, launching streams of light and rockets toward the surrounding Evolved Zombies.
At the same time, boxes filled with military grenades were opened on the helicopters, and grenades rained down.
Boom boom boom~
Instantly, continuous explosions rose to the sky as deafening blasts shook the entire farm’s ground vigorously.
The rockets and grenades exploded within the zombie horde like giant fireballs.
The center zombies, both first and second rank, were blown to bits, leaving no trace.
The surrounding Zombies were shattered by the force, body parts flying everywhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 246: Lu Chuan’s Wrath
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 246: Lu Chuan’s Wrath
The deafening explosions finally subsided, and in an instant, the whole world seemed to fall silent, leaving only the humming roar of the helicopter formation overhead.
After the explosion, the farm was in chaos, with the scorched, burning ground covered in charred remains and fragments, resembling a scene from hell.
In the post-apocalyptic world, the incredibly precious vegetable plots were completely destroyed. The vegetables were blasted out of sight, leaving only smoking craters in their place.
The orchard behind the house wasn’t spared either, having been showered with rocket fire, leaving the scene in disarray. Not a single fruit tree was intact, with many broken trees ablaze and emitting flames.
However, the target of the Sky Squad was to capture Ji Ruxue alive, so they didn’t bomb the residential area at the center during the attack.
Only the first and second-level evolved zombies patrolling the perimeter suffered devastating losses, with more than half lost in an instant. A small number of third-level Corpse Puppets were also damaged, but the situation wasn’t severe, with mostly minor injuries.
The fourth-level zombies like Tyrant One were unharmed. Tyrant One, Er Pang, and other Corpse Puppets, though caught in the initial bombing, had exceptionally strong physical defenses, making the power of grenades and rocket launchers ineffective against them.
Meanwhile, the Corpse Puppets like Flame One, which were physically weaker, remained inside the residential area, shielded by the Tank Type zombies and thus unaffected.
"Damn it, my farm!"
Inside, Lu Chuan was furious upon seeing the destroyed farm, wishing to rush out and curse the attackers vociferously.
The hard-earned farm he’d meticulously managed was ruined by these bastards.
The vegetables in those plots were invaluable in the apocalypse, and now they’ve been blown away.
Lu Chuan felt a pang in his heart.
In the bedroom next door, Ji Ruxue was equally angry, clenching her fists tightly.
This farm was a haven for her and her father, and now it was wrecked by the enemy.
Even if she and her father could kill those damned people, whether the farm could be restored to its original state was uncertain.
Especially the vegetable plots and orchards, which couldn’t be restored quickly; destruction was easy, reconstruction was hard.
In the coming period, she and Zhao Lin would have trouble even getting a bite of fresh vegetables.
"Dare to destroy the farm, you’ve completely enraged me!"
Ji Ruxue watched the brazen helicopter formation above, a murderous intent stirring within her, exuding intense coldness.
Since they dared to destroy the farm, they must pay with their lives.
Outside, Zhao Lin, who had successfully reached the eaves of the house, wore the most severe expression as she gazed at the scorched playground and her burning bed, trembling with fear.
The explosion had barely missed her; if she’d been a step slower, she might have been killed by those people above.
She still had great ambitions to achieve and didn’t want to die senselessly, especially not at the hands of humans.
Moreover, this farm was her utopia, a place she’d already considered home.
But now, these people had wrecked it.
Blowing up her house, how could she possibly be in a good mood now?
Whirrrrr~
The helicopter formation had been hovering above for a long while, its screeching roar seeming like a loud taunt by the Human Base City at the farm.
Inside the helicopter.
Looking at the scorched earth below, everyone was highly satisfied.
"Captain, the effect is significant, the corpse tide is basically destroyed and won’t hinder our next actions. However, the recent attacks didn’t seem very effective on the higher-level evolved zombies."
The crew-cut youth, observing the scene below, reported swiftly.
Seeing the third and fourth-level evolved zombies still lively below, Captain Lin’s eyes showed a trace of gravity.
He had witnessed the bombing; these zombies had incredible defense.
Normal thermal weapons were effective only against lower-level evolved zombies in the corpse tide. The third and fourth-level evolved zombies had developed a significant resistance to thermal weapons.
However, when ordering the bombing, he didn’t expect to solve all problems at once.
These remaining few third and fourth-level evolved zombies would require the personal intervention of their Evolutionary Squad.
Moreover, capturing that little girl alive meant they had to eliminate all the third and fourth-level evolved zombies under control before succeeding.
"Alright, check your equipment immediately and prepare for action."
"Remember, try to capture them alive!"
Realizing the time was ripe, Captain Lin issued the command over the intercom.
Captain Lin definitely wanted to capture them alive, but the battlefield was unpredictable; if it proved impossible, they might only bring back a dead body.
"Yes!"
Everyone responded in unison.
The next moment, the Evolver on each armed helicopter, faces serious, began checking their gear. Meanwhile, the helicopter formation, which had been hovering in the air, started descending.
Led by the Sky Squad’s helicopter, followed by four others, they descended swiftly.
In an instant, the violent wind stirred by the helicopter rotors swept toward the farm, accompanied by a series of howling sounds.
The atmosphere was extremely tense, and a fierce battle was imminent.
Inside the farm.
After a brief moment of anger, Lu Chuan quickly calmed down, coldly watching the rapidly descending helicopter formation, his gaze fluctuating.
Now, with the battle upon them, it wasn’t the time to let anger cloud his judgment.
Although the opponent had hit them hard upon arrival, that was all.
As long as he had the fourth-level Corpse Puppets, these humans couldn’t do anything to him.
Moreover, the farm could be rebuilt, although it would take time, with the Corpse Puppets, he wasn’t afraid it couldn’t be restored.
In his view, the most important and crucial thing now was to ensure Little Qiqi and his own safety.
As long as they were alive, even if the farm was destroyed a hundred times, it didn’t matter.
However, since the farm was what Lu Chuan had painstakingly managed, and now it was destroyed, he naturally wouldn’t let them go.
If they dared to destroy his farm, he was determined to make them pay the price.
With a fierce glint in his eyes, Lu Chuan focused his mind, immediately commanding the fourth-level Corpse Puppets to gather in the residential area to prepare for battle.
The enemy had obviously not bombed the residential area because they wanted them alive.
Just right, today, I’ll make sure none of you escape!

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 247: Blaze Feast!
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 247: Blaze Feast!
The helicopter formation, resembling a long serpent, rapidly flew over.
Bang bang bang~
In an instant, the machine guns mounted on the five helicopters spewed fiery tongues, and a barrage of shells rained towards Er Pang and his group in the residential area.
Whoosh whoosh~
One shell after another came whistling in.
Lu Chuan’s gaze remained calm as he directed Da Pang, Er Pang, and other Tank Type zombies to raise their arms, which were like metal door panels, forming a wall of flesh shields, standing firm at the front of the residential area.
Boom~
In the blink of an eye, the barrage from the machine guns slammed into the shield wall, erupting into dazzling blasts of firelight while emitting a series of metallic collision sounds.
The five torrents of metal unleashed by the five armed helicopters had no effect on the shield wall, as Da Pang and the other Corpse Puppets stood unyielding, like an immovable mountain.
The defense of the fourth-tier Corpse Puppets was not something these machine guns could shake.
Seeing this, Lu Chuan’s lips curled slightly, and with a mere thought, Flame One and Flame Two, who were standing by behind the shield wall, sprang into action simultaneously.
For dealing with such flying targets, only remote Corpse Puppets like Flame One were the most effective.
Flame One and Flame Two, whose bodies seemed made of magma, suddenly burst into flames and completed their Flaming transformation, turning into two flame giants over three meters tall. The fiery blaze emitted endless light and heat, with waves of heat sweeping across the entire farm.
Lu Chuan, Ji Ruxue, and the others, being too close, could distinctly feel the burning heat stinging their faces as the waves of heat rolled in.
After transforming into two flame giants, the flames on Flame One and Flame Two began to spread along the ground, connecting with each other to form a sea of flames.
At this moment, the two Corpse Puppets stood in the middle of the blazing sea, appearing like two fire elves born from the inferno.
Roar~
With a skyward howl radiating endless ferocity, the two Corpse Puppets raised their hands almost simultaneously, confronting the incoming helicopter squadron.
In an instant, fiery balls each a meter in diameter shot out from the blaze like rising suns, streaking swiftly through the night towards the helicopter formation.
Particularly, the lead helicopter was the primary target of the assault.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh-
At this moment, the entire sky was as bright as day, with fireballs quickly closing in on the armed helicopters of the Sky Squad. The intense heat wave that preceded them caused the helicopters to falter mid-flight, swaying erratically while emitting creaking noises.
"Watch out!"
The rapidly approaching fireballs took the Sky Squad by surprise.
"Quick, we must leave, we can’t stay in the helicopters!"
Captain Lin roared, leaping from the cabin door. The black scaled wings on his back flapped frantically, swiftly pulling him away.
The other members of the Sky Squad also displayed their unique talents, quickly escaping from the helicopters.
However, the multitude of fireballs were too fast, and in an instant, they were upon them. The last member of the Sky Squad had just escaped the helicopter when countless fireballs collided violently.
"No!!!"
Boom!
Numerous fireballs crashed into the helicopter, exploding on impact. The member of the Sky Squad, unable to escape in time, let out a final, unwilling scream before being consumed entirely by the engulfing blaze, life extinguished.
At this moment, the massive explosion of fireballs, combined with the explosion of the helicopter, formed a gigantic fireball suspended in the sky above the farm, resembling a true sun, refusing to fade away.
The sudden change startled the following helicopters in the formation, causing them to quickly change direction to avoid the massive fireball. The pilots desperately tried to control the helicopters’ balance, attempting to keep them flying steadily.
Scattered in the sky, the Sky Squad watched in shock as a comrade perished before their eyes, disbelief evident in all their gazes.
Soon, their eyes reddened, and they were filled with rage.
"Kill! Make sure to destroy all the Fire-breathing Zombies for me!"
Flying high above, Captain Lin glared angrily at Flame One and Flame Two below, eyes filled with hatred.
In the next instant, the members of the Sky Squad launched a frantic assault.
Boom!
In an instant, members with Flaming Ability transformed into Firemen, faces full of murderous intent. They thrust their hands forward, unleashing a torrent of flames. The terrifying heat seemed to warp the surrounding space.
Simultaneously, other members displayed their talents, exerting every bit of their strength to avenge their fallen comrade.
Among them, Captain Lin suddenly let out a beast-like roar to the sky, wings stretching wide. His body underwent a dramatic transformation, finally morphing into a winged, humanoid creature covered in layers of black scale armor.
Then, Captain Lin let out a roar, swooping down with deadly black claws aimed at his enemies.
Meanwhile, blue Wind Blades zipped through the air, slicing the air with a tearing sound. Under the control of a Sky Squad member, these blades formed a Wind Blade Tornado surging downward.
A flat-headed young man with transformation abilities also turned into a giant black eagle, extending powerful, sturdy talons.
In an instant, no fewer than six lethal attacks converged towards Flame One and Flame Two, who were protected by Da Pang and the other Corpse Puppets below.
Rumble~
However, the collective assault had no effect on the wall of Tank Type zombies like Da Pang.
Whether the scorching torrents of flames or the Wind Blade Tornado like a meat grinder, they only left faint traces, slight scorching, and shallow blade marks on the bodies of Da Pang and the other Corpse Puppets.
And the physical attacks from Captain Lin and the others were exactly where Da Pang and the other Corpse Puppets excelled in defense.
After clashing, only a few metallic collision sounds echoed before Captain Lin and the others were blasted back by the powerful counterforce.
Nevertheless, the Sky Squad didn’t retreat but instead attacked even more ferociously. Confident in their aerial advantage, they believed victory was within grasp.
Unexpectedly, at this moment, Flame One and Flame Two, hiding behind Da Pang and the others, made their move again.
In an instant, flames shot to the sky, forming a colossal net of fire overhead. The fiery glow and waves of heat enveloped the Sky Squad still maneuvering in the air.
Faced with the terrifying power and resilience of the flaming net, the Sky Squad found themselves at a distinct disadvantage, continuously dodging to avoid being ensnared.
Captain Lin roared incessantly in the air, launching attacks on the fire net, but to little effect. His body was covered with burns and charred patches, yet he still couldn’t dent the massive fire net.
By the window, watching the Sky Squad in the sky, Ji Ruxue’s eyes gleamed coldly as a few embroidery needles appeared in her palm.
PS: It’s the author’s first time writing a post-apocalyptic novel. I know this book has many issues, so readers’ complaints are justified... I apologize to my readers.
Nevertheless, I will persist in completing it, culminating in roughly 1.2 million words. It’s also my first attempt at such a long piece.
Moreover, I probably won’t read comments anymore. I’m afraid I’ll lose my resolve, so I’ll just focus on writing quietly without distractions...

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 248: Killing Unseen
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 248: Killing Unseen
At this moment, the chaos over the farm was indescribable.
While flames filled the sky, countless other lights flickered inside. The explosive sounds from their collisions were incessant.
The Sky Squad was frantically fleeing from the overwhelming flames, in an extremely sorry state. Almost everyone was burned, and while dodging the flames, they still had to find a way to attack Flame One and Flame Two below.
Now, within this farm, only these two fire-breathing zombies were significantly restraining the Sky Squad. The flames made it impossible for them to stay in one place for too long, otherwise, the endless Fire Net would engulf them the next second.
If they could not eliminate the two fire-breathing zombies in a short time, the task of capturing the little girl could not proceed at all.
"Captain, this damn flame is impossible to deal with, and those Tank Type zombies are too bothersome. With them around, our attacks can’t even harm the fire-breathing zombies!"
"Captain, you need to make a decision quickly, otherwise this mission will very likely fail!"
The young man, transformed into a giant black hawk, was flapping his wings burnt black while avoiding the troublesome Fire Net, anxiously shouting to Captain Lin.
Facing the Fire Net’s pursuit, his combat power was only at seventy percent of its peak now, and if this stalemate continued, disaster would surely strike.
Suspended in mid-air, Captain Lin heard the words, his brows tightly furrowed. He understood the awkward situation without needing a reminder from others.
Facing the restraint of the two fire-breathing zombies, the Sky Squad had no way to handle them.
Especially since the opponent had fourth-tier Tank Type zombies as meat shields, even if they rushed forward, it was uncertain whether they could harm the fire-breathing zombies.
However, if they didn’t want to fail the mission, the current situation couldn’t continue any longer; they must find a way to break the stalemate.
Thinking for a moment, Captain Lin immediately instructed the young man dodging in mid-air loudly: "Quick! Notify the other squads to come down and assist, attack from all directions, and distract the Tank Type zombies’ attention for us!"
Only by letting the other three squads help to hold off the Tank Type zombies could they have a chance to kill the fire-breathing zombies.
"Yes!"
Upon receiving the order, the young man felt delighted, flapping his wings vigorously to avoid the Fire Net, and quickly leaving the battlefield to fly towards the helicopter squad in the rear.
At this time, the helicopter squad had just stabilized from the previous explosion, maintaining a relatively low altitude.
Seeing the precarious situation of the Sky Squad in the air, the other three Elite Squads, unsure of what to do next, immediately took action upon receiving the young man’s notification.
They quickly controlled the helicopters to land on the ground.
However, the three Elite Squads were aware of the formidable Bloodthirsty Demon Vine at the perimeter; once they got close, they’d surely be attacked, and with time being tight, now wasn’t the time to get entangled with the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine.
Therefore, the landing spots weren’t chosen near the Bloodthirsty Demon Vine but in an open area between the stone wall and vine wall.
Buzzing~
Within a few seconds, the helicopter squad had smoothly landed.
Subsequently, the three Elite Squads quickly jumped out of the helicopters, fully armed, with each squad moving in one direction, crossing the stone wall from three directions at high speed, heading towards the residential area.
"No, if this continues, we’ll be surrounded!"
Zhao Lin, who had been watching the battle closely, was initially pleased seeing the Sky Squad suppressed in the air, but now seeing the other squads surrounding them, she instantly became anxious.
Currently, the Corpse King had been held off by those guys in the sky.
If these people rushed in, they’d be in danger.
Even though she wasn’t weak, once the fighting started, she might not be able to take care of Little Qiqi.
"Little Qiqi, I’ll take you to break through!"
Zhao Lin anxiously looked at Little Qiqi by the window, about to come over and take her away.
"No, Mrs. Zhao Lin, breaking through now would make us targets!"
Ji Ruxue, with a serious expression, reached out to stop her, shaking her head decisively.
Though those third-tier Evolvers in the air are currently restrained by her father, Ji Ruxue can clearly sense that these people’s gaze remains fixed on the residential area.
If they dare to escape now, they’ll face not only the approaching Evolvers but also those seemingly extremely helpless third-tier Evolvers in the sky, who’d decisively disengage from the fight to attack them.
Their previous lack of attack on the residential area clearly indicated their intention to capture alive, so how could they possibly allow her to escape now?
Therefore, staying put is paradoxically the best choice.
Nevertheless, staying doesn’t mean Ji Ruxue can’t secretly intervene to resolve their current predicament.
"What do we do now!"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin also felt that Little Qiqi’s words made sense, but turning to see the rapidly approaching Evolvers, she was still exceedingly anxious.
If the opponent rushes up, she fears she won’t be able to stop them alone, especially given their firearms.
While anxious, Zhao Lin didn’t entertain thoughts of fleeing alone, instead she scanned the surrounding Evolvers closing in, showing a resolute expression.
No matter what, she wouldn’t let Little Qiqi get hurt!
Ji Ruxue glanced at her father, focusing on maneuvering zombies in battle, ensuring he wouldn’t notice this side.
Then, with a thought, several embroidery needles emitting chilling glimmer in her palm flew out instantly.
Under the cover of night and the blinding firelight, the extraordinarily tiny embroidery needles swiftly threaded through the air, drawing a long tail-like streak of light, as fast as Lightning.
Simultaneously, Ji Ruxue activated her Time Control Ability, an invisible force surged forth towards those Evolvers.
The next moment, the Elite Squad Evolvers in the forefront, before they could react, suddenly froze in place, unable to move an inch.
Just as panic surged within them, about to struggle, they felt a chill on their brows, as embroidery needles pierced directly, instantaneously extinguishing their consciousness.
Once the Power of Time dissipated, the bodies of these Evolvers crumbled to the ground powerlessly, lifeless.
"What happened? An ambush?"
This sudden change caused the Evolvers behind to pause, utterly terrified, no longer daring to advance easily.
They halted in place, gripping their guns, scanning their surroundings in fear searching for something.
In the air, Captain Lin, observing the progress of the three Elite Squads, was shocked and dismayed seeing this scene.
Upon scrutinizing closely, he didn’t discover the assailant at all, instantly shouting in a voice filled with anguish:
"Everyone be careful! There are enemies in the shadows!"

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 249: Father-Daughter Coordination!
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 249: Father-Daughter Coordination!
Ji Ruxue’s assassination techniques put the present Evolvers on high alert.
After all, in the blink of an eye, four Evolvers met their untimely deaths, and the scariest part was that the cause of death was completely unclear, with no idea where the assailant was.
Huh?
Hearing Captain Lin’s loud roar, Lu Chuan was slightly taken aback. He immediately followed the gaze and quickly spotted the four bodies lying on the ground not far away.
Dead?
Lu Chuan looked bewildered. He had originally planned to command the third-tier Corpse Puppets to intercept, so how had they suddenly been killed?
However, upon noticing the bloodstains between these people’s eyebrows, Lu Chuan immediately realized it was Little Qiqi who had acted.
Remarkable performance, taking out four enemies in one go.
Lu Chuan was gratified at heart, confirming that the training during this period was indeed not in vain.
In such chaotic battles, Little Qiqi’s abilities can be extraordinarily effective.
After all, those embroidery needles, one by one, were really too small to be noticed unless specifically paid attention to, especially when flying out.
The four Evolvers just killed suffered because of this, recklessly charging forward and ignoring the hidden dangers coming their way.
As long as the speed was fast enough, even when the embroidery needle reached their eyes, they wouldn’t notice it.
"Everyone, be careful! Don’t give the hidden attacker any opportunity!"
In the midst of entanglement with the Heaven-Covering Fire Net, Captain Lin once again reminded the disorganized Evolvers below.
However, this sudden change also dampened Captain Lin’s heart, erasing any previous confidence.
He had a premonition that this mission might be doomed.
No one expected another mysterious Evolver to be hiding in this farm, and judging by the power displayed by the assailant, their capability was certainly not weak.
To Captain Lin, the other party was at least a third-tier Evolver, with bizarre attacking abilities, hiding in the shadows. Such enemies are very troublesome, especially during such a major battle.
"Only daring to sneak attack from the shadows, come out and face me!"
"Sneaking attacks are no skill, come face us if you dare!"
"Everyone, be vigilant and find this guy..."
"..."
At this moment, the remaining eleven Evolvers were extremely cautious, fearing that the hidden attacker would target them at any moment.
Compared to opponents in the open, such hidden enemies are even more terrifying.
"No, Little Qiqi cannot be exposed!"
Seeing these Evolvers searching for the assassin, Lu Chuan naturally wouldn’t give them the chance, and with a thought, he commanded the remaining third-tier Corpse Puppets to attack.
Roar roar roar~
As seen, the third-tier Corpse Puppets like Lightning Two erupted with deafening roars, bursting towards the Evolvers.
"Not good! Everyone, be careful!"
Witnessing the assault of the third-tier Evolved Zombies, the remaining Evolvers were shocked, having no time to search for Little Qiqi, hastily raising their firearms to open fire on the oncoming Evolved Zombies.
Bam bam bam~
Instantly, dense gunfire sounded, a torrent of bullets and grenades unleashed, tracing countless fiery lines in the air.
Unfortunately, this kind of thermal weaponry posed too small a threat to the already third and fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, besides slightly halting their advances, it couldn’t inflict any real harm.
The tank-type Corpse Puppets like Da Pang have astonishing defense, those bullets could only emit sparks upon hitting, while the Corpse Puppets like Lightning Two moved so swiftly, they were simply uncatchable.
With extraordinary speed, in merely a few seconds, the Corpse Puppets reached the Evolvers, who then had no choice but to drop their firearms, employ their Talent Abilities, and retreat while fighting.
Rumble rumble~
In an instant, both sides collided, the third-tier Corpse Puppets barging around with their robust flesh.
The tank-type Corpse Puppets like Er Pang indeed resembled humanoid tanks, each step causing a thunderous rumble on the ground, each punch producing sonic booms.
The Corpse Puppets like Lightning One moved as fast as lightning, their claw blades ceaselessly slashing in the air, cold glints appearing rapidly while shrill tearing sounds echoed.
Those only second-tier Evolvers dared not engage them directly, dodging left and right, quite embarrassed.
The battle became increasingly chaotic, with relentless fighting above and turmoil below, naturally, creating a greater opportunity for Little Qiqi.
"I wonder if Little Qiqi can make the right judgment and strike decisively."
Silently steering the battle’s evolution, Lu Chuan’s gaze shifted.
However, Lu Chuan was unaware that with her rich experience from a past life, Ji Ruxue had a grasp on timing that was supremely perfect.
So, in the instant Lu Chuan maneuvered the third-tier Corpse Puppets, Ji Ruxue immediately knew what to do next,
At this moment, her attention was fully on those Evolvers scrambling from the Corpse Puppets, as a series of cold-glinting embroidery needles emerged in her palm again.
Ah!
Just then, a cry of pain resonated as an Evolver, struck by Lightning Two’s blinding blade light, had an arm severed, covering the stump hand while screaming, swaying, attempting to flee.
Ji Ruxue’s gaze turned sharp, and the embroidery needle in her hand flew out instantaneously.
Swish!
In the blink of an eye, the Evolver evading Lightning Two’s pursuit stiffened, rolling onto the ground lifelessly.
The other Evolvers, preoccupied with battling the Corpse Puppets, had no room to notice others. The fallen was assumed to have been killed by Evolved Zombies.
Afterward, Ji Ruxue repeated the action. Whenever an Evolver was injured by Evolved Zombies, she promptly delivered the final blow, sending them on their way.
Soon, several Evolvers died by Ji Ruxue’s hand, yet due to her concealed movements, the remaining Evolvers hadn’t realized that someone in the shadows was acting.
Bang!
At that moment, a third-tier Evolver, taking advantage of the situation, broke through the Heaven-Covering Fire Net’s blockade, a faint black light emanating from their body, flashing across hundreds of meters, racing towards the house wielding a forearm-length bayonet.
"It’s that little girl!"
The third-tier Evolver’s eyes lit up upon spotting Ji Ruxue in the window, then adjusted direction slightly, drawing closer.
"Let me face you!"
Unexpectedly, at that moment, Zhao Lin, having procured a steel knife from somewhere, rushed forward brimming with battle intent to confront him.
"Get lost!"
Seeing Zhao Lin, the Evolver was infuriated, with a flash of black light on their body, instantly reaching Zhao Lin, the bayonet in hand gleamed icily, thrusting out swiftly with intense killing intent.
"Kill!"
Unfazed, Zhao Lin forcefully swung the steel knife in hand, charging straight ahead, cleaving down fiercely.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 250: Zhao Lin Is Killed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 250: Zhao Lin Is Killed!
Seeing Zhao Lin not only not defending but even attacking recklessly, the third-stage Evolver’s expression changed, and he could only raise his hand instantly, setting up the bayonet in his hand to block Zhao Lin’s strike.
Clang!
A piercing metal collision sound exploded in their ears, and under the countershock force, the two couldn’t control their bodies as they retreated several steps backward.
"Dare to block me, die!"
The third-stage Evolver was furious, his tone full of killing intent, and as soon as he finished speaking, a black flash surrounded him as he rushed at Zhao Lin again.
"With me here, don’t even think about getting close to Little Qiqi!"
Zhao Lin’s face showed determination, and he slashed out fiercely with the steel blade in his hand.
Rumble~
The next moment, both sides were engaged in battle again. The sharp flashes of the blade danced continuously in the air, and the piercing explosive sound from the metal clashes was endless.
The two fought for several minutes, yet it seemed evenly matched.
Mainly, Zhao Lin’s reckless combat style was too crazy, the "kill eight hundred, lose a thousand" tactic made the opponent restrained, even with the talent ability of Extreme Speed, he couldn’t fully utilize it.
After all, facing someone fighting recklessly, unless one’s power is much higher, wanting to win without risking it all was impossible.
However, this kind of thing, only madmen would do, and this third-stage Evolver naturally wouldn’t.
And in just these few minutes, another Evolver perished under the attacks from the third-stage Corpse Puppet and Ji Ruxue.
In the sky, witnessing his comrades continuously perishing, Captain Lin, still entangled with Lu Chuan, was incredibly gloomy.
If this continued, let alone completing the mission, even the three elite squads assigned by the highest command would be wiped out.
If the mission failed and they returned to Jianghai Base City, how would he report back to the highest command!
Seemingly contemplating something, Captain Lin’s expression kept changing, and eventually, he made up his mind.
The battle situation was continuously worsening, and it was no longer possible to hope that they could bring back that little girl intact. He decided to carry out the decapitation mission, with no regard for the girl’s safety, or else, at this rate, they would all meet their end here.
Boom!
In his distraction, a scorching fire net collided with him instantly, and Captain Lin’s expression changed.
Not good!
The next moment, Captain Lin flapped his wings fiercely, trying to dodge, but it was a bit late; half his body was grazed by the fire net.
Boom!
Puff~
Blood sprayed from Captain Lin’s mouth, and he was directly flung away several hundred meters, the black scale armor on his body exploded under the intense heat, making the wounds unbearable to look at, and even the tip of one black-scaled wing was roasted, resembling charred wood.
"Cough cough~"
At this moment, Captain Lin, gasping like a bellows, coughed up blood again, and his aura weakened.
"Captain!"
The surrounding team members, seeing Captain Lin’s state, exclaimed in surprise and quickly gathered around.
It all happened in a flash, and by the time they reacted, Captain Lin had already been flung away by the fire net.
"Stay back, all of you!"
Enduring the intense pain ripping through his body, Captain Lin, slightly recovering, stretched out his hand to stop everyone.
Then, with a stern and murderous look, Captain Lin loudly ordered, "Everyone, immediately execute the decapitation mission, disregard the casualties, and the target, dead or alive!"
The greatest threat now was the little girl who could control Evolved Zombies. As long as she was controlled or killed, their crisis would naturally be resolved.
"Yes!"
Receiving the order, the Sky Squad members in the sky immediately took action, trying every means to pass through the overwhelming fire net.
The flat-headed youth, transformed into a giant black eagle, suddenly shrank to palm-size and then shot out, trying to endure the fire net’s burn, passing through its gaps;
The Evolver with Flaming ability, transformed into a fire stream, attempted to bypass the fire net at an astounding speed;
The Evolver possessing control over Qing Feng surrounded himself with a solidifying cyan acceleration, with maddeningly rotating Qing Feng circling around outside...
At the same time, the other Evolvers entangled below with the third-stage Corpse Puppet showed resolute expressions upon understanding the order.
Knowing that if they delayed any longer, they’d surely die, they began using their abilities to break through the third-stage Corpse Puppet’s blockade and charge towards the building.
Someone flashed with a brown-yellow Spiritual Light around their body and instantly disappeared, slipping into the ground, moving quickly underground; another blurred their figure, and swiftly passed the third-stage Corpse Puppet incognito.
However, for the remaining Evolvers, their abilities didn’t suit stealth, so they could only try a desperate rush to break through the third-stage Corpse Puppet’s obstruction.
Puff!
An Evolver gathered blocks of metallic-glossed rock shields around his body, then formed a few upward-extending stone steps in front.
Quickly stepping on the stone steps, he directly passed over the third-stage Corpse Puppet’s head.
And just as he was descending, the Tank Type Corpse Puppet turned around and punched.
Boom!
The rock shield in front of the Evolver shattered under the Tank Type Corpse Puppet’s punch, and the Evolver himself spewed blood, hurtling uncontrollably towards the house.
Continuously spewing blood from his mouth, the Evolver, despite the painful expression on his face, showed a bitter smile.
Daring not to delay, he quickly got up, rushing towards the house swiftly before the pursuing third-stage Corpse Puppet could catch up.
Seeing a group of Evolvers trying to rush over recklessly, Ji Ruxue, with her head sticking out of the window, frowned slightly.
These two places were where the Invisible and Earth Diver resided.
Sensing two Evolvers approaching her, Ji Ruxue remained calm, with poison needles ready to strike.
She had the Time Control Ability; these people attempting to assassinate her was simply too naive.
As soon as these two made a move, her poison needles would be triggered instantly, striving for a one-hit kill to avoid any trouble.
Boom!
Suddenly, the Earth Diver erupted, instantly emerging from underground into the room, aiming at Ji Ruxue standing by the window, eyes full of murder.
In a flash, a cold light struck fiercely towards Ji Ruxue.
"Little Qiqi!"
Zhao Lin, who had been blocking in front of the window, covered in blood, changed expression drastically, wielding a blade to push back the enemy, leapt into the room through the window, shielding Little Qiqi behind her.
Thunk!
In an instant, the Earth Diver’s saber stabbed into Zhao Lin’s abdomen.
Zhao Lin’s body stiffened instantly, emitting a painful muffled groan, with blood constantly seeping from the corners of her mouth.
Feeling the strength within her body draining away, Zhao Lin endured the immense pain and waved her blade to force the Earth Diver back.
Bang!
The next second, a pale-faced Zhao Lin powerlessly kneeled on the ground, steadying herself with her right hand on the steel blade.
Ji Ruxue: "???"
Looking at Zhao Lin in disbelief, Ji Ruxue was utterly speechless.
I can kill him, why are you offering yourself?​

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 251: Ji Ruxue’s Wrath!
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 251: Ji Ruxue’s Wrath!
"Mrs. Zhao Lin!"
Coming back to her senses, Ji Ruxue hurriedly stepped forward, preparing to check Zhao Lin’s injuries, but was stopped by Zhao Lin.
"Little Qiqi, I said I would protect you. Quick, go, go! I can hold them off!"
Zhao Lin stretched out her trembling left hand, blocking Ji Ruxue behind her, using her right hand to prop herself up with a sword, struggling to rise, trembling unsteadily.
Puff!
But in the end, Zhao Lin still spat out a large mouthful of fresh blood, her body weakly collapsing on the ground, her breath rapidly declining.
"..."
Ji Ruxue was at a loss for words.
She really wanted to curse right now. It should have been a smooth operation; who could have anticipated that things would turn out this way!
But seeing Zhao Lin sacrificing her life to protect her... why did she feel a bit touched all of a sudden?
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue’s expression turned peculiar.
She looked down, seeing Zhao Lin on the ground, taking more in than out, and shook her head helplessly.
Alas, this foolish woman... wasted her life again for nothing...
Zhao Lin’s sudden move had also startled the Earth Divers and the others around.
"Hmph, this woman is truly crazy, simply courting death!"
The Earth Diver, having come back to his senses, glanced disdainfully at Zhao Lin lying on the ground.
Subsequently, the Earth Diver shifted his gaze toward Ji Ruxue, flicked his war knife in hand, brimming with killing intent.
Meanwhile, the Invisible and the third-stage Evolver who had been fighting Zhao Lin before, had also arrived outside the window, ready to make a move on Ji Ruxue.
Ji Ruxue, looking like an innocent child, however, the three, knowing her danger, dared not underestimate her at all, and made their move with full force.
Boom!
The three burst out instantly, sharp knife lights attacking Ji Ruxue’s small figure.
At that moment, Ji Ruxue, somewhat angered by Zhao Lin’s death, flashed cold eyes, an invisible force surged out, covering the three, instantly freezing them in place, immobile.
Swish, swish, swish~
With the sound of three subtle breaking wind noises in the room, three embroidery needles pierced through the foreheads of the three, bringing out a few drops of scarlet blood.
Subsequently, Ji Ruxue released her time control.
The next second.
Bang, bang, bang~
The three bodies suspended in mid-air slammed heavily to the ground, emitting dull thuds.
Killing as easily as slaughtering chickens, Ji Ruxue remained unfazed, lowered her head to glance once more at Zhao Lin, finding that she had already breathed her last.
She sighed!
Rest assured, I will make these people pay with their lives for you!
Ji Ruxue turned around, looking at the battle situation outside.
She wasn’t overly saddened by Zhao Lin’s death, after all, the latter could resurrect.
However, for Zhao Lin, a life was still extremely precious; wasting it so senselessly was truly a pity.
At this moment, outside the residential area, Lu Chuan was also going all out, doing his best to intercept those third-stage Evolvers who were trying to dive down.
Flame One and Flame Two, while maneuvering the Heaven-Covering Fire Net, also conjured flame serpents, each five or six yards long.
Rumble~
Dozens of giant flame serpents, carrying blazing flames, constantly besieging and intercepting those Evolvers in the air, their fiery mouths repeatedly emitting bites.
Besides Da Pang and Er Pang acting as a shield wall, blocking harm for Flame One and Flame Two, Lightning One hid in the dark to protect Little Qiqi, while the same fourth-stage Earth Diver One and Tyrant One, under Lu Chuan’s command, made moves against the Evolvers.
Instantly, Tyrant One and Earth Diver One charged out.
In the sky, the flat-headed youth transformed into a black eagle was continually attempting to break through the gaps in the fire net, his feathers starting to emit a pungent burnt smell under the flames’ scorching.
And at this moment, seeing the black eagle enduring intense pain and about to break through the fire net’s gap.
Swish~
In a flash, a few splitting air sounds came from below.
Below the fire net, Tyrant One raised his right hand, with sharp claw blades on his hand transforming into five black streaks of light shooting upwards, targeting the black eagle about to breach the fire net.
Puff~
Instantly, a few streaks of light pierced through the black eagle’s body, bringing down a large portion of fragmented feathers and blood spray.
Subsequently, the five streaks of light shot out turned back under Tyrant One’s control, returning to his right hand.
Screech!
In the sky, the black eagle emitted a mournful cry, flapping its wings heavily, plummeting headlong to the ground and reverting to its original form.
The flat-headed youth kept spitting blood, lying in a pool of blood, on the brink of death.
At this time, the ground shook as Tyrant One slowly approached, stepping down with one foot.
Boom!
The flat-headed youth’s head instantly exploded, after a few futile twitches of limbs, it finally ceased to breathe.
High in the sky.
Ah~
While fighting against nine flame serpents, an Evolver with flaming ability got struck by the giant tail of one of the flame serpents due to an oversight. After a scream of pain, the body crashed into the nearby fire net.
Bang!
The next moment, the scorched Evolver screamed again, his body then uncontrollably falling downward.
Whoosh!
At the critical moment, about to crash into the ground, the Evolver endured the pain and reactivated his flaming ability, transforming into a mass of flames, allowing him to land safely.
Swoosh!
Yet before he could catch his breath, a thick brown-yellow spiritual light suddenly emerged from the ground, wrapping his legs entirely.
Before realizing it, the startled Evolver was forcibly dragged into the soil by the mass of brown-yellow spiritual light.
Underground, Earth Diver One firmly imprisoned the opponent’s legs. As the Evolver continuously struggled, even thinking of forcefully charging out with his flaming ability, Earth Diver One’s hands emitted invisible power, swiftly sweeping toward the Evolver.
Instantly, the soil around the Evolver began transforming into rock, eventually becoming a massive black stone, with the Evolver permanently sealed within.
Unable to breathe, it took only a moment for the Evolver to cease to exist.
On the ground, under Ji Ruxue’s time control, an Evolver who had reached a spot not far from the house suddenly found himself unable to move and was then beaten to death by the pursuing Corpse Puppet.
Amidst the chaotic battle, even Lu Chuan hadn’t noticed these bizarre occurrences; at the moment, he was focused on maneuvering the Corpse Puppet against the remaining Evolvers from the Sky Squad.
With time slipping away, the Evolvers’ side suffered heavy losses, from the three elite squads, only three Evolvers remained.
And above, in the Sky Squad, including Captain Lin, also only three remained alive, though all were injured.
"You’ve destroyed my farm, none of you will get away!"
Gazing at the few remaining Evolvers, Ji Ruxue’s eyes flashed coldly.
Thinking about no longer having vegetables and fruits to eat, Ji Ruxue’s heart burned with rage...

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 252: Want to Reason Now? Where Were You Before?
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 252: Want to Reason Now? Where Were You Before?
Rumble~
The battle at the farm continued on both sides.
The clash between Evolved Zombies and Evolvers erupted into intense waves, producing ear-piercing booms that echoed without end.
As time slowly passed, after Tyrant One eliminated the young man who turned into a black hawk, it began, with the cooperation of some third-order zombies, to besiege the Evolvers on the ground.
The remaining Evolvers, having survived the confrontation with the third-order Corpse Puppets until now, at the very least, had extremely strong survival and self-preservation abilities.
Facing the third-order Corpse Puppets, they were unafraid and even started fighting directly.
"Kill!"
On the ground, an Evolver weaved and dodged under the hands of two third-order Corpse Puppets.
He was not only unscathed, but the war sword in his hand was also furiously slashing, leaving deep cuts on the two third-order Corpse Puppets.
No matter how the two third-order Corpse Puppets attacked, they could not inflict the slightest harm on him.
This Evolver was a bald middle-aged man, and his ability seemed to be transforming himself into a blue fluid at the moment of attack to resist the damage dealt by the third-order Corpse Puppets.
The steel blade in Lightning Three’s hand, when cutting through the opponent’s blue fluid, could slice it open instantly, but it restored almost immediately.
San Pang’s heavy punches were similar, with immense strength only flattening and squishing the blue fluid momentarily; after being knocked away, it quickly restored, extremely annoying and troublesome.
For this reason, San Pang and Lightning Three’s siege took considerable time yet still failed to take him down.
At this moment, Tyrant One, who had just stomped the third-order young man with a flat head, rushed over under Lu Chuan’s control.
For these more troublesome beings, likely only the powerful force of a fourth-order could kill them all in a short time.
Boom boom boom~
The ground continuously shook with booming roars as Tyrant One’s enormous form charged like a tank toward the bald middle-aged man, its momentum towering.
Boom!
In an instant, Tyrant One approached, swinging a heavy punch. In the air, a piercing sonic boom was heard, with wild energy sweeping toward the bald middle-aged man entangled with the two third-order zombies.
"Not good!"
Before the fist reached, the blast of air and ear-piercing roar arrived first. As the bald middle-aged man turned his head, he watched in horror as a massive fist rapidly enlarged in his sights, feeling all the cells in his body trembling at this moment, issuing the strongest warning.
His pupils contracted, and at the last moment of danger, he instinctively activated his ability, turning his body into a blue fluid.
Boom!
Tyrant One’s fist smashed heavily into his back, with violent energy exploding instantly.
Under the unmatched giant strength, the Evolver’s back directly sank in and spread toward the chest, resembling bubble gum, with a massive blue bubble bulging from the chest, paper thin, almost bursting.
Subsequently, the Evolver turned into a blue fluid, falling backward like a cannonball, landing heavily in the vegetable field full of pits.
In an instant, the earth strongly shook, with soil splattering everywhere.
Poof!
Lying in the pit, the bald Evolver returned to human form, spitting out a mouthful of blood, pale-faced with fear, quickly leaping out of the pit, trying to escape the farm.
Too terrifying, the power of the fourth-order Evolved Zombie far exceeded his expectations; even in fluid form, he couldn’t completely immune to its force.
Rumble~
At this moment, Tyrant One rushed over with a vibration sensed from the earth behind. The bald middle-aged man desperately ran with all his might.
But the gap in their realms made Tyrant One much faster, catching up shortly.
Boom!
Tyrant One, decisive in slaughter, instantly swung a punch.
Sensing the sound of the fist’s whistle from behind, the bald middle-aged man’s liver and gall trembled, instinctively trying to employ his ability again to dodge the strike.
Unexpectedly, an invisible force descended from the sky, freezing him in place in the next second, unable to move.
Boom!
At this time, Tyrant One’s attack arrived, hitting the Evolver’s back with terrifying precision.
Instantly, the Evolver, intact moments ago, burst into a cloud of blood mist, limbs and flesh exploding, with organs and blood splattering everywhere.
Inside the house, Ji Ruxue observed this scene. After the Evolver’s death, she shifted her gaze to another Evolver entangled with a third-order Evolved Corpse Puppet.
The opponent seemed to be an Evolver with physical body capability with strong defense and self-healing abilities, though not strong in attack.
Compared to the bald middle-aged man before, this Evolver fought blow for blow with the third-order Corpse Puppet, unwilling to yield, even with a head full of blood and spitting blood, and not reducing his fighting power, with injuries healing rapidly.
Boom!
At this time, under Lu Chuan’s control, Flame One’s Flame Serpent flew down from the sky, crashing toward the opponent.
The Evolver’s expression changed, attempting to dodge.
Whiz!
In a flash, an embroidery needle accurately pierced through the opponent’s brow, killing him.
The situation deteriorated rapidly, with the Evolvers below nearly exhausted and Captain Lin, among others overhead, felt anxious.
"Captain, the situation is dire. If this continues, we can’t help but explain ourselves here!"
The Sky Squad member piloting Qing Feng called to Captain Lin while resisting Flame Serpent.
Captain Lin’s expression turned extremely grim; the opponent’s coordination in controlling the zombies to attack and defend was perfect, really hard to deal with.
The most troubling thing was other secret helpers lurking, catching his teammates off guard and resulting in inexplicable deaths.
Captain Lin’s heart sank. This operation was bound to end in failure.
Recalling his ambitions before, wanting to capture the opponent alive, seemed rather laughable.
Hesitating for a moment, Captain Lin still ordered the others to hold.
"Everyone, hold!"
"Friends inside, we are the Imperial Capital’s official Evolver squad, apologies for any offense, please don’t be mad.
This time, we came as it seemed that there was a Corpse King here, upon seeing, it turned out to be an Evolver controlling zombies, a misunderstanding.
We are all human; there’s no need to fight to the death. I greatly admire your abilities and wonder if you have any interest in joining the official ranks?"
"Can’t win, so now trying to reason?"
Upon hearing, Ji Ruxue let out a cold laugh.
What were they doing earlier?

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 253: Sky Squad Begins to Retreat
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 253: Sky Squad Begins to Retreat
Seeing all the evolved zombies in the farm stop, Captain Lin was overjoyed, thinking his words had made an impact.
Immediately, he continued his effort, gently persuading, "Little sister, we admit we can’t defeat you, but don’t forget, we have the authorities and the entire human world behind us.
Your ability is indeed powerful, controlling so many zombies is truly astonishing, but such capabilities should be used where they are needed. Staying in this small farm, your potential is not fully utilized. Why not join the government? In this apocalypse, humanity’s future needs your help!"
Captain Lin truly did not want to show weakness to this evolver who had killed so many of his comrades, but unfortunately, they couldn’t fight against them now, so he had to change his approach.
Since the other party is a human evolver, both sides are human, so through communication, there must be a peaceful solution.
Since forcefully taking them away isn’t possible now, they could only appeal to emotions and reason, binding the other party with humanity’s future.
In his view, just a little girl, she should be easy to fool...
If he could get her to agree to join the government, then as long as she’s taken away from the farm, without the support of evolved zombies, her threat would be minimized.
Inside the room, Ji Ruxue listened to Captain Lin’s words, showing nothing but disdain.
Did they really take her for a little girl who could be tricked like a fool?
The other party clearly mistook her for an evolver with the ability to control zombies.
Not to mention she wasn’t one, but even if she was, she wouldn’t fall for their tricks and join the government.
These Evolutionary Squads, when they arrived, were extremely arrogant, destroying the farm instantly, filled with malice.
Now suddenly trying to recruit her is nothing but a desperate measure; they want to play tricks because they can’t beat her.
Moreover, with Ji Ruxue’s past life’s understanding of humans, if she really believed their lies and joined the human government,
what awaited her wouldn’t be excellent treatment and a high status, but so-called "voluntary" scientific research until they uncover the secret of zombie control.
"Haha, they destroyed my farm and still want a peaceful resolution?"
Inside, Lu Chuan laughed with anger after hearing Captain Lin’s words.
So naive!
However, the next second, Lu Chuan paused suddenly, realizing something.
"Both humans? Did these guys have some misunderstanding?"
Lu Chuan frowned slightly, feeling puzzled.
What’s his relation with humans? He’s a genuine zombie.
Wait!!
Little sister?
Suddenly, Lu Chuan’s eyes lit up, realizing the truth.
"Could it be, these humans were referring to Little Qiqi?"
No wonder those evolvers were charging at Little Qiqi like mad; they mistook Little Qiqi for him and took her for an evolver with the power to control zombies.
Interesting~
Lu Chuan’s mouth curled up slightly, unexpected to encounter such a blunder.
But, in a few seconds, Lu Chuan’s smile disappeared completely.
He suddenly remembered something.
Today, Little Qiqi’s telekinesis control was exposed. Although these evolvers might still be in the dark, once they escape and report the information to the human authorities,
the truth behind might not withstand the analysis by human elites...
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan’s eyes filled with killing intent; only by keeping all these people here could he ensure the farm’s secret wouldn’t leak.
Just as well, humans have made a misjudgment, mistaking Little Qiqi for an evolver who can control zombies. Next time, he might use this to trick the humans.
Of course, all this hinges on not letting these people escape.
"Little sister, what our captain said is true. With such abilities, hiding in the farm is really a waste of your talent.
Right now, humanity is facing the threat of zombies; your ability to manipulate zombies is exactly what the authorities and humanity need."
The evolver riding Qing Feng echoed, shouting to the ground below.
After speaking, the few people in the sky looked at each other and stopped talking, waiting for the other’s response.
If the fighting continued, they were very likely to be wiped out; now they could only hope the other side would listen to reason...
A moment later, Dean Lin saw there was no movement inside. After thinking for a moment, he assumed the other side was considering it, and then he painfully lifted his severely injured right arm, looking at the shredded skin that was burned by flames, frowning inadvertently.
Secretly, this tier-four zombie’s power is indeed horrifying!
His scale armor can withstand various tier-three abilities, but now facing the flames of a tier-four fire-breathing zombie, the black scale armor was like paper, instantly engulfed in flames and bursting apart.
Gritting his teeth, just as Captain Lin prepared to forcibly tear off the curled and dried skin around the wound,
his teammate beside him let out an exclamation!
"Not good! Captain, be careful!!"
Always maintaining a trace of vigilance, Captain Lin reacted swiftly, and the moment he heard the sound, he looked downward.
Only to see massive fireballs hurtling towards him and his team, flames blazing and heat waves roaring.
In the next moment, the black-scaled wings behind Captain Lin flapped fiercely, swiftly dodging aside, successfully avoiding the incoming fireball.
"Little sister, you have to think this through; if you attack again, you’ll be going against all of humanity! Do you understand?"
Captain Lin shouted downwards with a furrowed brow, somewhat angrily.
This little girl is hard to deal with... Captain Lin was troubled.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he finished speaking, the flame corpse puppet below gathered another dozen giant fireballs and hurled them towards them.
"Outrageous!"
Captain Lin hurriedly dodged, anger rising in his heart, but he still calmed himself and used a normal tone, shouting, "As long as you agree to join us, any condition is yours! Do you have any living relatives? We can search for them in the major base cities!"
This little girl is really hard to handle, Captain Lin thought, wondering if he could find a breakthrough from the aspect of relatives, especially since she seemed so lonely; if she had relatives, she would surely miss them.
Unfortunately, what responded to Captain Lin next were more fireballs glowing with intense flame.
"Damn it!"
Dodging the attack, Captain Lin’s face was grim as water.
The other side was so impervious to persuasion that the possibility of convincing them was practically nonexistent, and at this moment, Captain Lin already had a mind to retreat.
Since the Sky Squad couldn’t handle it, it would have to be reported.
The next time the authorities would definitely send overwhelming forces, this little girl won’t be able to escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 254: Zhao Lin Returned from the Dead!
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 254: Zhao Lin Returned from the Dead!
Rumble!
The evolver controlling Qing Feng’s expression slightly changed. With the Qing Feng swirling around him, several Wind Blade Tornadoes were unleashed, violently blasting apart the three gigantic incoming fireballs. The explosions were deafening, and flames soared into the sky.
The evolver was pushed back tens of meters by the powerful shockwave before barely stabilizing his stance.
The intense pain from his body made the evolver’s face look extremely grim.
Looking at the continuous incoming fireballs below, the evolver controlling Qing Feng found it difficult to hold on any longer and advised, "Captain, why don’t we retreat for now? There’s always another chance. We can make her pay next time."
Due to the earlier battle with the Fire-breathing Zombie, they were already injured, with burns from the Fire Net all over their bodies. Now, having to constantly evade attacks exacerbated their injuries and deteriorated their condition.
If this stalemate continued, they would surely face total annihilation.
Upon hearing this, despite the desire to retreat, Captain Lin felt unwilling when things had reached this point.
Remembering his repeated assurances to the top command, full of confidence that he could complete the mission... returning in such a sorry state would disgrace the ace squadron.
Moreover, this time, not only did Sky Squad suffer significant losses, with many of their comrades fallen, but the three Elite Squads sent by top command to assist also faced heavy casualties due to his commands to assault the residential area.
If he returned like this, how would he explain it to top command? How would Jianghai Base City view him and Sky Squad?
Once back at the Imperial Capital, when accountability was enforced, even the title of ace squadron could be lost.
Such an outcome was something he couldn’t accept.
If it weren’t for that little girl’s desperate resistance, how could Sky Squad fall to such a state?
Captain Lin looked coldly at the houses below, his eyes full of hatred.
To make amends, the only way was to capture that little girl.
As long as she was brought back, everything could be salvaged...
"Brothers, let’s fight once more!"
"Are you content to go back like this? Sky Squad’s reputation can’t be ruined just like that! Otherwise, how can we face our fallen brothers?"
Captain Lin’s face twisted into a grimace, his eyes full of resolve. Then he looked at the two teammates not far away and said through gritted teeth.
This little girl was an evolver with the ability to control zombies, a major asset to humanity. Whether to study her ability or to utilize her against zombies... bringing her back to the Imperial Capital would be a monumental contribution.
Once the hidden threat to Jianghai Base City was eliminated, they’d surely be welcomed back, even if it cost them three Evolutionary Squads.
Upon returning to the Imperial Capital, all failures of Sky Squad would be erased, and the benefits gained would be countless. Honor and status would be generously granted by the Empire.
And the reputation of Sky Squad’s ace title would become even more renowned!
Hearing this, the remaining two were initially stunned, completely unexpected that the captain was still insistent at this juncture. However, remembering what the captain just said, they exchanged a glance, eyes flickering.
"Captain, you mean?"
The evolver controlling Qing Feng hesitated for a moment and asked.
In this situation, the only way to turn the tide seemed to be...
In the next moment, they saw Captain Lin pulling out a vial from his waist, removing the lid. He glanced at the two and said, "If we capture that little girl, it’s a great feat, and we won’t be punished. In fact, none of the honors or positions you aspire to will be missing. Think it over."
Then, without hesitation, Captain Lin gulped down the serum.
Upon witnessing this, the remaining two members of the Sky Squad hesitated for a moment. In the next moment, with a flash of determination in their eyes, they followed Captain Lin and also gulped down the serum from their waists.
After consuming the serum, in just a few seconds, the powerful effects began to surge wildly within Captain Lin.
Initially still in a relatively normal state, Captain Lin suddenly let out a painful groan.
Amidst the pain, his slightly bent figure began to tremble uncontrollably, with all his muscles spasming at that moment.
Bang!
Suddenly, as if the serum took effect, Captain Lin’s trembling body rapidly began to expand until he grew into a terrifying giant over twenty feet tall.
His joints were thick, limbs like giant pillars, and with muscles knotted and robust, he looked like a mountain.
At the same time, his existing injuries rapidly improved, with the charred black scales burned by fire starting to grow frantically, gradually large enough to cover the entire body surface like a thick, metallic scale armor.
Raising his eyes slightly, the madness and fury were apparent in Captain Lin’s reddened gaze.
The next moment, the ever-rising aura around him finally surpassed the threshold from third to fourth stage, with a frightful aura sweeping in all directions. A pair of black claws, like long knives, moved slightly, gleaming and emitting explosive sounds tearing through the surrounding air.
At this moment, it seemed as though even the surrounding space was trembling slightly due to Captain Lin’s movements, with boundless murderous intent soaring skyward.
The two remaining Sky Squad members also experienced massive transformations in their aura, their power surging to the fourth stage, causing a violent demeanor as they faced overwhelming power with no outlet.
Meanwhile, inside the house.
Zhao Lin, lying in a pool of blood behind Ji Ruxue, whose body had already turned cold, suddenly underwent changes, with flesh buds secretly growing from the injury through her waist, beginning to connect and slowly heal the wound.
Next moment, as if a suction force emerged from Zhao Lin’s body, Energy Factors from all directions started rushing toward her.
In an instant, the wound on Zhao Lin’s waist began to heal at a speed visible to the naked eye, soon restored completely, with the skin smooth and showing no signs of having been damaged.
Meanwhile, Zhao Lin’s once pallid complexion gradually became rosy as her wounds healed.
Suddenly, Zhao Lin’s fingers twitched, her consciousness returning, and as she slowly awakened, she turned her blood-stained face to look around.
Seeing the familiar house, her initially confused eyes gradually cleared, as the scenes before death replayed in her mind.
Little Qiqi!
The next moment, Zhao Lin’s expression changed slightly, concerned for Little Qiqi’s safety. She used her arms to support her body with difficulty, wobbling as she stood up.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 255: Frenzy Potion
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 255: Frenzy Potion
"I... my strength..."
After standing up, Zhao Lin realized her power had increased several times, her whole body filled with strength.
Amidst her joy, she quickly turned around and saw Little Qiqi standing peacefully by the window, finally relaxing.
"It’s good that nothing happened!"
Zhao Lin slowly walked to the window, her gaze scanning the battlefield.
"This woman has come back to life again?"
Using the Corpse Puppet’s perspective, Lu Chuan saw Zhao Lin and was quite surprised. Is she really an Undead Body... dying only to revive again?
The commotion behind did not escape Ji Ruxue’s attention. She was very clear about Zhao Lin’s ability to keep reviving, but what shocked her was the speed of her resurrection this time was so fast...
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, be careful, they are about to charge over!"
Immediately, Ji Ruxue shifted her focus back to the sky, noticing the few remaining members of the Sky Squad, her expression gradually became solemn, and she reminded Zhao Lin behind her.
Ji Ruxue sharply detected that several people’s aura had changed; while they had obviously become stronger, it also seemed they had grown more frenzied and chaotic...
The next moment, Ji Ruxue had a guess, thinking that these people must have taken the forbidden drug.
At this moment, Zhao Lin also noticed the changes in the three people above. Her eyes immediately showed battle intent, saying seriously, "Little Qiqi, don’t worry, as long as I’m here, no one can hurt you."
Ji Ruxue thought to herself: "Please, don’t go sending yourself to your death again."
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin gave a sheepish smile, she also felt her previous actions were too reckless, but the situation was urgent, and she was thinking about Little Qiqi’s safety.
Anyway, she could revive...
"These guys are really reckless, daring to take the forbidden drug!"
Ji Ruxue felt the increasingly strong aura from the three people above, shook her head, and sighed.
This stuff is not to be trifled with, while it can boost one’s strength in a short time, the aftereffects are extremely severe, draining the body’s potential, making the path of future evolution difficult.
Ji Ruxue didn’t understand what these people were thinking; didn’t they know the dangers of the forbidden drug?
In the sky, Captain Lin let out a hearty roar, venting his inner mania.
"Brothers, make the most of our time!"
"The Frenzy Potion only lasts for half an hour!"
The Frenzy Potion is a forbidden drug created by Imperial Capital Base City using Mutated Fierce Beast flesh and special mutated plants.
After consumption, it greatly boosts the user’s strength, with effects lasting half an hour.
Simultaneously, the user’s temperament becomes frenzied and bloodthirsty, their body devoid of pain.
As soon as he finished speaking, Captain Lin, full of ferocious aura, roared downwards, powerful sound waves sweeping all around, stirring up gusts of wind.
Subsequently, his Heaven-Covering wings suddenly vibrated, with intense winds surrounding him, propelling his strong body toward the residential area below at Extreme Speed.
Boom!
Captain Lin’s speed was astonishing, producing a series of sonic booms during his descent, the sound deafening, like bursts of thunder.
Simultaneously, his two team members each began their assault, charging toward the residential area, aiming directly at Ji Ruxue.
The Evolver, commanding the green winds, surrounded by fierce green gales, merged himself into a massive green tornado, descending rapidly below.
Meanwhile, the other Evolver, covered in a layer of ice armor, with a pair of ice wings behind him, flapped them, stirring up endless gales and ice crystals, resembling a blizzard, carrying him downward.
Sensing the trio’s intentions, Lu Chuan certainly wouldn’t let them succeed. Flame One and Flame Two once again deployed the Heaven-Covering Fire Net, pressing down on the trio.
Fierce flames soared, the space around the Heaven-Covering Fire Net seemed to wrinkle from the burning, flames reaching sky high, turning the entire sky crimson, clouds in the heaven dyed red, transformed into gorgeous fiery clouds.
The gap between the Heaven-Covering Fire Net and Captain Lin and his companions narrowed, layers of heat waves continuously assaulted.
"Break through!"
Feeling the rising temperature ahead, and the imminent fire net, Captain Lin shouted to the two behind him, a resolute look on his face.
The flames from the fourth-stage Fire-breathing Zombie were too much for the Fireproof Suit. By now, the Fireproof Suits on the three of them had long since been torn to shreds, reduced to charred black rags.
This time, to break through the fire net, they must rely on their own abilities and physicality to withstand it.
Captain Lin’s fierce eyes locked onto the fire net ahead, his two strong and powerful arms beginning to build strength, the sharp black claws at the ends like long knives, gleaming with metallic luster.
Boom!
In an instant, Captain Lin collided with the fire net, igniting a blaze, numerous flames spreading from the fire net toward Captain Lin’s massive body, yet despite the scale armor on him being baked till it exploded, and his skin underneath torn open, Captain Lin felt nothing, continuing to madly swing his claws, tearing at the fire net.
Moments later, the center of the fire net was torn open; the entirely charred Captain Lin dashed out, the burning black wings behind him vibrating wildly, rushing towards the houses.
At this moment, Flame One waved his hand, a dozen fiery long snakes hissed, and all lunged toward Captain Lin.
"Get lost!"
Captain Lin’s blades frantically danced, intersecting with knife lights, slicing apart two incoming fiery long snakes.
Yet the next second, a fiery long snake rushed over from the side, tightly wrapping around Captain Lin’s arm, the snake body filled with flames endlessly roasting him.
"Damn it! These flies are truly troublesome!"
He forcefully clawed at his own arm, dissolving the fiery long snake, Captain Lin was furious.
But before he could catch his breath, several more fiery long snakes entangled him.
Facing these annoying fiery long snakes, Captain Lin was held in place, unable to move forward.
Meanwhile, the Evolver wearing ice armor, with wings on his back, used his icy powers to successfully breach the fire net.
However, his body still couldn’t escape the flames’ burns, his face completely burned off, the ghastly white pupils embedded in a clump of rotten flesh looked extremely eerie, hair blackened and falling out, some parts revealing jet-black skull, even limbs were scarred by the flames.
With Captain Lin blocking in front, the opponent wielding an ice sword emitting chilly air managed to deal with a few fiery long snakes’ entanglements smoothly.
The nearly half-melted ice wings behind quickly recovered.
Then, the ice wings suddenly flapped, rapidly heading towards Little Qiqi.
"Little Qiqi, step back!"
Seeing the disfigured Evolver dare to charge recklessly, Zhao Lin’s expression changed, her eyes full of determination.
Immediately she raised the steel knife in her hand, her figure flickered, and she rushed upward.
"It’s a life-or-death battle, huh? I’m not afraid of anyone!"

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 256: Captain Lin Falls in Battle!
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 256: Captain Lin Falls in Battle!
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, be careful!"
In the blink of an eye, Zhao Lin had already dashed out. Ji Ruxue hadn’t even had time to react, and could only manage to call out a last-minute reminder.
Boom!
Zhao Lin no longer had time to reply to Ji Ruxue.
At this moment, she was already engaged in close combat with the enemy. The steel knife in her hand swung with all her might, its sharp blade slicing through the air, producing a piercing whistle as it flashed with a cold glint, constantly striking at the enemy.
Due to the effects of the Frenzy Potion, the Sky Squad Evolver, devoid of any sense of pain, wasn’t hindered in battle even though they were burned to this extent.
The ice sword in their hand lashed out, cold air flowing, clashing with Zhao Lin.
Zhao Lin’s steel knife swung fiercely, unstoppable, constantly colliding with the opponent’s ice sword, while her adversary fluttered their ice wings, attempting to break through Zhao Lin’s blockade and approach Ji Ruxue from various directions.
But evidently, they miscalculated, as Zhao Lin wouldn’t give them such an opportunity.
In this moment of desperation, she launched a frenzied attack, not defending at all, determined not to let the enemy get a step closer to Little Qiqi.
This strategy of trading injuries for injuries, life for life, clearly made the enemy uncomfortable.
Every time they were about to suffer a fatal wound, their body’s instincts would urge them to block it.
Rumble~
The two of them clashed not far from the window, with each collision erupting into deafening metallic clangs. The frenzied energy swept across the room, causing it to quake.
Their battle left the surroundings in disarray.
The ground was littered with marks from the sword energy, each at least a meter long, crisscrossed and chaotic. Even the concrete surfaces at the edges of the house bore distinct sword marks.
Unfortunately, even though Zhao Lin had grown much stronger after having died once, she was still somewhat outmatched compared to her opponent.
After all, after consuming the Frenzy Potion, her opponent’s strength skyrocketed, not weaker than the current Zhao Lin.
Furthermore, their body was protected by ice armor, impervious to blades and bullets, which would instantly repair even if cracked. Zhao Lin struck their body several times but couldn’t inflict any damage.
As time went on, Zhao Lin began to fall behind, the situation turning into one where she frantically attacked while the other struggled to defend, constantly retreating.
Pfft!
Finally, the Evolver seized a chance, heavily kicking Zhao Lin, who couldn’t hold on any longer. She spat out a mouthful of blood as she flew through the air.
The Evolver’s eyes were filled with a bloodthirsty frenzy as they pressed the attack, intent on finishing Zhao Lin off.
"Die!"
Suppressing the immense pain in her chest, Zhao Lin struggled to her feet, gripping her steel knife tightly, and charged forward with an angry roar.
The distance between them rapidly closed, and Zhao Lin viciously swung her steel knife at her opponent’s head.
The enemy, with a cruel smile, transformed their ice sword into a spear in an instant, aiming for Zhao Lin’s abdomen with a startled gaze.
At the critical moment, Ji Ruxue, watching intently from the window, seized the chance and unleashed her Time Control. An invisible force descended upon the enemy.
In an instant, the Sky Squad Evolver’s movements stalled, freezing on the spot.
Thud!
Zhao Lin’s steel knife cleaved downwards, instantly splitting the enemy’s head in two, brain matter and blood splattering, drenching Zhao Lin’s face.
"Blech!"
Zhao Lin looked at the headless corpse collapsing to the ground, spitting out a mouthful of blood.
Meanwhile in the sky, Lu Chuan was manipulating the Corpse Puppet, battling furiously with two foes.
