With the Fire Net and numerous Flame Serpents working together, Captain Lin and the Evolver riding Qing Feng were firmly entangled.
Even after taking the Frenzy Potion, they couldn’t bridge the gap between themselves and a fourth-tier zombie—true fourth-tier powerhouses.
Boom!
Winds swirled violently in the sky as the Wind Master, with a nearly carbonized right leg, hung at the center of the whirlwind, swinging his hands frantically. Spiraling Wind Blade Tornadoes formed continually in the gale, crashing into the Fire Net and Flame Serpents manically.
The Wind Blade Tornadoes and Flame Serpents shattered each other, constantly exploding in the air.
The Heaven-Covering Fire Net directly shattered the incoming Wind Blade Tornado, its flames crashing into the Wind Master’s body.
The Wind Master was sent flying, the intense heat baking his skin into a layer of rough, withered bark.
Captain Lin, eyes ablaze with madness, slashed wildly with the claw blades in his hands at the oncoming Flame Serpents.
His surrounding flesh released a faint scent of roasted meat, clearly indicating that the surface of his body had been cooked by the flames.
"Kill! Charge down!"
In the sky, the two gravely injured men met up. Captain Lin roared and shot downwards, forcibly tearing open a gap in the Fire Net with his body, breaking through it and charging downwards again.
The Wind Master followed closely behind, darting through the gap and trailing Captain Lin, rushing towards Ji Ruxue.
"Ready to die? Fine, I’ll grant that wish!"
Seeing the severely injured duo still recklessly charging down, Lu Chuan also became resolute.
These two posed a significant threat, and he mustn’t let them reach Little Qiqi.
With a thought, all the Corpse Puppets on the ground sprang into action. Tyrant One quickly moved to the window, guarding Little Qiqi, while Earth Escape One carried the covert Lightning One, lurking underground, awaiting the right moment.
Under Flame One’s and Flame Two’s control, the previously upward-closing Fire Net transformed suddenly, rapidly closing in and morphing into a towering Flaming Giant Python, roaring deafeningly as it lunged at Captain Lin in front.
The enormous, flaming maw was about to devour Captain Lin.
"Get lost!"
Captain Lin bellowed, and slashed heavily at the python head the size of a cistern.
Boom!
The Flaming Giant Python’s head was partially severed by this strike, scattering into tiny firelight, while Captain Lin, knocked hard by the impact, crashed to the ground.
Captain Lin quickly scrambled up from the ground.
But at this time, the Flaming Giant Python, along with dozens of Flame Serpents, charged at Captain Lin.
Captain Lin, eyes bloodshot, swung the claw blades in his hands, continuously clashing with the Flame Serpents as they flew in, occasionally slicing one apart.
Ji Ruxue, focused on the battle, seized the moment when Captain Lin was entangled with the Flame Serpents, shooting out several embroidery needles from her hand.
Swoosh!
Captain Lin’s eyes burst instantly.
Aah~
The sudden darkness prompted a panicked howl from Captain Lin as he stumbled blindly.
It was at this moment that Earth Escape One emerged from the ground, with Lightning One in tow. Lightning One’s sharp claw blades instantly pierced Captain Lin’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 257: Total Annihilation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 257: Total Annihilation!
Captain Lin’s body stiffened instantly; though he felt no pain, his heart turned cold, and all his strength was swiftly draining away.
Bang!
With a forceful push, Lightning One sent Captain Lin’s powerless body flying. He crashed heavily onto the ground, rolling a few times before coming to a stop.
"Brothers, run!!!"
Blood continually poured from his mouth, and with blinded eyes, Captain Lin used his last ounce of strength to shout loudly at the Wind Master above.
Hah ha~
Blood gushed from his mouth as Captain Lin found he could no longer speak, the scalding liquid turmoil inside his mouth.
In his dying moments, Captain Lin regained clarity, thinking of his brutally slain comrades, he felt deep regret.
If only he had known...
This mission, I...
I definitely wouldn’t...
The next moment, Captain Lin’s consciousness faded away, and he lay silently on the ground.
"Captain!"
The Wind Master tangling with the Flame Serpent above could hardly believe his eyes, his form swaying, face filled with grief.
Who would have thought the Captain would sacrifice himself too...
Soon, the Wind Master’s gaze fell upon Ji Ruxue below, his eyes filled with hatred, red as blood.
Now, the team is down to just him alone; everyone else has died in battle. What face does he have left to survive?
"Captain! I will avenge you!"
The Wind Master, with a face of madness, rode the wild wind, ignoring the surrounding Flame Serpents, desperately charging at Ji Ruxue.
Today, willing to die if it meant taking a piece of the enemy with him!
Boom!
A Flame Serpent struck the Wind Master’s blue whirlwind barrier, exploding upon impact.
The blue whirlwind had a hole blasted through it, and before it could regenerate, sparks from the explosion splattered onto the Wind Master’s body, igniting a blaze.
Before it went out, the flame burned away a piece of flesh from the Wind Master’s body, revealing the white bone beneath.
But he paid it no heed, aiming squarely at Ji Ruxue, his face full of murderous intent.
Crash~
In the next instant, several Flame Serpents caught up to the Wind Master, exploding upon collision.
The Wind Master was blasted hundreds of meters away, his surrounding blue whirlwind shattered, half of his body catching on fierce flames.
Under the influence of the Frenzy Potion, he felt no pain.
With his unwavering determination, even with the risk of being burned to a crisp, he couldn’t care less.
After adjusting his direction, he charged again towards Ji Ruxue at the window, persistent as ever.
"Seek death!"
Seeing this, Lu Chuan’s face darkened, a cold light flashed in his eyes.
This guy is quite the character, willing to throw away his life to kill Little Qiqi.
Unfortunately, he won’t let that happen.
If you dare invade the farm, you must be ready to face total annihilation!
Zhao Lin, standing by the window, looked at the stubborn and crazed figure not far away, eyes flashing with a hint of reluctance.
Alas, if only he’d realized earlier.
Willing to risk his life for revenge on behalf of his teammates, it is indeed admirable.
But the one he wants to kill is Little Qiqi!
For Little Qiqi’s safety, Zhao Lin still gripped the blade, transforming into a black shadow, rushing forward to kill.
Ji Ruxue behind the window simply watched the Wind Master coldly, showing no trace of sympathy.
They were mortal enemies all along, fighting endlessly.
Why pretend to be nice?
Moreover, if their farm were defeated today.
She and her father’s fate would undoubtedly be worse than death.
Thus, these people are bound to die!
In the apocalypse, any unnecessary compassion is fatal!
At this time, Zhao Lin had already faced off against the Wind Master.
Facing Zhao Lin, who blocked his way, the Wind Master’s eyes brimmed with killing intent.
Now, he most wanted to kill Ji Ruxue, avenge his brothers; anyone blocking him is a mortal enemy.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh~
Numerous razor-sharp Wind Blades, each the size of a palm, shot towards Zhao Lin; simultaneously, the Wind Master’s battle saber followed closely.
Clang~~
Zhao Lin’s face tightened, his steel blade in continuous motion, intercepting the incoming Wind Blades one after another, producing metallic collision sounds, while the blade itself vibrated ceaselessly, emitting a humming noise.
In the next moment, the Wind Master’s saber struck, the dazzling blade flash unbearably bright, carrying an unstoppable force.
The blinding flash of the saber stung his skin; Zhao Lin intensified his glare, his right hand shifted, forcing the trembling steel blade to become calm.
In an instant, he swung fiercely, accompanied by a terrifying sound of the wind.
Clang!
A loud metallic clash erupted by Zhao Lin and the Wind Master’s ears; Zhao Lin felt a momentary dizzying vertigo, a wave of energy sweeping outward, the powerful counterforce simultaneously sent both their bodies uncontrollably retreating.
"Die!"
Steadying his stance, the Wind Master shouted furiously, instantly launching several rotating Wind Blade Tornados, resembling dragons of air, charging toward Zhao Lin.
Any flesh caught by the Wind Blade Tornado would be shredded to pieces by the crazily spinning Wind Blades within.
Facing these Wind Blade Tornados, Zhao Lin’s expression was grave, his flowing hair swayed with the wind.
Knowing he couldn’t face them head-on, Zhao Lin swiftly dodged with his steel blade, evading two Wind Blade Tornados before swinging his steel blade with full force.
In the sound of whistling wind, a powerful energy surge surrounded the steel blade, forcibly slicing through the last Wind Blade Tornado.
Boom!
After cleaving through the Wind Blade Tornado, the terrifying energy continued unabated, leaving a long knife mark over a yard on the ground.
The caught-off-guard Wind Master, under the impact of the energy wave, was sent flying away.
"Kill!"
With blood trickling from the corner of his mouth, the Wind Master in madness rose again, enveloping himself within a massive Wind Blade Tornado, appearing like a giant wind dragon, about to charge at Zhao Lin.
But at this moment, under the Wind Master’s feet, flashed a brown-yellow Spiritual Light, and Earth Escape One suddenly pulled the Wind Master’s legs into the earth.
"Damn it, you bitch!"
The unexpected change made the Wind Master curse furiously, frantically trying to control the wild winds around him to pull himself free.
But to his dismay, Earth Escape One continued pulling the Wind Master downward, against the fourth-stage Earth Escape One, the Wind Master’s strength was no match.
He could only helplessly watch his body sink bit by bit, roaring furiously in vain.
Alas, no matter how much the Wind Master struggled, the sinking motion would not be halted.
At this moment, the Flaming Giant Python hovering in the air roared, rushing towards the helpless and crazed Wind Master.
"Ah~ You won’t die well!!"
The Flaming Giant Python approaching closer within his sight, the Wind Master let out an unwilling roar.
Boom!
In an instant, the Flaming Giant Python bit onto the Wind Master, exploding, creating a towering blaze.
In the explosion, the Wind Master was utterly obliterated.
The entire farm fell silent instantly; the charred desolate ground lay strewn with cold corpses.
And so, all Evolvers who invaded the farm died.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 258: Clearing the Battlefield! Heavy Losses!
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 258: Clearing the Battlefield! Heavy Losses!
"Huff, finally... won."
Watching the Wind Master fall with her own eyes, Zhao Lin breathed a sigh of relief.
She tossed the steel knife in her hand aside and plopped down on the ground, panting heavily.
This battle was incredibly difficult for her.
First, she died once, then fought to the death with two third-tier Evolvers. Even a slight mistake could have cost her life.
The intense fight had drained a lot of her physical and mental strength.
Now, she just wanted a good sleep.
Moments later, Zhao Lin’s breathing gradually steadied. She looked at the bodies sprawled out ahead of her with a complex gaze... but it quickly turned into a look of determination.
Humans, yet fighting each other.
However, it wasn’t that she wanted to kill them; they attacked first. She couldn’t be blamed for that.
How could such a good farm be destroyed just like that?
A place like a paradise, ruined because of these Evolvers.
And such a cute, kind Little Qiqi, how could they hurt her? So these people deserved to die...
Upon understanding this, a cold glint appeared in Zhao Lin’s eyes.
Next, Zhao Lin scanned the farm, starting to search for Little Qiqi and the Corpse King’s whereabouts.
The two who were just here had vanished in the blink of an eye, and she had no idea where they had gone.
After looking around and not finding them, Zhao Lin decided not to continue searching, lying down right where she was, letting out a comfortable moan.
While Zhao Lin rested, Lu Chuan and Ji Ruxue didn’t immediately relax. They repeatedly scouted around the farm, leaving no corner unchecked.
Only after confirming there were no hidden enemies did they finally relax a bit.
After ensuring there were no more enemies, Lu Chuan finally had the chance to assess the losses of this ordeal.
The warehouse where supplies were stored was mostly burned down, meaning the supplies that Lu Chuan had painstakingly collected from the Jiangnan City District were almost all gone, save for a few leftovers inside the house.
"Alas, so many things are destroyed. What a pity!"
Looking at the devastated white area in front of him, Lu Chuan shook his head helplessly. Tools like shovels and bamboo baskets were all kept in the warehouse, and without these things, tasks like farming couldn’t be done.
Of course, even if he had these tools, they couldn’t actually be used.
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but let out a bitter smile in his heart.
Because, aside from the gathered supplies.
The vegetable fields once full of greens and the orchard were all gone. These couldn’t be restored in the short term.
To fully recover the vegetable fields might take several months, and for the orchard even longer. The growth cycle of fruit trees was too long, taking two or three years.
Besides the daily necessary supplies, the stone wall of the inner perimeter was basically ruined, with sections collapsed, turned into piles of rubble.
At the same time, the Corpse Puppets under Lu Chuan’s command were also in a bad state.
The first and second-tier Evolved Corpse Puppets were almost obliterated under concentrated rocket and grenade fire.
Many third-tier zombies were also killed or injured in battle, with only the fourth-tier zombies unscathed...
This time, the farm suffered heavy losses, taking a severe blow.
After gaining an understanding of the farm’s losses, Lu Chuan couldn’t help but let out a long sigh.
This was a huge loss.
Not gaining any benefits, yet suffering such great losses.
Although they eliminated the invading Evolvers, it was essentially a lose-lose situation.
Just that, the other side paid a bigger price, leaving their lives behind.
While on Lu Chuan’s side, there were no casualties, their living supplies were destroyed, making future life problematic. Maintaining their previous standard of living was almost impossible.
Meanwhile, the loss of Evolved Corpse Puppets was too great. Though the most powerful forces, the fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, remained intact, providing some security assurance.
But Lu Chuan’s warfare potential was severely weakened, with the number of third-tier puppets waning sharply, and almost none of the first or second tiers.
The structure of the Corpse Puppets now under his command could only be described as an extremely distorted talent hierarchy, like a building in the air.
After accounting for all the related losses, Lu Chuan prepared to start cleaning the farm.
On the other hand, Ji Ruxue thought of the Old Turtle, so she specifically went to the fish pond to check on it.
During the previous helicopter squad’s rocket launch, quite a few rockets had exploded on the pond’s surface, and she was unsure if the Old Turtle had been injured.
Rushing to the edge of the pond, as soon as Ji Ruxue looked at the murky water surface, a figure surfaced from below.
It was indeed the Old Turtle; upon seeing its owner, it slowly paddled over.
Upon careful observation, seeing that it was unscathed, Ji Ruxue was initially surprised, then her face was full of smiles, relieved that it was okay.
Looking at the Old Turtle’s nearly five-meter-long body and its jet-black turtle shell, Lu Xueqi could guess why it remained unharmed.
This extremely hard turtle shell was simply the best shelter.
Because of the cultivation technique passed on by Ji Ruxue, even without consuming Crystal Cores, the Old Turtle’s growth was rapid, having successfully advanced to the third tier.
Swimming to the shore, the Old Turtle opened its mouth towards Ji Ruxue.
As if saying: Rich lady, I’m hungry~
Instantly, Ji Ruxue’s smiling face stiffened, caught in an awkward moment.
In the past, she would always bring various Mutated Beast Meat to feed the Old Turtle on schedule every day.
But today was different. After the great battle, the warehouse storing Mutated Beast Meat was turned to ash, leaving her penniless with nothing to feed it.
Its mouth agape for quite some time, still empty, causing the Old Turtle to look at its owner with puzzled little eyes.
What’s going on? Did today’s automatic feeding machine malfunction?
The Old Turtle couldn’t help but let out a soft growl at Ji Ruxue on the shore, reminding her.
"Just bear with it for now, find some little fish to munch on. Once things settle down, Daddy will go hunting Mutated Fierce Beasts to ensure plenty of Mutated Beast Meat,"
Ji Ruxue said slowly, patting the Old Turtle’s head with distress.
After comforting the Old Turtle, Ji Ruxue returned to the residential area where she saw Zhao Lin lying on the ground, about to fall asleep.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, are you okay?"
Previously, this woman had been kicked so hard while protecting her that she spat blood. Ji Ruxue was a little worried about her injuries.
"Little Qiqi, there’s no need to worry, I’m fine. Just need a few days’ rest,"
Zhao Lin opened her eyes, got up quickly, and smiled as she looked at Little Qiqi.
"That’s good, then let’s help Daddy clean up the farm together!"
Ji Ruxue suggested with a smile.
"Alright, Little Qiqi, let’s go find your Dad!"
Looking at Little Qiqi’s adorable little face, Zhao Lin felt her exhaustion lighten a bit.
So Zhao Lin took Little Qiqi’s hand and walked towards Lu Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 259: Relocation or Postwar Reconstruction?
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 259: Relocation or Postwar Reconstruction?
At this moment, under Lu Chuan’s command, the entire decayed farm was bustling with activity, corpses coming and going.
In order to clean up the battlefield, all the Evolved Corpse Puppets that survived the great battle on the farm were mobilized.
Lu Chuan not only dispatched the sporadic surviving first and second-level Evolved Corpse Puppets, as well as quite a few third-level ones, but even the fourth-level Corpse Puppets were ruthlessly added to the cleaning team.
At this moment, under Lu Chuan’s manipulation, the Evolved Corpse Puppets moved quickly, first picking up the charred remains of Evolved Corpse Puppets that had been killed or burned to death by artillery fire.
Some were half-buried in the scorched earth due to explosions, requiring the Evolved Corpse Puppets to use their sharp claws and blades to dig them out.
Afterward, Tyrant One and other Corpse Puppets dug large pits in the ground, throwing the charred remains of the Evolved Corpse Puppets into them, with burial being the next step.
Soon after, the dispersed bodies of the Evolvers were also gradually found by the Evolved Corpse Puppets.
These Evolver bodies were all thrown by Lu Chuan to feed the Bloodthirsty Vines.
Thump, thump, thump~
The bodies of the Evolvers were tossed out, turning into black shadows that hit the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall, then fell heavily down, rolling several times on the ground, with blood flowing everywhere.
Instantly, a strong scent of blood quickly filled the air.
Whiz, whiz, whiz~
As the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall reacted, it was like a wild dance of a thousand snakes, with countless motionless Blood-colored Vines suddenly charging out like long snakes at extreme speed, making dense whistling noises.
Poof~
In just a breath, the bodies of the Evolvers on the ground were completely pierced by these Blood-colored Vines.
Soon after, these bodies were quickly wrapped by the Blood-colored Vines and pulled into the vine wall like a nest of snakes.
Immediately, countless Blood-colored Vines rushed into these bodies through the wounds and orifices, frantically sucking their flesh and blood.
In just a few moments, nearly twenty Evolver bodies were sucked to bone fragments by the Bloodthirsty Vines.
And after consuming a large amount of third-level flesh and blood essence, the Bloodthirsty Vines were instantly greatly nourished, each vine emitting a brilliant blood light, evidently benefiting greatly.
Moments later, the once restless Bloodthirsty Vine Wall returned to tranquility, intertwining like blood-colored long snakes, completely still.
Underneath the vine wall lay scattered a large area of ghastly white bones.
While handling the bodies of the Evolvers and Corpse Puppets, the surrounding destroyed buildings were also being cleared by Lu Chuan.
The crumbling walls, charred wood, large piles of rubble under the stone walls, and the orchard’s completely burned, disfigured fruit trees were all gathered by the Evolved Corpse Puppets, stacked in the corner of the farm.
Before long, the building debris had formed a small mountain.
After running over to inquire with Lu Chuan along with Little Qiqi, Zhao Lin also received a task to clean up the amusement park.
Looking at the charred, desolate amusement park before her, Zhao Lin’s mood was indeed quite downcast.
She used to live in this place and had been here for a considerable amount of time.
The amusement park facilities were all destroyed by the helicopter fleet’s artillery fire, either blasted into ruins, devastated, or directly burned to white ash, or left with twisted, deformed frameworks.
Zhao Lin glanced at her slide but found it had been blasted into several segments, structure twisted and deformed.
As for the bed under her slide, it had long been reduced to white ash.
She slowly walked into the amusement park, feeling the still slightly warm ground, then reluctantly tried to reassemble some of the seemingly intact facilities.
Unfortunately, despite several attempts, none succeeded; all efforts were in vain.
Moments later, Zhao Lin gradually approached a pair of iron columns.
Looking at the bent columns before her, Zhao Lin couldn’t help but recall memories of playing with Little Qiqi in the amusement park.
At that time, Little Qiqi was sitting on the swing in front, swinging back and forth, laughing joyously, utterly happy.
But now, all that... is destroyed, leaving only debris and ruins. The amusement park in her memories can never return.
Zhao Lin, feeling distressed, forced herself not to dwell on these matters and focused on cleaning the amusement park.
Not far away, a figure stood still.
Lu Chuan looked at the utterly demolished vegetable plot, feeling gloomy, with no sense of excitement or joy from a victorious battle.
It was a vegetable plot he had painstakingly cultivated: eggplants, tomatoes, cabbages...
The variety of vegetables could sustain the farm for a long time.
But now... Alas, Little Qiqi won’t have any vegetables to eat in the future.
I wonder if this will cause any nutritional deficiencies, affecting Little Qiqi’s growth.
Humans, oh humans, since you won’t let me live peacefully.
Then you can’t blame me!
In Lu Chuan’s faint red eyes, there was deep, chilling intent that would send shivers down one’s spine with a single glance.
Beside the amusement park, Ji Ruxue watched her father standing in the vegetable plot, motionless, understanding that her father must be very sad at the moment.
Looking at the pocked and scarred vegetable plot, Ji Ruxue couldn’t help but sigh.
The farm was arduously managed by her father. Though controlling the Evolved Zombies under his command, it still took considerable effort.
And now, with the vegetable plot destroyed like this, no wonder her father was so upset.
"Little Qiqi, don’t be sad. Your father has so many zombies at his command, I reckon the farm can be rebuilt quickly.
The vegetable plot, orchard, or whatever, can all be replanted.
And the amusement park, you don’t really need to worry.
There are plenty of these facilities in the Jiangnan City District, just look around and there will be heaps. It’s not a difficult task for your father either."
At this moment, Zhao Lin, dragging a pile of scrap metal, heard the sigh and thought Ji Ruxue was saddened by the destruction of the farm. She hurried to put down what she was holding and came over to comfort her.
Ji Ruxue didn’t say a word, just watched her busy father, lost in thought.
So far, this wasn’t the first time Evolvers had invaded the farm, and each time they were stronger.
Currently, the farm’s location probably isn’t a secret to the Human Base City.
Now, with this hard-managed farm destroyed, given her father’s nature, he likely wouldn’t continue to stay here.
Ji Ruxue guessed that next, her father would probably leave here and head to another place to rebuild their home.
She just didn’t know where her father planned to go next.
At this thought, a determined look suddenly appeared in Ji Ruxue’s eyes.
No matter where her father goes, she will follow.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 260: From Now On, Wherever We Go Is Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 260: From Now On, Wherever We Go Is Home
Several hours later, the farm’s cleanup work was finally completed.
The distance from the house to the stone wall in front is now completely open and clear, with no obstructions in sight.
The craters in the vegetable garden caused by explosions, along with the various ravines left by the battles, have all been filled in, leaving no trace of what once was.
Only the patches of dark ground, stained with blood, serve as a testament to the fierce battle that once took place on this land.
The spot where the amusement park once stood is now completely barren. All the destroyed amusement facilities were cleared out of the farm by Zhao Lin, and the residual white ash from the fire was also cleaned up, leaving only a scorched, blackened earth behind.
In the orchard at the back, the charred stumps of trees, burned black by flames, were pulled up by Da Pang and Er Pang. The holes left behind were then filled in one by one.
As a result, what was once a lush and bountiful orchard has been reduced to a barren wasteland.
Beneath the outer stone wall, the piles of rubble from broken stone have also been cleaned up.
And on the stone wall, several gaps have appeared at regular intervals, now wide enough to allow a truck to pass through, making the inside visible from the outside, completely losing the function of the wall.
If it weren’t for the additional layer of the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall outside, the farm’s security would be greatly compromised and unsuitable for habitation.
At this moment, the cleaned farm, apart from the central house, is utterly empty, destitute of anything.
Outside the house, the three stood together, looking at the desolate farm, their expressions grim.
Lu Chuan and Ji Ruxue’s faces were cold, while Zhao Lin’s face showed a hint of worry.
Looking at the scene in front of her, Zhao Lin felt a surge of emotion.
Just yesterday, it was a vibrant landscape, with lush green vegetable gardens where some evolved zombies tended to the weeds and watered the plants; the bountiful orchard also had evolved zombies pruning and de-weeding; and on both sides of the sturdy stone wall, evolved zombies patrolled...
Yet overnight, the vast farm, what she considered a paradise on earth, had suddenly become this "destitute" state, leaving one heartbroken. Those evolvers really were inhuman.
From Lu Chuan’s perspective, his heart must be filled with anger towards humanity too. Everything he’d painstakingly built was destroyed by these damned humans!
Having lived here for so long, she could tell that the Corpse King had invested a lot of effort in this farm.
Those evolvers... sigh, although it’s a Corpse King, it hasn’t provoked you in any way, quietly staying in the farm minding its own business. Why do you people keep pestering?
Now, despite destroying the farm, not only did they fail to kill the Corpse King, they also lost their own lives in the process.
It’s truly not worth it!
"Daddy, don’t be sad. Even though the vegetable garden and orchard... these things are gone, we can find and build them again in the future.
The farm can still be restored to its original state."
Standing beside, Ji Ruxue consoled her father.
She didn’t want her father to remain saddened by this, as what’s done is done, and everything needed to be looked forward to.
Just like Zhao Lin mentioned earlier, with the evolved zombies under her father’s command, the vegetable garden, orchard, and even the entire farm, could quickly be restored.
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan lowered his head, gently stroked Little Qiqi’s head, and smiled.
This little one really knows how to console people, it’s worth doting on you.
However, with the little one’s words, Lu Chuan felt a bit better and his expression softened considerably.
"Lu Chuan, what are your plans for the future? If you want to rebuild the farm, I can help."
Over here, Zhao Lin looked at Lu Chuan and couldn’t help but ask.
Regarding what happened last night, she actually felt very guilty.
After all, the farm’s destruction was a sin committed by humans, and she was human too, making her feel a bit apologetic towards the other party.
So if she could contribute to the rebuilding of the farm, it would also alleviate her guilt somewhat, making her feel better.
Moreover, she had previously suggested the peaceful coexistence of humans and zombies in the future. At that time, although the Corpse King didn’t agree, it didn’t reject either, indicating that there was room for negotiation.
As long as she could become the supreme leader of humans, there was a good chance of making this happen.
But what she never expected was that before she could even say much, the human evolvers turned around and crazily attacked the farm, even going as far as to destroy it completely.
This made her afterwards, hesitant to speak of the coexistence of humans and zombies to the Corpse King again.
Rebuild?
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan shook his head. Even if the farm was rebuilt, what then?
Wouldn’t it be destroyed by humans again?
The farm was already exposed to the humans’ gaze, and with their heavy losses this time, it was inevitable that the farm would suffer a frenzied retaliation from humans.
Thus, the option to rebuild the farm was never part of Lu Chuan’s consideration.
He already had plans for his future path in mind.
Previously, he chose to hide out in this place because Little Qiqi was still young, and he wanted to provide Little Qiqi with a stable life.
Allow her to grow up well without constantly moving around, living in a post-apocalyptic environment.
But now it seems, he was overthinking, you don’t need to seek trouble for it to find you.
This situation isn’t something you can avoid by simply hiding.
Isn’t this farm remote enough? It’s neither in Jiangnan City District nor any towns.
Yet he hid on the farm, and these human evolvers still found their way here, bringing malice each time.
Tiger doesn’t intend to harm people, yet people bear harm in mind for the tiger... Lu Chuan understood that constantly running away won’t solve the problem.
When Zhao Lin saw that the Corpse King actually decided not to rebuild the farm, her expression slightly changed.
She understood that last night’s attack had definitely caused the other party to change.
And whether this change is good or bad... no one knows, especially concerning humanity.
It should be known that Lu Chuan was a Corpse King possessing human intelligence. Once the other party’s mindset shifts dramatically and starts harboring hostility towards humans... it is no exaggeration to say that humanity’s disaster would be upon them.
Humanity had released a fierce tiger that would bite back to death themselves...
Thinking of this, Zhao Lin turned pale and forced herself not to imagine the worst-case scenario.
But looking at Lu Chuan’s silent demeanor, exuding coldness, she couldn’t help it herself.
Next to her, Ji Ruxue was even more certain that her father was planning to move, so she couldn’t help but ask, "Daddy, are we leaving this place?"
After a moment of silence, Lu Chuan looked at Zhao Lin and Little Qiqi, who were intently watching him, and wrote on a piece of paper, "Little Qiqi, henceforth, wherever we go, there shall be home."

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 261: Little 77, From Now On You’ll Be Wandering Everywhere with Daddy
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 261: Little 77, From Now On You’ll Be Wandering Everywhere with Daddy
Ji Ruxue guessed right, Lu Chuan has already decided to leave Qingshui Farm.
The location of Qingshui Farm is rather remote, which played an important role in Lu Chuan’s early development and was beneficial for Little Qiqi’s growth.
Actually, if everything remained peaceful and stable here, Lu Chuan felt that he could live here indefinitely until Little Qiqi grew up.
Unfortunately, this place has already caught the attention of humans.
Repeated failures will not deter humans; instead, it will serve as a reminder to them, making them realize that Lu Chuan is a significant threat to humans that must be eliminated as soon as possible.
So staying at the farm will only lead to endless trouble in the future.
And Lu Chuan no longer wants to experience the farm being destroyed again.
The feeling of seeing everything he had painstakingly accumulated turn to ashes in an instant was something he really couldn’t accept.
To be honest, with Lu Chuan’s ability to manipulate zombies, he should never have had to hide.
It should be humans fearing Lu Chuan’s attack, rather than Lu Chuan being forced to defend against the Human Evolvers.
Because as long as Lu Chuan entered the city, relying on the millions of zombies in the city, no one would dare to act against him easily.
If he were provoked, with just a wave of his hand, a massive Corpse Tide would come surging in, and soon, it would be able to wipe out the Human Base City.
It was only before, for the sake of Little Qiqi’s safe growth, that Lu Chuan thought of temporarily finding a safe place to settle down and allow Little Qiqi to live peacefully.
But now, the peaceful life has been disrupted repeatedly, and the facts prove that hiding away cannot avoid trouble. Therefore, Lu Chuan naturally has no more reason to hide in the future.
From now on, he wants to go wherever he pleases!
He has so many fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, there is nowhere in the world he can’t go.
Especially in human cities rich in resources, where there are abundant supplies.
Just casually searching a bit would be enough for Little Qiqi to live comfortably for a long time.
The only downside is that after leaving the farm this time, he won’t be able to provide Little Qiqi with the ideal life she desires.
In the future, she can only follow him through rough times, living a vagabond life, and everything they encounter along the way will no longer be as beautiful as it was on the farm.
The most they might see is all kinds of killings and the unique desolation of the apocalypse.
Of course, there are also benefits, at least they won’t have to live in constant fear at Qingshui Farm, worrying about when an attack from Human Evolvers might come.
Lu Chuan absolutely won’t accept this passive waiting to die.
Lu Chuan can be certain that if he continues to stay here, sooner or later, there will be Human Evolvers coming again.
At that time, there will be another battle, and their strength will be even more terrifying than this time.
In a previous battle, Lu Chuan overheard those Evolvers referring to Little Qiqi as an evolver who awakened the ability to manipulate zombies, wanting to recruit Little Qiqi into the human command.
Afterward, when softer methods didn’t work, they used force, persistently targeting Little Qiqi.
This indicated that the other party placed great importance on Little Qiqi, and the forces behind them wouldn’t easily let go of the farm.
So to avoid unnecessary trouble, it’s better to leave this farm soon.
Next, Lu Chuan wrote again on paper: "Little Qiqi, get ready. Tomorrow, we’re leaving here. Organize all your treasured items, and we’ll take them together."
Ji Ruxue understood this in her heart, obediently nodding, and said, "Got it, Dad."
Ji Ruxue was already mentally prepared for this; she just didn’t know where Dad would take her first?
Regarding this, Ji Ruxue was still quite looking forward to it.
After all, staying on the farm for a long time might be safe, but it also gets boring, and the place is too isolated in terms of information.
Even if Ji Ruxue wanted to develop, she couldn’t.
She couldn’t interact with other humans, and various knowledge and methods from her past life couldn’t be used against Evolved Zombies!
The most frustrating part was that she couldn’t even train a few subordinates.
Just like Zhao Lin, this Nine Deaths Demon Police from a past life, if not for a chance coincidence, they might never have met.
Lu Chuan continued writing on the paper: "Let’s go! Go back to the house with Dad to rest and eat some meat porridge to fill our stomachs."
"Okay!"
Mentioning food, Ji Ruxue realized she hadn’t eaten breakfast yet, and immediately felt her stomach was empty, nodding happily.
But just as Lu Chuan was about to take Little Qiqi and turn back to the house, he was stopped by Zhao Lin, who had been hesitating for a long time.
"Lu Chuan, where do you plan to go?"
Zhao Lin couldn’t help but ask.
She was a little worried, guessing if he was planning to retaliate against the Human Survivor Base out of anger.
The farm being destroyed, Lu Chuan must be seething with hatred towards humans.
It’s not that she’s worried about the Human Base City. She’s mainly afraid that Lu Chuan would act too impulsively, confronting humans head-on in a battle to the death, which would only end in mutual destruction, yielding no benefits.
Hearing this, Lu Chuan glanced at Zhao Lin, didn’t answer, and instead looked down at Little Qiqi. He wrote on the paper: "Little Qiqi, in the future, you’ll have to wander around with Dad. Is there anywhere you want to go?"
"Wherever Dad goes, I’ll go!"
Ji Ruxue hugged Lu Chuan’s leg in a very obedient manner and said with a sweet smile, showing utmost dependence.
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan smiled, patted Little Qiqi’s head, then turned his gaze to Zhao Lin and wrote on the paper: "What about you? Where do you want to go? Once I take Little Qiqi away, you can leave."
This time, Zhao Lin, in order to save Little Qiqi, shielded her from a knife without hesitation and later even risked her life to fight consecutively with third-tier Evolvers.
This made Lu Chuan gain a bit more acknowledgment of Zhao Lin in his heart, and he believed that Zhao Lin genuinely wanted to protect Little Qiqi.
So if Zhao Lin wanted to leave, he was willing to let her go.
"You’re willing to let me go?"
Seeing the words on the paper, Zhao Lin was a bit surprised and looked up at Lu Chuan.
Lu Chuan wore a faint smile and nodded at Zhao Lin.
Whether Zhao Lin stayed or left, he wouldn’t interfere, leaving it entirely up to her own will.
Though having her stay would give Little Qiqi a companion and someone to talk to, Lu Chuan saw everything Zhao Lin did for Little Qiqi.
Seeing this, Zhao Lin felt a sense of joy in her heart.
If Lu Chuan stayed true to his promise, then she would be truly free. But thinking back, having pledged to always protect Little Qiqi’s safety and her grand ambitions previously stated in front of Lu Chuan...
Recalling the treacherous human nature she witnessed on the journey post-apocalypse, and the comfortable life after entering the farm, formed a stark contrast in Zhao Lin’s mind.
The next moment, Zhao Lin, somewhat conflicted, bit her lip and said: "I’ve decided not to leave for now. I promised to protect Little Qiqi. She’s still young and doesn’t have the ability to protect herself yet!"

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 262: Leaving Qingshui Farm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 262: Leaving Qingshui Farm!
Zhao Lin chose to stay, and Lu Chuan naturally welcomed it.
He nodded to Zhao Lin and wrote on the paper: "Sure! We’ll set off tomorrow."
Seeing this, Zhao Lin felt relieved, thinking that Lu Chuan might find her a burden and take this chance to send her away; it seemed she was overthinking.
"Let’s go! Let’s go back inside and have a meal together! Last night, it was hard work."
Lu Chuan wrote these words on a paper, handed it to Zhao Lin, and then pulled Little Qiqi, heading towards the house.
Zhao Lin looked at the words on the paper, a bright smile appeared on her face. She looked up at the backs of Lu Chuan and Little Qiqi, following them with light steps.
While Little Qiqi and Zhao Lin were sitting at the table eating, Lu Chuan had already begun to take action.
Since he decided to leave, Lu Chuan immediately started the necessary preparations to avoid any delay tomorrow.
Lu Chuan first went alone to the back of the house.
At this moment, the Corpse Puppets, including the Tyrant, were all summoned by Lu Chuan to gather here.
First, he took a bloodstained bag from the hands of the Tyrant, which contained several Crystal Cores.
Then, Lu Chuan set his gaze ahead on the Evolved Corpse Puppets.
In total, there were ten third-tier Corpse Puppets and seven fourth-tier Corpse Puppets.
These were all the Corpse Puppets he currently possessed, and his initial safety guarantee upon leaving the farm.
As for the lingering first and second-tier Corpse Puppets and some damaged third-tier ones, they were decisively killed by Lu Chuan, and he extracted their Crystal Cores, which were in the bag.
Because the first and second-tier Corpse Puppets, and some damaged third-tier ones were entirely burdensome to Lin Chuan, it was better to deal with them directly and make the load lighter.
With a thought, Lu Chuan commanded the Corpse Puppets to disperse across the farm, conducting surveillance.
He himself took the bag and walked into the room, ready to wash each blood-stained and brain-fluid-covered Crystal Core clean with water.
A while later, Little Qiqi had finished eating and rushed out.
Lu Chuan went to the table, looking at Zhao Lin, who had just put down her chopsticks, and wrote on the paper: "Zhao Lin, next, you and I will pack the supplies inside the house, anything usable, load it all into the vehicles."
"Alright!"
Reading the words on the paper, Zhao Lin nodded and agreed happily.
Having joined Lu Chuan’s big family, she naturally needed to lend a hand in moving.
Next, Lu Chuan took Zhao Lin, picking and choosing items in the house, packing everything useful and loading it onto the vehicles.
By the fishpond.
"Little Turtle!"
Ji Ruxue looked at the Old Turtle with a face full of smiles.
The Old Turtle had proved itself quite worthy, having eaten many Crystal Cores not in vain.
The Old Turtle floating on the water emitted a formidable presence, having advanced to the third tier, its body size was over six meters, and its Ink Jade Turtle Shell was wide enough to park a car on.
Just earlier, when her father was washing the Crystal Cores, Ji Ruxue used her cuteness to get a few second and third-tier Crystal Cores from him, which were now all in the Old Turtle’s stomach.
Roar!
Having consumed the Crystal Cores, the Old Turtle was quite excited, paddling its limbs, approaching Ji Ruxue, its pair of ink jade-colored forelimbs hanging on the shore, nudging her, displaying great docility.
"Little Turtle, starting tomorrow, we are going to leave this place!
In the short term, you won’t be able to live in the water, you have to adapt!"
Ji Ruxue gently petted the Old Turtle’s head.
At that moment, the Old Turtle climbed onto the shore, turning its turtle shell towards Ji Ruxue.
Ji Ruxue smiled, leaping onto the turtle shell, sitting down.
Under Ji Ruxue’s command, the Old Turtle quickly crawled to the gap in the stone wall and stopped instantly.
Ji Ruxue looked at the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall ahead, frowning slightly.
Obviously, these well-living Bloodthirsty Vines weren’t like the Old Turtle, unable to leave with her and her father, and could only stay here.
Thinking of this, Ji Ruxue felt a bit of a pity. These Bloodthirsty Vines had previously rendered great service when facing Human Evolvers.
But the Bloodthirsty Vines couldn’t move, and there were too many of them, otherwise Ji Ruxue would have truly wanted her father to take all these Bloodthirsty Vines along.
However, even if she left the farm, these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines would still be under her control, and if they matured, she could return to harvest Blood Crystals.
As long as they weren’t destroyed, these Bloodthirsty Demon Vines would someday yield a harvest.
As Ji Ruxue was lost in thought, a voice shouted from behind.
"Qiqi, come over here!"
Zhao Lin stood by the door, holding a small bag, waving to Ji Ruxue.
"Coming!"
"Little Turtle, quickly take me over."
Hearing this, Ji Ruxue hastily turned her head, responded, and then patted the Old Turtle’s turtle shell.
Rumble~
The Old Turtle carried Ji Ruxue, rushing swiftly towards Zhao Lin, kicking up dust along the path.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, what can I do for you?"
Sitting on the Old Turtle’s back, Ji Ruxue asked with some puzzlement.
"Look, I found these when I was packing things, some vegetable seeds. I’ll plant them in the vegetable field later... maybe someday we will return, and I hope by then these vegetables will have grown again!"
Although the vegetable field had been leveled during the cleanup, the soil there remained fertile, quite suitable for the growth of vegetables.
"How about it? Want to come with me to plant some vegetables, Qiqi?"
Zhao Lin said with a cheerful smile, shaking the bag in her hand at Little Qiqi.
"Okay!"
Ji Ruxue didn’t hesitate and readily agreed.
Then Zhao Lin took Little Qiqi and the Old Turtle to the vegetable field location and began planting.
Under Ji Ruxue’s direction, the Old Turtle used its claws to draw trenches in the ground, while Zhao Lin planted the seeds one by one.
Not long after, a small handful of vegetable seeds were all planted.
"Alright, let’s go back!"
Zhao Lin clapped the dust off her hands, looked at the field already planted with seeds, feeling very satisfied, and then she brought Little Qiqi back.
The next day.
A convoy slowly drove out of the farm, and after some time, the zombie convoy finally entered the Jiangnan City District.
Lu Chuan hugged Little Qiqi, sitting on the Old Turtle, leading in the front.
The speed of this Mutated Giant Turtle wasn’t any slower than a car and was even more stable, with no bumps at all during the journey.
Zhao Lin sat in the first truck behind Lu Chuan, looking listlessly at the desolate scenery along the way.
Under Lu Chuan’s control, the zombies in front of the convoy gave way, allowing a clear, unbothered path.
The convoy crossed a large area and was about to leave the Jiangnan City District when, with a thought from Lu Chuan, the zombies within the city district simultaneously let out roars, as if sending off their king!

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 263: Flood Dragon Enters the Sea, From Now On the Sky’s the Limit!
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 263: Flood Dragon Enters the Sea, From Now On the Sky’s the Limit!
Night fell, and the chill deepened over the wilderness beyond Jiangnan City District.
Mist drifted faintly in the darkness, causing the surrounding temperature to plummet rapidly.
At this moment, in this desolate wilderness, an exceptionally rare bonfire suddenly flared up, its blaze shooting skyward, drawing significant attention.
Occasionally, large sparks flew from the bonfire, swept up by the wilderness wind, disappearing into the darkness.
Surrounding the bonfire were two side-by-side green tents already set up, faint light seeping out from within.
At the farthest point reachable by the firelight stood a group of tall, imposing figures, guarding the campsite from behind.
These figures were, of course, the ten Stage Three Corpse Puppets under Lu Chuan’s command.
The seven Stage Four Corpse Puppets were chosen by Lu Chuan to spread out within the campsite to provide close protection for Little Qiqi.
This wilderness had no wall protection around it, giving a sense of insecurity. Without deploying several Corpse Puppets as guards, Lu Chuan would likely find it hard to sleep.
At this time, Little Qiqi and Zhao Lin were sitting nearby at a collapsible dining table.
Meanwhile, Lu Chuan was busying himself in front of the bonfire.
An iron rack was placed above the bonfire; on it was a long, flat-bottomed grill pan.
Lu Chuan used tongs to pick up slices of marbled meat, placing them on the pan to grill.
In a short time, under the searing flames, the grill pan turned entirely red, sizzling the meat slices, releasing a rich and enticing aroma, enough to make one’s mouth water.
These meat slices were from a Stage Two Mutated Giant Bull, one of the fierce beasts Lu Chuan hunted on the road.
Leaving Jiangnan City District and entering the wilderness, the convoy had encountered many Evolved Zombies and Mutated Fierce Beasts along the way.
Lu Chuan naturally wouldn’t pass up the benefits laid before him.
Whether Stage One or Stage Two Evolved Corpse Puppets, all were harvested for their Crystal Cores.
Stage Three Evolved Zombies, however, were rare, and the convoy hadn’t encountered any.
For the fierce beasts encountered, regardless of their level, they were all outright eliminated.
After slaughtering them, all Crystal Cores were extracted, while the flesh was stored away in the convoy.
Some of the premium portions were eaten, while the rest of the flesh could be used to feed the Stage Three Corpse Puppets, accelerating their growth.
With seventeen Evolved Corpse Puppets as bodyguards, the convoy had a high level of safety during its journey, rarely disturbed by fierce beasts or zombies.
This was because they were shot down by the Evolved Corpse Puppets before they could even approach.
After filling the grill pan, Lu Chuan set the tongs down, staring quietly toward Jiangnan City District with a deep, unfathomable gaze.
Now, having vanished from there, on the boundless land, he was free to roam, like a Flood Dragon entering the sea, entirely liberated, flowing freely through this vast world.
In this chaotic apocalypse, humans could only hold sway over everything within the limited range outside of Base City.
Once beyond this frontier, everything outside was beyond human control.
Especially in the wilderness, where the situation was extremely complex, Lu Chuan existed like a drop of water in the ocean. It was impossible for humans to determine his location again.
From now on, the sky is the limit!
Unlike before in the farm, where Lu Chuan, under its influence, felt locked in place.
In such circumstances, if a Human Evolver wanted to attack him for revenge, they wouldn’t have to think much—just show up at the farm.
This put Lu Chuan at a considerable disadvantage.
But now, in the wilderness, even if humans wanted revenge, they couldn’t find him, and going to the farm would be in vain.
Sizzle~
Returning to his senses, seeing the meat slices nearly done, Lu Chuan moved them all onto a plate, then used the tongs to place new slices onto the grill.
Carrying a plate full of grilled meat, Lu Chuan slowly walked to the dining table, placing the plate in front of the two.
"Thank you, Dad!"
Ji Ruxue beamed happily, thanking Lu Chuan with joy.
"Thank you, Lu Chuan,"
Zhao Lin said, a bit embarrassed.
Getting the Corpse King to grill meat for her—no one would probably believe it if she told them!
Lu Chuan smiled, nodding to the two, then shifted his gaze to Little Qiqi, writing on paper: "Little Qiqi, do you want to add more spice?"
Unpacking the supplies, Lu Chuan made sure to bring various necessities, including seasoning necessary for grilling.
Without these items, one could only eat it plain grilled.
"No need, Dad!"
Ji Ruxue shook her head; she was already getting impatient as the aroma of the grilled meat heightened her appetite.
After confirming Little Qiqi had no such desire, Lu Chuan nodded and turned back to the bonfire.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, hurry and eat!"
The next moment, Ji Ruxue politely invited Zhao Lin before quickly picking up pieces of meat with her chopsticks, stuffing them into her mouth, chewing with a pleased expression.
At her prompting, Zhao Lin also picked up a piece of grilled meat, placing it into her mouth.
Instantly, the charred flavor and delicious oils exploded in her mouth, causing a surge of saliva that couldn’t be controlled.
Soon after, Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue had devoured more than half the grilled meat on the plate.
Putting down her chopsticks, Zhao Lin instinctively reached for the bottle of beer on the table, but grasped nothing.
Instantly realizing, Zhao Lin gave a wry smile.
"If only there were beer!"
Zhao Lin began to reminisce about her time at the farm.
Back then, there was plenty of beer in the warehouse, but most of it was blown up, thanks to those Human Evolvers.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, do you want beer?"
Ji Ruxue noticed Zhao Lin reaching empty, speaking with amusement.
"No, I was just used to it before; it doesn’t matter if I drink or not!"
Zhao Lin shook her head vigorously, reluctant to admit this in front of Little Qiqi.
"Really? I remember seeing you ask my dad for beer every time you had a barbecue."
Ji Ruxue innocently inquired.
"Uh... no, no! It’s just a barbecue—I can do with or without drinking!" Zhao Lin awkwardly responded.
"Oh, is that so! I saw Dad take a case of beer from the room to the car, but it seems it’s not needed now."
Ji Ruxue regretfully shook her head.
"Wait! Little Qiqi, that beer... which car is it in?"
Zhao Lin asked urgently.
"Hee hee, I was just teasing you, Mrs. Zhao Lin. Didn’t you say you didn’t want beer?"
"Ah, Little Qiqi, you tricked me!"
"Oh no, stop tickling me, it’s too itchy, haha~"
"Getting you back for tricking me, let’s see if you’ll dare again."
Hearing this, seeing them laughing, Lu Chuan felt a wave of comfort in his heart.
It seemed Little Qiqi was not opposed to this lifestyle.
After seeing them finish playing, the grilled meat gone, Lu Chuan approached, writing: "Alright, everyone, sleep early! We have to continue our journey tomorrow!"
Moments later, Zhao Lin led Ji Ruxue into the tent.
Leaving Lu Chuan alone outside, silently observing the flickering flames.
This time, he did not intend to stop; he would stay in a new place each day.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 264: Mutant Fruit!
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 264: Mutant Fruit!
In the morning, the gentle sunlight spilled over the camp from the eastern horizon.
Lu Chuan leaned against the car window, holding a map, carefully looking at the area near Jianghai City.
Beside him, Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue sat at the dining table, chatting and laughing while eating meat porridge.
This is easy to make—a handful of rice, and just cut some meat and throw it in. It’s very convenient to make in the wild.
Lu Chuan was now using the map to determine where their convoy should head next.
The convoy couldn’t just wander aimlessly across the wilderness; it was best to follow the roads from before the apocalypse, which are the most convenient.
Jianghai City belongs to Jiang Province. At this time, Lu Chuan and the others were already outside the Jianghai City District.
If they continue south, they will reach another city in Jiang Province, the neighboring city of Jianghai City, Northstar City.
Northstar City is not smaller in scale than Jianghai City. Lu Chuan decided that the next step is to head to Northstar City.
After all, as the Zombie King capable of controlling zombies, Lu Chuan wanted to strengthen his power, which was inseparable from zombies, especially evolved zombies with crystal cores.
And in this world, where there are large numbers of evolved zombies, it’s naturally in densely populated urban areas.
After all, only with large numbers of ordinary zombies can enough evolved zombies be cultivated.
For instance, Jiangnan City District is just like this, but now the evolved zombies in Jiangnan City District have been picked clean by Lu Chuan.
It might take a long time for a significant number of evolved zombies to appear again in the city district.
The Jiangnan City District is like a mining field that Lu Chuan has already emptied. Now he’s ready to head to a new mining field, Northstar City.
At this moment, Zhao Lin and Little Qiqi, having finished eating, came over.
"Lu Chuan, where is our next step?"
Zhao Lin looked at the map with curiosity.
"Yeah, Dad, where are we going next?"
Ji Ruxue, who was wiping her mouth with a tissue, also couldn’t help but ask.
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan looked at the two with a smile and pointed on the map with his hand.
"Northstar City?"
...
Two days later.
On the national highway leading to Northstar City, a convoy was steadily advancing, as the mutant giant turtle quickly pushed aside the vehicles blocking the road, ensuring the convoy traveled unimpeded.
Inside the convoy, Lu Chuan sat in the passenger seat, turned to look at the somewhat weary Zhao Lin and Little Qiqi, and decided in his mind to find a place to rest next, and also gather some supplies.
Lu Chuan took out the map, checked it, and found a small town ahead, Jiangli Town.
"Let’s rest at Jiangli Town."
Having decided, Lu Chuan put the map away again.
Soon, the convoy stopped at a junction.
"Jiangli Town? Yes, this should be the place."
Looking at the road sign with the words Jiangli Town, Lu Chuan felt certain, and with a thought, the convoy set off again, turning into the junction and heading to Jiangli Town at the end of the road.
"Huh? Lu Chuan, where are we heading? Aren’t we going to Northstar City?"
Zhao Lin, feeling somewhat drowsy, asked confusedly at the change in direction.
"Let’s rest at the small town first, you and Little Qiqi are exhausted from the journey."
Upon hearing this, Lu Chuan wrote down his response on a note.
"Alright."
Seeing the words on the note, Zhao Lin nodded.
This journey involved either traveling by car or sleeping in tents, which was indeed tiring.
She was still okay, but it was hard on Little Qiqi, who was so young, having to endure such tiring travel. Now, they could finally rest in the town.
The convoy drove along a narrow concrete road for about ten minutes before finally arriving at Jiangli Town.
As soon as the convoy entered, a massive wave of visitors greeted them.
The noise from the mutant giant turtle ramming into vehicles ahead, combined with the sound of the convoy moving, directly alerted the zombies wandering in the small town.
Roar roar~
A large number of zombies roared and surged out from the surrounding houses, flooding the streets, forming a massive corpse tide that rushed toward the convoy.
Lu Chuan calmly watched the corpse tide ahead, as his Spiritual Power surged, like a tide, in an instant turning the zombies ahead into manipulable corpse puppets.
Instantly, the previously fierce zombies stopped in place, and soon they automatically cleared a path allowing the convoy to pass.
"Is this the Zombie King’s formidable corpse control ability?"
It was the first time Zhao Lin saw Lu Chuan’s ability to control zombies from the back seat, her eyes wide with shock.
It’s truly terrifying; humans should definitely not provoke Lu Chuan in the future, or the consequences would be unimaginable if he ever lashed out!
At this time, Lu Chuan naturally had no idea Zhao Lin had so many thoughts in her mind. With a thought, all the third-tier corpse puppets in the convoy stepped out and joined the corpse tide on both sides.
Boom! Boom!
In an instant, the third-tier corpse puppets launched an attack on these immobile zombie groups, breaking open the heads of the evolved zombies, extracting the crystal cores.
In facing these zombies encountered along the route, Lu Chuan’s principle was not to bother with ordinary zombies; all first-tier and second-tier zombies were to be killed for their crystal cores, but all third-tier and fourth-tier were kept to enhance his army of corpse puppets.
However, there were only two third-tier zombies in this small town, and no fourth-tier zombies at all.
Moreover, they were all agile-type evolved zombies, and after dealing with the zombie horde, these two third-tier agile-type evolved zombies returned with the other third-tier corpse puppets.
So Lu Chuan’s army of third-tier corpse puppets expanded to twelve, while the fourth-tier remained at seven.
Taking a bag containing crystal cores from a corpse puppet, the convoy started again, driving through the path opened by the zombie horde, finally entering the small town.
Not long after, Lu Chuan and the others chose a kindergarten in the town as their resting place, as it was surrounded by walls, making it easier to defend and relatively safe.
In the kindergarten, in an office, Lu Chuan leaned back in a chair with the map in his hand, his eyes showing a look of recollection.
Over the past two days, from the outskirts of Jianghai City to the outskirts of Northstar City, they killed quite a few fierce beasts and zombies, and collected a lot of resources for living.
For instance, they found an undamaged vegetable garden and harvested a batch of fresh vegetables. They also came across a pear orchard by the road, picking some pears, including a few mutant ones with completely black skin.
At that time, Little Qiqi shouted for a taste, but Lu Chuan initially refused, worried there might be a problem with the fruit.
He wrote on paper: "Little Qiqi, eating this fruit might cause a stomach ache."
Zhao Lin was also curious, looking at Little Qiqi, "Little Qiqi, can this fruit really be eaten?"
"Of course, Mrs. Zhao Lin, trust me!"
As Little Qiqi spoke, Zhao Lin took a bite of the black-skinned pear, immediately feeling invigorated.
Later, according to Zhao Lin’s description, after eating this black-skinned pear, you feel energetic, all fatigue disappears, and essence and energy are replenished, with excellent effect.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 265: Growing Stronger Through Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 265: Growing Stronger Through Battle
The downtown area of Beicheng in the apocalypse is no different from Jiangnan City District, with its ruins and desolation, utterly devoid of life.
On the streets, a large number of cars are parked haphazardly, extremely chaotic, some vehicles have collided with one another, becoming dilapidated with parts scattered everywhere, some car windows are shattered with the inside covered in dark-colored bloodstains.
Between the vehicles, you can occasionally see rotten corpses lying on the dark red ground, with flies swarming and emitting bursts of stench.
At the same time, the storefronts on both sides of the street are in a state of devastation, with glass windows completely smashed by violent means and goods scattered everywhere, some roll-up doors show signs of being forcibly pried open, and some doors are still smudged with blood, indicating the chaos that occurred here when the apocalypse arrived.
A gust of wind sweeps through the streets, scattering all kinds of trash everywhere, some even drifting onto the heads of wandering zombies, causing them to let out bursts of roars.
Between the city’s corners and high-rise buildings, you can occasionally spot evolved zombies revealing themselves, disappearing in a flash.
Rumbling sounds~
At this moment, the noise generated by moving vehicles comes from the north of the city.
From afar to near, suddenly every zombie that was previously aimlessly wandering halts its footsteps, their heads slowly swaying as if discerning the direction from which the sound is coming.
Roar!
In the next moment, numerous zombies let out a roar and rushed toward the north of the city.
From buildings, shops, and residential buildings, many zombies burst out, including evolved zombies, gathering on various streets.
Finally, they assemble from the streets, forming a massive horde of zombies that surges toward the direction of the noise like a black tide.
On the main road of the northern city area, feeling the vibration from the ground and the sound akin to thousands of troops charging forward, Lu Chuan controls the convoy and slowly stops.
Looking at the end of the road, where a group of zombies has appeared, Lu Chuan is not surprised, as he anticipated this situation even before entering the downtown area of Beicheng.
Unless someone deliberately clears out the zombies from Beicheng, the convoy driving into Beicheng is bound to face the impact of the zombie horde.
Rumble rumble rumble~
More and more zombies appear ahead, even directly filling the main road, crazily rushing toward the convoy,
Watching the overwhelming rush of zombies, Zhao Lin in the back seat feels slightly panicked.
Although she understands in her heart that no matter how many zombies there are, to the Corpse King, they are nothing, seeing so many zombies charging at her all at once makes her inevitably tense.
Beside her, Ji Ruxue sensed it and comforted, "Mrs. Zhao Lin, don’t worry! These zombies can’t do anything to Dad."
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin returns to her senses, knowing she was overthinking things, then smiles and nods at Little Qiqi.
At the front, Lu Chuan looks at the attacking zombies with a calm demeanor; to him, these zombies are not threats but mines, all here to deliver resources.
With a thought, Lu Chuan commands the convoy’s Da Pang and other fourth-tier zombies to advance toward the zombie horde.
Boom boom boom~
Da Pang, Er Pang, and Tyrant One lead the charge, directly rushing into the zombie horde, causing chaos, with a large number of zombies getting knocked flying, and many attacked and torn apart.
Boom!
Da Pang’s punches land solidly with every punch unleashing deafening bursts, zombies on the path explode into blood and flesh.
Simultaneously, a pair of arms like metal door panels fling surrounding zombies away.
Beside him, Er Pang swings a massive iron rod, like the Demon Lord of Chaos, sweeping with every swing, splitting a large swath of zombies into pieces.
The zombies on the periphery are flipped by the terrifying force.
On the far-right side, Tyrant One, wielding claw blades like pitch-black long knives, slices through the zombies like a harvester, chopping large swathes of zombies into fragments, piling them on the ground.
With three strong fourth-tier Corpse Puppets blocking the front, the massive zombie tide cannot surge forward.
Besides Tyrant One and the other fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, others also began to engage.
As Elemental Zombies, Flame One, Flame Two, and Earth Escape One stand behind, sending out spell attacks toward the zombie tide ahead.
Flame One and Flame Two fire blazing fireballs, each with a one-meter diameter, like rocket launchers, condensing and falling onto the zombie horde.
Rumble rumble rumble~
Instantly, the zombie horde explodes into a blaze, with countless zombies killed by the fireballs, creating open spaces in the horde.
At the same time, flames splash from the exploded fireballs, igniting more zombies, making the whole horde completely chaotic.
On the side, Earth Escape One gathers massive boulders like meteorites to fall, targeting the zombie horde below.
Boom!
The instant the boulder hits, it crushes the evolved zombies below into pulp, with debris shattering and tearing surrounding zombies into blood and mist.
Remaining Lightning One doesn’t rush forward but marks zombies, quickly picking off those that slipped by, standing behind Tyrant One and other Corpse Puppets.
With seven fourth-tier Corpse Puppets slaughtering the zombie horde, under Lu Chuan’s command, all low-tier evolved zombies are culled for their Crystal Cores, while third-tier evolved zombies are directly subdued as his Corpse Puppets.
After more than ten minutes, the constant stream of the zombie horde thins, unable to sustain anymore.
Moments later, the convoy slowly passes through the nearly clogged main road, with zombie bodies piled high behind like mountains, emitting a pungent stench.
Heading into the city district, the convoy eventually stops at a fuel station.
Controlling his Corpse Puppets to gather fuel from the station, Lu Chuan temporarily pauses with Zhao Lin inside the station.
Finding a place to sit down, Lu Chuan looks at the bag filled with Crystal Cores in his hand, showing a satisfied expression.
From this battle, Lu Chuan gained abundantly, obtaining dozens of second-tier Crystal Cores, and his third-tier Corpse Puppets increased by more than a dozen.
In a short time, Lu Chuan’s strength has greatly improved.
Leaving Jianghai City was indeed the right move.
Thinking of this, Lu Chuan feels fully confident, his lips curling up slightly.
Inside Beicheng City, there are truly quite a few evolved zombies; with his ability to command zombies, his strength will continuously grow stronger as long as he keeps fighting.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 266: Dire News!
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 266: Dire News!
After temporarily stopping at the gas station for a while, and once his Corpse Puppets had acquired enough fuel, Lu Chuan controlled the convoy to set off again.
Next, he needed to find a suitable place for the convoy to spend the night. There were many zombies in Beicheng’s urban areas, so he couldn’t be careless.
As night fell, Lu Chuan led the convoy directly into a residential area, intending to spend the night there.
...
Qingshui Farm.
With Lu Chuan and the others gone, and the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall protecting the perimeter, zombies and Fierce Beasts couldn’t get in at all.
Thus, inside the farm, it sunk into permanent silence. In just two days, the once-bustling farm started showing signs of decay, moss began to appear in the corners of the houses, and cobwebs formed under the eaves.
In the vegetable field, the seeds Zhao Lin planted had now shown pale yellow sprouts, diligently emerging upwards.
Buzzing~
At this moment, a helicopter flew in from afar, breaking the farm’s tranquility.
The helicopter didn’t land, instead, it hovered above the farm for a long time.
Inside the cabin, a robust, dark-skinned middle-aged Evolver observed below for a moment, then said to a white-haired old man beside him, "There’s nothing moving down there, completely empty, neither Evolved Zombies nor any trace of the Evolutionary Squad."
"I smell a lingering scent of blood, let’s go down and take a look!"
The white-haired old man furrowed his brows and sniffed downward, Chen Sheng said.
The middle-aged Evolver nodded.
Then, the two of them descended along two ropes.
Looking at the flat empty courtyard, the middle-aged Evolver asked in confusion, "Didn’t the intel say that there was a vegetable field in this farm? Why is it gone? And those Evolved Zombies..."
As the other spoke, the white-haired old man beside them slowly squatted down, gazing at the dark red ground, and his expression instantly became grave.
"Look at this, and combined with the few gaps in the wall over there, it’s very clear that a major battle occurred here, most likely it was the Sky Squad fighting the enemy."
"These are soil stains of blood! And the Sky Squad members..."
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged Evolver quickly squatted down, picked up a handful of dark red soil, sniffed it at his nose, and his face changed dramatically, harboring a bad premonition.
This operation involved the Sky Squad from the Imperial Capital and three Elite Evolver Squads from Jianghai Base City, if something had gone wrong...
"It’s too soon to draw any conclusions, let’s first search this courtyard, see if we can find any other clues."
The white-haired old man stopped the other from speaking further, speaking gravely and solemnly.
"Okay, I’ll follow your lead."
The middle-aged Evolver felt heavy-hearted, nodding his head.
At present, it’s indeed too soon to jump to conclusions; it’s better to wait until concrete evidence is found before making any assumptions.
The two then separated to meticulously search the courtyard.
Moments later, the middle-aged man stood in the corner of the courtyard, shouting, "Captain, come quickly, I found a clue."
Hearing the voice, the white-haired old man who was searching the residential area hurried out, rushing over to the place.
"Where is it?"
"Captain, look!"
The middle-aged Evolver grimly pointed to a pile of rubble ahead.
There, the wreckage of several helicopters lay among the rubble. It looked like these helicopters had been struck by external forces, each one flattened, with large fist marks on their hulls.
"These helicopters should be...they should be the very ones Captain Lin and his team flew..."
The middle-aged Evolver clenched his fists, saying in a deep voice.
The white-haired old man stared at the helicopter wreckage ahead, not speaking, but the grief was apparent on his face, reflecting his current emotions.
"Captain, if nothing unexpected happened, it’s very likely that Captain Lin and his team have already sacrificed themselves.
To dare to kill our officials, this bastard really has a lot of guts, he must be given no burial ground!"
The middle-aged Evolver hesitated for a moment, then, with eyes full of rage, gritting his teeth, he said.
"Hah! Let’s keep looking! Alive, we need to see them, dead, we need to find their bodies. We haven’t found Captain Lin and their bodies yet, there’s still a sliver of hope, we can’t give up."
The white-haired old man took a deep breath, turning to the middle-aged Evolver.
Even knowing that the hope was slim, he was still unwilling to make such a conclusion, what if there were other hopes.
"Alright!"
The middle-aged Evolver didn’t say anything further, nodding his head, he naturally also hoped that Captain Lin and the others were okay.
A few minutes later, in front of the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall, two figures stood side by side.
The surrounding atmospheric pressure was terrifyingly low, the dense chill emanated from both the white-haired old man and the other man.
At this moment, their gazes were both fixed below the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall, staying silent, while the white-haired old man still clutched a piece of bloodstained torn cloth.
After a lengthy silence, the white-haired old man looked down at the fabric in his hand and said, "This is a fragment of Captain Lin’s battle uniform, and these... seem to be their remains!"
Speaking, the white-haired old man looked toward the white bones beneath the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall.
"Captain, the Sky Squad and other Elite Squads seem to have all perished!"
The middle-aged Evolver nodded with a grim expression.
Things were already quite clear, the clues were laid out in front of them, and even if they wanted to deceive themselves, it was impossible.
"Let’s go! This Demon Vine is hard to deal with, we’ll gather the warriors’ remains next time. Now we must report everything as soon as possible, let the highest command know about this! This enmity, my Jianghai Base City will never forget!"
The white-haired old man squeezed the bloodstained cloth in his hand, speaking coldly.
After saying this, he turned quickly, striding toward the direction of the helicopters.
"Fellow comrades, you won’t have to wait too long, the Base City will avenge you!"
The middle-aged Evolver took a deep glance at the bones under the Bloodthirsty Vine Wall before leaving.
Jianghai Base City.
Dong Dong Dong~
The office door was knocked on.
"Enter!"
Seated at a desk, the highest commander put down his pen.
Squeak!
The door opened, and the secretary swiftly walked in.
"Sir!"
"Wang, what’s the matter? Have the investigation personnel that went to the Jiangnan City District returned? What are the results?"
The highest commander asked gravely and solemnly.
After the Sky Squad went to Jiangnan City District, there were no communications for two or three days, which gave Jianghai Base City a bad feeling, forcing them to send out investigators to look into it.
Secretary Wang hesitated, then finally braced himself and said, "Sir, the situation isn’t good... The Sky Squad and other Elite Squads seem to have all perished!"
"What!"
In an instant, the highest commander felt as if struck by lightning, he slumped into his chair, and within moments, seemed to age twenty years.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 267: Annihilation? Base City in Ruins!
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 267: Annihilation? Base City in Ruins!
Jianghai Base City, Conference Room.
After receiving the meeting notification, all the senior officials of the base city put aside their work and gathered here.
The Supreme Commander sat at the head of the table with a grim expression, exuding a low pressure and an aura of coldness.
The senior officials, seeing the Supreme Commander’s state, dared not speak to disturb him. The entire conference room was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
After a long silence, the Supreme Commander, with a stiff face, raised his eyes to the crowd and said solemnly, "Today, I called you here to inform you about Captain Lin and his team’s situation..."
After just one sentence, the Supreme Commander paused, his mouth opened slightly, as if the next words were hard to say and couldn’t come out.
The crowd glanced at each other, already having a bad premonition. Captain Lin and the others had been out of contact for several days, and they had secretly guessed if something had happened to them.
Now, seeing the Supreme Commander like this, everyone felt a pang in their hearts, more convinced of their judgment.
"Supreme Commander, did the Sky Squad succeed?"
One senior official couldn’t help but ask cautiously.
At this moment, other senior officials also looked over, eager to know the answer.
After all, to clear out the Corpse King or suspicious Evolver in Jiangnan City District, Jianghai Base City had spent a lot and lost many excellent Evolvers.
This time, they even brought over the Sky Squad from the Imperial Capital.
If this time they still fail, then Jianghai Base City truly has no solution.
Upon hearing this, the Supreme Commander sighed, looked at the white-haired elder next to him, and slowly said, "Captain Zhang, please tell everyone about your team’s findings in the Jiangnan City District."
This matter was a huge blow to the Supreme Commander. The Sky Squad was one of the five ace squads in the Imperial Capital, and now that it was wiped out, he didn’t know how to explain to the Imperial Capital.
There were also the three elite Evolution Teams he had sent out to assist; they were all top-notch talents in the base city, and they were all gone at once, significantly weakening the base city’s Evolver strength.
"Yes!"
The white-haired elder stood up, saluted, and said with a serious expression, "Honorable leaders, our team has already scouted the farm. According to related clues, it seems the Sky Squad and the three elite squads have all sacrificed themselves.
We found several wrecked helicopters on the farm, and upon inspection, confirmed they were the ones Captain Lin and his team were using.
Additionally, we found some fragments of battle uniforms belonging to Captain Lin and others under the Demon Vine outside the farm, covered in blood, along with many bones left after the Demon Vine’s consumption."
Upon hearing such horrifying news, the conference room was immediately in an uproar. The previously quiet atmosphere exploded, and everyone showed faces of shock.
"What? All sacrificed?"
"How could they all be sacrificed? The Sky Squad had the ability to fly; even if they couldn’t win, they could have escaped! What on earth happened..."
"It’s all over, even the Sky Squad is gone. How powerful must the opponent be for Jianghai Base City to deal with such an entity."
"Damn it..."
"..."
