The crowd discussed, their expressions turning to anger.
At this moment, someone hurriedly asked the white-haired elder, "Captain Zhang, what about the Corpse King? What about the little girl? Were they successfully executed?"
Although hope was slim, if Captain Lin and the others perished together with the opponent, they would at least find some solace.
Hearing this, Captain Zhang replied with a somewhat unnatural expression, "Leaders, our team did not find the little girl’s body on the farm, and not a single Evolved Zombie was seen, leaving the area empty, indicating a fierce battle had previously occurred.
Moreover, the battlefield showed signs of having been cleaned up, with traces of craters and bloodstains on the ground concealed, and signs of tidying inside the central farm house..."
Before Captain Zhang could finish, the meaning he wanted to convey was already clear.
That is, the Corpse King is highly likely still alive!
The counterpart is not only alive but has also left the farm, whereabouts unknown.
Immediately, the senior officials burst into heated discussions, their voices filled with both shock and anger.
"So you’re saying the Sky Squad and the three elite squads didn’t just suffer total annihilation without achieving anything, but they also let the Corpse King escape, and we don’t even know where they are now!"
"This is the incompetence of the Sky Squad; they boasted before leaving, claiming it would be a breeze, and now, not only have they been completely wiped out, but they also failed to kill the Corpse King.
Now, with the Corpse King vanished, how are we supposed to find them?"
"Indeed, this time Jianghai Base City has truly been sabotaged by the Sky Squad.
We initially thought they would resolve our issues, but it turns out they’re only adding to our troubles.
With the mission failed, the Corpse King is bound to resent Jianghai Base City. Once they grow stronger, how will we resist?"
"Alas, now Jianghai Base City is teetering on the brink. If we can’t locate the Corpse King soon and eliminate it before it fully matures, our base city will be threatened constantly..."
"..."
Bam!
"Enough! Everyone quiet down, complaining won’t solve the actual problem!"
Suddenly, the Supreme Commander slammed the table and sternly reprimanded.
Immediately, the conference room fell silent, and all the senior officials wisely shut their mouths.
"The Sky Squad, along with the three elite squads, couldn’t handle the opponent. Jianghai Base City has done its best. The most important thing now is to report the information to the Imperial Capital and request reinforcements again!"
The Supreme Commander’s heart was heavy as he spoke slowly.
With the current Evolver combat power of Jianghai Base City, even deploying all the Evolvers to confront the Corpse King might not suffice.
"Indeed, we have no clue where the Corpse King is hiding, meaning Jianghai Base City is constantly under threat.
Right now, our top priority is to explain the situation to the Imperial Capital and request support. Only then can the base city’s safety be more secure."
Deputy Commander Zheng on the left nodded in agreement.
Upon hearing this, the other senior officials also expressed their agreement, knowing that the security of the base city was paramount.
Not long after, Jianghai Base City sent the relevant information and request back to the Imperial Capital Base City.
The entire Sky Squad has been sacrificed!
The Corpse King has now left the farm, whereabouts unknown!
Additionally, requesting the Imperial Capital to dispatch reinforcements to Jianghai Base City as soon as possible!

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 268: Watching from the Shadows
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 268: Watching from the Shadows
Beicheng urban area.
A huge shopping mall, situated at the heart of the city, its former bustling prosperity now turned into desolation and decay.
The glass curtain wall surrounding the mall has been shattered, and the goods inside are scattered everywhere.
Near the entrance, a multitude of zombie corpses lie strewn about.
These dead zombies seemed to have suffered extremely brutal treatment when alive, either having their heads blasted open by heavy blows or sliced into several pieces by sharp weapons, their deaths are gruesome.
Outside a clothing store inside the mall, Da Pang and a group of hefty bodyguards are on duty, surrounding the clothing store tightly.
Zhao Lin is inside selecting clothes with Ji Ruxue.
After several consecutive days on the road, neither Zhao Lin nor Ji Ruxue had any new clothes to change into.
After Little Qiqi communicated the trouble to Lu Chuan, he brought them to the mall, cleared out all the zombies, and let the two engage in a true zero-dollar shopping spree inside.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, these pants suit you, try them on, they’re very loose and won’t restrict your body during a fight."
Ji Ruxue took a pair of black women’s casual trousers from a nearby rack and handed them to Zhao Lin.
"Okay, I’ll try them later!"
At this moment, Zhao Lin was changing into a women’s jacket, she smiled upon seeing the clothes brought by Little Qiqi.
"By the way, Little Qiqi, have you tried the little dresses I took for you earlier? Go try them, if they’re pretty, we can take them all with us later."
Zhao Lin reached out and took the pants, placing them on a nearby pile of clothes, and suddenly spoke to Little Qiqi.
"Not yet, I’ll try them now."
Ji Ruxue nodded, then rushed to the other side, grabbed a few light-colored butterfly dresses, and hurried into one of the fitting rooms.
For a moment, the two were going back and forth in the shop, trying on clothes incessantly, laughing and chatting, creating a stark contrast to the apocalyptic world outside.
They looked completely like a mother and daughter shopping for clothes in a mall before the apocalypse.
An hour later, Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin were finally satisfied, coming out with large and small bags, as if they were shopping before the apocalypse.
The Corpse Puppets guarding outside quickly acted, protecting the two in the middle.
Ji Ruxue just paused following Zhao Lin out of the mall, a strange glint flashed in her eyes.
She had just sensed a peering gaze from around, although fleeting, she definitely didn’t sense wrong.
Someone was watching them...
Is it someone from the Base City?
Or survivors from Beicheng?
Ji Ruxue wasn’t surprised about survivors and people from the Base City being in Beicheng, after all, Beicheng is resource-rich, these two groups of people were sure to be searching for supplies and hunting Evolved Zombies in the urban area.
Ji Ruxue’s gaze swept towards the distant high buildings, trying to pinpoint the location of the observer.
"Little Qiqi, what’s wrong, are you uncomfortable anywhere?"
Ji Ruxue’s abnormality caught Zhao Lin’s attention, seeing Little Qiqi’s somewhat off complexion, she asked worriedly.
"I’m fine, Mrs. Zhao Lin, it’s just that there are too many things, and I’m a bit unable to carry them!"
Coming to herself, Ji Ruxue smiled and said.
"Then let me carry some for you! It was inconsiderate of me; you’re still so young, how could I let you carry so many things!"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin’s worry eased, and she quickly helped Ji Ruxue by taking some items into her hands.
"Let’s go! We’d better head back, your dad should be waiting for us to have dinner."
Zhao Lin looked down at Ji Ruxue, smiling as she spoke.
"Mm! Mrs. Zhao Lin, let’s go back."
Ji Ruxue nodded, stepping forward to follow Zhao Lin.
Then, the two slowly left under the protection of a group of Corpse Puppets, Ji Ruxue glanced back, her eyes full of cold light.
No matter who you are, I hope you don’t seek death, or else the outcome for Jianghai Base City’s Evolvers will be yours.
Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin hadn’t gone far.
On the rooftop of a building several kilometers away from the mall, two sneaky figures are lurking on the ground, heads touching, whispering.
"How about it? Easy to deal with?"
One bald young man with a roguish face asked anxiously.
"Are you blind? That’s at least a third-tier Evolved Zombie, maybe even fourth-tier, are they something we can handle?"
The young man lying beside him turned his head, revealing a pair of strange vertical pupils, glaring at the bald one, speaking irritatedly.
"Third-tier Evolved Zombies? Even fourth-tier, really? What kind of people are these, to have such powerful Evolved Zombies protecting them!"
The bald young man was shocked, his mouth wide open, speaking in disbelief.
"You ask me, who do I ask? I don’t know where these two came from either, didn’t see them around before."
The vertical-pupiled youth shook his head, puzzled.
"It’s really odd, we’ve never seen it before, humans and zombies walking together, and the zombies don’t attack."
The flatheaded young man scratched his bald head, suddenly feeling like his brain couldn’t quite keep up.
This scene, was as if a mouse and a cat were playing together, equally explosive, beyond his imagination.
Recalling the scene he just saw, the vertical-pupiled youth was also incredibly shocked.
"Do you think that woman or that little girl might be Evolvers, capable of controlling those Evolved Zombies?"
The vertical-pupiled youth furrowed his brow, a Spiritual Light flashed, uncertain as he spoke.
Besides this answer, he couldn’t find any other explanation for such a phenomenon.
"Controlling zombies? Are you joking? If they truly had the ability to control zombies, those two women would be unstoppable, they’d be able to rule Beicheng even if sideways.
Tell me, are you scared stupid, talking nonsense here?"
Upon hearing this, the bald youth was startled, looking at the vertical-pupiled one like he was an idiot, speaking speechlessly.
"Then tell me, explain to me, why those Evolved Zombies are protecting those two women?"
The vertical-pupiled youth was immediately displeased, angrily questioning.
"I... I..."
The bald one was stunned, speechless; he didn’t know either!
"Think about it now, is what I’m saying possible?"
The vertical-pupiled youth looked at the bald one, scornfully spoken.
"Possibly... Though if it’s as you say, we must inform the big boss, and let him decide."
Faced with the vertical-pupiled youth’s questioning, the bald one helplessly chose to nod.
"Exactly, those two women carrying so many Evolved Zombies among us are too threatening; best to let the big boss know, and see how he acts!"
"Let’s hurry back then!"
The vertical-pupiled youth nodded, began to slowly get up, hunched over, heading for the stairs, while the bald one followed behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 269: Dragon Tiger Gang
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 269: Dragon Tiger Gang
After coming down the stairs, the vertical-pupiled young man quickly traversed the city with the bald guy, finally passing through a secret passage to enter an underground club.
This underground club had an enormous interior space, stretching out as far as the eye could see. Moving forward, places like bars and casinos were available in abundance.
Rumor had it that this underground club was built by some rich second-generation individuals before the apocalypse, offering a one-stop service for eating, drinking, and entertaining, exclusively for friends within their circle. Therefore, facilities like casinos, bars, and fight arenas could be seen everywhere here.
The vertical-pupiled young man, accompanied by the bald guy, greeted some people on the way as they walked toward a fighting ring.
By this time, a considerable crowd had already gathered below the spacious ring.
These people were whispering and discussing fervently, occasionally breaking into a series of cheers.
On the ring, a four-zhang-long Ice Python exuding a chilling aura was engaged in an intense battle with a robust-sized, fiery red Fire Tiger.
The Ice Python, covered in scale armor that resembled ice crystals, emitted a brilliant radiance under the lights, and as its thick tail swung, it sprayed a bone-chilling cold air toward the Fire Tiger.
The Fire Tiger, ablaze with flames, let out a violent roar, its massive body flashing as it dodged the python tail’s strike.
Boom!
The cold-endowed python tail struck directly on the ring’s ground, creating a crater in the rock-hard surface, causing the crowd below to emit a gasp of astonishment.
The Fire Tiger, having dodged the python tail, immediately launched a counterattack. The flames around its body suddenly intensified, and with the aid of the high temperature, it pressed against the cold air sprayed by the Ice Python as it charged straight ahead.
Roar!
The contact of cold air and flames birthed a large mass of white mist. The Fire Tiger, like a bolt of lightning, dashed out of the mist, swinging its blazing tiger paw fiercely at the Ice Python.
Unexpectedly, a glint of cunning flashed in the Ice Python’s indifferent eyes, and at the last moment as the Fire Tiger charged up, it sidestepped the attack, while its thick tail once again whistled toward the Fire Tiger.
Caught off guard, a look of shock crossed the Fire Tiger’s eyes as it hurriedly turned to block, its tiger paw clashing with the incoming python tail.
Boom!
With a loud crash, a terrifying shockwave swept through all directions, causing the bodies of those below the ring to sway as they retreated in fear.
Squeak~
After the collision was over, the Fire Tiger’s body was forcibly pushed back, its four claws scraping the ground, sliding backward over ten meters on the ring before finally stopping.
The Ice Python’s tail, however, was repelled in this collision, smashing hard against the edge of the ring.
"Hahaha, exhilarating, little brother, let’s do it again!"
At this time, the Fire Tiger’s eyes were filled with fighting spirit, surprisingly speaking human words, it chuckled and said.
With that said, the Fire Tiger instantly charged toward the Ice Python.
"Big brother, take a break!"
The Ice Python said somewhat helplessly.
Unexpectedly, the Fire Tiger did not listen at all, stubbornly charging to attack, leaving the Ice Python no choice but to make another move as they engaged in another fight.
After ten minutes, with no winner or loser between the Fire Tiger and the Ice Python, they finally stopped.
Amidst the cheering of the crowd, the two beasts consecutively transformed into human forms.
The Fire Tiger transformed into a sturdy man with a flat-top hairstyle, a bare upper body adorned with several tattoos, while the Ice Python transformed into a slender young man with cropped hair, fair skin, and a stern face.
If observed closely, one could find that although the two differed in age and physique, they bore a seventy-percent resemblance in appearance.
Because the two were biological brothers and also the leaders of the Dragon Tiger Gang.
Both brothers had awakened the Beastification Ability, one capable of transforming into a Fire Tiger, the other into an Ice Python.
After the apocalypse arrived, the brothers, relying on their formidable strength, gathered many Evolvers and established the Dragon Tiger Gang, using this underground club as a base.
"Little brother, your strength has grown fast enough! Now you’re almost on par with your big brother.
Perhaps in a while, your big brother might not be able to handle you, at which time, I’ll step down and let you take over as the leader!"
Zhang Xi walked over, patted Zhang Qing on the shoulder, and said with a hearty laugh.
"Big brother, what are you talking about? We’re brothers, why make such clear distinctions? If it weren’t for you risking your life to save me several times before, I might have long died at the hands of the Evolved Zombies."
Zhang Qing frowned and said.
"Alright, alright, I’ll listen to you. While being the leader is enjoyable, it’s also quite exhausting. Since you don’t want it, I’ll keep at it for now."
Seeing his brother frown, Zhang Xi retracted his hand and shook his head, saying.
"Come on! I’m starving, let’s get something to eat!"
At this moment, most of the spectators had already left, and Zhang Xi led his brother down the ring.
"Leader, second leader, I have something to report."
Seizing the opportunity, the vertical-pupiled young man, along with the bald guy, hurried forward and respectfully said.
"Zheng Yu, what’s going on with you and Bald Guy?"
Zhang Xi and Zhang Qing halted their steps. Zhang Qing looked at the two, frowning, and asked.
"Second Leader, Leader, Bald Guy and I just found a woman and a little girl in the city, constantly protected by Evolved Zombies. Those zombies were at least at the third stage, possibly even the fourth.
We dared not act rashly and returned specifically to report to both of you!"
Zheng Yu explained earnestly.
A woman? And protected by Evolved Zombies?
Hearing this, both Zhang Xi and his brother were extremely surprised.
"Zheng Yu, are you pulling my leg? Since when did Evolved Zombies stop attacking people and start protecting them?"
Zhang Xi raised his eyebrows, questioning in disbelief.
"It’s true, Leader, if you don’t believe me, you can ask Bald Guy, he saw it too."
Zheng Yu felt urgent as he spoke.
Under the gaze of the three, Bald Guy hurriedly nodded.
"Big brother, Zheng Yu and Bald Guy have no reason to deceive us, what they’re saying should be true.
If Evolved Zombies are protecting humans... Could it be that the other party is an Evolver with the ability to control zombies?"
At this point, Zhang Qing’s eyes twinkled as he speculated.
"Exactly, second leader, that’s what I thought earlier too!"
Zheng Yu promptly nodded in agreement.
"Controlling zombies? That’s unbelievable. If she’s allowed to grow, will there still be room for our Dragon Tiger Gang in Beicheng City?
No, no, little brother, quickly gather men, and let’s eliminate them now!"
Upon hearing this, Zhang Xi was flustered, hastily calling out.
"Big brother, don’t rush! An Evolver capable of controlling zombies is rare indeed.
If we could win them over, with the help of their zombies, the strength of our Dragon Tiger Gang would rapidly expand!"
Zhang Qing quickly held Zhang Xi back, advising.
This is a valuable Evolver capable of controlling zombies, Zhang Qing thought they must seize this opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 270: Invitation to Join the Gang? Refused!
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 270: Invitation to Join the Gang? Refused!
Beicheng City, He Garden District, Building Eight, Room 301.
Er Pang and Lightning One were stationed at the entrance to the community, while other third-tier Corpse Puppets patrolled the complex continuously.
The remaining Da Pang and other fourth-tier Corpse Puppets were stationed downstairs and outside the room door.
Only Lightning One was responsible for guarding the living room, preventing any flying Mutated Fierce Beast from crashing through the windows.
In this arrangement, Lu Chuan and the other two were thoroughly protected.
In the kitchen, Lu Chuan was cooking, with the gas stove spitting blue flames.
The smoke and steam rising from the pot filled the kitchen with a dense haze.
Due to a power outage, the range hood couldn’t operate, and the kitchen window was opened to let out the smoke, which dispersed very slowly.
Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin, both in fresh clothes, sat laughing as they played a Monopoly-type game on the living room sofa.
Suddenly, amidst the smoke while cooking, Lu Chuan paused, a flicker in his eyes.
Sensing something, he instantly turned off the flames on the stove, closed his eyes, and transferred his consciousness to the Corpse Puppets outside the complex.
Moments later.
Rumble~
A modified car slowly drove to the entrance of the complex.
After stopping, Zhang Xi, Zhang Qing, and several Evolvers from the Dragon Tiger Gang got out of the car.
"It really is an Evolved Zombie, seems like Zheng Yu wasn’t lying!"
Staring at Er Pang and Lightning One at the disaster-stricken entrance, Zhang Qing looked shocked, with an even greater desire to contact the Evolver inside who controlled these Evolved Zombies.
If he could persuade that person to join the Dragon Tiger Gang, they’d dominate Beicheng City, and the dangerous Evolved Zombies of the city would no longer threaten them.
"Bro, this, this... what tier are these Evolved Zombies, so fierce?"
Looking at Er Pang’s frame, Zhang Xi stammered as he asked.
This physique is terrifying, isn’t it fourth-tier?
"Big brother, it might be third-tier, but fourth-tier is possible too, however, the aura on them is too strong, likely fourth-tier."
Zhang Qing said gravely, focusing on Lightning One and Er Pang.
"What should we do? Should we just drive the car in? I don’t believe these two can stop us."
Zhang Xi seemed eager to try, considering his car was specially modified, and thinking these zombies, with their flesh and blood, wouldn’t be able to withstand the spikes on the car’s front.
With this thought, Zhang Xi impatiently took out his keys...
"No, don’t! Did you forget why we’re here?"
Zhang Qing pulled his brother back, a bit exasperated, knowing his brother meant well but sometimes acted impulsively, without thinking things through.
"Right, right, we’re here to...invite them."
Zhang Xi suddenly realized.
Today was the day to invite others to join the Dragon Tiger Gang, not to pick fights or shed blood.
Roar!
Perhaps alerted by Zhang Xi’s movements, Er Pang and Lightning One turned their gaze, with Er Pang roaring and wielding an iron rod that shook the ground with each step.
Facing Er Pang’s towering frame and terrifying presence, the group in front felt shaken.
"Brother, quickly, get me the loudspeaker."
Zhang Qing held out his hand to Zhang Xi.
"Here!"
Zhang Xi nodded, quickly unhooking a large loudspeaker from his waist and handing it to Zhang Qing.
This loudspeaker was almost identical to those used by fruit vendors before the apocalypse.
Taking the loudspeaker, Zhang Qing swiftly called out towards the complex: "Friends inside, we mean no harm. Could you come out for a chat?"
Hearing this, and with his consciousness in Er Pang’s body, Lu Chuan paused, refraining from moving forward, simply watching the other party while remaining guarded in case of tricks.
These survivors turned Evolvers, having lasted in the city this long, couldn’t be entirely benevolent, and Lu Chuan remained extremely wary of their motives.
Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin in the living room heard the shout from outside and immediately paused.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, it might be some Evolvers from Beicheng City. What should we do? Do we need to inform Dad?"
Ji Ruxue asked Zhao Lin.
"No need, such a small matter doesn’t need to trouble your Dad, I’ll go have a look. If it’s nothing, I’ll send them away soon."
Zhao Lin shook her head, getting up from the sofa.
They were probably just a few Evolvers; the district was heavily guarded by the Corpse King’s Evolved Zombies, so even if they had ill intentions, they couldn’t possibly harm them.
"Mrs. Zhao Lin, I’ll go with you!"
Fearing for Zhao Lin, Ji Ruxue quickly got up, taking her hand.
"Okay, but stay by my side and don’t run around."
Zhao Lin initially didn’t want to agree, but the security provided by the Corpse King’s fourth-tier Zombies reassured her, so she nodded.
With Building Eight close to the entrance, Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue quickly arrived.
Seeing Zhang Xi’s group by the car, Zhao Lin, holding Little Qiqi, feigned indifference and asked coldly, "What do you want?"
"Ma’am, we’re from the Dragon Tiger Gang. My brother and I are the second and first leaders of the gang. We’ve admired your abilities from afar and came here to invite you to join our Dragon Tiger Gang."
Zhang Qing said politely, smiling warmly.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue exchanged surprised looks.
Both understood the absurdity of their proposal, having a Corpse King on their side...
Asking a Corpse King to join an Evolver gang?
Absurd.
Ji Ruxue lightly shook Zhao Lin’s hand, and Zhao Lin immediately understood, directly refusing: "Sorry, I’m not interested in joining the Dragon Tiger Gang. Please leave!"
Being directly rejected, Zhang Xi and his group’s expressions turned sour.
Zhang Qing quickly hid his displeasure, grabbing Zhang Xi’s hand to prevent him from lashing out, then smiling, "Ma’am, please don’t worry, we truly mean no harm.
You must know that going solo in these end times is ineffective; sometimes, only united strength ensures survival in this harsh world.
Moreover, you have a child with you, trying to survive alone while caring for a kid is too much.
If you join us, you’d only need to focus on combat, the gang will handle everything else, including caring for your little one...what do you think?"

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 271: The Night Monster Feared by the Dragon Tiger Brothers
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 271: The Night Monster Feared by the Dragon Tiger Brothers
To be honest, from Zhao Lin’s perspective, what the other party said wasn’t entirely without reason. If it were anyone else, they might have agreed.
After all, for a woman with a child trying to survive in this end-of-the-world scenario, it truly is difficult.
But unfortunately, those are considerations for ordinary people. Zhao Lin is different, with the Corpse King protecting her. Not only can she survive without relying on collective strength, but she can even live quite well.
Besides, given the personality of the Corpse King, how could it possibly join this so-called Dragon Tiger Gang?
Of course, Zhang Qing didn’t know any of this, which is why he was so puzzled by Zhao Lin’s outright refusal.
Is this woman really so confident that she can rely on herself to survive?
"Gentlemen, please leave! I don’t want to say this for the third time!"
Zhao Lin, with a calm expression, once again issued the eviction order.
"You..."
At this moment, Zhang Xi, looking at Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue with an indifferent, seemingly disdainful face, suddenly flew into a rage, unable to suppress his violent temper any longer.
Just as Zhang Xi was about to rebuke Zhao Lin, a deafening explosion, like thunder, erupted beside his ear, and at the same time, the ground beneath him shook violently.
Zhang Xi, feeling dizzy and disoriented, couldn’t help but take a few steps back.
Roar!
Then Er Pang, who had been standing still, took a sudden step forward and let out a growl, releasing a powerful aura that overwhelmed the members of the Dragon Tiger Gang, causing their hearts to tremble with fear.
Monster!
Impossible to fight against.
At this moment, both Zhang Qing and Zhang Xi looked pale. It’s probably their first time facing a fourth-tier Evolved Zombie at such close range.
If this Evolved Zombie weren’t under someone’s control, they might have been killed instantly.
"Ma’am, since you’re unwilling, our Dragon Tiger Gang won’t insist. Farewell!"
Zhang Qing, whose head was still ringing from the roar, knew that this was not a place to linger and politely spoke to Zhao Lin before hastily pulling Zhang Xi and several Evolvers from the Dragon Tiger Gang into the car and leaving the community.
Watching the truck slowly vanish at the corner ahead, Zhao Lin looked down at Ji Ruxue and said, "Little Qiqi, just by looking at the Dragon Tiger Gang, you can tell they’re not good people. This time, I’m afraid they won’t give up easily. Although our strength isn’t afraid of them, the other side might launch a surprise attack. You need to remind your dad to be careful and vigilant, so as not to give them an opportunity."
"Okay, Mrs. Zhao Lin, I’ll go back and tell Dad right away!"
Ji Ruxue nodded obediently. She understood the logic, and judging from the recent encounter, she estimated the other side wasn’t up to any good.
And they must have mistaken Zhao Lin for an Evolver who could control Evolved Zombies, which is why they sought to recruit her.
But now that Zhao Lin has rejected them, these people certainly won’t let it go.
However, Ji Ruxue wasn’t worried at all. Given the other side’s strength, they posed no threat to her and her dad.
......
Dragon Tiger Gang headquarters, underground club.
Bang!
"A stupid woman and her brat dare act so arrogantly! Refusing a toast only to drink a forfeit!"
Zhang Xi furiously slammed the table, spilling several beer glasses across it, with the liquor filling half the table.
The gathered underlings were as silent as cicadas in winter, not daring to speak, creating a heavy atmosphere.
"Brother, calm down. I didn’t expect that woman would so decisively refuse to join our Dragon Tiger Gang!"
Zhang Qing said, trying to appease Zhang Xi, shaking his head helplessly.
Logically speaking, a woman with a child in this world should see joining their Dragon Tiger Gang as the best option. He truly can’t understand why she refused.
"Hmph, no, no, we can’t just let this go. What’s so great about being able to control zombies? I must teach her a lesson!
Since the end-times, no one has dared to show me any defiance, and this time, I must smash her face!"
Zhang Xi let out a cold snort, the anger burning in his eyes, his fierce aura causing quite a few subordinates to shrink their heads in fear.
Turning his head, Zhang Xi urged Zhang Qing not far away: "Little brother, quickly gather the troops!"
"Brother, that’s a fourth-tier Evolved Zombie. It’s not something we can handle right now, even if we go all out; we probably wouldn’t be a match for it.
Moreover, we don’t even know how many fourth-tier Evolved Zombies they have. If there are many, we might all be doomed."
Zhang Qing said, trying to persuade Zhang Xi anxiously.
This is no joke; a fourth-tier Evolved Zombie is not something they can take on. If his brother remains stubborn, all of them might die.
Zhang Qing’s mention of a "fourth-tier Evolved Zombie" was like a cold bucket of water over the furious Zhang Xi, bringing him back to sanity.
That’s right, even with more people, facing a fourth-tier Evolved Zombie would just be a death sentence.
"So what should we do now? Beicheng is our Dragon Tiger Gang’s territory. The zombie Crystal Core is ours. How can we let others have free reign?"
Zhang Xi frowned and looked at the calm Zhang Qing, inquiring.
He’s always been accustomed to seeking advice from his brother.
Often, at moments like this, his clever brother would come up with ideas.
"Brother, with our Dragon Tiger Gang’s current strength, we can’t compete with that woman, but don’t forget about that monster."
"We can use a borrowed sword to kill."
As he spoke, a glint of coldness flashed in Zhang Qing’s eyes.
That woman’s ability is terrifyingly strong, with immense potential. If given time to grow, Zhang Qing was sure that the small Beicheng wouldn’t be her final destination.
However, two tigers cannot share one mountain. Beicheng is the territory of their Dragon Tiger Gang, and they cannot tolerate others encroaching. Since she refuses to accept the goodwill of their Dragon Tiger Gang, they would have to eliminate her in advance.
The mention of the word "monster" made even the usually arrogant Zhang Xi look serious and filled with dread in his eyes.
The surrounding Dragon Tiger Gang members, upon hearing about that monster, also stirred restlessly, their faces filled with panic.
Obviously, the monster Zhang Qing mentioned left an extremely deep impression on them.
There’s a rule in the Dragon Tiger Gang that they cannot take action at night.
This rule was specifically made because of this monster.
That monster is known for its nocturnal activities.
"It’s a good idea. That monster’s power is immense. Even if that woman’s subordinate has a fourth-tier zombie, it may not be a match for it. It would be best if both sides suffer, and our Dragon Tiger Gang can reap the benefits."
The more Zhang Xi thought about it, the more he found the plan feasible. If the plan went smoothly, their Dragon Tiger Gang had a great opportunity to eliminate two big threats at once.
However, soon the smile on Zhang Xi’s face disappeared, and he said with some worry, "That monster doesn’t listen to us at all, so even if we want to use a borrowed sword to kill, it won’t work!"
"Haha, brother, we don’t need that monster to follow our command. The monster craves blood, so we’ll give it blood."
Zhang Qing chuckled and said confidently.
"You mean..."
Zhang Xi’s eyes suddenly brightened.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 272: Tier 4 Licker!
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 272: Tier 4 Licker!
Nighttime.
On the streets of Beicheng City, aside from the dragging sound of zombie footsteps, silence reigns.
In the He Garden District, Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue have already fallen asleep peacefully.
Lu Chuan lounges on the living room sofa, using his consciousness to link with evolved corpse puppets scattered throughout the district, monitoring every move outside through their perspectives.
Whoosh~
Suddenly, a faint sound of something cutting through the air is heard above the dark He Garden District.
An evolver with wings, dressed in black, slowly flies into the district, carrying a bucket exuding a fishy scent in his right hand.
The next moment, the evolver quickly descends, slightly tilting the bucket, his body weaving through the district.
Before long, the evolver has scattered the blood inside the bucket all over the district.
In a brief span, a thick scent of blood spreads rapidly through the district with the evening breeze.
After dispersing all the blood into the district, the evolver, seemingly worried about something, hurriedly flaps his wings and swiftly escapes the He Garden District.
But the sound of his vibrating wings has already caught Lu Chuan’s attention.
A third-level corpse puppet hidden in the greenery sits upright, the one squatting on the rooftop raises its head, while the one stationed in the stairwell gazes through the glass...
In an instant, dozens of blood-red eyes fixate on the gradually departing figure in the sky.
"What is this person trying to do?"
With a flicker of his gaze, Lu Chuan controls an evolved corpse puppet to approach the area where the blood was scattered, wanting to see what kind of conspiracy the person is plotting.
But then, he discovers what was scattered on the ground is a kind of blood-red liquid.
"Is this blood?"
In an instant, Lu Chuan understands that someone is trying to stir trouble.
"It must be the Dragon Tiger Gang!"
Lu Chuan squints slightly, forming a hypothesis in his mind.
During the day, Little Qiqi had warned him to watch out for the Dragon Tiger Gang’s retaliation; true to the prediction, they began their move at night.
Roar roar roar~
Soon, the bloody scent begins to spread rapidly, wafting out of the district in no time.
The zombies roaming outside the district smell the pungent bloody scent, become extremely agitated, and roar as they rush toward the district.
Not long after, a large group of zombies gathers at the district gate, their roars continuous and raucous.
Unfortunately, guarding the gate is Er Pang, embodying a stance of indomitable defense; his large iron club swings out with residual shadows, mercilessly suppressing all zombies attempting to breach the gate.
For a while, the cracking sounds of skulls resemble a symphony.
By now, Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin are also awakened by the commotion.
"Dad, what’s happening?"
Ji Ruxue, dressed in sleepwear, frowns slightly, opens the door, and looks toward Lu Chuan on the sofa.
"Lu Chuan, are zombies attacking the district?"
Listening to the zombie howls, Zhao Lin asks with some confusion.
Logically, there shouldn’t be an attack on the district; they’ve stayed quiet without making any noise.
Lu Chuan takes out paper and pen, writes down what he discovered, and hands it to them.
After Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin understand the situation’s origins, they too guess it was the Dragon Tiger Gang stirring trouble.
"Such vile methods, unwilling to confront us directly, resorting to these disgusting tactics. Humph, next time I encounter them, I must take them down!"
Zhao Lin snorts coldly, speaks angrily.
However, Zhao Lin isn’t worried; with the Corpse King around, the opposing zombies are brought in vain.
Thinking of the Dragon Tiger Gang secretly rejoicing at their evil scheme’s success, Zhao Lin can’t help but chuckle coldly.
"Indeed, we must teach them a lesson."
Beside her, Ji Ruxue nods, agreeing.
"These zombies are too weak; for your father’s evolved zombies, it’s merely the flick of a stick."
Watching Er Pang playing "baseball" below, Zhao Lin laughs and says.
"Indeed, relying on these zombies to deal with us, the Dragon Tiger Gang surely overestimates their capabilities."
On a stool, looking down, Ji Ruxue nods.
"However, they don’t seem like foolish people; perhaps they have follow-up plans."
Zhao Lin frowns, thinks for a moment, and speaks uncertainly.
"Don’t worry, Mrs. Zhao Lin, with my father’s evolved zombies, even their backup plans can’t alter the outcome for us."
Ji Ruxue is incredibly confident in her family’s strength, speaking with absolute self-assurance.
Now her father commands dozens of third-level evolved corpse puppets and seven fourth-level evolved ones, rendering the Dragon Tiger Gang’s strength futile against them.
Suddenly, a piercing howl echoes from the opposite rooftop.
Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin’s expressions change, quickly looking over.
A blood-red figure emerges from the rooftop, swiftly scales down the outer wall, charging towards Zhao Lin and Ji Ruxue.
A horrifying zombie devoid of skin, its entire musculature exposed in blood-red.
This zombie’s limbs appear exceedingly robust and powerful, particularly its legs, with bulging muscles, seeming capable of leaping several meters in a single bound.
From its spine, four pairs of elongated, vine-like tendrils extend, each tipped with barbed suckers.
Most terrifying is the zombie’s head, with its brain atop revealed, encased in a layer of blood-colored crystal; this crystal is highly transparent, rendering the zombie’s brain clearly visible from outside.
Simultaneously, the zombie’s mouth resembles petals divided into four parts, filled with sharp, hook-shaped teeth, with a strange, snake-like tongue akin to a blood-red serpent weaving in between.
"This... is a similar type of zombie to the bloodthirsty monster in the Sunshine District?"
Utilizing the zombie’s perspective, Lu Chuan instantly recognizes it; this zombie bears a striking resemblance to that in the Sunshine District.
However, presumably due to a difference in level, the current bloodthirsty zombie, now at fourth-level, has undergone some changes.
"It’s really a Licker, no wonder they scattered blood..."
Looking at the blood-red evolved zombie, Ji Ruxue finally understands why the Dragon Tiger Gang wanted to spread blood in the district.
Lickers are incredibly sensitive to blood; the opponents aim to use it to lure the Licker in for an attack on them.
This tactic, truly despicable!
On the other side, realizing the bloodthirsty zombie’s approach, Lu Chuan feels a surge of urgency, quickly commanding a fourth-level corpse puppet to intervene.
This bloodthirsty zombie is extremely formidable, undoubtedly a difficult foe!

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 273: Subjugation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 273: Subjugation!
The Licker moved with incredible speed, its limbs touching the ground. In the blink of an eye, it crawled down from the tall building opposite and swiftly leaped between the two buildings.
If given a little more time, the Licker would inevitably reach the third floor of Building Eight, posing a threat to Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin.
Lu Chuan naturally wouldn’t let this creature have its way. Just as the Licker descended from Building Nine, the fourth-tier Corpse Puppets stationed in various positions moved under Lu Chuan’s control.
Lightning One, standing in the living room, moved behind Ji Ruxue and Zhao Lin for protection while Earth Escape One came to Lu Chuan’s side.
Tyrant One, stationed at the entrance of Building Eight, and Da Pang, quickly charged at the Licker, followed by Flame One and Flame Two, ready to strike at any moment.
Da Pang suddenly went berserk at the entrance of the district, knocking away all the oncoming zombies, sweeping through the horde, killing most of them, then hurriedly returned to the district.
By this time, Tyrant One and Da Pang had already trapped the Licker at the foot of Building Eight.
"Dad is taking action!"
Seeing a series of rapidly moving fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, Ji Ruxue said with relief.
Indeed, with so many zombie subordinates as ears and eyes, any movement in this district would be known to dad instantly.
Zhao Lin also completely relaxed now. With the Corpse King present, this evolved zombie, no matter how terrifying, couldn’t pose any threat.
"Why does this Bloodthirsty Monster look even uglier now?"
Through the perspective of Tyrant One, Lu Chuan could see this Bloodthirsty Monster more clearly and found it even more hideous and ferocious compared to when it was seen in Sunshine District.
However, Lu Chuan wouldn’t underestimate it just because of its appearance. Although the Bloodthirsty Monster looked ugly, its abilities were not to be underestimated.
Especially that tongue, resembling a long spear.
The previous Bloodthirsty Zombie in Sunshine District nearly killed Lu Chuan.
"Roar!"
The Licker gazed at its kind blocking its path with violent eyes, its mouth splitting into four parts like a blooming flower, letting out a scream.
In the next moment, the Licker’s feet pushed off the ground forcefully. It charged towards Tyrant One and Da Pang with speed like lightning, its sharp claws gleaming coldly, aiming at Tyrant One’s chest.
Roar~
Da Pang and Tyrant One, undeterred, roared and swiftly charged forward under Lu Chuan’s control.
Boom!
They collided instantly. The Licker’s sharp claws cut across Tyrant One’s chest, slicing through the black armor and leaving a shallow gash.
Tyrant One’s swinging claws tore through the Licker’s right arm, pulling off a piece of flesh.
Immediately, their bodies collided, and the impact wavered Tyrant One’s stance.
The Licker, light on its feet, tried to lock its limbs around Tyrant One’s body, while its long tongue hovered above, attempting to stab down into Tyrant One’s head.
Roar~
Tyrant One roared furiously, slamming its arms towards the Licker’s body, trying to pull it off, while its claws frantically tore at the Licker.
At this moment, Da Pang’s attack arrived.
Boom!
Da Pang’s massive iron fist swung fiercely, accompanied by a terrifying whistling wind, striking the Licker’s waist.
The Licker let out a cry of pain, and its massive body was catapulted to the left like a cannonball.
Immediately, the Licker slammed heavily onto the concrete ground, rolling a few times and kicking up a cloud of dust.
From its mouth came a series of incomprehensible roars as it quickly got back up, staring coldly at Tyrant One and Da Pang.
At this moment, the various wounds on the Licker, including the deep gashes left by Tyrant One and the bleeding punch from Da Pang, rapidly healed and returned to normal.
Whoosh!
In an instant, the Licker transformed into a red lightning bolt, dashing towards Tyrant One and Da Pang.
Swish!
Next moment, the eight snake-like flesh tendrils on the Licker’s back shot out, the suckers on their tips clamping onto Tyrant One, pulling it forward.
Tyrant One staggered but barely steadied itself and swung its claws, severing the two flesh tendrils biting onto it.
The Licker let out a painful howl; its mouth opened wide, and a sharp long tongue shot out, targeting Tyrant One’s face.
Poof!
In the nick of time, Da Pang quickly stretched out its right arm, massive like a door panel, blocking in front of Tyrant One. The sharp tongue pierced through the black scales, embedding into Da Pang’s flesh.
Just as the Licker was about to retract, it was horrified to find its tongue caught on Da Pang’s arm.
Da Pang tightened its arm, pulling hard. The Licker, grounded on all fours, was forcefully dragged over, unable to break free despite its struggles.
At this time, Tyrant One finally severed all eight flesh tendrils gnawing on it. Looking at the Licker being dragged over, it launched an attack.
Facing Tyrant One’s sharp claws, the somewhat flustered Licker hastily raised its arm to block.
Rip!
Unexpectedly, its right arm was cut off.
The severed arm flew away, and with one less arm, the Licker lost its balance, being forcibly dragged on the ground by Da Pang, appearing extremely pathetic.
However, the Licker’s self-healing ability was incredibly strong. In a matter of moments, its severed flesh tendrils and arm began to sprout new flesh, rapidly regenerating.
"This evolved zombie’s self-healing ability is so strong!
If it weren’t for the defensive prowess of your dad’s evolved zombies, it wouldn’t have been defeated so quickly."
The attack power of this evolved zombie was evident. It even managed to pierce through the arm of that large fellow.
Faced with some fourth-tier zombies with weaker bodies, its tongue would have skewered them right through.
Seeing the Licker being restrained, Lu Chuan led Zhao Lin down the building, approaching the battlefield, spiritual power surging towards the Bloodthirsty Monster.
He intended to attempt controlling this Bloodthirsty Monster.
However, upon contact, Lu Chuan encountered great resistance. The Bloodthirsty Monster was unwilling to be controlled, even becoming furious, its eyes turning blood-red, more violent.
Roar!
With an angry roar, the Bloodthirsty Monster wanted to attack Lu Chuan.
Ji Ruxue secretly used Time Control, causing the Licker to pause, followed by Tyrant One striking it down to the ground.
At this moment, Lu Chuan finally overcame the resistance of the Bloodthirsty Monster in front of him, successfully taking control and turning it into his Corpse Puppet.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 274: Launching the Corpse Tide!
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 274: Launching the Corpse Tide!
The controlled Licker finally quieted down, and under Lu Chuan’s command, it gradually approached.
Da Pang relaxed his tense arms, pulling the Licker’s tightly locked tongue from his arm, allowing it to retract smoothly.
At this moment, looking at the bloodthirsty monster before him, Lu Chuan’s eyes were filled with joy, and his heart was immensely satisfied.
The reason he didn’t let Red Flame One and Red Flame Two attack just now was because he wanted to subdue this bloodthirsty zombie and turn it into his Corpse Puppet.
Over this long period, the Corpse Puppets Lu Chuan has collected were truly in the thousands.
But this type of Corpse Puppet, up until now, he still didn’t have under his command.
It’s unclear whether this type of zombie is too rare; this bloodthirsty zombie Lu Chuan encountered is the second he’s seen since the apocalypse.
The number is really pitiably small.
However, despite the small numbers, Lu Chuan was very satisfied with the abilities of this type of zombie.
Not only is its speed astonishingly fast, but its regeneration ability is frighteningly strong, and additionally, this Evolved Zombie possesses climbing abilities, suitable for various terrains, compensating for a weakness in Lu Chuan’s Corpse Puppets.
Besides that, there’s the terrifying long tongue; this tongue is almost impossible to defend against, especially in a fight with an enemy, when it suddenly shoots out, it can certainly catch the enemy off guard.
Corpse Puppets like Tyrant One and Da Pang might still rely on their flesh to block the bloodthirsty zombie’s attack, but if the target was Flame One, then the result would definitely be Flame One being directly pierced and losing combat ability.
"Since you have such a strong regeneration ability, let’s call you the Undead Zombie! From now on, you’re Undead One."
Thinking it over, Lu Chuan gave the bloodthirsty zombie a code name.
Wondering how long it might take before encountering Undead Two.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk, this one is really ugly! Almost unrecognizable as human, how could this zombie still take such a form!"
"To think these zombies might all evolve into bizarre forms in the future!"
Zhao Lin looked at Undead One with curiosity.
This zombie is the ugliest she’s seen among zombies, even a glance is unsettling.
Especially the slightly twitching, exposed brain, it’s truly disgusting.
Nearby, Ji Ruxue, who helped her dad successfully subdue the Licker, smiled.
Another fourth-tier combat power!
With the Licker, dad’s strength has significantly increased.
The more fourth-tier Evolved Zombies there are, the safer she and dad are in this apocalypse.
Especially a Licker!
Among Evolved Zombies, in terms of individual combat strength, Lickers are considered the strongest; its evolution state is like a killing machine.
Extreme speed can gain an advantage in combat, suppressing enemies with speed; its hidden sharp oral appendage can deliver a surprise kill in battle.
The spines on its back can bind and hinder enemy movements in battle; its formidable self-recovery ability allows it to keep fighting.
This Licker was born for battle.
This time, if the Licker hadn’t encountered Tyrant One and Da Pang, who are tough-skinned, and got a bit unlucky with its tongue being locked, they wouldn’t have been able to take it down so easily.
After all, with such speed, even if a Licker eventually can’t win, it can still choose to escape, being able to climb walls makes it very difficult to catch unless very fast.
And just then, Ji Ruxue frowned, her eyes turning cold.
Someone watching in secret?
The next moment, Ji Ruxue’s gaze began to search around, quickly spotting a figure standing on the rooftop of a high building outside the community, looking in their direction.
It must be the Dragon Tiger Gang!
"Dad, look, there’s someone up there..."
Ji Ruxue hurriedly grabbed Lu Chuan’s hand and pointed in the direction of the figure.
Lu Chuan and Zhao Lin turned their heads simultaneously and saw the figure on the rooftop.
The Evolver on the rooftop, upon being discovered, quickly flew away in the next moment, disappearing into the night.
"Hmph! No need to guess, it’s definitely the Dragon Tiger Gang scoundrels.
As expected, their purpose for spreading blood in the community was to lure this Evolved Zombie over to cause us trouble.
That Evolver was definitely here to check if we were dead!"
Zhao Lin’s eyes burned with fire and she yelled angrily.
"That’s right, Mrs. Zhao Lin, these people are truly too evil!"
Ji Ruxue nodded, then looked up at her dad, subtly reminding him: "Dad, their plan tonight failed; might they come again tomorrow?"
"Little Qiqi, you’re right, the Dragon Tiger Gang failed in their scheme to kill us indirectly, they’ll likely plot something bad again to deal with us, Lu Chuan, we must be prepared!"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Lin frowned and looked at Lu Chuan.
Only the Corpse King could resolve this matter.
"Since that’s the case, then there’s no need for this so-called Dragon Tiger Gang to exist! These guys dared to move against us, they should be ready to bear the consequences."
With these words, a cold glint flashed in Lu Chuan’s eyes, already sentencing the Dragon Tiger Gang to death in his heart.
Then, Lu Chuan wrote on paper: "Little Qiqi, leave this matter to dad, dad guarantees they won’t appear again."
"Mm, Dad, you’re the best!"
Ji Ruxue clenched her little fist and said with a smile.
Seeing the paper’s content, Zhao Lin knew the Corpse King was preparing to act against the Dragon Tiger Gang.
Naturally, Zhao Lin fully supported this decision; the sooner these disgusting guys are destroyed, the better.
Next, under Lu Chuan’s indication, Little Qiqi followed Zhao Lin upstairs.
Lu Chuan led some Corpse Puppets out of the community.
To eliminate the Dragon Tiger Gang, he needed to know their exact location; this time, the Evolver that came had flight ability, making tracking impossible.
So, finding the Dragon Tiger Gang’s base requires another approach.
And Lu Chuan’s solution is the human wave tactic!
Under the protection of Earth Escape One, Tyrant One, and other four fourth-tier Corpse Puppets, Lu Chuan stepped out of the community’s entrance.
The next moment, his Spiritual Power swept forward, instantly halting the motion of nearby wandering zombies, converting them all into Corpse Puppets.
Having reached fourth-tier strength, Lu Chuan can directly control low-level zombies within a thousand meters, turning them into Corpse Puppets.
Therefore, stirring up a Corpse Tide is effortless for him.
Then, Lu Chuan began walking along the street, and wherever he passed, zombies were directly controlled by him. Soon, a terrifying number of zombies gathered behind him, filling a wide street completely.
The dense mass of zombies moving slowly sounded like thousands of troops marching through the streets.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 275: The Tiger and Dragon Brothers’ Terror!
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 275: The Tiger and Dragon Brothers’ Terror!
As Lu Chuan’s mind stirred, a massive corpse tide rapidly spread across the city of Beicheng, searching every corner for the shadow of the evolvers.
Originally silent, Beicheng’s city streets suddenly became unbelievably lively.
Centered around He Garden District, Lu Chuan’s corpse puppets appeared on every street, searching every building, every room under Lu Chuan’s command, leaving no space unchecked.
Lu Chuan closed his eyes, relying on the vision of his numerous evolved corpse puppets to observe suspicious areas within Beicheng.
In Lu Chuan’s view, since the Dragon Tiger Gang is the local power, its reputation must be considerable, and the evolvers within the city surely have heard of it.
So, as long as he can find one evolver to question, he can basically obtain the location of the Dragon Tiger Gang.
Of course, if not a specific location, a vague area will suffice; with the corpse tide, Lu Chuan can search the area thoroughly in no time.
Even if the Dragon Tiger Gang is hiding in the sewers, Lu Chuan can find these guys.
Time slowly passed, the corpse tide spreading in all directions, groups of corpse puppets walking along each street, dense footsteps echoing in the dark city.
The wandering zombies along the route, influenced by the corpse puppets, slowly merged into the group, moving along with the corpse tide.
Consequently, as time went on, the scale of the corpse tide stirred by Lu Chuan grew larger, surpassing even his expectations.
Among the overwhelming corpse tide, only one of Lu Chuan’s puppet corpses appeared for every dozen ordinary zombies.
At this moment, if looked down upon from above, one would find the corpse tide spreading in all directions of Beicheng’s cityscape, increasing in number and size, seeming like a black and white flower growing larger and larger.
Minutes passed, yet no trace of the Dragon Tiger Gang or any evolvers was found; however, Lu Chuan was not anxious. As long as he searches the entire city, he will surely find them.
The Dragon Tiger Gang cannot escape his grasp.
...
Dragon Tiger Gang.
After being discovered, the evolvers with flying abilities quickly returned to the underground club.
A moment later, the evolvers hurriedly arrived before Zhang Xi and Zhang Qing.
"Haha, how did it go? Did that vile woman get eaten by the bloodthirsty monster?"
Seeing the evolvers return, Zhang Xi impatiently asked with a smile spread across his face.
Beside him, Zhang Qing frowned slightly, noticing that the evolver’s expression didn’t resemble a successful plan.
In his heart, a bad premonition arose; did they fail?
"Boss, Second Boss, it’s not good. The bloodthirsty monster... not only failed to kill the opponent, it turned around and was controlled by them.
Moreover, the opponent has under their command four-stage evolved zombies, not just one, roughly three or four."
The breathless evolver reported fearfully.
"What? Not only did they fail, that bloodsucking monster was also collected by that vile woman?"
Zhang Xi jumped up in shock, the smile on his face instantly vanishing, replaced by a deep gloom.
This power is too strong; if even the bloodthirsty monster can’t handle the opponent, how can the Dragon Tiger Gang possibly fight?
Beside him, Zhang Qing’s pupils contracted, a storm raging in his heart.
Their Dragon Tiger Gang couldn’t even contend with that bloodthirsty monster, yet they hoped to use it to eliminate that woman. Now it seems, truly laughable.
"Brother, what do we do now? The opponent is so strong, we can’t possibly win. Maybe we should just admit defeat, or else I fear the Dragon Tiger Gang won’t be able to stand."
At this juncture, Zhang Xi was already somewhat panicked, his previous arrogance nowhere to be found.
"Indeed, we can’t cause trouble for the opponent anymore. The Dragon Tiger Gang’s power is not on the same level; we should immediately withdraw, or else continuing may put us in grave danger."
Zhang Qing nodded heavily, showing immense apprehension towards Zhao Lin.
This woman has no fewer than one four-stage evolved zombie under her command, and now with a powerful bloodthirsty monster, it’s completely beyond the scope the Dragon Tiger Gang can handle.
"Brother, quickly gather all personnel from outside; now we cannot rule out that woman taking revenge on the Dragon Tiger Gang.
So this underground club is no longer safe, the opponent will inevitably track us here. Our Dragon Tiger Gang must relocate promptly."
Suddenly, Zhang Qing expressed his worries, speaking urgently.
They designed this scheme to kill indirectly, yet it was not clever at all. As long as the woman wasn’t foolish, she would undoubtedly discern the Dragon Tiger Gang’s intentions, so the likelihood of the opponent striking back is very high.
"Okay, okay, I’ll send someone to gather everyone from outside..."
Upon hearing, Zhang Xi was also internally apprehensive, that woman is terrifying; if she comes over, they probably won’t be able to escape, so he hastily nodded, preparing to call over his underlings.
Tap tap tap~
At this moment, a series of hurried footsteps echoed.
A member of the Dragon Tiger Gang rushed over, slightly panicked, saying: "Boss, Second Boss, something major has happened!
A massive corpse tide suddenly appeared in the city, thousands of zombies are frantically attacking all the streets, and it won’t be long before they reach us."
"What?"
Instantly, the expressions of the Zhang brothers changed.
"Why on earth is there suddenly a corpse tide? Quick, quick, gather everyone from outside, if they encounter the corpse tide, it’s over."
Zhang Xi hurriedly called out to the underlings nearby.
Now, more than half of the Dragon Tiger Gang’s people are outside; if they’re killed by the corpse tide, the gang will be seriously weakened.
"Yes!"
Upon receiving the orders, the underlings scattered, rushing out of the club to find people.
"Brother, we should go upstairs to have a look!"
With a dark expression, Zhang Qing suggested, frowning.
This corpse tide is strange; somehow he felt a vague sense of unease.
Could it be related to that woman?
"Alright, let’s move quickly!"
Zhang Xi nodded.
Moments later, the Zhang brothers reached the rooftop of the tall building above the club.
Gazing at the distant city, their expressions grew extremely grave.
Far away, the city streets were densely packed, countless zombies squeezed together, like numerous ants constantly surging, making the scalp tingle.
At this moment, the corpse tide resembled a tidal wave, engulfing everything, spreading along the streets towards the city, overwhelming and imposing, the sound of the corpse tide moving seeming like thunderous claps, shaking the spirit.
"This... this..."
Faced with such a massive corpse tide, the brothers’ complexion turned pale, unable to suppress their fear, legs weakening.
